body:
![IMG_20260519_092856.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWisjcJoRcKd6f2QuE3w8KWs6ATithJtp8MaLoGoD7dUP/IMG_20260519_092856.jpg)

### Judged
We get judged by people for even the simplest mistakes. They immediately forget the good things we've done for them and for others. But the truth is, they're doing worse away from our sight. Apparently, there is so much hypocrisy on their part. They never hear from us despite their actions. If they won't change, it will have its consequences.They should be thankful I'm not the kind of person who will retaliate, but they cannot expect me to be close to them. I need to protect my mental health and my peace.Initially, anger was within me, but I tried to fight it off. I won't let their hypocrisy and betrayal affect my whole being. They can go on with their backstabbing, but they're losing the trust of everyone.

### Tuesday 
I'm almost done with my laundry, and I'm glad. I already put some of those dry clothes in the closet, while others are still damp. Got some dirty clothes on the washing machine too. Meanwhile, it's so hot today. I probably lost a lot of calories from perspiring. 

### Waterfront Park
After our morning sign language field service, we had our lunch and rest in Subic Bay Waterfront Park. Fortunately, it's well-sheltered by huge trees to fight off the summer heat.

title: Postre frío de limón y galletas || Hive top chef
body: > Feliz Lunes amantes de la comida un cordial saludo a todos, espero esten genial y saludables, animada de estar aquí nuevamente esta comunidad de #foodiesbehive Hoy preparé un **Postre frio de Limón** una opción rápida y fácil para merendar. > Happy Monday, food lovers! Warm greetings to everyone—I hope you’re all doing great and staying healthy. I’m excited to be back here with the #foodiesbehive community. Today I made a **Lemon dessert**—a quick and easy option for an afternoon snack. ![1001717971.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23xL2YN9Ynu1anwNwXmZ2zia4Jz9ibHjeGhtJn5LS2d3j14BFdpKEbmFB48zoUqAPYs13.jpg)

> Cuando se trata de preparar un postre rápido, fácil sin necesidad de usar el horno y sobre todo delicioso, este postre de galletas es ideal, así que me fui al supermercado cercano compré galletas Maria que es la tradicional aquí en mi pais, podras usar sus favoritas, la leche condensada y crema de leche, también podras usar leche evaporada. Esta es la segunda vez que prepero este postre, aunque de manera muy diferente. Su sabor agridulce, poruqe contiene limón y su textura cremoso. Esta es mi entrada para el concurso semanal de el amigo qurator. Aquí mi receta a mi estilo. > When it comes to making a quick, easy dessert that doesn’t require an oven—and is, above all, delicious—this cookie dessert is perfect. So I went to the nearby supermarket and bought Maria cookies, which are the traditional choice here in my country. You can use your favorite cookies, condensed milk, and heavy cream, or you can use evaporated milk instead. This is the second time I’ve made this dessert, though in a very different way. It has a sweet-and-sour flavor, thanks to the lemon, and a creamy texture. This is my entry for the weekly contest hosted by my friend, the curator. Here’s my recipe, my way.
![1001717940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFThB6ouV4qiFc4zb4qbnRAPpvyjJS6eQrbkuQXN9cYNccXqdLMgZeuJynzU5t7QuyC.jpg)
> * 4 Limones * 1 paquete de galletas * Crema de leche * Leche condensada * Gotas de chocolate blanco * Rayadura de limón

> * 4 lemons * 1 package of cookies * Heavy cream * Condensed milk * White chocolate chips * Lemon zest
![1001717510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uFRzMJuXCLU2KS9h1PzoHiHbiS2V4h4UUsZmmLuxjQ6kAb2cqjJhqUp1o17KwLTDH1P.jpg)

>

Paso a paso| Step by step.

> 1.- Primero lavé los limones, rayé para obtener su rayadura reservé para decorar, luego exprimí para sacar su jugo. > First, I washed the lemons, zested them (setting the zest aside for garnish), and then squeezed them to extract the juice.

> ![1001717582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoEqaJzaJ38V5UkPA5GJWxbocFWiUv7XthpgChNwP2Y6H9vFJp1aDTFuDM7L8jbbeh3.jpg) ![1001717542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wgKYJ4b596KfPMNHXJ3bkhtd8DL7SYjfLRM8JjsN9AepFDxyqPNQacYP8bxJsz43QNL.jpg)
2.- En una licuadora agregamos la leche condensada, la crema de leche fría. > In a blender, add the condensed milk and the heavy cream.

>

  
   

3.- A continuación, agregamos el jugo de limón y lucuamos por 1 minuto.Debe quedar una mezcla muy cremosa.

    
> Next, add the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute. The mixture should be very creamy.


 
 

 

 
 
 



 
     

<hr>

 <center>

 









![1001717592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23w2m3zAAcYm45QF5LHjD5MiigVmv56FsDNWEAXBcVHYxXvuo9tvcs2aPrqZSN965ByDo.jpg)

![1001717591.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vhuD1whoF8C8nuY4JRR5ERH3QnbKz9wrcR9auy2CcHcEzSkXVwQYKxDPM7f5LYoXZUQ.jpg)


 


![1001717702.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vsQfkP1Vvag1tPLmUwRkZFtyq7qUMYChjaUkNxPgzpb7m7X9GiZVY94CE5Ut56PNnaU.gif)

<div class = \

> 4 Es hora de armarla capa de galletas, capa de la mezcla de limón, hasta el final. Decoré con la rayadura de limón y gotas de chocolate blanco, metí en el refrigerador por 5 horas o más. I’ll decorate it with lemon zest and white chocolate chips, then chill it for 5 hours or more.
![1001717571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wCJN8TnU6o8Urp2n6xdyjAhHyRgK87MaTAL6dThrGGtgktmTVEruKaHncHJobjRHNxC.jpg) ![1001717595.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uQtN5ax6GmQs9fnEFmKbd2fUDCAkCw7u6PP1damZfHEnqNkYZMPCmFM26o7YpnTPDri.jpg) ![1001717596.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23y8qeqqgXwHp6wkXCuf3BkuTEhZni4NKSgtz5Yi73oTaGxL7eCHNYqFvdyhBmW4xxbnM.jpg) ![1001717598.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tmMo9marcGv1ibfoBss527ddE4Fd4F5uVqis8F65VHmvmZx1DoSLg9bbZHbzusQS1Kw.jpg)

> A disfrutar de este súper postre, para la merienda de hoy, es buena opcion para celebrar aniversarios o cumpleaños, súper cremoso y delicoso y su sabor agrio y dulce complace los paladares exigentes. title: Un amigurumi personalizado muy especial
body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, Feliz #needleworkmonday, hoy les comparto otro amigurumi personalizado que hice esta semana, realmente esta comisión es muy especial porque se queda en familia, la cliente fue una prima que lamentablemente migró del país y sus padres aún están aquí, ella me pidió que por favor hiciera a mi tío y su esposa en versión amigurumi y me envió una fotografía como referencia, empecé haciendo a su madre en primer lugar y el resultado me gustó mucho, pues lo bonito de hacer amigurumis personalizados es que ninguno se parece a otro, cada uno tiene sus características únicas y siempre se trata de que incluso con las limitaciones que tiene la técnica amigurumi, hacer que tenga los rasgos representativos de la persona retratada. > Greetings dear community, Happy #needleworkmonday! Today I'm sharing another custom amigurumi I made this week. This commission is truly special because it's staying in the family. The client was a cousin who sadly emigrated, and her parents are still here. She asked me to please make amigurumi versions of my uncle and his wife and sent me a photograph as a reference. I started by making her mother first, and I was very pleased with the result. The beauty of making custom amigurumi is that no two are alike; each one has its own unique characteristics, and the goal is always to capture the essence of the person portrayed, even with the limitations of the amigurumi technique.
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Comencé trabajando desde los pies a la cabeza con hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25mm, para los pies hice 6 cadenas de base, hice dos hileras con aumentos en las puntas para obtener un ovalo de 20, sobre este trabajé dos hileras de altura y luego 3 con disminuciones en las punta para obtener el tobillo de 12 puntadas solamente, luego cambié de color para hacer el pantalón, la idea era hacer una especie de pantalón tipo jogger por eso debía ser ancho desde el tobillo hacia arriba por lo cual hice 4 aumentos para hacer una pierna de 16 puntadas de ancho, trabajé 11 hileras de alto y uní a la otra pierna con dos cadenas, hice aumentos para los glúteos y disminuciones para la cintura, decidí hacer el torso desnudo con el hilo color piel morena para hacer la blusa aparte, hice aumentos para los senos antes de unir los brazos y luego disminuciones para los hombros y cuello, extendí el cuello por 12 hileras para poder introducirlo mas adelante en la cabeza. > I started working from the feet to the head with acrylic yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook. For the feet, I made 6 foundation chains, then two rows with increases at the tips to create a 20-stitch oval. On top of this, I worked two rows for height and then three rows with decreases at the tips to create the ankle, which was only 12 stitches. Then I changed colors to make the pants. The idea was to make a kind of jogger-style pants, so they needed to be wide from the ankle upwards. I made four increases to create a 16-stitch wide leg, worked 11 rows for height, and joined it to the other leg with two chains. I made increases for the buttocks and decreases for the waist. I decided to make the bare torso with the brown skin-tone yarn to make the blouse separately. I made increases for the breasts before joining the arms and then decreases for the shoulders and neck. I extended the neckline by 12 rows so I could insert it later into the headpiece.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJmszosJrUZzktSdYED8yo85J4yy85cnkYSePS7PcKkjjVrWpftjrXZZ8kemS4v.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Hice la cabeza primero con 12 puntadas por 12 hieleras para hacer el orificio por el cual se introduciría el cuello, luego seguí con 6 aumentos por hileras hasta obtener 48 puntadas, hice 11 hileras sin aumentos , coloqué los ojos y luego hice 6 disminuciones por 7 hileras hasta cerrar, aparte hice la blusa de ese modo se podría vestir antes de hacer la unión del cuello por dentro de la cabeza, bordé corazones rosados en la blusa, luego hice el cabello, con 60 mechones de 12 cadenas y 12 puntos deslizados, para la cola de caballo hice 12 mechones de 24 cadenas y 24 puntos deslizados. Luego hice los detalles como el bordado de los ojos, la nariz, las orejas y los lentos los hice con alambre floral. > I made the head first with 12 stitches per 12 rows to create the opening for the neck. Then I increased by 6 stitches per row until I had 48 stitches. I worked 11 rows without increases, added the eyes, and then decreased by 6 stitches per 7 rows to close the opening. Separately, I made the blouse so it could be worn before attaching the neck to the head. I embroidered pink hearts on the blouse. Then I made the hair with 60 strands of 12 chains and 12 slip stitches. For the ponytail, I made 12 strands of 24 chains and 24 slip stitches. Finally, I added details like the embroidered eyes, nose, and ears, and I made the lenses with floral wire.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK2E3YErfFd2FRM8HcRWn2SjqiFa56TBVX4YR3LL11Xf7EyMkxfybySjAZsqR1e.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

title: Salud integral: Hablemos de temas de salud observados desde otro ámbito [esp-eng]
body:
<center>![1000027774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/Ep1YrgevVjSx8VNXrWpMJxynq77Eg4oDV558zYHQpJWjm2WewswudJP3HT7orUoP6QA.jpg)</center>

En esta nueva edición sobre temas de salud, vamos a hablar de esta parte importante pero desde otra vereda; es decir, ejemplificando el funcionamiento de nuestro cuerpo de manera fácil y cotidiana.

​La salud es un tema primordial y, a la vez, desconocido, ya que la mayor parte del tiempo sus palabras técnicas dejan a las personas fuera de foco. Por esta razón, siempre es bueno buscar entender nuestros padecimientos y saber a qué rama sujetarse para no colapsar tratando de comprender lo que, para el paciente, son \

. ​En este sentido, y habiendo hablado antes del sistema simpático y parasimpático, quizás sientas que aún no logras entender del todo su funcionamiento en el sistema nervioso. Así que vamos a ejemplificarlo de manera cotidiana y simple para que comprendas qué ocurre en esos picos altos.

Sistema nervioso

​El sistema nervioso simpático —que de simpático no tiene mucho— es la parte que actúa como la marcha atrás en un vehículo, ya que su principal función es la huida. En medio de su escape, podríamos imaginar que el cortisol y la adrenalina que se liberan en esta instancia son como el combustible que sale del carburador.
![1000027775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFKKevurq4rbeBAWep4bofVrXfaDBrMUMgGGwr1vsaLJVqWwZt8srvTa51Hw4YnLurH.jpg)
​El estrés, en ese sentido, sería el derrape de las llantas en el momento de la huida, y el fin de este proceso equivaldría a quedarse sin gasolina y frenar en seco. Es decir, aún queda el miedo abrupto, pero estamos en cero, tratando de asimilar lo ocurrido. Una vez que estamos aún con las manos temblorosas en el volante, por fin ingresa el sistema parasimpático, quien está a bordo del mismo auto aunque en ningún momento se nos haya ocurrido usarlo. Y es que, en el fondo, un episodio de carga alta de estrés no permite observar el freno de mano —mismo que lleva por nombre \

—, el cual ayuda a frenar la huida.
![1000027776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vrrftotbpKuH2i18Eay6kn1GMUyXWPAcH6R7p68j29zZQJH8HPFX2mJwTT7tBdi8sUM.jpg)
​Este proceso logra que paulatinamente se reduzcan las palpitaciones y el sudor, mejora la visión que antes estaba nublada, y disipa el nudo de la garganta y del estómago.

Estómago

​El estómago es el centro de nuestro sistema digestivo y, al ser considerado el segundo cerebro del cuerpo humano, recibe las emociones de forma directa; sus consecuencias se expresan a través de síntomas físicos reales, aun sin existir una patología de base en su inicio. ​Es decir, se manifiesta a través de molestias que muchas veces parecen \
, donde el nudo en la garganta y la sensación de saciedad temprana suelen ser los primeros indicios. Esta situación casi siempre detona en una \

, la cual puede volverse crónica e ir en aumento de manera lenta y silenciosa en su inicio, para luego gritar con fuerza en su clímax. **​Para entenderlo mejor, podríamos imaginar lo siguiente:** ​El esófago es un canal estrecho que se inflama por el temor a comer y a sentir los síntomas; al inflamarse, dificulta que el alimento baje de forma óptima. Por otro lado, el estómago en alerta genera mucho más ácido, como si tuviera un volcán en erupción, y para rematar, el píloro (la puerta de salida hacia el intestino) está cerrado con llave.
![1000027777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23u67KhzrvyW97BdiaAKybMZWmHPzc8LgRWyh7JpW1aY5NecQPXUPLrbN2AXb9mgQ91rE.jpg)
​Bajo este escenario, el alimento ingresa pero no se disuelve de buena manera; con la puerta cerrada, el gas a causa del ácido se acumula y busca una salida. Como sabe que solo hay dos opciones —bajar por el píloro o devolverse por el esófago—, termina subiendo en forma de eructos secos y constantes, o como vómito. Sin embargo, este vómito es distinto: es una espuma blanca que parece merengue cortado, la cual no es más que el moco protector que el propio estómago ha creado para defender sus paredes. ***

Conclusiones

​Las emociones son el detonante de cada dolencia y padecimiento, y muchas de estas nacen a causa de eventos específicos: traumatismos, tratos denigrantes, críticas o exceso de presión. Con esto quiero expresar que el sistema nervioso es una parte fundamental de nuestro cuerpo a la que, lamentablemente, muchas veces se le resta notoriedad y cuidado. ​Por otro lado, debemos ser conscientes de la importancia de consultar a un especialista médico. Esto es vital, en primer lugar, para quitar esa pesada capa de temor al suponer que la dolencia o el padecimiento es severo o grave. ​Para finalizar, es primordial buscar ayuda psicológica. Si la mente es la que está enfermando al cuerpo por no poder regular estos impulsos caóticos, estaríamos expuestos a un ciclo crónico que nos sumerja, de forma constante, en distintas enfermedades y sus respectivas dolencias. *** Próxima edición. 25 de mayo de 2026. *** ###
English
***
![1000027774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/Ep1YrgevVjSx8VNXrWpMJxynq77Eg4oDV558zYHQpJWjm2WewswudJP3HT7orUoP6QA.jpg)
​In this new edition on health topics, we’re going to discuss this important subject but from a different angle; in other words, by explaining how our bodies work in simple, everyday terms. Health is a fundamental yet, at the same time, unfamiliar topic, as most of the time the technical jargon leaves people feeling lost. For this reason, it is always good to try to understand our ailments and know which branch of medicine to turn to, so as not to become overwhelmed trying to make sense of what, to the patient, is a ‘maze of jargon’. In this regard, and having previously discussed the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems, you may feel that you still do not fully understand how they function within the nervous system. So let’s illustrate this in simple, everyday terms so that you can understand what happens during those peaks.

Nervous system

​The sympathetic nervous system — which isn’t all that ‘sympathetic’ — is the part that acts like reverse gear in a car, as its main function is flight. In the midst of this escape, we could imagine that the cortisol and adrenaline released at this point are like the fuel coming out of the carburettor.
![1000027775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFKKevurq4rbeBAWep4bofVrXfaDBrMUMgGGwr1vsaLJVqWwZt8srvTa51Hw4YnLurH.jpg)
​Stress, in that sense, would be the tyres skidding as we flee, and the end of this process would be like running out of petrol and coming to a sudden halt. In other words, the sudden fear remains, but we’re at a standstill, trying to process what has happened. Once we are still there with trembling hands on the steering wheel, the parasympathetic system finally kicks in; it has been in the car all along, even though it never occurred to us to use it. The fact is that, deep down, a high-stress episode prevents us from noticing the handbrake — known as the ‘parasympathetic’ system — which helps to bring the flight response to a halt.
![1000027776.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vrrftotbpKuH2i18Eay6kn1GMUyXWPAcH6R7p68j29zZQJH8HPFX2mJwTT7tBdi8sUM.jpg)
This process gradually reduces the palpitations and sweating, clears the previously blurred vision, and eases the tightness in the throat and stomach.

Stomach

​The stomach is the centre of our digestive system and, as it is considered the human body’s second brain, it receives emotions directly; the consequences are expressed through real physical symptoms, even without an underlying medical condition at the outset. ​In other words, it manifests through discomforts that often seem ‘phantom’, where a lump in the throat and a feeling of early fullness are usually the first signs. This situation almost always triggers ‘nervous gastritis’, which can become chronic and progress slowly and silently at first, only to flare up violently at its peak. **To understand this better, we might imagine the following:** The oesophagus is a narrow passage that becomes inflamed due to the fear of eating and experiencing the symptoms; when inflamed, it hinders food from passing through properly. Meanwhile, the stomach, in a state of alert, produces far more acid, as if it were an erupting volcano, and to top it all off, the pylorus (the exit gate to the intestine) is locked shut.
![1000027777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23u67KhzrvyW97BdiaAKybMZWmHPzc8LgRWyh7JpW1aY5NecQPXUPLrbN2AXb9mgQ91rE.jpg)
​In this scenario, food enters but does not break down properly; with the gate closed, the gas caused by the acid builds up and seeks a way out. As it knows there are only two options—to go down through the pylorus or back up through the oesophagus—it ends up rising in the form of dry, constant belches, or as vomit. However, this vomit is different: it is a white foam that looks like chopped meringue, which is nothing more than the protective mucus that the stomach itself has created to defend its walls. ***

Conclusions

​Emotions are the trigger for every ailment and condition, and many of these arise from specific events: trauma, degrading treatment, criticism or excessive pressure. By this I mean that the nervous system is a fundamental part of our body which, unfortunately, is often overlooked and neglected. ​On the other hand, we must be aware of the importance of consulting a medical specialist. This is vital, first and foremost, to dispel that heavy sense of fear that arises from assuming the ailment or condition is severe or serious. Finally, it is essential to seek psychological help. If it is the mind that is making the body ill by failing to regulate these chaotic impulses, we would be exposed to a chronic cycle that constantly plunges us into various illnesses and their respective ailments. *** Next edition. 25 May 2026. ***
![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)

title: II Edición Reto Villa Las Azucenas 2026. 🥇🙌🏽😎🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️🚵🏻🏔️
body: > Domingo de carrera en mi pueblito. Hoy participe en la II edicion del reto Villa las azucenas 2026, una carrera que une dos disciplina ciclismo y running hacia una ruta bien ruda la casita blanca de la montaña. La cita fue a las 7:00 am. mientras se termino de armar todo salimos a las 7:30 am los corredores primero, para nosotros eran 4,5 Km, de los cuales 3,5 fuero de puras fuertes subidas. El primer kilometro todos salieron volando, yo me reserve, controlando mi estrategia de frecuencia cardiaca, sabia que tenia que guardar energia para lo que venia, que era bien fuerte, y muchas veces me ha retado en los entrenamientos. Muchos runners comenzaron ya a bajar intensidad y otros a caminar a penas comenzamos la primera subida. Yo mantuve pasos cortos y controlados. Cada kilometro se hace eterno eran como correr otro kilometro adicional por cada kilometro, mantuve la calma, fui pasando a mis contrincantes, ya cuando senti que las dejaba atraz, en una de las subidas mas fuerte camine unos metros para recuperarme para el ultimo kilometro, que lo vi super eterno. En la meta me esperaba mi hija y mi esposo y me dio fuerzas, y sobretodo cuando se acerco mi hija y medice mama eres la primera mujer en llegar, eso me dio el combustible para terminar. --- Llegue a la meta, con las piernitas temblorosas, pero muy feliz, me decia a misma lo logre, gracias a Dios me recupere rapido, y feliz por ser la primera mujer en llegar, lo habia soñado, y gracias a dios todo se dio como mi corazon lo anhelaba. Recibi felicitaciones de todos mi compañeros runners, mi familia, ya que es un reto bien fuerte. Ser la campeona si que es un momento maravilloso de gloria,me senti como una heroe, es mi primer podio de campeona absoluta, si que se puede con disciplina, enfoque, constancia, y mucha paciencia. Mi tiempo fue 38,2 minutos. Recibi la medalla de parte del alcalde de la ciudad. Agradeciendo por esta maravillosa experiencia, una actividad maravillosa, excelente organizacion, un ambiente deportivo especial, con la fuerte conviccion de que estos ambientes son los que disfruto , y donde siempre quiero estar para vivir estas experiencias, y sobretodo si los comparto con mi familia, amigos, por un estilo de vida que quiero seguir disfrutando. Las carreras son la materializacion de nuestros entrenamientos. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Race day in my little town. Today I participated in the second edition of the Villa las Azucenas 2026 Challenge, a race that combines cycling and running on a very tough route to the White House on the Mountain. The event started at 7:00 a.m. While everything was being set up, we set off at 7:30 a.m.—the runners first. For us, it was a 4.5-kilometer course, 3.5 kilometers of which were nothing but steep climbs. On the first kilometer, everyone took off like a shot; I held back, monitoring my heart rate strategy. I knew I had to save energy for what was coming—it was really tough, and it had challenged me many times in training. Many runners started slowing down, and others began walking as soon as we started the first climb. I kept my strides short and controlled. Every kilometer felt like an eternity; it was like running an extra kilometer for every kilometer. I stayed calm, passing my competitors one by one. When I felt I was leaving them behind, on one of the steepest climbs, I walked a few meters to recover for the last kilometer, which seemed to go on forever. My daughter and husband were waiting for me at the finish line, and that gave me strength—especially when my daughter came up to me and said, “Mom, you’re the first woman to finish.” That gave me the fuel I needed to cross the line. --- >I crossed the finish line with my legs shaking, but I was so happy. I told myself, “I did it!” Thank God I recovered quickly, and I was thrilled to be the first woman to finish. I had dreamed of this, and thank God everything turned out just as my heart had longed for. I received congratulations from all my fellow runners and my family, since it’s such a tough challenge. Being the champion is truly a wonderful moment of glory; I felt like a hero. It’s my first podium as the overall champion—it really is possible with discipline, focus, perseverance, and a lot of patience. My time was 38.2 minutes. I received the medal from the city mayor. I’m grateful for this wonderful experience, a wonderful event, excellent organization, and a special sporting atmosphere—with the strong conviction that these are the kinds of environments I enjoy and where I always want to be to live these experiences, especially when I share them with my family and friends, for a lifestyle I want to keep enjoying. Races are the culmination of our training. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/hO4R5QJKf3b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/hO4R5QJKf3b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/ii-edicion-reto-villa-las-azucenas-2026)

body:
I am a person in that situation. I haven't seen my child in 2 months now and still don't know where they are. [As I wrote about today](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@beelzael/longing-for-the-sky-last-weeks-favorites), the accusations that Lily's mom is putting out against me are escalating. Nothing of child abuse yet, but it wouldn't surprise me. And a friend of mine got hit by that, too. Courts here are incredibly slow and have turned to the other extreme, believing the woman first instance, no matter what. Which I honestly hope has saved many lives, because the opposite was many times deadly here. 

So it's not black & white. It's a very complicated situation to be in. I do see the judgement in people's faces right away when the topic comes up, especially those who don't know me. And it's impossible to prove a negative, so I have to use the proof I have of her blackmailing and psychological abuse against me. It will be ugly, and I really wouldn't have wanted that. Especially for Lily. 

Unfortunately, most couples go for vengeance. Not for balance. Not to right, but to do the same. I really hope that I will find a way that puts Lily's wellbeing in the focus, not mine nor the mother's. Because that's what it's really about. And many people loose focus off that in all their emotions.

title: 祝福七安弟弟
body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![nH6LARj4DVA6GbFf_mmexport1779153926532.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/nH6LARj4DVA6GbFf_mmexport1779153926532/nH6LARj4DVA6GbFf_mmexport1779153926532.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

四月份的时候，七安弟弟不是叫我教他去币安出金的吗？大家可能忘了这件事了，但是我还是很记得的！年初残留0.03的时候打的化疗，到现在涨到了0.1，准备又去石家庄化疗了！七安弟弟，哎！他要移植了，癌细胞控制的不好！看起来挺壮健的一个小伙子，看不出生病，他其实颜值不错的！经常化疗，身体不好，而且他花了很多钱了！

[捂脸]我还好，未到白血病去移植，不用化疗[流泪]！他其实上年已经在骨髓库预约了！白血病就比较麻烦了，手术前后都要打化疗，我在仓里打，都难受的要死！还出现幻觉，然后人都模糊糊涂了！

不过他预约了，配到好的才是关键啦，快慢不是重点！配型不说的，有些人快，有些人慢！[吃瓜]我配的很多，但是很多人体检不过关！有些人好配型，有些人不好配型，而且点数又有要求，匹配度高才好的！

我最近也在努力运动，现在身体慢慢好了，希望炎症和血糖血脂下去！刚才提起来腿在路边弄鞋带都没事！以前腿都提不起来！感觉越来越好，希望七安弟弟也一样！

今天不做力量训练了，走够步数就好了！

title: ✨ Sometimes a mirror shows more than just your reflection
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQUjNPacWkVRe8dAMEJ94Yvs2Mpt2jgBLsC6E8fy8Y1kH/IMG_3941.jpg 

I took this picture without thinking too much about it.  
No perfect lighting, no special plan… just one of those random moments where I looked in the mirror and decided to capture it.

And honestly?  
I kinda liked what I saw.

Not because everything was perfect, but because I looked comfortable being myself for once.

I think that’s something I’ve been learning lately.  
You don’t always need to become a completely different person to feel beautiful. Sometimes you just need to stop being so hard on yourself.

Maybe that sounds dramatic 😅  
But I spend a lot of time in my head, probably because I read too many mangas where every character has an emotional crisis every five chapters.

Still… those stories make me feel understood somehow.

And maybe that’s why I enjoy little moments like this.  
Quiet, simple moments where I can just exist without pretending to be anyone else.

Just Lynda, her thoughts, and another mirror selfie ✨📱

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@lyndax/-sometimes-a-mirror-shows-more-than-just-your-reflection-gmm)

title: Night Work Activities; An Overtime Activities That Needs to Be Done
body: >\nDoing night work or as I we say overtime work without payment or salary is very normal for me specially when I had a busy day at morning until afternoon. Doing this kind of activities are not really easy for me and it is very tiring but enjoyable. The only ideas comes to my mind is to have a clean and organized house. Yesterday, I decided to perform my work at afternoon and it was already 6 in the afternoon. The first thing I did was to washed my clothes. Gladly we already have lots of water here because we stored lots of it at the big galloons. But I really not finished all of clothes to wash because the white clothes needs to soaked with water and powder soap so the dirt will easily removed.\n</div class=\

>

![IMG_20260518_181344.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTnxi2JEeNFBzSfoLBDAk6mH2NPesc5PVXV71e6hqir5/IMG_20260518_181344.jpg)
</center>
After washing the color clothes, I did the next work by arranging the dry firewoods at the dirty kitchen. I decided to out here so it will dry very fast because of the heat from the fire. I also already cooked rice for our dinner and the only thing I did was to arranged the firewoods so I can get it instantly when I will use it. It helps us here to save lots of money instead of buying gas stove and tanks that costs thousands of Pesos. 

![IMG_20260518_180505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeEiabmXNKzP5NX9GS7yQqz6fFHeVKxbvbJ4JdnyLXXoz/IMG_20260518_180505.jpg)
</center>
My Brother brought this fish and it added to me the work that I need to finish. Taking care fish specially cleaning the  the fish box pond. I separated the small fish from big fish and transferred here in this small container. I don't have dun collecting this kind of fish and I wondered why my Brother really wants to collected it. 

![IMG_20260518_180543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakXhJk84DLD7ULF6ACVrBJayYWyqrLsCjYSnyButcs5j/IMG_20260518_180543.jpg)
</center>
Next, I almost forgot to check and visit my seedling tray placing at the corner of the house. This seedling tray contains chilli pepper seeds and I planted it almost 3 days already. I really wish it will grows and start planting lots of it again here at the garden. This seedling tray I'd used was found at the garbage area and I've seen and brought it home. It will usable again by planting seeds. There are still lots of vacant seeds pots that needs to filled and I keep looking for any vegetables seeds to plant so the  seedling tray will fulled.

![IMG_20260518_181919.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWJTUT9jU1Y1ajW7GxMGoDWSgWNQBHAAnRn17VNwsiPKs/IMG_20260518_181919.jpg)
</center>
I also put some ornamental plants inside of the house as an indoor decorations. I decided to put my aglaonema plants inside because the color is fit inside at the grows of the plants is stabled and healthy. Gladly I have junk sound box, I recycled it and used into a plant placer. This is my first time to placed ornamental plants inside of the house. 

![IMG_20260518_180850.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbLqrskxbh2T8gJTpCPEdnbPh1JUUPjxJ8KGKE1bHKwg7/IMG_20260518_180850.jpg)
</center>
Arranging my stuff toys also needs to be done to make the place well organized and neat. My niece was visited us here and the stuff toys are all over the place because she played it. As they went back home, I started to arranged it again. I really like to collected different kinds of stuff toys and gladly I already have lots of it.

![IMG_20260518_181834.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPc3Ver5K2geLxVjnoFURrcztcY4GLGU5HCpktmVYdWBr/IMG_20260518_181834.jpg)
</center>

![IMG_20260518_181730.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2YpidmYwH1H72wEZSc2RChmKg4e2iNRXKX3d698VZat/IMG_20260518_181730.jpg)
</center>
After that, I also heated the left-over foods  my Aunt gave to us. Luckily the foods are not yet spoiled because we put it in the refrigerator. This foods are some of my favorite and it really needs to heat or recooked before eating it. Now, the foods for dinner are already prepared.

![IMG_20260518_180811.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVRzDr7Y1gMmXstDkSGwrcGM6SL5Avh3zCBkxdzQHokgc/IMG_20260518_180811.jpg)
</center>
While eating the dinner together with my Parents, We also watched our favorite cartoon movie to my laptop. We really had a wonderful dinner while watching. Dinner together with family helps the family relationships stronger and strengthen.  

![IMG_20260518_181233.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUeeUMB9EqddW6BK7XYpRTds6Mgk1DbJ8yBkQtrdAoAxy/IMG_20260518_181233.jpg)
</center>
After keeping and washing the plates we used for dinner, the movie was also ended and I decided to went to my bedroom to read my favorite book. This is a kind of self-development combined with spiritual topics about God. 

Even if it is already evening, still I did my job and obligations in life very well. Another obligations and tasks are waiting for the next day. 

Have a nice day to all of us.

title: Who Will?
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXikYwYEbQAxhXkU3hC7jH7THBG5QhJFDnhooL3jqjjFN/1779153509239.jpg)

ဖြည်းဖြည်းမှန်မှန် နိုင်ပွဲဆက်နေတာက Arsenal ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာ ကစားသွားသည့် EPL Round 37 ပွဲစဉ်မှာ Burnley အသင်းကို ၁-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရသွားခဲ့လေ၏။ ပထမပိုင်း ၃၇ မိနစ်မှာ Havertz က သွင်းယူပေးသွားခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ ယခု နိုင်ပွဲကြောင့် ၃၇ ပွဲ ကစားပြီး ၈၂ မှတ် ရရှိထား၏။ အဆင့် ၂ က City ကို ၁ ပွဲအသာဖြင့် ၅ မှတ် ဖြတ်ထား၏။ City က ၃၆ ပွဲ ကစားပြီး ၇၇ မှတ် ရရှိထား၏။ 

နက်ဖြန် မနက် ၁ နာရီမှာ Bournemouth vs Man City တို့ ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ အဆိုပါ ပွဲစဉ် သရေရလဒ် ထွက်ပေါ် ခဲ့မယ်ဆိုရင် Arsenal တို့ ချန်ပီယံ ဖြစ်ပြီ။ City အနေဖြင့် မဖြစ်မနေကို အနိုင်ကစားဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။ လောလောဆယ် ၁၆ ပွဲဆက် ရှုံးပွဲမရှိ စံချိန်ရရှိထားသည့် အိမ်ရှင်အသင်းကို City တို့ အနိုင်ကစားနိုင်ပါ့မလားက စိုးရိမ်စရာပင်။ ဒီပွဲသာ မနိုင်ရင် ချန်ပီယံ မျှော်လင့်ချက် ပြီးဆုံးသွားမှာမို့ City တို့ အစွမ်းကုန် ကြိုးစားဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။

Bournemouth အနေဖြင့် အဆိုပါ ၁၆ ပွဲထဲမှာ Liverpool နဲ့ ၃-၂၊ Man United နဲ့ ၂-၂၊ Arsenal ကို ၁-၂ ဖြင့် နိုင်၊ သရေ၊ နိုင် ကစားထားနိုင်ခဲ့၏။ အသင်းကြီးတွေကို ကောင်းကောင်းကြီး ဒုက္ခ ပေးထားနိုင်သည်ဟု ပြောလို့ရ၏။ လက်ရှိမှာ ၃၆ ပွဲ ကစားထားပြီး ၅၅ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၆ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ လာမယ့် ရာသီ Europa League ဝင်ရောက် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ခွင့်ရထားပြီ ဖြစ်၏။ ယခု ပွဲစဉ်ကိုသာ အနိုင်ကစားထားနိုင်မယ် ဆိုရင် Liverpool ၏ UCL ဝင်ခွင့်ကို ချိန်းခြောက်နိုင်မှာမို့ Bournemouth တို့ ရေကုန် ရေခန်း ကစားသွားဖို့ ရှိနေ၏။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLu6dgPkntccw5sQJgwhVTSjwbmx3Cw2MMkzqMN28M5J/1779153509215.jpg)


Bournemouth vs Man City ပွဲလိုပဲ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ ကောင်းသည့် နောက်ထပ် ပွဲစဉ် ၁ ပွဲ ရှိနေခဲ့၏။ Chelsea vs Tottenham ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်၏။ Chelsea အတွက် လက်ကျန် ပွဲစဉ်တွေက ဘာမှ ထူးခြားမှု မရှိတော့ပေမဲ့ Tottenham အတွက်ကတော့ ပွဲစဉ်တိုင်းက ဗိုလ်လုပွဲတွေအလား ကစားသွားရဖို့ ရှိနေ၏။ ယခုပွဲစဉ်ကို သရေကစားနိုင်ရုံဖြင့် EPL မှာ တင်ကျန်ခွင့်ရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ရှုံးလို့တော့ မရပေ။

Chelsea အနေဖြင့် အမှတ် မလိုဘူး ဆိုပေမဲ့ EPL မှာ ရှုံးပွဲဆက်နေမှုကို ရုတ်တရက်ကြီး ချေဖျက် ပြချင်လာရင်တော့ မပြောတတ်ပေ။ ပြီးခဲ့သော စနေနေ့ FA Cup ဗိုလ်လုပွဲမှာလည်း City ကို ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့ရသေးသည် မဟုတ်လား။ မထူးတော့ပါဘူးလေ လန်ဒန်သား အချင်းချင်းပဲဟု တွေးပြီး သရေပဲ ကစားခဲ့မယ်ဆိုရင် နောက် လန်ဒန် တသင်း ဖြစ်သည့် West Ham တို့ တန်းဆင်းရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ နက်ဖြန်ပွဲစဉ်တွေက ချန်ပီယံနှင့် တန်းဆင်းရမယ့်အသင်းတွေ အဖြေထွက်ပေါ်လာနိုင်၏။ ထိုသို့ မဟုတ်ခဲ့ရင်တော့ နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ်တွေအထိ အဆုံးအဖြတ် ရယူသွားဖို့ ရှိနေ၏။

title: Mini pencil ✏//Mini lápiz ✏
body:
<center>

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 5.33.20 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23wMTvxEPoj1igxvPd4nivpJWXKirutWmRYTmFTdXxYSNrUdcwaPJbHPrki8JpAYQhYcQ.jpeg)


</center>


![Separador_de_texto_costura-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/EoCh8pE4fzkgoHFSQZ8Riwd7mbVhRgZ1LQ2VHvRaVsfe7p6xURwbpZ3g2gfmjW3miTU.png)

---

  <center>

#### ✏Welcome to my blog//Bienvenidos a mi blog✏</center>

		
---

<div class=\

> ***Hello #NeedleworkMonday***. Happy Monday—it’s a pleasure to be here. I wanted to share this cute, simple amigurumi crochet project: a mini pencil ✏, a very useful tool that I’ve been using since I was a child. Here are the details on how to make it.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #Needleworkmonday***. Feliz lunes, es un placer estar por acá. Quise compartir este bonito, sencillo proyecto de tejido amigurumi. Un mini lápiz ✏, una herramienta muy util, y que desde niña he estado usando. Paso a dar detalles de su elaboración.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Cotton yarn in pink, lilac, yellow, white, and black. - Size 2 crochet hook. - Stuffing.
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo de algodón, rosado, lila, amarillo, blanco y negro. - Aguja crochet Nº 2. - Relleno.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 5.33.20 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23xySuChiJPQsHSemzSwiDEC7MibSBmNUh1vV1yzmnC7pv8WLTgxpNY3WSRCv9mXMxCdP.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> #### Pink. - R1: Magic ring, 6 sc, sl st to close. - R2: 1 inc, repeat, sl st. - R3–R5: 1 sc in each stitch, working into the back loop, repeat, sl st. #### Lilac. - R6–R7: Repeat R3. #### Yellow. - Rows 8–14: Repeat Row 3. #### White. - R15: Repeat R3. - R16: 2 sc, 1 dec, repeat sequence, sl st. #### Black. - R17: 1 sc, 1 dec, repeat, sl st. - R18: 1 dec, repeat. - Fasten off, cut, and weave in ends. #### Pendant At the top, insert pink yarn and chain 25 stitches; single crochet in the first chain.
ESPAÑOL

#### Rosado. - v1: Anillo mágico, 6 mp, pr. Cerrar. - v2: 1 aum, repetir, pr. - v3-v5: 1 mp en cada punto, en la hebra interna, repetir,pr. #### Lila. - v6-v7: Repetir v3. #### Amarillo. - v8-v14: Repetir v3. #### Blanco. - v15: Repetir v3. - v16: 2 mp, 1 dism, repetir secuencia, pr. #### Negro. - v17: 1 mp, 1 dism, repetir, pr. - v18: 1 dism, repetir. - Anudar, cortar y ocultar hilo. #### Colgante En la parte superior, se inserta hilo rosado y 25 chs, pr en el primera ch.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 5.34.41 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23vhwxbcW4yAJFpvMm1arem9RSBkvfdBQrJz7crFeJ3AjASXnbcxXGt7o7cqtBoqQKVsn.jpeg) ---

> #### ***... And there you have it: the mini pencil ✏*** I finally made this mini pencil; I’d been meaning to do this for a long time until I saw it yesterday and decided to knit it. I looked for scraps of cotton yarn in various colors—a perfect project for using up those leftover bits of yarn that often get tangled up between projects and turn into a mess. Then I realized that with this mini pencil ✏, I could recycle them♻. It’s an easy project aimed at beginners. We can give this piece as a keychain or bookmark to our teachers on their birthdays, since Teacher’s Day has already passed here. This mini pencil will be for my daughter, since she’s a teacher and loves collecting keychains in her backpack.
ESPAÑOL

#### ***... Y listo el mini lápiz ✏*** Por fin hice este mini lápiz, tenia mucho tiempo con este pendiente hasta que ayer lo vi y decidi tejer. Busque retazos de varios colores de hilo de algodón, un proyecto adecuado para usar estos trozos de hilado que muchas veces se nos enredan entre piezas y se vuelve un caos. Entonces vi que con este mini lápiz ✏ lo iba a reciclar♻. Es una pieza fácil dirigido a principiantes, esta pieza la podemos obsequiar como llavero o marca libro a nuestros maestros y profesores en sus cumpleaños, porque aqui ya pasó el día del maestro. Este mini lápiz será para mi hija, ya que ella es docente y le encanta coleccionar llaveros en su morral.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 5.36.38 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23xydoBEsA7fSA7VqDp5GDYiLzAj4rNFbNqz6QXtktJ5yLb9Gt4pt7L1ZsybKhX6tmw9X.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 5.35.46 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23vsXCanU62XvdCMs6Tfgqp392ZyrwasRsMNwCrrfebQ47kDYzx3RwTN3pDN4GJ7XgX47.jpeg) --- ***Friends, did you like this little ✏amigurumi pencil? I'd love to hear your thoughts...***
ESPAÑOL

***Amigos, ¿les gustó este mini lápiz ✏amigurumi? Sus opiniones son bienvenidas...***

***
#### Well my friends #Needleworkmonday, have a nice day! >#### Bueno mis amigos #Needleworkmonday que tengan ¡un lindo día! --- 💖💖💖Everything with **LOVE** is achieved💖💖💖 >💖💖💖Todo con **AMOR** se logra 💖💖💖 --- #### So much for my publication. Thank you for reading.❤ >#### Hasta aquí mi publicación. Gracias por leer.❤ *** Texts and photos are my authorship. Translation with Deepl. Photo taken with Xiaomi Redmi Note 8. title: My Actifit Report Card: May 19 2026
body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g85f5b653c72d37d99f25af1630d1714793b62542f265e2a1fd5b57d2729663e2617a3173e18cca0efdfcbe810ac35c1a8dc1fb05420d950e87eb8a08d70f4806_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente inspiradora. Empecé por un parque local, donde vi a un grupo de niños jugando al fútbol. La alegría en sus rostros era contagiosa, y no pude evitar sonreír mientras pasaba. Me detuve un momento para admirar cómo un niño, que parecía ser el más pequeño del grupo, logró hacer un gol impresionante. La camaradería entre ellos era palpable, y me recordó la importancia de la diversión y la amistad. Más adelante, me crucé con una mujer que estaba pintando un mural en una pared. Su pasión se reflejaba en cada pincelada, y el mural representaba la diversidad de la comunidad. Me quedé observando un rato y, al acercarme, me contó que había estado trabajando en este proyecto durante semanas, buscando color y vida para embellecer el barrio. La forma en que hablaba de su trabajo me inspiró a reflexionar sobre cómo el arte puede transformar un espacio y conectar a las personas. Finalmente, terminé mi recorrido en una pequeña cafetería que descubrí por casualidad. Decidí entrar y disfruté de un delicioso café, mientras escuchaba a la gente conversar y reír. Cada día en la ciudad trae consigo nuevas historias y conexiones, y hoy no fue la excepción. Sin duda, seguiré explorando y disfrutando de cada rincón de este lugar vibrante. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title: New scientific discovery: Charger rickshaw
body:
![1000096617.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWf2F7faQdnbH5wGov3bZfboa1JGXB87KUD8TSLW7ch7Q/1000096617.jpg)

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-man-sitting-on-a-cycle-rickshaw-6462436/)

When I was very young, I saw several rickshaws. Basically, those rickshaws were used to carry passengers by pedaling their feet. A rickshaw puller had to work hard to make a living. After waking up in the morning, he would take his rickshaw out in search of passengers. If he found passengers anywhere, the rickshaw puller would take the passengers by pedaling their feet and take them to their destination. Just as the rickshaw puller had a lot of trouble here, the passengers also wasted their time. An office worker took a rickshaw and set off for his office. However, there is no way to go very fast. Because a rickshaw puller has started his journey by pedaling his feet and there is no possibility of going there fast. On the one hand, the rickshaw puller is having a lot of trouble and on the other hand, the passengers' time is wasted. To reach the office on time, they have to leave the road about one to one and a half hours in advance.


![1000096614.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQXHux7uCGgL3j6S2mRh7NaMwgA1EtCQy9NKUc9Mb1sjs/1000096614.jpg)


Basically, in this era of technology, it is very difficult to accept this issue. So those who have modern technology and scientists have found a solution to this problem. Although it is very late to modify it, but even then it has made our life easier and more beautiful. Nowadays, a rickshaw puller can easily earn his livelihood because now our rickshaws no longer have to be pedaled. Now we are using motors with great pleasure and speed and our rickshaws have become very fast. Some time ago, when rickshaws were driven by pedaling, only two passengers could be carried in a vehicle. Even then it would have been very difficult. But now our rickshaws are using motors and good quality batteries. We are using electric power. It takes about 6 to 7 hours to charge a rickshaw. But when that rickshaw is taken out on the road and it gives a backup of about 15 hours. That is, we can drive for about 15 hours by charging the battery for only 7 hours and there is no fear of getting tired.  The biggest thing is that we can save our time. Where it used to take an hour earlier, we can reach our destination in just 15 minutes. Before the charging system was set up in the van, only two passengers could be carried. However, now the design of this vehicle has been improved and arrangements have been made to accommodate 10 passengers. By using only one lithium battery and one controller, an excellent charging system has been made in our rickshaws. This helps us save time on one hand and reduces our pain on the other. Moreover, this charger van makes an important contribution to our livelihood.


![1000096618.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTrLVDMt6gWUcPpZ8fXtavnSmbh7uBuKuPY7kF3F96u4p/1000096618.jpg)

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/aerial-view-of-bustling-dhaka-street-traffic-37408554/)


Basically, to live in the modern world, we must know about new technologies. The more we resort to technology, the more beautiful our life will be. Currently, we are living in the modern world and everything has a touch of modernity. Basically, in this scientific world, we have got updates in everything. As time goes by, our modern science will become more advanced. I salute this contribution of science and I want to thank them immensely for this achievement.

title: Kickstarter Project Aims to Bring Internet Connectivity to Sega Genesis Console
body:
The Sega Genesis is no stranger to connecting to online services. Previous options included the Sega Channel and Xband, neither being the “Internet as we know it today”, more akin to logging into oldschool America OnLine (AOL) if you will. Well, a recent Kickstarter project has popped up that aims to revive that online connectivity with the Sega Genesis called MegaWiFi. The interesting thing is, it is close to funding already, even if details are quite scarce.

Getting Online and Kicking Butt May Not Be Great

From what I can gather from the Kickstarter project page, this new add-on aims to give the Sega Genesis both Internet access and direct connection for gaming. The trailer shows off Battle City, but the FAQ section refers to it as BattleTank. A slight annoyance but there are bigger concerns with this Kickstarter project to worry about. You will see in the video a bit of lag between the player on the left and the player screen on the right. They are quickly out of sync with each other. This lag is hopefully going to be fixed somehow because at this rate, I could not imagine how badly a fighting game would play. Forget playing something like Street Fighter II or Mortal Kombat based on the connection quality shown in the trailer. https://youtu.be/2cWsBOx9LfI

Very Little Information Available Hurts This Project

The lack of information on the project is a concern. I don’t care that they used A.I. to get advice on decision making. I do care that the project page is lacking on MANY details. What is said though, mostly in the FAQ section – not the main body of the Kickstarter project (a mistake in my opinion) is that you are not going to be able to play just any Sega Genesis title online. No playing Sonic 2 in two player simultaneous play with your friend across the country, or even living room. Games must be programmed to take advantage of the MegaWiFi adapter. This severely limits the potential for support as, well, game development takes time. It will be interesting to see how this develops but right now, I would not hold my breath for a success story to come of this. Check out their [Kickstarter page and see for yourself]( https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rbof/megawifi-addon/description). Thanks to [Time Extension](https://www.timeextension.com/news/2026/05/megawifi-brings-online-play-to-the-sega-genesis-mega-drive) for the heads up on this project.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSGwLNGunGzu2gp5A6sQW2t67oEZmNR2idyvTMKgcA2hN/1779152610722.jpg) “Cowards die many times before their death,” a popular saying by William Shakespeare. I have watched several movies, and in real life, how people do give up in the face of great fear. This could be fear of limited resources, intimidation, the future, and bullying. Fear can be defined as an emotion or sense of danger in the sight of uncertainty. Fears limit us a lot in the pursuit of our daily achievements because it deals with our subconscious. Once upon a time, I abandoned a job assessment because of fear. I thought the assessment would be difficult, only to learn from those who attended that it was not difficult. It was a bitter lesson for me because I had been following the organisation’s recruitment; when the opportunity came, I didn’t pursue it to a logical conclusion for fear of writing and failing an assessment. Subsequently, I had to sit down in front of a mirror and sincerely advise myself of the importance of living above fear to move forward in life. To overcome fear, I started engaging in online preparatory test-writing websites. I also engaged in frequent interview practice to strengthen my confidence and prepare my mind for such assessments, whether online or offline. Presently, I still practice often and make sure to update my skills frequently to reflect my competencies. Furthermore, I attend scheduled assessments to continue sharpening my skills. Sometimes fear of failure will set in, but I will always overcome it by talking to and encouraging myself with the ones I have attended, feeding my inner man with optimistic thoughts rather than negative ones. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTS2x131yCy3YVMCbeqyuB3iAJpdRcdJnErj5MXk1UL65/1779152949928.jpg) In conclusion, I try to stay optimistic in my life pursuits rather than feed my inner man with fears and anxiety. This helps me to wash away negativity and stay positive. I also sieve my friends list and remain highly focused on being successful in life. body: is for this week's ZAPFIC Monday challenge. Thinking about how to utilize the word, I rely on my personal interpretation of the meaning of \

. To be considered as part of a two-person team in a romantic relationship means there are no outside influencers. The members of the team are a couple. It's their decision whether no others will enter their circle with the specific understanding agreed to. 

Often one of the partners will break that circle. Doing so may bring unanticipated circumstances if that partner fails to adhere to their agreement. I share a flash fiction story along those lines. 

The ZAPFICMonday challenge was created by @felt.buzz and consists of a story told in 240 characters or less. Quite a feat to accomplish. If you're interested, visit the current challenge post: [It's Monday 18th May! Time for #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

Guy's embrace, detached; his kiss, unemotional. Amber suffered through. They'd be the last. \

She pulled away, then showed the text. 

\

>

Qué tema tan interesante es «exclusividad» para el reto ZAPFIC Monday de esta semana. Al pensar en cómo utilizar esta palabra, me baso en mi interpretación personal del significado de «unidad». Formar parte de un equipo de dos personas en una relación sentimental implica que no hay influencias externas. Los miembros del equipo son una pareja. Es decisión suya que nadie más entre en su círculo, según el acuerdo específico al que hayan llegado. 

A menudo, uno de los miembros de la pareja rompe ese círculo. Hacerlo puede acarrear circunstancias imprevistas si esa persona no cumple con el acuerdo. Comparto un relato breve en esa línea.

**Todo es cuestión de timing**

El abrazo de Guy, distante; su beso, sin emoción.

body.title: How to Shield Zcash in Under 30 Seconds (And Why You Should Do It Today)
body.body:
https://youtu.be/K5yF-_yRB6k

Privacy on a public blockchain sounds like a contradiction. With Zcash, it isn't. You can take a regular, transparent ZEC balance — the kind any block explorer can see — and encrypt it onchain so no one knows the address, the amount, or the counterparty.

The process is called **shielding**, and a lot of the newcomers to ZEC in this awesome rally we are seeing have never actually done it. That's the gap I want to close in this post.

I'll walk you through how to shield ZEC inside the LeoDex wallet in under 30 seconds, why this matters more in 2026 than it ever has, and a shortcut most people don't know about: **you can buy ZEC that lands shielded automatically** and skip the manual step entirely.

## Why Shielding Matters Right Now

Zcash supports two address types. Transparent addresses (starting with `t1`) behave like Bitcoin addresses. Every transaction is publicly auditable forever. Shielded addresses (starting with `zs1` or unified `u1`) use **zero-knowledge proofs** to encrypt the sender, receiver and amount onchain.

Right now, about 30% of all circulating ZEC sits in the shielded pool. That's a record high, and it's nearly four times where the number sat at the start of 2024. The shielded-supply chart is the single most-watched fundamental metric in the asset.

AI is making blockchain surveillance trivially cheap and big players in the space like Grayscale are talking about it. Pattern-matching transaction graphs across exchanges, salaries, supplier payments, and treasury flows is no longer a research project. It's a SaaS product and one query away in a Claude Code session. Anything you do on a transparent chain is fair game for that pipeline.

The fix for onchain money is the same fix that the internet needed in the early days of buying stuff online: encryption. The asset that ships with encryption built in is Zcash and that's exactly why its blowing up today. 

## What You'll Need

- [LeoDex Wallet App](https://leodex.io/download) (Windows or MacOS, no KYC, no account creation needed)
- Some ZEC, OR any other crypto you can swap (BTC, ETH, USDC, anything)
- About 30 seconds


## Step 1 — Open the Shield Function in LeoDex

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcohEwkyb3rKnBbUGS4x5iLPCz7ayQG3o45uRQ8WXtfoN/image.png)

Head to your LeoDex wallet and find the **Shield** button. This sits in the same interface as your normal swap and trading view, so you don't have to leave the app or switch wallets to use it.

If you already have transparent ZEC sitting in your LeoDex wallet, the Shield button is your one-click path to making that balance private.

## Step 2 — Enter the Amount and Confirm

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRSc5bmGZtEihZbdNiE1EU4RnqxzW3VsRqFQVpsX1k6z3/image.png)

Type in how much ZEC you want to shield. For this walkthrough I used 0.10 ZEC, but you can shield any amount up to your full balance.

Hit **Shield**.

That's the whole interaction. The LeoDex MacOS & Windows wallet handles the zero-knowledge proof generation and broadcasts the shielding transaction to the Zcash network. You'll see a confirmation that reads \

## Step 3 — Verify the Transaction Onchain

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRXNpp9KEYQVMK3BMf2Tp1ine7UbZpouVDjB36fEcEiBN/image.png)

*trust, but verify*

This is the part most tutorials skip, and it's the part that matters if you want to actually check what just happened.

After shielding, click the **Explorer** link. LeoDex will open a Blockchair link of your transaction onchain so you can watch it confirm. You're not trusting LeoDex's UI — you're verifying that the network actually processed the shielded ZEC TX.

The transaction will show as pending, then confirmed within a few minutes or less. Once confirmed, the value lives in the shielded pool. Block explorers can see that shielding happened but when you start paying/swapping from that Shielded balance, it won't be connected to your T address whatsoever. 

*Pro Tip: don't shield an amount and then spend/swap that exact amount onchain afterwards as it creates a clear trail to your T Address*

That's it. Your ZEC is now encrypted onchain. Welcome to encrypted Bitcoin.

## The Shortcut: Skip Shielding Entirely with Direct-to-Shielded Swaps

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc1amPjVaq32SLovCE1d1KJGVUxaTM9Wr3fgTYRzLQq86/image.png)

Here's the part of LeoDex that almost nobody is doing yet.

If you don't currently own ZEC and want some, the conventional path is:
1. Buy ZEC on an exchange (lands in a transparent address)
2. Withdraw to your wallet (still transparent)
3. Shield it (the step above)

That's three transactions, two of which are publicly visible. Anyone scanning the chain can see you acquired ZEC, even if your eventual storage is shielded.

LeoDex supports **direct-to-shielded swaps**. You can put in 0.1 BTC, hit swap, and the ZEC arrives in your shielded balance. No transparent leg. No onchain record of the acquisition in your name. This is a UI flow that we've built seamlessly into the wallet. It is powered by our route providers at Near Intents and Maya Protocol. 

The flow:
1. Open LeoDex wallet
2. Select the asset you want to swap from (BTC, ETH, USDC, anything supported)
3. Select shielded ZEC as the output
4. Hit Review Swap
5. Confirm

The output lands shielded. You skip the shielding step entirely because there was never any transparent ZEC to shield in the first place.

## Why I Built This Into LeoDex

Most privacy tooling in crypto forces you to pick: either run a dedicated app/node just for ZEC or accept that your shielding behavior is bolted into a single-purpose wallet you only open when you want privacy. Neither of those is how people actually live in a multi-chain world. They want to open one app and *\

. Securely, privately and entirely onchain and on their machine. 

LeoDex's bet is: **privacy should sit inside the same interface where you do everything else** — crosschain swaps, trading, holding, paying. The act of shielding shouldn't feel like a separate ritual. It should feel like a natural part of navigating your crypto wallet.

The current numbers say the market agrees. ZEC has run from $380 to $615 in the last month, and the shielded supply keeps climbing. The thesis isn't \

**The thesis is that encryption stops being optional once AI makes surveillance free**, and the assets that ship with it built in are the ones that get repriced.

## Try It

If you want to actually do this — either shield existing ZEC or pick up some directly to a shielded address — open LeoDex and run through the steps above. The whole flow takes longer to read about than to just literally execute.

→ **Try LeoDex:** https://leodex.io

body.title: 做梦
body.body:
晚上的时候，我听到客厅里静悄悄的，出来一看，老大一人坐在桌子前在看平板。

“在看什么呢？” 我问他。

“在问豆包一些问题”。

我走近一看，发现屏幕上果然很多内容，都是一些他喜欢的动漫相关内容，看起来，他已经很熟悉问豆包了，这之前的时候，他还是习惯性问siri，估计发现siri回答的问题已经很难满足他了。

“这挺好”，我说了句，便走开了。

我在去年的时候，试图让孩子们学习下用一些AI工具 。但是孩子们似乎对这些没有太大兴趣，开始还敷衍下我，后来干脆不装了，压根就不用。

我知道“强扭的瓜不甜”，无奈只好放弃让他们学习AI的念头。

没想到，现在老大竟然自己开始用上了AI工具，虽然他问的那些问题都是一些兴趣爱好，看上去总是有那么些不务正业的感觉，但总算是走入“正途”了。

不知道这算不算“有心栽花花不成，无心插柳柳成荫”呢？🤣

不过通过这件事情，我自己也总结了下，就是在教育孩子时，不要硬着来，不仅效果甚微，反而很可能适得其反。

最好的办法，就是顺着他们的兴趣去做，往往很容易做成某件事情。比如先引起他们的兴趣，然后再引导，通过兴趣入门，让他们自己主观去做，不是靠我以父母的权威去“压迫”。

熟悉了这点，我也摸清了孩子们的心里。比如我提议做某件事情，如果老大的回应慢，或者支支吾吾，答案就不言而喻，他对此兴致不大。反之，他若兴致盎然，哪怕有一丝兴趣，那就趁热打铁试下呗。


![05_19_001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuWfNhoByDJQo9kAiueBj5RXNufcVmKmc2ajwk5CD5fG/05_19_001.jpg)


前天做了个梦，梦到掉发。话说回来，虽然曾经做过的大多数梦都不记得，但是有些梦却时常做，我自己回忆了下，大致有以下几种梦境：

第一种梦，就是刚参加工作的那些年，经常会梦到要么忽然深处考场，马上临近考试结束，自己的试卷却还有许多没做完；要么就是临近考试，发现很多知识点自己还没掌握。。。心里都是慌的一批。

第二种梦，就是梦到爬山。爬啊爬，爬到很高处，实在爬不动了，索性就一松手，心想这下完了，非摔死不可。结果恍惚一下子就从醒来，发现是场梦，内心的不由还是很高兴的。


第三种梦，就是梦到自己不知道怎么，似乎是长了翅膀，展翅高飞，飞过湖泊，飞过高山，那心中愉快的劲别提多高兴了，做到这种美梦，次日能让我的心情美美一整天。

第四种梦，也是我做过的最多的一种梦。在梦里，我回到了童年时候，跟发小伙伴们一起捉知了，欢快的劲甭提有多么高了，心里那自然是美滋滋的。这种梦是我做过的最多的梦，以至于再在路边看到知了叫时，我都会下意识地掐下自己，看下自己是不是又做梦了？🙂🙂

你呢，都做过哪些有趣的梦呢？

body.title: Let's Play Resident Evil Village - Holy Moly Beast!
body.body:
![Resident Evil Village Holy Moly Beast!.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23wqZfk5iZZtdsMiXWq4RmfKVo36NhMwrPfvM7wS6626z1JTPzq9HD7Qep2mRdRe4RjdL.gif)

---

# What a beast she turned into

Before I head out those newly opened doors I had to connect the Azure Eye, with the Silver Ring which would socket nicely, providing a now highly expensive and valuable item I could sell for even more Lei and it is always welcome, so I could stock up and upgrade even more!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.43.53.26.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tm9YErR9KR8269QBU1JYqjhSH3TS5aFcnkeQBAEFQV6pHH1xixskeKFajMWvWMnBAZJ.png)

Once I claimed all my Lei for items sold and I had upgraded the power, of the sniper rifle, I walked out the front doors, up the stairs ahead and turned to say goodbye to the castle before I entered the church, wondering what shit show I was about to walk into here.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.40.06.60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tbMLg7aMA75JH4wsbczpDfZfTFvw3CM2ULejFdzuqntSNZoasxPiPdxpAAzGdfSgDyW.png)

I turned and went to the coffin that was inside, opened it up to see some skeleton and grabbed the dagger that the skeleton was holding. Suddenly, Lady Dimitrescu had come up behind me to try stop me.. I stabbed the dagger into her side, triggering the first big boss fight of a large scale as she transformed, into some huge and hideous beast!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.41.37.72.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tRp8kj4564pZLTC3tBgY6RjYYQ236eNWtAXS5NdDZGyVq8NbgB5LR7Uqi2xxDA7yTVe.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.42.09.91.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23uEt3MSn1JVK32YjDsjaapxUoKdJVM9wLmNsEvgQ6DuPih3daJRusW7pwq2XAUFrEP16.png)

She started to fly about so she could taunt me and try intimidate me now. I picked up some nearby ammo and chem fluid as it was a nice stockpile, then waited for her to land and start the fight. I got use of the sniper rifle early on, to get some shots in but it was going to take many more bullets to get this win.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.43.54.71.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tGVuquGBMcLCme9aXuV6d7s5XRBHgH9fhjhb5A2SvL1CuDY4fQ95tP5iRoebwZNWaFH.png)

After shooting with the rifle to scare her away, taking flight and coming back around I changed to the pistol and the shotgun for easier shooting. I was able to get off a lot of shots so she got weakened, but it was about to be my turn to get hurt.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.45.32.95.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23u5tavSnMY3skBRQkEBJ7C16YyTzraxg1SNaYBm96N8Dm7Yk6PVv7WBEgHTE9vxrxrJt.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.45.45.54.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23zbPgEj9nyxcDqUgNVCZvnNY3HPaDW5mcKXWdHLsM1xkHcke5dSVbFQ37b1WHFs9ga7D.png)

The next time she landed was when I got done inside the chapel building and required some medicine to heal me up, I was not happy and had to get off some great shots while she was close to me, I only stopped shooting when she would fly away and it was not worth the ammo wasted on going for shots while on the move and I played the patient game instead.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.47.50.37.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23wWpeUx5rqYe8NYCAtCVGr3syq7aaCBTkrPhiXDkiVhySrk6wF4UmyDeR1AkWTsRWhdh.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.48.09.63.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23uQfg6JEsHdYA8o4Qw1AqTjCgFm6sSMFkQpYaDg7aiX6oYea7LRthEeVbNAN2WheydwU.png)

I was expecting her to fly away once more so soon. Did not realise how many bullets had been layered into her because once two more were shot into her, well that was the end of that and really, I did not find this to be such a hard fight after all.

It had the moment I got dragged down multiple floors to reach the bottom of the castle church, where I received the Crystal Dimitrescu and finally, the Lady was no more and I could move on to other locations for exploring while searching for Rose!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.48.17.23.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tGVhqmeEiCQNjUqxWm2UgrKECZyPgvTvqbxttkJQpQkiPPnyuHv3LrzhSzBXoPCsbg8.png)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 19 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gdae2fd8208ff0175466083c6ffcfb30517e0da1be95ec175cadd0b4d4fa7e1498e0e226564c3e9cd0f3db4b80dfead68eec2e0e2b357e2d5a96a8a518d3e180f_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто замечательной! Я выбрался в лес, где свежий воздух и тишина создают идеальную атмосферу для размышлений. На протяжении пути я встретил несколько интересных людей: сначала встретил пожилую пару, которые собирали грибы. Мы обменялись парой советов о том, какие грибы стоит собирать в это время года. Далее, наткнулся на группу молодых людей, которые устроили пикник у небольшого озера. Они делились с нами историями о своих походах, а я рассказал им о своих недавних приключениях в горах. Это было приятно — встретить таких энергичных и позитивных людей! По дороге я также увидел удивительное природное явление — раскидистое дерево, которое, похоже, росло на краю обрыва. Его корни выглядели так, будто находились в постоянной борьбе за жизнь, хватаясь за камни. Это напомнило мне, насколько природа сильна и стойка. В целом, прогулка была наполнена приятными моментами и вдохновляющими встречами! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: The most interesting card the guild pack
body.body:
Today I had a really great experience opening the guild pack. Every time I open a pack there is a different kind excitement, because you never know when card will come out. Opening the pack today was a lot fun for me, because I got some important and powerful cards that will be very useful in future battles. I especially enjoyed the whole thing more because I got some Rare and Epic cards.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcDgL2wd3UVsHYQBHDz6bPLBMZexgzj5tvFPaL6dpdejw/1779151898959.png)

The most interesting card I got in the first picture was Edith Emberstar. Since it is an Epic card, I was naturally more interested. This card has quite good attack power and the ability to hit the enemy from a distance can bring a big advantage in battle. Sometimes, having a good ranged unit behind a strong tank line can change the outcome of the entire match. I think Edith Emberstar is just such a card. If you use it in the right mana match, it will be possible to put pressure on the opponent.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH8Pv7JUbBLjSL8C26KZZDp9Q7RqZHs5SPQ9ouvXiETQ/1779151714399.jpg)

I was also very happy to get the Captain Katie card. As a Rare card, it is already popular with many players.  Looking at its magic attack and stats, it seems like it could be very effective for the mid lane. Especially in matches where the opponent has high armor, magic attack plays a big role. Because magic attacks can directly damage health. So I plan to use this card in some important battles in the future.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAj736ZBTn5hvRwFPjTjfP5puPzgdio5BEjDWpJRfuU5/1779151714754.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcm7zgXrKzVABXkbeJB3qa6UgC4jyS14LwYayJ8sP8ZEk/1779151714918.jpg)

I also like the Krash Wanderford card in the same picture. Its speed and attack power combined allow it to hit quickly. In some matches, speed is the key to winning. If you can attack before the opponent, it is often possible to easily take control of the match. So I think this card will be quite effective in low mana battles.

Then comes Hugo Strongsword. I have seen this card before and it always seemed like a balanced card. Attack, defense, and health—everything is fairly well balanced. Sometimes such cards help the most in battles because they can be used in different situations. It can also be used as a tank and can also be used as a support.  I was very happy to get this card again today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY9xxHbTVzrYNKnRgChA3TnihZC1AC2ytMaASbXVTEkph/1779151714500.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVbNzLKWxL6E7YPcxgqEDCGk4pJ6W6XPkkjc43mfdcoxu/1779151714620.jpg)

Another card was Witch of Warwick. I found the design of this card very interesting. It looks a bit mysterious and gives a dark type feel. Although its stats are not very strong, it can be useful in the right combination. Especially if there is a rule set where less mana is used, then this type of card is very useful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNv8R4eRXv4DD6YvGSaQSGjX5mmY2TUJyCCGv1htx1Mpi/1779151764015.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuMGYcoY5k1DeWqw4287JLmD2FfqdM9NCMQJs8cNZw4p/1779151764109.jpg)

There were also some good collections among the cards in the second picture. The Katrella Gobson card seemed quite unique to me. Its attack power and special features made it seem like it would good for fast-paced battles. There are some cards that seem very ordinary first glance but perform exceptionally well in right team combination. I think Katrella Gobson could one such card.

Then there was Alva The Crusher. As name suggests, it is a very aggressive card. Since this card has both good health attack, it can be effective when used in the front line. Sometimes it becomes difficult survive in battle without a strong tank.  So it's always a good idea have such cards in your collection.

Hugo Strongsword is also found in the second picture. Although it can be annoying to get the same card multiple times, it is actually very useful. Because duplicate cards are needed to upgrade cards later. So I see it as an added advantage. If you can increase the level of this card in the future, its power will also increase a lot.

Among the rare cards, Orella Abadon seems quite interesting to me. Especially low mana matches, small but effective cards can sometimes turn entire match around. I always try to keep such cards in my collection, because each ruleset requires a different strategy.

Finally, there was Ajax Lightfoot. I really liked the speed and balanced stats of this card. It is a card that can create a nice balance between attack and defense. I think it will fit very well in a fast attack-based team. Especially if there is a speed bonus, this card will become more effective.

From today's guild pack opening, I realized one thing again—in addition to luck, patience is also very important in this game. You can't always get big or legendary cards, but small good cards also gradually build a strong collection. Each new card creates new possibilities for the future. You can't tell in advance when a card will win a match.

I personally enjoy the moment of opening a pack a lot. Because it has a kind of surprise. The feeling of seeing new cards on the screen is really different. That joy has increased even more with the Epic and Rare cards in today's opening. Now my goal will be to gradually upgrade these cards and use them in the right combination to achieve better results.

 today guild pack opening was quite successful and enjoyable for me.  The new cards not only enrich my collection but also give me the opportunity to create new strategies for future battles. I hope able play more great matches using these cards in the coming days and gradually be able build stronger decks.

body.title: 老师又给家长布置作业
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![LqWm0jBo7vBcHcT0_nwt7.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/LqWm0jBo7vBcHcT0_nwt7/LqWm0jBo7vBcHcT0_nwt7.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

周末老师发了一个很长的消息，我大概看了一下是关于“我的幸福盒子”温暖作品创作说明。说什么本学期心理课上，孩子们学习了“幸福”主题课程，学会了如何寻找和感受生活中的幸福。为了鼓励孩子发现并珍藏身边的幸福瞬间，将开启\

特色创作活动。让家长陪伴孩子用立体手工的方式，将内心感到幸福的人、事或瞬间装进盒子里，让幸福被看见、被珍藏。看到这里我就感到头大，后面的创作建议与灵感库更是让我直接皱起眉头。这哪里是感受生活中的幸福，分明是给生活添乱添麻烦。

其实我也知道不是老师自己留的作业，而是学校统一布置的，目的是评选出优秀作品放到学校的陈列室，给学校增光。我原本想的是利用周末时间，和孩子一起动手做个简单的。可是周末都是阴雨天，孩子妈出差了不在家，孩子去奶奶家写作业。留我一个人在家里，以我的美术功底肯定无法完成如此复杂的手工。按照以前的经验，我都是在网上找个黑白模版，打印出来让孩子涂色。可这次老师让做个立体的，用半个纸盒子，里面还要用橡皮泥捏出各种人形和小动物，远远超出了我的能力范围。

最后我选择忽略，这种作业不会要求每个人都交的。对于老师来说一个班肯定有几个人做，收到以后提交上去选出最后的放到陈列室。因此就算我们做出来了，大概率也选不上，这种费力不讨好的事凑这个热闹干啥。

---

body.title: My Reading Block and The Captive Prince
body.body:
![1000967859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annacarstairs/23zbYJ7WUBkwYSqkh712SpXr7WBNnzb7YRaKoJECFxnNAkYZNf4Dy3GtPdJtmPpcnBBDR.jpg)

_____

Hola querida comunidad de Hive, espero que se encuentren muy bien. Como siempre, es un placer venir por este medio a hablarles de algo que tanto nos gusta: los libros.

>Hello, dear Hive community. I hope you are all doing well. As always, it’s a pleasure to be here to talk to you about something we all love so much: books.


La verdad es que no estoy pasando por un proceso fácil en este momento, y justamente por eso considero que el avance que he tenido con *El Príncipe Cautivo* ha sido algo maravilloso. De hecho, creo que este libro me ha ayudado muchísimo a no caer nuevamente en un bloqueo lector.

>The truth is, I’m not going through an easy time right now, and that’s exactly why I think the progress I’ve made with *The Captive Prince* has been wonderful. In fact, I think this book has really helped me avoid falling back into a reading slump.


![1000967901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annacarstairs/23ywwRUFPKG4GD23AKpfWHtjgcbc1k8Xj3kuSznNkvEWun1THbXNcdMkQbzAMGUPJgzPC.jpg)


Desde hace bastante tiempo me ha costado terminar libros, y es algo que sinceramente me ha deprimido un poco, porque leer siempre ha sido una de las cosas que más disfruto. Por eso, encontrar una historia que realmente logre atraparme otra vez se siente emocionante y hasta reconfortante. Me hace feliz volver a sentir esas ganas de seguir leyendo capítulo tras capítulo.

>For quite some time now, I’ve had a hard time finishing books, and honestly, that’s been a bit of a downer for me, because reading has always been one of the things I enjoy most. That’s why finding a story that really manages to draw me in again feels exciting and even comforting. It makes me happy to feel that urge to keep reading chapter after chapter once more.

En estos primeros capítulos he encontrado algo muy diferente a lo que estoy acostumbrada. Ya había leído antes a la autora, específicamente *El Rey Oscuro*, pero siento que esta historia tiene un enfoque distinto. Desde el inicio se percibe menos explícita y menos lasciva en el comportamiento de los personajes, y no me refiero únicamente a los protagonistas.

>In these first few chapters, I’ve found something very different from what I’m used to. I’ve read this author before—specifically *The Dark King*—but I feel like this story takes a different approach. From the very beginning, the characters’ behavior feels less explicit and less lewd, and I’m not just talking about the main characters.

Algo que me está gustando muchísimo es la perspectiva de Damen. La autora logra que conectes con él desde el principio, entendiendo su posición, su confusión y también la manera en la que percibe todo lo que ocurre a su alrededor. Eso hace que la lectura se vuelva mucho más inmersiva.

>One thing I'm really enjoying is Damen's perspective. The author makes you connect with him right from the start, helping you understand his situation, his confusion, and the way he perceives everything happening around him. That makes the reading experience much more immersive.


![1000967940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annacarstairs/23z7LT6Bb6pXjfGsg8zeb2aFx5RJRACHPQqtQ9M6nMCEQn8u1vqwxzFKpF3iVvevLWmxg.jpg)


También me genera muchísima intriga la forma en la que se desarrollará la relación entre los protagonistas. Admito que al principio la dinámica entre ellos puede parecer bastante bizarra o incluso incómoda, pero como empecé el libro sabiendo que sería un *enemies to lovers*, realmente no me molesta. Al contrario, creo que esa tensión inicial es justamente parte de lo fascinante.

>I'm also really intrigued by how the relationship between the main characters will develop. I admit that at first the dynamic between them might seem pretty bizarre or even awkward, but since I started the book knowing it would be an *enemies-to-lovers* story, it doesn't really bother me. On the contrary, I think that initial tension is exactly what makes it so fascinating.

Y creo que eso es lo que más me está atrapando: sentir que estoy leyendo algo nuevo para mí, algo distinto a lo habitual, pero que al mismo tiempo logra mantenerme completamente interesada en hacia dónde va la historia.

>And I think that's what's really drawing me in: the feeling that I'm reading something new to me, something different from the usual, but that at the same time keeps me completely hooked on where the story is going.


![1000967965.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annacarstairs/48Xfz53AQwrMkG6Jkxf5SCNgxhoxi7no5VEgcnragdMELxevtuCevfiVmZ1HR4ehjW.jpg)
