body.title: WHERE THE HORIZON BEGINS
body.body:
/>

image generated using Gemini AI

Gabriel was the second child of his parents; he was always happy and would make everyone around him smile. Gabriel will always keep a smiling face, and because of that, people call him Smiles. He was very intelligent and was also a smart boy; he was kind and cheerful, and would do everything in his power to make the people around him feel loved. He had 2 elder sisters and was the last of his parents.

  
Whenever Gabriel saw an aeroplane flying across the sky, he would run outside, covering his eyes to prevent the sun from shining in them as he watched the plane disappear into the clouds. He loves aeroplanes so much so that with no shadow of doubt, he knew he was going to become a pilot in future. To him, the sky was going to be his home, where his imagination came to reality.  
Adulthood will arrive at Gabriel's doorstep without prior notice; he will come to understand that life was never smooth sailing as he comes face-to-face with it.  
After his secondary school, it was time for Gabriel to enroll into the aviation school. Gabriel was happy that he was soon going to the aviation school to study and later in the near future, become the pilot he had dreamt of becoming. Gabriel had hustled hard for money and registered for his exams, and would later pass with flying colours. Gabriel was offered admission to start in the coming session, and it was time for him to go for his registration.

Since it was his dream of becoming a pilot, none of his siblings or parents knew the cost of tuition for aviation school, and Gabriel was still young that, amongst all his research, he forgot to conduct research on the fees and to discuss a plan with his parents. His illiterate parents were there to support all his decisions, but were also not educated to understand that the cost of tuition was exorbitant and needed planning.  
Gabriel realised that being a smart boy was not enough to pay for his aviation dreams, and his sisters had their own challenges that they were facing at the time, and he wouldn’t want to be a burden to them even if he could.  
As a result, Gabriel had to pick up a job to gather money to sponsor himself through school. He was fortunate to get a job at a logistics company where he was given a motor vehicle to dispatch mail and pickup mails for dispatch.  
Gabriel will realise that adulthood was way different from his childhood days; it was not difficult for him to get what he was looking for. He had strong parents who made sure he had everything he needed. Never in his life did he know that he had always been sheltered by his parents. He had a straight life, but never had to face the realities of life until now.  
During these difficult years, it was a period of testing for his character. The smile he always gave for free had become scarce and expensive; he would smile in reflex to joy, but in his adulthood, it became something he chose to do.  
Gabriel even in his trying times choose to be kind to everyone, even when his colleagues were tired and angry, Gabriel was always there to bring laughter amongst them, he had come to understand that everyone was facing one challenge or the other in this adulthood and his job as a human was not to make them feel worse and unhappy, but to relief them from their pains in any way that he can.  
One evening after Gabriel had finished his shift for the day, he was caught looking at a passing plane by a senior colleague, and the senior colleague asked him if he was still wishing to be up there someday. I used to think that being a pilot was all about escaping the ground when I was still a child, Gabriel said quietly. But I have come to realise something. A pilot's real job isn't just to fly; it's to carry people safely through the storm and bring them back down to earth gently.  
Gabriel never lost hope in his dreams; it only took him more years longer than he had expected to achieve his dreams from when he was a child, but he was able to save up from his day job and could have enough to put himself through school in the end. Adulthood had taught him patience and resilience.

body.title: The French Connection (1971) Is One Of The Grittiest And Most Influential Crime Films Ever Made. It Is Rough Around The Edges, A Little Corny In Some Seventies Ways, But Still A Personal Classic Because It Feels So Raw And Real.
body.body:
The French Connection (1971) Is One Of The Grittiest And Most Influential Crime Films Ever Made. It Is Rough Around The Edges, A Little Corny In Some Seventies Ways, But Still A Personal Classic Because It Feels So Raw And Real.

![IMG_1652.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQRigJdXV8sGGEi4kH4iL6zPhKJV745EJug4WEe9oDZUz/IMG_1652.webp)

Released in 1971 and directed by William Friedkin, The French Connection changed crime movies in a major way. Before this film, a lot of police thrillers still had a polished Hollywood style. Friedkin stripped much of that away and delivered something dirtier, faster, and more grounded. The result feels almost like a documentary at times, and that realism is exactly why it still hits so hard.

Gene Hackman stars as Detective Jimmy “Popeye” Doyle, and this is easily one of the best performances of his career. Popeye is obsessed, reckless, aggressive, and far from heroic in the traditional sense. Hackman plays him with an intensity that makes the character fascinating even when he is difficult to like.

Roy Scheider plays Doyle’s partner Buddy Russo, bringing a calmer and more controlled energy to balance Hackman’s chaos. The chemistry between the two feels authentic because they do not overplay the partnership. They feel like actual detectives trying to survive exhausting work rather than movie cops delivering speeches.

The plot follows Doyle and Russo as they uncover a massive heroin smuggling operation connecting New York City to French criminals overseas. What starts as small suspicion slowly grows into a much larger investigation involving surveillance, informants, and dangerous pursuit.

Fernando Rey plays Alain Charnier, the sophisticated French drug smuggler at the center of the operation. Unlike Popeye, Charnier is calm and elegant, which creates a great contrast between hunter and hunted. Rey barely raises his voice, yet still feels dangerous throughout the film.

William Friedkin directs the movie with an almost relentless pace. The streets of New York feel cold, crowded, and exhausting. Everything looks dirty and worn down, which gives the film a realism that separated it from many crime movies of the era.

Of course, the film is most famous for its legendary car chase sequence, and honestly it still deserves the praise. Watching Popeye chase an elevated train through crowded city streets remains one of the most intense action scenes ever filmed. Friedkin shot it with a dangerous realism that modern CGI heavy action movies often cannot match.

The chase works because it feels genuinely out of control. There is no polished superhero style here. Cars crash, pedestrians scatter, and Popeye himself barely seems in control of the situation. That chaos makes it unforgettable.

At the same time, the film is not really about action. It is about obsession. Popeye becomes so consumed with catching Charnier that it starts destroying his judgment. The movie does not romanticize that obsession as much as some later cop thrillers would.

Some parts of the film definitely feel a little corny now in that very seventies tough guy style. Certain attitudes, dialogue choices, and rough edges clearly belong to another era. But honestly, I think that adds to the character of the movie instead of hurting it.

That roughness makes the film feel alive. It does not feel overly polished or cleaned up for modern audiences. It feels like a snapshot of gritty seventies filmmaking before studios started sanding everything down.

Don Ellis’s score also deserves mention because it adds constant tension without overwhelming scenes. The music feels nervous and sharp, helping create the paranoid atmosphere hanging over the entire story.

What makes The French Connection such a classic is that it refuses easy victories. Police work here is frustrating, exhausting, and messy. Even when progress is made, it often comes with mistakes and collateral damage. That realism gives the movie weight.

The ending especially stands out because it avoids the neat Hollywood closure audiences might expect. Friedkin understood that real life investigations do not always end with perfect satisfaction, and that ambiguity makes the final moments even stronger.

![IMG_1653.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTLyc68JPc4cRYPK1tNzKxTp3miaKeaPrnA1NT6BUmQPw/IMG_1653.webp)

In the end, The French Connection remains a classic to me because it is intense, gritty, and deeply influential. It may have a little seventies corniness around the edges, but underneath that is one of the smartest and most authentic crime thrillers ever made.

It is not just a great cop movie. It is one of the films that helped redefine what crime cinema could look and feel like.

body.title: Pet fish and hamsters
body.body: Good Morning to my friends here in Hive. Do you like animals? I have a lot of animals at home as well as toys. I have been taking care of fish for around ten years. This aquarium has been at my house for the last decade. I have had a fish that lived here for a long time. For around 8 years before it passed due to old age. I have a four-foot aquarium that I enjoy looking at. A majority of the fish in my tank are goldfish. A lot of them are black in colour, and I also have some Neon Tetras. Now, I usually keep fish that are tankmate-friendly. Those who won't nip at others. The aquatic plants help increase oxygen and aerate the whole tank in case there is not enough.

/> The water is quite clean because I have a good water filter, and I usually change 1/3 of the water a couple of times a week. I used to only change the water after three weeks, and it has been hard work because the water becomes a lot dirtier by then. I also have a couple of Pelcos in my tank to remove the algae inside.

/> Will be updating my aquarium and progress from time to time. I found that changing the 1/3 water from time to time is quite effective in having clear water in the aquarium without much work. The other thing I do not need to worry is the chlorine level as there is an adequate amount of the original water inside for the fishes to get use to. My wife ordered a pot of Kalanchoe. One thing about these Kalanchoe that I found out is that you cannot water it directly from the top, but into the pot instead.
/> I also have lots of hamsters. These are the hamsters that were born a month ago. I originally got a pair of hamsters a couple of months ago. Then, they started to breed.

/> I originally kept them in a caged enclosure. Somehow, they always found ways to escape. But, one thing about these hamsters is that they tend to just stay around the area and I usually get to spot them after a couple of days of dissapearing.
/> These hamsters are quite tame because I slowly got to know them from the day they were born. So, in a way, they figure that I was part of their family.

/> I also have three tortoises, five guinea pigs, two cats, and a couple of dogs. The reward is that you get to feel a sense of relaxation when you look at them, as they are quite cute. Have a great day. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

body.title: Game File Sizes are Too Big
body.body:
I am finding myself enjoying lower storage games than the big clunky 60-120 GB games. It is a lot of space just to feel 'meh' about a game. I get that graphics are a big draw but I feel like developers aren't optimizing the storage like they used to.

Back in my early console days, a memory card was 2MB and saved games would fit on there easily enough. That makes sense because the technology to make bigger storage wasn't around yet but that didn't mean the developers hadn't figured out a way to optimize a save file size to accommodate the storage requirements.

I mean, Having a huge download size just bogs down my machine and reduces the amount of games I can play at the current time. Not too long ago I had some hefty 'Triple-A' tier games on my computer but because their storage requirements were so massive, despite my Terabyte SSD, I could only have probably 4 installed. 5 if I got rid of some old folders with previous ventures (Audio, Video, Edits, ETC). but I've gotten tired of being let down by major game companies and those tripe-A rated games themselves for whatever reason.

I uninstall one 'triple-A' and suddenly I have so much storage space that I feel spoiled being able to install so many \

games that provide me more gameplay options.

 My current conundrum is this: I want to play an isometric ARPG, no problem! I have several in my library but some haven't reached their full potential, others don't quite hit the mark, and the rest are just a mess. While they are 'newer' (1-4 years) many of these ARPGs are a whopping 60-90 GB with one being 137GB!


![Last Epoch Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23wLziFR5rMbnJEp85jmaAmDrXJAKmUncx4HooMXBx5N56WJxEWe4qHYW56DGknvoDzHX.jpg)


![PoE2 Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23uQGhEcHkSngKcaY6rW5wSQg3a6eQ7ftdSCHpR8hUF3TRJi8oTcK5FWhPoh3FNJNwHdn.jpg)


![Warhammer 40k Martyr Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23wfhjkJ1GPzNZ8nuhC2rBrr12TUQVMaZGQoA22ExLR9ZYKHcNj4bHF6xsN9kojpzobkD.jpg)


![Path of Exile Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23wqXfvz1zBiFGhXRqzf3HTm6bcJPKjPmyuhjG75TPHcoCcQyXHXF8eAgEXadkjxCXGFm.jpg)

*Why haven't these games done a storage squish yet? they've had time to optimize some parts of the game I would think.*

What the hell is this? An Isometric style shouldn't be 'too' much of a file size. And that just about kills the rest of my storage to hold 'one' game. It's too much storage.

The big 'storage' requirement just kills my willingness to install a game now. First I gotta commit my computer to that one game, I have to take the time to install a HUGE game, and the worst part is: I just wanted to play that genre of game for a short while to scratch the 'itch' that game genre gives out.

Just because there is empty space doesn't mean it should be filled or that lazy developers get a free pass.

I've actually 'retired' some games from my library because the file size is just too massive and have downright refused to play games with previous friends because the game they wanted to play (ARK) would've been the majority of my hard drive storage.

So now I am stuck wondering if I should even bother downloading an ARPG to scratch the ARPG itch, All because of the file size. It's a ridiculous problem that can be fixed with some care and attention from a developer or coder.

---

After a bit of searching I discovered two games that are low file size but have massive return on Playtime, variety, and general input. 

Grim Dawn (ARPG), a game that has a small file size even with the expansion packs, and Over The Top: WW1, a game that features 200 players in a single server/match and vehicles, VOIP, destructive terrain, and other fun things that ensure a single match is never exactly the same.


![Grim Dawn Filesize.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23tbK2d7LA7DUSNjSuf9s1d2CokSzx5buryY6xsoTVJARiunWzheSUqLs2WayRPoCCK13.png)


![Over The Top Filesize.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23tkhYuDQ1HMkFwjZmBqnVesVHi1LBQaHJQACx3H2ZoynvLfj5a3CgL1Qxe5kVBTtxVWg.png)

*^These sizes are appreciated in todays climate of storage hogs*

![Squad Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/2432BfNPUCZXiEGsbGsbY1ZmyaLqPQrn2ikz4nD5RiRPEz69FsYCS9E2ohvh2gY3csLcV.jpg)


![Hell Let Loose Filesize.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asynckronism/23ynJD4pRUqwVHidffWbLypzzVpyfxSTj6i4W3LLZY5CYMoRSV4HkGjcPj9EPnceoc4Tm.jpg)

*I know these games are way more complex than Over The Top but it is still a lot for a modern intricate version of battlefield and another semi-realistic WW2 mil-sim*

These both sort of tickle that little game genre itch that occasionally occurs WHILE not being huge bogs on my hard drive.

I'm finding myself enjoying these older/indie games and what they provide more than the 'Triple-A' studio created games because they are more tolerable to store, play, and start up.

I also have an inkling of a conspiracy that the big storage requirement is a sign of 'commitment' to that game and the developers want to ensure their players only have a limited amount of games to choose from. But thats neither here nor there.

Anyway, just a rant. Thank you for reading.

body.title: Aderezo de pimienta y mostaza | Ideal para sandwiches con pollo [ES][EN]
body.body:
> La mayoría de las veces que se piensa en una salsa o aderezo para un sándwich, la mayonesa, ketchup y mostaza son las 3 salsas por defecto. En mi país, al salir a comer comida rápida, bien sean hamburguesas, perros calientes, parrillas o cualquier comida entre panes, las salsas que se utilizan siempre son esas tres que mencioné y algunas otras que son a base de mayonesa. Caemos en lo fácil, rápido y repetitivo, que olvidamos explorar nuevas experiencias a la hora de comer comida rápida. > Most of the time, when you think of a sauce or condiment for a sandwich, mayonnaise, ketchup, and mustard are the three go-to options. In my country, when we go out for fast food—whether it’s burgers, hot dogs, grilled sandwiches, or any other sandwich—the sauces we use are always those three I mentioned, plus a few others that are mayonnaise-based. We fall back on what’s easy, quick, and repetitive, forgetting to explore new experiences when it comes to fast food. ![1000261959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261959.jpg) Si bien uso las tres salsas clásicas, me encanta explorar nuevas experiencias. Hacer hamburguesas y colocarles un chutney de tomate es mejor que usar ketchup o ponerles una salsa de pepinillos a base de yogur griego. Hay muchas opciones, como este aderezo de pimienta y mostaza, que se encarga de activar el paladar para que puedas disfrutar todos los sabores y mejorar al máximo la experiencia de comer. Es uno de mis aderezos favoritos y se prepara tan fácil, que pensar en lo fácil de usar mayonesa ya no es una excusa. > While I do use the three classic sauces, I love exploring new flavors. Making burgers and topping them with tomato chutney is better than using ketchup or a Greek yogurt-based pickle sauce. There are many options, like this pepper and mustard dressing, which really awakens your palate so you can enjoy all the flavors and maximize your dining experience. It’s one of my favorite dressings, and it’s so easy to make that thinking about how convenient mayonnaise is is no longer an excuse. ![1000261958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261958.jpg) ![1000261957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261957.jpg) Si quieres aprender a preparar este aderezo y cómo preparé este sándwich, estos son los ingredientes que yo utilicé: > If you want to learn how to make this dressing and how I made this sandwich, here are the ingredients I used: ![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Ingredientes || Ingredients

Para el aderezo - 200 gr de crema de leche - 1 cucharadita de pimienta molida - 1 cucharada de mostaza - 2 cucharadas de leche líquida - Sal al gusto Para el sándwich - Pan de orégano - Lechuga - Tomates - Milanesa de pollo - Rábano - Pepinos encurtidos - Cebolla For the dressing - 200 g heavy cream - 1 teaspoon ground black pepper - 1 tablespoon mustard - 2 tablespoons milk - Salt to taste For the sandwich - Oregano bread - Lettuce - Tomatoes - Chicken cutlet - Radish - Pickled cucumbers - Onion
![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Preparación || Preparation

- En una sartén, colocar la crema de leche y la pimienta. Dejar cocinar 2 minutos a fuego lento. Agregar la leche, sal y la mostaza, mezclar y dejar cocinar 1 minuto más. Esperar que baje la temperatura y envasar para utilizar. Mi crema de leche la había congelado por error, por eso se ve como un bloque. > - In a saucepan, combine the heavy cream and pepper. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add the milk, salt, and mustard, stir, and cook for 1 more minute. Let it cool, then transfer to a container for later use. I had accidentally frozen my heavy cream, which is why it looks like a block. ![1000261947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261947.jpg) - Para preparar el sándwich, se abre el pan por la mitad y se coloca aderezo al gusto. Se coloca una capa de lechuga y sobre la lechuga el pollo. Me gusta colocar aderezo sobre el pollo. > - To make the sandwich, cut the bread in half and spread dressing on it to taste. Add a layer of lettuce, then place the chicken on top of the lettuce. I like to drizzle dressing over the chicken. ![1000261952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261952.jpg) - Se termina colocando el rábano, el tomate, la cebolla y el pepino encurtido. Se ajusta, se cierra el pan y a disfrutar. > - Finish by adding the radish, tomato, onion, and pickled cucumber. Adjust the sandwich, close the bun, and enjoy. ![1000261955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261955.jpg) Ya el sándwich está listo. Por supuesto que puedes colocar los ingredientes de relleno a tu gusto; yo suelo prepararlo así; a veces coloco fetas de queso amarillo, aguacate, lentejas germinadas, etc. Hay muchísimos ingredientes que van muy bien entre panes, pero sin duda alguna, este aderezo de pimienta y mostaza es uno de mis favoritos. > The sandwich is ready. Of course, you can add whatever fillings you like; this is how I usually make it; sometimes I add slices of cheddar cheese, avocado, sprouted lentils, etc. There are so many ingredients that go great in a sandwich, but without a doubt, this pepper and mustard spread is one of my favorites. ![1000261956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000261956.jpg) Déjame saber en los comentarios si has comido antes aderezos de pimienta y cuál fue tu experiencia. ¡Hasta una próxima receta! > Let me know in the comments if you've tried pepper dressings before and what your experience was like. See you in the next recipe! --- ---

body.title: The Books That Shaped My Life Eng 🇬🇧 /Los libros de mi vida Esp 🇪🇸
body.body:
Eng 🇬🇧 

![D_NQ_NP_752922-MLM49478066670_032022-O.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23xydNA9DrH3QK8SVZQEekUc4dxdiNGT4VqPmnus3qE3Y8CP5pEP2KZQDeGnkbJxu3s5S.webp)

Today I was thinking about the books that have shaped my life. I’ve read many, but there’s one that truly left a deep mark: The Encyclopedia of Wonders. I read it in eighth grade, and for those of us who studied in Cuba, I know that year can be challenging. With subjects like physics, chemistry, and others, many things seem impossible to understand. Chemistry has always been difficult for me, and even after all these years, I still haven’t mastered it. Physics, on the other hand, found its way to me thanks to this book.
What makes The Encyclopedia of Wonders special isn’t just what it teaches, but how it teaches it. It talks about magnetism—how it works, where it comes from, and why it happens. But it doesn’t do this like a boring school textbook. It does it with stories, images, historical examples, and curious passages that connect science to real life. For example, it explains that Christopher Columbus didn’t reach America because of a magnetic error, while also telling things you’d never learn in history class. Every page is a journey through science, history, and fascinating curiosities that awaken the mind.
The book even shows how physics can be fun and surprising. It explains, for instance, how an angel could float in a church thanks to the placement of magnets, and how years of study and experimentation made that effect possible. It teaches basic physics concepts while keeping you interested, like the nature of magnets, how the Earth’s magnetic field works, and why we call certain objects “magnets.” Everything is explained clearly, simply, and in a fascinating way.
What this book taught me most wasn’t just physics, but a deeper lesson: it’s not that some people are good or bad at learning, nor that certain subjects are impossible. What really matters is the interest we put into it. Content can be hard or easy, but if it captures us, we understand it and become passionate about it. This book showed me that learning isn’t about memorizing formulas or dates, but about understanding, observing, and marveling at the world around us.
That’s why I recommend it so much. It’s not just a book for learning physics; it’s a book that sparks curiosity, teaches you to think, and makes science and history feel alive. It helped me get through a difficult school stage, taught me to enjoy learning, and left memories and lessons I still value today.
I want my son to read it one day too. Because a book like this doesn’t just teach knowledge—it plants seeds of curiosity and a passion for learning. And in the end, that’s what turns a book into something more than pages: it becomes a lifelong companion, a guide to explore, understand, and marvel at the world

body.title: Mythos Breaks the Illusion: AI Is Now Stress-Testing the World’s Defenses
body.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPFSxLP6Mmu4K2hBhikbMBcLG1o9CbFxFEQ8sPePwudF6)

# Mythos Breaks the Illusion: AI Is Now Stress-Testing the World’s Defenses

For years, the AI race has been narrated as a contest of bigger models, smarter agents, and faster demos. Today’s more important story is what happens when those systems stop impressing users and start interrogating the infrastructure underneath modern life. That is why Anthropic’s latest warning landed so hard: the company is set to brief the Financial Stability Board after its unreleased Mythos model surfaced cyber vulnerabilities serious enough to worry global regulators.

This is a different kind of milestone. It is not just that the model is powerful. It is that a frontier AI system is now capable of finding weaknesses in legacy digital systems quickly enough to force banks, policymakers, and security teams into a new operating rhythm. Reuters reported that U.S. banks are already rushing to patch issues flagged by Mythos, with some vulnerabilities being fixed in days rather than weeks. That alone shows how AI is changing the tempo of cybersecurity.

The bigger significance is the setting. The Financial Stability Board exists to coordinate financial rules and monitor systemic risk. When the Bank of England’s governor asks a leading AI lab to brief that body, it signals that AI capability has moved from a technology story into a macro-risk story. The concern is not hypothetical. Reuters notes that experts warn the model could enable more sophisticated attacks, especially against banks running older technology stacks. In other words, the same system that can help defenders see blind spots can also compress the time attackers need to exploit them.

That dual-use reality is becoming the defining feature of frontier AI. The industry has spent much of the past two years proving that models can write, reason, code, and act. The next phase is proving they can do so safely inside the constraints of the real world. Anthropic’s Mythos episode suggests those constraints are no longer abstract. If an AI can uncover hundreds or even thousands of weaknesses in a banking environment, then every enterprise running old software, brittle integrations, and thin security staffing has to assume the floor has shifted.

There is also a cost to this new speed. Banks are not just fixing bugs; they are being forced into a continuous testing posture. That means more scanning, more patching, more downtime planning, and more coordination between teams that often move at different speeds. It also means AI security will increasingly favor institutions that can combine machine-speed detection with disciplined governance. The winners will not simply be the organizations with the smartest model. They will be the ones with the cleanest data, the most modern infrastructure, and the strongest control systems around how AI is used.

The broader AI landscape today points in the same direction. Dell announced a production-ready push for agentic AI that can run locally, securely, and with data that never leaves the environment. That is a clear response to the same market pressure: enterprises want autonomy, but they want it inside their own walls. Meanwhile, robotics firms like Agility continue to emphasize that humanoid systems are no longer science fiction but deployed industrial tools. Whether the form is software agents, cyber models, or robots on a factory floor, AI is moving from spectacle to operational reality.

That shift matters because it changes what “progress” means. The most important AI development is no longer always the model with the flashiest benchmark or the most viral demo. It is the system that can be trusted in a high-stakes environment, where errors are expensive and speed cuts both ways. Mythos is a reminder that the frontier is now touching institutions that hold the economy together.

The future, then, is not just about whether AI gets smarter. It is about whether our systems can adapt quickly enough to use that intelligence without being overwhelmed by it. Today’s message is blunt: the age of sandbox AI is over. The machines are starting to look at the plumbing.

![PSX_20260519_072521.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf5dxBJELGe2p4WXxfx5k6Rg68TkPUcAjANtdQSqQH46W/PSX_20260519_072521.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
Today, I once again enjoyed the bustling atmosphere of the pier, bustling with fishermen's activities. Brightly colored boats were neatly docked at the harbor's edge, carrying various fishing gear. A gentle sea breeze blew, and the sky was slightly overcast, creating a calm atmosphere even as the workers continued their busy activities.

I stood for a moment, watching a large ship being prepared to sail. Ropes, fishing nets, and even boxes for storing the catch were arranged on board. Everything looked simple, yet this is where many people rely on their hopes of earning a living in the vast ocean.

Watching the activity on the pier always teaches me a lesson in hard work and patience. The fishermen must brave the waves, the weather, and the long journey to bring home the best catch for their families. Not all work is easy, but their spirit remains strong every day.

This atmosphere also instills a sense of gratitude in me. Life on the coast truly has its own story. The sea is not only a place to earn a living, but also a part of the community's life, filled with struggle and togetherness.

As midday approaches, the pier becomes increasingly busy with the sound of ship engines and the conversations of the crew. I enjoyed the moment, gazing at the expansive, soothing ocean view.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

Hice mi calentamiento y arranque, mi ruta fue, parque Los Caobos - Paseo los ilustres - parque Los Caobos, logré comenzar en Z2, pero km y medio después, se me empezó a subir un poco la FC, andaba con algo de alergia, el polvillo de la tierra del parque no me ayudaba, así que camine un pedazo para poder calmarme, luego seguí y todo fue muy bien, logré mi Z2, súper tranquila, con algo de calor, pero no estaba tan potente como días anteriores, de hecho cuando salí, tenía frío. Me sentí relajada, creo que la semana había sido algo pesada y ayer solté todo, también me encontré a un amigo en la ruta que estaba haciendo y solo corrimos 500 mts juntos (a mí ritmo 🤭) porque ya me tocaba devolverme, también me encontré a @mlb49 saliendo del parque, que también había terminado su entrenamiento. 

Solo puedo decir que mi domingo fue muy bonito, aunque muchas veces corro sola y extraño correr acompañada, lo disfruto mucho, porque voy a mí ritmo y no me siento presionada con que me están esperando y más en este tipo de entrenamiento que la Z2 (por lo menos la mía) aún es muy lenta 🙈

Sigamos enfocados y haciendo lo que amamos 💚

body.title: Sunday with coffee and black cake
body.body:
![papaps.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdzRWws6WcFZtYb5TG3QDdBH9hWYMdWMJeUTRvVyaACt/papaps.jpg)
My week is packed with so many things—work, school—and that’s why every time Sunday rolls around, it feels really special. Maybe it’s because it’s a much calmer day compared to the rest, and it’s a day that invites you to slow down and enjoy the simple things. That’s why one of the things I always love to do is have an afternoon snack with my family around the table, with hot coffee and a freshly baked homemade cake. The kitchen becomes a very special place, starting with the aroma of coffee and the scent of the freshly baked cake, and along with that come conversations, laughter, and the sense of peace that every member of my family brings. This time it was a very moist, fluffy chocolate cake—the kind where one bite makes you want to keep eating all afternoon. Plus, coffee is the perfect drink to go with it, creating a combination that no one can resist.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWwyg11Sh73n2AY1VNMqG2cVr2if5qLhgH8MC19Gv1iuV/image.png)
Every Sunday afternoon is different, and it’s not just about a cup of coffee with cake or a cup of coffee with a cookie. Rather, it’s about those moments that unfold, where everything starts with an idea and ends up becoming something incredible. Here, my mom starts by making the coffee and pouring it into each cup, while my sister bakes the cake, and before we know it, we’re all pitching in to make sure our afternoon snack turns out perfectly. This is one of my favorite combinations—a cup of coffee with a chocolate cake—since the intense flavor of the chocolate and the bitterness go together perfectly, and the best part is that everyone in the house loves it. That’s why that moment becomes a family gathering, the perfect opportunity for us all to be together, since surely many families would love to have moments like this.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJcfgNzQenfrqM3U2QdshjuS86bucRsVNfU7uKvztV3F/image.png)
That’s why, on that Sunday that flew by so quickly, I managed to enjoy my family, the smell of coffee, a slice of cake, and above all, the fact that, in the end, that’s what life is all about. It’s about taking a moment any afternoon to share with love, and realizing that the little plans are the best. And as the coffee and cake grow cold, I write these words.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: Our family experience watching “Michael” at the movies 🍿 [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
> ##
***Hello friends, welcome to my blog***
Today I want to tell you about a very special family outing we had last weekend. We went to the movies to see “Michael,” the new biopic about the King of Pop, Michael Jackson. To be perfectly honest, I’ve never been the biggest Michael Jackson fan, mainly because I don’t usually listen to much music in English. However, it’s impossible to deny the enormous impact he had on pop culture and how much we miss artists as versatile as him today. But the real reason for this outing was my husband, who is a huge fan. Thanks to him, I started listening to his music, and I confess that what drove me was curiosity about how they would portray his complex life on the big screen. Although I’m not here today to write an in-depth review with spoilers, I can tell you that, for my taste, I would have liked them to delve a little deeper into certain aspects of his life. https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png >##
***Hola amigos, bienvenidos a mi blog***
>Hoy les quiero contar sobre una salida familiar muy especial que tuvimos el pasado fin de semana. Nos fuimos al cine a ver Michael, la nueva película biográfica sobre el Rey del Pop, Michael Jackson. >Para serles muy sincera, nunca he sido la más grande fanática de Michael Jackson, principalmente porque no suelo escuchar mucha música en inglés. Sin embargo, es imposible negar el impacto gigantesco que tuvo en la cultura pop y lo mucho que hacen falta artistas tan completos como él en la actualidad. Pero el verdadero motivador de esta salida fue mi esposo, quien sí es súper fanático. Gracias a él empecé a escuchar su música, y confieso que lo que me impulsaba era la curiosidad por ver cómo retratarían su compleja vida en la gran pantalla. >Aunque hoy no vengo a hacer una crítica profunda con spoilers, sí les puedo adelantar que, para mi gusto, me hizo falta que profundizaran un poco más en ciertos aspectos de su vida.
![1001617058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23wWpwMombxgfVGNYxoKjQPu8ATK4CDf4jaYhpqfA3cWnucgYc8GcmjmuruSgH5vTBgGu.jpg)
![1001617059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23zGWBqnFo4gwpTnzgEHTCQoabA3bjXvb26UDLEX6EgVZgjiLehJbqHnZeF1RC3QwHchh.jpg)
My husband had been saying he wanted to go see it ever since the first promotions came out. Since our kids are already teenagers and didn’t know much about Michael Jackson’s story, we thought it was the perfect opportunity to take them to learn about the career of one of the greatest artists of all time. We arrived at the theater on Saturday afternoon for the 5:45 pm showing. Thank goodness we had the foresight to arrive more than an hour early! The line to buy tickets and popcorn was super long. While we were waiting to get into the theater, I thought it was a bit of a letdown that the theater had a gorgeous photo booth with a red carpet for the premiere of The Devil Wears Prada 2, but there was absolutely no Michael Jackson-themed decor. Anyway, I wasn’t going to miss the chance, so I took my photos with whatever was available! You’ve got to make the most of the scenery in life. https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png >Mi esposo estuvo diciendo que quería ir a verla desde que salieron las primeras promociones. Como nuestros hijos ya son adolescentes y no sabían mucho sobre la historia de Michael Jackson, pensamos que era la oportunidad perfecta para llevarlos a conocer la trayectoria de uno de los mejores artistas de todos los tiempos. >Llegamos al cine el sábado por la tarde para la función de las 5:45 pm. ¡Menos mal que tomamos la previsión de llegar con más de una hora de anticipación! La cola para comprar las entradas y las cotufas estaba larguisima. >Mientras esperábamos para entrar a la sala, me pareció un detalle un poco “chimbo” que el cine tuviera un stand de fotos precioso con alfombra roja para la premier de The Devil Wears Prada 2, pero no tuvieran absolutamente nada decorado sobre Michael Jackson. De todas formas, ¡yo no iba a perder la oportunidad y me tomé mis respectivas fotos en lo que había disponible! En la vida hay que aprovechar los escenarios. ![1001577478.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/EpGQdCSrDNDtxfupgauVaVhv8g5v7JKUBkJHN2S2rXGNBQpm3EyFxKPhuLFEiJFoDnL.jpg)
![1001577481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23yd8684qcdeE38SVBWAuRpJjWYG2yMuLVMWN3xuWRjoMuTmP2M3aZsdLDCCCLjaQue8x.jpg)
![1001577482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/242s1FVW1EvNZVPPsmxMotwAK7aBr7qKeUZLER13GrmBetDRwrgcFGEuiTrTJwxNEvZjv.jpg)
We were among the first to enter the theater, but little by little it began to fill up in an impressive way. I asked my son to take a photo of the place to capture the moment, because it had been ages since I’d seen a movie theater like this. I think the last time I experienced something similar was in 2004, when I went to see *The Passion of the Christ*. It was great to feel that collective energy again! We had a blast. For me, the biggest highlight of the afternoon was seeing my kids come out excited, humming and talking about Michael Jackson’s music. As for me, I left knowing a lot more about his early days in the music industry and, above all, that intense father-son relationship that practically becomes the driving force and main plot of the entire movie. Honorable mention to the giant combo we bought: it came with extra-large popcorn, tequeños, peanuts, Doritos, and soda. It was so huge that the movie was almost over and we were still eating popcorn. It was a wonderful afternoon, and it’s definitely a movie I’d watch again. It’s moving, and it’s easy to see why Michael was someone who, despite being an adult, had the soul of a child and wanted to experience all the childhood he wasn’t able to enjoy back then. The casting was spot-on—since the actor is a direct relative—and at times we can actually see Michael Jackson in his eyes, so 100 points. I’d love to see a sequel, but given how controversial his life became after the movie ended, I doubt anyone would dare to make one. https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png >Fuimos de los primeros en entrar a la sala, pero poco a poco se empezó a llenar de una manera impresionante. Le pedí a mi hijo que tomara una foto del lugar para registrar el momento, porque tenía años de años sin ver una sala de cine a Creo que la última vez que viví algo parecido fue en el 2004, cuando fui a ver La Pasión de Cristo. ¡Fue genial sentir esa energía colectiva otra vez! >La pasamos súper bien. Para mí, el mayor logro de la tarde fue ver salir a mis hijos entusiasmados, tarareando y hablando de la música de Michael Jackson. Por mi parte, salí conociendo mucho más sobre sus inicios en la industria musical y, sobre todo, esa intensa relación paterna que se convierte prácticamente en el motor y la trama principal de toda la película. Mención honorífica al combo gigante que compramos: traía cotufas extra grandes, tequeños, maní, Doritos y refresco. Era tan enorme que la película ya estaba casi terminando y nosotros todavía seguíamos comiendo cotufas. >Fue una tarde excelente y definitivamente es una película que volvería a ver, es emotiva y es facil entender porqué Michael era una persona que a pesar de ser un adulto tenía alma de niño y quería vivir toda esa infancia de la que no pudo disfrutar en su momento. El casting súper acertado, al ser el actor familiar directo, hace que por momentos veamos en sus ojos a Michael Jackson,así que 100 puntos. Me gustaría una segunda parte, pero con lo polémica que fue su vida apartir de dónde quedó la película, dudo que alguien se atreva a desarrollarla.
![1001617066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beysyd/23tbPQHhoVZawZiocCFKYNd6Xp4puSEr5tFiwm3PYTGJLfmjezvP58U25iUM272i3AnLo.jpg)

![43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/ALQcpcgC7Aw21nAhZXK4dViDtTsCDGdQ3Uw4ZKXwRq9HUFHuEa8n13g5o4k9TAu.jpg) Good afternoon, my dear readers in the #Hive artistic community! Happy Monday and happy start to the week to everyone here reading this new post. It’s your friend Manuel here again, thrilled to share a new artistic post on my blog. This time, I’m bringing you an artistic piece focused on the game #Holozing, which, as many of you already know, is one of the most popular games within our platform’s ecosystem. What I came up with this time was to illustrate one of the game’s Healers, specifically the Forest Healer, but in this case, I decided to give her a slightly more fantasy-like style, and I drew her as if she were a kind of protective spirit of the forest, with a large wooden scepter or staff through which she channels all her powers of nature: >*Muy buenas tardes mis queridos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #Hive, feliz lunes y feliz inicio de semana para todos los que se encuentran por aquí leyéndome en esta nueva ocasión, por aquí los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel, super feliz de poder compartirles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog. En esta oportunidad les traigo una representación artística enfocada en el juego de #Holozing, que como muchas ya sabrán es de los juego mas populares que existen dentro del ecosistema de nuestra plataforma, y lo que se me ocurrió esta vez fue ilustrar a unos de los personajes Sanadores del juego, específicamente a la Sanadora del Bosque, pero en este caso se me ocurrió darle un estilo un poco más como de fantasía, y la dibuje como si fuese una especie de espíritu protector del bosque, con un gran cetro o báculo de madera en el cual canaliza todos sus poderes de la naturaleza:* ###

PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJegV7UxV7P4h7uN6XERgvjpD2WFsdz3jSoFVUAVYs9crqmaNB9aEfXjyFSWePp.jpg)
Well, the first thing I did was start working on the initial sketch for my illustration. In this case, I drew the Forest Healer in a style very much in line with my own illustration style. I gave her a slightly slender build and a somewhat youthful appearance to try to maintain the character’s original essence from the game, and as a distinctive detail, I drew her holding a large wooden staff in front of her. Once I finished the line art, I moved on to the coloring process. In this case, I wanted to start by adding color and life to the skin, so I used shades like peach and some reddish tones to give the Healer a realistic look and a lot of vitality. >*Bueno, lo primero que hice fue comenzar a trabajar un poco en el boceto primario de mi ilustración, en este caso dibuje a la Sanadora del bosque apegada mucho a lo que seria mi estilo de ilustración, le di una estructura un poco delgada, con una apariencia mas o menos juvenil para tratar de mantener la esencia original del personaje en el juego, y como detalle característico la dibuje sosteniendo un gran báculo de madera frente a ella. Habiendo terminado con el line art continúe con el proceso de coloreado, en este caso quise empezar dando color y vida a la piel, para la cual utilicé tonos como el durazno y algunos tonos rojizos para dar una apariencia realista y mucha vida a la Sanadora.*
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2CmnsokN7Lwb5NR77XzrcztEDA9MwmKngD6E8qxAeLpZYHxFTdgpWrvcbYtov.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2Cm4AaP2VdmK7mQCdv2utb8yemNn4wutZ1u9zsgqmEcE2Fv7NaGDse4FX6zb4.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2CkPcZ2vfPL42h4hdU3uofYoGT3YzPsPN8LQNtAZKS8n1qiwcpJYS1wwZRcB4.jpg)
For the eyes, I started by working with a fairly greenish color palette; the idea here was to give the Healer a very sweet and friendly style and personality, adding plenty of highlights along the edges. Then, for the mouth, I wanted the character to look quite cheerful, so I used orange tones and soft brushes to create good volume in the lips. As for the clothing, I stuck with the greenish color scheme but with a slightly darker shade. Using the watercolor brush, I created the basic shape of the hair, giving the strands a certain wave, and then with a finer brush, I worked on the highlights and realistic texture of the hair. >*En el caso de los ojos empecé a trabajar con una paleta de colores bastante verdosa, la idea aquí era darle una un estilo y personalidad muy tierna y amigable a la Sanadora, colocando Bastantes brillos en los bordes; luego para la boca mi idea era que el personaje se viese bastante sonriente, para ello usé tonos naranjas y pinceles suaves para lograr un buen volumen en los labios. En lo que respecta a la ropa me mantuve en la línea de los colores verdosos, pero con un matiz un poco mas oscuro, con el pincel de acuarela cree lo que sería la forma básica del cabello dando cierta ondulación a los mechones, y luego con un pincel mas fino me encargue del relieve y la textura de realismo del pelo.*
![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2CkPcZ2vfPL42h4hdU3uofYoGT3YzPsMywc6fSLNA1SWbDciavA3Hup8mRTgK.jpg) ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK3dxquWvcbRfp1spST4PE5V18rxj1b1rfHAX8BViohDCT84b2sJRDxWLsMmzjF.jpg) ![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2CkPcZ2vtSipQDbBWN9FQzbDMgciVYKmKL8Mvitaf5ZZh75QspeUSS5n6QBQC.jpg)
As for the costume, I decided to tweak the design a bit to better suit my style, but I also adjusted the color palette. In this case, I chose a very dark gray as the main color for the base of the Healer’s costume, and reserved the green tones for the central area of the costume’s zipper; I also added small details to the forearms and sleeves to give it a slightly more personalized touch. For the wooden staff, I started by working on the base structure with slightly chocolatey tones and a bit of dark red to make the wood look more realistic. Then, using green tones, I added color to what would become the large four-leaf clover, which would go right at the tip of the scepter. >*En cuanto a la vestimenta decidí variar un poco el diseño para adaptarlo mas a mi estilo, pero también varié las tonalidades, en este caso tome como principal protagonista un gris muy oscuro para la base del traje de la Sanadora, y los tonos verdes los deje para para la zona central de la cremallera del traje; también agregue pequeños detalles en los antebrazos y las mangas dándole un toque un poco más personalizado. En el caso del báculo de madera comencé a trabajar la estructura base con tonos un poco chocolatosos y un poco de rojo oscuro que diera un mejor realismo a la madera, luego con tonos verdes di color a lo que seria el gran trébol de cuatro hojas, el cual iría justo en la punta del cetro.*
![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK2CjCogT3MUrE1QPHJx7iBpNLxzy2eAR9z56VprB7w3jKvDtmafZvFV1ZGbHuV.jpg) ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK559udndZAj6m582RQAaDwz2b2SENtmLS8498vBiTWaov2aBcpWxE7wgC3VHuF.jpg) ![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK54rAj3gPaGEJULz3GsRBR3e1AzpUd5pMpag8jbepoS1si5GZBeKJC63RhncyL.jpg) ![33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AL5x78g1qZhmXWPJSBAMaR8QtWyYD2Q8y4zxAbNqM6BJdPkjTDBssSf8jjKSvtT.jpg)
###
MATERIALS / MATERIALES
- Sai Paint Tool Program - Huion inspiroy h610 v2 tablet >- *Programa Paint Tool Sai* >- *Tableta Huion inspiroy h610 v2*
![as4xns.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJegDMuEGTsjKUJiadSqAbN2Lt8WWGy7RboqWwLwjx4Kjq3sVn2oVRbWKs9ko2y.gif)
######
REFERENCE
[![FORREST HEALER - WOMEN.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJL5mcfHDTBz78ybWHFbdQhxRxePKpUduft1gWi7Jh9V7UiyL5gbtq2BDyo8yLF.jpg)](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/the-other-healers-and-a-starter-item-reveal) Well, folks, that’s all for today. Thank you so much to everyone for sticking with me this far and for reading. I hope you really liked the final result of my illustration, and if you did, please don’t hesitate to let me know in the comments below. With nothing more to add, I’ll sign off now. Sending you all a big hug, and we’ll see each other again in the next post…see you later!😎. >*Bueno mi gente, esto ha sido todo por el día de hoy, muchísimas gracias a todos por haber llegado hasta aquí, por leerme, y espero que el resultado final de mi ilustración les haya gustado mucho, y si fue así por favor no duden en hacérmelo saber abajo en los comentarios. Sin nada más que agregar, me despido, les mando un fuerte abrazo a todos, y ya nos volveremos a ver en un siguiente post…hasta luego!😎.*

body.title: The World May Be Entering An Era Of Silent Economic Pressure
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYmfkBzRiNCZg65kwupmY6wou1g9sRGMMyLfBkovAg3tm/1000701732.png 


Not every economic collapse happens dramatically.
Sometimes…
the most dangerous crises happen slowly.
Quietly.
Almost invisibly.
People continue working.
Cities remain crowded.
Markets still move.
Social media still looks normal.
But underneath the surface, pressure continues building.
And personally, I believe the world may already be entering that kind of phase now.
A long period of silent economic pressure.
Not necessarily one giant crash…
but a slow transformation that changes how people live, think, work, and survive.
Why Many People Feel Financially Stuck
One thing I notice globally is this:
Even people with jobs increasingly feel financially unstable.
Years ago, a stable salary often meant:
predictable growth
home ownership
family security
and long-term comfort
Today, that equation feels weaker.
Why?
Because modern economic pressure comes from multiple directions simultaneously:
inflation
rising living costs
debt dependence
expensive housing
global competition
automation
and declining purchasing power
This creates a dangerous psychological effect.
People begin feeling like: “No matter how hard I work, it is never enough.”
And when millions of people feel that way at the same time, societies begin changing emotionally.
Inflation Is Quietly Reshaping Society
Many people underestimate inflation because it does not feel dramatic overnight.
But over years, inflation quietly changes everything.
Food prices rise.
Transportation becomes expensive.
Education costs increase.
Healthcare becomes harder to afford.
Savings lose strength.
And eventually, lifestyles that once felt “normal” become luxury.
This may become one of the defining realities of the next decade.
The shrinking power of money itself.
That is why I think future generations may increasingly focus on:
ownership
investing
digital income
and asset accumulation
Not because they are greedy…
but because survival itself may require it.
The Future Could Become More Competitive Than Ever
Another trend I notice is this:
Technology is removing barriers everywhere.
Which sounds positive.
But it also means competition becomes global.
A person is no longer competing only with neighbors or local businesses.
Now people compete internationally through the internet.
AI accelerates this even further.
One skilled individual using AI tools can outperform entire teams from previous generations.
This changes the value of labor itself.
And honestly…
I think many traditional career paths may become unstable over the next decade.
Not disappear entirely.
But evolve rapidly.
The future economy may reward:
adaptability
speed of learning
creativity
digital leverage
communication
and independent thinking
More than rigid traditional systems.
The Psychological Divide Will Grow
But I think the biggest future divide may not be financial.
It may be mental.
Some people will adapt psychologically.
Others will resist change emotionally.
And that difference may shape entire futures.
Because the modern world is becoming increasingly overwhelming:
nonstop information
constant comparison
economic fear
political division
AI disruption
attention overload
People who cannot emotionally manage uncertainty may struggle deeply.
Meanwhile, calm and adaptable people may gain massive advantages simply because they can think clearly while others panic.
This is why I believe emotional discipline may become one of the most valuable future assets.
Not just intelligence.
Not just money.
But emotional stability.
Why Attention May Become The Most Valuable Asset On Earth
We often think money is the most valuable thing.
But increasingly, I believe attention is becoming even more important.
Every company wants it.
Every platform fights for it.
Every algorithm manipulates it.
Because attention controls behavior.
And behavior controls economies.
The people who learn to protect their focus may become the people who build the future.
While distracted populations may remain trapped in reaction cycles.
This is one reason why long-term thinking is becoming rare.
And rare things usually become valuable.
My Prediction For The Next Decade
Personally, I think the next 10 years will create enormous contrasts.
Some people may experience:
confusion
financial stress
emotional burnout
technological displacement
and increasing instability
While others may quietly build:
digital income
online communities
investments
AI-assisted businesses
and long-term leverage
The gap between reactive people and adaptive people may become massive.
And honestly…
I do not think governments alone will solve these problems.
Individuals themselves may increasingly need to:
educate themselves
build skills independently
understand economics
protect mental health
and think long term
Because the future may reward preparation more than comfort.
Final Thought
I do not believe humanity is doomed.
But I do believe the easy era is slowly changing.
The next decade may test people in ways previous generations never experienced.
Financially.
Mentally.
Emotionally.
Technologically.
And perhaps the biggest mistake people can make right now is assuming the future will operate like the past.
Because I think the world ahead may look completely different.
The people who survive best may not necessarily be:
the richest
the strongest
or the smartest
But the people who remain adaptable while others freeze in uncertainty.
And maybe…
that transition has already begun.
#EYS | Turning Patience Into Power 🌍💎

body.title: [Retrogaming] The Fairies Save Us on our Way to the Blue Pendant! | The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past (SNES)
body.body: >**My 3Speaking Today** \n\n  Hey, what's up, players! I truly hope you are all having an excellent start to the week. For my part, I have had quite a complicated start to the week, but I will explain that to you later, ha ha! For the moment, welcome back to my gaming channel on 3Speak and to its corresponding post, as is already customary. Players, I am truly sorry in advance for the delay that my Zelda: A Link to the Past series has had, but due to a hardware problem with my PC I was away from everything related to 3Speak and Hive in general for more than 15 days until I was able to resolve said problem. But thank God! I am back, and although the problems with the electrical power supply in my country (Venezuela) have worsened, I am still here, resilient and standing strong with good spirits towards the future. For now, fellow players, I am focused on continuing to bring more Zelda content here to the Snapie community and other gaming content from my 3Speak channel on a more regular basis. I truly believe that when things become complicated due to 'external factors' is precisely when you must, how shall I say it, \

and overcome adversity, because otherwise it is not possible to get past the obstacle. On another note, I recently also launched a new series on my 3Speak channel featuring Rockstar Games' portable title, Grand Theft Auto: Advance. At the end of this post you will find the list of videos already available on my 3Speak.

  As for this gameplay number 13, we can say that the fairies continue to be of enormous help, ha ha! As these are truly more than fairies, they are our guardian angels for recovering health in moments where it is running low. After obtaining the Pendant of Courage, we set out to head directly towards the south-west of Hyrule with the intention of obtaining the Blue Pendant, but the road leading there was riddled with all kinds of enemies, among them some new ones for us, such as the **Geldmans**, who are a sort of sand men that attack us very quickly in the desert area of Hyrule, as well as the **Toppos**, who tend to hide in tall grass to catch us off guard when we pass near them. Furthermore, on the way to Hyrule we solved a puzzle in an abandoned temple which helped drain some underground waters, and upon exiting the temple once again, we obtained a **heart piece**, just as we can see starting from minute **01:00** of the gameplay.


  Finally, the Geldmans, or sand men, make their appearance at around minute **04:00** of the gameplay, where they overwhelm us with their high attack speed, so we recommend that it is better to simply avoid them since they only attack for a brief period of time before hiding themselves among the sands of Hyrule's desert once again. We then arrived at the temple where the Blue Pendant was supposed to be, but we were unable to access it as it was blocked, and furthermore the runes surrounding it were written in a language that was at this point unintelligible to Link. So, while searching further around the area, we found another sage in a cave named **Aginah**, who tells us that he has a feeling that something terrible is going to happen in the Golden Land, and who in short instructs us that we must now obtain the Book of Mudora in order to be able to understand the ancient language of the Hylian People. That is to say, with this Book we will be able to understand the hieroglyphics of the temple where the Blue Pendant is located, and so under Aginah's instructions we must search for said book in the Hyrule village further to the West. By the way, at minute **07:26** of the gameplay you can see how I solve another puzzle in Aginah's cave and manage to obtain another heart piece : ) . With nothing more to add, I bid you farewell for today, but not without first thanking you for the support of my 3Speak channel and these gameplays. Thank you always, players.

body.title: 重新喜歡上香港
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaLPeitqMYef8JuQYb5QXF9ApUjWpXEFX5N47oNG5de7F/_20260517202739_35_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZbYfRYPFb71Lguq6fK2RZLUSN1d3TphMGzuSo2YEW9U/_20260517202740_36_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctMyndoEGPa8x27bdfisWSC3E1Kgv4Dkws5Jstaphxfw/_20260517202740_37_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxPRQEtWH2526QiyPnMVrS1jmNMir3dpY3A2ouziSeGq/_20260517202741_38_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU4rAbpFJwytFpFjeYSDC9z7woExjSwmwhENecqkc7VyY/_20260517202742_39_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2PqR93G7G9MgmrhZGLxUTRVHV2pomJj65QDhWcSEctt/_20260517202743_40_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSV4ChUjUb8mMk44961KYvbRBpAKMjNLMM5JRTVdEqb4/_20260517202744_41_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePFYzfvLJWY4xZerpAJUTspoGkRWax4283ajTCLbLTJH/_20260517202746_42_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYieuN1fUw9493j9CxsF4AGrCV1fGbK8ebXDonMc9pLjx/_20260517202748_43_9.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbbfds39VcZMryAXGfidz8amCbmBvMN23LgiVHFvawEvu/_20260517202749_44_9.jpg)

十一年前, 我因為不喜歡香港的生活節奏, 在深圳找了一份工作, 雖然只做了兩年就沒做, 但我沒做深圳駐廠那份工之後, 馬上便跟湘搬出來住了, 一住就在皇御苑這個小區住了十年. 雖然這十年以來我還是在香港上班, 但是, 我跟一個永久移民離開了香港的人沒太大分別了. 

這十年以來, 每天都是一線兩點, 過關上大巴, 下大巴, 轉小巴, 去吃早餐, 之後就到公司, 下班以後, 要麼直接殺回何文田在樓下商場吃飯, 要麼就坐地鐵回太子, 坐大巴回深圳. 香港的路? 除了老頭公司附近一帶之外, 基本上都認不出來了. 

在4月20日, 我表姐約我吃飯, 也算是補祝生日, 這次約了去尖沙咀東那邊, 嗯, 雖然離我的前公司不遠 (現在要改口叫前公司了哈) , 但估計我也要用導航才知怎過去了. 唯一知道的是, 我要坐8號小巴過去在科學館下車, 之後再慢慢用導航找找怎走吧.

下車之後, 果然就像一個遊客一樣, 去這不熟路, 去那認不到路, 也許就是這份十來年慢慢變得生疏的感覺, 令我在一路上都覺得, 原來香港也挺美, 要是我還可以舒舒服服, 多點下班就留在何文田就好了. 

不過, 這些事可能都要我自己再調節一下心態再說吧, 反正到現在為止, 我仍然一回到何文田就全身上下都不舒服, 回到公就是草草沖個涼, 草草跳上床就睡, 第二天起來草草跳下床, 梳洗就閃人, 一秒也不想多留.

Anyway, 當下是先找到酒樓在那裡, 我表姐應該沒那麼快到, 我先上去拿位. 拿完位, 看看餐牌, 現在香港吃飯果然是我吃不起的樣子了, 隨便一道菜148-188, 貴一些的還得268一道. 兩個人, 點4個菜豈不差不多1000元下樓? 對於我這種經常要在外邊吃飯的人說, 要是在香港住, 我怎負擔得起這種消費?

自己做飯? 看看新公司的工作強度再說吧, 要是每天朝9晚8, 我倒不覺得自己有能力回到家之後再做飯, 其他人行, 其他人上, 反正我不行. 湘雖然是朝10晚7, 但到家也晚了, 等她做飯, 也是9點過後才能吃, 所以, 現在又回到經常在外邊吃飯的節奏.

等了我表姐約25分鐘, 終於見到人, 見面就寒暄一下, 之後點菜吧. 現在都是聊一下大家的近況, 我就問為甚麼她們遲遲不過來深圳找我, 現在有車了, 可以帶她們到處去, 可是, 聽完表姐講她家的近況之後, 也理解了, 實在安排不了. 那就只好等過一陣子看看她家裡情況再說, 真的家家有本難念的經囉.

吃完之後, 我回去理論上還是坐8號小巴的, 但太久沒坐了, 以前的車站在修路, 都不知站點現在搬到那裡去了, 只好去我記憶中的上一個站點, 但要走好遠, 剛走到的時候走了一班車, 之後連等兩班都滿座了. 最後好像等了半小時才上到車, 回到家, 又是累死的一晚. 洗個澡就倒頭大睡了. 

2026.5.19

body.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you again. I hope you have a blessed start to the week. Today I want to show you this beautiful pastel makeup with a subtle shimmer that, combined with the gold headband, gives you a mystical, ethereal, and fantastical look. I hope you like it. \n

> Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta nueva oportunidad, espero tengan un bendecido inicio de semana, hoy quiero presentarles este hermoso maquilla colores pasteles y un brillo sutil que, combinado con la diadema dorada, te da un aire místico, etéreo y de fantasía. espero les guste ![IMG_8536.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23wMggGvThPm1W5WsxNZMd1Nfvci3BfUNpvweo3PcCYnhkqedQF28N9c3xZ9ajQwBkrx3.jpeg)

> The first step is to cleanse and moisturize my face. Then I begin my makeup, starting with my eyebrows. For this, I apply glycerin soap and shape my eyebrows. Now I work on the eyelid, adding concealer and blending it. Then I begin working on the upper eyelid with yellow eyeshadow, followed by blue, and finally pastel pink. On the upper eyelid, I set it with compact powder in my skin tone, and to finish, I apply eyeliner in black. \n

> el primer paso es limpiar e hidratar el rostro, luego comienzo con mi maquillaje por las cejas para esto aplico jabon de glicerina y le doy la forma a mis cejas , ahora trabajo en el parpado , agrego corrector y difumino luego comienzo a trabajar en el parpado fijo con color amarillo luego le aplico el color azul y finalmente el color rosa pastel , en el parpado fijo sello con el polvo compacto del tono de mi piel y para finalizar realizo el delineado en color negro - ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AJmtJZhCPcAMVwtJiBZzJV6wdNYhvc9RTusZQNgWCsnRTtiBeALDkszpVKjhAZD.jpeg)

> Now I apply foundation and blend it, then I apply brown concealer to the nose and cheekbone and blend it. Next, I apply concealer to the under-eye area and blend it. Then I set everything with pressed powder, dark concealer, and blush. In the inner corner of the eye, I extend black color, and on the waterline, I use pastel pink. Finally, on top of the eyeshadow on the upper eyelid, I place rhinestones. \n

> ahora aplico base difumino , luego aplico corrector cafe en la nariz y pomulo y difumino , lo siguiente es aplicar corrector en el area de ojeras y difumino , lo siguiente es sellar todo esto con polvo compacto , corrector oscuro y rubor en el area de lagrimal extiendo con color negro y en la línea de agua rosa pastel , finalmente arriba de las sombras en el párpado fijo coloco piedreria ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AJmsPtV3ZUGJxz4XKTvdbrdsPuvamWstGF1Wuy4YoRiVqTVJ24FR55J9jn5YfAP.jpeg)

body.title: Monday's Spin
body.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23xKzo8FHTfYhVCJFby7fnhDrWykypmjExieryYFpb6revZPPJR1fZQy6A8ditqkAAmta.jpg
A drive yesterday morning took us to the region's capital. The hubby couldn't be happier as he's got two mischievous creatures for company, so his delivery trip wasn't boring😅 We ate lunch halfway through the journey. Yongi was in a different mood, so he growled at a guy at the next table. The man laughed, saying my little bodyguard is feisty. It would have been good to have recorded the exchange, but I left my phone in the truck. Anyway, we reached the warehouse past 2 pm, passing through the ever-producing Strawberry Fields of La Trinidad (although they grow not only strawberries, but also leafy veggies like lettuce, romaine, green ice, etc). The rows of tunneled greenhouses and mulched fields are quite a view. We once lived nearby for a year after we came back from overseas, but the loud neighborhood had us abandon ship for the quieter countryside.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Eqd9YmZgXkUPRLaignqspNexGrg1eL22bjbwm5EM4yT8E4MAggjLGQWFpsRwwXqhEgA.jpg
The stock house was busy as always, so we waited for our turn. And while there, some reflections showed up right before the accustomed eyes. Gray clouds, blue sky, and part of the building were mirrored on the SUV's rear windshield.
||| |-|-| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/EoptRcZ3mkqpV1SJfofC7GwXPjvUPiYRHvYSA6iBMY2ctAgndgsXSzx16PDLAesuASk.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23wMYHxF7M8fwTy3uqtxiDbbx8WZ75DPqmDDRSKgaDU7DdcaEpJfdqktejF5ML1rgwoby.jpg|
Minutes later, the sun came through, dispersing the gray clouds and shining brightly like a light bulb.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23yd1R2SChyHJRsQceJpGCg8Q5JrbbdiA6JumpTmDscZCMb6Wvx2yNGmq3vEimyq6Cnv9.jpg
We moved forward, and images of water tanks and their stands showed up in a truck's tinted glass. As I was taking a snap (discreetly), the driver rolled the window down, hence, only one photo, lol!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/Eokd6BmDa83EogPKtJzjZhW8Wdfs6LrTwBwCaRydbURmnqhbrQ4y8ZQvjTB39AcDrMW.jpg
We waited for another hour while the boys unloaded our delivery. Then we rushed to the construction supplies center to pick up our purchases (iron pipes, PVCs, and such). Thankfully, we made it there barely 10 minutes before their closing time (5 pm). We refilled the gas tank afterwards and went on our way back home, stopping a couple of times along the way for other supplies, and of course, dinner. By 9 pm, we were at Papa's place to drop off his supplies and by 10:30, we arrived in DD. Quite a drive that was!
--- ---
*All photos are my own unless specified. 19052026/08:13ph*

***

```markdown
물결 속의 기억

파도는 속삭임,  
잊혀진 날들의 노래,  
해변에 남은 발자국,  
시간의 흐름에 스러져.

그리움의 물결,  
부서지는 꿈의 조각,  
바람에 실려오는  
너의 이름, 잊지 못해.

깊은 바다 속,
```

body.title: The Painted Smile
body.body: <center>\n\nThere is a quiet performance we play every day, where the smile is painted on and the laughter is just loud enough to drown out the sound of a heart breaking. It is a strange, hollow skill to be the sunshine in everyone else’s room while your own world is slowly turning to gray. We learn to let go in the dark, in the quiet minutes between the social scenes, perfecting the art of \

until we almost believe it ourselves. ***

The Painted Smile

I wear the morning like a golden mask,
And answer \

to every soul that asks.
I spin through hours with a steady grace,
With not a single crack upon my face.

The happy-go-lucky girl is back again,
A bright distraction from the hidden rain.
I tell the jokes, I lead the easy dance,
And leave my heavy secrets up to chance.

But deep beneath the surface of the show,
I’m learning all the ways of letting go.
I’m untying knots that I have held for years,
And washing out the salt of ancient fears.

It’s lonely work, this private, quiet death,
To lose a world with every shallow breath.
While they see light and hear a joyful tune,
I’m watching pieces crumble in my room.

So I’ll be bright, I’ll be the summer sun,
Until the long, exhausting day is done.
And when the curtain falls, I’ll find the peace,
Of letting go until the shadows cease. *** The world doesn't always need to see the struggle for the healing to be real. Sometimes, the mask we wear is a shield that allows us to mend in private, away from the questions we aren't ready to answer. I am learning that I can be both the woman who laughs and the woman who is grieving—that my outward joy doesn't make my internal letting go any less brave. One day, the smile won't be a performance; it will be the truth.

body.title: Dónde haya esperanza hay vida
body.body:
![IMG-20260503-WA0025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagroscmiranda/EpJb3SutKpqgynjxcSNCxD8Dn2H55DsTjry82rsfrQq2G5fMMLs1X7S3eW8yvLVFrUX.jpg)

Hola amigos de hive y de la comunidad HoloLotus.
Mi nombre es Milagro y hoy quiero compartir una de las experiencias más difíciles de mi vida, una historia que marcó para siempre mi destino, pero que también me enseñó que mientras exista vida siempre habrá esperanza.
Todo ocurrió el 8 de septiembre del año 2009.
Ese día, después de llevar a mi hija @diazktty a la escuela, regresé a casa como cualquier mañana normal. Vivíamos en un segundo piso junto al padre de mis hijas y mis dos niñas. Mi hija mayor aún dormía y para no despertarla decidí caminar por el alero de la casa para entrar por la parte de atrás.
Nunca imaginé que aquel momento cambiaría mi vida para siempre.
De pronto perdí el equilibrio y caí desde la placa. El impacto fue terrible. Se me comprimieron tres vértebras de la columna y el dolor era insoportable. Grité pidiendo ayuda, pero nadie me escuchaba. Cuando intenté acostarme en el piso también se me fracturó un brazo.
Una vecina llamada Aide, que hoy ya no está entre nosotros, fue quien me encontró tirada y llamó a la ambulancia. Gracias a ella fui llevada al hospital Faustino Pérez.
Comenzó entonces una etapa muy dura para mí y para mis hijas.
Pasé un año completamente postrada en una cama y otro año entero en rehabilitación aprendiendo nuevamente a caminar. Mi hija Katy apenas tenía 9 años y mi otra hija ya era mayor. En medio de aquella tragedia, el padre de mis hijas decidió apartarse y nos dejó prácticamente solas, sin apoyo económico ni emocional.
Fue entonces cuando mi pequeña Katy tuvo que crecer demasiado rápido.
Dejó la escuela para ayudarme y comenzó a trabajar vendiendo croquetas, galletas y cualquier cosa que pudiera aportar comida a la casa. A veces me cuesta hablar de eso porque era solo una niña, pero se convirtió en mi fuerza para seguir viviendo.
Ella me bañaba, me peinaba, me ayudaba a moverme y cuidaba de mí con un amor inmenso. Siempre le digo que yo no terminé de criarla a ella, sino que ella terminó criándome a mí.
También tuve el apoyo de mi madre, una mujer mayor que aun así hacía todo lo posible por ayudarme.
Aquella caída me enseñó muchas cosas. Aprendí quiénes realmente estaban a mi lado y descubrí una fuerza que ni yo misma sabía que tenía. Con mucho sacrificio logré volver a caminar usando un corset y poco a poco recuperé mi vida.
Hoy, después de 17 años, sigo aquí. Más fuerte, más agradecida y con el corazón lleno de experiencias que me hicieron crecer.
Quiero compartir mi historia para decirles que, aunque existan momentos donde todo parezca perdido, nunca debemos rendirnos. Siempre habrá una luz al final del camino.
Mientras haya vida, todo puede superarse.
También quiero agradecer a quienes siempre me motivan a seguir creando contenido, incluso cuando siento cansancio o desánimo. Sus comentarios me recuerdan que vale la pena continuar compartiendo mi realidad, mis pensamientos y esos pequeños momentos cotidianos que para mí tienen tanto valor.
Gracias por apoyar mi creatividad, por valorar mi esfuerzo y por hacerme sentir acompañada en este camino dentro de Hive. Espero seguir trayéndoles contenido sincero, cercano y hecho desde el corazón.
Les envío un abrazo enorme y todo mi cariño. Gracias por estar aquí y formar parte de esta aventura conmigo. 💖
![IMG-20260502-WA0112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagroscmiranda/23uQvaMjPh7ES46Yh7jQ5DXKn88GMYYTWk3p6EWAV99nxDTsyxHwWt5gp7dq1sBxG1N3o.jpg)
Estas fotos son mucho después ,cuando logré caminar y volver a vivir , cuando paso todo no teníamos ni cámaras digitales ni teléfonos móviles .

body.body:
>

Evil uses human stupidity to establish itself, for example flattering people, those who repeat like parrots without understanding what they are saying, people who are expert climbers, are the ones who actually give power to the evil one. Albert Einstein said that there are only two infinite things, one of them is the Universe and the other, well, human stupidity!. The extraordinary thing is that Moderna science has discovered that The Universe literally \

, and the same may be happening in the case of human stupidity, which lengthens and does not shrink. Thinking is always more difficult than accepting, thinking deserves effort, dedication, commitment and critical honesty; that's why the masses decide to only accept without filtering and defend to the utmost what is barely known so as not to remain ignorant. The truth is that the thinking being subjects everything to a question mark, but that fabric can be dirty if we have bad principles and values, I also think that submitting everything to judgment is necessary, not blindly believing in anyone or anything, always asking ourselves why?, for what?, from where, and to where? we want to arrive when *stupidity always insists on nothing and everything*... It is something like wanting to evaluate ourselves well, before we are emphasizing terms about value judgments or by repetition... Although we always run the risk of being part of stupidity because it is transversal in the real world. The time has come for us to think, to discern, to listen well, to reflect, to analyze. Because the most powerful weapon we have is not the things we already know, but the narrative, the discourse, what they tell us. Let's not fall into the trap of the binary reality, of the polarized world, reality is like a stadium and I fall short, there are thousands of sides and edges that we must strive to review so that we are not easily manipulated. We live in a society that does not recognize achievements, only recognizes mistakes, that is wedged in criticizing everything bad about us but cannot praise or recognize strengths or virtues, no matter if these are physical, intellectual or emotional. Without knowing that whoever makes a mistake has more merit because if he makes a mistake it's because he's doing something!! We must open people's eyes, because we are so busy with problems that many times we do not stop to analyze a little the shortcomings of critical thinking and normalize such shortcomings of the right, it only puts society in a stupidity of repeating bad thoughts. You have to make it difficult for people who make the way easier for the evil ones who want power, think about it, these bad guys who have the power want to use you, even more.
