body.title: Fake Breakout In Silver
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 18, 2026, 10_52_07 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23ydQrNhARzYQBZSRSXPSn7Gzd8joQVGSmAw6d28FLEgeJCgWLxmCZ5PAiud8pFcStiv3.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


A new and interesting twist has appeared in Silver’s movement which has confused many traders and investors. Whether we look at the 4-hour time frame or the 1-day time frame the chart pattern appears almost the same. 

I would like to explore some important points in this analysis so traders and investors can better understand the current situation.

We saw a strong bullish move earlier but after that the market faced bearish pressure again resulting in eight to nine consecutive red candles. Then during the weekend the market mostly moved sideways. 

As soon as the new week started a green candle initially showed buying pressure but immediately after that a red candle appeared with a large wick. This wick itself is actually a sign that strong buying entries are also present from lower levels.

As shown by the trendline drawn on the chart it seems that Silver has broken its bullish trend and has now formed a clear bearish pattern because the candles are now closing below the EMA 200. 


![Hive Explodes with a 34% Pump – Did You Catch It (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tmmjqSSWjhRRnRgATEww7mLFhwQN7h9JsWRuD1UbzFan9RwfaWS5vsXLCTzs9qJ9e9J.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

At the same time the red candle has also broken the trendline which at first glance looks like a very bearish scenario.

However such moves often turn out to be fake breakouts. This is the point commonly referred to as a liquidity grab where large institutions make retail traders believe that the market has become completely bearish so that most people enter selling positions. 

In contrast smart money usually looks for the best buying opportunities in these same zones. They always shows you the back side of the image..

In my opinion after its continuous red candles, Silver has now entered an important exhaustion phase and there are still three unfilled fair value gaps remaining. 


![Hive Explodes with a 34% Pump – Did You Catch It (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23twABpCtFTFGwxNuf697TfsT4GcvGqFQNwxG7chPC3XuCx37grDwBSM8YU6U8rshXEKV.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

In particular the fair value gap between 79 to 80 appears highly significant and it seems possible for the market to fill it. This is why I still see this move as more of a bullish recovery setup.

It is possible that this entire move is simply a fake breakout designed to confuse retail traders forcing weak hands out of the market before the price starts recovering again. 

If buying pressure remains strong Silver could once again target the upper liquidity zones and after filling the fair value gaps decide its next major move.

I am not a financial advisor. I simply enjoy studying and analyzing charts, candlesticks and market structure. This is only my personal observation and idea to help traders better understand different market possibilities and it should not be considered financial advice.

@dfinney , I request you to please add me as a member of this community.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

This afternoon I went to my grandfather’s farm for a while to take in the scenery from there, since everything looks so beautiful and it gives you a sense of peace and tranquility. Above all, I love the countryside—the sunsets that appear in the afternoon seem almost unreal.

body.title: 4+ Years in Praetoria
body.body:
![b44b6b81-0b35-4dab-bb7f-5f6e6fac2a80.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/breakingbenjamin/AK7vecjLWdh4Z7u29P9jtBebbaCWg32ZaLUXWLWFF5JKYqVGm2YKEswhESFay2s.png)

After more than four years writing the story of the Splinterlands, I'm stepping away. I gave my notice about two weeks ago, and Wednesday, May 20 is my last day. I wanted to write a proper goodbye here, where so much of the community lives and thinks out loud.

When I came on, Praetoria was little more than a coastline, the outline of a continent and not much else. Everything inside was still a blank. My job was to breathe life into it, to draw the inside of that outline and the characters that populated it and the lives and stories they lived. I built history that happened and would keep happening, I created names that meant something, and I'm damn proud of it.

Worldbuilding for a card game is a strange craft. Most of what you write, people meet sideways. A player opens a pack, glances at a card, and the lore is two paragraphs they may or may not read after the stats. You learn to write for that, to put a whole life into a few paragraphs or even a few lines, because that's all you get.

Conflicts were their own discipline, an epic story summed up in a short video or a couple paragraphs. Kingdoms, empires, politics, rivalries, heroes, antiheroes, villains, and the gods and goddesses all wove together in a mad tapestry of my design, along with the final battle everything has been building up to since Chaos Legion released. Some of it has shipped. Some of it is still in the wings. All of it was a privilege to build.

Most writers don't get to watch their work land in real time, but I did. You theorize about the Secret of Praetoria and Uul and the rifts. You wonder what Silus's endgame really is. You got to know the characters, got attached to them, and, dare I hope, fell in love with some of them. Enough of you did it, often enough, that I never once felt like I was writing into a void. That is a rare gift for a writer, and you gave it to me.

The story of Praetoria is not finished. There is a great deal still ahead, and I hope you get to experience all of it. A world is bigger than any one writer. This one will keep going without me, as it should. Praetoria was always meant to be yours more than mine. I just got to write some of it down first.

Thank you for letting me build this world with you. It's been an honor. Take care of Praetoria. From here on out, I'll be reading from the cheap seats.

Joey
Breakingbenjamin

body.title: ETF Outflows Are the Story, Not the Noise
body.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPyhCN5r7EZT6g4ZVvsdT4wJw2TNF5E3U9Lx2rK147GnB)


Crypto spent the session trying to argue with gravity, and gravity won. Bitcoin slipped below $77,000, Ethereum retested the $2,100 area, and the broader altcoin tape followed the same risk-off script. But the key driver behind today’s move is not a single headline about one coin or one chain. It is the steady withdrawal of institutional capital from the market’s most important on-ramp: spot ETFs.

That is the defining story of the day. When exchange-traded funds are bleeding and leverage is already thin, price discovery gets brutally one-sided. The result is a market that can still talk about long-term adoption while trading like nobody wants to be the first buyer.

## What the tape is saying

Bitcoin is now hovering around **$76,771.80**, down about **1.9%** on the day and roughly **7% off its May high near $82,850**. Ethereum is near **$2,113.20**, off **3.4%**, while Solana is around **$84.24**, PYTH is about **$0.0425**, LINK is near **$9.41**, and XRP trades around **$1.39**. That’s not random weakness; it’s broad de-risking.

The more important signal sits underneath price. Fresh data showed **roughly $1 billion in net weekly outflows from U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs**, the largest pullback in months, while spot Ethereum ETFs also saw **about $255 million** leave last week. In plain English: the institutions that were supposed to smooth crypto’s path into mainstream portfolios are, for now, stepping back.

That matters because ETF demand has been the cleanest proof of structural buying this cycle. If those flows reverse, rallies lose their fuel fast. Even with Bitcoin’s longer-term setup still supported by low exchange reserves and persistent accumulation from some holders, the market cannot ignore the flow picture in front of it.

## Why the market is failing to hold gains

This is less about panic and more about conviction. The market has been trying to trade higher on a stack of bullish long-term themes:

- the U.S. regulatory framework is slowly getting clearer,
- tokenization is moving from theory to infrastructure,
- stablecoins are increasingly treated like settlement rails,
- and firms like Galaxy are still expanding institutional access.

There is real progress there. The U.K.’s financial watchdog and central bank, for example, just laid out a tokenization roadmap that explicitly includes stablecoins for institutional settlement and a move toward 24/7 liquidity. In the U.S., the CLARITY Act is advancing. None of that is bearish.

But the market trades the margin, not the memo. Right now the marginal buyer is cautious, while the marginal seller is active. That is why Bitcoin can have supportive long-term fundamentals and still lose the short-term battle.

## The altcoin read-through

Altcoins are confirming the same message. ETH is lagging BTC again, which is a classic sign that traders are reducing beta instead of reaching for it. XRP is holding better than many majors, but that resilience looks more like selective positioning than a broad risk-on turn. Solana, LINK, and smaller liquid names are also under pressure, which usually happens when traders stop paying up for narrative and start protecting capital.

That’s also why the Fear & Greed backdrop matters. Sentiment has cooled into fear territory, and when that happens alongside ETF outflows, dips tend to get sold instead of bought.

## What could change this

For crypto to stabilize, it probably needs one of three things:

1. **ETF flows turn positive again.** That would be the cleanest signal that institutions are ready to re-risk.
2. **Bitcoin reclaims the moving-average band above the mid-$80,000s.** A technical recovery would help rebuild confidence.
3. **A fresh narrative outruns the flow drag.** That could be a stronger regulatory breakthrough, a major tokenization announcement, or a surprise macro shift that pushes investors back toward hard assets.

Until then, this looks like a market in digestion mode, not a broken one.

## Bottom line

Today’s most important crypto story is simple: **institutional outflows are overpowering the bullish narrative**. Bitcoin, Ethereum, and the alt complex are all behaving like a market that needs fresh demand before it can climb again. The long-term setup still exists, but short-term price will follow flows. If ETF buyers return, this pullback can fade quickly. If they don’t, the market may need to test lower support before it finds its next real bid.

body.title: ¿Caminar derecha = ser creída? [Esp - Eng]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRkHhYkSaUALnQXyJBic1CvngLg7GLjfPTJJHp4ws9HJv/1779148330289.jpg)
***
Muchas veces la gente suele confundir andar erguida, vista al frente, hombros hacia atrás y hacia abajo con sentimientos de superioridad en una persona como si fuera engreída, y es porque una postura correcta suele otorgar una imagen de carácter y seguridad en las personas.

Soy del tipo de persona que de repente se da cuenta de que está sentada con la columna vertebral en arco perfecto y rápidamente se endereza. Así que pregunté a mi entrenador si existían ejercicios físicos que ayudaran a corregir postura. Su respuesta fue afirmativa, pero agregó un comentario como complemento.

*\

.*

Y justamente ahí comenzó el debate...

Andar erguida o erguido sí es sinónimo de autoconfianza y de seguridad, pero también es salud. Mucho tiempo con una mala postura termina favoreciendo dolores en lo adelante y con ellos limitaciones y otras consecuencias para nuestros organismos. Cada hueso fue puesto con una función y para sostener algo en específico, forzarlos a moverse de ahí imposibilita la realización de determinadas acciones necesarias para vivir plenamente.

Pero, ¿por qué se suele confundir con exceso de ego o poder?
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQw14s6kgPFkbJz5w83EGZ7V95eXu2RnTfyWG6u75rCp/1769291657381.png)
***
Por lo general, para no ser absoluta, cuando alguien tiene miedo, tristeza o inseguridad suele encorvarse, bajar la mirada, dar pasos inseguros. Es método de protección, pero al mismo tiempo una señal clara de encogimiento.

Al contrario, quien muestra valentía y tener lo necesario para aferrarse al mundo y no soltarlo lo demuestra caminando erguido. 

Más allá de lo que suele transmitir esta correcta pose, en ocasiones juzgan mal a quienes andan con la espalda derecha, como si fuera moda la mala postura. 

Verdaderamente todo está en recordar andar derecha, al sentarme, al caminar; en todo momento. La mayor fuerza para lograrlo es tu propia consciencia y la imágen de tí que desees transmitir.

Me gustaría acalarar que como humanidad al fin, no se trata de perfección (o al menos mi post no). Conozco personas que han nacido con alguna situación en la columna vertebral y también son personas super seguras. ¿Cómo lo demuestran? Con la mirada. Las verdaderas puertas al alma y a quienes realmente somos.

La práctica de ejercicios físicos también ayuda a corregir postura, además de que todos sabemos que es bueno para la salud en general. Evita los horribles dolores que el paso de los años suele dejar y da la fuerza física para, aunque pasen los años, seguir siendo independiente y saludable.

Hay también muchos alimentos que fortalecen los huesos, por lo que una correcta alimentación es también fundamental.

Yo siempre trato de andar derecha (siempre que me doy cuenta). Es verdad, la espalda luce hermosa en los vestidos y en los crop tops, es verdad que luzco más alta estando derecha, es verdad que mi mirada se ve diferente al andar, pero creo ser una persona sencilla, que simplemente busca una buena pose, para ayudar a mi cuerpo a no doler en la vejez.

Es casi imposible ir por ahí tratando de convencer a todos de por qué adoptas tal postura o semejante actitud, quienes me conocen de verdad (igual a ustedes que me leen) sabrán la hermosa persona que irradia luz y buenas vibras, por andar erguida me van a juzgar, pero me queda la tranquilidad de que cuando me haga mayor, podré jugar en el piso con mis nietos, regar las plantas y seguir dando las caminatas que tanto me gustan al atardecer.

Para saber si es creída, observa a sus ojos, en su interior y en sus actitudes, que te van a decir más de ella que su postura.

Gracias por leer.
Con cariño: Vicky ❤️
***
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGfBfFw6Rps5gV5ogZ1Cj2dirCgddUEeXmZdnS3VnsJZ/1779147612366.png)
***
***
People often confuse walking upright—head up, shoulders back and down—with feelings of superiority, as if the person were conceited. That's because a correct posture usually gives off an image of character and confidence.

I'm the type of person who suddenly realizes they're sitting with their spine perfectly arched and quickly straightens up. So I asked my trainer if there were physical exercises that help correct posture. His answer was yes, but he added a comment as a complement.

*\

*

And that's exactly where the discussion began...

Walking upright is indeed a sign of self-confidence and security, but it's also about health. Spending too much time with poor posture ends up causing pain down the line, along with limitations and other consequences for our bodies. Every bone was placed with a function and to support something specific; forcing them out of that alignment makes certain actions necessary for a full life impossible.

But why is it often confused with excessive ego or power?

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQw14s6kgPFkbJz5w83EGZ7V95eXu2RnTfyWG6u75rCp/1769291657381.png)
***
Generally speaking—not to be absolute—when someone is afraid, sad, or insecure, they tend to hunch over, lower their gaze, and take hesitant steps. It's a method of protection, but at the same time, a clear sign of shrinking.

On the contrary, someone who shows bravery and has what it takes to hold on to the world and not let go demonstrates it by walking upright.

Beyond what this correct posture often conveys, people sometimes misjudge those who walk with their back straight, as if bad posture were the fashion.

Truly, it all comes down to remembering to walk upright—when sitting, when walking, at all times. The greatest strength to achieve it is your own awareness and the image of yourself you wish to project.

I'd like to clarify that, as humanity after all, it's not about perfection (or at least, my post isn't). I know people who were born with some spinal condition and are also extremely confident people. How do they show it? Through their gaze. The true windows to the soul and to who we really are.

Physical exercise also helps correct posture, and we all know it's good for overall health. It prevents the horrible pains that the passage of time usually brings and gives you the physical strength to remain independent and healthy as the years go by.

There are also many foods that strengthen bones, so proper nutrition is also essential.

I always try to walk upright (whenever I catch myself). It's true, your back looks beautiful in dresses and crop tops; it's true that I look taller when standing straight; it's true that my gaze looks different when I walk. But I believe I'm a simple person, just looking for good posture to help my body not ache in old age.

It's almost impossible to go around trying to convince everyone why you adopt a certain posture or attitude. Those who truly know me (just like those of you who read me) will know what a beautiful person I am, radiating light and good vibes. They may judge me for walking upright, but I have the peace of mind that when I'm older, I'll be able to play on the floor with my grandchildren, water my plants, and keep taking my beloved sunset walks.

If you want to know if someone is conceited, look into their eyes, inside them, and at their attitudes—they will tell you much more about her than her posture.

Thanks for reading.
With love: Vicky ❤️
***

body.title: Probé las frambuesas con chocolate de la marca Águila / I tried Águila's chocolate-covered raspberries
body.body:
Cuando se trata de chocolate, yo no pongo peros al momento de probar, y mucho menos, si me lo regalan. Y así justamente pasó este encuentro, pues mi supervisor me preguntó si había probado las frambuesas con chocolate, y como le dije que no, me regaló un envase casi completo.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmbj1Vn5pc6frGhoMzAq3jWZS4bACePovnM6HNXmVDPeW1/chocolate_y_frutas_.png</center>

Hace tiempo vi que esta nueva presentación se ha puesto muy de moda, combinando frutas y chocolates en una versión fría, ya que desde hace mucho, en las fiestas se estilan las fuentes de chocolate en las que se pueden sumergir frutas trozadas, marshmallows o cualquier canapé dispuesto en la mesa para ello, pero estos van en modo caliente.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeUiTc3uV1vbr6iuNaQV9UB9YttRZf9RXjvBtJY4smDF/20260512_162348.jpg</center>

De hecho, la primera vez que vi este producto, fue con una noticia lamentable, en la que unos chicos recibieron un delivery con un envase de fresas con chocolate, sin haberlo pedido, pero adolescentes al fin, aprovecharon la ocasión y lo comieron entre todos, con el lamentable fallecimiento de una de las chicas y una intoxicación severa en el resto del grupo. La noticia era que quien lo envió fue la amante del padre de la chica fallecida, como venganza por haber terminado la relación.

Pero más allá de eso, y de la coincidencia del producto, yo nunca imaginé que mi jefe quisiera asesinarme, por lo que los comí con confianza, brindándole a mis hijos, aunque solo el mayor fue quien quiso probarlos.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzZxii22VudVXjhmdBSNpbiP8GQJfTVZ5JRnatjMEmz8/chocolate_y_frutas_1_.png</center>

En cuanto al producto en si, la combinación ácida de las frambuesas con el chocolate, es interesante al paladar, pues aunque no le quita protagonismo a la fruta, son dos sabores que se manejan muy bien juntos, pudiendo sentirse cada uno por separado en algún momento.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyyvmbQJ5SfA3Mmk4yn8BpNMhcPURkf5SxczN61TS7ek/chocolate_y_frutas_2_.png</center>

Una de las cosas que me encantó es que pueden consumirse solos como un postre, pero también pueden agregarse como decoración en algún pastel, por lo que no necesariamente tienen una manera de degustarse, así como tampoco el hecho de estar congelados o a temperatura ambiente, ya que el chocolate no se derrite tan fácilmente.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWakAQ4BT4S45RuuMMaYJ2MWAQbM3DWnJZVakFj7MiMXM/chocolate_y_frutas_3_.png</center>

Definitivamente es un producto que se deja desear, pues cuando terminas el envase, quedas con ganas de repetir la experiencia en otro momento, más allá del precio que no es económico, pero que puede ser ese placer culposo de una vez por mes, o tenerlo para consumirlo dosificado.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYf4QK63yfBoQJAapQDmzsWMS7exnhZ7m9FjcDpZxgV6/20260515_151536.jpg</center>

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

When it comes to chocolate, I’m always up for a taste, especially if it’s a gift. And that’s exactly how it went this time: my supervisor asked me if I’d tried the chocolate-covered raspberries, and when I said no, he gave me a nearly full packet.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmTK5WciKAqcW3oCps3XcvKvkk3y3F248jQGnxV8sy5o2D/20260512_162411.jpg</center>

I noticed some time ago that this new format has become very fashionable, combining fruit and chocolate in a cold version, as for a long time now, chocolate fountains have been popular at parties, where you can dip chopped fruit, marshmallows or any canapés laid out on the table, but these are served hot.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeUiTc3uV1vbr6iuNaQV9UB9YttRZf9RXjvBtJY4smDF/20260512_162348.jpg</center>

In fact, the first time I saw this product was in connection with a tragic news story, in which some teenagers received a delivery of a box of chocolate-covered strawberries without having ordered it; but being teenagers, they seized the opportunity and shared it among themselves, resulting in the tragic death of one of the girls and severe food poisoning for the rest of the group. The story was that the person who sent it was the mistress of the deceased girl’s father, as revenge for ending the relationship.

But beyond that, and the coincidence of the product, I never imagined my boss would want to murder me, so I ate them with confidence, offering them to my children, although only the eldest wanted to try them.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzZxii22VudVXjhmdBSNpbiP8GQJfTVZ5JRnatjMEmz8/chocolate_y_frutas_1_.png</center>

As for the product itself, the tart combination of raspberries and chocolate is intriguing on the palate; although it doesn’t overshadow the fruit, the two flavours complement each other beautifully, whilst each can still be tasted distinctly at times.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyyvmbQJ5SfA3Mmk4yn8BpNMhcPURkf5SxczN61TS7ek/chocolate_y_frutas_2_.png</center>

One of the things I loved is that they can be eaten on their own as a dessert, but they can also be used as a decoration on a cake, so there isn’t necessarily a set way to enjoy them, nor does it matter whether they’re frozen or at room temperature, as the chocolate doesn’t melt that easily.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmWakAQ4BT4S45RuuMMaYJ2MWAQbM3DWnJZVakFj7MiMXM/chocolate_y_frutas_3_.png</center>

It’s definitely a product that leaves you wanting more, because once you’ve finished the packet, you’re left wanting to repeat the experience another time. Despite the price—which isn’t cheap—it could be that once-a-month guilty pleasure, or you could keep it to enjoy in small doses.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmfYf4QK63yfBoQJAapQDmzsWMS7exnhZ7m9FjcDpZxgV6/20260515_151536.jpg</center>

body.title: Encuentro de Talentos:   \
body.body:
>

Los amigos y seguidores de Encuentro de Talentos, más que una comunidad, nos hemos convertido en una gran onda de amistades con buena vibra que traspasamos fronteras y que aprendemos y crecemos todos juntos con **#EmpowerTalent.**

Para esta semana tenemos otro tema interesante, que les permitirá pensar y repensar sobre situaciones de su vida o incluso de otros, para escribir grandes historias.


## Tema de la semana:  \
\n\nEsta semana es para seguir creando contenido, aprendiendo y disfrutando mientras lo hacen.  *\

*; es un dicho, que quizá todos conocen, pero que no todos entienden. Hay momentos en la vida en que se van postergando acciones y decisiones que son necesarias de tomar, pero que por alguna razón se van dejando pasar. En muchas oportunidades, el hecho de no accionar viene derivado de imaginar que no se sabe lo que pasará en el futuro, ya que es incierto y misterioso; es posible también que puedan paralizarse debido a que esperan a que en el futuro todo sea mejor. Pero, a decir verdad, nadie conoce lo que el futuro nos tiene preparado. Esta semana la comunidad de EmpowerTalent los invita a soltar las ideas alrededor de lo que hoy puede hacer, y creamos la siguiente interrogante. Si hoy tomaran la decisión de cambiar algo en sus vidas, ¿Qué sería o qué acciones tomarían? Escriban en una hoja en blanco esa decisión y realicen dos columnas, los pros y contras de esa decisión. De este tema, pueden escribir desde cualquier perspectiva, creando historias propias o de fantasía. Cuando entendemos que el futuro es un misterio, dejamos de preocuparnos tanto de lo que no llega; hay momentos en que nuestra mente crea enfermedades que no existen debido a lo que piensa que será en el futuro. Por ello, algunas personas comienzan con padecimientos que se traen de esa imaginación; parece algo increíble de creer, pero somos capaces de condicionar a la mente. Es por ello que esta comunidad deseamos compartir el regalo del poder de acción de hoy, para que vivan libres. Estamos seguros de que cualquier forma que creen su historia al respecto de este tema será grandiosa, como una forma de agregar contenido a las páginas del libro que todos vamos a escribir, con gran emoción y buena vibra de talentos. *Qué comiencen los juegos del talento.* **Algunas sugerencias** El título de tu publicación que invite a la creatividad y no necesariamente debe llevar implícito la palabra que invita al tema, sabemos de la ingeniosa capacidad de creatividad que todos nuestros participantes del programa tienen. Los esperamos con la buena vibra de siempre, con sus creaciones que cada día más conquistan corazones, y con su encantadora voz que al compartirla nos llena de alegría y deseos de continuar. Encuentro de Talentos Es un programa de promoción y presentación en vivo, donde proponemos temas cada semana con los cuales hemos recibido una grata respuesta de la comunidad y para este año 2026 deseamos continuar aportando ideas para la generación de contenido creativo que permita fortalecer el vínculo con diferentes comunidades. Parte de nuestro trabajo es, compartir publicaciones creadas con tema originales para aprender y hacer comunidad por medio de la música y la energía en positivo. En este programa estamos abiertos a recibir a todos los que se animen, a escribir sobre nuestros temas propuestos, pero además también a los que se atrevan, a compartir una canción, sin temor a equivocarnos, porque estamos seguros de que al cantar liberamos energía que permite que el cuerpo se relaje, romper con el miedo escénico y mejorar su forma de expresión en público. ___
>\n\nDeseamos conocer tus ideas, aportes, reflexiones, ocurrencias, iniciativas sobre lo que significa **\

** y como siempre decimos: la creatividad no tiene límites, porque los límites únicamente están en la mente y todos ustedes son dueños de ella. 


<h2><center><div class=\

>Comparte tu creación en los comentarios de esta publicación ___ Encuentro de Talentos Todos los días son importantes, pero cada martes en el mundo virtual para nosotros representa una emoción diferente por querer cumplir y estar con todos ustedes, quienes han sido fieles a este programa, de Encuentro de Talentos, es por ello, que hoy volveremos a reencontrarnos para continuar compartiendo energía positiva. ___

Vamos todos a cantar y no dejes de usar la etiqueta #empowertalent y #talento y #Encuentrodetalentos ***AL COMPARTIR EN OTRAS REDES SOCIALES.***

 Agradecemos infinitamente tu mención dentro de la publicación, porque nos permite ser más visible ante otras comunidades.
___

>


La invitación queda abierta para disfrutar de un programa maravilloso lleno de talento, energía y buena vibra.

<h2><center><div class=\
>Entonces, ¿Qué harás el martes 19 de mayo de 2026? 8:00 pm ___

>Te esperamos para cantar y vibrar en positivo por medio de la música Te esperamos a disfrutar con nosotros en el discord de un rato diferente, nos vemos en PAL, en la sala [espanol-chat](https://discord.gg/fJ5ZXy9) y el canal de voz `[espanol-Voz PPT](https://discord.gg/a76xGMv) en nuestro querido canal #discord de -Paz- Abundancia -Libertad (PAL). 19 de mayo 2026 Hora: 8:00 pm hora de Venezuela Hora de Recepción de publicaciones: a partir del mismo día martes hasta las

___ # ¿Cómo puedes participar en Encuentro de Talentos? ___

>

- 1 .Prepara tus ideas para crear tu publicación respecto al tema propuesto en la semana, pero recuerda que deberás publicarla el mismo día martes.

- 2 .Organiza un resumen de 3 min de publicidad y fama para invitar a todos los participantes a leerte (Breve introducción, desarrollo, cierre y enganche). Son solo 3 minutos aprovéchalos.

- 8.Importante: queda a juicio del curador si asigna o no el voto. Es decir la participación en el programa no implica que el voto es automático.

Te esperamos con mucho cariño y apreciamos tu constancia y dedicación para seguir compartiendo en este \

body.title: A Blessed Start to My Sunday
body.body:
Last Sunday, I went to church by myself and this church is near my place but I went there using my electronic bike (EBike) that I always use whenever I go somewhere around my town. 


![chur11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23ynf4VUCbgFPyFgzG6e4vc8VykQGqa3eEH7VUsocUfYdZK189vAzxrVKC5MpjL1Dkqhr.png)


I prepare my things around my house at around 7 because the mass will start at eight in the morning and I need to listen to the gospel so that I will be bless and listen to the verses and gospels from the father.

I went to the church by myself and it was the second time that I went to that church, that was a catholic church, and yeah, there were lots of people that went to this place, too.

body.title: A cleaner water source
body.body:
Recently, the water spray from the shower head is getting smaller and slower by the day. I already knew it has something to do with the filtration system, so I decided to give the entire filtration system in the house a clean sweep.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1cC54t1D4A4vagJq5JfCD4NDxS1sZc3aStFdJW69H9d/1779140633287.jpg)

First I tackle the shower water supply filter. If you do not know where this is, it's usually located at the water supply knob, where there is a small cap beside the knob where you usually turn on and off water supply.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeCWQiwNXhe6dZTkTJoE5fWrSRLsmSkBPrC7PG9t3vGoJ/1779140633425.jpg)

Before you remove the cap, make sure you have turn off the water supply so you don't spray yourself. I mean it's ok if you're already stark naked and getting ready to take a bath. But it's best to turn off the water heater as well for safety purpose.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdvew2rsMQ8He3AhJdyKiaEb7V1SWgcTGX34anH7tiwE8/1779140633484.jpg)

Once the cap removed, there's a small head you can use your finger to pinch it down and gently yank the filter out. If it's too hard, get a small plyer and gently clamp it down and yank it out. Once clean up the wire mesh, you may proceed to reverse the entire process and put everything back on.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdRApwacGpEv5L2VCJdnd7X4p94cnnirpgRzjWB3n39e/1779140633542.jpg)

Before you turn on the water tap and test the water flow, it's a good time to give the shower head a quick clean. Mine had a built in element filter, so I actually dismantle it and had the filter changed. Meanwhile, it's good to get a used old toothbrush and brush through all the pinholes. Who knows, particles might just lodge there and block the flow. Is also good to use the tooth brush to brush the inner passage way just to make sure rust doesn't become stain over the long run.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdMWRxHBTYLBmFWEd2jPKeXJvDaSwPoMSvzaRXjvmYJY4/1779140633591.jpg)

Ok I admit it's my fault. I've been thinking, there's already a wire mesh filter, my whole house is also supply by element filter. I will never think of an extra filter in the shower head can filter out such crazy amount of dirt. The last I changed this was a couple of months ago. I should really make it a habit to check on the shower head as well. In the end, these water we use to bath our body.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBi9PtG4bQjAKrBDuRA45hYCLYG8CPbxHB89T4yziTuL/1779140652143.jpg)

Other than all that, the main water filter from the main water supply looks quite ok. The element filter was supposed to push water from the putter surface of the cylindrical filter, and clean water supply pass through the enter tube.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQByBcTZnDkxUKUMX3YBGmNWCXnLL3aAusfgk3W9PKaz2/1779140652215.jpg)

I was \

to change the inlet and outlet, so the source water supply came from the center and push water outwards. Technically, the fltration sould be the same, however I won't be able to see how dirty the filter is before the water supply gets blocked off and water flow become so poor that my urine flow faster than the water tap 😅

body.body:
>



# Tranquila

​
#


A veces puedes ser ese tipo de persona que se afecta con mucha facilidad por todo lo que sucede a su alrededor, al punto que un pequeño problema suele convertirlo en algo grande; el detalle es que aunque otros intenten explicar que **no es grave** lo que ella ve sin solución para los demás hasta puede ser algo inofensivo. Es una personalidad bastante sensible y quienes la conocen deben tenerle mucha paciencia y tacto a la hora de tratarla, escucharla y prestarle mucha atención para ayudarla brindándole todo el apoyo cuando este frente a circunstancias que evidentemente la afectan.

No se trata de quitarle importancia a lo que piensan y de como ven las cosas; comenzando por entender que no todas las personas son iguales ni siente ni ven de la misma manera. Si decirle en un momento que lo que está pasando no es grave hay que hacerlo con mucha delicadeza y nunca desde la burla o quitándole valor a lo que les pasa; al contrario, trata siempre de ayudar hablando para que le muestre todo con más claridad y menos confusión mostrando las soluciones sobre lo que está sucediendo.

Como el refrán que dice: *no te ahogues en un vaso de agua*, haciendo referencia a esas personas que se angustian mucho viendo problemas donde no los hay; incluso pasa con aquellas personas que se quejan cada día por pequeñas cosas creyendo que están mal sin darse cuenta de que después de ellos hay miles de personas sufriendo cosas realmente malas como necesidades de alimento o están en una enfermedad terminal, lamentablemente.

​
​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



#  Don't worry



#
Sometimes you might be the kind of person who is easily affected by everything going on around you, to the point where a small problem often seems like a big deal; the thing is, even if others try to explain that **it’s not a big deal**, what she sees as unsolvable—even something harmless to others—can still feel overwhelming to her. They have a very sensitive personality, and those who know them must be very patient and tactful when dealing with them, listening to them, and paying close attention to help them by offering full support when they face circumstances that clearly affect them.
​
It’s not about downplaying what they think or how they see things; it starts with understanding that not everyone is the same, nor do they all feel or see things in the same way. If you need to tell them at some point that what’s happening isn’t serious, you must do so very delicately and never in a mocking way or by downplaying what they’re going through; on the contrary, always try to help by talking to them so they can see everything more clearly and with less confusion, while pointing out solutions to what’s happening.
​
As the saying goes: *don’t make a mountain out of a molehill*, referring to those people who get overly anxious by seeing problems where there aren’t any; this even happens with people who complain every day about little things, believing they’re in a bad way, without realizing that there are thousands of people behind them suffering from truly terrible things, such as a lack of food or a terminal illness, unfortunately.

Por aquí todo muy bien, gracias a Dios. Disculpen, que llevaba días sin escribir; la verdad, no me sentía muy pero muy bien, me daban unos dolores de cabeza que no sé ni de dónde salían y no tenía mucho ánimo para escribir, pero aquí volvimos. Sabes que ayer en la tarde me sentí un poquito mejor, así que mi novio decidió salir un rato a una vuelta. Yo tenía muchísima duda con 2 cosas; una era el cine, que mañana se los puedo compartir, y la otra eran unas ofertas que había visto hace unos días por TikTok en Traki y quería ir a averiguar a ver qué tan cierto era y si les hablo del centro comercial La Vela Margarita.
Hi, everyone, how are you? Everything’s going really well here, thank goodness. Sorry I haven’t written for a few days; to be honest, I wasn’t feeling very well at all – I’d been getting these headaches that I don’t even know where they came from, and I didn’t really feel up to writing, but here we are again. You know, yesterday afternoon I felt a bit better, so my boyfriend decided to go out for a bit. I was really torn between two things; one was the cinema, which I can tell you about tomorrow, and the other was some offers I’d seen a few days ago on TikTok at Traki, and I wanted to go and check out whether they were genuine or not, and whether I should tell you about La Vela Margarita shopping centre.

La verdad, no me quejo y fui ahí por la recomendación de una prima y quedé enamorada de los pantalones; entonces, una de las cosas que seguí, que había en descuento, eran precisamente esos pantalones, así que yo tenía que ir a averiguar. Pero la verdad es que no todo podía ser lindo como pintaba, porque realmente no estaban los pantalones, pero si no te quería, muchos racks de descuento de 3, 4 y 5 dólares en cositas bastante bonitas, pero más que todo patrones de vestir de caballeros, eran lo que había y no estaban tan mal. La. Verdad. No los vi tan feos, pero no había lo que yo quería ir, así que no me gustó mucho por esa parte.
Because of my job, which is quite formal, I wear a lot of smart clothes and I love Sara-style trousers, and most of my Sara-style trousers are from Traki, as, as well as being very reasonably priced, they’re really nice. To be honest, I’m not complaining; I went there on a cousin’s recommendation and fell in love with the trousers. body.title: Deer everywhere! - My Actifit Report Card: May 17 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a9bd1228-fcc9-4370-a539-e61184db3892.jpg) Hey Actifitters, A few weeks ago, I learned that the city I live in and a few others around had performed a deer culling. I knew it was planned but I thought it was for next year. I understand the reasons but I like seeing all these deer, and I'm glad to see in my neighborhood, there are still a lot of them. This one was hanging out in the yard, with no idea that Kaia was growling at him from behind the window. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/21156964-52b4-423b-af4a-5200205d3c79.jpg) Brand new antlers growing, that's pretty cool. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d3f027f3-69a5-4fbf-8774-8865588a344d.jpg) Later in the afternoon, still in the yard, Le Chat was trying to teach Kaia the art of the grumpy face. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/212e94d6-8fc1-400c-bb3d-cffa13639cf5.jpg) But clearly Kaia wasn't being a good student, way too many things to keep an eye on, she's always a guard dog before anything else. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/253fe4f3-a799-4196-9bc8-f6c56224a6b2.jpg) Le Chat doesn't care anyways, she's the best, and her talent cannot really be taught. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5d3b9d42-9f18-4d46-9f7f-2360a1b620f2.jpg) Of course, we also started our daily walk behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bb269775-0b38-4bff-a069-0b4e2baefb31.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2c863bc4-faa4-4a55-a67d-9f6aff3d1bcd.jpg) After chasing all these deer earlier in the day, Kaia started limping more than she's been the past few weeks. But she seemed somewhat okay in the small forest, so we started on our way to the bigger forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/11a828c4-3099-4744-98d8-6bb57b402ea0.jpg) But quickly, it was obvious she was in real pain, limping even more. So we turned around pretty quickly and went back home, where a bunch of deer were waiting for us again. The smaller one, probably younger and female, was the first one to see us. Then another one that looked like the one earlier in the backyard. Kaia was on leash, so they were safe and started to play with the smaller one chasing the other one, even poking him with its head. Or maybe they were fighting, not entirely sure. It was fun to watch, except maybe for Kaia who really wanted to join the game, even with her painful leg. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7c608370-6c3a-49d3-b873-ded054984fca.jpg) Since our walk was really short, I decided to go for a run. I made sure Kaia got some rest for her leg, but I ignored my own knee pain. I kept it short though, just 5k at a slow pace. Again, even if I walked for a few minutes in the middle, I kept the overall pace below 6min/km, so it is slow but not so bad considering my current form. And bonus, it is very counter intuitive and I didn't expect it, but my knee is less painful after the run. Let's see when I can go for another one this week. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260518t233844688z)_

Ayer salí a pasear muy temprano, y di con un lugar que me pareció muy bonito. Es una zona rural pero también tiene una parte industrial, la vegetación me recordó a mi ciudad Maturin, además que cuando iba en el bus a casa lado podía mirar una buena cantidad de ganado. 

Las casas de la zona todas me parecieron hermosas, incluso algunas de madera, no tome fotos de muchas de ellas porque no estaba seguro de si las personas les molestaría. 

Pude capturar la casa que ven en la portada porque no había nadie a la vista. Aunque se ve un diseño algo cuadrado, no deja de tener estilo, es diferente y está bien cuidada. 

Feliz noche.

body.title: Mía , el gato que vive en mi casa
body.body:
![IMG20260518130149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/EogNrtZZS6GyVAjL8TVP8V2wyL8TdxSTM8Lr5m8sYnMqNEkVy9oNK7Dp7LnvsZpPp2p.jpg)
Hoy quiero publicar en esta comunidad ya que se que muchas de las chicas de hive aman a los animales , espero que les guste esta historia hermosa y graciosa
. Soy de un pueblito de la ciudad de Matanzas por motivos de trabajo vine a vivir junto a mi esposo @valderalazaro y mi hijo Lukas , a la ciudad de Matanzas , vivimos es una casa rentada , al llegar aquí en septiembre del 2025 ,Lukas iba a cumplir 6 meses y en la casa de el frente había una gatita recién parida , los dueños de mi renta que viven debajo de mi , se quedaron con el único gato que se salvó de aquel trágico parto .
El 20 de noviembre llegó Mia ,la nueva integrante de la casa , el dueño anterior dijo que era hembra 😁 pero yo que ya eh tenido gatos antes le dije a mi casero que era macho pero no me creyeron 🥺.
Mía creció con ese nombre hasta que creció y con el crecieron sus testículos jajajaj . Lukas y mía crecieron juntos y se hicieron buenos amigos. Me gusta que mi hijo le gusten los animales y que no los maltrate .
En realidad Mía es de mis caseros pero sube cada día a comer aquí y a qué le acaricie la panza , le encanta el pan y la carne jjj
Mi esposo no le gustan mucho los gatos pero ya le ha cogido cariño , le dice que es un gato trasverti jjj 
Espero que les guste mi pequeña historia 
Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛

body.title: Mario Galaxy y un viaje nostalgico  (Review) [ESP-ENG] by edwardstobia
body.body:
> Hoy quiero ponerme un poco nostálgico y hablar de un personaje que para los que nacimos a mediados de los 80 no es solo un simple videojuego, es parte de nuestra identidad. Tengo 43 años lo que significa que conocí a Mario y Luigi cuando eran humildes plomeros de 8 bits donde solo saltaban sobre tortugas y hongos y menos existía una historia, no había voz solo existía música de fondo y por supuesto que mi dedo índice hecho un nudo de tanto presionar el botón (A) ja ja ja… >_Today I want to get a little nostalgic and talk about a character who, for those of us born in the mid-80s, isn’t just a simple video game he’s part of our identity. I’m 43 years old, which means I met Mario and Luigi when they were humble 8-bit plumbers who just jumped on turtles and mushrooms there was hardly any story, no voice acting, just background music, and of course, my index finger was all knotted up from pressing the A button so much, ha ha ha…_
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/AKVVVHnxKBQd4sPDNtRVJy7seL5WDV5vvReE2ofC96JYg8WEb8ajLtRoBhWvygM.png Pasé horas interminables frente al televisor maravillado con cada nueva versión, descubriendo mundos, pasadizos secretos y por supuesto, disfrutando de esas melodías pegajosas que se grabaron mi mente de por vida Pero lo mejor de esa época no era solo el juego en sí, sino compartirlo. Mario Bros era el punto de encuentro en mi hogar, de horas de risas, de pasarnos el control, de celebrar cuando lográbamos vencer a Bowser y de molestarnos sanamente en familia. Aunque a veces mi hermana y yo éramos más intenso y en ocasiones eramos luchadores de lucha libre ja ja ja… [Image source](https://as.com/meristation/noticias/los-enemigos-del-super-mario-bros-de-nes-llevan-cuarenta-anos-enganandonos-de-esta-manera-n/) >_I spent endless hours in front of the TV, marveling at each new version, discovering worlds and secret passages, and of course, enjoying those catchy tunes that have stayed with me forever. But the best part of that time wasn’t just the game itself it was sharing it. Mario Bros. was the gathering point in my home hours of laughter, passing the controller back and forth, celebrating when we managed to defeat Bowser, and having some good-natured family banter. Although sometimes my sister and I got a little too intense, and on occasion we turned into professional wrestlers, ha ha ha…_ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23x9zFLw1FaGGG5Pviy14hRuZT729kbZR9un7MU8D8fZhmRaThAgEfqEDTv3yDuvfPhye.png)](https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/NES/Super-Mario-Bros-803853.html)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23zGioZGBrV4QNKjRRWajZWJT7EvKVrafLmFHibvYpJYx6qERRMU1WmUD5onx6YYaCVDc.png\n\nAhora décadas después ver nuevamente a esos mismos bigotones en una película con gráficos de otro nivel, con voces de verdad, con una historia que contar ha sido una experiencia increíble. Me gustado haber podido jugar todos estos nuevos mundos después de Mario Galaxy en la Wii pero mi inclinaciones se fueron más a la Xbox debido a que el mismo Wii me decepcionó mucho. Lo mejor de todo es que ahora comparto este mundo con mi hija Luna, que me mira raro cuando digo \

como si fuera un lugar real. Y sí, me emocioné cuando apareció el castillo. Y sí, canté el tema subterráneo emocionado. [Image source](https://rpp.pe/cine/internacional/super-mario-galaxy-la-pelicula-arrasa-en-taquilla-y-ya-es-la-cinta-de-hollywood-mas-vista-de-2026-noticia-1684088) > _Now, decades later, seeing those same mustachioed characters again in a movie with next-level graphics, real voices, and a story to tell has been an incredible experience. I enjoyed being able to play all these new worlds after *Mario Galaxy* on the Wii, but I ended up leaning more toward the Xbox because the Wii itself really disappointed me. Best of all, I now share this world with my daughter Luna, who gives me a weird look when I say “World 8-4” as if it were a real place. And yes, I got emotional when the castle appeared. And yes, I sang the underground theme with excitement._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23zbRaCBQHzgKWfewWngZkWPxWEu6ZVEi2pY1Qth3UKpHu4dmbfRAWYbgNsGU8mTZXQSE.png)](https://es.ign.com/untitled-the-super-mario-bros-movie-sequel/225937/news/todos-los-anuncios-del-nintendo-direct-de-super-mario-galaxy-la-pelicula)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/EokagxgxbRFeaDXbmxkC6izHwQxdiE2qsZG9MqLGgbZWpStdQAG7cY13ESrGcus6Js7.png)](https://www.culturaocio.com/cine/noticia-super-mario-galaxy-pelicula-confirma-otro-legendario-personaje-nintendo-20260326175845.html)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uFPTq1sTQxTZGhVvThf6kWBQLsjh2XhBhU1NUyzRdCfkDhxJ3hbEU2CQDqvcNCioyup.png Porque al final Mario no es solo un videojuego, es un pasaporte directo a cuando la vida era más simple: solo tú, un control con cable y la promesa de que la princesa estaba en otro castillo. Al culminar la película me di cuenta de que Mario Bros ha logrado algo increíble, trascender generaciones porque lo que comenzó para mí como unos cuantos pixeles en la sala de mi casa hoy es un fenómeno global que sigue uniendo a familias, solo que ahora con una tecnología que sin duda ha revolucionado el mundo del cine. [Image source](https://es-us.noticias.yahoo.com/the-super-mario-galaxy-movie-173957976.html) > _Because, in the end, Mario isn't just a video game it's a direct ticket back to a time when life was simpler: just you, a wired controller, and the promise that the princess was in another castle. As the movie ended, I realized that Mario Bros. has achieved something incredible: transcending generations. What began for me as a few pixels in my living room is now a global phenomenon that continues to bring families together only now with technology that has undoubtedly revolutionized the world of cinema._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23zbRyLH1qK78LE8AxXboLWKSsQc5wifJzzC1Bn1KjECA3SuAdJMAEmeLYnrGXTp9Wqb9.png)](https://planoamericano.com/cine/criticas/super-mario-galaxy-la-pelicula-2026/) Para mí esta película no fue solo entretenimiento, fue un viaje en el tiempo, un homenaje a mi niñez, a la música que me formó y a esos momentos inolvidables con mi familia. No creo que haya una tercera pues en esta nueva se han jugado todas las cartas, y si pensaran en esa idea, espero que no terminen acabando el negocio de los plomeros. >_For me, this movie wasn't just entertainment; it was a trip down memory lane, a tribute to my childhood, to the music that shaped me, and to those unforgettable moments with my family. I don't think there will be a third one, since they've played all their cards in this latest installment, and if they were to consider that idea, I hope they don't end up putting plumbers out of business._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uFHTB2UdKwQtXe4W92sikZgXc43oCfEVCpL5zefPehrv4sErkL6cgc9ApQ9S8RnaHyF.png)](https://www.latimes.com/espanol/entretenimiento/articulo/2026-04-12/the-super-mario-galaxy-movie-encabeza-la-taquilla-en-norteamerica-con-629-millones)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iTzCWDQSwvk ######
Imagino que muchos no la han visto asi que bueno, igual que siempre, esta es solo mi opinión, y los invito a compartir la de ustedes. >_I imagine that many of you haven't seen it, so, as always, this is just my opinion, and I invite you to share yours._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQtP2R1a2EhamPWx6xAWC35MDfmvyQ3WiDWuYq1or5Xc4oxGUTBJU4XkY81A5Dqgszp.png) A bordo de la nave me despido, mi querida familia. ❤LOS QUIERO❤
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23vhpyiwoPUFDCX8pZ3j2CugVaLjXwNTiZgMdE8wMpfR85ZxsbSsbQvCoVyxbnTRfnSsa.png)

They say you shouldn't ever tell your plans to the devil or he will do his best to foil them, but they also say it's good to celebrate achievements, so I'll go with the latter.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgAoowVohmCwA2vdfvTEdstDvjUpUeCJeb7NGhqjJYXW/1779146857086.jpg)

Honestly, it has been very difficult to let go of these shelters that have allowed me to numb out my mind whenever things get dense. It doesn't feel like I'm winning anything from it either, it's not bringing absolutely any rewards, and life is just generally painful. However,there is a slight sense of achievement growing slowly and steadily within me.

So why do it? Because I'm curious to what happens after 90 days of this practice and have faith a new and better version of me will be born by then. And if nothing happens, then we'll see if there are any positive conclusions by then, but I know that the only way to get there is by staying on track.

I did drink one can of beer the other day because I ended up by accident at a very boring party, and a lady offered so nicely I couldn't say no. But when offered more, I refused. Also I haven't smoked tobacco but did consume through *rape* which is a medicine from the Amazon jungle which includes tobacco and other herbs. But only one day, then I figured I shouldn't accept any more because I see people getting very addicted to it as well.

body.title: Beauty Even in the Dark
body.body:
I took these photos last night during a quick walk around the neighborhood, but I only got the chance to share them today. It was already dark outside, and the lighting was not really ideal for taking photos. Still, when I saw these flowers, I felt like I had to stop for a moment and take a few shots. There was something about the way the flowers appeared in the darkness that caught my attention. The petals, the leaves, and the small drops of water on some parts of the plant created a dramatic look. In color, maybe the scene would have looked ordinary, but in black and white, the shadows and highlights gave the flowers a stronger mood. Too bad the lighting was quite dark, but even with that limitation, the beauty of the flowers still showed through. Sometimes, that is also how life feels. We do not always have the perfect condition, the best timing, or the clearest view, but there is still something beautiful that can come out of the moment. These photos reminded me that we do not always need perfect light to appreciate what is in front of us. Sometimes the darker setting can help us notice the details differently. It can make the subject feel more quiet, more dramatic, and more meaningful. That is one of the things I enjoy about photography. It encourages me to make use of what is available and to see beauty even when the situation is not perfect. A quick walk can still become a creative moment, and a simple flower can still become a memorable photo. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000154175.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eonj8SvCuZPuz1sXa4ziv6KERtYjzJm7ddYpqJiNwqWP4HGyzbk5zdSdXAEXJQUsiwR.jpg) ![1000154174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoATujtZDoMfM4nkNBAeLN5kEfMVGEVTX5GvaX2XHiLRqHL9Bu9HZJ15ZSfJGwLC8BE.jpg) ![1000154173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6D7MRb7L2bcadtzxX6gmxjUJjz7pivE9DzduUhVVvNWwVnCsPrGHFEjiXcPu78o8t.jpg) ![1000154172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vRkCvTRQXrS4tHPtjgBo6mSWCm21A89SZcu6z4srTum5ruJycmtWWy8AFnkNzZaK.jpg) ***

body.body:
The #SaturdaySavers programme run with huge dedication and commitment by @shanibeer came to an end with the close of 2025. 

But there are a couple of initiatives to keep the motivation going !

I've decided to post them in the BusyBees Community. This is a community set up to support @zakludick's tireless work in encouraging and teaching newer Hive users. Additionally, I'm adding the #SlothlySavers tag and linking my updates in their weekly update post, because that's another place where former #SaturdaySavers are gravitating to.


![Busybees2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/EppLbzgN3V6scyZCA4g2e4EXmenmK4hGjT5PWLkJ3TgrcC5UMmHQZ3AGpQRKTXqV8xb.jpg)

Image by [Rebekka D](https://pixabay.com/users/castleguard-2970404/?utm_source=link-attribution&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=image&utm_content=1537694) from [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com//?utm_source=link-attribution&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=image&utm_content=1537694)


![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)


Here's a screenshot of last week's progress;


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23zbkpccJ9pUoCLwn4xmgzSD6j3BuYvuuRrAS5bVeXL7km2NCjcbjRXqoAUL73G5u5cdq.png)




![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)

### How Did The Week Go ? ###

I'm running a couple of days late posting my update this week - work and a couple of other real life things hit all at once and took all my attention away from Hive. But hopefully I'm getting back on an even keel again now....

In the meantime, I've been kept afloat by earnings on previous posts coming through plus automated curation. Lazy, I know, but it still earned me 128 mixed HIVE and HP !

Looking at the numbers, Hive had dipped down a little and lost most of the gains of the brief rally last week. I'm not too concerned; while I'd hoped it was an indicator of increased confidence, the reality is that pretty much every form of investment is taking a hit right now due to the global geopolitical and economic situation. I've seen the price of diesel here in the southern part of the UK go up from £1.51 to £2.19 in the space of 3 months. Admittedly my car much prefers the expensive premium diesel, it runs far better on it, gets better MPG and it burns cleaner so less likely to cost me thousands in replacing a clogged DPF.

I'm hopeful that in the next month or so, the US and Iran will hammer out some kind of proper peace agreement, or will give up on the farce of a ceasefire that neither side is fully honouring and go at it hammer and tongs until a firm winner is clear. Either method will work to clear up that particular round of geopolitical uncertainty ! Slightly perversely, I hope the US comes away with enough of a bloody nose that Trump gives up his designs on Cuba and Greenland. There are always better solutions than bullying and warfare !

In the meantime, the best thing we can do as Hivers is carry on posting great content, upvoting and supporting each other, and supporting the people working hard to develop new apps and dapps for us. 

Have a great week, everyone !



![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4arJr6HtnfHGJpnth33F4sSek1XxEQS3vHpdjcuokqyKGz3jFHfMZf.jpg)

body.title: Homemade Mango, AloeVera Juice (Tropical Sun)
body.body:
## Greetings hivers and drinkslovers 🥰❤️.

![C0900FDA-F0F8-4DFB-8D6B-25B4947E2430.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKchwZsNvYy2zGrwRFjfpfvi3fNYXzGhxSUQVLmXFv2ERHFA4d98WrbwRcPnH8Q.jpeg)

![667C64CA-CFC8-42E3-AD2D-1A00BC4C11CD.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrbDGU373D9e2hQc9yLfZWhmq556KsskwJXE2g4jp3DTfUL6RQSng9DNoymcgCoJ3Kr.jpeg)

![FAC68814-B9BC-453E-BD09-EDD8DCECD3DE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sJzavnxue26vSJuuManFDckSnSVgktGF5PhMdWFgRtA6DF4kYfeW6dwaTtBbKJ1Ve3B.jpeg)

I can never not enjoy this tropical 🏝 fruit called mango 🥭 once it’s in season. In fact the sun ☀️ color that mango is known for and that inviting aroma with great taste flavor always made me to be hooked to this delicious fruit until it disappears totally from the grocery stores 🏬. 

And among all other recipes I prepare with mango 🥭, like salads, breads, pancakes and more, this very juice is always never  left out. Homemade Mango Aloe Vera Juice 🍹, which I have prepared today to share with you. 

Its not just an ordinary juice, but a juice packed with good immune boosting system for that healthy living. As we all know how great mango juice is with its vitamins apart from that we are getting a 💯 percent natural juice without any artificial nor additives. 

Aloe vera being one plant 🌱 that is known for its great properties and benefits, can only also be enjoyed with mango in a combination of blended juices for a better balance of sweetness and bitterness. 

![2635CF57-5478-4E0B-9811-9F6457EAE0DC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nGLcuWnb9diaGNVnWmVPwLKeiuRHdmCKhD2NT4zDCzGv9nxP886egGtKtxQtNi4FcR.jpeg)

Try the  tropical flavor of mango and aloe vera yourself and see how healthy you become because this two combination surely makes a great immune boost especially for those who wants to lower their sugar level.  This drink is delicious, refreshing and has a fantastic fruity flavor. Its a must - have drink 🍹.

Here below are the detailed step by step for this homemade mango, aloe juice 

# INGREDIENTS L: (2 servings)

![CEAC23FF-B105-48DF-9FDC-E30F9F015662.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2432Q8PCRzoNcpbBJsxZnA2xM3zZQAtTFXYZhA1aMKrA6vB9eN46zfb4Pb67oXvM6HRBo.jpeg)

2 fresh succulent mangoes 
1/2 of a long stem of aloe vera
11/2 glass of spring water

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1. 

![EE32BB48-9B43-4BA7-853D-56D3543CF401.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrarAg1brrhHwCyPNgnFAmRp9Ad5RHrpLEzxqWLbRbjkgs52e9jqFXdFKGKRH5DpmBi.jpeg)

![B4FB31BE-ECF1-4CEA-8606-A5D97E708121.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242rwdKZBdzdiYZSvpKUdCNw4wvJeuamgKKZSrosogYiGHxFzhwVgxkLimd6Xf7rM6q2G.jpeg)

![DE2E75FC-A302-4D37-877D-8E9DA5977935.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywuKt8rit3RPXtc3B8wdALX796zQ9pRTPU2jhY9VaRpjcPE3ioguHgAkGSyiiqACu1E.jpeg)

We start by peeling off the back of the already washed mangoes . Cut out the flesh from the seed.

![A9A7EE0E-5A40-4057-B55D-12A8CF92D1F0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGgrhKSzgPW1stAHaLT3UuNLzy6t82XJAuRMgKCqgRc7RtkNBCVcWDpcBpnoqPJ1F2x.jpeg)

![EB00746C-75F4-4BA9-8B8C-62D8816448E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245J2HPtTkAWeE9G1thfDp6HXELph25cucXxmxkxBKV99kyVvuLaw7Dw2MYfWeVDK1rvq.jpeg)

Then we gradually chop the flesh into thinly squares above. 

Step 2.

![D6920EBE-8B73-4344-8207-A5DEBD8C3B0D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALHTHqmhj3dvTPcMGUcgRKUJxXsiJfLfutAjvY73djujrWZJU9jB3TDTYbmxPk8.jpeg)

![07DD7A27-7821-40F5-BA55-E7F198E6FDC3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244UqhA6Rs2efKC7R4sQcGHduNybvzKkCiMu2N48LkwSE5EC8VynQ6zzMNKUCDDLoBrPw.jpeg)

We cut and peel the needed aloe vera above.

Step 3.
- 
![154B8860-21A9-4729-9F52-7265809C996B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp69Fm2KXTtLuSfUfXtpxcWVejyHaEtWKpxdVVG5udyd4xRR5rF5dgCjhQroyfuLu5s.jpeg)

![689CE08F-84A1-473B-A3A7-D83FB5F75F90.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywrw7oRzjazgBsndDmWHFNY7NADDCNeWP85YD6UGhNjfwJVL2koF4SNBoK9dxeUEzyT.jpeg)

Next, we have the two ingredients ready here.

Step 4.

![D15E823E-C9EA-4236-9CF7-CE43164135C5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJoKuirFbba4bzrEMqGfgyKPDXncUK97E5kiiVSRHyodkPBVWMA81kZtcgYR8uZ.jpeg)

To blend, we take the mango into the blender, adding the aloe vera and water 

Step 5.

![0B50B408-E062-4326-8B3E-8005B01F57D8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xerLiRDiuPeBRbJ39pgJfqZxX3AGCowxrNTAkTZoekYyx4UR1XmNZMQmnEQZAEp26Y2.jpeg)

![C3A41F66-203B-4ECB-B82B-01934A787B69.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242NmU4djQB1RVKtp923bQFdvs9VmYMT7c3qYng1DE5QSLx2pLktQBWgCqbR6oqikS76u.jpeg)

And we gradually blend them into a puree above.

Step 6.

![3C026C07-4F11-4AC1-974A-668833787388.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242DQXWd47YVGkjNrCRh8cRNyq251bUZYcxDhnjReZo8GbiJ4MfGG8H93vM68CrbbLTo9.jpeg)

![726BC15E-0110-4B4C-985A-E2A311E931C2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKZpAhcAUFFLGXUhUPgRVchy9DshoFjB6XRv2NTK755XAK1eu8H3LqyEeexvxNW.jpeg)

And serve in a glass of our choice before we refrigerate for few hours

![C54EAE80-119E-4F0A-B624-085805CD93EC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244A8gC7b1jVWoTv6VYRCEQ6XFMrNGuWkemSRjNUbWLVzXnubs8odW5xBL5b83DW8dVYD.jpeg)

As here above .

![CA4E76A8-1A41-4C34-BDD0-E646DD1FC5A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrYc2pyRuy77mcn42AMhcbX4Jy6CPbzhDUhoGY93SvykzhZXy8MyejDMQsLjDYFWmFF.jpeg)

Nothing beats tropical 🏝 flavors when it comes to juices. This homemade mango, aloe vera juice is everything you need this summer even though its with some light bitterness taste. No artificial sweetener, no artificial colors . Just 💯 percent natural.

![C0CE0123-D108-461B-9FC2-1B6EDF97568C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23qrZE5ETBjK8YtrLqh2jpc5NEDmN4wwoveh9c5U3EwT4kdBfTgojGkYrVxx8dTT7zki6.jpeg)

Its so refreshing and one juice that can help put our sugar level in check. Boosting our immune system and nourishing us at the same time. A must - try juice this fresh mango season friends. Enjoy ☺️.

#### Thank you for your time coming with me through this recipe. Sending you hugs 🤗❤️.

### Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine

![CBD1F29D-577A-420C-AC9A-142F12EDEDA5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMwo9dpnWRR6a5qCdw8UPgbcTmU3uyb1RSZx1SzchJyqsdt3XBQwAvLaRCVfYtYN4U5.jpeg)

body.title: Data center Hosting Outpaces Crypto Mining: Soluna’s Q1 Revenue Soars 58% but Net Loss Widens
body.body:
Let’s cut the fluff and look straight at the hard data. Soluna Holdings’ Q1 2026 financial report is a prime textbook example of structural business transition, showing both massive infrastructure scaling and severe operational cash burn. The company reported a substantial 58% year-over-year revenue surge, reaching $9.4 million. This top-line growth is primarily driven by their data center hosting segment, which generated $6.7 million. Concurrently, Soluna's direct cryptocurrency mining revenue experienced a noticeable decline, shrinking to $2.2 million from nearly $3 million in the same period last year. This explicit flip confirms that data center hosting for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) has officially surpassed proprietary crypto mining as the company's primary economic engine. Soluna is aggressively monetizing stranded renewable energy—using its Dorothy and Kati campuses—to capture the insatiable infrastructure demand from the AI boom.

However, anyone blindly celebrating this revenue growth is a rookie who doesn't know how to read a balance sheet. Despite the impressive revenue momentum, Soluna’s net loss significantly widened to $17.9 million, compared to a net loss of $10.5 million a year earlier. When you dig into the root causes, the culprit is blatantly obvious: general and administrative (G&A) expenses more than doubled, skyrocketing to $18.5 million. A staggering $10.2 million of that sum was allocated to stock-based compensation for executives. While management highlights operational milestones—such as finishing the 48 MW Kati 1A project ahead of schedule and expanding their development pipeline past 4.3 GW—the financial reality remains highly pressured. Adjusted EBITDA is still sitting in negative territory at $(2.1) million. Soluna is sitting on $68.6 million in cash, which gives them a runway to build out their massive AI joint ventures, but the massive internal corporate expenses are eating away at the margins. The takeaway is simple: revenue velocity is excellent, but if a company cannot rein in its administrative overhead and dilute less of its equity on non-cash executive pay, retail investors will be the ones left holding the bag while insiders get rich off stock rewards.

Source : [cointelegraph.com](https://cointelegraph.com/news/soluna-q1-revenue-rises-58-data-center-hosting-surpasses-crypto-mining?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound)

body.title: The law of dishonesty  | La ley del deshonesto
body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

>

**Hace un rato pasó algo que no podía creer.**

En mi país, desde hace años se suelen recargar las bombonas de gas para cocinar gracias a operativos. Sin embargo, si necesitas una recarga, no puedes hacerlo, sino solo cuando esté disponible. 

En esta ocasión, antes de llevar la bombona de gas, la marqué con nombre y apellido en color rojo. La bombona llegó el día de hoy, pero, cuando fui a retirarla, me dijeron que mi bombona estaba dañada. 

Me pareció extraño debido a que vi a lo lejos mi bombona junto con las demás que iban a entregar. Mientras que la bombona dañada, que no era mía, estaba a un lado en la pared. 

Le mencioné a la persona en cuestión que mi bombona estaba marcada y que desde donde estoy la estoy viendo. 

Da la \

de que mi bombona y la dañada tenían el mismo número. 

>Aqui en el país también suelen identificar las bombonas con numero de llegada que se marca con pintura. 

La persona se quedó en silencio; se dio cuenta de que no podía darme la dañada nuevamente, algo que me había pasado antes, pero en ese momento no tenía pruebas para reclamar. 

Y esto me hizo pensar en lo común que se está haciendo esto. No sé si solo sea aquí, pero sí suele pasar que otras personas quieren aprovecharse de otras, quitarles sus cosas, beneficiarse gracias a otros. 

La falta de valores en la sociedad cada vez es más evidente y no tienen ningún descaro. 

Y no, no se trata de personas jóvenes; esto sucedió con alguien que me supera bastante en edad. 

Precisamente son esas personas las que crían a las nuevas generaciones. Las generaciones que hacen daño, que abusan de otros o se aprovechan de las situaciones. 

Se puede pensar que ser deshonesto simplemente se da porque sí. Decimos \

, cuando la realidad va más allá. Ser deshonestos es algo que viene de casa, de la raíz. Es como una costumbre que pasa de generación en generación. Por ello, al sucederme esto, entendí por qué había tanto problema con respecto a esa persona en particular. También mi mente fue más allá al pensar en el ejemplo que estas personas dan en sus hogares. El testimonio que dan a sus hijos, las enseñanzas que transmiten a sus próximas generaciones. Lo que me hace sentirme triste por esta sociedad, bueno, parte de la sociedad. Sé y confío en que no todos son así; sin embargo, es increíble que haya que estar constantemente alerta porque cualquier cosa puede pasar, cualquier persona puede aprovecharse de ti o hacerte algo. No me imagino la vida pensando de esa manera, pero sí entiendo y muy bien a las personas que lo hacen. Ante ello solo viene a mi mente seguir siendo precavida ante todo, documentar como siempre lo he hecho y aplicar ese principio a todo en mi vida. No es lo ideal, pero el mundo no es color de rosas y este tipo de situaciones forma parte de la realidad. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**A while ago something happened that I couldn't believe.** > >In my country, cooking gas cylinders have been refilled for years thanks to operations. However, if you need a recharge, you cannot do so, but only when it is available. > >On this occasion, before taking the gas cylinder, I marked it with my first and last name in red. The cylinder arrived today, but when I went to pick it up, they told me that my cylinder was damaged. > >It seemed strange to me because I saw my cylinder in the distance along with the others that were going to be delivered. While the damaged cylinder, which was not mine, was on the side on the wall. > >I mentioned to the person in question that my cylinder was marked and that I can see it from where I am. > >It just so happened that my cylinder and the damaged one had the same number. > >Here in the country they also usually identify the cylinders with an arrival number that is marked with paint. > >The person remained silent; He realized that he couldn't give me the damaged one again, something that had happened to me before, but at that time he had no evidence to complain. > >And this made me think about how common this is becoming. I don't know if it's just here, but it often happens that other people want to take advantage of others, take their things, benefit from others. > >The lack of values ​​in society is increasingly evident and they have no nerve. > >And no, these are not young people; This happened with someone who is quite a bit older than me. > >It is precisely these people who raise the new generations. The generations that hurt, that abuse others or take advantage of situations. > >You might think that being dishonest just happens for the sake of it. We say \

, when the reality goes further. > >Being dishonest is something that comes from home, from the roots. It's like a custom that passes from generation to generation. > >Therefore, when this happened to me, I understood why there was so much problem regarding that particular person. My mind also went further when thinking about the example that these people set in their homes. The testimony they give to their children, the teachings they transmit to their next generations. > >Which makes me feel sad for this society, well, part of society. I know and trust that not everyone is like that; However, it is incredible that you have to be constantly alert because anything can happen, anyone can take advantage of you or do something to you. > >I don't imagine life thinking that way, but I do understand the people who do it very well. > >Given this, the only thing that comes to mind is to continue being cautious above all, to document as I have always done and to apply that principle to everything in my life. > >It is not ideal, but the world is not rosy and these types of situations are part of reality. >Texto de mi autoría. > **Imágenes en el post creadas por mi en estos software:** >+ Iconos hechos en Photoshop, usando como referencia los logos de las redes sociales correspondientes. >+ Banners y portada realizados en Canva en la versión gratuita. >+ Todas las fotografías en el post son de mi autoría, las cuales edito con las apps de Lightroom y Meitu.
