body.title: Nuremberg Movie Review
body.body:
~ Seki.

It was one scene that made me decide to watch Nuremberg. A single scene I saw on Instagram, that incredible 40 seconds of acting made me watch a movie that has left an incredible impact on my life.
Perhaps an impact as large as the one the real life incident which the movie is based on left on the world.
***
## <center>Nuremberg</center>
***
### Plot
> 5 months after the war against the Nazi ended, the world was greeted with a feast.
A legal and somewhat moral judging of what's left of the group of men who brought terror to the world.
The men who were convicted were like none ever seen before, men so believed to be evil and different that they had to bring in a psychiatrist to check them.
The main character of the movie, the psychiatrist, the hero, Douglas Kelley, made a shocking discovery.
These men, evil as their actions may be, were just men.

https://youtu.be/WvAy9C-bipY?si=l7MePKuOZgbepPvj
***
The movie felt like what a history documentary should be and even more.
We weren't just taking a look at the past, we were put in there ourselves and made to be part of the audience in the courtroom, taking mental notes and having our own thoughts about these convicts.

![1003735559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tGXhXkTSXjgYSZvE2h2mNrTyu2EHtTJgitiEYuVEcucydZeVDEnHmCqsHQZoYBFNcmn.jpg)

The movie initially focuses on the relationship between two men; Dr Douglas Kelley and Hermann Goring.
It is fair to say that this movie was carried by their test of intellects, clash of wills and sincere acting prowess.


![1003734136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23u5ZgCo1hLxMMActQHaacHHhLRt9bXqANY2kYnCiJeZ4afkQGSXb6FuCuNAayjhARyoP.jpg)

I cannot begin to describe the acting genius Rami Malek, it's just beautiful seeing him work. He seemed like the kind of man that genuinely enjoyed being in the scene, he was happy to be there, happy to be a part of the movie and happy to converse—although in character—with a genius of the same caliber but different timeline; Russell Crowe.

![1003734123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tGVGDDk2oyZebwwsLYuABxd7fEVGSxAGd4TSdducJDSW154KrmFHTxKYMatnU9P98Gb.jpg)

The character played by Russelle isn't an easy one to maintain, not by any feat. If anything, Herman Goering can be described as the peak man.
His ever changing principles, his great discipline and the ability to have a big heart, a great drive, patriotism and a sense of responsibility that caused his downfall.

> The *Reichsmarschall* can't be wrong..


![1003734139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tbMFrK6kdvCEsefbEgp1MXkrWur8U7uJvM2xvNapvZPHe2EGXSunzCHEhDw9tiWdJha.jpg)

This thought process, a product of Goering's discipline, embodies the idea that a leader can't ever second guess his decisions. He can't be allowed to show doubt in what he says.. even if he knows it's a mistake.
This was his fatal flaw and it was what ended him. 

![1003734144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tbMFobKDZ74EfXH5hgwNTCGGrgWMWiZJwFjreEZrBki5NQp7P6z7kdwM9nYP23msByJ.jpg)

In this movie, one thing I noticed was with our protagonist being Dr. Douglass Kelley it seemed at first that there was no antagonist. 
No obvious evil person was brought in light, at least to me.
At first, one could say that the Nazi's in trial are the obvious antagonist, but that's not how the movie spinned it and that's what made me love it the more.

![1003735680.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tGcPKPHJE8rdakncJF7pVM1hSgoyXwXCkGqVubj5FA6Gq33YB7nmdyaqtYWTgZcc5Yw.jpg)

The movie tries it's best to bring us as close as possible to these men. Like I said earlier, we were put into there ourselves with Douglas Kelley, meant to make the decision of whether they are villains or not.
It is in all its entirety a trial and we the audience are the judge and jury.

![1003735819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tbH2wnVpJHPuwZNGmBKfAYTLALG6TuHw3Lk3jCyzMpEcRZoJBFCjARByGAwjW8ze68a.jpg)

People originally thought that there was something particularly evil about them, yet like Dr Kelley said at the end of the movie.
They are just like ordinary men. The only difference is that they had the means and positions to fulfill their desires.

It's a thriller... Not the type with explosions and cars and high stakes fights, but the type where your brain watches and subconsciously partakes in  trying to judge these men without being tricked by the media, their lies and their half truths.
I totally urge any one who has a hint of interest to check it out, you would not be disappointed.


![17791455860603134854891474893375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23tvYHQh1cdaZZsd9rL1ZeVoAjdQWyud2HYE5p9bkLbJ4o8XepuehBMX7wrzG8ckRnFRf.jpg)

body.title: Carne molida con calabacín y puré de papas [ESP-ENG]
body.body: >¡Hola comunidad de Hive Food! Espero que todos se encuentren muy bien y con muchas ganas de disfrutar una receta casera. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una comida sencilla, pero muy rica y perfecta para cualquier día de la semana. Se trata de una deliciosa carne molida con calabacín acompañada de un suave puré de papas, una combinación simple, económica y llena de sabor. Me gusta mucho este tipo de recetas porque son fáciles de preparar y además permiten hacer comidas completas usando ingredientes que muchas veces ya tenemos en casa. El calabacín le aporta un toque ligero y jugoso a la carne, mientras que el puré de papas hace que todo quede aún más reconfortante y sabroso. Espero que les guste esta preparación y que se animen a hacerla en casa.\n

>Hello, Hive Food community! I hope you’re all doing great and looking forward to enjoying a homemade recipe. Today I want to share with you a simple yet delicious meal that’s perfect for any day of the week. It’s a delicious ground beef dish with zucchini, served with a creamy mashed potato—a simple, affordable, and flavorful combination. I really love these kinds of recipes because they’re easy to prepare and let you make complete meals using ingredients you often already have at home. The zucchini adds a light, juicy touch to the meat, while the mashed potatoes make the whole dish even more comforting and flavorful. I hope you like this recipe and that you’ll give it a try at home.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![Agregar un título.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23y9EksRVb5k87Se9gtuPaqNgM5YeaY852nyywa27pLKtNfTMUvHntAtKU52yVKnGonBA.png)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:
>500 gr de carne molida, 1 calabacín, 7 papas, 1 cebolla, 100 GR de pasta de tomate, sal, pimienta, comino, aceite, 1/2 taza de leche, 2 cucharadas de parmesano.\n\n
>500 g ground beef, 1 zucchini, 7 potatoes, 1 onion, 100 g tomato paste, salt, pepper, cumin, oil, 1/2 cup milk, 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>Inicié preparando el puré de papa, para ello lavé y retiré las cáscara de las papas, coloqué en una olla.con aufi agua, llevé a cocinar hasta estar suaves, al estar blandas retiré del agua, añadí sal, el parmesano y la leche mezcle todo hasta obtener una mezcla consistente y cremosa.\n\n

>I started by making the mashed potatoes. To do this, I washed and peeled the potatoes, placed them in a pot with enough water, and cooked them until tender. Once they were soft, I drained them, added salt, Parmesan cheese, and milk, and mixed everything together until the mixture was smooth and creamy. ***
>Para la carne lavé y corte los vegetales, calentamos un sartén, en el añadimos aceite, llevo.ls a sofreír la carne junto a la cebolla, sazonamos al gusto con nuestros condimentos preferidos.\n
>For the meat, I washed and chopped the vegetables, heated a skillet, added oil, and sautéed the meat with the onion, seasoning to taste with our favorite spices. ***
>Para la carne solo añadimos 2 papas, y el calabacín completo cortados en cuadritos, sofreímos junto a la carne.\n
>For the meat, we simply add 2 potatoes and the whole zucchini, both diced, and sauté them together with the meat. ***
>Agreguemos la pasta de tomate, 1/2 taza de agua y rectificamos sabores, además añadimos 1/2 cucharada de azúcar para equilibrar la acidez del tomate, cocinamos hasta espesar.\n
>Add the tomato paste and 1/2 cup of water, then adjust the seasoning. Add 1/2 tablespoon of sugar to balance the acidity of the tomatoes, and cook until thickened. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23xepV8oHAFwbHeLBBZ5AwQ9nieqiWC6dyafgHjrWzjo2gr9XJirqwZV8Mv6p7ZPyj3nT.gifY así quedó lista esta rica comida casera, perfecta para disfrutar en familia o preparar en un día tranquilo. Me encantó cómo combinó la carne molida con el calabacín y lo cremoso del puré de papas. Son recetas sencillas, pero hechas con mucho cariño y sabor. Muchas gracias por llegar hasta aquí y acompañarme una vez más en otra preparación para Hive Food. Los invito a dejarme en los comentarios qué les pareció la receta y si ustedes también prepararían esta combinación en casa. ¡Nos seguimos leyendo en una próxima receta! > And just like that, this delicious home-cooked meal was ready—perfect for enjoying with the family or making on a quiet day. I loved how the ground beef paired with the zucchini and the creaminess of the mashed potatoes. These are simple recipes, but made with lots of love and flavor. Thank you so much for sticking with me and joining me once again for another Hive Food recipe. I invite you to leave a comment below letting me know what you thought of the recipe and if you’d try making this combination at home. See you in the next recipe!

body.body: Hola @monochromes. Creo que hubo un malentendido con el silenciamiento de mi cuenta y mis publicaciones. Pero les pido que revisen mis imágenes y me dejen editar el post. Quiero cambiar el texto por mis propias palabras. Hive Engine was hacked last night via an EVM bridge, and the backing assets for SWAP.ETH, SWAP.SOL, SWAP.USDT, and SWAP.GUFU were drained, making them worthless. I won't go into any great detail about how bad this is for the greater Hive Eosystem, rather choosing to focus instead on the significant collateral damage that directly affects the We Are Alive Tribe. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260515_162752523_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xKotfe7UCrYKER9DzbUR9qTWeXG39krxisi8MJSDHgWFvyhdPBRAUh21MW5T7qQNpFx.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260515_162823765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGwVUzuFUx7YXxAzPkWNqxPfTiqGkQUP2U2u1iDPmm8DKhSqjQ2jcfoDggqgTdtywAZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I removed liquidty from all SWAP.ETH and SWAP.USDT pools on my account and on three community accounts, @aliveandthriving, @heartbeatvault01, and @heartbeatonhive, and I swapped the SWAP.ETH and SWAP.USDT for other useful layer-2 assets. We didn't have a large amount in the affected pools, so this hack didn't cause much direct damage, thankfully. The collateral damage, and the ramifications of those, is another story, however. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260515_162936699_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQnR1WPVrWGFU5wXucEz2KUTQq9iMhsfawf8JttbtPPkgvzZiBn9pb2uu8oNmq5w7s8.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260515_163009474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2kp7noStrEx5J6PABUeeHLfj3LAuG67Y6wMC1Te7iWcWSVU5r18whQSk8WA26edTXY.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Because of the hack on Hive Engine, the HIVE-for-BEE @bee.voter delegation service was discontinued, which hits very hard indeed, as that was The We Are Alive Tribe's primary source for HIVE weekly. With that now gone, our weekly HIVE income doesn't even come close to being able to cover all the HIVE that we're sending out for payments to HP delegators, or in the daily ALIVE dividends, which means that when the chunk of HIVE on @hive-155221 runs out, we are going to have to make some notable changes, including strongly lowering the amount of HIVE that we send out weekly to HP delegators and in the ALIVE dividends. We still have a little buffer but it's going to dwindle fast. That seriously sucks, and I have no clue yet how to compensate. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_153432157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMU56DN7Y74hE4rJD8fmdnC5cvqvZ5akqsKioP98YGxvx4STppLJATdS7SxCW9b3p2o.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_153538821_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xpALe3tYqsePVnGgJvU7Vmgj1YgTiNV8QYyuAh1TTCqdBrRPDASyxSdMd3hQ37nG7aj.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) With the loss of our primary weekly HIVE income from our delegation of 20.4k BEE to @bee.voter, and the recent loss of our daily SWAP.HIVE income from the end of the PWR project and its SWAP.HIVE:PWR pool, we're not in a good place in terms of financial sustainability, or in terms of our available investment liquidity. It seems like every solid source if income is being cut off, one by one, with very few viable ones left. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_153624864.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23x1BAMxHonGmaJ56nLvqf2DkfgXDt4JndvHKjYeeQJn69FerqqGGKAyPUs1hVSYvsstE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_153732145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWpaccQm21VhSy4BQB9gat4ymsXp6yDN1AuFkdMuYtVNWYL9182yQroUypdPpHR3YKs.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) There is one good thing in all of this, however. Since I've recalled the BEE delegations on my account, and on various community accounts, we're going to have a whole lot more BEE coming in and available to use, especially from the 20.4k staked BEE on @aliveandsocial. With the strongly-increased BEE income, we'll have much more to create and manage new 'We Are Alive Tribe' liquidity pools, and potentially to use for paying HP delegators and to send out in the daily ALIVE dividends. That's just an idea, and I'll have to see exactly what our weekly BEE income would be with such an increase in staked BEE across our various community accounts. I'll do my best, my friends. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_154013702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23yTd3zS7sH7rcfAjjHEp8m4hgnDiHPcqdApoKrewjBEmnPwGzywr943gtspaN78Q7Hn5.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_154231172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFTmWHPtvtTFsaZ39ow9LExmUwTH5SFMpmFqi15ey5Q9jEuwHPkHhjAXzuxuopq25X3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Sunday, I left the Flow House, after completing most of my numerous important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by a little after 3:30PM, giving my attention first to collecting a few food supplies for Wabisabi from Tutu's, and to some photography for my posts. It rained all day, so with no inspiration to work outside, I headed back to the Flow House early, after turning on the generator, making myself some food in Wabisabi, and collecting my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge there. I got through all of my notifications fairly late, by bit after 10:30PM, and after a little agentic-AI research, and working with Hermes a bit more, I went to bed by just after 12AM. I woke up a bit before 7AM, having slept fairly well, hearing about the Hive-Engine hack, beginning to reallocate assets because of it, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to reallocate more assets, to work with Hermes some more, to prepare my Weekly-Hive-Goals-and-Progress Update to write later, and finally to write this post. It's now just after 1PM, so it's a very good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the after, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until my Weekly-Hive-Goals-and-Progress Update hopefully later this evening or tomorow morning, and the next incarnation of these posts tomorrow afternoon! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁 🙏 💚 ✨ 🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_154311855_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMYWvaZ8Zr2g8zpm28LWAB7Ko5RaiLpJohkc3mx81XmvCk9CCZnqTJwVXMCGqcu3R9M.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260516_154337025_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsLcZHk4t5Tj3A1Un7bXwQZmGSG6pAzuUaSFB7dGADq55ioMvYkryzTWoPZMxEbxxXS.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! body.body: /> * * * Los venezolanos conforman la nacionalidad más grande en Hive. Hay varios que viven en otros países, pero igualmente los conocemos. Este post es para observar un poco el crecimiento de esta comunidad. Debido al éxito de la publicación de @danielvehe [Datos de los Venezolanos en Hive](https://inleo.io/hive-189306/@danielvehe/datos-de-los-venezolanos-en-hive-or) que también sirvió de inspiración a otras comunidades; publicaremos este reporte todos los meses desde @rutablockchain. Vamos a ver las estadísticas personales de: más Hive Power, más HBD en ahorros, más seguidores, mayores recompensas del mes pasado y mayores delegaciones recibidas. Se listan los 10 primeros lugares de cada categoría. Además, para esta edición se incluyen: Comunidades con mayor cantidad de recompensas, con más suscriptores y más publicaciones. Los datos de las comunidades fueron sacados en Hive SQL gracias a @enmy. Los demás datos fueron buscados por @danielvehe de forma manual. Hay una página con datos de comunidades que no es muy confiable, sobretodo con las recompensas; es por eso que sacamos nuestra propia data. Incluimos flechas para expresar el movimiento de cada uno. La flecha roja 🔻 indica que perdió y la flecha azul 🔼 indica que ganó. Las flechas de la izquierda indican la cantidad y las flechas de la derecha, la posición en la tabla. * * * **_En las siguientes estadísticas no se tomaron la muestra de las cuentas de proyectos; solo cuentas personales_**

2189🔼

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - I am not going to Volunteer
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - I am not going to Volunteer. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSXm-RuBHPBgZjFHGRV4-S-opRmvQWdHHsy698AQElrFw&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSXm-RuBHPBgZjFHGRV4-S-opRmvQWdHHsy698AQElrFw&s=10)

[Source ](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSXm-RuBHPBgZjFHGRV4-S-opRmvQWdHHsy698AQElrFw&s=10)

\

reads the broadcast message from the leader. 

As Leonard is working on a key project and has been working late for the past 2 weeks. Thus he happily submitted all the hours for review. This is when Jeremy his supervisor and a more senior member on the team dropped by his cubicle, and advice him on the team's unspoken rule of having a cap on the number of hours per member. 

As Leonard is a new transferee to the team, his previous team does not have such restriction. He was dumbfounded. \

Leonard tells Jeremy. Free OT is equal to volunteer was his reasoning. 

At least for this month, he's prepared to reason with the boss on the ground of not knowing the rules, and moving forward, he will keep a watch on his timing. So as not to end up volunteering for the company where he is selling his time for pay. 

He's very clear if he wants to volunteer, he will do it at a non profit organization.

description.title: Head of Household (Eng/Esp)
description.body:
<center>![1000720433.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/AKtTtMRdqE8FQpAssXMaF45oAgfAf8bp5zcbWZgyEECvx2iCG8N3bgfAj7jwfzb.png)</center>Canva IA</center>

***


The suitcases were already set out in the living room, while Alicia gave her daughter Marisela her final instructions. The flight to Greece marked the start of a long-awaited anniversary trip: two weeks touring the various islands of the Aegean Sea. Her only concern was leaving her daughter in the care of her two younger siblings and the house.

\
, addressing her two children, Carlos and Anita, aged 12 and 10 respectively, \

The father came over to say goodbye.


\

they replied in unison.

After the hugs, the parents left in a taxi. They wouldn’t see them again for much longer than they thought.

Marisela got through her first week with her newly acquired adult responsibilities with great discipline, even though her siblings were rebellious and wanted to take advantage of their parents’ absence. Doing their homework or bedtime were the most critical moments.



\
Anita looked at her with her arms crossed over her chest.\n\n\

Marisela was counting down the days until her parents returned. Even though everything seemed to be going well, she felt she didn’t have time for herself or her friends. From the university where she was studying biology, she would rush home to take care of her siblings, her two cats, and the house. She was already starting to get tired and was eagerly waiting for her grandmother to come and help her.

After making some ham-and-cheese sandwiches for dinner, she sat down with her siblings in the living room. It was Friday night.

The movie they were watching was interrupted by a breaking news report. *A rare viral disease that had been detected in some Asian countries had spread to Europe, where there were already a few cases, and was suspected to have reached the Americas as well.*

Her siblings didn’t think much of it, but an alarm bell went off in Marisela’s mind. Viruses have been the cause of serious pandemics in the past. But she told herself she already had plenty on her plate and stopped thinking about it—until the next day, when she received a call from her Aunt Rosita.

\

That was all. Marisela felt she had to take care of the house and her siblings on her own. She told herself, *Hang in there, it’s only a week, just a few days. You can do this.*

But the disease spread very quickly; there were many cases, and it was spreading rapidly. Control measures began to be implemented, including the suspension of classes and flights. Her mother called her.

\
They've suspended classes here, and there are very few people outside. Everyone is scared and won't say anything. What's going on?\

Honey, listen carefully. This is serious; they’re talking about a pandemic. You have to protect yourself and take care of your siblings. There’s enough food in the house to last a month, but you have to ration it. If you need money, look in the closet. There’s a safe in there with some money. Memorize the combination and don’t tell anyone. We love you, honey, and we hope to be back soon. I don’t know if we’ll be able to call later.\
Marisela, how are you? I saw the news that they’ve suspended flights and that your parents won’t be able to come back on Saturday.\
I’m so scared, Carla! I have to take care of my siblings, and I don’t know if I can do it.\
Of course you can do it. You’re so strong, my friend, and as for being scared—we’re all scared. We can’t visit each other, but we can talk to each other, and that way we can help each other.\
Hija ya sabes, todas las instrucciones te las he dejado por escrito. Tu abuela vendrá en unos días a ayudarte. Y ustedes dos\
ya saben tienen que portarse bien y ayudar a su hermana.\
No te preocupes mamá ya soy mayor de edad. Acuérdate que los cumplí hace tres días.\
¡Vamos Alicia que se nos hace tarde!. Cualquier cosa que pase nos llamas hija y ustedes, ya saben a ayudarla. No quiero quejas cuando regrese.\
Déjanos un poco más Marisela. Queremos seguir viendo televisión\
¡No Carlos! mamá dejo las instrucciones muy claras. Tienen que irse a dormir a las 9 pm.\
No me vas a convencer con eso. Vamos a la habitación.\
¡Hola Marisela! ¿como están ustedes?, mi mamá no se siente muy bién y no va a poder ir a ayudarte esta semana.\
La llevamos al hospital y la han dejado en observación. Nos dijeron que nos quedáramos en la casa y no saliéramos\
¿Hija como están? Tu abuela sigue hospitalizada, nosotros no podemos regresar, intentamos cambiar el pasaje pero no pudimos. Estamos encerrados en el hotel.\
Acá suspendieron las clases y hay muy poca gente afuera. Todos tienen miedo y no dicen nada. ¿Que está pasando?\

Hija, presta mucha atención. Esto es grave, se está hablando de una pandemia. Tienes que protegerte y cuidar a tus hermanos. En la casa hay comida como para un mes, pero tienes que administrarla. Si necesitas dinero busca en el closet. Allí hay una caja fuerte con algo de dinero. Apréndete la combinación de memoria y no se la des a nadie. Los amamos hija y esperamos regresar pronto. No sé si podremos llamar luego.\
Marisela ¿cómo estas? Vi las noticias de que habían suspendido los vuelos y que tus padres no van a poder regresar el sábado.\
Tengo mucho miedo Carla, tengo que cuidar a mis hermanos, no se si pueda.\

¡Claro que lo vas a poder hacer!Eres muy fuerte amiga y si es por el miedo todos estamos asustados. No podemos visitarnos, pero podemos hablarnos y así nos ayudamos. 
 
La voz de su amiga la tranquilizó. Se lavó la cara y fue a ver a sus hermanos. 
 
Ellos estaban acostados en los muebles con sus gatitos. Los abrazó y les dijo. 
 
\

Durante seis meses Marisela se hizo cargo de la casa y de sus hermanos y cada día sentía que aprendía a ser mas fuerte y a tomar decisiones por si misma. Su abuela había muerto y no pudo ir a verla. Eso fue muy triste, fue una de las primeras víctimas de la enfermedad. 

Sus hermanos también aprendieron a colaborar en mantener la casa ordenada y hacían sus tareas escolares  sin necesidad de que ella los obligara. A pesar del caos en el exterior, la casa era el refugio que los mantenía a salvo.
 
La pandemia fue controlada, para la alegría de la población. Sus padres llamaron para decirles que al fin podían regresar al hogar y esta noticis no podía ser mejor.

You know what they say, time is slow when your less busy or idle and time is super fast when your very busy like you won't know how fast time flies.

talking of a recent activity; last month I started working with this  great and amazing cake artist one of the best I've  ever known  so far, but then little did I realise that being around such a personality come at a great cost...

>***TIME***

I never realise these untill recently when I resumed work as an assistant baker, this is a fast paced   working environment  were  one could barely have time to take a break, I literally  stood on my toe from resumption till close of work, within that time I never realise how fast time  is, ....


recently  I've  been too busy to notice certain things and I rise up early close very late not a glimpse  of sun light. steadily  at the work station trying to makesure everything  happens in  time


time is very precious  cause it's what drives every other human activity  and as such is most be treated  with caution, cause time wasted is money wasted.

lately I've  been so busy I realise that the normal 24hours  is not enough, I sometimes  steal my night time for my free time whike during the day is my work time, I hope to be truly free someday.

description.title: Worldbuilding Weekend Prompt #160 - Tough Trade Routes
description.body:
Welcome to the next in an ongoing series of writing prompts in the Worldbuilding community ! 

I'm aiming to post one of these each Sunday. They aren't a replacement for the excellent daily prompts from @worldbuilding they're just an extra opportunity if you have a writing itch you want to scratch. 😀

![Potionsa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/23tH5eLPaqvcPDdq9FKF6CjccpPyvVFqJoiULatXRyUqxSDkFDgaM1SSaR9yTRi5wLn9h.jpg)
*Image generated by AI in Wombo.art*</center>

The prompt this week is - **Tough Trade Routes**

*Trade has never been easy, and that is especially true of long distance trade. Before the invention of the railway, trade was always easier by water. Despite storms, shipwrecks, pirates and ships which were sometimes of dubious seaworthiness, it was always faster and cheaper to move bulk goods by ship or boat.*

*Movement over land was limited by the fact that the animals towing wagons and the merchants, guards and staff all had to be fed. In practical terms, a horse or ox would literally eat the profits of a trip within a hundred miles, taking up limited wagon space to carry food instead of merchandise.*

*The amber trade of the ancient world is a good example of the result; precious and lightweight cargoes passed from merchant to merchant in a lot of small steps between the Baltic and the Mediterranean. Each step added to the cost as merchants added their profit element. By the time the amber reached Rome or Greece, it's value had increased a thousand-fold. But early trade even by sea was still expensive due to the time and risks involved. In the 15th Century, a single nutmeg was worth more than a decent house in Tudor England. In the 19th Century, tea clippers raced from China to be the first to bring back the new harvest and earn their owners a fortune.*

*Tell me a story about trade routes from your fictional setting ! What is traded ? How is it moved, and who does the trading ? What are the challenges and risks, and how are they overcome ? Have new methods of transport been discovered to solve the problems ?*


![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


Just to add a bit of spice to things, the two entries I most like (and are linked in comments to this post, so I can find them !) that are posted by **midnight (GMT) next Saturday** will each get a prize of **one Hive SBI**.  

This link will take you to the FAQ where you can read more about [Hive SBI](https://ecency.com/hive-189312/@steembasicincome/hive-sbi) - it's a project I thoroughly support because it gives both the donor and winner a steady trickle of passive income paid out in the form of upvotes on posts.

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)


**Guidelines**

I stole these guidelines straight from @worldbuilding prompts (I hope that's okay !), I couldn't have written them any better myself....

* Prompt replies may be anything! Art, game assets, stories, worldbuilding details, fake wiki entries, maps... whatever you want to create!
* Please ensure you reply to this post with a link to your reply
* Posting in or cross-posting to the Worldbuilding community is highly encouraged
* Use the hashtag #worldbuilding
* Prompt replies can be any length.
* AI images to illustrate your posts are fine, as long as they are credited to whichever software you used to make them
* Posts using AI to create the text are not acceptable; these prompts (and community) are a way to expand and have fun with human imagination, and I firmly believe AI will never be able to replicate the human spark.

Some other neat communities for writing that you might want to check out are:

* [Freewriters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-161155)
* [Scholar and Scribe](https://ecency.com/created/hive-199275)
* [Tabletop / DND](https://ecency.com/created/hive-189497)
* [The Ink Well](https://ecency.com/created/hive-170798)

It can be a lot of fun to mix and match our prompts with some of these other community prompts.

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)

If you'd like to be tagged in on these prompts, let me know and I'll happily add you 🙂

description.title: Perfect Crown:  Born for Duty, Doomed by Love | Series Review [En-Es]
description.body:
> When the monarchy outweighs freedom and morality. > Cuando la monarquía pesa más que la libertad y la moralidad.
![Movies & TVShows.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tkpDVsw5EReT5icsiNcWtfY5EuVfFvQ4asCsntU9ExjT47aEjRyp7NW1iP2e7zzkcwe.png)

> Perfect Crown is one of the K-dramas that has broken stereotypes this year, 2026. This production stars IU and Byeon Woo-seok. What makes this story so striking is its world-building and the parallel universe it portrays — a vision of what could have been. I mean the idea that Korea was never divided and that, despite its dark historical period, the monarchy endured. # Under that premise, the series has completely captivated me and has broken international viewership records. Despite that success, many people in South Korea want to cancel the series, and the backlash has led the lead actors to issue public apologies. The controversy emerged from lines that allegedly suggest Korea’s submission to China. In my opinion, that is absurd and reflects a false sense of sovereignty — one that no longer truly exists today. # The past is the past; the present is what matters. The K-drama created a beautiful narrative that showcases political power, concentrates institutional authority within the nobility, and presents love as a possible fantasy. A wealthy yet marginalized commoner can achieve the highest title by marrying the prince of the Korean Empire. After all, a K-drama is ultimately just fiction. > Perfect Crown es uno de los kdramas que ha roto estereotipos este año 2026. Esta producción está protagonizada por IU y Byeon Woo-seok. Lo que hace impactante esta historia es la composición y el universo paralelo de aquello que pudo ser. Me refiero al hecho de que Corea nunca se hubiese separado y, a pesar de su oscuro momento histórico, la monarquía prevaleciera. > > # > > Bajo ese argumento, la serie ha logrado cautivarme y ha marcado récord de audiencia a nivel internacional. A pesar de ese detalle, en Corea del Sur quieren cancelar la serie y los comentarios negativos han provocado que los actores principales pidan disculpas públicas. Los comentarios surgieron por frases que sugieren la sumisión de Corea ante China. Lo que a mi parecer es una estupidez y mantiene una falsa protección de soberanía. Una que hoy ya no existe. > > # > > El pasado es pasado, el presente es lo que importa. El kdrama construyó un argumento precioso donde se muestra el poder político, se concentra la institucionalidad en la nobleza y prioriza el amor como una fantasía posible. La plebeya millonaria y marginada puede lograr el título más grande al casarse con el príncipe del imperio de Corea. Después de todo el kdrama es solo ficción.
![Movies & TVShows (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23uFXuz3cvf22V28GAX6Q5uXpPRd5CExBfTJJbi2TMqfPzdTV6TmfENTKCfnkxb3hKzjT.png)

> The K-drama adaptation feels fantastic to me because every detail was handled with remarkable depth. The costumes, the settings, and the screenplay were all carefully crafted. Of course, nothing can ever be perfect; Koreans often strive for perfection, and they managed to find a flaw in the ending. What frustrates me is that, despite the K-drama being wonderful and ending beautifully, there are still complaints. The backlash exists precisely because of its success, and perhaps because democracy feels fragile when the drama explores the idea of a constitutional monarchy. # The story centers on the relationship between Prince I-am and Hui-ju, the illegitimate daughter of one of the most influential conglomerates in the empire. The imperial family is deeply scarred; a child sits on the throne as emperor, while I-am, as prince, serves as regent of a nation that does not allow them to live freely. The story carries a heavy political atmosphere. I-am was raised under the values of honor and nobility, and every decision he makes must be just. His father taught him that he must never desire what was not his: the throne. > La adaptación del kdrama me parece fantástica porque priorizó cada detalle con profundidad. Se cuidaron los vestuarios, los escenarios y el guion. No todo puede ser perfecto; los coreanos buscan que todo sea perfecto y ellos encontraron un detalle en el final. Mi disgusto es que, a pesar de que el kdrama fue maravilloso y cerró fantástico, hay queja. La queja ocurre por ese mismo éxito y quizás porque la democracia se siente débil porque el kdrama habla de la monarquía constitucional. > > # > > El argumento del kdrama se centra en la relación del príncipe I-am y Hui-ju, la hija ilegítima de uno de los conglomerados más influyentes del imperio. La familia imperial está llena de cicatrices; un niño es el emperador, mientras que I-am, como príncipe, es el regente de una nación que no los deja ser libres Hay mucha pesadez política en la historia; I-am creció bajo los valores de honorabilidad y nobleza. Cada una de sus decisiones debe ser justa Su padre le indicó que nunca debía codiciar lo que no era suyo: el trono.
![Movies & TVShows (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23uFMbMkCtFn7usDh3AZf7m2yHGAPQ4XCRGC6UeuhqmGcoheFdbMFGyRuGTDHCLRxMFo4.png)

> At the same time, the same conflict unfolds with Hui-ju, who is not supposed to desire the position of president of her father’s conglomerate. She wants more, more, and more. However, neither her father, the shareholders, nor her brother are willing to hand over control of the company so easily. # Both protagonists carry deep emotional wounds. What is truly remarkable is how, as the story progresses, they gradually mature. They come to understand that pain and life experiences are part of their personal growth. That process helps them confront each event with courage as everything around them begins to fall apart. After all, their marriage began as a contractual arrangement. # The story may be cliché in some aspects, but it also portrays moments of raw political intensity with great depth. Certain parts of the plot were never fully resolved, such as the first assassination attempt against Hui-ju. The second attempt was explained, but what impressed me most was the twist involving the prime minister after more than half of the episodes had passed. He had been both the prince’s and Hui-ju’s friend. Even friendship can collapse when love for someone fades away. Even the most righteous person can change. With affection, Neruel. > Paralelamente, ocurre lo mismo con Hui-ju, quien no debe codiciar el puesto de presidenta del conglomerado de su padre. Ella quiere más, más y más. Sin embargo, ni su padre, ni los accionistas y su hermano están dispuestos a entregarle el poder de la empresa fácilmente. > > # > > Ambos protagonistas poseen heridas profundas. Lo sorprendente es que, a medida que se desarrolla la trama, ambos van madurando. Comprendiendo que el dolor y las vivencias son parte de su proceso. Ese proceso los ayuda a enfrentar con valentía cada uno de los acontecimientos que presentan y viven cuando todo comienza a romperse. Después de todo, su matrimonio comenzó por contrato. > > # > > La historia puede ser cliché en algunos aspectos, pero también muestra de manera profunda hechos de categoría política cruda. Existen partes de la trama que no fueron resueltas, como el primer intento de asesinato de Hui-ju. El segundo se esclareció; lo que más me impresionó fue el giro que tuvo después de más de la mitad de los episodios respecto al primer ministro. Él era el amigo del príncipe y de Hui-ju. La amistad también se puede desmoronar cuando el amor por alguien sosiega. Hasta la persona más justa puede cambiar. Con cariño, Neruel. Images: IMDB [1](https://www.imdb.com/es-ES/title/tt39333617/mediaviewer/rm1175180290/) / [2]() / [3](). Designs Canva. Content by @neruel.  So today I played exhibition for efootball, Arsenal vs Manchester B. I chose Arsenal sha cause I dey comfortable with them and I wan test the new update players. I pick 4-3-3 formation make I see how e go be.

First half slow small, both teams just dey pass dey find space. Around 25 mins I find Gyokeres with through ball and he no waste time, just slot am in. Make am 1-0 for Arsenal. Then before half time I score another one, so e be 2-0. 

I get one standard I dey follow whenever I dey play against AI for efootball. If I score 2 goals for first half, I go make sure I score 2 or more for second half too. E don be like that since I start the game, except say dem win me. So after 2-0 for first half, I already know say I must try get at least 2 more.

Second half I change formation small make am more attack, push my wingers forward. E work sha. Around 70 mins I play Gyokeres again through ball, he run pass their defender and score again. Make am 3-0. Then last minute counter, I pass to Gyokeres again and he score him hattrick. End am 4-0 for Arsenal. Game sweet sha, I keep the standard today. Gyokeres dey ball for me, I go use am more next match.
Thanks for visiting.

description.title: El espectacular centro comercial ICONSIAM en Bangkok  [ESP/ENG]
description.body:
>

Hola a todos! les cuento que después de volver de la isla Koh Chang a Bangkok, nos hospedamos en el hotel Pullman Bangkok Hotel G y desde la gran ventana de nuestra habitación podíamos ver a lo lejos un centro comercial que se veía muy colorido e interesante llamado ICONSIAM, y al ver buenas reseñas en internet sobre este, decidímos que teníamos que visitarlo y por supuesto lo hicimos.

> Hi everyone! I wanted to tell you that after returning from Koh Chang to Bangkok, we stayed at the Pullman Bangkok Hotel G. From the large window in our room, we could see a shopping mall in the distance that looked very colorful and interesting—it was called ICONSIAM. Since we saw good reviews online about it, we decided we had to visit, and of course, we did.


![photo_2026-05-18_23-36-30.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMefN1hKDzJoPurRbximoqHBXw4tWQVD3xCveLhARvuv/photo_2026-05-18_23-36-30.jpg)



Llegamos hasta allí caminando hasta el Muelle Oriental ya que allí tomaríamos un barco que nos dejaría cerca de este centro comercial y es que el mismo está ubicado a orillas del río Chao Phraya. Allí en el muelle tardamos un poco porque esperabamos el último barco por este día y es que ya era muy tarde pero no tuvimos problemas esperando, Olivia estaba entretenida viendo a los demás barcos pasar y el costo del boleto fue muy barato.

> We walked all the way to the Eastern Pier, since that’s where we were going to take a boat that would drop us off near this shopping center, which is located on the banks of the Chao Phraya River. We spent a little time at the pier because we were waiting for the last boat of the day—it was already quite late—but we didn’t mind waiting; Olivia was entertained watching the other boats go by, and the ticket was very cheap.


![photo_2026-05-18_23-51-52 (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSUe21nAEcj8HveMuYrmM87YXdh5wrMF4orYe65XcVnxa/photo_2026-05-18_23-51-52%20(2).jpg)

![photo_2026-05-18_23-51-52.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVttAoaqa3tCbtAp9EHLyv8ZysBbGfuUbWCRwLBRGWpCJ/photo_2026-05-18_23-51-52.jpg)



Una vez llegamos al centro comercial, nos sorprendimos con las hermosas decoraciones de luces que tenían afuera, luego entramos echamos un vistazo al supermercado y seguidamente vimos el mercado flotante o SookSiam que fue una de mis partes favoritas de este centro comercial y es que muy bonito pues refleja un mercado en canales de agua y barcas de madera, muy interesante la verdad, al igual que todas las cosas que vendían allí, y es que tenían hasta recuerdos de Tailandia muy bonitos y la decoración del mismo es espectacular.

>Once we arrived at the mall, we were surprised by the beautiful light decorations outside, then we went inside, took a look around the supermarket, and soon came across the floating market, or SookSiam, which was one of my favorite parts of this mall. It’s really beautiful because it recreates a market on water canals with wooden boats—very interesting, to be honest—just like all the things they sold there. They even had some really nice Thai souvenirs, and the decor is spectacular.

<div class=\

> ![photo_2026-05-18_23-37-17.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPhyRXTNHjsZYsPeraJv48E3qVts5VHqpoZMqhxL9mfyj/photo_2026-05-18_23-37-17.jpg) Después de ver el mercado flotante, fuímos al ascensor, para seguir viendo más del centro comercial y es que les cuento que el ICONSIAM es muy grande, y cada piso es más interesante que otro, había uno que parecía muy caro con tiendas por supuesto de lujo y decoraciones muy peculiares, luego había otro piso con restaurantes y decorado con muchas plantas artificiales por supuesto pero era encantador y daban muchas ganas de caminar por allí para ver todo. >After seeing the floating market, we headed to the elevator to explore more of the mall. I have to tell you, ICONSIAM is huge, and each floor is more interesting than the last. There was one floor that looked very upscale, with luxury stores, of course, and very unique decorations. Then there was another floor with restaurants, decorated with lots of artificial plants—of course—but it was charming, and it really made you want to walk around and take it all in.

> ![photo_2026-05-18_23-37-07.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6iN8gttDBwofxkEASoWDPrwntwsaZnidFNLpz4VEmVm/photo_2026-05-18_23-37-07.jpg) Luego subimos al rooftop que era muy bonito también, allí habían lugares para sentarse debajo de árboles, una heladería, y la vista era lo mejor, paseamos un poco por allí mientras hacíamos fotos también y nos relajamos un poco y finalmente bajamos donde vimos la estatua de un grande perro que a Olivia le encantó y es que aquí hay muchas cosas interesantes para ver y si me preguntan, sí, es un lugar que recomiendo conocer si van a Bangkok, no sé si el mejor centro comercial de allí pero estoy segura que les va a encantar, es enorme y van a vivir una experiencia única, eso sí, recuerden ir temprano porque fue muy difícil conseguir un taxi para volver al hotel desde allí ya que había mucha gente esperando pero valió la pena la espera. >Then we went up to the rooftop, which was really nice too. There were places to sit under the trees, an ice cream shop, and the view was the best part. We walked around a bit while taking pictures and relaxed for a while, and finally went back down where we saw a statue of a big dog that Olivia loved. There are so many interesting things to see here, and if you ask me, yes, it’s a place I recommend visiting if you go to Bangkok. I don’t know if it’s the best mall there, but I’m sure you’ll love it—it’s huge, and you’ll have a unique experience. Just remember to go early, because it was really hard to get a taxi back to the hotel from there since there were so many people waiting, but it was worth the wait.

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23vi49DeB7BqBmdyyK4AQSt6M517mc6q5gKxghfB5DeDLQ5TtkcEE5QPZnXPkkQwLmJD6.png) [Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg](https://peakd.com/@lanzjoseg)
![cooltext508394795360060.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23uFMm1EV96PMUcR5EUiGvWi6AYT7yzKYMDX4HtBES5oTibAskDF18iUh7GAh3hk2RxDK.png)
Muy bien familia, presten atención, este es mi consejo: **\

** y me refiero a hacer magia en la cocina. Seguramente alguna vez en la vida debiste de probar el ketchup, esa sustancia condimentada que combina con toda comida existente.

La salsa de tomate es el pináculo de la gastronomía mundial, fue creado para potenciar el sabor de las mejores preparaciones culinarias: Como el espagueti con albóndigas.

Su elaboración requiere ingredientes sencillos y seguir al pie de la letra una receta secreta que ha pasado de generación en generación en mi familia: 

- Tomates maduros
- Aceite de oliva extra virgen
- Cebollas 
- Ajos
- Sal
- Azúcar (solo una pizca) 
- Hojas frescas de albahaca o perejil para darle esencia

Solo comienza lavando los tomates con cuidado en el lavamanos más cercano, seguidamente se hacen cortes superficiales en forma de cruz en la base de cada tomate, estas se sumergirán en agua hirviendo por un minuto, luego de dejarlas reposar tras su baño caliente, se pelan fácilmente y se cortan en cubos diminutos.

Ahora bien, en la sartén, se calienta el aceite de oliva y se sofríen la cebolla y el ajo finamente picados con antelación. Posteriormente, se incorporan los tomates troceados y se cocina a fuego lento durante aproximadamente media ahora, tienes que ir removiendo la sartén con frecuencia para evitar que la salsa se pegue. (Lo digo por experiencia)

Mientras lo haces, se añade sal y una pequeña cantidad de azúcar. Al final, agregaras la albahaca o el perejil fresco y una vez que este sazonado, lo dejaras reposar en el refrigerador durante media hora.

Esta salsa resulta ideal para acompañarla papas fritas, pero dime ¿Te gustaría preparar una pizza?

Pues para eso, solo repite los pasos anteriores + una buena cantidad de puré de tomate, media cucharadita de pimienta negra, una cucharada de orégano seco y albahaca seca.

Espero que esta receta te sea de utilidad para que te sirvas un banquete repleto de salsa.

description.title: Dziennik #84/2026 - nicość
description.body: > Dobry wieczór. Nie wyspałam się. Niemniej jednak musiałam dość wcześnie jak na mnie wstać [a ja nienawidzę wcześnie wstawać], ponieważ na 8 byłam umówiona z przyjaciółką. Chciałam z nią porozmawiać na temat tego, że nie chcę chodzić na terapię uzależnień. Powodów mojej awersji jest kilka, ale główny jest chyba taki, że mielę terapię uzależnień od ponad 6 lat i jestem już tym po prostu zmęczona. To są cały czas te same odgrzewane kotlety, a ja chyba potrzebuję chwili oddechu. Ze swojej normalnej terapii nie zamierzam rezygnować, ale od tej uzależnień potrzebuję odpoczynku. Po prostu czuję, że tego potrzebuję. Nie mam przestrzeni znów gadać o tym samym. Chciałam o tym porozmawiać z Gosią, bo trochę odebrałam naszą rozmowę ostatnią tak, że to jest warunek dla mnie, że mam tam wrócić. Na szczęście udało nam się porozumieć i nie muszę, a między nami wszystko jest w porządku. Poszłyśmy na spacer i dobrze spędziłam ten czas. Jak zawsze zresztą no chyba, że coś odpierdolę i obrywam to wtedy fajnie nie jest, ale że byłam grzeczna cały weekend i nie upadłam to było naprawdę spoko. Kocham ją soł macz. Pojechałam do pracy w bardzo niestabilnym nastroju. Bardzo. Miotało mnie między depresją, a euforią. I dużo lęku i gniewu. Wybuchowa mieszanka. Jak tylko przyszła asystentka to zaczęła mi się bacznie przyglądać, więc od razu jej powiedziałam, że nic nie odwaliłam w weekend, jestem trzeźwa. Odniosłam wrażenie jakby jej ulżyło. Przyjaciółka mi powiedziała dzisiaj, że pisała do niej zaniepokojona tym co się ze mną dzieje. Przykro mi tak po ludzku, że dostarczyłam jej takich nerwów. Gdzieś tam przez te pół roku zbliżyłyśmy się do siebie i nasza relacja trochę wykracza poza standardową relację lider - asystentka, ale no już trudno, stało się. Mogę jedynie popracować nad tym, żeby już ani jedna ani druga nie cierpiały przeze mnie. Dużo dzisiaj rozmawiałyśmy i jak zostałyśmy same to ją przeprosiłam za to, że musiała się o mnie martwić. Po prostu czułam taką potrzebę. Przeprosiny przyjęte, wszystko między nami gra, ale i tak będzie się o mnie martwić. W sumie to miłe. Nowe i nieznane, że ktoś się o mnie tak martwi i troszczy, a tu robią to już dwie osoby. Pod koniec pracy zaczęły mi siadać baterie i ta euforia odchodziła w niebyt, a w to miejsce pojawiła się pustka, depresja, ból, lęk, nicość. Coś jakbym wpadła do oceanu i powoli opadała na dno bez możliwości jakiegokolwiek ratunku. Bez w ogóle najmniejszych szans na ratunek. I na to wszystko wkroczyła cała na biało moja przyjaciółka, żeby ze mną przeprowadzić poważną rozmowę co mam zrobić PO JEJ ŚMIERCI. Więc najdelikatniej mówiąc rozpadłam się już zupełnie i nawet jej nie odpisałam na ostatnią wiadomość, bo wszystko co mi się cisnęło, żeby napisać wywołałoby pyskówkę niepotrzebną. Rozumiem, że miała potrzebę wyjaśnienia mi swoich planów, rozumiem, że taka jest kolej życia i takie tam pierdolenie, ale nie mam zgody na jej śmierć kompletnie i na co dzień odpycham od siebie skutecznie myśl, że kiedyś może jej nie być w moim życiu, więc jak mi zajebała dzisiaj taką petardę jak moja forma była zła no to nie mogło się skończyć inaczej niż upadkiem psychicznym. Nie jej wina. Z obietnic się wywiążę, ale mam nadzieję, że zdechnę pierwsza [a są na to spore szanse], bo nie chcę świata bez niej. Wracałam do domu to się w ogóle popłakałam w aucie. Zabrałam psa na długi spacer co nie do końca sprzyjało mojemu zdrowiu psychicznemu, bo trochę mi się lęków odpaliło przez łażenie po nocnym osiedlu, ale tego potrzebowałam. I znowu czuję nic. Pustkę, nic, nicość. Ciekawe co mnie szybciej wykończy: moja wrażliwość czy miłość do używek? W ogóle to chyba udało mi się w miarę sensownie rozplanować weekend, więc jak się postaram, a nie będę leniwą pizdą to jest potencjał na to, że nie złamię abstynencji ponownie. W sobotę widzę się z przyjaciółką i jej córką, a w niedzielę idę do pracy na ponad 10h, a potem jadę do ziomka nad jezioro. Naprawdę są spore szanse, że nic nie odpierdolę. Oby. Do jutra.

description.body:
> Today I celebrate one of my students who's graduating from the intermediate level to the advanced class. She's been nothing short of a blessing to me. It's how she makes my work so easy, how she make it so fun to do. She came in with a basic knowledge of sewing, wanting to be more. I saw the passion in her eyes and I promised to make every penny she paid worth it. Gradually, we started this journey of being better in her craft. I watch her tried to stupor, sometimes she failed, sometimes she cried, some days she almost gave up, but I was right beside her, not just as a tutor but as a mentor, a cheerleader, always rooting for her. ![1777366358495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23wqiH4ycCgqstrjgZTpANrzHCaUz9D6H7p2Azu8upVgXF2EXaeep3DqjtgsTySjRGarc.jpg) This outfit she wore was her final project in the interndiate class and truth be told, she made the dress herself with little supervision from me. That's exactly what growth looks like and I'm so proud of her. As I watch her smile, it gladdened my heart. Because I know for a fact that, It takes a lot of effort to be a better person. One who lives with intentionality, has found a hack of surviving life. ![1777366424773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23wqnVxjjgqyRPqviPRMcvUfso51DcnispTcDpHZacyv5dTUwmMNYE8vGyt4pMBJL78c9.jpg) I can't wait to see more amazing project by her as soon as she'll get into the advance level but this alone has assured me, that anything anyone puts her mind into is very achivable. One need to cast fear aside and be brave, because life is only for those tough at heart. Cheers to her!!! A new batch resumes soon, I hope I found time to show up here as much as I would love to. Hopefully I'll get my superpowers in multitasking back. Anyways, I can't wait to see how things will unfold. ____
Images used are mine.
____ ____

description.title: Learning Never Ends
description.body: Today something small but meaningful happened to me. I was in my room, sitting quietly with my books scattered on the floor. I was reading and trying to understand some things better. Then a young girl from our compound, her name is Happy, walked into my room.\n\n

> She looked around and saw all the books on the floor. Then she asked me, “Uncle, are you going to school?” I smiled immediately. Her question was innocent, but it carried a lot of meaning. I told her, “No.” Then I asked her, “Why did you ask that?” She pointed at the books and said nothing more, but I already understood. To her, seeing many books meant only one thing — school. And honestly, I don’t blame her. That is how many people think. Once you graduate, people expect you to close your books and move on with life. But for me, it is different.

> Her question reminded me of something that happened earlier this year, around February. A grown-up lady also asked me something similar. She already knew that I had graduated, yet she was surprised to still see me reading seriously. She asked why I was still studying so much. At that time, I didn’t say much, but deep inside me, I knew the answer. I love studying. It is as simple as that. For me, reading is not just about passing exams or getting a certificate. It is more than that. It is about growth. It is about becoming better every single day. School may end, but learning never ends. Life itself is a classroom.

>

Sometimes, people think that once you finish school, you have finished learning. But the truth is, that is just the beginning. There are many things school does not teach you. There are many things you still need to discover on your own.

When I sit with my books, I am not just reading for marks. I am reading to understand life, to improve myself, and to prepare for the future. Knowledge gives confidence. It opens your mind and helps you see things differently.

That small question from Happy made me smile, but it also made me think deeply. Even a child can remind you of something important.

People will always ask questions. Some will wonder why you are still pushing yourself. Some may not understand your journey. But you don’t need everyone to understand. What matters is that you know why you are doing what you are doing.

As for me, I will keep studying.

Not because I am going back to school, but because I believe learning is a lifelong journey. Whether people understand it or not, I am comfortable with it.

And maybe one day, that same young girl will grow up and understand that books are not only for school, but for life.

Sometimes, the smallest moments carry the biggest lessons. 
Thank you all for coming to my blog, pls let me have your contribution on the the comment session i will love to go through it.

**All pictures are real and mine...**

Thank you!

description.title: First day of the semester…😑
description.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![First day of the semester…😑](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/b1224bd6-b768-4afa-a5c9-8af9fdbd576b.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/ukgH3vF4Fa5q6xXpXhgVHP) 
 
 Lectures finally started today, so I guess our semester just started for real 😂 even though it started two weeks back but we never really had class till now. The class was from 8am till 10am, so I had to wake up early and go to school like few minutes to 8 so I wouldn’t be late. It felt kind of weird being back in class after waiting that long, but I was also lowkey happy that it finally started. The first day wasn’t too heavy sha, mostly just settling in and getting the gist of things.
After class I came back home, dropped my bag and just rested small before doing anything else. I was kinda tired from waking up early and sitting through the class, so I just laid down for a bit, scrolled my phone and cleared my head. It felt nice to just relax after the first day back, cause the morning was a bit rush and I needed that break to reset.
Later in the night I decided to cook rice and eat it. Nothing fancy, just something quick for dinner since I didn’t feel like stressing. After eating I just chilled small, watched a bit of video and relaxed before calling it a day. That was basically how my day went - school in the morning, rest after, then food and rest again. It was a simple day, but at least it marked the real start of lectures.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/ukgH3vF4Fa5q6xXpXhgVHP)

##### Hi everyone

And with this sharing, I conclude our tribute to our little friend, may she rest in peace.
This is the closest possible scale using this inverted lens technique.
It is absolutely fantastic to be able to observe such tiny details, like those small dots on the little wings, or even in the drone's eyes.
Next, we will return to the mineral sessions, still using the current light source, expecting to use the new light source, anticipating that it will be possible to obtain much more focused images. We shall see.

---

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/5 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: Variable aperture between f/4 and f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (800) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)

body.title: CCC's Street Art Contest # 301 \
- Mariana Duarte Santos - Bairro 2 de Maio, Lisboa - Portugal
body.body:
### Good evening, friends! #### Welcome to another post in the [Street Art community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784/created)! This week, I’m featuring the third piece by artist [Mariana Duarte Santos](https://marianaduartesantos.com/), whose other two works—also created in this same Lisbon neighborhood—I’ve previously shared here. This neighborhood is particularly significant because it was one of the areas converted into public housing, largely driven by the Revolution of 1975, as there was a great demand for housing at the time. Initially, it is believed the neighborhood was being built to house state police officers and their families, but it was later occupied by people who had nowhere to live, and they went on to finish the houses that were not yet fully constructed. Some are missing walls, others doors, and other details. The work shared here, titled “Neighborhood,” was inspired by a painting, as were other works here in the neighborhood ([link 1](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@xrayman/cccs-street-art-contest-298-memories-of-the-invasion-mariana-duarte-santos-bairro-2-de-maio-lisboa-portugal), [link 2](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@xrayman/cccs-street-art-contest-296-the-reading-mariana-duarte-santos-bairro-2-de-maio-lisboa-portugal)). The painting that served as inspiration is called “Rua do Arco do Marquês D’Alegrete,” which was painted by Roque Gameiro in 1910. > ! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23xerYnaRp5bTb3FyegnaEspavPvMkKo4DRBkhqU2RsTzXTf5eKD1HjAMVSKZm6JxiySa.png) > >https://marianaduartesantos.com/project/3-mural-in-bairro-2-de-maio-lisboa-portugal/ The artist painted the mural with this scene in mind, drawing on the daily lives of various people and the conversations that take place on the stairwells of the buildings. The stairwells become a common gathering place where news about everyone’s lives is shared with those who live in the same building. It’s interesting to see the connection that exists between neighbors, who end up participating a little in each other’s lives. Something that, at times, isn’t seen in the more elite neighborhoods—or isn’t even possible there. There are some neighborhoods where the elevator leads directly to a parking spot, isolating people from any possibility of communicating with their neighbors. It’s a strange world, isn’t it? We know more about what’s happening thousands of miles away, and sometimes we don’t even know that a neighbor is going through some kind of hardship or difficulty. And you, what is life like in your building? Are you able to talk to your neighbors? Do you know their names? Or is the “obligatory” greeting exchanged daily only when you run into each other in the elevator or the lobby? We spend more and more time worrying about “our own lives,” our problems, or our goals, and we don’t even notice that perhaps our next-door neighbor just needed five minutes that morning to talk a little… Often, the best gift we can give is our time and our willingness to listen to others. I hope that community life is lived more and more authentically, with a focus on making our neighbors’ lives a little more bearable. And most of the time, that doesn’t even require spending money or a lot of time. It makes you think, doesn’t it?
![20260506_124538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23zRy2cXfcZWT59zEn1ckBnBpYcHFtiWQZ94zJSoyefm73B7Mq6QsERYF1FnRrba3TXZX.jpg) ![20260506_124605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EoAZDbDuNWKVaNJQ71CUR8i8RHMex2j4Yd2Hrng7gARxiovfCx9TqTtosGiqdzZzjfe.jpg) ![20260506_124601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/Ep1XR2KebN9UDMsiL94R3PMagL4fECZndENQAMQwoCGvNH6YP7TzvEw1EFP3oyufy8H.jpg) ![20260506_124548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23vsNTxqduEb8uH5TwdnRnPtaBiCiYQbzQCwu5yojHTSeSE3uaDt5NrBZutWFhFSkXt3Q.jpg) ![20260506_124555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EoEqymVK7Z2tDYzLBQbxahy5SZcSEDpaUyc9Vj7KDwoZHwaewgYxmHBd6RHRnhSvffh.jpg) ![20260506_124648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EogNNiSBH23gY4A8WxYTxgdaqRVy5rgitBCRhL8MSJ6m7kc2PhGMNps8cZDXuWFzj81.jpg) ![20260506_124620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/23tH7bBNn5wi7o7PR9ZMPh1deL2n1rg6xLhuWNb82rKgvj6mLpyJFMn4yQKdwiGh5pvuZ.jpg) ![20260506_124625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EoAaEzKsst7ZNgW7yMbUtYEdS6KsNWUbKPxdDdFcPKusWkZZFgwjSFDB5Jev8qBN6L7.jpg)

body.title: Aerial tangles / Marañas aéreas - Monomad Challenge
body.body:
As soon as you look up, you can see them. On many streets in Venezuela, utility poles covered in tangled cables are a common sight. >*Apenas alzas la mirada, los puedes ver. En muchas calles de Venezuela, los postes de electricidad con marañas de cables encima son algo común.*
![IMG_20260518_170021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23yTjGbPyk6pEUpvxdQWLSxFyonGp8j46iChtwjQiDJUqKhBJwgucvjoVRn5dZW38hJCc.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/241tZ87odQiZHRtZBYWWbsWzqcBQVRWbutnYvDKoChv69CFJRgYBxsNkLDVCAZFNt3z5i.jpg)
These tangles of cables create a lot of visual chaos, in my opinion. Every day, more and more black wires are added to these utility poles, for example, those from companies that provide Internet services. >*Estas marañas o enredos de cables generan un gran caos visual, a mi parecer. En estos postes de electricidad se agregan cada día más hilos negros, como por ejemplo los de las empresas que ofrecen servicios de Internet.*
![IMG_20260518_165845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23zS3XqsuFAqWgzHn37BQFFbvbvcoQo1YoKy8vDM3a564Tdq9ADL1xjFWxZJma2THXMWa.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/2458QRccwVV4dosjML6TW66afQVG3vBgBV8HPEXAUm3WjuyQm1vNdWXa1eyAau8KzQUYx.jpg)
The style of these companies is to leave large rolls of cable hanging from the poles. I've seen some that are already overloaded, clearly, they don't care about aesthetics... >*El estilo de estas empresas es ir dejando grandes rollos de cable guindado en los postes. He visto algunos ya demasiado cargados, obviamente no les importa la estética...*
![IMG_20260518_170052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xejpECVdjXD4tDCTXnKPHCYYdZTS8zQtZ9XisJG2xA7M3ikFrnKK7ok9tu776J8C16E.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xpAd75w3pv2qJHPd3mfpcp422GjE8fCZPo4Wby4gEqVibF1MVBYdQe8sGaqBxiB4oUe.jpg)
And safety isn't a concern for them either. There are streets where many of these cables have fallen or broken, and they can be a hazard to pedestrians, but days go by like this and no one picks them up. >*Y la seguridad tampoco les preocupa. Hay calles en donde muchos de estos cables se han caído o roto, y pueden ser un peligro para los transeúntes, pero pasan días así y nadie los recoge.*
![IMG_20260518_170143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/243WTjqakv8TTHQw1uEAkz9dzQtyceuxNSu4v7aTu2Z5Do8KyReHiM3m9yEGwqekabAf6.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xKtdMmRjGPoakZDFwnyL1pkpy8Phgtkq4uuS2pdMPajYJxJRKBTWBBnCSWyChSLeHER.jpg)
I know that other countries have gone underground with their wiring to make their cities look nicer and keep those tangled messes from spoiling the cityscape and getting in the way of traffic. But as you can see, we’re a long way from that here 😆. >*Sé que en otros países han implementado el cableado subterráneo para que las ciudades luzcan mejor y estas marañas no interfieran con el paisaje urbano y el movimiento en las calles. Pero como ven, aquí estamos muy lejos de eso 😆.*
![IMG_20260518_165931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoErYr81vsHwQUBecXQC6vvvR5Z39tPA1p4DedfgSAb7C84BGWRv5uLsBsCAGTteavT.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_165901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/244ob2pCs4tXhTqhCyftLfs68vUk5UdcPrR3bLByAiqNLczJrD72aiyXYowQBwsmWNojW.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eo6Lw76qQBb2jKdCMk5PnpUtAbuzm172yH9J2e64ePnBy9hwUt3umVZpi5zRdMsF6y4.jpg)
![IMG_20260518_170036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23ynUSqF6J3kDuYe1RNuFM11WfSCssfnHUUBSKMMWqETbUXWTZiUp6mMMTD9TihXA9Btt.jpg)
Well, at least this air chaos makes for an interesting subject for those of us who love street photography 😄. You can get some interesting shots. What do you think? >*Bueno, al menos este desorden aéreo es un tema atractivo para los que nos gusta la fotografía callejera 😄. Se pueden hacer tomas interesantes. ¿Ustedes qué opinan?*
![IMG_20260518_165952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23wqkBU4NKc6WjDpnR6pY2QeYx3HSW63WT81ugnk9kiNd5gnid7YDPJTKxA7Eawn3ru6C.jpg)

body.title: 잘 걷는 법
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVqDBjH5j4VcrFP6m2sYv7sfkE5tXhncyiPBafL1xW9QD/gemini_generated_image_92eb0092eb0092eb.png)

걷기 운동은 얼마나 자주 걷느냐보다, 결국 얼마나 많이 걷느냐가 더 중요하다는 연구 결과였다.

미국 Harvard Medical School 산하 브리검 여성병원 연구팀이 평균 나이 71.8세 여성 1만3000여 명을 대상으로 약 11년 동안 조사했다고 한다. 연구 결과를 보니 하루 4000보 이상 걷는 날이 일주일에 3일 이상인 사람들은 거의 걷지 않는 사람보다 사망 위험이 40%나 낮았다고 한다. 심혈관 질환 위험도 줄어들었다고 하니 걷기의 힘이 정말 대단한 것 같다.

특히 기억에 남았던 건 “매일 꼭 해야 한다”는 부담보다 총 걸음 수가 더 중요하다는 부분이었다. 바쁜 날에는 많이 못 걷더라도 주말이나 시간이 날 때 몰아서 걸어도 건강에 도움이 된다는 이야기라 마음이 조금 편해졌다.

요즘은 앉아 있는 시간이 많아서 운동 부족을 느끼곤 했는데, 오늘 기사를 읽고 나니 거창한 운동보다 일단 많이 걷는 습관부터 만들어야겠다는 생각이 들었다. 엘리베이터 대신 계단을 이용하거나, 가까운 거리는 걸어 다니는 작은 습관부터 시작해봐야겠다.

하루 5000보, 가능하면 6000~7000보 정도를 목표로 천천히 실천해보면 좋을 것 같다. 몸 건강뿐 아니라 기분 전환에도 도움이 될 것 같아 오늘부터라도 조금 더 걸어보고 싶다
