body.title: Decline to Nothing
body.body:
>

>Finnish men hold on average 62 percent more investment wealth than women.

Seems like a massive gap, and it is - but it doesn't really tell the whole story, even though this is what people in Finland will remember. Because while the investment wealth gap is massive, the *median* wealth gap is at 11%. This is because older me, especially those already retired, have significantly more investments that women of the same age, because they were earning in a different time and benefiting from massive economic growth and high interest rates on their savings and investments. 

> But it should be remembered.



---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23wXQcTiRuDTC6Vipf2vgnWRg59HNRya7WK3QB9ADy8MKXwtKni2a2b8hEfYBURwngAfo.png)


---

> Those men also had children. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/EptfoBY7U6kQrXyMBTdo21otYLGNBixez8WzroWfaKziZP5sqWomreas2fTd2nuuB5f.png)


Over the last 70 years, the live births per 100 people has dropped dramatically, going from over 24 to 8.5 as of 2025. Those older men with investments will soon pass away and then pass on that wealth to their spouses (who tend to outlive them) and their two to three or more children. And what is interesting is that because the birth rate is so low, the people who will be getting those inheritances have less children, if any at all. That means that the accumulated investment wealth will be distributed, but will be spread among a smaller pool of people than it would have done had birth rates remained the same. 

Essentially, this wealth is going to become far more \

than it would have been if there were more children, which means it is going to be spent on more consumer and lifestyle purchases, since it is likely that the people inheriting will have a job already. Yes, some might pay off their house, but many will travel, buy holiday homes, upgrade cars and push that investment wealth back into the pockets of consumer corporations. And while in the past that would be great because it would mean more jobs, with automation replacing humans in the workplace, not many more jobs will be created even though a huge amount of wealth will be captured. It is going to be the largest wealth transfer between generations ever, but for the most part, the beneficiaries are going to be the billionaires, and likely a handful of new trillionaires. Lately I feel like investing isn't going to have great returns for humanity, or even the people investing that many believe it will have. At some point, the market eats itself and there aren't enough consumers to keep a business profitable, no matter how efficiently they create the product. If people can't afford to buy, it doesn't matter what is sold. And then, no matter how much wealth an individual has, it isn't going to e a great life for anyone when the majority are in constant hardship, facing daily violence and it is unsafe to walk the streets anywhere, day or night. And while the wealthiest will be able to insulate themselves on an island or in a bunker, the reality is that only the top of the 0.1% will have that option. The rest will be doing the best they can where they are, with little chance to truly insulate. It is a bit like average people arguing over which mid-range car is the best because it makes them feel special, when the reality is that mid-range is nothing compared to a private jet. > Those who can insulate are in a different class. If you are reading this, *you are not in that class.* I think that while we are arguing over wealth gaps between men and women, opportunity gaps between generations, and what pronouns someone uses, we are missing the fundamental conversation that we need to have as a society at all levels: > What kind of society do we want? Because I think that we can all agree based on the current state of the world and the projections for the future, *that this is not it.* We keep looking for ways we can survive as individuals, keep chasing a fantasy sold as reality, keep pushing for stability, security, and opportunity - that just can't materialise from the environment we have created. It is a *blood from a stone* scenario, where what we need isn't possible from the way we are doing things. With the changing technology, I reckon we are facing an existential threat to our species. Not because AI will take over and kill us all, but because the automation will replace everything we do that matters to us. It will be better than us at all we hold dear, and will be more efficient, more accurate, and willing to work non-stop at all the things that we do for an income. If we do not reimagine what it means to live as a society, we are just going to peter out into the ether, in a crush of disillusionment and violence. > Because we are human; we will not lay down, we will fight, even when it is futile, even when it is for the wrong cause. The answers aren't in more financial mechanisms to generate more imaginary wealth that we for now can trade for something. It is in our actions as a species to build the kind of world where we can live and thrive, create and collaborate, to build the kind of society we want to live in. > One that matters, making us matter. But we will not focus our attention on improving our actions. Instead, we will keep playing the game that we have been conditioned to play for hundreds of years, despite it leading us to where we are today - close to social collapse. > We all die. But how did we live? body.title: Hive Engine EVM Tokens Bridge Got Hacked! .:. WorkerBee PH-Pool Week 275
body.body:
Not sure if this attack was realized by using AI to find loopholes, or it was something else, but unfortunately it did happen... During the day, the EVM bridge for Hive-Engine custodial wallets was breached, and significant funds have been stolen... 

<center>
![WorkerBee Pool 275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23yJEEvE5x8N2S7JNuMHimGEE7FRcg9e81Z36A4mzSYMaXX2AsJXbn75yD5p3pGjkrfv3.jpg)
*Created on Canva.com, using my photo as a background*
</center>

If you are in crypto long enough, you have probably heard dozens of times about hacks happened in \

... As these wallets usually hold a lot of tokens, they are a honeypot for potential hackers... On Hive-Engine, these wallets have nothing to do with witnesses, and they are pretty centralized, which may make them an easy prey... 

As I wasn't at home the whole day (that's why this report is a bit late), I have no more details about the hack except official announcements from the H-E Discord server... 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/Eo1wrWdNjZ9aZy3oW8HNDygeZREaq5XtAdvRUAnL6ZHMaTK7qmrHxnb6NazVn8HBzYk.png)

Regarding BEE and WORKERBEE tokens, these hacks didn't have direct influence, and hopefully, they will not get \

because of that...
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png)
Let's see the WorkerBee Pool numbers for this week... **This week, we have mined 152 BEE tokens in total, 35 tokens more than the week before!!** I'm doing this report a bit too late, but this amount of mined tokens is extraordinary! I suppose we were lucky this week (at least with the mining lottery)... This week, we didn't get new delegators... As usual, we got additional delegations from old members! Thanks for your continuous support, guys and girls! I really appreciate it! > **This pool doesn't charge fees, and you can earn up to 20% more by delegating to it!**
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tmjJDBEo8aBq9bCveiyxhgkquuDvPVbj5RDVKmAKRwUN2rUQRAmiHZxP6iRmDqZBpcU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tw83Ju7oqXNtgTCXnqdbe1Ui5NQjJLpYb7Vj6XGZQePvZFjjX2Xgxw8uYJo31Y3UoP8.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tw83Ju7oqXNtgDEuTNfuYVxJPiTUFGNNrb2c8B3SzpDpfj6NEy8DJng52YeBFDxcDCU.png)
![Liotes Divider Blue.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23tkbF4DcCGQEGiCeHeG4sUJewcA9b5MwubaESF9UnsbGiZjuEBo43Dsdseh7hKo2qwcG.png)
**What about the bonus tokens?** This week, I will distribute **SPS tokens** to the delegators of the pool... One of the tokens from the Splinterlands game, which owners are also closely connected to the Hive-Engine... Not sure what the repercussions will be after this hack, but we will soon find out... For now, the SPS token didn't take any damage... > **There will be distributed 270 SPS tokens to the delegators of the pool as a bonus reward today!**
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ph1102/23xf4wsTRb4V8JLCDthR8DuKkpXtPxdsHG5jb3HEmkZgkeTwriRAqSn17aApr1ARn7VZr.png)
270 SPS tokens will be distributed as a bonus... The APR (without the bonus) was **10.585%**, and when we added the bonus, it went up to **12.719%**! *I have calculated the ROI approximately with medium prices for all tokens when creating this post... So, those numbers are valid if you bought WB and sold BEE tokens at the middle HiveEngine price... Currently, the BUY side of the WORKERBEE tokens is very thin, and it's hard to calculate the middle price.* > *Do you want to sponsor the PH-Pool with your tokens, receive a short SPONSORED segment in this post, and raise awareness about your front-end or dApp? body.body: > ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/2466nr1KWv4QD1kUU1aeTxXHna9DaZw7pq1oMMn7KvtpmstPCg1E8rSCskqYHVmuPGqeC.JPG) Tucked away in the Stormsrivier forest, the small micro brewery feels like a slice of heaven, especially after a long day. We were driving for a while now, getting the roadtrip under way, and we saw the small brewery boasting various beers. And it was also on my beer passport! What luck. We turned in, and parking our car under one of the magical and massive trees, we sat down for a sip or three. The brewery had various beers on tap, and obviously I gravitated toward the larger ales. They had some interesting beers on tap though. Which is a good thing, until you need to buy some beer... Which ones do you take with so many options on the table? # The Massive Trees Sadly, this area was part of the logging world long ago. Massive trees were cut down without giving it a second thought. body.title: Decentralization needs incentives, which needs significant effort
body.body:
Decentralization is one of those feel-good ideas that most people don't stop to think about how much efforts is required to make it work!

The central challenge of decentralization is making individual self-interest point in the same direction as collective welfare.

You want people to act in a way that serves everyone whilst simultaneously serving themselves.

It's harder than people make it out to be.

How do you convince people to protect billions in value just so they can earn a few thousand.

Doesn't really seem like a fair trade does it?

### It's not

What is demanded is generally more than what is given. As a result, something else must exist to ensure that regardless, the system can achieve some reasonable distribution.

That something else is the opposite factor to incentives, penalties.

If a person tries to steal the billions he's supposed to protect, he loses millions.

Essentially, the system is structured to reward thousands to distributed participants to secure billions, whilst the individuals risk losing millions if they attack the system.

Pretty balanced right?

### Not necessarily

The above statements just assumes that there's not just billions waiting to be secured, and that there's also people with millions to stake, and also that there's thousands somewhere to issue as rewards.

Generally, most of these things don't exist at the early stages of blockchains, effectively demanding that initial incentives design and roll-out must be structured to achieve meaningful decentralization that can self-sustain.

### The hard part

The roll-out is the hardest phase for any blockchain or project.

This impacts the future of it all.

Poorly planned or executed roll-outs could cause projects to never achieve decentralization.

So again, it's rather comical that we often don't look at the efforts required to build truly decentralized economies.

Smart incentive structures and sustainable economic systems are required to achieve provable decentralization. The sooner we acknowledge this, the sooner we'd come to terms with what needs to be done to change the realities of most crypto projects today.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@badbitch/decentralization-needs-incentives-which-needs-significant-effort-qh)

body.title: The reward
body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4v2AoxUkcuFEeUuXqshtaho37HjdYDWwBVc7QT59oGs/1779141299398.jpg)

Helping people in life is something that has become part of me. I have helped a lot of people that I have crossed my path with, however I have not received help from any of them. The only thing that has been keeping me going in all I'm doing is that statement that my parents used to tell me when I'm downcast that, 

“Not everyone that you help will pay you back, just continue doing good to all and in due time, you will reap your reward.”

The first time my mum told me this, I was happy and elated thanking her for the insightful statement as I was about to be weary when she uttered that statement to me and this is because of what transpired between me and my best friend Whose name is Ade.

Ade and I were best of friends and our friendship was dated to our year three(3) in the university. Then, I was squatting with a friend who happened to be my fellowship member on campus, but this brother who was far older to me was not as relatable as Ade who was my age.

So, what actually brought Ade and I was our age bracket as I could really relate with the old cargo man in the person of bro. Segun who although advised me not to solely rely on Ade as my best friend. He said,

“Sam, this guy, Ade that you are romancing with is not the kind of guy you should be romancing with as I don't trust him to be the good guy he portrayed himself to be, just be careful.”

Even when he had told me this, I didn't really take his words of advice to heart as I was like he didn't want me to be a friend to Ade, not knowing he was only telling me the truth. 

So, when Ade and I started our friendship, it's like there's no other relationship on that campus as people who knew us knew us to be  more than a friend and that was when I began to see bro. Segun as a bad person who would not want me to have someone like Ade as my best friend.

Although we are not in the same department in the university, everyone in my department knew us to be the best of friends and vice versa.

The journey of our togetherness was so smooth and rosy and It got to a time when our parents were even involved in the relationship. I could remember both families attending functions of each other's family together. Atimes, both will buy the same uniform or fabrics to attend functions together.

That's the extent at which our friendship has gone with our different families. So, this was how we lived and journeyed together both on and off the campus.

However, after our final exams we both graduated together and not only that, we were still doing things together as our separation from the university after the graduation didn't tell on your relationship.

After few years of our graduation, I secured a job with one of the state government in the country and on my first day of resuming to this work, I asked if there's a cooperative society where I would be contributing part of my monthly earnings and I was told there's one and immediately I heard that, I joined and it wasn't too long after I joined that Ade called for help. He said,

“Sam, I have been processing my travelling abroad and at this point I'm in need of money to complete the process, can you please lend me money?” “I just spent a year in my place of work and in the cooperative and I don't think I would be eligible for any loan now, but if I'm eligible to take loan, I will surely get back to you,” I replied. “Like when should I be expecting your response on this matter?” He asked. “Very soon,” I replied.

After our phone conversation, I called the chairman of the cooperative society and he said I'm eligible for double of what I had saved with the cooperative. When I heard this, I was happy and this was because of my love for Ade and not only that, for the purpose of our friendship and family ties.


Although I had it in mind to tell my parents what was going on between both of us, I decided not to tell them as I believe they would not stop me from helping a friend. In the end, I collected the money from the cooperative and lent it to Ade who promised to refund the money as soon as he travelled out of the country.

Fortunately, everything clicked for him and he was able to get out of the country and when he got there, he promised to refund the money and asked me to give him more time, but alas! After waiting for years, he refused to refund me and even blocked me from accessing him. 

Ab initio, I thought things were not fine with him over there until I was told by my parents that he's just buying up properties at home. When I heard this, I felt cheated and that was when I opened up to my parents and that's what prompted my mum telling me that,

“Not everyone that you help will pay you back, just continue doing good to all and in due time, you will reap your reward.”

To cut the long story short, I have been rewarded for my good deeds as bro. Segun who accommodated me years back has helped me process my travelling and I'm now where Ade believed I would not get to, but I'm not actually angry with him as God has also helped me too.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Living Inside My Head. LOH#289
body.body: > If late if I am being really honest with myself, the main thing that makes me feel like I’m doing too much is not even physical work… it is definitely overthinking, and when I say overthinking, I don’t mean small small thinking oh, I mean the kind that carries everything on its head and refuses to drop it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWxP3rA9MQsi6PyimL2x4b95WP3veGc54ytBqQ2TCTXC9/1779140856473.jpg) It is actually exhausting, Because tell me why I can have one simple conversation with someone and then replay it in my head like ten different times, I will start asking myself questions like, “ Did I say the right thing? Did they misunderstand me? Should I have just kept quiet? and before I know it, something that lasted five minutes is now taking up hours in my head. That alone can drain somebody, and the annoying part is that it is not something I even plan to do, It just happens, my mind will just pick one small situation and stretch it like elastic until it becomes something way bigger than it actually is, Sometimes I even start creating scenarios that have not even happened, like preparing for problems that might not even exist. It makes everything feel heavier than it should be, even when nothing serious is going on, my mind will still find something to hold on to, If it is not about something I said, it is about something I didn’t say,If it’s not about now, it is about the future, If it’s not about the future, it is about something that already happened that I can’t even change again. So at that point, it starts to feel like I’m doing too much… but it’s all in my head, And that is the scary part. Because physically, I might just be sitting down, doing nothing stressful, but mentally i am carrying like ten different loads at the same time. It’s like my brain refuses to rest, even when I try to distract myself, it will still find its way back to those same thoughts. I have realized that overthinking is one of those things that makes you forget your limits, you don’t even know when to stop because it does not look like work, but it drains you like actual work, and before you know it, you are tired, irritated, and mentally checked out all because of thoughts. Sometimes I wish I could just switch my mind off for a bit, but I am also starting to understand that maybe the answer is not to completely stop thinking because is that even possible?, but to learn how to slow it down, to remind myself that not everything needs deep analysis. Some things can just be what they are. I’m still figuring that part out, honestly,, but one thing I know for sure is this: overthinking will make you feel like you don’t have enough time, not because time is actually short, but because your mind is too full, and right now, that’s exactly where I am… just trying to clear some space in my head so I can breathe small. Image Is Mine ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

# <center><u>**💚🌟PEACE BE UPON YOU ALL💚🌟**</u></center>

<center><u>**Welcome Back to @alive.chat Monday Challenge. Let’s share our goals, track our progress, and support each other.**</u></center>

<center>
![](https://media.tenor.com/Me82v-d-XDIAAAAC/welcome-back-wb.gif)
</center> 

I hope you are all doing great, healthy, and well. I’m happy to have you here and warmly welcome you all.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)
</center>

You already know the purpose of this activity is simple: to share our goals, share our progress, and try to support each other in achieving them.

Everyone has goals, and the journey is not always easy. Here, we can motivate one another, learn from each other, and grow together. There is no pressure, just honest sharing, encouragement, and positive energy.

Feel free to share your goals, update your progress, and engage with others because when we support one another, success becomes more achievable for all.

<center>**<u>We are alive, we are growing, and we are moving forward together. 💪✨</u>**</center>

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

# <center><u>**Challenge Task and Rules.**</u></center> 

<center>**<u>Kindly read the rules before participating in the challenge activity. You must follow all the rules mentioned below to be eligible for the Prizes.</u>**</center>

1. To be eligible, each participant must **<u>share their weekly, monthly, or yearly goals (whether posted or not) in the comments section, along with their progress during the week.</u>**

2. **<u>Sharing your weekly progress is an important part of this activity.</u>**
Please remember to include your progress along with your goals; without it, your entry won’t be eligible for the challenge.   
This requirement does not apply to first-time participants only.

3. <u>**Increased the time duration:**</u> This challenge will remain open for **<u>more than 48 hours, until Wednesday at 11:59 PM UTC</u>**.

4. We will post the participant list and the raffle results (if there are more than five participants) for last week’s challenge in the next post.

5. **<u>Using #alive tag is mandatory, addittionally you can use #aliveandthriving, and #AliveChat tags in your posts.</u>** 

6. Feel free to share your post and receive upvotes from the community.

7. **<u>It’s not mandatory, but we really appreciate it if you reblog the post and tag your friends in your posts and comments.</u>**

8. **<u>Engage with other participants and community members; don't forget the purpose of this activity is to encourage and support each other.</u>**

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SiJNYXS5WrkQGHwUTqc8ovYW5dnPFQJstbWui91WWNjsSipwyPyZ5ZEqXFc6gRK.jpg)</center>

# <center><u>**Special Thanks**</u></center>

Very special thanks to @benthomaswwd for donating 10K HEARTBEAT for the prize pool. And because of his generosity, now participants and winners are also receiving HEARTBEAT Tokens, along with other Tokens.
Don't forget to participate in the daily activity that he hosts on @heartbeatonhive for more fun and rewards.

body.title: Una Maravilla con Remolacha [Spn/Eng]
body.body:
>Maravillosa semana llena de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

\n\n

>Cada día nos llegan ideas de cómo utilizar los vegetales, no solo como comida salada sino también como dulces para una tarde entretenida de disfrutar un delicioso café uniendo una maravilla creada con vegetales sin azúcares agregados, solo el dulce natural de cada uno de los ingredientes utilizados.

\n\n

>El plátano, se le conoce como plátano macho, tiene sus encantos para nuestro cuerpo además de la energía que nos provee, presenta otras bondades.

\n\n

>La remolacha utilizada en ensaladas cocida o cruda, también aporta innumerables de vitaminas para fortalecer nuestro cuerpo físico.

\n\n

>La manzana en esta caso se utiliza la roja, también nos muestra sus encantos de cualquier forma como se usa.

\n\n

>Entre vegetales y frutas, agregando otros ingredientes que también tienen sus beneficios bien fundamentados se creó, se probó esta maravilla con remolacha.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/752/752004ewor3ue4oi.webp

> Para esta creación se utilizó 1 plátano maduro pequeño (el plátano con la cáscara con más espacios negros) 1 remolacha pequeña 1 manzana roja 3 huevos ¼ de aceite vegetal 29 gramos de cacao
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/752/752004ewor3ue4oi.webp

>Quitamos la cascara del plata y lo cortamos en pequeños pedazos.

\n\n

>La remolacha se manipula de igual forma (sin cáscara, cortada en pequeños pedazos).

\n\n
>La manzana sólo bien lavada, quitar el centro, dejar la cáscara, cortar en pequeños pedazos.

>Se lleva a la licuadora todo lo que ya cortamos, incorporamos los huevos, el aceite, batimos por unos tres minutos aproximadamente, colocamos el cacao, volvemos a licuar, esta vez un minuto aproximadamente.

>Al tener la mezcla ya bien licuada, horno precalentado, envase elegido enmantequillado y enharinado, (o como usted suele hacerlo) vertemos la mezcla y la llevamos al horno por espacio de de 33 minutos. Recuerde que cada horno tiene sus características y de acuerdo a esto se elige el grado de calor para hornear, en mi caso de 300 a 350 grados centígrados.
>Ya lista, la prueba del palillo, lo hice varias veces, hasta que salió muy limpio. Dejar reposar, colocar en una bandeja y disfrutar de su encanto.

>

>Have a wonderful week filled with health, energy, amazing ideas, and magic. May it be a week of connection with your inner self and great enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

>Every day we receive ideas on how to use vegetables, not only in savory dishes but also in sweet treats for a delightful afternoon enjoying a delicious coffee. This treat combines vegetables with no added sugar, just the natural sweetness of each ingredient.

\n\n

>The plantain, also known as the banana, has many benefits for our bodies. Besides the energy it provides, it offers other advantages.

\n\n

>Beets, used in salads, cooked or raw, also provide countless vitamins to strengthen our bodies. The apple, in this case a red one, also reveals its charms in any form.

\n\n

>From vegetables and fruits, along with other ingredients that also have well-established benefits, this red marvel was created and tested.

For this recipe, we used: 1 small ripe banana (the banana with the peel that has the most black spots) 1 small beet 1 red apple 3 eggs ¼ cup vegetable oil 29 grams cocoa powder We proceeded as follows: Peel the banana and cut it into small pieces.

>Prepare the beet in the same way (peeled and cut into small pieces).

\n\n

>Wash the apple well, remove the core, leave the peel on, and cut into small pieces.

\n\n

>Place all the chopped ingredients in a blender, add the eggs and oil, and blend for about three minutes. Add the cocoa powder and blend again for about one minute.

\n\n

>Once the mixture is well blended, preheat the oven, grease and flour the chosen baking dish, pour in the mixture, and bake for 33 minutes. Remember that every oven has its own characteristics, and you should choose the baking temperature accordingly. In my case, it's between 300 and 350 degrees Celsius. body.title: Why Quix the Devious is my favorite summoner in Wild Format
body.body: > In the wild format, there is a large group of Summoners who played a vital role in your strategies whether the arena is hot or at normal temperature. If you have the change to cross the Gold I league barrier in Wild format you will see the difference between a normal battlefield and the heated arena. Here is the perfect moment when Quix a dragon summoner can build a perfect team to destroy the enemy regardless of the level of experience on the opposite side of the board. This season has resumed with a lot of great opportunities I will share the role Quix played in the making of my team progress.

> ## A:/ Return to the basic My team entered the game in season 96 with interesting ranking. I was in Gold III right after the reset of all account following the season finale. I used to restart from Silver II or III. I think that this situation is an interesting step towards the realization of my plan for the current challenge in the ranking battles space. If you made the math it gets cheaper to rank up to Diamond League if your resume your season in the Gold League. However, it is worth noting the rapid increase of difficulty in the game because of the pool of players who surround me at this stage of the game.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1koCN9CiPZraxn8ehxp1hoXK5mwgaYuuBatNJ8ZZPG2/image.png)
## B:/ Quix in Wild Format, Why not in Modern too? It will be crazy to add Quix in Modern format. The power of this summoner is legendary in Splinterlands. I found this warriors exceptional and easy to level up back when the summoner was released to player. This dragon summoner remains the most utilized commander in my team as considering the Wild format. I don't even know if one day I will be able to play modern cards with Quix in wild format. It will be insane to unlock Oridum at full speed in a gaming area that nobody plays safe. In this first battle you can see the dominance of QUiX.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXkJUZsxvwoJrvMyiXD1fD9exiF8BY6N54YWZT7yUB6cj/image.png)
It was impossible to imagine that this combat was registered in Wild format. [Bat 1](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_b5f9b277cdb3e174e568190ddf188c3f) -- ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6RZUaXdFzMXYKnPTVQucqink1Yc4XERQVmmgtQahzfY/image.png)
I lost in this second combat, but you can see that the low mana game was as challenging as it should be in the arena. [Bat 2](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_5552fd7d15bdb36a8c00aa13cc1e7333) -- ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcLws4cYG2t9pNSSK92DLTCMs85fyvrEW2ke8FBxDZbVs/image.png)
The third battle is a difficult one where the low mana representation of cards around the arena showed the beauty of combat with large representation of warriors. [BAt 3](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_ec93cb0e6b22d041b8a662aa7e421f77) I did not succeed in this combat and lost the game after an intensive combat. My prayer is to return strong this season with Quix as champion. -- --- Current staking of SPS on my account: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpLWBFDTXTDVJQ5L3erwgJSuZXXEk9iUdsf9KdSBLJMD/image.png) If you are a large stake holder of Splintershareds in Splinterlands please let me know if you have a main source of acquisition of SPS from hive engine or another exchange. -- ---

> ## C:/ Maintain the momentum The plan to increase my SPS holding is working so well that you may have seen the rapid progress of my holding for the past seven days
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZDyqjkQKQb29UeoLVvji5XMobDEvcZmkE7GmmfXM92YM/image.png)
I shifted most of my staking in Hive to SPS because it is a project that I love to defend long term and secure influence on the platform Have a cool season gaming and exchanging assets in Splinterlands -- ---

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779140363148-328d50985c2b6385.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=isaacmartiubeda/25944a1c)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=isaacmartiubeda/25944a1c)


---

Hola, ¿cómo están comunidad de Full Deportes? Hoy vengo con mi segundo video sobre un tema que he estado leyendo e investigando. Quería conocer su opinión sobre Neymar y si realmente creen que marcaría una diferencia con Brazil en el Mundial 2026.

En mi opinión, como fanático del fútbol, me gustaría que Neymar tuviera su último Mundial. He seguido sus últimos partidos con Santos FC y he visto que incluso ha disputado encuentros completos de 90 minutos. Se nota que el jugador realmente quiere estar en la lista final del Mundial.

Ahora también me pongo a pensar: si el seleccionador Carlo Ancelotti le hubiera dado una oportunidad en la selección mucho antes, ¿Neymar se habría esforzado igual? Son preguntas interesantes que ustedes también pueden analizar.

Además, me gustaría ver a Brasil llegar lejos en este Mundial, enfrentándose a las mejores selecciones del mundo. Y claro, ver la calidad técnica del brasileño sería un espectáculo. También queda la duda de si Ancelotti lo utilizaría como titular o como un suplente de lujo. Eso solo lo sabremos si Neymar es elegido en la lista final para el Mundial 2026.

Otro punto importante es si la selección actual de Brasil está acostumbrada a jugar con Neymar, ya que últimamente no lo hemos visto mucho con la camiseta de la selección. Aun así, esperemos que pase lo mejor tanto para el futbolista como para Brasil y que puedan dar lo mejor en el torneo.

Neymar tiene visión de juego, creatividad y mucha experiencia. ¿Se imaginan que vuelva a hacer jugadas increíbles y que Brasil sea favorecido por su talento? Ahora solo queda esperar y ver qué sucede.

---
---
---

Hello, how are you Full Deportes community? Today I’m here with my second video about a topic I’ve been reading and researching lately. I wanted to know your opinion about Neymar and whether you really think he could make a difference for Brazil national football team in the 2026 World Cup.

In my opinion, as a football fan, I would like Neymar to have his last World Cup appearance. I’ve been following his latest matches with Santos FC, and I’ve seen him play full 90-minute games. It’s clear that he truly wants to be included in the final World Cup squad.

At the same time, I wonder: if coach Carlo Ancelotti had given him a chance with the national team earlier, would Neymar have worked just as hard? These are interesting questions that you can also think about.

I would also love to see Brazil go far in this World Cup, facing the best teams in the world. And of course, watching Neymar’s technical quality would be a real spectacle. Another big question is whether Ancelotti would use him as a starter or as a super substitute. We will only know that if Neymar is selected for the final 2026 World Cup squad.

Another important point is whether the current Brazil team is used to playing with Neymar, since we haven’t seen him much with the national team lately. Still, let’s hope for the best both for the player and for Brazil, and that they can give their very best in the tournament.

Neymar has vision, creativity, and a lot of experience. Can you imagine him making incredible plays again and helping Brazil succeed? Now all we can do is wait and see what happens.

---

Hola, ¿cómo están comunidad de Full Deportes? Hoy vengo con mi segundo video sobre un tema que he estado leyendo e investigando. Quería conocer su opinión sobre Neymar y si realmente creen que marcaría una diferencia con Brazil en el Mundial 2026.

En mi opinión, como fanático del fútbol, me gustaría que Neymar tuviera su último Mundial. He seguido sus últimos partidos con Santos FC y he visto que incluso ha disputado encuentros completos de 90 minutos. Se nota que el jugador realmente quiere estar en la lista final del Mundial.

Ahora también me pongo a pensar: si el seleccionador Carlo Ancelotti le hubiera dado una oportunidad en la selección mucho antes, ¿Neymar se habría esforzado igual? Son preguntas interesantes que ustedes también pueden analizar.

Además, me gustaría ver a Brasil llegar lejos en este Mundial, enfrentándose a las mejores selecciones del mundo. Y claro, ver la calidad técnica del brasileño sería un espectáculo. También queda la duda de si Ancelotti lo utilizaría como titular o como un suplente de lujo. Eso solo lo sabremos si Neymar es elegido en la lista final para el Mundial 2026.

Otro punto importante es si la selección actual de Brasil está acostumbrada a jugar con Neymar, ya que últimamente no lo hemos visto mucho con la camiseta de la selección. Aun así, esperemos que pase lo mejor tanto para el futbolista como para Brasil y que puedan dar lo mejor en el torneo.

Neymar tiene visión de juego, creatividad y mucha experiencia. ¿Se imaginan que vuelva a hacer jugadas increíbles y que Brasil sea favorecido por su talento? Ahora solo queda esperar y ver qué sucede.

---
---
---

Hello, how are you Full Deportes community? Today I’m here with my second video about a topic I’ve been reading and researching lately. I wanted to know your opinion about Neymar and whether you really think he could make a difference for Brazil national football team in the 2026 World Cup.

In my opinion, as a football fan, I would like Neymar to have his last World Cup appearance. I’ve been following his latest matches with Santos FC, and I’ve seen him play full 90-minute games. It’s clear that he truly wants to be included in the final World Cup squad.

At the same time, I wonder: if coach Carlo Ancelotti had given him a chance with the national team earlier, would Neymar have worked just as hard? These are interesting questions that you can also think about.

I would also love to see Brazil go far in this World Cup, facing the best teams in the world. And of course, watching Neymar’s technical quality would be a real spectacle. Another big question is whether Ancelotti would use him as a starter or as a super substitute. We will only know that if Neymar is selected for the final 2026 World Cup squad.

Another important point is whether the current Brazil team is used to playing with Neymar, since we haven’t seen him much with the national team lately. Still, let’s hope for the best both for the player and for Brazil, and that they can give their very best in the tournament.

Neymar has vision, creativity, and a lot of experience. Can you imagine him making incredible plays again and helping Brazil succeed? Now all we can do is wait and see what happens.

description.title: Grandpa interview
description.body:
![3E7C2A2A-9100-4EDD-A85D-D967BA09BF92.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23wqnrg26uMKfmBTHLM1EfTja6ah42ZuKE2YN1YGNjtBrRdag4kWLVGGn89GLxiu7oVxn.jpeg)
***

Today I hosted an interview directed by me and my team members. This interview was hosted as a premise to our market research and eventual evaluation and propagation of a popular food vendor in our campus. The interview hosted is as follows:

How many customers do you get in day?

Grandpa: I don’t count them

Grandpas customers aren’t particularly consistent. Some may not be the same customers that come the next day.  Customers also vary in their food choices “one may pick sausage, or one beef or egg just like that”. 

What are your busiest days?

Grandpa: our busiest days are not stable.

Grandpa tells us again that customers aren’t reliably situated and don’t typically buy from him at times when free food services at campus can be spontaneous or on Sundays when students parents will visit them and may give food to their friends as well.

What time do you open?

Grandpa: 4pm.

Like most outside food vendors situated and approved by SBU (student business unit), his food service opens by 4pm in the evening. Not much of a surprise.

Do you have a menu for your customers 

Grandpa: potatoe chips, mashed potatoes chips, fried yam, gizzard, round fish sausage, boiled egg, beef and egg sauce.

Grandpas food menu is a stable approved by SBU (student business unit). They are not allowed to sell any other thing unless it’s approved and documented by the management.

Any social media you use to advertise your business?

Grandpa: I have telegram and instagram.

Grandpas social media outlets are pretty trivial. It seems like it’s not really a leverage he optimally makes use of consciously to further his business. So advertising hasn’t really been his go-to.

Do you feel like there’s something we can help you with for your business?

Grandpa: if you have any suggestions please share with us.

Grandpa is open to suggestions and recommendations.

Have students given you any feedback concerning your business?

Grandpa: yes they give me positive feedback. Maybe sometimes people may have  more than they ordered. Apart from that nothing else

Grandpas feedback is good and complaints aren’t typical if at all. Maybe a few mistakes may occur on grandpas part. When selling food he may give a customer more then they opted for. For example instead of giving customers two sausages he may accidentally give them three. Or he may give them one instead of two. If that happens the student usually comes right back and grandpa will give him what he forgets to right away.

Do you face any challenges?

Grandpa: maybe weather interruptions can interfere with the business. We abide by the school rules so we don’t typically have any challenges really.

There aren’t many challenges when it comes to grandpas business. The only unchangeable inconvenience he may face are weather interferences. Apart from that since they follow the rules of the management they don’t run into any challenges or issues.

What makes your brand stand out ? 

Grandpa: I don’t really know. 

Grandpa isn’t really keen on promoting his brand in a way that’s inviting or appealing. At most his efforts to do such was picking a brand name that was some what interesting which he called “grandpas chips”. Besides from that his creative approach to making his brand unique was sub-par.

How do you navigate yourself when it comes to food hygiene?

Grandpa: I don’t joke with that. We tidy up everywhere and make sure we’re neat. Personally what we’re prepare myself to eat must be clean. If I know what I eat has the slightest bit of dirt I won’t eat it. The food I sell  to others I treat it like it’s my own food and make sure it’s hygienic. What I cannot give to myself and give to others

Grandpa makes sure the food hygiene of the food he sells is very clean. He treats the food he sells as his own and does not like the idea of food hygiene being sub standard and encourages others to do the same. 

Are you planning to add new menu items or anything that your planning to add? 

Grandpa: i don’t think I have as of now. If there’s anything I want to add I still have to meet the management to approve it. I’m also not planning to add anything to our menu.

Food variety and expansion depends on SBU approval. So his choice to immediately introduce new foods are fragile if not properly evaluated by SBU management.

description.title: [ESP/ENG]/Transformando un Cuaderno Viejo en un Álbum de Recuerdos Playeros 📓🌊 / Upcycling: Transforming an Old Notebook into a Beach Memory Album
description.body:
> ![1000273112.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPG5ycc2PLyoCpuuJnDJ8Qxrba8NT6p1xyNJRaf9BJdok/1000273112.png) ¡Hola, queridos amigos creativos! Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes un proyecto muy especial basado en el **upcycling** o reciclaje creativo. Tenía en casa un cuaderno viejo con espirales que ya se había quedado sin hojas, y en lugar de desecharlo, decidí darle una segunda vida transformándolo en un álbum de recortes (*Scrapbook*) para inmortalizar mis recuerdos del mar 🌊. Les confieso un pequeño detalle, estaba tan entusiasmada y concentrada al iniciar el proyecto que **olvidé tomar la foto de los materiales** 🙈. Sin embargo, el proceso es tan lindo, sencillo y económico que quise documentarlo de igual manera. Esta es una propuesta base, la estructura es simple para que cada persona pueda adaptarla y decorarla a su gusto personal. ¡Espero que les guste la idea! *Hello, my dear creative friends! Today I want to share with you a very special project based on **upcycling** or creative recycling. I had an old spiral notebook at home that was completely empty, and instead of throwing it away, I decided to give it a second life by transforming it into a scrapbook to immortalize my memories of the sea 🌊. I'll confess a little detail: I was so excited and focused when I started the project that I **forgot to take a picture of the materials** 🙈. However, the process is so lovely, simple, and inexpensive that I wanted to document it anyway. This is a basic design; the structure is simple so that everyone can adapt and decorate it to their personal taste. I hope you like the idea!*
--- ## 🛠️ Materiales Utilizados / Materials Used | Español | English | | :--- | :--- | | • Un cuaderno viejo con espiral (sin hojas) | • An old spiral notebook (without pages) | | • Cartulinas de tres colores diferentes | • Cardstock in three different colors | | • Hojas blancas (para el interior y las letras) | • White sheets (for the inside and letters) | | • Marcador o rotulador fucsia | • Fuchsia marker or pen | | • Silicón líquido y tijeras | • Liquid silicone and scissors | | • Lápiz y regla | • Pencil and ruler |
--- ## 📸 Proceso de Elaboración / Elaborating Process ### **Paso 1: El cuaderno antes / Step 1:The notebook before**
![1000273134.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY4mVgdnWyZiZMNUdUi8hKw9rkSU9EK6VXhN7LXnEErva/1000273134.jpg)

> Como pueden ver en la imagen, las tapas originales que tenía este cuaderno estaban bastante desgastadas y ya no tenían ninguna utilidad, eso parece 🧐. El primer paso fue rescatarlas para trabajar en su estética exterior y devolverles la vida. *As you can see in the picture, the original covers of this notebook were quite worn and no longer useful, it seems 🧐. The first step was to rescue them, work on their exterior appearance, and give them a new lease on life.* --- ### **Paso 2: Medición con regla / Step 2: Measuring with a ruler**
![1000273135.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKTPjHhhGu7JjaXJQBCFiStuqzzYFoZ5FRYYYeELhZoP/1000273135.jpg)

> Utilicé una regla para medir con precisión los bordes de la tapa sobre la cartulina morada. Calcular bien los espacios antes de realizar los cortes es fundamental para que el acabado final quede exacto. *I used a ruler to accurately measure the edges of the cover on the purple cardstock. Calculating the spaces well before making the cuts is fundamental so that the final finish is exact and without imperfections.* --- ### **Paso 3: Preparando las bases de color / Step 3: Preparing the colored bases**
![1000272651.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQeVx83n18qY1XDP9ho16t9yuUfiMSoaxzwwZYFQ5xtYh/1000272651.jpg)

> Una vez tomadas las medidas, procedí a cortar los rectángulos de cartulina. Aquí pueden ver la primera pieza de color morado completamente lista y con bordes limpios. *Once I had taken the measurements, I proceeded to cut the cardboard rectangles. Here you can see the first piece, in purple, completely finished and with clean edges.* --- ### **Paso 4: Cortes simétricos para ambas tapas / Step 4: Symmetrical cuts for both covers**
![1000272658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma18F7f15FtpyMv7xRmZwSM7RZZmc9SgQd8UZEAssjzHm/1000272658.jpg)

> Para asegurar la simetría de nuestro álbum, repetí el proceso de corte para obtener las dos franjas moradas principales.Tambien la otra tapa lleva dos franjas moradas *To ensure the symmetry of our album, I repeated the cutting process to obtain the two main purple stripes. The other cover also has two purple stripes.* --- ### **Paso 5: Presentación de la paleta de colores / Step 5: Displaying the color palette**
![1000272660.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVfyi6z5JxZh8vkM4fsP5mUZ6P682skkroLbpTNz1ZGT7/1000272660.jpg)

> Dispuse las piezas juntas de forma horizontal para verificar la combinación. *I arranged the pieces together horizontally to verify the combination.* --- ### **Paso 6:Ensamblaje / Step 6: Assembly**
![1000273136.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmekDAqLdUCiVprbpwGZbdoYnqdwoxGvhpckXTogtct5xW/1000273136.jpg)

> Utilizando silicón líquido, comencé a aplicar el pegamento directamente sobre el borde de la tapa vieja de cartón. Fui colocando la primera franja morada con mucho cuidadito *Using liquid silicone, I began applying the glue directly to the edge of the old cardboard lid. I carefully placed the first purple stripe.* --- ### **Paso 7: Combinando los bloques de color / Step 7: Combining the color blocks**
![1000272663.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPe2G1yom44Jerp7zjVSj5jrq2USzH4bUXybPKas9KvZx/1000272663.jpg)

> Continué aplicando silicón líquido para unir el bloque de color rosado justo sobre la franja morada. Es fundamental cuidar la unión entre ambos papeles para que no queden espacios vacíos. *I continued applying liquid silicone to join the pink block directly over the purple stripe. It's crucial to ensure a smooth seam between the two papers to avoid any gaps.* --- ### **Paso 8: Estructura de color completada / Step 8: Completed color structure**
![1000272671.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaBqrcr7EkEkPAjJ2KsCgFqvFqFz87JYN5efZcZEtQ2K9/1000272671.jpg)

> Y aquí ya se puede ver completamente ensamblada cada parte de las líneas de la cartulina. Las secciones de cartulina se unieron de manera que los colores combinaran, combinando el morado, rosado y amarillo de forma equilibrada, cubriendo por completo la desgastada superficie del cuaderno. *And here you can see each part of the cardboard lines fully assembled. The cardboard sections were joined in such a way that the colors matched, combining purple, pink, and yellow in a balanced way, completely covering the worn surface of the notebook.* --- ### **Paso 9: Perforación de las tapas / Step 9: Punching the covers**
![1000273138.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEgX2Qh8LjUiSgnRpnz6ZWJYEQrbNCC5NGS7UF2YH2Yn/1000273138.jpg)

> Con mucha paciencia, marqué y abrí cada uno de los agujeros en las cartulinas nuevas, guiándome de manera exacta por los orificios originales de las tapas de cartón. *With great patience, I marked and opened each of the holes in the new cardboard, guiding myself exactly by the original holes in the cardboard covers.* --- ### **Paso 10: Marcado de las hojas internas / Step 10: Marking the inner sheets**
![1000273139.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcBipfKdhwfuePAfCSt6CiJvugwZKsemkYjPzjFdpBSXG/1000273139.jpg)

> Tomé hojas blancas y las medí para cortarlas al del tamaño del cuaderno. Luego, utilizando un lápiz, marqué con cuidado la línea guía y los puntos donde irían los orificios para asegurar que todas las páginas queden alineadas al espiral. *I took blank sheets of paper and measured them to cut them to the size of the notebook. Then, using a pencil, I carefully marked the guide line and the points where the holes would go to ensure that all the pages would be aligned with the spiral.* --- ### **Paso 11: Ensamblaje parte interno / Step 11: Internal assembly**
![1000273140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8MChQqX2vqjykb7XQqVBwWa7gg8QZFafEVTs7TTGnfF/1000273140.jpg)

> Con mucho cuidado, fui colocando las hojas a través de los anillos del resorte, asegurándome de incorporar también la otra tapa de forma ordenada. *Very carefully, I placed the sheets through the spring rings, making sure to also incorporate the other cover in an orderly fashion.* --- ### **Paso 12: Cierre de la libreta / Step 12: Closing the notebook**
![1000272695.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmct6Y6Fq5xYgSLyo25wYYyrwPhtW1RFn8XiQwwezYg4Dc/1000272695.jpg)

> Coloque la otra tapa del cuaderno y cerré bien el resolte,ya así de por si se ve muy bien,ya no se ve igual a como estaba. *I put the other cover of the notebook on and closed the spring well; it already looks very good like this, it doesn't look the same as it was before.* --- ### **Paso 13: Diseño del título / Step 13: Title design**
![1000273141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaXDzqDucqQajxY1fntFnGq6EZ14DfnbAYL8TTeLVAL8i/1000273141.jpg)
>\n\nDibujé cada una de las letras de la palabra \
de forma individual sobre papel blanco y las recorté con cuidado. Luego, utilizando un marcador fucsia, delineé los contornos para añadirles.\n\n*I drew each letter of the word \

individually on white paper and carefully cut them out. Then, using a fuchsia marker, I outlined the letters to add to them.* --- ### **Paso 14: Decoración final de la portada / Step 14: Final decoration of the cover**
![1000273142.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRQChgU2CDaKmb2zXsZAD1N7TzmgpzVjKJrE3qywRBWFW/1000273142.jpg)

. Estos triángulos actúan como esquineros seguros fijados en los extremos opuestos de la página interna para deslizar las fotos sin dañarlas.\n\n*To make the inside interactive, I used white paper to make two pieces with a fold similar to the \

. These triangles act as secure corners fixed on opposite ends of the internal page to slide the photos without damaging them.*

Como pueden observar, encaja bien y se sostiene firmemente en la hoja blanca sin necesidad de aplicar pegamento directo sobre el recuerdo, lo cual permite proteger la imagen y cambiarla cuando lo desee. Aunque inicialmente partimos de un procedimiento sencillo, considero que esta es una excelente **idea base** para proyectos de bitácoras o álbumes de recortes. Lo hermoso del *Scrapbooking* y el *Upcycling* es que la decoración final queda abierta al gusto y la creatividad personal de cada quien, se le pueden añadir dibujos, stickers, conchitas de mar o frases inspiradoras según las vivencias de cada viaje. Thank you so much for reading about my entire creative process and joining me step by step! 😊 I hope it inspires you to give a second life to those old notebooks you have at home. 👋See you in the next creative project 🏖️📓* ---

description.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 18 2026
description.body:
Hello, everyone, and happy Monday! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/782ae392-2f1b-40aa-b09c-afce7e080863.jpg) ​I hope you all had a wonderful weekend. Today is Monday, May 18, 2026, and I decided to kick off the new week with plenty of energy and a brand new outdoor adventure. Mondays can sometimes feel a bit sluggish, but there is no better cure for the Monday blues than getting out into nature. Today, my fitness journey took me to the breathtaking grounds of Richmond Park, and I am thrilled to report that I smashed my goals, locking in an impressive 12,174 steps on my Actifit tracker! ​Richmond Park is renowned for its vast, wide open spaces, ancient trees, and peaceful atmosphere. Walking here always feels like a mini escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The weather today was absolutely ideal for a long trek mild, slightly overcast, but with beautiful soft light filtering through the trees. ​As I walked along the pedestrian paths, I was surrounded by vibrant green hills and the peaceful sounds of nature. Richmond Park is a massive hub for outdoor enthusiasts, and today the roads were buzzing with cyclists testing their endurance on the park's famous undulating hills. Watching them pedal past against the backdrop of lush greenery and open skies added a wonderful, active energy to my own walk. It inspired me to push a little harder and extend my route just a bit further. ​What I love most about walking in a place like this is how easily the steps accumulate. When you are busy admiring the landscape, watching the deer in the distance, or simply enjoying the fresh air, you completely forget that you are working out. Before I knew it, my tracker was buzzing to let me know I had cleared my daily targets. ​Looking at my Actifit dashboard for today, my activity graph shows a very consistent and solid block of movement starting from the late morning through the afternoon, with a fantastic peak right in the middle of my park exploration. Closing that bright green activity ring completely on a Monday evening gives me a massive sense of accomplishment and sets a wonderful, healthy tone for the rest of the week. ​Days like today prove that consistency is key, and finding a beautiful location to stay active makes all the difference in the world. It keeps the routine exciting and gives me something to look forward to every single day.

description.title: HIVEMIND Update: Bug Fixes, Solo Play with Bots & High-Ping Feel Improvements
description.body:
![Screenshot_20260518_222919.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cadawg/Eo43tkFC2xh82yKGgdxdPvhymvTd9YQ4nGNc3CcQkjBMTJGrEnPfZurZdd35rDPncU7.png)


Since launch, I've been focused on stability and accessibility. Today's update addresses critical bugs, introduces **bot opponents** for solo play, and dramatically improves the feel of the game—even at relatively low latencies like 20ms.

## What's Fixed

### Workshop & Scrap Management
- **Scrap count now displays correctly** when opening the workshop, instead of showing 0 until your first action
- **Scrapped posts are immediately removed from your deck** so you can't accidentally play with destroyed weapons
- **Safeguard added**: Old saved decks are automatically cleaned of scrapped posts when loaded, preventing edge cases from lingering damage

## New: Solo Play with a Second Player Bot

With only one match since launch, I needed to make the game accessible to solo players. **If you're alone in the lobby, a bot joins as a second player after 10 seconds**, so you can start your match.

This is a **one-time exception** - bots are normally not allowed in HIVEMIND. This bot exists only to let you try the game without waiting for another player. Ideally it'll be removed once there's enough of a playerbase for organic games.

### How the Bot Works

The bot uses the **same mechanics as human players**:
- Same weapon types, damage calculations, and RPS interactions
- Lets posts wear down to 50% durability before fixing them, a suboptimal strategy that gives you a slight edge if you play smarter
- Consistent, predictable opponent so you can practice and learn matchups
- **Fair latency handicap**: Bot experiences a 50ms firing delay, simulating network latency so it doesn't have instant-reflex advantage over real players

I am aiming to make it as good as the average player - I'm waiting to see how it goes and can tune it if it's over or underpowered. It contributes to the reward pool like everyone else via my account so it remains fair.

### Session Resumption

Disconnect from the server? No problem. Your **session token lasts 30 minutes**, so you can reconnect without re-authenticating via Keychain. If the server restarts, you can still use your token to get back in the game—perfect for handling unexpected downtime or a quick bathroom break during a match.

## New: High-Ping Feel Improvements

I noticed the game felt sluggish even at 20ms latency. I rebuilt the networking layer with intelligent prediction and extrapolation:

### How It Works

- **Local player prediction**: Your movement is predicted locally using the same physics as the server, so you feel instant response to input. The server quietly confirms your position and smoothly corrects if needed.
- **Remote player velocity extrapolation**: Instead of opponents teleporting between snapshots, I now send their velocity with each update. Opponents smoothly glide to the correct position, even on 10Hz snapshots.
- **Ghost projectiles**: When you fire, the projectile appears on your screen immediately. The server confirms it on the next snapshot. If there's any discrepancy, the ghost vanishes and the server's version takes over seamlessly.
- **Server-side latency compensation**: The server measures your round-trip time (via WebSocket ping/pong) and advances projectiles forward by your estimated latency. This means your shots land where you aimed, not where you aimed several frames ago.

The result: **the game feels responsive and fair at any latency**. Movement is instant, remote players flow smoothly, and projectiles behave consistently with what you see on screen.

## Why This Matters

HIVEMIND's core mechanic - **your actual Hive posts as weapons** - only shines when you're playing. Bot matches let you:
- Test deck compositions without waiting for lobbies
- Learn weapon matchups and RPS dynamics
- Build your arsenal and experiment with repairs
- Understand how post stats affect combat

Once there is a playerbase, human matches will be the main event. Bots are the on-ramp.

---

**Play now:** [arena.hive.uno](https://arena.hive.uno)

Have feedback? Find a bug? Drop it in replies.

description.body:
# ‘84 Olympics ufo — Control Alt History

**Source:** https://www.control-alt-history.com/articles/84-olympics-alien

HIGH STRANGENESSWhere does one even begin to analyze this event? Well, for starters, I hate to break anyone’s bubble, but it’s highly doubtful that the spaceship or the alien were real.  Hollywood producer David Wolper is the man credited with producing the ’84 ceremonies. In a 2009 article for The LA Times, he described in detail how they put together the finale featuring the UFO.  Former Disney amusement ride designer Bob Gurr is credited with creating the UFO, and he described the process in a 2004 article. The story they tell is that the UFO was made in a factory in California, then suspended over the Rose Bowl by a cable attached to a military helicopter, which was difficult to see against the night sky. Their stories seem detailed enough to make this a believable explanation. Of course, you can take their words with a grain of salt, if you want to. People lie all the time. Especially Hollywood producers. And Disney is one of the shadiest companies in the world, so you’d be perfectly justified in being skeptical of what anyone associated with Disney says. So…you can believe them or not. There have been people over the years who’ve claimed the UFO was flying under its own power. But the explanations given by Wolper and Gurr are detailed enough to support the idea of the UFO being built in a factory, then carried by a helicopter as if hovered over the Rose Bowl. Oh, and about that alien. In a recent interview, basketball player (and tallest man in the USA) George Bell said that he was the person in the alien costume.

body.title: [EN/PT-BR] Thoughtful: key points to continue
body.body:
>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23yTWtmzoP13GK9v7jtKpHZkHcxHpN64VEvpFKvMbwKqJ4vkv4ZhhLCqxknqwMrh5wtch.png)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/homem-em-jaqueta-preta-e-chapeu-marrom-pescando-no-rio-durante-o-dia-462iMQiH32g)
![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg) Today I don't have much to say, just that we are in a moment that, from what I see, is still complicated for everyone. Whether it's with Hive or the general cryptocurrency environment, it seems like interest is waning, well at least mine is. Apart from a few posts about Horizon Forge, I'm pretty much out of ideas for posts. I haven't been able to participate much in Hive's daily life, I still talk to some friends here, I join Discord, but, I don't know, things are strange. Still, as usual, we need to stay positive. Will things get better? Maybe yes, maybe no, but we need that, to believe that a better time will come. A lot of things are being accelerated with AI, who knows, maybe with this we can even change the way we use Hive? I believe that creating accounts and managing keys is the most complicated part of attracting new users. Of course, the price is also not attractive, because many people don't understand that entering with a low value is the best, thus creating low equity at the moment, but what about in the future if everything goes well? Well, whoever believes from beginning to end will definitely do very well. I've already started thinking about more things, more projects, but I need to take it easy, one step at a time (another thing I always think about) take it slowly so that things flow, in a good vibe, so I believe that by controlling expectations, things can flow better. *Positive thinking, hard work, not giving up and believing in a better future are key points to continue.* ![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23yTWtmzoP13GK9v7jtKpHZkHcxHpN64VEvpFKvMbwKqJ4vkv4ZhhLCqxknqwMrh5wtch.png)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/homem-em-jaqueta-preta-e-chapeu-marrom-pescando-no-rio-durante-o-dia-462iMQiH32g)
![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg) Hoje não tenho muito a dizer, apenas que estamos em um momento que pelo o que vejo, ainda complicado para todos. Seja com a Hive ou no ambiente geral de criptomoedas, parece que o interesse está diminuindo, bem, pelo menos o meu está. Tirado alguns posts sobre o Horizon Forge, estou praticamente sem ideias para postar. Não tenho conseguido participar muito do dia a dia da Hive, ainda falo com alguns amigos daqui, entro no Discord, mas, sei lá, está estranho as coisas. Mesmo assim, como de costume, precisamos manter o pensamento positivo. As coisas vão melhorar? Talvez sim, talvez não, mas precisamos disso, acreditar que um momento melhor irá chegar. Muita coisa está sendo acelerada com a IA, quem sabe com isso conseguimos mudar até mesmo a forma de utilizar a Hive? Acredito que a criação de contas e o manejo das chaves seja o mais complicado para atrair novos usuários, claro que o preço também a principal não é chamativo, porque muita gente não entende que entrar com o valor baixo é o melhor, assim, cria um patrimônio baixo no momento, mas e no futuro se tudo der certo? Bem, quem acreditar do começo ao fim, com certeza vai se dar muito bem. Eu já comecei a pensar em mais coisas, mais projetos, mas preciso ir com calma, um passo de cada vez (outra coisa que sempre penso) ir devagar para que as coisas fluam, em uma good vibe, assim acredito que controlando as expectativas, as coisas podem fluir melhor. *Pensamento positivo, trabalho duro, não desistir e acreditar em um futuro melhor, são pontos chaves para continuar.* ![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)
