body.title: Longing for the sky - Last Week's Favorites
body.body: > I'm grateful last week is over. Not sure about how this week will be, but hopefully not worse. There were many moments that I just looked up into the sky to find some solace in the endless. There wasn't much. Although, now in retrospective, maybe there was. ![IMG_20260513_180304156_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Ep1WSMo2TSb4RrYSkNv6LsTy9YTGxcgw2KCdi9X3jbA23KKbCVTU5vswq574bV9ro29.jpg) Lily's mom is becoming more brazen with her lies about me, using words like harassment and abuse - not only from my side, but from basically everyone. And there's nothing I can do about that. I can't proof that it never happened. Nobody can proof a negative. But it doesn't matter. The first reaction of many people is to believe that, because too many times it wasn't believed, and women and children ended up dead because of it. I know why the legal system has gone to the other extreme. But it still hurts to see the attitude towards me change immediately, without any need of proof. ![IMG_20260512_061222161_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EpQvGin61jpukBfi2gy9xSPSHsq2z7CbEAK4JbDLAr14LnKBj29W5VYK3tSpz85u84A.jpg) I have to wait for a hearing to be able to defend myself. And what I do have proof is of her abuse against me, the blackmailing, the manipulation using Lily to hurt me. And a lot of people who were with me and saw how calm I reacted when she was insulting me or (verbally) attacking me otherwise. Because it did happen quite often. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://usermedia.actifit.io/974e9a25-32a0-4e26-afb5-8f008c36f94e.jpg It's the patience that I need that is incredibly hard to keep up. Keeping my calm in the face of something so unfair - not that much against me, that I can handle somewhat well by now, but against Lily. Having trust as only weapon, trust that she will see through the lies that she's probably being fed. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://usermedia.actifit.io/2f67d2fd-ec45-425c-a7a8-0f15dbe32aa2.jpg So, what's the good? The rising dramatics in her lies could be a sign of getting nervous. Because it's several contact calls that she got from institutions by now. And it's not going to stop. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://usermedia.actifit.io/1f32facd-7f1b-4be7-9607-0f5dfa2ba05c.jpg And then, the cat. Nero ate poison a week ago and was in hospital for 8 days, piling up a juicy bill of $670. Minimum wage in Ecuador is $480 for a full time job. Even for me, $670 is not pocket money but eats into my savings. Which it didn't have to, thanks to Nero and my community stepping in. The little bugger has made a lot of friends in the back patio of Subs, where he likes to linger during the day and scrounge fries or chicken. People love him, and gladly helped to cover the bill, so it became manageable for me. ![IMG_20260517_162757925_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Ep3cq8SapKjNjsEoo5Loo4ZrbCksvy2ndsdEWVDj4DWKmRBWoCBAG17atGW1RLLiyXM.jpg) Tomorrow they're going to pull his feeding tube out, and then he can go out into the garden again. He really, really wants that. His possible demise hit me hard, and opened up the floodgates from all the tensions that I've been carrying around with the Lily situation. I did cry because of that before, but last week? Oh boy. ![IMG_20260513_082414078_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqUcTrk1n6atq5srFUHdtK2mMfufW3GkgBRuQ3CrSHkfQiJDGMRnFrpeuroN5sbv9cm.jpg) It didn't help that I was also somewhat sick, still am. Exhausted, maybe, it's not that much of a cold anymore. I have to rest, but I don't feel like it. I want to get things done quickly, as always. And I'm moving forward on many projects, making great progress. Just not writing as much as I'd like, but the diary on my @beelshops account is at least something. ![IMG_20260513_174911100_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqBbhqwZqEBqk2yP12wMd2bTEQityTVrUpe436S1JEPp2d8VE728qDBBEnyMCj9cceV.jpg) Might be being tired today as well. The cat is a night reveler, so I woke up several times from weird noises, mainly the cat either eating or pooping or cleaning itself. And of course it took several naps, for which it jumped on my bed and made himself comfortable right where he would wake me. ![IMG_20260512_180454776_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EoiVJq1y7hWJcBGkRvd5i199Z1YQW5ZJ996tneu7YkwP9M8Eu8YPDBzQdFipwDzD3qW.jpg) So far for my selection from last week. I didn't take any pictures today, yet. I'll probably go for a walk now, take some, and then prepare dinner before going to self defense classes with Kami. Thank you for reading! ___ As always, any feedback and especially tips and tricks are very welcome! As long as it's not AI generated content or comment spamming... 😅 ___ Thank you for stopping by! >All pictures are taken by myself with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro and I reserve the copyright - but you're welcome to ask if you'd like to use one of the pics!

Hice mi calentamiento y arranque, mi ruta fue, parque Los Caobos - Paseo los ilustres - parque Los Caobos, logré comenzar en Z2, pero km y medio después, se me empezó a subir un poco la FC, andaba con algo de alergia, el polvillo de la tierra del parque no me ayudaba, así que camine un pedazo para poder calmarme, luego seguí y todo fue muy bien, logré mi Z2, súper tranquila, con algo de calor, pero no estaba tan potente como días anteriores, de hecho cuando salí, tenía frío. Solo puedo decir que mi domingo fue muy bonito, aunque muchas veces corro sola y extraño correr acompañada, lo disfruto mucho, porque voy a mí ritmo y no me siento presionada con que me están esperando y más en este tipo de entrenamiento que la Z2 (por lo menos la mía) aún es muy lenta 🙈

Sigamos enfocados y haciendo lo que amamos 💚

body.title: Today: SDA Token Completes Its Four-Authority Renouncement
body.body:
![header](https://media.sdafintech.com/sda-freeze-hook-renounced-landscape-20260518.png)

# Today: SDA Token Completes Its Four-Authority Renouncement

Today, 18 May 2026, SDA Token will complete something few token issuers ever do — voluntarily destroying every administrative power the issuer holds over the token after issuance.

## What burns today

Two issuer authorities still exist over SDA as of this morning. They are revoked permanently on-chain today:

- **Freeze authority** — until today, we could technically lock any SDA wallet. After today, that ability is gone forever.
- **Transfer-hook authority** — until today, we could attach programmable rules that run between sender and receiver. No hook is currently attached, but the *option* still existed. After today, even the option is gone.

## What was already burned

Two more authorities were burned at the mint and have been gone the entire time:

- **Mint authority** — supply is permanently fixed at 100,000,000 SDA. We cannot mint more. Ever.
- **Metadata authority** — the token's name, symbol, image and URI are immutable.

## Why this matters

Most Solana token issuers keep these authorities indefinitely — \

The polite framing is *flexibility*. The honest framing is that the team retains the ability to change the rules after holders are already exposed.

We are taking the opposite approach. After today, every SDA in self-custody answers only to its holder. Where regulatory enforcement applies, it sits at the exchange or custodian layer — not inside the token itself.

## Verify on-chain

Don't take our word for any of this. The state of these authorities is public, queryable in one command:

```
spl-token display SDAmxfpgaGmtxTqcTcvr4yi2kBwEFxTLF2XU4oLFw4b --url mainnet-beta
```

You will see `mintAuthority: null` and `tokenMetadata.updateAuthority: null` already, and `freezeAuthority` and `transferHook.authority` flipping to `null` today. The burn transaction signatures will be posted publicly the same day.

## Documentation

- Whitepaper v1.2 — [sdafintech.com/documentation/whitepaper](https://sdafintech.com/documentation/whitepaper)
- SHA-256: `6319bb0c5ba47b84438353ffc54e5a7fb33c18f3c06cedb57cf4d00d06af0523`
- Filed under MiCA Article 6 / Annex I, supervised by FIN-FSA

Sustainable Digital Assets Inc. — Helsinki, Finland

---

*This post is informational and does not constitute investment advice.*

body.title: #MyHiveGoals week #18: Update on my work as a Hive bee: Reaching the title of Knight of Capital! [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> Hey everyone! Happy start to the week! I'm writing this from my office at the institute. I overslept and had to rush to the university! I stopped to buy a couple of coconut rolls, and let me tell you, they're addictive! Then I went back to my office and found out I'm going to have to postpone my lab session tomorrow. In short, I woke up ridiculously early only to end up doing absolutely nothing for the next few days. Well, since I'm alone in my office, I took the opportunity to write my weekly #MyHiveGoals summary while enjoying my coconut roll and a good cup of coffee. The first thing that surprised me when I turned on my PC was the price of Hive, which had returned to its price from a month ago, exactly below $0.06. I was really excited last week when I saw the price take off at $0.09, but it was definitely a fleeting joy. However, as I mentioned before, I'd prefer the price to stay this low when it comes time to fund my Hive wallet. In fact, we're currently in a dispute to get a raise, and if we're successful and get one, I'll convert my fiat money to crypto as soon as I receive my first paycheck. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtj3eMWCrCnYFuMfS59aLc9syJmYnBwggkWmKKVerbob/image.png) Link: [livecoinwatch](https://www.livecoinwatch.com/price/Hive-HIVE)

> In any case, we'll continue growing in Hive as I have been doing these past two years. Consistency and dedication are the two principles that guide my steps on this wonderful blockchain. We've already seen that the token can rise dramatically from one day to the next, so there's no reason to think this was just a fluke or that it simply won't happen again.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo4Ab6YHDAqaRVh7pHakA5AGvkNLYU7VLBS8c1rk9qDwzndFTYaNHBV8B4vRG9gDDam.png)
# Hive/HP

> Okay, if we look at the amount of liquid Hive we have today compared to a week ago, we'll see it's only changed by a few cents. For the past two weeks, I've been using the Hive Suite platform to microblog everything from my progress in Splinterlands to my work in the lab, and it's a good way to fill the necessary Hive to power up every 24 hours. I haven't microblogging as much as I'd like, because often I'm teaching or doing experiments, and I always forget to share what I'm doing with a photo. Perhaps when my teaching load is over, I'll be more active in this Web 3 layer on Hive. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTy1MDPxmzxpmEaADqUQ3w6Vj1YV6Ei2NmVAP3roQZFqX/image.png)

> Now, regarding HP, we have generated a good amount this week, ending with 124.73 HP, bringing our total to 9821 HP. At this rate, we will reach 10,000 HP by the end of May and will be only 2,000 HP away from our annual goal of 12,000 locked hives. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbi6FJi4RU4ZN7CmA1jd9qrxvRtmjQMt6X4e3nFQyRPAx/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVToj6k9NSAqbcCB3w9PmYdB5mxsF6tz19faBYR8AW9LD/image.png) --|-- Link: [hivestats](https://hivestats.io/)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbkj8mbMn9CYGJL7qVH3Zzq9mBSpZMLFAwUuy9ggaZ1KBkyRJwKGLVu3gb6pfH3bZUd.png)
# HBD Savings

> We've reached the part I've been waiting for! Finally, friends, I've reached 2,000 locked HBD. It's a secondary goal because my real objective for this year is to reach 2,300 HBD. But the highlight of this week is the badge we earned: Knight of Capital! That's why I preferred to collect the interest on the locked HBD today and not in the middle of last week, because we would have been just 1 HBD short of reaching the goal. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbK2grRkFzp6gTiNxwqEnpbEMQzPePwMeWpQvpsTU8CJuAWeznKNXgfw8LqbhJVMH2x.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGTdg1qRnfBUVW75TqYfZTGksdBvDivEiskUPwCxhnqGAQfdB8xePfmfqGxpQMfNj1M.png)

> Along with the 23.6 HBD from interest, we add the 7.4 HBD from the week to reach a little over 2000 HBD. I honestly didn't think I'd generate more than 6 HBD this past week. Therefore, I decided to keep a full 1 HBD to buy some second-layer tokens like Decs (Splinterlands) and Starbits (Rising Star Game), which are Gamefi projects in which I'm very active.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdx4HksKDUrxpf3raKmV18hfMUEkabmzLLBw1Fuk2eVdf/image.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRvemjxAW3DTHfSYJaucGtWeFfGdSyJykaA17cdXHjVxU9efUn1sQTZmJWuCn2Ek1ip.png)

> Compared to last week, we've added more than 23 HBD to our Hive stablecoin savings. That's the magic of compound interest that this HBD savings mechanism offers. Of course, getting started is the hardest part, which is why discipline is so important, along with having clear goals and the conviction to achieve them. This is the result of over two years of work on the blockchain, and now we're starting to see the first fruits of all this effort. While we did achieve this special award, our annual goal remains a significant challenge. We haven't reached 2300 HBD halfway through the year, and with Hive's low price, this goal has become even more difficult. We'll see if the monthly APR interest helps us reach this challenging target.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGyXZoWHqdFmZ3okUbJHeoVbbUXGqH9Q7Eq9XGt2nrFidVxjieoh8GH2HD5583firb5.png)

> Well, friends, that was my report for the week. I was really looking forward to sharing this first achievement, the Knight of Capital badge. The next step would be 5,000 HBD locked, but that's a very long-term goal. However, I do have a good amount of liquid Hive waiting for the price to rise significantly so I can convert it to HBD and add it to the vault. That's why I always start these reports by evaluating Hive's price throughout the week. See you in the next report, friends. Best regards. ---

---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma7j5qYGkqsSyuFpTUTsZfy9HwU5rr76Wg16LKfgLfaye/front_mhgw18.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23zRw3SoGotiSUAysx4tbYSPR3V3jdvPQ3LTooQ4k1z4VBxtPoNchWgAq1KiuHBo874BJ.png)

> Que tal comunidad! Feliz inicio de semana, estoy escribiéndoles estas líneas desde mi oficina en el instituto, me quedé dormido y tuve que salir corriendo a la universidad! Me detuve a comprar un par de panes recubiertos con coco y amigos es un verdadero vicio! Luego fui a mi oficina y me enteré que voy a tener que posponer mi práctica de laboratorio que sería mañana, en resumen me levante desaforadamente temprano para al final no hacer nada estos próximos días. Bien, ya que estoy solo en mi oficina, aproveché de hacer el resumen semanal de #MyHiveGoals mientras disfruto de mi pan con coco y una buena taza de café. Lo primero que me sorprendió al encender el Pc fue el precio de Hive que volvió a su precio de hace un mes exactamente por debajo de los 0.06$ La verdad era que estaba muy entusiasmado la semana pasada cuando vi el precio despegar a los 0,09$ pero fue sin duda una alegría efímera, pero como les había dicho anteriormente preferiría que el precio se mantuviera así de bajo para cuando llegue el momento de fondear mi billetera de Hive. De hecho, justo ahora estamos en conflicto para que nos suban los salarios, si tenemos éxito y logramos un aumento, apenas cobre mi primer salario llevaré ese dinero fíat a cripto lo más pronto posible. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtj3eMWCrCnYFuMfS59aLc9syJmYnBwggkWmKKVerbob/image.png) Link: [livecoinwatch](https://www.livecoinwatch.com/price/Hive-HIVE)

> En cualquier caso, continuaremos creciendo en Hive como lo he estado haciendo estos últimos 2 años, constancia y dedicación esas son las 2 divisas que guían mis pasos en esta maravillosa blockchain. Ya vimos que el token pudo subir drásticamente de un día a otro, así no hay razones para pensar que esto fue solo casualidad o que simplemente no se va a repetir.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo4Ab6YHDAqaRVh7pHakA5AGvkNLYU7VLBS8c1rk9qDwzndFTYaNHBV8B4vRG9gDDam.png)
# Hive/HP

> Ok, si vemos la cantidad de Hive líquido que tenemos hoy comparado con el de hace una semana, nos daremos cuenta que apenas vario unos pocos céntimos y es que desde 2 semanas he estado usando la plataforma de [HiveSuit](https://hivesuite.app/#/dashboard/blogs) para hacer microblogging desde mi progreso en Splinterlands hasta de mi trabajo en el laboratorio y es una buena forma de completar los hive necesarios para hacer los power up cada 24 horas. No he hecho tanto microblogging como me habría gustado y es que en muchos casos o estoy dando clases o haciendo experimento y siempre olvido compartir las cosas que hago con una fotografía. Quizás cuando termine mi carga docente esté más activo en esta capa de la web 3 en Hive. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTy1MDPxmzxpmEaADqUQ3w6Vj1YV6Ei2NmVAP3roQZFqX/image.png)

> Ahora con respecto al HP, si que hemos generado una buena cantidad esta semana que terminó con 124.73 de HP para llegar a un acumulado de 9821 HP a este ritmo, llegaremos a los 10000 HP para finales de mayo y estaremos a solo 2000 HP de nuestra meta anual de 12000 Hive bloqueados. ---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbi6FJi4RU4ZN7CmA1jd9qrxvRtmjQMt6X4e3nFQyRPAx/image.png)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVToj6k9NSAqbcCB3w9PmYdB5mxsF6tz19faBYR8AW9LD/image.png) --|-- Link: [hivestats](https://hivestats.io/)

# Ahorros HBD

> Llegamos a la parte que más estaba esperando! Finalmente amigos, he logrado llegar a los 2K de HBD bloqueados, es una meta secundaria porque realmente mi objetivo para este año es llegar a los 2300 HBD. Pero el detalle de esta semana es la insignia que hemos ganado: Knight of Capital! Por eso preferí cobrar los intereses de los HBD bloqueados hoy y no a mitad de la semana pasada porque íbamos a quedarnos a solo 1 HBD de llegar a la meta. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbK2grRkFzp6gTiNxwqEnpbEMQzPePwMeWpQvpsTU8CJuAWeznKNXgfw8LqbhJVMH2x.png) --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tGTdg1qRnfBUVW75TqYfZTGksdBvDivEiskUPwCxhnqGAQfdB8xePfmfqGxpQMfNj1M.png)

Por supuesto, empezar es lo más complicado, por eso la disciplina es muy importante, tener las metas claras y la convicción de completarlas. Esto es el resultado de más de 2 años trabajando en la blockchain y ahora comienzan a ver los primeros brotes de todo este esfuerzo, lo otro es que si bien conseguimos esta medalla especial, nuestra meta anual todavía se erige como un reto cuesta arriba, 2300 HBD aún no llegamos a mitad del año pero con el bajo precio de Hive, esta meta meta se ha vuelto más cuesta arriba. Ya veremos si con los intereses mensuales del APR podemos alcanzar esta difícil meta.

Tenía mucha ganas de compartirles este primer logro que fue la insignia de Knight of Capital, el siguiente escalón sería 5000 HBD bloqueados pero esa ya es una meta para muy largo plazo, aunque tengo una buena cantidad de Hive liquidos esperando el momento a que suba su precio significativamente para pasarlo a HBD y sumarlo a la bóveda, es la razón por la que siempre comienzo estos reportes evaluando el precio de Hive a lo largo de la semana. Nos vemos en el próximo reporte amigos. Saludos.

body.title: In Search of Ants (Baby Blog)
body.body:
It has been a long time since I've written about Kaleb and Ollie, so I thought I'd share a few things here.

Back when I was in the midst of a posting streak here, I regularly wrote updates/ diaries on the kids. Kaleb had a good few posts written about him as I spoke about milestones, but then I dropped my streak and took a back seat for writing in general, so I didn't get a chance to write much about Ollie's early stages.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6Gaa4BXGCeBbwKfPpS1ESygWuYyXsyT7Nzeni5DRPZF/image.png)

[Source](https://www.freepik.com/vectors/animated-ants)

****

**Kaleb**

Now at the age of 3 and 1 month, he is flying along. As I have often said, it never ceases to amaze me just how fast they grow and pick up new things.

He is talking - a lot - (I'm told that he gets that from me), he is as curious as a kid can be, and it's great. 

Yesterday, we went out for a walk while he rode his scooter along, and he started stopping at different spots to talk to ants and look for creepy crawlies. 

I spotted a roll-up woodlice and picked it up and dropped it into his hand, and he was amazed by it. He's very gentle with animals, as well as bugs, which is great. 

There's one spot we found a bunch of ants, and now every time we walk past it, he stops to see if they're out.

\
and he continues to look around. \

In general, I think the development of language is fascinating. Seeing him go from a jumble of sounds and the odd word to full-blown sentences was amazing, and it's even cooler that he quickly picks up new words or phrases based on what we say.

\

He said before. Which he either picked up from his mum or grandad. (I usually say for God's sake.)

When he started saying that, I could hardly contain my laughter. But we all did well to ignore him and not react, which stopped him from saying it.

The funny thing about it, though, is that he used it in the correct context. He dropped something on the floor one day and put his hand up to his forehead and said the forbidden phrase.

****

**Oliver**

Ollie, or Ollie-pop as Kaleb calls him. Is doing really well.

I have never seen a hungrier child. He could drink a bottle, have a bowl of dinner, a yoghurt for dessert, and as one of us brings in our dinner, he will instantly look up, drool, and repeatedly open and close his mouth. Which is Ollie's language for, feed me. 

He is 9 months old now, but is nearly the same weight as Kaleb. (not literally, but he's getting there) He's an absolute tank of a child. Imagine a pint-sized doorman, and that's basically Ollie. Every time I walk into the room, I expect to hear, \

If he is on the ground, he will find anything at all to grab to help himself stand up. His main obsession is Kaleb's old Bluey chair, which has led to a few falls and plenty of tears. It has become such a problem that we have to take the chair out of the room every time we let him down.

He has one tooth coming up at the moment, which I forgot about until he chomped on me.

Ollie is also incredibly smiley. Whether it's one of us or a complete stranger, he is always giggling and smiling. We've taken to calling him Jolly-Ollie for it, and I think the nickname may stick.

****

**The Bros**

Ollie is obsessed with Kaleb to the point of never wanting to leave his side or take his eyes off him. 

Kaleb is a very caring older brother, but he likes to play by himself sometimes, or with either Aimee or me, without having Ollie tag along. Which is kind of sad to see, but understandable, as there is a bit of a gap between the two of them.

Ollie was trying to play with one of Kaleb's cars the other day, and Kaleb grabbed it back. \
\n\nBut then, right after saying that, Kaleb ran over to Ollie's little toy box, pulled out a teddy, and came over to give it to him. \

****

Parenthood is amazing. It's tiring, sometimes it can be frustrating, but all the time it is heart-warming.

body.title: Temper Is Not A Justification For Doing Wrong  \n
body.body:
>Each of us has a measure of temper issues, but not everyone explodes when that part of them is triggered. Over time, I have seen people do certain crazy things: causing serious havoc and then channeling the blame on their temper weakness. The first question that always pops up in my head in such situations is, are they the only ones with temper issues? Let's tell ourselves the truth: there are times when we all get to a point where we are so vexed that we feel like bursting open like a volcano that has matured and is ready to erupt, but somehow, we manage to keep it cool. In truth, people can be very annoying at times. People can offend you to the point where you would wish you could do something terrible to them just to ease your hurt, but then, give it a moment, and it will dissipate. I have acted based on anger before, and I regretted my actions. Some of them I still regret to date. Sometimes, you may even be right, and your decision would have probably been right, but because it was made in anger, you ruined it. Maybe instead of simply walking away, you ended up landing a hot slap on someone, and because of that very action, you lost your respect or a relationship. Temper is something we can manage just like every other emotion. I know it is difficult, but it is worth the effort. It amazes me whenever I hear some people bragging about how hot tampered they are. Is that something to be proud of at all? Something that puts you in a situation where you are not able to think straight and act based on a temporary feeling. Is that a feeling anyone should allow themselves to walk with? All my life, I have never seen anybody who has never felt terrible after reacting based on temper. The majority of the time, after doing all that their energy carried them to do, quietly, they begin to feel bad. Those who are humble enough immediately look for means to apologize and to make things right, while the proud stay unremorseful, yet deep inside, something will register to them that they have done wrong. Left to me, I don't see any reason why anyone would do something, then say it was because of their hot-tempered nature. We are all given the ability to correct any wrong trait we find in ourselves. The fact that we are aware that our temper is causing havoc to people, and we refuse to work on it, is a sign that we know what we are doing. Putting the blame on temper for doing wrong is a sign of irresponsibility. Anyone who possesses such character is a big threat to society because one day, the same person would do something dangerous and still use temper as an excuse. The best way to handle this issue of temper is for individuals to take responsibility for controlling their temper. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUWzTHPuuCzrmF4Q6j7jGYBkbrdEUrSpbARgaKepHeM8Y/1779136949932.jpg) It's not easy, but with consistent practice, control would surely be established. ------- N.B: All Images Were Generated By Gemini AI -------

body.title: How My Bus driver took us on rat race || Plus I made Dinner
body.body:
![IMG_20251226_080308_855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23xKvVMc3oVCG6ehmdVqJSHcgEWF4pQZhdFTMtkEPAxSagj6srng8m8acTFWWRK7CyVtA.jpg)


Earlier on, I shared how I ate eba and soup my favorite meal as breakfast this morning at my friend's place and which was delicious I really enjoyed the food as it made my day.

Leaving this afternoon, I took a bike and wanted to stop at the motor park, only for me to realize that there was a waiting bus loading by the road side.

 I told the bike man to drop me so I could board the roadside bus as it was way shorter than heading to the park because of distance 

When the bike man was about to drop me off, the bus zoomed off while the conductor beckoned on us to follow him, the bike man followed him and drove me round only for the bus to later stop, I quickly highlighted from the bike and hopped into the bus.

The bus stopped again to pick another passenger, when she was able to hop in, the local taskforce sighted our bus and started chasing after our bus, following which our driver took off with high speed.

I was just praying in my heart that our bus shouldn't get caught, because I learnt that our driver was not supposed to stand by the road side and load his vehicle, that all loading should have been done at the motor park. 

Luckily, our bus driver was able to escape being caught after taking the taskforce vehicle on a marathon race. The taskforce vehicle got tired and had to return back to duty post after their failure to catch our bus.

When I got home eventually, I had to thank God for a safe trip because it wasn't easy with such a rat race experience on my journey.


![IMG_20260518_171844_818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wCDrRgfUBQDy48hVCkmzVpjpVXDjDfQHgYMJR9t8yrjqjvucwig6amJWwxC6tvhuajH.jpg)


I later went to the market where I got a few clothes. I also bought foodstuffs which I used in preparing dinner; okro soup and white rice, my photo above. I enjoyed the meal so much because the rice was very slimy, just as I needed it to be.

I also bought an apple and I enjoyed it. I am having a little challenge with my android phone, that is why I couldn't take some pictures to complement my write-up. Did you go through anything today? let us know too. 

I really appreciate your time to read.
Hope to see you in my next one.

Photos taken with my Infinix Smart5 phone camera,
Writing is my own writing.

body.title: Hail to the Queen!
body.body:
Today we celebrate Victoria Day, which refers to Queen Victoria's birthday. She was instrumental in the creation of Canada. While the constitution limits royal power in Canada, we are a monarchy, and Charles III is our current king. His great-great-great grandmother oversaw many historic events in Canada's history, including events that influenced the history of the province of British Columbia. Under her reign, disparate dominions were united into a single confederation that we now know as Canada. For this and other reasons, today we officially honour her memory.

body.title: Bamboo Tiger Longhorn (Chlorophorus annularis)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Chlorophorus annularis*** | May 14, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhphncei9nkgMbLExAiNkA1uveVK1RZzEaki2ihNgkTg/mix_20260519_010816.jpg)

After uploading a picture of this strange insect to the iNaturalist app, I learned some surprising facts about it. The yellow-black stripes on this insect's body are very similar to the color of a tiger's body, so it can be recognized at first sight. After analyzing the information provided by the app, today I am presenting you with details about this beautiful yet mysterious insect.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdYkY2GDzWRRFtYcXxFFdZohuwChfFqQg7cMTGzCv9Nv4/mix_20260519_011241.jpg)

Name and Family: The common English name of this insect is **Bamboo Tiger Longhorn** or **Bamboo Borer**. In zoology, its scientific name is ***Chlorophorus annularis.*** It is originally a member of the **Cerambycidae** family and is a species of the **Chlorophorus** genus. The biggest characteristic of insects in this family is that they have very long antennae compared to their bodies, which is why they are called 'longhorn beetles'.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFXrkXcGBfqMYUNfjjNyXaUA5EHzeT6uQaVMBGeLJCrX/mix_20260519_010916.jpg)

​Home and Habitat: According to the map and information of i-Naturalist, this insect is native to Southeast Asia and our Indian subcontinent. They are found in large numbers in various parts of Bangladesh, India, China, Thailand and Japan. However, recently, due to international trade, they are also seen in some parts of Europe and America. They usually prefer to live in damp and shady places such as bamboo gardens, houses made of bamboo and where dry bamboo is stored.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNVXiFdHWq49cqtgxayvvc7fv5KAo4xVr6E5hVhD19pAz/mix_20260519_010532.jpg)

​Food and Life Cycle: Their diet and life cycle are quite peculiar. Adult bamboo tiger longhorn beetles mainly survive by eating pollen and sweet juice or nectar from various flowers. But their larvae or young have a completely different diet. The larvae mainly grow by eating the hard part inside the dry bamboo. They make long tunnels inside the bamboo, which reduces the durability of the bamboo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPCsi9KciCZPooDvSxsQD2K96H55aSiDZhWzQjFNtp4GG/mix_20260519_010954.jpg)

​Reproduction: Their reproduction process is closely related to bamboo. The female beetles lay their eggs in small cracks or holes in the bamboo. After the eggs hatch, they enter directly into the bamboo and start making tunnels there. They can remain in the larval state inside the bamboo for about one to two years. After that, they emerge as pupae and finally as full-fledged winged insects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTungsdqt6dxz9oYuBCBKY9gxvcePJXLxYNx5QRefwomC/mix_20260519_010702.jpg)

​Beneficial and harmful aspects: Just as this insect is an integral part of nature, it also causes damage to many valuable things used by humans.
​Bamboo tiger beetle is a big threat to the bamboo industry on the one hand, and on the other hand, it plays a special role in the pollination process of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcfgdwd9LXiH36Lz3SN1g1pvHah2QMp5wyFqxTuNrATFt/mix_20260519_010737.jpg)

​Beneficiality: When these insects fly from one flower to another in their full-fledged state, they naturally pollinate various plants. In addition, they play an indirect role in increasing soil fertility by breaking down old bamboo in the forest and mixing it with the soil and maintaining the natural food chain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSHhPSaLXhAHTfpAhS4fLnJosBrSdowV49ZPHJMRnMqGX/mix_20260519_010622.jpg)

Harmfulness: They are mainly known as a harmful insect to humans. They mainly tunnel inside dry bamboo, due to which furniture, baskets or house poles made of bamboo are destroyed very quickly. Sometimes they hide inside good bamboo and then gradually pulverize that bamboo, which is a big financial loss for the agricultural industry and the bamboo industry.

​All in all, this beautiful insect that looks like a tiger is as interesting as its life struggle is just as diverse. Have you ever seen a yellow-black insect that has made holes in bamboo in your home or neighborhood? You can share your experience in the comments.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

body.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles: Did you have a pet as a child 🐶🐈🐇
body.body: >Did you have a pet as a child

> My family home not only had a porch with trees and grass, but also a large backyard where we could play freely and which could easily have been the perfect place for pets. But for some strange reason, my parents never allowed dogs or cats. To be honest, it was never a problem for me, since I was afraid of cats from a very young age, and as for dogs, when I was five, the neighbor's dog bit my arm and I had to get a rabies shot. However, even though there weren't any of those kinds of pets at home, there were always parakeets or parrots, which they brought from the countryside, and my paternal grandmother was usually the one who took care of them.

></center>\n\nThe parakeets or parrots weren't in cages, so my grandmother had to clip their wings to keep them from escaping. She taught them to talk, and it was lovely to come home from school and hear the parrots calling to us, begging for food: \

Pancho and Juancho would say, following us around so we'd give them bread or fruit. We also had a small sea turtle at home, which was brought to us in December, so we named it Navidad (Christmas). The turtle was so small it could fit in the palm of our hand, and although we were in charge of feeding it and cleaning the small pool where it lived, my parents adored it so much that they also took care of it. Sadly, Navidad died of a heart attack after an earthquake, leaving the whole family devastated.

> All these little animals belonged to everyone; they didn't belong to anyone in particular within the family. But the only time I had a pet was because I received one as a gift for my 15th birthday. A classmate, with whom I got along very well, gave me a gray rabbit, which I named Candy. Candy was a beautiful baby rabbit who slept in a box in my room, and I took her for walks in the garden every day. I remember buying her several colorful ribbons to match my clothes, and I had a little tag made with her name on it, which she always wore around her neck. She was easy to care for, love, and feed: I put a container of food and a container of water in the box, and that was it. I remember sometimes bringing her into my bed, and she would sleep with me, and my mother would scold me for taking such good care of her. But once, I took her out into the garden, and she ate a plant that poisoned her. I suffered so much that from then on, I didn't want to get attached to another animal.

> As a curious fact, strangely enough, animals die in my house. It's not due to lack of care or food; on the contrary, I feel we sometimes overfeed them. Some say they absorb negative energy and that, like plants, they can even die from the evil eye. I don't know anything about that, but I do believe that this might explain why my parents didn't let us have pets: they spared us the pain of losing them. 🐾
>The first image was made in Canva and the others are from my personal gallery. The text was translated with Deepl
>Thank you for your support, reading, and comment. Until next time, friend. Regards

body.title: Alicante: Vacation Day #2 part one : Walk to the castle... mostly just photo's
body.body:
#
The picture filled version of my trip

I have already given the quick version of my trip in my Actifit report. Unfortunately I have to write that on my phone and it takes forever to write everything. So... That is why I'm writing a little more complete version here so I can add more pictures and commentary. Of course I don't really know if anyone is paying attention but I like having a personal record :) On the second day we had to walk back to the Castillo Santa Barbara and had to go back over the beachfront promenade area. ![PXL_20260515_081315445.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EpJY9wJvPTV8FbexfRD2bWrG1TApTwD3hLy9n3fhqmTnh1JY2HeCm4Pq64nCwdNPXfY.jpg) My wife really wanted a picture by the Mariposa statue. Then we continued on and once again marvelled at just how large some of those really old trees are. ![PXL_20260515_081812382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EoChd1R31jA8tAinsoqvpYua2EGPdxqn4jpHmyTWJ8XvT9KEWp6aaNA5P1HoK3Qhsfe.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_081818430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23w2eTHk6haVVhnAdmAGxYqdG7cqSJVUX3Qc1mKu2prmLZPWSGFZ7oEdkG8upgyfU21zq.jpg) On this day we actually travelled up a side road through the town rather than continue on the tourist path. Stilll, I picked a road with a huge central walkway. Very pretty and very open, great for walking. Wish we had stuff like this in Canada. ![PXL_20260515_082138769.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23xKsyqKB3pQesgkTMFXk467tPSaZeTmSA5SiuWkxgUt84VCddKvZwaJzG9inoSmxTA8Q.jpg) Of course then we looked at the side streets and they were really really tiny. Those were the narrow streets of the old town. ![PXL_20260515_082254545.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Ep5mgxcqij52m8PqUBisCSfDAFCkPePGSD6vxxhJn4tQzkU29cUcxfdcRmWxa4aEyDL.jpg) and as I was walking I saw a bitcoin buy and sell location. As I'm a crypto enthusiast I am always happy to find places like that :) ![PXL_20260515_082602183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eoc77G5wQ2fQHU678ibZSsLCm3aoZLyfr9GcP9FfB5urXskVKBEB5Hk5if9uXX8AXgC.jpg) Now to get to the Castle we had to travel through the old town and we found a funny little road with mushrooms on the street ... weird but cute. ![PXL_20260515_082849404.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eou9eUU1a8a8SeyYiRCWDSp8BDRmce5xtaQUaTxqQvDLVMZcChsekhFaQyfgV6JMo53.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_082936431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23yd69Kw6aaGmiWJNdUzDkn5bmGg1gDRhjYn8HaSAtaRN2aMxSGimUcuhJwNtaCTMkQGU.jpg) There lots of cool places walking along the old narrow roads and one led us to an opening with some cold trees. Kind of nice. ![PXL_20260515_083926718.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EpLgSsiAwamggYFfa9kBCPoVxsKLGwZCV4LomG6n1r4ZVhi9JeYughWNJ8sKXJhMRJy.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_083357458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eoc7bYVEPsv16gBBUHnxGoKut2ttcRHijmEphpnHUaW2UygUsV5Mq42iVux7pjvskJq.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_083926718.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EpLgSsiAwamggYFfa9kBCPoVxsKLGwZCV4LomG6n1r4ZVhi9JeYughWNJ8sKXJhMRJy.jpg) Now I really wanted to just get to the Castle but we found the Central Market so we had to stop in and take a look. I also wanted to look inside because I read it was a good place for a public washroom and knowing where those are in a foreign town is usually a pretty good idea. ![PXL_20260515_084624375.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eo8SQ9KraekA3WTjNQy3pSbpuJatUJMDXsSBPuZoB2Gsg5aZkjHisot1seV6UUM5FKn.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_083326220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EoptRcZ2qfyHqmJ6HALt3W8jXZXrGKLYUAM1SV4Ta8vQEP9GgexycYcrx1iWwV8p6hm.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_084709504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EowHbSj3QurRkZ8hm3r1njPhJ3241TheJoCmWV4kzBHbiKPC8EeAi4LfFzeT87u8YXr.jpg) Now there were multiple levels but we mostly hung out on the second level. That is where my wife found a washroom and we both marvelled at just how much meat and cheese there was along the aisles. It was kind of awe inspiring... plus the cheese was reasonably priced...something I'm not used to in Canada. ![PXL_20260515_084952614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EoeEpnNehzCPyXYyHJurEuciM7uKi4DrmbyKEqQ6wk5PJbcHNdNUV6L5oVmSj8SMpfT.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_084837562.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eo4BWBs9oJ8xmTt3ZUk4VHvyRKAifbvFnSVcGy4ySzS5nAEwvyZQ1MKKJuz61tn7VUB.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_085004581.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EokdfBTWr8hNN4oYoLWbYbe8HHvHhB7LsvLmP1ShoHsGDEyt1DRQoMo39ykzZEWmY3L.jpg) Then we finally got going and made it to where we could see the castle. It was still in the distance but at least we knew we were going the right way. ![PXL_20260515_085912958.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23xKonoaGbTH7tepeEDmbtPbF9jESZrfKhS4wEZ8d6cE6KHhxNq2i5Jh8utJjQCbQBfoY.jpg) Then the walk began. Castles are typically built on hills to make it tough for attackers and this one was no exception. Except that means lots of stairs. Lots and lots of stairs. ![PXL_20260515_090241650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23zS2uoWrEFAsRkLLDJW8Ek9K7QKHamH2BKxGk2u3145swRapGbpNkzqgRELVnhD3BxzC.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_085918537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23ywnsxsHpsyrE4CuM55NvT78RwqZMyNDcSjWb5Qc7Nhcz4dwQg6kQiXVHksf16E7c9mK.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_090255777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23ywq77uzvg53nvSnYVchDVnwKdbQLBXTnR4g2ncAsuX1StbDCjHs4z3rWRM2oeSMBBvW.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_090521164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Eoc77Fe2qcPKG9Lrm6ELv9nkcEqE7799sEVS1NMjWazePoomgN14xHNYmT1u3M5vYBH.jpg) Of course from the hill you can get a pretty good view of the city. ![PXL_20260515_090637955.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/245caVWQQ58QNCBkizND5Zs5oAe1gpurbCwr4aAoAmWfgTzxAothDBTEQ6TK3Jdwr9z8A.jpg) ![PXL_20260515_090631150.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/Ep5ncfsGWUgGpP9VCH1PfrXiQbgJJ8sk9KdR5aUjyAe1vTwQrfivJHNv1d8zQAFFJDf.jpg) After getting about halfway up the hill we got to a \

in the path.  We decided to go to the right and it was absolutely the wrong way to go.  It seems that there are three ways up to the castle and we took the wrong way and it led to the way off the mountain.  Haha.  Oops.  However we did get to see part of the barrier wall and it was way thicker than we would have thought.  Here is my wife compared to the wall.

Walked along the wall for just a little way and found a great spot for a city view

![PXL_20260515_091949218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/244obKcaUEkre9SYYBjme3bVcwujrh92pHhziWNJaTSyMoxqxkEwZHhaw9jhFnfrrj2zL.jpg)

![PXL_20260515_091803586.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EpVCxqyzoc6BhrgVoe2VBNm8XH2pJ33tSAQtDTPbRWe8rP51RB1kiAewiXsjj8CD5Ao.jpg)


![PXL_20260515_091025116.MP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/246G8vVae5MqCWrxQtH4S17WPwY1Tg6y3swCKDF9gaPnRjActfufZDPJUk7qJXoAcSVEY.jpg)

![PXL_20260515_090659100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23xyZaFAmtdWkMn6PixnZMZbmkBenYUDi395awijsXjotJy5MTcUicYxL5tK2i3z7JxqY.jpg)

and then another for a castle view.

Backtrack along the path and then what do we get to do?

More travel uphill but this time along a road that has big signs on it \

.  Makes sense as here is very very little parking at the top of the hill (it's mostly castle) and when we got near the top they were doing repair work on the road.  Guess the castle isn't 100 percent authentic.  We actually found out later that much of it has been completely destroyed by time so it was rebuilt bit by bit over a long period of time.  


![PXL_20260515_093346617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23wqnf6qHXmZgq5WVKYgiA262mywF8kyVdgHukABtZnUfjLFwCSonj9PxKtcb9X1BYbja.jpg)

![PXL_20260515_093335058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EoptomQ9DE5X4Kapj4eVMfqvLyvz6ZJJJ3P58E224aHaZwFT7GCcVYAshrc7SvpT3Vu.jpg)


![PXL_20260515_092039361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/243qAgTYeHjt9uzfEhxeFFx4xnPkNDd5txqLm3ohsw554WVV5ZWhpHkqF9NzZ5V2mdGK9.jpg)

Now I could have taken pictures just after the entry gate but... well, it was just a stone pathway to a person telling everyone which was to go in and that there was no entry fee.

### No Entry Fee

Horray!  My wife kept saying that they could charge an entrance fee.  They actually sort of do.  There is an *easy* way to the castle but it involves using an elevator that you get on to from the beach / tourist area.  I'm quite certain that any tourists just use that to get to the top :)  Smart people and locals get some steps in and do the hike :)

They do however force everyone thought the souvenir shop before you get into the castle.  They may not charge you but they do tempt you!

But there is a lot more to the day....

.... and I think I've used up my quota of images for this post so
.... tomorrow I'll post more photo's from the trip.  

That way I can keep all of the Castle Pictures together :)

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#135
body.body:
>

![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/489y1wbwMJi9zcQ6gS2pMwDAMcJBaE5cuUN4o1PK3swF7ZpTTB2KEpa2i4U6KtaHxc.jpg)

Dwadzieścia cztery godziny temu biegałem po tej samej trasie pod ciężkim, ołowianym niebem, z szarą mgłą wiszącą nad boiskami. Dziś przez cały dzień pogoda była podobna, dopiero wieczorem rozpogodziło się i mogłem wykorzystać „złotą godzinę” na terenie bazy. Słońce chyliło się ku zachodowi, zamieniając każde źdźbło trawy w złoto. Ten sam teren, ta sama trasa – a jakby zupełnie inne miejsce na ziemi.

> ***[ENG] Twenty-four hours ago, I was running this exact same route under a heavy, leaden sky, with a gray mist hanging over the fields. Today was much the same all day long, until it finally cleared up in the evening, allowing me to catch the \

around the base. The sun was dipping toward the horizon, turning every blade of grass into gold. The exact same grounds, the exact same route—yet it felt like a completely different place on earth.*** ![IMG_4625.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xARY5F1769atZVEbNyBKKsHQcCyjVNYAr3jZAXsBRz1dNaAdomVSZXx2DnELsGs4R1D.JPG) ![IMG_4626.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/241tUgfrmZiQPvMLq8i1QUTLwXBKnrGR93VQAzQWGx9Rx21drjxH5EhemeNfNfoCNeYiR.JPG) Wyjście o tej porze to była jedna z lepszych decyzji biegowych ostatnich tygodni. Kiedy skręciłem w aleję wzdłuż boisk baseballowych, słońce znajdowało się już tuż nad linią drzew. Nowe osiedle po prawej stronie, w ciągu dnia tak zimne i modernistyczne, w tym świetle wyglądało niemal... ciepło. Było prawie nie do poznania. Ta sama asfaltowa ścieżka biegnąca między zielonym ogrodzeniem a starymi drzewami, którą wczoraj przemierzałem w szarej mgle, dziś wieczorem była kompletnie odmieniona. > ***[ENG] Heading out at this time was one of my best running decisions in weeks. When I turned into the avenue along the baseball fields, the sun was sitting right above the tree line. The new housing estate on the right, which looks so cold and modernist during the day, felt almost... warm in this light. It was barely recognizable. The same asphalt path cutting between the green fence and the old trees, which I had traversed in a gray haze yesterday, was completely transformed tonight.*** ![IMG_4628.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/245Hf1STtyFUMzeYtYNXaKhzSqnNThJpp7vMnfmfFHtSn1NwuLBDGw94eQPfsu5WTqLLh.JPG) ![IMG_4630.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zbKfUcYcbHSHmVyDq8dpqq3apecsvn3miT2jpShMYtWJH5pytQdXs9iWuhuR3UzacBT.JPG) Nie tylko widoki dopisały. Nogi miały dziś zupełnie inny pomysł na siebie niż wczoraj. Strava pokazała coś, czego się nie spodziewałem po dwóch kolejnych dniach biegania: dystans 7,92 km, średnie tempo 5:40 min/km, tętno 162 bpm. Dla porównania – wczoraj tę samą trasę pokonałem w tempie 6:02 min/km. Oznacza to, że dziś każdy kilometr przebiegłem o ponad 20 sekund szybciej, zachowując bardziej równomierny rozkład sił. Nie wiem, czy to sprawka wieczornego powietrza, złotego światła, czy może wczorajszy spokojny bieg okazał się najlepszą rozgrzewką. Pewnie wszystkiego naraz. > ***[ENG] And it wasn't just the views that delivered. My legs had a totally different plan for today than yesterday. Strava showed something I didn't expect after two back-to-back days of running: a distance of 7.92 km, an average pace of 5:40 min/km, and a heart rate of 162 bpm. For comparison—yesterday I covered the same route at a 6:02 min/km pace, meaning today I ran each kilometer over 20 seconds faster, with a much more even distribution of effort throughout. I don’t know if it was the evening air, the golden light, or if yesterday's easy run just served as the perfect warm-up. Probably a bit of everything all at once.*** ![IMG_4631.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/245wL2f3jQNV8U5beyMeVKF79oRDW3X7g98Q3jfML352XRjwkpLs4ppnGb2pKXjmfGUMf.JPG) ![IMG_4636.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2449xYcsYfRzhbZJKRZwNXsGqMseBp434M4gXKdiZUvRcdkptjsyFQpVTS53fG24xDLfo.JPG) ![screenshot-www.strava.com-2026.05.18-22_05_35.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/EogU664pSzPqHR11NjGARvtiNySmyFf9NEAYDDmm9xeQbq4ZSwP6FNRhvDaLnS5pHcF.png) ---

title.title: V podzemním království; The Dwarfs Kingdom
title.body: Ochozské jeskyně se nacházejí v jihozápadní části Moravského krasu. Samotná Ochozská jeskyně není běžně přístupná veřejnosti, a právě proto bývá o její návštěvu velký zájem. Náhodou jsem narazil na možnost registrace na komentovanou prohlídku, a tak jsem v sobotu ráno mohl vyrazit za dalším podzemním dobrodružstvím.\n\n

/>
Z Mariánského údolí v Líšni jsem se vydal pěšky a po zhruba sedmi a půl kilometrech dorazil na místo setkání právě včas. Naše skupinka čítala osm lidí. Protože jeskyně stále slouží také k průzkumu a není běžně turisticky zpřístupněna, byly doporučeny holínky a povinnou výbavou byla čelovka a přilba, alespoň cyklistická.

/>
Jeskyně byla objevena kolem roku 1830. Krátce nato nechal hrabě František Xaver Dietrichštejn upravit vstup a financoval práce, díky nimž mohly být podzemní prostory zpřístupněny návštěvám. The Ochoz Caves are located in the south-western part of the Moravian Karst. The main Ochoz Cave is not normally open to the public, which is why tours are always in great demand. By chance, I came across an online registration and on Saturday morning I was able to join a guided visit.

/>
Po průchodu úzkými a nízkými chodbami čeká návštěvníka zasloužená odměna v podobě bohaté krápníkové výzdoby. Stropy poseté brčky, stalagmity vyrůstající ze země, mohutné sintrové záclony i rozmanité útvary, kterým jeskyňáři dali poetická jména. V podzemí tak lze objevit Sněžku, smuteční vrbu s jezírkem nebo křtitelnici. Zajímavostí byla i plastová láhev zapomenutá zde před mnoha lety, kterou nám průvodce ukázal jako příklad toho, jak rychle dokáže příroda pokrýt předměty silnou vrstvou sintru. I walked 7.5 kilometres from bus terminal stop in Maria's Valley, Brno-Líšeň and arrived at the meeting point just in time. There were eight people in our group. Because the cave is not regularly accessible and exploration is still taking place there, visitors were advised to wear rubber boots, while a headlamp and a helmet – at least a cycling helmet – were required equipment. The cave was discovered around 1830. Shortly afterwards, Count F. X. Dietrichstein had an entrance built and paid for work that would allow the cave to be shown to visitors.

/> Prohlídka trvala přibližně hodinu a půl. Poslednímu dómu se přezdívá Taneční sál, protože zde měl podle legendy hrabě Dietrichštejn uspořádat bál. Při zpáteční cestě úzkými a nízkými chodbičkami se však nechce věřit, že by se tudy někdy prodíraly dámy v honosných róbách a hudebníci nesli své nástroje. After passing through narrow and low corridors, the cave rewards visitors with beautiful dripstone decoration. The ceilings are covered with calcit straws, stalagmites rise from the ground, and huge curtain-like formations hang from the walls. There are also many unusual rock formations to which cavers have given fitting names. In the underground spaces, visitors can find “Sněžka” (the highest peak in the Czech Republic), a weeping willow with a small lake, or a stone baptismal font. Our guide also passed around a plastic bottle that had been forgotten in the cave many years ago and was now covered with a thick layer of calcite.

/>
Během zpáteční cesty jsem bojoval s únavou, bolavými nohami i nevlídným počasím. Přesto to byl krásný den — plný zajímavých objevů, tichého podzemního světa a silných zážitků, na které budu ještě dlouho vzpomínat.

/>
On the way back, I had to deal with fatigue, sore legs, and unpleasant weather. Even so, it was a wonderful day — full of interesting discoveries, the quiet underground world, and experiences that I will remember for a long time.

title.title: Using the Bible to Defend Male Superiority in 2026?
title.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![IMG_5608.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23vsUge9mpc22wbQEdXcciQxPTUYFEBaog2sf5Yh8gqoV95Xdnc4gF6xCLpoQmbyYvFoP.jpeg)

So today, my brother and I found ourselves in the middle of what felt like a full-blown gender war debate.

It all started because of the trending scandal in Nigeria involving a popular *Who Wants To Be A Millionaire* host, his wife, and a very famous artist. Allegedly, the wife cheated on her husband with the artist, and the husband got angry enough to leak the story through a blog.

Now, from everything being said online, the man himself isn’t exactly innocent either. During their marriage, he allegedly cheated repeatedly, disappeared for weeks at a time, and publicly enjoyed the luxury and stability the woman provided while still treating her badly behind closed doors. According to the gist flying around, she would plead with him to stay committed to their marriage, but he constantly returned with new attitudes and fresh disrespect.

So while discussing it, my brother suddenly got upset and said that regardless of whatever the husband did, the wife had no right to cheat back. Fair enough. That’s a valid moral stance. But then he followed it up with, “Because she’s a woman and women are subjects to men.”
Now that statement completely threw me off.

I genuinely didn’t expect that kind of thinking from him because I’ve always considered him wise and open-minded. But hearing that felt like I had accidentally traveled back to the stone age. This is a completely different century. Society has evolved, women have evolved, relationships have evolved and thankfully many people no longer see women as beings designed simply to endure suffering in silence.

Now, if he had argued from a moral standpoint alone, I would have understood. Personally, I also think if someone cheats on you repeatedly, the healthier thing is to leave and file for divorce rather than revenge-cheating. But the moment the argument became *“she’s a woman”,* I checked out emotionally.

Because why are we still reducing women to subjects beneath men in 2026? What made the debate even more intense was when he started using the King James Bible to back up his point. And I had to stop him right there because, respectfully, that argument has never fully convinced me. The Bible, as we know it today, was written, translated, edited, and interpreted by men during periods where women were not even fully regarded as equals socially.

![IMG_5607.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/241tSfz5WjXp9KotMtNiW9hjstu3QcdGmKzikBJRnT2VuHUk6nnQ5qHi7Um8WH1sZk9cp.jpeg)

So yes, I’m going to question certain interpretations. At this point, I strictly told him they would either need to show me the original untouched scrolls or the heavens themselves would need to open so I could hear God audibly calling women subjects to men before I fully buy into that narrative. Because at the end of the day, we are all human beings and humans respond differently to pain.

Was cheating the best response from the woman? Probably not. But I also think people are too quick to judge reactions without acknowledging the emotional damage that led there in the first place. That woman was clearly grieving within her marriage. Loneliness inside a relationship can make people emotionally vulnerable in ways outsiders may never understand.

Maybe she leaned on the wrong shoulder and maybe made a bad decision. But it’s interesting how society often expects women to endlessly absorb betrayal with grace while men completely lose their minds the moment they experience even a fraction of the pain they’ve been dishing out. That’s the part that really gets me.

The same man who repeatedly cheated suddenly couldn’t handle being cheated on himself. Funny how pain only becomes unbearable when it finally knocks on your own door.

<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/photos/lighthouse-north-shore-lake-superior-2707574/)</sup>

<sup>[thumbnail](https://pixabay.com/photos/lighthouse-rubjerg-knude-lighthouse-6702435/)</sup>



</diva>

# 🚨 Massive WOO Update: Battle Pass Season 1 + Major Mobile Improvements

WOO just got a **huge** update, and this is one of the biggest quality-of-life and content additions we’ve rolled out in a while.

We’re excited to officially introduce the **inaugural WOO Battle Pass Season 1** while also bringing a wave of **mobile-friendly improvements** across the game.

This is a major step forward for WOO, both in terms of gameplay progression and overall usability.

---

## 🎟️ WOO Battle Pass Season 1 Is Live

The first-ever **WOO Battle Pass** has arrived.

Season 1 gives players a brand new way to progress through the game, complete quests, level up, and earn rewards through both a **Free Track** and a **Premium Track**.

The Premium Track is unlocked with **WOO Tokens**, making it a meaningful part of the WOO ecosystem while giving players a chance to earn back rewards as they climb through the pass.

### 📅 Season 1 Schedule (UTC)
- **Start:** 2026-05-19 00:00:00 UTC
- **End:** 2026-06-30 23:59:59 UTC

### 🔗 Jump In Here
[https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/battle-pass](https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/battle-pass)

### What you can expect from the Battle Pass:
- **Free Track rewards**
- **Premium Track rewards**
- **Daily quests**
- **Weekly quests**
- **Seasonal quests**
- **Level-based milestone rewards**
- Rewards focused heavily on:
  - **WOO Gym Bags**
  - **WOO Jobber Packs**
  - **WOO Tokens**
  - **WOOBucks**

This system is designed to reward players who show up consistently, play daily, and keep progressing.

**Play daily. Level up. Earn bigger rewards.**

---

## 🏆 Inaugural Season Rewards

Season 1 is all about setting the tone for what WOO Battle Passes can become going forward.

This inaugural season is built to feel rewarding from the very start, while also saving some of the biggest milestones for higher levels. That means the more you stick with it, the better the rewards get.

The goal was to create a pass that feels exciting for players while also fitting into the long-term health of the WOO economy.

With both a **Free Track** and a **Premium Track**, players can start earning immediately, while those who unlock premium with **WOO Tokens** can chase even bigger rewards throughout the season.

---

## 📋 New Quest System

Battle Pass progression is driven by quests, giving players more reasons to jump in every day and keep moving.

### Quest categories include:
- **Daily Quests**
- **Weekly Quests**
- **Seasonal Quests**

These quests are focused around actual gameplay and activity, such as:
- playing matches
- winning matches
- claiming rewards
- opening packs
- participating in tournaments

This helps make the Battle Pass feel like a natural extension of playing WOO rather than just another menu.

---

## 📱 Major Mobile-Friendly Improvements

This update is not just about the Battle Pass.

A lot of work also went into making WOO feel better on mobile, which is a massive quality-of-life upgrade for players who check in, manage their teams, or play on the go.

### Pages that received mobile-friendly improvements include:
- **Matches**
- **Events**
- **Battle Pass**
- **Earn**
- **History**
- **Explore Cities**
- **Store**
- **Organization**
- and likely more 😄

This is a very important step because a smoother mobile experience makes the game more accessible, easier to manage, and more enjoyable day to day.

---

## 🔥 Why This Update Matters

This update adds more than just content.

It adds:
- a new progression layer
- more daily engagement
- better reward structure
- improved usability
- a stronger foundation for future seasons and updates

The Battle Pass opens the door for WOO to deliver more seasonal content, more progression goals, and more exciting reward drops in the future.

At the same time, the mobile improvements help modernize the experience and make it easier for players to stay connected to the game wherever they are.

---

## 👊 This Is Just Season 1

This is only the beginning.

Season 1 is the inaugural launch of the WOO Battle Pass system, and it lays the foundation for even bigger things ahead. As we continue building, refining, and expanding WOO, systems like this will help make the game deeper, more rewarding, and more fun to interact with over time.

If you’ve been waiting for a good time to jump in, this is a strong one.

---

## 🎯 Jump In Now

Battle Pass Season 1 is here.

Start completing quests, climbing levels, and earning rewards while checking out the new mobile-friendly improvements across WOO.

👉 [Enter the Battle Pass here](https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/battle-pass)

Let us know what you think, what rewards you’re chasing first, and what you want to see in future seasons.

**Play daily. Level up. Earn bigger rewards.**

title.title: SMASh Contest Round -426
title.body: > Perhaps sharing photos of shadows when we don't know how to appreciate them is difficult. I used to feel that way; they would pass right in front of me and it was complicated for me. But since I discovered the #shadowhunters community, that perception has changed forever. Now, I regularly look out for shadows when I go for walks, so I can take some photos and share them here. >Quizás compartir fotografías de sombras cuándo no la sabemos apreciar es difícil yo sentía así le pasaba por el frente y era complicado para mí pero desde qué conozco a la comunidad #shadowhunters esa percepción cambió para siempre ya qué regularmente ahora estoy pendiente de ver al salir a caminar un poco dónde observar una sombra para tomarle algunas fotografías y compartirlas aquí. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKENk7VHqx7HMp74aEwn5DFkiyJ9BMGdtDgV8jd5HPwa/1779135507746.jpg) For example, sometimes it's complicated because when I change position and see a shadow I like, I'm in a hurry or simply can't stop to capture it with my cell phone. I hope to do so on the way back, but it's gone, so I have to wait until another day for the photos. That's what happened to me with these pictures of the gate last week. I went to buy some things early and saw it; but since it was already a bit late, I didn't stop and told myself I'd take it on the way back. But it wasn't like that because after a few hours, when I returned, it wasn't there, so I had to wait a few days to go out early again and finally take the pictures. >Por ejemplo a veces se me complica ya qué al rotar de posición cuándo veo una sombra qué me gusta, voy apurada ó simplemente por algún motivo no me puedo detener y capturarlas con mí teléfono celular espero hacerlo de regreso ya no están así qué debo esperar hasta otro día para las fotografías así me pasó con estás del portón la semana pasada fuí a comprar unas cosas temprano la ví; pero cómo ya era un poco tarde no me detuve y me dije de regreso lo hago pero no fué así ya qué después de unas horas cuándo regresaba no estaba así que tuve que esperar unos días para volver a salir temprano y ahora sí tomar las fotografías. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR15uxAJdLvx4SFbUkB5FHx4m1CnaHEKQjDqfRkht6q4i/1779135537734.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZbAacyuSxRMK5gN2pNNhTefehjCMfo8nWU1hyyQvmuLG/1779135538102.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRgX8hWYu57r1FkzQVU1ymJGDt5Nn6cjdBAwt6KwLC8Bo/1779135538472.jpg) I'm signing off, but not before thanking my friend @melinda010100 for the opportunity to first discover and experience this amazing world of shadows, as well as for the chance to participate in the weekly contests, this time with the number -426 here in the #shadowhunters community that we all love so much; greetings and blessings to all of us who share our posts daily here in the Hive ecosystem. >Me despido no sin antes agradecer por la oportunidad a la amiga @melinda010100 de primero conocer y darme cuenta de este mundo tan genial cómo lo es el de las sombras así cómo de participar en los concursos semanales en esta ocasión con el número -426 aquí en la comunidad #shadowhunters qué tanto nos gusta; saludos y bendiciones para todos los que a diario compartimos nuestras publicaciones aquí en el ecosistema Hive.

title.body:
Salud, estimado autor.
Cuántas verdades juntas en una tarde de amena conversación. Coincido en que la vida es un emprendimiento y no pocas veces un redescubrirse. 
Cuando me tocó andar el camino de productor artesano, intenté muchas cosas y en la que menos me imaginaba me sonrió la suerte. Ahora en pausa, no dejo de buscar alguna actividad que me dé satisfacción y algunos ingresos adicionales.
Conversando con una vecina que solo conozco de verla pasear a su perro, me resumió su historial: Tiene 85 años y se cuida y cuida a su perro anciano de 17 años. Viuda con hijos volvió a trabajar su profesión de enfermera hasta la jubilación, pero como no alcanzaba, volvió a estudiar para trabajar como podólogo a sus 60 o 65 hasta que los huesos le dijeron no más.
Una profesión que se estudia en un año está bastante bien remunerada y la estoy considerando si no surge otra cosa.

Celebro volver a leer sus letras y me retiro deseándole lo mejor. 

Un abrazo fuerte, amigo @janaveda.

title.title: Lets Make Chicken Spaghetti In My Style #HomeMade
title.body:
Hi everyone.....! 
I hope you all are doing well. 
Today I am going to share one of my favourite meal's recipe CHICKEN SPEGHETTI🍝. Speghetii or chowmein noodles....i love it in evry style. I guessi can eat this meal every single day.Whenever i go to any restaurant, chowmein is my top 1st order...every single time. And when it comes to home made....hella i love my hands who cooks such delicious speghetii...hahahah..!
Usually i used to cook flavored speghetii as FAJITA, CHOWMEIN, TIKKA. Chowmein is my favourite one. ut today, i tried in without any flavored MASALA..i tried to cook it in my own style. And trust me it turned out hellaa amazing....

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf7MX9Gc8Tf4AX7DGeEVripSheS5Y3pLvWU88PCYDX7Yt/1779133514703.jpg)

**INGREDIENTS**     

1-Chicken Spaghetti 
2-Chicken Cubes/Fingers
3-Capsicum 1/2
4-Garlic 3 cloves
5-Onion 2
6-Tomato 2
7-Oil 3-4 table Spoon
8-Salt 2/3 table Spoon
9-Chili Flakes 2.5 Table Spoons
10-Soya Sauve 2 table Spoons
11-Chilli sauce 3 table Spoons 
12-Oyster Sauce 1 tabel Spoon
13-Tomatoe Ketchup 1 table Spoon

**RECIPIE**      
First take a cooking Pain, add 3-4 Table Spoons of oil or as by ur own choice. Then Add Chopped or finally cutted onions in it 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFaKzNhN9XBon4UtwiqyNB8VUy863G7NkmB7T6Pk63E1/1779134419887.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKGCtFouKYYGhSZ8BjMC1uTopPrw2DfBVtdKdpGkmtoW/1779134419958.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX7fKFvvEUF39G9zCRkFJfNay9BxP3YXxFp1GucDof4fk/1779134420028.jpg)

Now thoughly mix onions in oil and let it fry.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc5rSM86RBGYVfdnJQqTVNsD36VNP26gf8R7GXyTDVDoE/1779134420097.jpg)
Now lets Add chooped Garlic in it:

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUt9ke16MMJKmg7uKCgUuxGrd7cTAAW59RiyQiGJahkGj/1779134475159.jpg)
Mix it well in the Onions and let it fry properly untill it gives strong fried fragrance.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1u5uSPKQXEgXUa2B8Rf3rW8DWi6mVuZn5LrzBnShWwZ/1779134475207.jpg)
Cut the chicken peace in fine finger shapes like this

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZaLcLGQNZRAawS2FKFiAtrbHuA6STC2R7XmzhZZP14sj/1779134543743.jpg)
Now add it in the frying onions and garlic.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYi5M2LR9xwR6A3V6NMmQ6TYDUavKtfPnfrRsXKdv2cQ7/1779134568227.jpg)
Mix it well and wait for it to turn white bright.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVC9KuH9yTs7MJsoUmx7ztYLkdQ431vLH1d4oKchEtYwF/1779134588140.jpg)

Now peal the tomatoes and chope them nicely and add them in chicken :

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYoqjrxitgo6XxGCzxHEeHJ5nwTR8AbdfW44i6AvEWKYr/1779134644484.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCo5GmFxQkxRgcUX1oth2oxosoEPPQohpUxnZwEYSvNm/1779134644550.jpg)
Its time to cut capsicum . I like to cut it in small cubes. Cut it and add in the frying mixture.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2Rfj67X36eHk4TgViWbHSekwgAdv69p62bJ9oBpuxdL/1779134727498.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVE5LDdCTQunF1MxaadqtzMfjspQvA3W5hWCtKGRutCj9/1779134727564.jpg)
Now add some salt, Red chilli flakes, soya sauce, chilli sauce,oyster sauce and last some ketchup.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnjgLH4p2UgxcJK2SjKFckt2yeSjdKk3efjj9y4GGq5Y/1779134812910.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQoHfJjufvQw7dCgeXSXpixsr8Qa9JiJRXAFWRbsTesmR/1779134812986.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWAiBpicV69xnVKC76YqdCCo2fg7LKya645K8TAPLUFQ8/1779134813053.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPi6ytLLAtVdHwxXj6x754SQhGXtLnNj7vcaf9yM7gi6m/1779134813123.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecT1o6Sgu2vNLU9XAshuatDsUb3EMqR5VaFKDk2TACfT/1779134813187.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYrpdLVN7maEvf9frE6b4cPm7W891cz4YhEHTBHDcMZRG/1779134825791.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaE2MpgqGUpYZ7kzJTT7duLYSaZ3hBMrS6WyPFSbdD41/1779134825861.jpg)
Now , let all these ingredients cook for about 15 minutes untill the chicken cooked softly and properly. 
Im a separate pan add water fot boiling spaghetti.Add one table spoon of salt in it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVeK8ijVtRowkmffCLgzuip6gU95iKCLYLtCzs4bfqtmy/1779134923050.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTP5ysZWhJLHWofr6V4PUedqiL3MjCuaRqkeT29pccVas/1779134923104.jpg)
As the water starts to boil, add spaghetties in it. Its always own choice to add them without breaking or after breaking. I like breaking it into half . I used Bake parlor Spaghetti. Add them in the boiling water and cook it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWteBjrqYwXEGpqucYaSngK8g8iEMytyXxCehyLQkXta/1779134998874.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQaRykdAocLH3x2qPT9p74LWsUEmyUURpH3fcy3ovx84/1779134998964.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdnuMerJUDsmLm72meMLGZD3rPHSeU6HSwwniFSnbdfJf/1779134999030.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQQ2oquKFtqq1bbh5yrULo9oug2b3ZzVTVpcSKG13fu2M/1779134999111.jpg)
 As the spaghetti cook's to 95%,stain them and drain all the water out it. Here is a bit difference from others..i never drain them with cool water.. instead i cook them a bit less and as soon after draining them, i add them in the chicken. I usually complete both these task on time so i don't have to wait for the chicken to cook properly with having spaghetti already stained .


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS3dySi8MfBGZbj71wJqx5DHgo4FSwNy9eSGKU4VmkymN/1779135196407.jpg)

Now add them in the chicken 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyNhiJPBSMY4PX99R5hpStf3NCkU9iF469LWHT3UEpEB/1779135213441.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdDWzZ9JyJqyvZrG8A24GUQxi3ppprR8cKvjkCYQGeZgt/1779135213517.jpg)

And here is the finall Look after serving it. 
I made it for both of us..me and my sister. Trust me it turned out super delicious. It was first time that i added oyster sauce and ketchup...my sister loved it and i love it so much that i am add it everytime whenever i am gonna cook spaghetti again ...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRL1dpxNb4GGtbWxzehqsMzXuwLToPXMVSvYsYu4gMkdB/1779135333368.jpg)

See yaa guyz...i hope you like it.

title.title: Bad times come when...
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTdi8Eqe49857ZyFr8D3xPyYwfcyLgJvFPyPP5LyLTjj7/image.png)

Bad times come when the darkness within becomes as impenetrable as the night itself around.

The bad parts come when no one is waiting for you anymore and your whole world here and now is a small closed room with a small dim window. Is that better than prison? At least... there are no unpleasant neighbors and guards.

Bad times come when you realize that the limits of your strength have been exhausted and the abyss is just a step away.

Bad times are when you choose which way is better. Painful or even more painful.

Bad times are coming. For some, these are the last bad times. But someone will be able to weather this storm. To survive.

---

title.title: Droid Territory.
title.body: > After navigating the exploded dam, I encountered the giant creature before suffering an elevator mishap caused by a droid. After dismantling the bots and surviving a barrage of heavy explosives, I used my special abilities to move a box, wall-run, and pull a rope to reach a mysterious small animal. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVf14eUW17NHqFLErE1dwgU677AxoY1kM9AXF7gzLkwCM/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMgMLciuWifoGtFcqoUVY3qBHU2m1CaHcjY8Y6ZZ9bcR/screenshot_2_.png) Now that my path ahead was higher with the exploded dam, I jumped in there to cross the newly formed gap. I was getting closer to the giant creature at last, watching its massive form loom over the landscape as I advanced. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBAMy6Kzajs8RaKSguzpbHJiw22AKXnKysWKKtgVEVE2/screenshot_3_.png) After getting close to it, the creature acted like a domestic animal when BD-1 tried to get close to inspect it. The little droid almost became food of the creature when it got closer as the creature was eating something at that moment. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaGMLeXf7HmdRfg5YYBJyWd6NC2aFj8k6TVhVgNkZSnXa/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjjsN8sUmTw3bdidCByKGZYNj1Lz5Kxhcd5skCKg3RH8/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyipUxqxEqtVBcitm5egn1ac3mgohdganQt6s2xzZiXX/screenshot_6_.png) I pressed the switch of the elevator to descend into the facility, but after getting down, a droid attacked me unexpectedly. I fell on the switch again during the scuffle, which made the elevator go up again before I could finish the fight. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWNBWDfAcoZiNxov9HwQFRqZUYpzGfyQsEV8BsnUDiSmw/screenshot_7_.png) Upon returning below after the frustrating elevator ride, I sliced the bot into two pieces with my lightsaber. The metal scrap hissed and sparked on the concrete floor, ensuring it would not disrupt my mechanical transit a second time. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5tSS4LD3eSAkDX4pbHBJ4utixbbXbDh766qNHJpYCEg/screenshot_8_.png) Then I kept moving through the lower corridors and found this bot off guard patrolling a narrow walkway. I took it down easily with a single strike from behind, moving forward before the rest of the sector could notice. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVGJwBywuGu9MTN4iNnWUUDxRfsgu8sDQUrSQqRMZNcd/screenshot_9_.png) Then I jumped on this container-like box where I took down an alien insect or worm that was nesting on the metal. The entire place was filled with droids marching in tight formations, making stealth completely impossible. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPB1kDsLeEEbXKcURwNGqn9YHmWZvUVEkDpx1r8QpGqvE/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbqpTXDA1hQJt5jyAS4k7cwENWoqe3WeqTgXAY6KufLze/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUCo94Mo1Hy24JqaQvzYDitvAq3oVyKAkN7pMC7i3pKFw/screenshot_12_.png) The droids started attacking me as soon as they saw me, and I was trying to escape as one of them was shooting with heavy explosives. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfXP1NFY2VpfFTDiG419QRSkQdHPWuJYoU4M4qV44TJK/screenshot_13_.png) Then I took down all the droids one by one until I took down this one that was shooting with all those explosives. Neutralizing that heavy gunner finally allowed me to breathe and survey the wreckage around me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3DjH4bMF3WbqyyYsoeKXexJ62KpMGy1L9z8oHBXNGSi/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVL2DyyXNpeawszrSYNA69PcMLQZyebnsvLwzXtPh1jd/screenshot_15_.png) I noticed this small creature on a height who was not attacking me and was not escaping as well as I approached. So I was trying to find a way to get there to see if it was friendly or hiding something. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFm6kTb8462uMeWsX2RDA7NR5gq1x1bPYaristCHWgQ5/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY3cBKKkvKD3Zs5QFUfXYkYbPRnVsmzr8Q7Wz2ZGwp81Q/screenshot_17_.png) After moving a big box with my special ability, I tried a wall run along the wall. And then I found this rope that I could use to swing across that gap and get to that creature, so I used my special ability to pull that rope toward me. That's all for this session. More moments coming soon and thanks for checking it out. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=ridwanan/1dfb1f46)
