body.title: Healing Angry Hearts With Love
body.body:
> *In this life, I believe there is no smoke without fire. The way people act is often a reflection of what life has put them through…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf4uYKVmJUqe5cfd8GK8kdKyGSqkV2sY7TL6kTM6XjsYY/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/anime-raining-anger-fantasy-street-8648011/) *When someone gets angry easily, it could be that they need love, or their heart is heavy and unhappy. Some people are deeply hurt, and any little thing can piss them off. It is rare to see a truly happy and fulfilled person getting angry unnecessarily…* *I have been there too. Sometime around 2011, I was heartbroken, and it changed me completely. From being that guy who tolerated almost everything and rarely got angry, I became an angry bird. Every little thing pissed me off, and hardly a week passed without me getting into a fight. It took time before I finally healed and stopped getting mad unnecessarily…* *So most times when I see someone who gets angry easily, I try to avoid them if we are not close. But if they are my friends, I observe and try to understand what they might be going through that triggered such behavior…*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVUe8gTXpxXTi1tfmBpPwyK5rHAoYH3aaCxadxxtRrYi/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/anime-raining-anger-fantasy-8647945/) *Life has gone beyond being hot-tempered because if we truly think about the consequences it can bring, we would pray to be delivered from such a spirit. That is the story I am about to share*… *There were once two close friends. Wherever you saw T, just know P was nearby. They were well known in the neighborhood, always outside in the evenings playing ludo together…* *On one fateful day, they were playing as usual when an argument suddenly started. Before anyone knew it, it escalated. People tried to settle the fight, but T was hot-tempered and refused to listen. In anger, he punched P, but unfortunately, the punch landed on P’s gullet, and he died instantly…* *Every attempt to save P was in vain. He was gone.* *T regretted fighting his best friend. It was the first time anything like that had happened between them. If only he had listened when people tried to settle the fight… but it was already too late. His best friend was gone, and he was sentenced to life imprisonment for taking another person’s life…* *His hot temper led to the death of his best friend and also destroyed his own life. What a wasted life…* *Stories like this are what made me stop fighting because you never truly know who is who. Many people are walking corpses, only waiting for someone to send them on their way. May we never fall victim. That is why we must be careful not to pick fights with anyone*… *God has taken control over my life. I am no longer hot-tempered because my heart has finally found peace.* *The best way to handle hot-tempered people is to show them love. Most of them are fighting battles within, and love can help heal whatever is making them angry. Once their hearts find peace, their anger will calm down, and they will learn to temper mercy with justice*.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmYqm3H4dEWQEzhzEVJtQvgJdDfs9oHtT2zS317xwPbU7C/image.png
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/b0s/23xB1Qv5bDBKikqiaiUcfQtaV6mbBnVYbZhJDdQZihpL3Aia58kuMfk19qGgp5TZRu8ro.jpg
https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZZuDr3arGngLn5SfCF6yHQm9yLP3Zkhzm5DodpnhqhH/imageedit_1_5025017951.jpg
**Just call me Burl.** *I am a professional gamer, motivational speaker and a crypto enthusiast* *Discord: burlarj* *Twitter id: burlarj1* *Telegram: burlarj* **God exists, I am a living testimony** **Giving up is not an option, every hustler has a payday** **Don't wish for it, Make it happen** **Only Love can heal a broken Heart** https://images.hive.blog/DQmRsJumvd4V6DGi3Pz1U4cqJmGZ6cowSrPhSqaYMnTKmVZ/3W72119s5BjW4PvRk9nXBzqrPWMsMTjNrXDPFFf11Me3xJu2FYAtZ1bFbvoF8BV4Jvf39axwiTNRZ9CsVGpdLBDvqA7jzfww3N2FxWmttUQLjn59xwxU29.gif

body.title: ‎LOH 289 || Running on Empty: When Being Busy Starts Feeling Too Heavy
body.body:
Hi Hive,
‎
Lately, I have  started realizing that feeling like I never have enough time may not really mean there are not enough hours in the day. Sometimes, it’s a sign that I’m trying to push beyond my own mental and physical limits while pretending everything is still going smoothly.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPVpwkEm9a2VMpTpQrNsakJrhB4m2yVemvTQeqs4XYKM3/pexels-man-1867887_1920.jpg 

‎[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-muscles-portrait-muscular-1867887/)
‎
‎There are days when I wake up already thinking about unfinished tasks. Between responsibilities, goals, social expectations, and personal ambitions, it can feel like my mind is constantly racing. I sometimes tell myself to Just do a little more, but that little more gradually becomes exhaustion. And the truth is, trying to do everything all at once can silently drain both the body and the mind.
‎
‎One situation that has made me feel like I’m doing too much recently is trying to balance productivity with rest. I always want to stay active, improve myself, chase opportunities, and remain consistent with my goals. But I sometimes ignore simple signs from my body like  lack of sleep, mental fatigue, irritability, and even moments where I struggle to focus properly while doing all of that. And I keep pushing instead of slowing down, because I don’t want to feel unproductive.
‎
‎And another thing that contributes to this feeling is the pressure of wanting to meet everyone’s expectations while also meeting my own too. I often say yes to too many things because I don’t want to disappoint people or miss opportunities. But the workload eventually becomes overwhelming, and I notice that I’m no longer enjoying the things I once felt excited about.
‎
‎I have also realized that constantly comparing my pace to other people can create unwanted pressure. Social media often makes it seem like everyone else is succeeding so quick, working harder, and achieving more. That mindset can make rest feel like laziness, even when rest is exactly what is actually needed.
‎
‎Lately, I have been learning that productivity should not come at the cost of peace of mind. Taking breaks, sleeping properly, and allowing myself moments of stillness are not signs of weakness. Because they are necessary for long-term  balance and growth.
‎
‎And at the end of the day, I’m beginning to understand that I don’t always need to do more. Sometimes, I simply need to slow down enough to breathe, reset, and respect my own limits.
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy/loh-289-running-on-empty-when-being-busy-starts-feeling-too-heavy-2k1)

body.body: It really happens a lot. Even when you decide to give someone a gift one day, and the next day you urgently need something and decide to ask—they say, \

😩

I'm the kind of person who doesn't like to talk, but if I feel I'm being misunderstood, I ask them what I've been saying so far to see if they comprehend.

Among peers who are angels of insults, I always have to disappear over and over again. What's the use of saying something when they already have a frame they want your words to fit into? No one is always able to give a perfect response to a question.

Anyway, you're doing your best, and you don't have to feel depressed about being misunderstood. Try to slow down a bit to see if they are understanding you mid-speech as you talk—unless it's a short reply. Be ready to explain things too. I also used to hate doing that because I was always in issues of: \
Public speaking isn't a day job. One has to be in it to be it if they don't have the natural talent.\n\nHave a nice day

body.title: A sinner save by Grace  thank God I am alive
body.body:
![20260518_100237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23wqgQhbsye9TshwN4Z3n1kFF56bRNTfRbbpDk2BvwvcFaBfcckTPsYFokVa523UdyRhP.jpg)

![20260518_100213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23yJNxydBziwK1qY8u4nXksYiayzBmtun7W8M1RZXP1sBfpQpVHwDsSTZQuEB2z2Zo7ge.jpg)
What a rare and precious gift I received today. Until you’ve faced a moment where it feels like the next few minutes are uncertain, you may never truly understand the beauty and privilege of simply being alive.
I woke up this morning full of hope, strength, and enthusiasm, but suddenly my body began acting in a way that completely contradicted how I felt inside. In those moments, I genuinely felt helpless, as though life was slipping away from me. So many thoughts rushed through my mind, and honestly, I feared I might not make it through.
But God showed up for me once again and reminded me that He is not done writing my story. Through the series of tests, examinations, injections, and medications, 
![20260518_111907.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23uFm6W6Ub8Lt1UBkQg5JQm84XEe2Tw4i6jXE117pzNLHv1bmAR4k2BbAdG2eSkUu5bwr.jpg)


![20260518_111930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23xAkfEKxQ6KqHGTkkUiug9HruSdvUfibauv8mk6z7nHuY66UfTFXGUnGsVVJhSoZeAhM.jpg)![IMG-20260518-WA0012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobywalter/23tmDgneqN3wApcrRXqu8iuvNNEzZCm3c8Td9q6ji1Fh12WPAefLBz2mY6sNHTPMwQ7xZ.jpg)

He gave me another chance to stand on my feet again.
Today, I am back home with my family, stronger, grateful, and deeply reassured that the gift of life is truly priceless. I do not take this second chance for granted, and I pray for many more beautiful years filled with purpose, joy, and good health.
To everyone checking up on me, praying for me, and showing love, thank you so much. I appreciate every message, call, and concern more than words can explain
**Thanks for visiting my blog @tobywalter cares**❤ 💕 ❤

body.title: Weekly StreetArt #218 (🎁 : 1 HBD to share)
body.body:
Like every Monday, here comes the time for [**Weekly StreetArt**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), your dose of weekly Street Art. It was a beautiful week in Montreal, still a little cool in the morning. But it's perfect for discovering #StreetArt by bike without sweating too much 😀.

> *Comme chaque lundi, voici venir le temps du [**Weekly StreetArt**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), votre dose de Street Art hebdomadaire. Cela fut une belle semaine sur Montréal, encore un peu frais le matin. Mais c'est parfait pour découvrir du #StreetArt en vélo sans trop suer* 😀.

![Cryote, WaxHead & Labrona](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/Ep5nfX5kReRwfMC6t7JHPGPhyGh3tDMXo1zYQxYR8zJ84vmBYTYt56Ej9ZGtehFnN88.jpg)

To illustrate this **Weekly StreetArt**, I present to you a set of works done by [**Cryote**](https://www.instagram.com/cryote.pup/), [**Labrona**](https://www.instagram.com/labronaoner/) and [**WaxHead**](https://www.instagram.com/waxheadart/). It was a few years ago, but I went back to this alley in the Plateau, Montreal's neighborhood, to see if there had been any change. But nothing... see [StreetArt #396](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-396-waxhead-alley-part-i-montreal), [StreetArt #397](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-397-waxhead-alley-part-ii-montreal) and [StreetArt #398](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-398-waxhead-alley-part-iii-montreal).

> *Pour illustrer ce **Weekly StreetArt**, je vous présente un petit ensemble de [**Cryote**](https://www.instagram.com/cryote.pup/), [**Labrona**](https://www.instagram.com/labronaoner/) et [**WaxHead**](https://www.instagram.com/waxheadart/). Cela date de quelques années, mais je suis repassé dans cette ruelle du Plateau pour voir si il y avait eu du changement. Mais rien... voir [StreetArt #396](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-396-waxhead-alley-part-i-montreal), [StreetArt #397](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-397-waxhead-alley-part-ii-montreal) et [StreetArt #398](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-398-waxhead-alley-part-iii-montreal).*

![Cryote](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xKxegDuKeLKRs5vMXNi6UUDD8x39BW94qbTCASWgnt229uJvRVNjTB5ao82N4TC5UGx.jpg)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)
# Last Week

| Members	| New Members	| Active Users | Nb Posts	| Ecency Points	|
|-|-|-|-|-|
| **1718** 🔼 | **1** 🔼 | **50** 🔼  | **16** 🔼 | **140.250** 🔼 |

This week, the [**Street Art**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784) community welcomed **1 new member**. Activity picked up slightly last week. We must have had trouble taking off. Fortunately, the regulars continue to post #StreetArt from their region every week. Still so appreciated. Welcome to the New 🔽

> *Cette semaine, la communauté [**Street Art**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784) a accueilli **1 nouveau membre**. L'activité a légèrement repris la semaine dernière. Nous avons dû mal à décoller. Heureusement que les réguliers continuent de poster du #StreetArt de leur région chaque semaine. Toujours aussi apprécié. Bienvenu au nouveau* :

| | | | |
| - | - | - | - |
| @fmsanchezart | | | |
|  |  |  |  |	

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

# Selection

🏆 **The 3 picks of the week**
Here are the three posts that caught my eye this week. As always, this choice is subjective - our community is brimming with quality posts!

For each publication highlighted in the Weekly StreetArt :
* Feel free to check out the photos and original texts on the posts (they're definitely worth a look!). 
* Don't forget to leave an upvote to encourage the creators!

**Important for the selected authors: Please indicate your award preference (HIVE or HBD) in the comments below this post.**

The images shown here are previews only - **discover the complete works by visiting the original publications!**

***

🏆 ***Les 3 sélections de la semaine**
Voici les trois articles qui ont retenu mon attention cette semaine. Comme toujours, ce choix est subjectif - notre communauté regorge de posts de qualité !*

*Pour chaque publication mise en avant* :
* *N'hésitez pas à consulter les photos et les textes originaux sur les posts (elles valent vraiment le détour !)*
* *Pensez à laisser un upvote pour encourager les créateurs*

***Important pour les auteurs sélectionnés : Merci d'indiquer votre préférence de récompense (HIVE ou HBD) en commentaire sous ce post.***

*Les images présentées ici ne sont que des aperçus - **découvrez les œuvres complètes en visitant les publications originales !***

***

## @florecitamejias - Ortuño Mató - La Guaira (Venezuela)

![01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23xVCmxduCjHgT9ta6H9NPDhvCKQftuFLJPo31AhVKYtnYYhJGqYMQaGq1s2fpKqBaDTA.jpg)

It's always interesting to see several works by the same artist in a post. We can better understand his artistic approach. Here **@florecitamejias** introduces us to **Ortuño Mató**, an artist who writes sentences that make you think and smile in the streets of the city. And she had the chance to see him at work, really cool. Thank you for this discovery.

***

> *C'est toujours intéressant de voir dans un post plusieurs oeuvres du même artiste. On peut mieux comprendre sa démarche artistique. Ici **@florecitamejias** nous présente **Ortuño Mató**, un artiste qui écrit des phrases qui font réfléchir et sourire dans les rues de la ville. Et elle a eu la chance de le voir en plein travail, vraiment cool. Merci pour cette découverte.*

**📰** [**An artist in my city: Ortuño Mató**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@florecitamejias/an-artist-in-my-city-ortuno-mato)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## @luchyl - Aba (Nigeria)

![02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ywyYP5N3JipLRKX6V2jNtrmZhX93L9ARyoFvq5VTohTGn48HZh4RqQqWituCTk9yZyJ.jpg)

Then we cross the Atlantic Ocean with a superb selection of works photographed by **@luchyl** in Aba, Nigeria. All the pillars of a passage were painted by different artists. An unwelcoming place is transformed into a #StreetArt museum. I advise you to take a look at his post to see all this, it's worth a look.

***

> *Puis nous traversons l'océan Atlantique avec une superbe sélection d'oeuvres photographiée par **@luchyl** à Aba au Nigéria. Tous les piliers d'un passage ont été peints par différents artistes. Un endroit peu accueillant se transforme ainsi en un musée #StreetArt. Je vous conseille d'aller faire un tour sur son post pour voir tout cela, cela vaut le coup d'oeil.*

**📰** [**The Underpass Gallery!**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@luchyl/the-underpass-gallery--gbs)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## @vesytz - Alexandria (Greece)

![03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23zbMTy7ub7AhMoTFa8txG5pu3cQjq1gfLHN5rvqDERZVygcC2v7Pukf4TEoeSYYRSELB.jpg)

It's always cool when in a **Weekly StreetArt** we visit 3 different continents. Here we're in Greece where another initiative is beautifying the city. Instead of leaving electrical boxes in their original, gray and dull state, they become perfect canvases for artists to demonstrate their talent. Thank you **@vesytze** for these photos...

***

> *C'est toujours cool quand dans un **Weekly StreetArt**, nous visitons 3 continents différents. Nous voià en Grèce où une autre initiative enjolive la ville. Au lieu de laisser les boitiers électriques dans leur état d'origine, gris et ennuyant, ils deviennent des toiles parfaites pour que les artistes démontrent tout leur talent. Merci **@vesytze** pour ces photos...*

**📰** [**Street art in Alexandria**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@vesytz/street-art-in-alexandria)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)
	
**Have a great week full of StreetArt**.
***Très bonne semaine à tous remplie de StreetArt***

body.title: Blanco y negro  / Black and white
body.body:
En un día soleado en la hermosa playa , en Iquique, Chile, tuvimos el honor de capturar a María Pérez, de 24 años, en esta serie de fotografías únicas. Con su figura esbelta, su largo cabello y su piel llena de arte e historias grabadas en tinta, María accedió a posar para nosotros en una sesión especial en blanco y negro. Este estilo resalta de forma mágica su belleza natural, la fuerza de sus tatuajes y la esencia tranquila y libre que transmite. Entre las olas y las dunas características de esta zona costera, cada imagen refleja su personalidad auténtica, segura y llena de vida, logrando una conexión perfecta entre ella y el paisaje icónico de Iquique.

> On a sunny day at the beautiful beach in Iquique, Chile, we had the honor of capturing 24-year-old María Pérez in this series of unique photographs. With her slender figure, long hair, and skin adorned with art and stories etched in ink, María agreed to pose for us in a special black and white session. This style magically highlights her natural beauty, the power of her tattoos, and the calm, free spirit she exudes. Amidst the waves and dunes characteristic of this coastal area, each image reflects her authentic, confident, and vibrant personality, achieving a perfect connection between her and the iconic landscape of Iquique.

body.title: Iron Knots, Concrete Scars / Nudos de Hierro, Cicatrices de Concreto (Eng/Esp)
body.body: /> I'm fascinated by how light and shadow can transform simple, industrial objects into visual art. In this shot, the contrast between the twisted wire and the textured concrete creates a narrative of tension and resilience. The black and white strips away everything unnecessary, leaving only the pure form and the power of the texture. >

>Me fascina cómo la luz y la sombra pueden transformar objetos simples e industriales en arte visual. En esta toma, el contraste entre el alambre retorcido y el concreto texturizado crea una narrativa de tensión y resistencia. El blanco y negro despoja todo lo innecesario para dejar solo la forma pura y la fuerza de la textura

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctgmk9nonWJTXmiC6HWgRcdQao2PM51sZE6FWgUrW2eQ/1779134351662.jpg)





My Neighbor Alice (ALICE) just posted a sharp +18.52% gain on Binance today, spiking from a low of $0.1201 to a high of $0.1560 on volume of 28.14 million ALICE worth $3.97 million USDT. The chart shows weeks of slow grinding lower  then one explosive green candle that blew through all three EMAs simultaneously. Here's the full story.

What Is My Neighbor Alice?

My Neighbor Alice is a fully on-chain multiplayer game built on the Chromia blockchain, with a strong focus on self-expression, collaboration, and community. Players explore, gather resources, craft unique NFTs, and shape their own virtual world in the Lummelunda Archipelago  making it the first 3D MMO game built entirely on-chain.  
ALICE is both a governance token and an in-game currency  used to purchase NFT assets in-game, participate in governance decisions, stake for yield, and even collateralize NFTs for lending.  Real utility, not just speculation.

Catalyst 1  Chapter One Is Live With 82,000 Players.

The launch of Chapter One A New Adventure in July 2025 marked a major milestone for the project  opening to over 82,000 accounts and representing the most significant gameplay expansion in the game's history.   82,000 active players on a blockchain game is substantial  most Web3 games struggle to reach even 10,000. Real users driving real demand for ALICE tokens to purchase in-game assets.

Catalyst 2  Pudgy Penguins Partnership.

A significant partnership with Pudgy Penguins integrates thousands of their NFTs directly into the My Neighbor Alice game universe  bridging two communities and enhancing creativity, cross-platform interoperability, and asset utility for both ecosystems.   Pudgy Penguins is one of the most valuable NFT collections in the world. Bringing their holders into Alice's world creates a powerful new demand source for ALICE tokens.

Catalyst 3  500,000 ALICE Airdrop Campaign.

The project is running its largest-ever ALICE Adventure Airdrop  distributing 500,000 tokens to engage active players and grow the community.  Airdrops create immediate engagement spikes and social media buzz and with altcoin season narratives heating up across crypto, gaming tokens are capturing disproportionate attention right now.

The Altcoin Season Gaming Narrative.

ALICE was specifically noted among altcoins gaining traction during market rallies in March 2026, and consistently appears on top NFT gaming lists  underscoring its established position as a foundational GameFi project.   In altcoin season rotations, gaming tokens with real playable products  not just roadmap promises  are the first to see capital inflows.

The Technical Picture Is Classic Breakout.

The Binance 1H chart tells the complete story. Price ground lower slowly from the left side of the chart all the way down to $0.1201  a new multi-month low  then bounced aggressively with a single candle that ripped through EMA(25) at 0.1323, EMA(50) at 0.1319, and EMA(100) at 0.1338 all in one move. Volume at the spike hit 15.7 million ALICE over 6x the MA(10) of 2.61M. That is not retail  that is whale-level accumulation at the lows.

title.body: ballpoint pen on paper, mounted on 9\

for framing

**1. Left is past Right is Future,** Also, top – past, middle – present, bottom - future

**Past** - rain clouds and confusion - the sun comes out and becomes the Source point, it's rays penetrate your crown and the energy flows down in and through your body, enlightening you.

**Present** - Present - Your guides are present with you, healing you and giving you all the information you need. All you have to do is ask. You do have a block - 

**Present to Future** - you are ready to bring your message to the world - you have been ready for a long time.

**2. Mirror Image** 
The artwork should be read as a mirror image of you.

**3. Sun** in the center surrounded by clouds at the top - again - there was confusion in the past but the Sun (Son) (God) broke through the confusion and lights up your life.

**4. Clouds** with flat bottoms cutting off the top 8th of the page - Rain clouds - Anvil Clouds - Rain refreshes the air and brings cosmic energy to the earth.

**5. X’s in the Clouds** - X's are a theme of this drawing...

**6. Sun shining through** the bottom of the clouds - the Sun (Son)(God) is a your Source

**7. More rain on the right than on the left** manifestation of your message has been difficult due to trapped emotions in the block

**8. Angel Wings and Butterfly Wings** of Guides come through the clouds to top
This means your guides have been with you from Past to Future - they are part of your whole incarnation here in this realm.

**9. You are left of center looking to the left** – past – fixated - perhaps it is a block from the past that must be reviewed for your renewal

**10. On the left there is an angel** kissing the top of your head – **X** for kiss **X** marks the spot

**11. She is praying** and has a spiral on her right wrist

**12. You are a mermaid.** We see your tail emerging from the lower left corner. A mermaid can swim to the deep cold depths of intuition and emotion and also survive in the air and on the land, but she is more comfortable in the water – spiritual realm.

**13. The Sun rays enter through your crown** – in X’s  - 7 X’s –  the bottom 2 X's are in infinity symbols - this reflects the root and sacral chakras

**14. a triple helix** - you are holding in your left hand - a piece of seaweed that ends in a triple helix on one end and to infinity symbols on the other end. It flows over your pinky finger. A wand...is an extension of your energy - like a pendulum...
 
**15. Pinky finger** of the left hand. The pinky finger is Mercury - communication - Intuition - Intelligence - Mental Powers - Feminine Influence (left)

**16. Winged heart bursting forth** from your heart and the water – with an open eye on it - your calling - bursting out from your place of comfort - the spiritual realm - into the air to fly free - guided by the window to your soul..

**17. Fingers crossed** on right hand – pointing upwards. Index and middle fingers – **The index finger** represents Jupiter - leadership, authority, ambition, and self-confidence. **The middle finger** represents Saturn & Ether, symbolizes balance, stability, responsibility, and inner strength, serving as the central anchor that maintains equilibrium in life. - governs discipline, karma, and the law of cause and effect. Crossed on the right hand. Balance, stability, leadership crossed with discipline, karma. – in the masculine – action – **in the world**.

**18. Butterfly Girl** on the right – sends information into your right ear, while sending energy through her fingers into your head – jaw – base of the skull

**19.Snake** on your left side of your head. **Usually indicates a block** – a source or need for transformation, since snakes shed their skin. Release it through dowsing.

**20. The triple helix merges into the waves**
**21. The waves oppose** - 4 waves go to the right and 4 go to the left merging at the triple helix
**22. Below the mermaid tail fin** is fire / water / flames and waves
**23. There is also a moon shape** under your arm – it is a Last Quarter Moon. Endings.

X’s mean “good luck”; the crossroads, the interconnection between the physical and the spiritual world, and crossing your fingers behind your back means that you secretly cancel out the promise you are making with your mouth. Sometimes we have to lie to liars or a dishonest system requires a lie to interact with it.

In this case the fingers are crossed in front and with the right hand, therefore that is a symbol of the interception of justice and mercy.

title.body:
![1000298921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/23vi1sd6GEtPDWBZQyKd9SPhhkDY4jNhyc4jY2XvqcDoCzQVxyQspJwxDkmMqDMx34dFr.jpg)

Hola hola para toda la gente hermosa que le encanta comer y cocinar de @hivefood un gusto volver a saludarlos y pasar por aquí a leer sus post, guardar recetas, tips y lugares super lindos para disfrutar de una buena comida 

>Hello to all the wonderful people who love to eat and cook at @hivefood! It's a pleasure to greet you all again and stop by to read your posts, save recipes, tips, and discover super cute places to enjoy!

El día de hoy les voy a mostrar el paso a paso de mi desayuno diferente jeje. Estilo de tacos con tortilla de arepa. yo amo las arepas las podría comer todos los días de desayuno o cena, pero no puedo por el sibo y que a mi esposo tampoco le gusta mucho. 

>Today I'm going to show you step-by-step how to make my different kind of breakfast, hehe. Taco-style with arepa tortillas. I love arepas; I could eat them every day for breakfast or dinner, but I can't.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Tenía ya varias semanas sin comer arepa así que estaba con muchas ganas, inicie preparando la masa que es harina de maiz precocido con sal y agua , darle mano hasta obtener una masa homogénea, suave y que no se parta. 

>I hadn't eaten arepas for several weeks, so I was really craving them. I started by preparing the dough, which is precooked corn flour with salt and water, kneading it until I obtained a smooth, homogeneous dough.

![1000298922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/AK3gC4LS96xpsc5zbMg2KnqmKT6exPzCZ63SdmQqsE3UBus8W7B4rLrCTmiJG3X.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Seguidamente agarre una bolsita plástica, coloque un chorrito de aceite para que no se pegue nada. Puse una bolita de masa y la aplasté muy bien para que me quedara muy delgada como una tortilla

>Next, I took a small plastic bag and put a little oil in it so nothing would stick. I placed a small ball of dough inside and flattened it very thin, like a tortilla.

![1000298923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/AK57WV7cE1eyQUDc8irehjyMHdfVLU9cMMtiJ2RJ6nFsM5uK5yMmQobCmA5zgtL.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Esto fue directo a un budare o plancha bien caliente y con un poquito de grasa 

>This went straight onto a very hot griddle or flat iron with a little bit of grease. 

![1000285122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/Ep7ve2Y51tWHrgWm4YeBkraYGFxb8wwGDeKv6jBwrAk64oW7Vpxn3jU2Lqs5hG8byLP.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Al mismo tiempo estaba picando unos aliños como cebolla y tomate, lo puse a sofreír cuando agregué un poquito de carne que tenía cortada en cuadritos pequeños 

>At the same time I was chopping some seasonings like onion and tomato, I put it to sauté when I added a little bit of meat that I had cut into small cubes 

![1000298924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/AK3fwgUm6Z9g5er7WEeYBKsSiPneZfgUxoE1STGhaj5azchYYaRe7VCrykpMwhZ.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Cuando la carne estuvo lista agregué cuatro huevos y revolvi muy bien , tuve que cambiar de sartén debido a que el otro se pegó y quemó .

>When the meat was ready, I added four eggs and stirred very well. I had to change pans because the other one stuck and burned.

![1000298926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/AK6Yze6kqyz3e1u5vroqgPrvvxt9oga1X6iHG8PyggrK2dp81mFMghhCevBwBSo.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Cuando tenía la tortilla y el revoltillo de huevo listo me puse a lavar y cortar un poco de tomate y lechuga para agregarle un toque a mi preparación 

>When I had the omelet and the scrambled eggs ready, I started washing and chopping some tomato and lettuce to add a touch to my preparation 

![1000285150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/EpGRjDKkRGDrxbDhFwcVye2Fk3baHwNWBaburMt39SJbowKP5c163HCkxFoV5j1Dk6N.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Y así fui armando puse la tortilla, seguidamente el revoltillo de huevo y carne , luego la lechuga y el tomate y por último pero no menos importante una cantidad generosa de queso 

>And so I assembled it: I put down the tortilla, then the scrambled eggs and meat, then the lettuce and tomato, and last but not least, a generous amount of cheese. 

![1000298933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/AK57XADfX5dcBXdBdJLQQWDmwmcfFCS1CRgjx9oo8tmztxQ1WsgDkoNsR4kHWA3.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Y así de fácil y delicioso quedó mi desayuno también lo pueden hacer para cenas o para compartir una tarde en familia, espero les guste tanto como a mi . Feliz día 

>And that's how easy and delicious my breakfast turned out! You can also make it for dinner or to share an afternoon with your family. I hope you like it as much as I do. Have a great day! 

![1000285170.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/EoiVg2Dq7WZAxqLbTfLGP95MiKwh53k8UpCJj1uqA8AEMYThd1HfFJcjzVw3pySDGgH.jpg)

Hey,hello friends.How are you all? I hope you are all well.I am also well.So today I will introduce you to a very interesting and very fun game which I am playing for the first time today.The name of the game is Zombie Highway 2.When I first entered the game, I found myself being dropped off on a highway in a car, and I was driving it, and zombies were attacking me from the side of the road and trying to flip the car over, so I used my intelligence to hit those zombies with any object on the road and shoot them.

So that's how I could kill the zombies and it's a very nice game you will have a lot of fun playing this game.The game usually has very nice graphics and often you will be given a desert, meaning there will be a highway in the middle and a desert-like area on the sides, and from there the lands will attack you.The game has a collection of different types of guns. You can change your gun to kill the enemies if you want, and different guns have different powers. You can kill zombies with one shot at a friend, and some guns will not kill zombies even after multiple shots.And there are different types of cars in the game. 

If you want, you can change your car to your liking, you can also change the color of the car and make various modifications.Many times in the game you will be sent down a tunnel in the dark. There you will have to kill the zombies by turning on the headlights in the car and you will have to get out of there very intelligently because the place is very dark and you cannot see anything well there.I really like the system of this game because I have never played such a beautiful game before, so I present it to you.

So, you all will be fine. I will try to give you more such beautiful gaming videos like this.

title.title: The Tale of Sunny - ENG- SPA
title.body: > It seems unbelievable, but there's only one week left until the big day Sunny has been waiting for so long: her musical anniversary. She's been waiting for this moment for ages to celebrate in style with all her fans. She still remembers her early years in music with such love that it brings tears to her eyes; it was an unforgettable experience. That's why she wants to relive it and celebrate it with those who were with her from the beginning. She's a professional pianist and singer who has always strived to make good music and please her fans. With only a week to go, she's finalizing the details for the big event she's planning. She wants to hold an outdoor concert for all her fans. She'll play for them all day long; it will be an unforgettable concert. She plans to play her best songs that day. She's already booked and paid for the venue in advance because she knows it will be secure and there won't be any cancellations. She's also hired musicians, stagehands, makeup artists, and a little bit of everything. This event has required a significant investment, but it's worth it to celebrate. But just when everything seemed to be going perfectly, things took a turn for the worse. Sunny was warned that a severe storm was expected that day, the day of her big concert. The storm would make it impossible to hold an outdoor concert as she had originally planned. This disrupted all her plans and forced her to completely change everything.

> Parece mentira pero solo falta una semana para el gran día que Sunny lleva esperando desde hace ya tanto tiempo. Su aniversario musical. Lleva esperando este momento este momento desde hace mucho para poder celebrarlo en grande con todos sus admiradores. Aún recuerda con tanto amor los primeros años en la música que la hacen llorar de emoción, fue una experiencia irrepetible. Por eso quiere recordarla y celebrarla junto con los que estuvieron con ella desde el principio. Ella es una pianista y cantante profesional que se ha esforzado al máximo siempre por hacer buena música y complacer a sus admiradores. Como solo falta una semana ella está ultimando los detalles para el gran evento que está preparando. Quiere hacer un concierto al aire libre con todos los fans. Tocará para todos ellos el día completo, será un concierto inolvidable. Planea tocar sus mejores canciones ese día. Ya reservó y pagó el lugar del evento por adelantando, porque sabe que será seguro y no habrá cancelaciones. También ha contratado músicos, puesta en escena, maquillistas y de todo un poco. Este evento ha llevado una buena inversión pero vale la pena para celebrarlo. Pero cuando todo parecía que iba a salir de lo mejor las cosas empeoraron. Sunny fue avisada que habría una fuerte tormenta ese día que tenía planeado el gran concierto. La tormenta haría imposible hacer un concierto al aire libre como ella tenía pensado en un inicio. Esto trastocó todos sus planes y la obligó a cambiar por completo todo.
![pawel-kielar-2porVj8NKfg-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uFRMjcM5XbFcvK7LaGPKGwJN2r4rLR314x5VcHNiJVepaSCzVqxEVqQzNGDgTTc6rdZ.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> She was extremely worried because with so little time left—about three days—there wasn't enough time to rent and prepare another venue. It was a terrible situation. She cursed time for ruining her plans, but no one can fight time. Since there was no other solution, she had to think clearly to find a realistic solution that didn't involve postponing the concert. At least she knew that an outdoor concert was out of the question. Several of her fellow musicians recommended changing the date, but she disagreed. How could she celebrate an anniversary on a different day? She wanted it to be on the exact day and time she started in music. It would be a proper anniversary, on the exact date and time. With two days to go, she looked for options to see if she could change the venue to an indoor one. But there wasn't one as big as the one she needed. And a small one wouldn't work because the idea was for as many people as possible to see her. He also had the idea of ​​putting up a strong nylon tarp over the first shop he'd seen, so people wouldn't get wet. But the winds would be so strong they'd surely rip it off. With every solution he came up with, new problems appeared. It was a real nuisance. He almost thought about giving up since there wasn't much else he could do. Besides, people wouldn't go to a shop, even one with a roof, in the middle of a bad storm that could cause havoc. There was only one day left, so it seemed he'd have to cancel everything; there was no other option.

> Ella estaba súper preocupada porque en tan poco tiempo que quedaba, unos 3 días no daba tiempo a alquilar y preparar otro local. Era terrible aquella situación. Maldijo al tiempo por haberle arruinado sus planes, pero nadie puede contra el tiempo. Dado que ya no había solución tenía que pensar con la cabeza fría para poder encontrar una solución realista que no implicara posponer el concierto. Al menos ya sabía que al aire libre no se podría. Varios de sus compañeros músicos le recomendaron cambiar el día, pero ella no estaba de acuerdo. Como iba a celebrar un aniversario en otro día que no era. Ella quería que fuera el mismo día y hora en el que comenzó en la música. Sería un aniversario con todas las de la ley, cumpliendo hora y día. Faltando dos días buscó alguna opción para ver si se podía cambiar el local por otro que fuera cerrado. Pero no había ninguno tan grande para como el que necesitaba. Y uno pequeño no servía porque la idea es que la vieran la mayor cantidad de personas posibles. También se le ocurrió la idea de instalar una lona de nailon fuerte encima del primer local que tenía visto, así la gente no se mojaría. Pero los vientos serán tan fuertes que seguro la arrancarían de golpe. Con cada solución que iba encontrando aparecían nuevos problemas. Era todo un fastidio. Casi pensó en rendirse dado que no había mucho más que hacer. A parte la gente no iría a un local aunque tuviera techo en medio de una fuerte tormenta que podía crear estragos. Nada, solo quedaba un día, así que parecía que tendría que cancelar todo, no había de otra.
![alvin-leopold-cWM1ZOSUzU4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uQiGyQ3oYvuuHERH5FKytcyzZ6Pob7buVjNyHGVuSzgAfND61JMYku6AuGGqYDpUrko.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> There were still a few hours left before the concert. Sunny lay in bed, heartbroken and crying. She couldn't believe that after so much preparation, her big concert would be canceled and ruined. She just stared up at the ceiling, trying to come up with an idea of ​​what to do. And it seemed an idea struck her at the last minute. Her house was quite large; all the instruments and musicians could fit inside. Besides, since there was going to be a big storm, everyone would be home. She had a brilliant idea: to do the concert live online. That way, fans from all over the world could watch her without leaving home, and she wouldn't have to postpone the date. It was an excellent idea. So she quickly jumped out of bed and called her fellow musicians. She announced on her social media that nothing was canceled, that it would go live. And so it happened the next day. Right on time, the concert began, streamed from her house. It wasn't ideal, but she managed to keep everyone's expectations, and she was happy because she didn't have to postpone anything. It was also an unforgettable concert in every sense of the word; he learned that there are always options, the trick is finding them.

> Aún faltaban unas horas para terminar el día antes de que fuera el concierto. Sunny estaba muy triste tirada en cama llorando, no creía que luego de tanta preparación su gran concierto quedara cancelado y arruinado. Solo miraba hacia arriba del techo intentado conseguir alguna idea para ver que se podía hacer. Y parece que alguna le calló porque se le ocurrió algo de ultimo minuto. Su casa era bastante grande, cabían todos los instrumentos y músicos dentro. Además como habría una fuerte tormenta todos estarían en casa. Se le ocurrió una gran idea, hacer el concierto en vivo por la red. Así los fans de todo el mundo podrían verla sin salir de casa y no tendría que posponer la fecha. Era una excelente idea. Así que rápidamente brincó de la cama y llamó a sus compañeros músicos. Anunció en sus redes que no se cancelaba nada, que se daría en vivo. Y así ocurrió al otro día. A la hora y indicada comenzó el concierto trasmitido desde su casa. No era lo más ideal pero cumplió con todos y ella estaba feliz porque no tuvo que posponer nada. Fue igualmente un concierto inolvidable en todo el sentido de la palabra, aprendió que siempre hay opciones, la cosa es encontrarlas.
![alexey-turenkov-CrKlfX2wmbo-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tkk7sp9t5FgLNkX66snRYSJtc6PZs5giSRTKMmE3o56n71Sp6etvyTTv5xh4ViqsuvZ.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

title.title: Walking from the train station. noMy Actifit Report Card: May 18 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/783b4d84-f313-4974-b8e7-b21dc8264992.jpg) Today there was only one thing on the to do list. Go from Alicante to Murcia. That meant get up in the morning. Have the hotel breakfast buffet and then start packing. Once packed we walked to the train station. On the way there was some sort of protest going on. The sort of thing they tell tourists to avoid. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d8932ed1-09d1-43ef-b184-3f716a2d51f3.jpg) Not entirely sure what the protest was about by I think it was for education. Anyways entered the train station and figured out how to get the ticket. Hooray. Had to wait about 40 minutes for the next train. Then an hour traveling between towns. I kept looking out the window seeing how arid it is here. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/35fc6996-0267-47a6-a533-c363a2673e8b.jpg) When we get to the new town we had to figure out how to get to the next hotel. Now most sane people would take the taxi. Some adventurous people would take the bus. We decided to walk. It is only a 50 minute walk to the hotel :) .. I figured it would be a good way to figure out the city. Walking through the city was a little embarrassing because my wife had me put a backpack on both the front and the back. I felt like either a sandwich.. or a pregnant turtle. Either way it was kind of embarrassing and not super comfortable in 30C heat. When we got to the hotel? A very weird room with a shower in the center of the room. Weird ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6c0ee408-738e-414f-8494-529e923139af.jpg) After that? Time to go to the grocery store to get food. Actually we went to two grocery stores. One we bought food at. The next one was kind of a megastore with food but also clothes, electronics, major appliances and more. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9aeaff4f-9e3e-4ce6-978b-f034977345a1.jpg) Then we came back to the hotel to use the pool. Only to find out that it was closed for the season. 30c and still not pool weather. Weird. Anyways. Tomorrow we do more exploring. I'm pushing for museum day where I can look, read and relax as for my wife? Well will see how the day goes :) Thanks for dropping by today, more to come tomorrow

title.title: Transforming Lives: New Jersey’s Innovative Recovery Methods
title.body:
## The Growing Need for Modern Addiction Recovery Approaches

Addiction recovery in the United States has evolved significantly over the past decade. Traditional rehabilitation models are no longer viewed as one-size-fits-all solutions, particularly as mental health awareness and substance abuse rates continue to rise. In New Jersey, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and community organizations have responded by creating innovative recovery programs designed to meet people where they are emotionally, physically, and socially.

The state has experienced growing demand for treatment services related to alcohol dependency, opioid misuse, and co-occurring mental health disorders. Rather than relying solely on inpatient rehabilitation, many recovery centers now emphasize long-term healing, community support, and personalized care. This shift has helped improve treatment retention rates while reducing the stigma often associated with seeking help.

Modern recovery strategies recognize that addiction rarely exists in isolation. Factors such as trauma, unemployment, anxiety, and unstable housing frequently contribute to substance use disorders. As a result, New Jersey’s recovery programs increasingly combine medical treatment with counseling, life coaching, and vocational support.

## How New Jersey Became a Leader in Recovery Innovation

New Jersey’s approach to addiction treatment stands out because of its emphasis on accessibility and integration. State-supported initiatives have encouraged healthcare providers to build networks that connect hospitals, therapists, support groups, and rehabilitation facilities into more coordinated systems.

### Community-Based Treatment Models

One of the most effective innovations has been the expansion of community-centered recovery programs. These programs allow individuals to receive treatment while remaining connected to their families and workplaces. Outpatient counseling, peer mentorship, and sober living environments have become essential parts of the recovery journey.

Many treatment specialists believe community integration improves long-term outcomes because it helps individuals develop coping strategies in real-world settings. Recovery is not limited to a clinical environment; instead, it becomes part of daily life.

Patients often seek reliable health information while navigating early recovery. Questions related to alcohol testing, detoxification, and physical recovery are common, especially among individuals facing employment or legal requirements. Resources discussing topics such as [how to flush alcohol out of your system for urine test](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/3-ways-to-get-alcohol-out-of-your-system/) can help people better understand how the body metabolizes alcohol and why medically supervised detox remains the safest approach.

### Expanded Mental Health Integration

Another major advancement is the integration of mental health services into addiction treatment. Many facilities now screen patients for anxiety disorders, depression, PTSD, and trauma-related conditions during intake assessments.

This integrated model reduces the risk of relapse because underlying psychological issues are addressed alongside substance dependency. Therapists frequently use evidence-based methods such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and trauma-informed counseling to help patients identify behavioral patterns and emotional triggers.

## Personalized Treatment Plans and Holistic Healing

Recovery professionals increasingly understand that successful treatment must reflect the individual’s unique experiences and needs. Personalized care plans are now a hallmark of New Jersey’s rehabilitation programs.

Holistic therapies have gained popularity because they address emotional and physical well-being simultaneously. Yoga, meditation, nutritional counseling, fitness programs, and mindfulness training are commonly incorporated into treatment schedules. While these therapies do not replace clinical care, they often complement traditional approaches effectively.

Nutrition and physical health also play significant roles in recovery. Long-term alcohol or substance use can weaken the immune system, disrupt sleep patterns, and impair cognitive function. By rebuilding healthy routines, patients may experience improved energy levels and emotional stability.

Some rehabilitation centers additionally focus on creative therapies such as music, art, and journaling. These methods encourage emotional expression in ways that traditional counseling may not always achieve. Patients often report that creative activities help them process difficult emotions without fear of judgment.

## Technology and Telehealth in Addiction Recovery

Technology has transformed the accessibility of addiction treatment throughout New Jersey. Telehealth services expanded rapidly during the COVID-19 pandemic and have remained a critical component of ongoing care.

Virtual therapy sessions allow patients to receive counseling from home, reducing transportation barriers and scheduling conflicts. For people living in rural or underserved communities, telehealth can make recovery services significantly more accessible.

Mobile recovery apps have also become valuable tools for maintaining accountability. Many applications include sobriety trackers, meditation exercises, emergency support contacts, and appointment reminders. While technology cannot replace human connection, it can reinforce positive habits between counseling sessions.

Digital communication has improved continuity of care as well. Providers can coordinate more effectively through shared medical records and secure communication platforms. This collaborative approach ensures patients receive more consistent support throughout different stages of recovery.

## The Role of Education and Preventive Awareness

Education is one of the strongest tools for preventing addiction and supporting long-term recovery. Schools, healthcare providers, and nonprofit organizations across New Jersey have expanded public awareness campaigns focused on substance misuse prevention.

These programs often emphasize early intervention and informed decision-making. By educating teenagers and young adults about the risks of alcohol misuse and opioid dependency, communities hope to reduce future addiction rates.

Public health education also helps combat misinformation surrounding substance use. For example, many people search online for answers to health-related myths, including questions like [does alcohol kill yeast infections](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/does-alcohol-increase-yeast-infections/). While alcohol may have disinfectant properties externally, consuming alcohol is not a medically recognized treatment for yeast infections and can sometimes worsen overall health conditions.

Reliable medical information is essential in recovery settings. Organizations such as the [Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration](https://www.samhsa.gov/) provide evidence-based guidance, treatment resources, and educational support for individuals and families affected by addiction.

## Family Support and Community Reintegration

Recovery rarely succeeds in isolation. Family involvement often plays a critical role in helping individuals rebuild trust, accountability, and emotional stability.

Many New Jersey recovery programs now offer family therapy sessions designed to improve communication and address unresolved conflicts. Addiction frequently impacts entire households, and healing those relationships can strengthen long-term recovery outcomes.

Community reintegration is equally important. Finding stable employment, housing, and social support can significantly reduce relapse risk. Some rehabilitation centers partner with local businesses and nonprofit organizations to help recovering individuals gain job training and career opportunities.

Peer support groups remain another cornerstone of successful recovery. Whether through 12-step programs or alternative recovery communities, shared experiences can provide encouragement and reduce feelings of isolation.

## Addressing Alcohol-Related Health Concerns During Recovery

Alcohol dependency presents unique physical and emotional challenges. Unlike some substances, alcohol withdrawal can become medically dangerous without proper supervision. Symptoms may include anxiety, nausea, tremors, elevated heart rate, and severe complications such as seizures.

Because of these risks, medically supervised detoxification is often recommended for individuals with long-term alcohol dependency. Recovery specialists stress the importance of professional monitoring rather than attempting extreme detox methods found online.

New Jersey treatment centers increasingly focus on educating patients about the biological effects of addiction. Understanding how alcohol impacts the liver, nervous system, and mental health can motivate individuals to remain committed to recovery goals.

Healthcare providers also emphasize relapse prevention planning. Stress management, emotional regulation, and healthy coping mechanisms are taught throughout treatment to prepare patients for challenges after rehabilitation.

## Challenges Facing Recovery Programs in New Jersey

Despite meaningful progress, recovery systems still face several obstacles. Access to affordable care remains a major concern for many residents. Insurance limitations, long waitlists, and staffing shortages can delay treatment for individuals in urgent need.

Stigma also continues to affect addiction recovery. Some individuals hesitate to seek help because they fear judgment from employers, family members, or their communities. Public awareness campaigns have improved perceptions of addiction as a medical condition, but misconceptions persist.

Another challenge involves maintaining long-term recovery support after formal treatment ends. Relapse prevention requires sustained care, and many experts argue that recovery services should function similarly to chronic disease management rather than short-term intervention.

## The Future of Addiction Recovery in New Jersey

New Jersey’s recovery landscape continues to evolve through innovation, research, and collaboration. Future treatment models are likely to become even more personalized as healthcare providers incorporate data-driven insights and expanded mental health services into rehabilitation programs.

Emerging strategies may include greater use of artificial intelligence for treatment planning, broader peer-support networks, and stronger partnerships between healthcare providers and community organizations. Policymakers are also exploring ways to improve affordability and expand access to underserved populations.

Most importantly, the conversation surrounding addiction recovery is becoming more compassionate and informed. Recovery is increasingly viewed not as a single event, but as an ongoing process that requires medical care, emotional support, and social connection.

The progress seen across New Jersey demonstrates that innovative, patient-centered approaches can transform lives. By combining evidence-based treatment, community support, and holistic healing, the state continues to create recovery systems that offer individuals not just sobriety, but the opportunity to rebuild meaningful and sustainable lives.

title.title: Carrick gets his contract.
title.body:
Michael Carrick has agreed a two-year deal to remain Manchester United head coach.

The final legal details are now being sorted and the club are hopeful of an announcement in the next 24 to 48 hours.

Good or bad idea?


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcg4kCjnzjjtcP3CGNzHYJBKmACPLcbxmjGPsBPXamno/image.png)


From my point of view it feels like the only logical option at this stage. United have been through every type of manager since Ferguson left, and none of them have really solved the bigger problem. We’ve had the name, the profile, the short-term bounce, the tactical specialist, and the so-called rebuild guy, but the end result has still been the same mix of inconsistency, poor recruitment, and a squad that never quite looks balanced.

Say what you like, but he can’t do much worse than Amorim, who had us sitting in 15th last year and hovering just above a relegation battle. That was a brutal place for a club like United to be in, and it showed how fragile the whole setup was. Carrick came in, steadied things, and got a response out of the players when the pressure was at its worst. He took a team that was underperforming and under serious pressure and has them beating the top contenders and sitting in a much better position for Europe next year. By any reasonable measure, that’s a successful stint.

It’s also not like there are loads of obvious alternatives waiting around. It’s a top club and a top job, but everyone knows the situation behind the scenes is messy. There are major issues at board level, there are financial limits, and the rebuild isn’t just about the manager — it’s about fixing a lot of things all at once. That makes the job harder to sell to elite coaches who have other options and want a cleaner project.

- Iraola
- Nagelsmann
- Emery
- Glasner
- De Zerbi

A lot of those names are either unrealistic, already tied up, or not exactly flying in their current roles. Emery is the one obvious exception because he’s proven, experienced, and has shown he can improve a side quickly when he walks into a new environment. But he’s firmly settled at Villa and never really looked like a genuine runner for the United job anyway. The others are interesting in theory, but there’s a difference between being a fashionable name and being the right fit for a club in this kind of state.

So if the shortlist is thin and the market isn’t exactly overflowing with world-class candidates, it becomes easier to stick with Carrick. He already has the players on side, and just as importantly, he’s got the fans with him too. That matters more than people sometimes admit. At a club like United, dressing-room buy-in and supporter trust can buy you a lot of time and stability. That’s half the battle before a ball is even kicked.

The real question now is who he brings in for next year. Losing Casemiro is a big blow because it leaves a hole in the midfield and takes a lot of experience out of the dressing room as well. Whether people think he’s past his best or not, he’s still the kind of presence that helps in a squad that’s trying to find some control and authority.

There are too many average players on the books and that has to change. Next season is going to be busier, the demands are going to be higher, and the squad needs to be deeper if United are serious about competing on multiple fronts. You can’t go into a bigger season with the same thin core and hope everything just works out.

Whatever you think about Amorim and his team selection, he did recruit well last year by bringing in Sesko, Lammens, Cunha and Mbueno, all of whom have settled into the first team nicely. That’s the kind of business United need to keep doing: identifying players who can contribute straight away, not just names that sound exciting on paper. The squad needs more balance, more energy, and more players who can handle the level without needing a full season to adapt.

For next year, the priorities are pretty clear. A good left back, a center back, a defensive midfielder and another striker all need to be on the list. Those are the spine pieces that make a team easier to manage and much harder to break down. There are some interesting players in the youth squad who can help fill out the group, but the quality and experience has to be bought in too. And this time, the deals need to be done early, not dragged out until the last minute when the market has already moved on and the club is scrambling again.

title.title: [ES/EN] My Collection of Gladiator cards – May 2026 - Season 159
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUcos4ZXJPxi8xVsHKw1xDaEXoWk7KhetDhThuFhqscQq/Portada%20-%20Coleccion%20-%20Gladiator%20-%20Mayo%202026%20-%20Season%20159.png</center>

<center>Since I was doing my reports and analyses, I also decided to do the one for a card set that hasn't changed since last month. It is a free set and its use is conditional, which makes it quite underestimated: the **Gladiator** set. And it has absolutely nothing to do with the fact that in my **Wild** battles I lost several matches against teams using **Archons** with **Conscript** and Gladiators like **Katrelba Gobson**, which prevented me from climbing higher in the **Diamond** Top last season.</center>

><center>Ya que estaba haciendo mis reportes y análisis, también decidí hacer el de un conjunto de tarjetas que no ha cambiado desde el mes pasado. Es un conjunto gratis y está condicionado para poder usar sus tarjetas, por lo que es bastante subestimado: el conjunto **Gladiator**. Y nada tiene que ver el hecho de que en mis batallas en **Wild** he perdido varias batallas contra equipos que usan **Archons** con **Conscript** y Gladiators como **Katrelba Gobson**, el cual evitó que pudiera subir más en el Top de **Diamond** la temporada pasada.</center>

### <center>Commons | Comunes</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXSKoJSmQReUxjP3NiNdt2qJ1k3yjeypdnzruRhsCdmJU/Comunes%20V2.png</center>

<center>In the **Commons** cards, having all of them at level **8** and having gathered quite a few copies, they weren't the **80** necessary to level them up. However, many are close, needing only **10** copies and others **40**, since at level **9** many gain another ability, which improves them a lot. Others only gain some stats, which is not the most striking feature but helps to win battles. There is a special case that I want to bring to Level 9 and not upgrade to 10, which is **Isgald Vorst**, because at her maximum level she has 5 melee attack; for me, this is a disadvantage because they can reduce her damage with **Forcefield** or she can become a target for enemies if they have one of the new abilities like **Reprisal**.</center>

><center>En las tarjetas **Comunes**, teniéndolas todas a nivel **8** y habiendo conseguido bastantes copias, no fueron las **80** necesarias para subirlas de nivel, pero muchas están cerca, necesitando solo **10** copias y otras **40**, ya que en el nivel **9** muchas ganan otra habilidad, lo cual las mejora mucho. Otras solo ganan algo de estadísticas, lo cual no es lo más llamativo pero ayuda a ganar las batallas. Hay una con un caso especial a la que quiero llevar a Nivel 9 y no subirla al 10, que es **Isgald Vorst**, ya que en su nivel máximo tiene 5 de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo; lo cual para mí es una desventaja porque pueden reducir su daño con **Forcefield** o volverse objetivo de los enemigos si tienen una de las nuevas habilidades como **Reprisal**.</center>


### <center>Rares | Raras</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNjTuKoVpg878mV1r1MmZWAcbx1RoPbikt3zfMiapFPBk/Raras%20V2.png</center>

<center>In the **Rares** cards, I obtained quite a few copies, so I can even upgrade **Cutter Brieze** to maximum level, being the first to achieve it. With the exception of him, all the others are 1 level away from upgrading, even some just **10** copies away from doing so. However, just as happens with the **Commons** card **Isgald Vorst**, there are also **Rares** cards like **Palidon Rakk** and **Captain Katie** that I think it is better to leave at level **7**. At level **8** they do not gain any ability and only increase their attack to **5**, which for me is a tactical disadvantage against abilities like **Forcefield** and other mechanics.</center>

><center>En las tarjetas **Raras** obtuve bastantes copias, por lo que incluso puedo subir a **Cutter Brieze** a nivel máximo, siendo el primero en lograrlo. A excepción de él, todas las demás están a 1 nivel de subir, incluso algunas a **10** copias de lograrlo. Aunque, como pasa con la tarjeta **Comunes** de **Isgald Vorst**, también hay tarjetas **Raras** como **Palidon Rakk** y **Captain Katie** que pienso que es mejor dejar en el nivel **7**, ya que en el nivel **8** no ganan ninguna habilidad y solo aumenta su ataque a **5**, lo que para mí es una desventaja contra **Forcefield** y demás habilidades.</center>


### <center>Epics | Épicas</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfKvEfXkmfwY9MCk4NXL6VANApsuYuD5tx9uswNs3cete/Epicas%20V2.png</center>

<center>In the **Epics**, I did have changes, being able to bring **Trapp Falloway** to level **5**. This makes all of them, with the exception of **Gorth** (who is already at max level), 1 level away from the maximum. I especially want **Quora Towershead** to be as useful as possible. Unlike the **Commons** and **Rares** cards, I don't have any that I want to prevent from reaching maximum level, since they all have a lot of power from low levels; to withstand their abilities, they have to be countered by **Forcefield**.</center>

><center>En las **Épicas** sí tuve cambios, pudiendo llevar a **Trapp Falloway** a nivel **5** haciendo que todas, a excepción de **Gorth** (que ya está a nivel máximo), estén a un nivel del máximo. Especialmente quiero a **Quora Towershead** para que sea lo más útil posible. A diferencia de las tarjetas **Comunes** y **Raras**, no tengo ninguna que quiera evitar que llegue a nivel máximo, ya que todas tienen mucho poder desde niveles bajos, por lo que para frenar sus habilidades tienen que ser contrarrestadas por **Forcefield**.</center>


### <center>Legendaries | Legendarias</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZj6rg5VfGTJSSRaqosSryKtRKuLq8wYwQ1M2cNqNcAZi/Legendarias%20V2.png</center>

<center>Regarding the **Legendaries**, I didn't have any changes because I didn't get any new copies, so they all remain between levels **2** and **3**. I hope to get more copies this season, even if it's just one of **Xulax Nightwind**, since he is the closest to being able to bring to maximum level.</center>

><center>De las **Legendarias** no tuve ningún cambio porque no obtuve ninguna copia nueva, por lo que todas se mantienen entre los niveles **2** y **3** mientras espero esta temporada obtener más copias, aunque sea una de **Xulax Nightwind**, ya que es el que está más cerca de poder llevarlo a nivel máximo.</center>

### <center>Gold Foil</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdbxNTt9MehUHvy6wQAmCkbjhrAxP2QRqz8aKLgLbZUqC/Gold%20Foil%20V2.png</center>

<center>I will surely burn the **Gold Foil** cards to combine them with the **Merits** I won this season to do a **Opening Packs** of **100 Packs** and analyze how much I would be missing to bring all the cards to their maximum levels, taking into account that I need **200.000 Merits** with the **Gold Foil** cards I currently have.</center>

><center>Seguramente queme las tarjetas **Gold Foil** para unirlas a los **Merits** que gané esta temporada para hacer un **Opening Packs** de **100 Packs** y analizar qué tanto me faltaría para poder llevar a todas las tarjetas a sus niveles máximos, teniendo en cuenta que para eso necesito **200.000 Merits** con las tarjetas **Gold Foil** que tengo actualmente.</center>

||||||
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**Rarity**|**Numbers**|**Merits**|**Total**|**Packs**|
|**Commons**|56|500|28.000|14|
|**Rares**|19|2.000|38.000|19|
|**Epics**|2|10.000|20.000|10|

title.title: Being Hot-Tempered Is Not an Excuse for Bad Behavior
title.body:
I believe it's actually okay to have a change in our temper when someone hurts us or we see something we don't like. I said it's okay because it's the nature of humans to have a change of reaction depending on what we see or hear. But then what differentiates each and every one apart is how we react to what we see or hear. A change of temper, in my opinion, is quite normal, but how you speak or the actions you take will determine how emotionally intelligent you are and how much of a self-controlled individual you are. We've seen people who do ridiculous things out of anger and then try to tie it on the fact that they're hot-tempered. Find out my take on such people and related things. ![1000769437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23uaU4Dp6XNwEs3sGNkU13BqGBSCnJsry3BqJniYR5TycwDmivDen1NxDMXcxQvYYqtGP.jpg) I'd like to state this fact before I respond to the question, and the fact is that every single individual is hot-tempered, so no one should keep using that card, thinking it's an opportunity to escape the wrath of their actions. Because other people are not showing their hot-tempered side doesn't mean they aren't hot-tempered too; it just means they have self-control and also value the relationship they have with you, and that's why they reserved everything they would have said out of annoyance that built up after their hot temper. Doing that helps them cool down and handle situations in a more mature way that promotes peace and good human relations. Now to respond to the questions, I must say that I don't like any individual that's hot-tempered. By being hot-tempered, I mean any individual who can't control themselves to the point of not using their annoyance to react or speak all that comes to their mind. It always irritates me when I see such people display their act of nuisance to the gathering or society. I remember how a senior former colleague once displayed such an attitude when I first got posted to that school; I immediately withdrew myself from anything that would have me have something to do with her because I just can't stand how she flew off at every given opportunity. Seeing how destructive the outcome of hot-tempered people's actions can be, I can't actually allow them to keep using that as an excuse; they need to own up to their wrongdoing and find a way to improve themselves by having more self-control. I remember this experience where a senior officer at my workplace accused me of stealing, and when the truth came out, she still wanted me to apologize because I, for the first time, matched her energy of being hot-tempered, just to let her know she's not the only one who can be like that, because she was unwilling to apologize after the truth came out but instead wanted me to apologize. It's not the right way to go, and I think people should learn to control their emotions. You can read more about that experience in [Addressing Miscommunication: Dealing with Unfounded Accusations.](https://peakd.com/hive-153850/@vickoly/disheartening-moment-i-was-wrongly-accused) What I believe the society can do to address this situation is to create an avenue where everyone can learn self-control and how to control their emotions. Also, in that awareness or sensitization, people should be educated on the danger and repercussions of hot-tempered actions; this will help people. Everyone becomes a better person, and whoever doesn't change still should be held responsible for their actions and not let their justification of being hot-tempered be a criterion to let them go. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/being-hottempered-is-not-an-excuse-for-bad-behavior-dwc)

Well, a tree gets sick if it doesn't get enough water. Here in California, we have had a lot of drought years and some people don't water their lawn as much and there is the problem. If the lawn is not watered, then neither is the tree watered. As far as I know these trees were planted about two trees to a house and these trees were planted around 1950's.

And over the years the trees have been disappearing or really getting sick and cut down. Trees do get sick when they are not watered enough.

I mean it tries it's best, but there is not a lot of rain in California, even now. Well they keep spraying the chemtrails and in my mind that is how they create drought.

They spray those trails of nano metal and they shoot energy at those nano metal trails, and heat up the sky and the clouds disappear and we have some kind of drought.

Let's get back to the part of the tree that fell down. You see there was also a lot of wind and of course weak trees will give up some of it's limbs to the wind. And there was a lot of wind.

Someone did call the county public works department and told them about a fallen tree. Well, they did come. One of them walked up to me, saying, We don't have too much time as there are eight other trees that have fallen in the area and they won't be able to clean it all up today.

Here is another view of the tree.

![20260517_122220.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPRjQBsqWktzu3CNHgShkLk1vCiKgtTUHQCWDnD4Vrdtf/20260517_122220.jpg)

So the tree affected the street we were on.

The guy told me to tell my neighbor that they can't finish it today, but will come back and finish the clean up. So I let the neighbor know they would come back, but are too busy at the moment to clean it all up.

They did saw off sections and pull them to grass and bigger sections like logs they had a machine pick them up and into the truck, then they were off to the next fallen tree.


![20260517_150453.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgaaQyT4NattYNZ6oaW1fxobJSFB6F9JS3naiJ9dt68j/20260517_150453.jpg)

So they left and the street was clear of the fallen tree. Now car and walking traffic was free to move again.


![20260517_150911.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcQBzKJ8jpWEoEWAFNmrMoyH1pc7bYETXvanbcFkYyrAP/20260517_150911.jpg)

I thought they did a pretty good job, well a lot better than if I would have done it.

Let's end with a scripture, as it is written, with Jesus speaking, Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me. John 14:6.

title.title: Shadow Fight 2: A game of shadow fighters.
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779127728720-c1b4450d7edbab27.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=tanhub6t9/bfc739c9)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=tanhub6t9/bfc739c9)


---

I thought it was a game. Shadow Fight is not just a game. Behind this game is a story of a warrior's sacrifice, strength, and rebirth.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTERVxVZuM7FXnCwxmxwvB7teK7gJh8nssWZXs8KY34mq/img_3476.jpg)

At the beginning of the game, a warrior is shown. His name is Shadow. He knew so much about war and was so strong that he could easily defeat any opponent. Out of pride, he one day opened the Gate of Shadow. A dark force came out of that door. Which turned him into a complete shadow. This increased his fighting ability even though he lost his strength.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSBvy2RnFCjrYQaCtGTxZZX6dvjTJyJobQkfYgqaBxrqK/img_3475.jpg)

Then Shadow's long journey began. If he wants to return to human form, he has to defeat 6 monsters. Lynx, Hermit, Butcher, Wasp, Widow, and Shagun. They had their own fighting styles. It wasn't easy to defeat them. That's why I had to practice in the game again and again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVWCvHFUbh8cEzxMqptr1aXRckJNEDH5FF7QHR1ZKu8U/img_3479.jpg)

The realistic combat strategy of this game is what attracts the most. There are weapons like swords, knives, nunchaku, sticks, hammers, etc. Each weapon has a different speed and power. Every fight becomes full of excitement when new armor and magic powers are unlocked.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVGxP2GPxxksJb8gkE1wz9Jtft2Z9FJcQqb6SCjEw541j/img_3478.jpg)

The battle with Titan in the last chapter will be more memorable. After many attempts, I defeated him. I felt the joy of true victory. It is not just a game win, but a victory through practice, patience and confidence.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTSujxV6x9jvDQzfWm6b3EVa6WGW7HwhZvYPpKRvTFTWW/img_3520.jpg)

Shadow Fight 2 is a game like no other. Every step reminds us that no matter how deep the darkness, with perseverance and patience, it is possible to find the light again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdfo4iWaJWdVSeJiqGU8MNBuGNHrR6J8n43tRz1FkUTKV/img_3521.jpg)

Image source: Edited with screenshots from the game.

Thanks for watching this video.

---
