links.title: Floods in Houston
links.body:
# Floods in Houston

I reflect a bit on flooding situation in Houston, based on my [previous post](https://peakd.com/hive-180505/@azircon/mistake-of-not-checking-the-flood-zone) yesterday. Turns out, I have been through a lot of these in the past 25 years that I have been living here. So my personal experience alone is fairly lengthy in human life time. So let us see how many 100 year and 500 years event happened that I personally have experienced in the last 25 years!

First the definition:

> A 100-year flood is an extreme flood event that has a 1% chance (1 in 100) of happening or being exceeded in any given year. A 500-year flood is an even rarer, more severe event that has a 0.2% chance (1 in 500) of occurring or being exceeded in any given year.

**Key point in the definition:** a 100 year flood is a 1% chance of happening in a given year! It is a statistical probability based on an entire given database. Here it is FEMA's US national database. 

PS: _It doesn't mean that the 100 year flood happens once in 100 year!!_
I intend to prove that with my personal experience in living in Houston, TX alone!


![Flood_Risk.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby5vREFEDimb7V6Q4R6JEXQ4j4NML8x9xkr9Cw5ti8Fa/Flood_Risk.png)

_It is about annual Risk!_

# Resources and Maps

FEMA maintains a national database of floods. It does have a very user friendly interface where you can type any address in the US and get the official assessment of risk. This is a public database and all information is public.

https://msc.fema.gov/portal/home
_If you live in the US, feel free to type your address, as this is national free database._

I will use a sample but real address to explain this process. The address is

12110 Green Willow Falls Dr, Tomball, TX, 77375, USA

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTW6vdAb7jNCDjnCLm3YNEQJ5tt3cJJABoisokZqmFMb/image.png)

Here is the official legend:

| Category            | Zone(s)                          | Annual Flood Risk            | Description                                                                 | Map Appearance                  |
|--------------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| **High Risk (SFHA)** | A, AE, A1–A30, AO, AH           | ≥1% (1-in-100 year flood)    | Inland areas subject to inundation from 100-year flood                      | Shaded blue                     |
|                    | V, VE                            | ≥1% (coastal + wave hazard)  | Coastal areas exposed to storm surge and wave action                        | Shaded blue                     |
|                    | Floodway                         | Highest within SFHA          | River channels + adjacent land needed to carry floodwaters                  | Red diagonal hatching overlay   |
| **Moderate Risk**  | B / Shaded X                     | 0.2% (1-in-500 year flood)   | Between 100-year and 500-year floodplain                                    | Shaded orange                   |
| **Low Risk**       | C / Unshaded X                   | <0.2%                        | Minimal flood hazard areas outside 500-year floodplain                      | Clear / unshaded                |
| **Undetermined**   | D                                | Unknown                      | Possible flood risk, but no detailed analysis completed                     | Not specifically defined        |

If you look at the map above, the red diagonal area is the 'floodway'; in this case the Willow Creek. The Blue area is the overbank spillway, or the 100-yr flood zone, meaning each year, there is 1% or higher chance of this area getting flooded per year. The Orange area is between 100-yr and 500-yr flood zone, meaning there is a 0.2% or higher chance of this area getting flooded per year. Here is a simplified version of the same legend.

| Color on FEMA Map | Risk Level        | Should You Build? 🚧 | Simple Interpretation                                  |
|------------------|------------------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| 🔵 Blue          | High Risk        | ❌ No               | Regular flooding likely (100-year flood zone or worse) |
| 🔴 Red Hatch     | Extreme Risk     | ❌ Absolutely Not    | Floodway — water must flow here during floods           |
| 🟠 Orange        | Moderate Risk    | ⚠️ Be Careful        | Less frequent, but still real flood risk (500-year)     |
| ⚪ Clear / None   | Low Risk         | ✅ Generally Safer   | Minimal flood risk, but not zero                       |
| 🟡 Undefined     | Unknown          | ⚠️ Proceed with caution | Risk not studied — uncertainty is a risk itself       |

# A single case

Let us closely look at the address I mentioned earlier in Tomball, and I will show you certain strange thing which is common when a subdivision development happens.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjeXnvVCLA1Cjc4ifsHHEatdL9tz6JgHPg4HynXBUGey/image.png)

First, you see the following:

1. Hatched, and Blue area fairly close to the home in question
2. The subdivision magically stays in the X-zone, orange and empty area (where this house is).
3. X-zone does NOT require flood insurance!

Do you see something funny? Or understand what I am getting at. Yes, usually subdivision built a highly higher earthed ground when the houses are built, which makes the area slightly higher than the surrounding. But it sort of magically follows the subdivision boundary. Regardless, would you be buying a property here in the Orange or 200 ft from the blue, even if it is deemed OKAY by this FEMA map?

Tell you what, let me share the flooding experience.

# Major Floods in Houston

Note: these are all floods that I have personal memories, and I can not reading old news articles and listing them. I clearly remember these major events where almost all of greater Houston experience 500-yr floods. Meaning, in majority of Houston all of the Orange in the map was covered in water in each of the instances! Well not exactly everywhere all the time, but in most places. 

2001 – Tropical Storm Allison
2005 – Hurricane Rita (evacuation crisis)
2008 – Hurricane Ike
2015 – Memorial Day Flood
2016 – Tax Day Flood + Memorial Day Flood
2017 – Hurricane Harvey
2019 – Tropical Storm Imelda
2020 – Beta
2021 – Nicholas
2024 – Hurricane Beryl

I count 11 event in the last 25 years. Among which 7 have been absolutely catastrophic! Now tell me how's that 500-year flood is working out for us? Let me list a few more details of those 7 events.

🟦 Tropical Storm Allison (June 2001)


* Dumped 30–40+ inches of rain over several days 
* Flooded the Texas Medical Center, causing billions in damage
* ~70,000+ homes damaged, major infrastructure failure 
* ~$5B in losses and dozens of fatalities

🟦 Hurricane Ike (September 2008)


* Massive storm surge along the coast
* Widespread power outages across Houston region 
* One of the costliest hurricanes in Texas history 

🟧 Memorial Day Flood (May 2015)


* ~12 inches of rain in ~10 hours 
* Several fatalities and widespread street/home flooding


🟧 Tax Day Flood (April 2016)


* 12–16 inches in ~12 hours, with intense rainfall rates 
* 10,000+ homes flooded 
* Reservoirs hit record levels 



🟧 Memorial Day Flood (May 2016)


* Occurred just weeks after Tax Day flood
* Re-flooded already saturated watersheds [hcfcd.org]



🟥 Hurricane Harvey (August 2017)


* Stalled over Houston for 4–5 days
* Dropped 30–50+ inches of rain (U.S. record-scale event) 
* Flooded ~100,000 homes in Houston alone 
* $125 + billion damage in Texas 

One side note here: 30% of Houston homes had some kind of roof damage. It was in fact so severe, that after 2 years you can still see the Blue tarp on the roofs of the house, as the roofing and insurance industry had massive back logs!

🟨  Tropical Storm Imelda (September 2019)


* Some areas got 40+ inches
* Severe flooding east/northeast of Houston

So, I hope I can state where we live matters a lot and risks of flood changes accordingly. It is proven that rain storms, Hurricane and flooding are getting more severe every year and will continue to do so as the oceans progressively warm up due to Human Induced Climate Change. 

When thinking about where to build or rent in flood-prone regions like Houston, FEMA map colors offer a simple but powerful guide. Areas shaded in blue or marked with red hatching are the highest risk—these are places where flooding is expected regularly or where floodwaters must flow, making them unsuitable for development if you want to avoid damage. Orange zones may appear safer but still carry meaningful flood risk over time, especially during extreme storms, so they require caution. Only the clear or unshaded areas represent relatively lower risk, though even these are not completely flood-free. In short, the closer a property is to blue or red on the map, the more likely it is that water will eventually find its way there—and building decisions should reflect that reality. 


https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaDBldXhqODk4emZrcnNsMWFkZWhwbnc0OHI3OGxjcTdrdnJsc2hzeSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/35pTQFiy14OeA/giphy.gif

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 18 2026
links.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g94475856b596764dede5024d1fb37a584da590c7d4d0800888286039ab2a5f0f01a678c9dabf2a2fd303dfb287cfdf09f4cb78f52efdb674d4418dfe40051d43_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí dar un paseo por el parque central de la ciudad. El clima era perfecto, con un cielo despejado y una brisa suave. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con un grupo de artistas que estaban pintando murales en una de las paredes del parque. Hablé con una de las artistas, una mujer llamada Clara, que me contó que cada mural representa una historia de la comunidad. Me inspiró su pasión por el arte y la forma en que busca resaltar la diversidad cultural del barrio. Continuando mi caminata, pasé por una pequeña plaza donde un músico callejero estaba tocando la guitarra. Su música era muy envolvente, así que me quedé un rato a escuchar. Al final de su actuación, se acercó un niño que le pidió que le enseñara a tocar un acorde. Fue un momento muy tierno y me hizo reflexionar sobre la belleza de las interacciones humanas. En general, fue un recorrido lleno de colores, sonrisas y buena energía. Definitivamente, cada caminata siempre trae consigo sorpresas y nuevas amistades. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

links.title: Cantonnière, plateel-in-lood, Gorniès, adieu Lies
links.body:
![623BACD4-EB6C-40E1-9051-A323F21419F8_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoeGpgUrT3egHZREP9KmpJ62ewcBoLLixsKotdVwz4RyQAQGaw8UGxMuu2eopH8qqqP.jpeg)
Deze week stond in het teken van de houten kap voor de gordijnen te maken: eerst kijken of 'ie past en daarna in de grondverf en twee keer aflakken.
![0A3740BA-9DF5-4841-84AA-C9E16152EA2E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/AKAqSd14e2vswFjA24ZcMfHEcZE5qRyLU5kA4mCvBiqH4jiYmg2cWogWLzw5687.jpeg)
Allemaal best kleine klusjes, die toch wel wat tijd kosten. Maar, met het lange weekend was dat allemaal best te doen. Dus konden ook de gordijnen weer teruggehangen worden. We vinden het beiden best geslaagd geworden! Het is alleen moeilijk te fotograferen, want met het raam heb je toch een partij tegenlicht..!

#### Plateel-in-lood
![07F1D402-F607-482B-8F38-DF8A9864C6E4_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23zkrVcE1waKnZeZH8wEiuQsu9zUqcazy44Zaw1du46vV7CdHfonaGypzWh9Dbg7w155F.jpeg)
Bart is ondertussen met een nieuw experiment begonnen: Plateel-in-lood... Af en toe koopt Bart wat plateel, en af en toe gaat dat tijdens het transport kapot en komt het in scherven aan. Erg jammer. Nu had ik beloofd om deze te repareren volgens de Japanse [kinstugi](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kintsugi) techniek, waarbij je iets wat gebroken is repareerd met een gouden lijmnaad. Alleen... dat beloof ik al meer dan een jaar.

Voor Bart duurde dat te lang (en terecht..), toen dacht hij: wellicht dat dat ook met de glas-in-lood of tiffany techniek kan. Dus ging hij aan de slag en het lijkt wonderlijk wel goed te lukken. Hij gaat alleen de soldeernaad nog met een koperkleurige patine afwerken, dat staat mooier bij het plateel, vinden we.
![34C29C14-18E3-415F-B216-39CBE5FAABDA_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EoGzJgxgntmTRE4mU8UoZw9Gj7s53juKbtimv4uQFXP7SRrcoVgBdDWYvg9YQonurBV.jpeg)

#### Carthagène
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23vsNmppPcYeb3foRxtT4dpx11TwTQLqw7A7pocxemRrW927Mq1P6WHML55WS24PSbYmo.png)
Zaterdag waren we uitgenodigd om bij Hélène te komen eten, de oude eigenaresse van ons huis. Haar vriendin Justine was er ook, die kennen we inmiddels ook een beetje, originele dame. We begonnen met een aperitief op het terras van haar nieuwe woning, die is het afgelopen jaar flink opgeknapt en ze woont er nu enkele maanden. Het aperitiefje was een glaasje 'cartaghène', een typisch drankje uit de Languedoc. Die kenden we nog niet! 

Het is een likeurwijn die wordt verkregen door 80 % vers druivenmost te mengen met 20 % wijnbrandewijn. De verhouding varieert enigszins, afhankelijk van het alcoholpercentage van de brandewijn. Er zijn verschillende manieren om een cartagène te maken, afhankelijk van de wijnregio, maar ze zijn allemaal gebaseerd op dezelfde ingrediënten: most (ongegiste druivensap), alcohol, eventueel diverse ingrediënten om te aromatiseren (bijvoorbeeld vanille), maar geen suiker. De smaak hangt af van de druivensoorten waaruit het sap is gewonnen, en de druivenpulp (vooral als deze ambachtelijk is verwerkt) geeft een heel ander aroma dan dat van neutrale alcohol (met dank aan Wikipedia).

Na een gezellige avond liepen we een beetje teut rond half één in het pikkedonker naar huis. Ze woont maar 200 meter verderop, in het verlengde van onze straat. Om middernacht gaat de straatverlichting hier uit, en ondanks dat het maar 200 meter is, moet je toch echt een zaklampje aandoen om de weg te vinden!

#### Cascade de Gorniès
![63C81A47-22E1-4417-BDAC-69E2A2BA4C85_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23ywkbJoiAXq43ACLjwj2XachCKkH5yrTSRDPY2889BbrkT3ue3w81vsdbZLJqSsuFe1K.jpeg)
Zondagmiddag maakten we een wandeling met Régis en Eve naar de waterval van Gorniès. Klein stukje rijden met de auto en dan nog een wandelingetje naar een gorge, de diepte in om naar de waterval te gaan. Daarvan is echter door de droogte niet veel meer over, een piezelstraaltje en een klein poeltje is er nog over. Toch leuk om er even geweest te zijn en een lekkere zondagmiddagbesteding, al was het uiteindelijk toch net een beetje te warm, zo in de brandende zon. 

![F922BF83-9608-4039-ABCB-EB8C44763B5E_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/EowFatYTeXKcjeVz2sWuYvQqoxHxw6JsQuTBTe6fM2NPAWRdXN9F4rsWjbx1s25yBtV.jpeg)
Onderweg naar de waterval lag ook nog -een beetje verscholen- een dolmen, best een groot ding die her en der wat gerestaureerd leek. Régis volgde ons met de drone, vandaar dat we naar de lucht staan te kijken en te zwaaien.

Het was een fijne afwisseling met allerlei dingen in huis verhuizen, want deze week zou Franck, de schilder, gaan starten met de ramen en luiken in de cour. Dat betekende: werkplekken verhuizen van de cour-zijde naar de straat-zijde, want al dat schuurwerk geeft behoorlijk wat herrie!

![BC302D73-6869-4A7F-B672-F65B826C97B8_1_201_a.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23wqkimMyMCRkJWtSWaoqaERhWTeRiAKa8wwehePnQLBwDJQt444RR26fqmnky53wSgFA.jpg)
Vandaag is de steiger opgezet en de luiken eraf gehaald. Dat is nog de grootste klus, want die dingen zijn me toch loodzwaar! We kijken nu al uit naar dat gezellige kleurtje groen wat er over twee weken op zal zitten.

#### Adieu Lies
![FC72FEAC-AB16-43B1-BA16-D58C761FE955_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23tbFAYNLgekWUWQJkoiAjQ5hRZD2jsYfRtkRzKx5382G8s64stNjs589Ym7DDRTebsx9.jpeg)
Afgelopen week bereikte mij ook het verdrietige nieuws dat mijn oude buurvrouw 'tante' Lies uit de Rietgors was overleden. Zo'n buurvrouw waar altijd de deur openstond, die altijd zwaaide als je langs reed en altijd geïnteresseerd was hoe het met je ging. We hebben er heel wat uurtjes doorgebracht, zo over en weer op nummer 33 en 37. 

Vanmiddag kon ik de uitvaartdienst online bijwonen en heb toch wel een traantje weggepinkt. Vele herkenbare foto's en liefdevolle verhalen. En toch hoorde ik ook nog iets wat ik niet eerder had gehoord: Lies was als heel jong meisje 'fotomodel' voor de eerste verpakking van een product van de Gist in Delft. Haar vader was blijkbaar huisfotograaf voor de Gist. Ik heb m'n oude buurjongen Ruurd en buurmeisjes Marjan en Marijke veel sterkte toegewenst. Het is altijd leuk om weer even contact met ze te hebben, al is het bij zo'n verdrietige gebeurtenis.

#### Cactus
![9305E08D-3B26-4DAB-BBA7-4D3D808D9DFC_1_105_c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marjoleinsch/23tbu3YqCr7fXffA1mauHHJmrSh3RUekAxtZaYo8Fdy6yqPiUFgyGqzmgNiLWmbwtheZN.jpeg)
Momenteel staan overal de cactussen in bloei, prachtig!

links.body: I have a normal-sized track home lot.  But I only grow veggies on the west side of my house, it may be like 35 wide and 45 long.  I cram a lot into that small space.  My beets are very sporadic, too.  I've done two plantings, and my seed was old, too.  For the first time, I'm successful with a full row of peas.  Usually, the snails or slugs eat them when they sprout.  This year, I put crushed-dried eggshells along both sides.  It seems to be working. Still something to learn after all these years, lol.

links.title: WHy we lose Interest in Birthdays, Festivals and many things as we grow up
links.body: In childhood, birthday meant new clothes, balloons, cake, gifts, and excitement all day long. The mere mention of festivals would incite excitement. School holidays for Diwali, playing with colors during Holi—everything felt wonderful. But if we look now, festivals are still celebrated, and birthdays are still celebrated, but the excitement and happiness that we had in childhood is no longer there. Birthdays now feel like normal days, festivals feel like holidays, and many things that were once close to the heart no longer seem so good.

/> But why does this happen? Perhaps because we didn't worry too much about the future, focusing on the present, we lived in the present. If we ever got a rupee, a chocolate, or even a small toffee, we'd be happy. But as we grew older, our desires also increased with age. As we grow older, our minds are constantly preoccupied with thoughts about one thing or the other. Sometimes it's about career, sometimes it's about relationships, and sometimes it's about money.

/> I remember that as a child, the joy of a birthday would start two or three months in advance, thinking I'd get new clothes, and I'd wear casual clothes instead of my school uniform. However, I never got the chance to wear a cassock because my birthday fell during the summer holidays. But even then, it felt good just to think that my birthday was coming. As we age, our expectations and desires also grow, which can lead us to overlook even the smallest joys. This is completely wrong. We should celebrate even the smallest of joys. If we want to be truly happy, we must learn to appreciate the little things. * * *

/> बचपन में जन्मदिन का मतलब होता था नए कपड़े, गुब्बारे, केक, उपहार और दिन भर की उमंग। त्योहारों का नाम सुनते ही उत्साह उमड़ आता था। दिवाली की छुट्टियां, होली में रंगों से खेलना—सब कुछ बहुत अच्छा लगता था। लेकिन अगर हम आज के समय को देखें, तो त्योहार और जन्मदिन तो मनाए जाते हैं, लेकिन बचपन की वो उमंग और खुशी अब नहीं रही। जन्मदिन अब आम दिनों जैसे लगते हैं, त्योहार छुट्टियों जैसे लगते हैं, और कई चीजें जो कभी दिल के करीब हुआ करती थीं, अब उतनी अच्छी नहीं लगतीं। लेकिन ऐसा क्यों होता है? शायद इसलिए कि हम भविष्य की ज्यादा चिंता नहीं करते थे, वर्तमान पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए वर्तमान में जीते थे। अगर हमें एक रुपया, एक चॉकलेट या एक छोटी सी टॉफी भी मिल जाती, तो हम खुश हो जाते थे। लेकिन जैसे-जैसे हम बड़े होते गए, हमारी इच्छाएं भी बढ़ती गईं। उम्र के साथ-साथ हमारा मन लगातार किसी न किसी बात के बारे में सोचता रहता है। कभी करियर की चिंता होती है, कभी रिश्तों की, और कभी पैसों की। मुझे याद है कि बचपन में जन्मदिन की खुशी दो-तीन महीने पहले से ही शुरू हो जाती थी, यह सोचकर कि मुझे नए कपड़े मिलेंगे और मैं स्कूल यूनिफॉर्म की जगह कैजुअल कपड़े पहनूंगी। हालांकि, मुझे कभी भी पारंपरिक पोशाक पहनने का मौका नहीं मिला क्योंकि मेरा जन्मदिन गर्मियों की छुट्टियों के दौरान पड़ता था। लेकिन तब भी, सिर्फ यह सोचकर ही अच्छा लगता था कि मेरा जन्मदिन आने वाला है।

>जैसे-जैसे हमारी उम्र बढ़ती है, हमारी अपेक्षाएं और इच्छाएं भी बढ़ती जाती हैं, जिसके कारण हम छोटी-छोटी खुशियों को भी नजरअंदाज कर देते हैं। यह बिल्कुल गलत है। हमें छोटी-छोटी खुशियों का भी जश्न मनाना चाहिए। अगर हम सचमुच खुश रहना चाहते हैं, तो हमें छोटी-छोटी चीजों की कद्र करना सीखना होगा।

links.title: Windig
links.body:
Hallo zusammen 

Ja was hab ich denn da im Hühnerstall gefunden


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfXGyGkTu5eSySdC1yk4EbRsHr5uah2dKjx1H5L2Emcj/1779129123219.jpg)

Ein sogenanntes Wundei, ein Ei wo die Schale quasi nicht gebildet wurde,Es ist lediglich von einer weichen, gummiartigen Eihaut umgeben. Die häufigsten Ursachen sind Kalziummangel, Vitamin-D-Mangel (welches für die Kalziumverwertung nötig ist), Stress, extreme Hitze oder der Beginn bzw. das Ende der Legeperiode.

Also was tun..?da ich keine Junghennen habe und auch Hitze und Streß nicht wirklich vorhanden waren, da meine Hennen einen eher ruhigen streßfreien Tag genießen, fwhlt woh Kalt, also erstmal Haferflocken bei gemischt, uns für morgen Muschelgrit auf die Einkaufsliste gesetzt


Das Innere eines frisch gelegten Windeis ist in der Regel komplett unversehrt und kann bedenkenlos verzehrt oder weiterverarbeitet werden, solange es sofort aufgebraucht wird. Da die Schale fehlt, lässt es sich jedoch nicht lagern. Also ab in die Pfanne

im Hühnerstall selbst muß ich zudem darauf achten Windeier schnell zu entfernen – da sie weich sind, können sie leicht von den Hühnern zertreten werden und so das Eierpicken im Bestand auslösen.

In diesem Sinne....uffpasse und die Hühner etwas aufpeppeln

links.body:
/></center>

[source](https://www.alibaba.com/product-detail/Semi-Automatic-Dairy-And-Nutritional-Products_1601613191340.html?s=p)

**The numbers will drastically increase so I have no idea the best machine to suit our needs. If we needed a much bigger machine I would still want some small ones around in case the big one broke down.**




The new packaging business I mentioned at the end of last year and the beginning of this year where we have to receive the bulk supply and then package them is behind schedule. The product has already been launched in Australia and has over 100 000 customers which is reassuring and the numbers are increasing monthly.


As pleasing as that all sounds this has been delayed due to the Straits of Hormuz and global shipping routes. For some reason our product comes from the Far East (not China) via Dubai and we are currently 6 weeks behind schedule. The starting up and launch in South Africa will have to wait for the time being. This even though is frustrating may actually be a blessing in disguise and gives everyone more time to prepare. The start up figures I already have a ball park number in mind and know roughly how quickly that investment will be returned. This may change depending on which machine is required and would like to use what they currently use so that ball park figure may be stretched out a little.

The thought process behind the owners logic is sound as for the time being they are flying in stock. The bulk consignment which we need to move to the next stage once it arrives will have a full marketing budget behind this and only then would that trigger a production packaging line here in Johannesburg. No point in marketing right now if the stock is in short supply and the sales could not be fulfilled. 

The owner has had a change of heart with regard to packaging production lines in Europe and a pick and pack warehouse is what will be required instead. The plant in Johannesburg will supply Europe due to South Africa having favorable trade terms with the EU. This we all know could change and will have to pivot if required further down the line.

The good part about all of this is the pick and pack warehouse is still required in the EU and the Portugal move is still very much in play. Relocating to another country is hard enough besides having to find a business for a source of income so this is still very good news and changes things very little. Pick and pack is our current warehouse business so this would be very simple to implement very quickly. These days it does not matter where you are based as the courier network is so advanced and intertwined these days delivery costs are not expensive when dealing with bulk shipments.

All this means is the production facility in Johannesburg will be that much busier than anticipated meaning many more packaging machines. This I am happy with because I can make sure things are set up correctly and functioning how they should be. I have no idea how successful sales will be in South Africa for this product but going by Australia's figures then Europe should do very well.

The business partner who I am involved with in this particular project is a very old friend going back over 20 years. I knew of him in the army as he was stationed at the same base for basic training. We never met then and only 15 years later, but still recognized each other. There is a close bond which has been formed over the years and we chat weekly helping each other think through any business issues. I would say I know his business as well as he does because I need to know and understand it in order to help with advice.

links.title: Today I accidentally hit a motorbike with my car while driving
links.body:
I should say that today was not a very great day. I expected the day to be a pleasant one, being it a Monday, but ultimately it ended up being very different. I was involved in an accident today. I was returning from a function when a motorbike suddenly came in front of my car, and I hit it. He fell and got a few scratches on his hands and legs. It was quite unfortunate, and we did not debate whose fault it was but instead started taking the next steps. Even though this event itself was quite unfortunate for me, the outcome was a little better. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmapy7tB1H9L4kgtGjGQNCcwGDBtXmfUJTAgFxbPuxp6Ng/image.png)

Source - Gemini

Usually, in situations like these, either the Police person would do the gold digging or the person who got hit would. That's one of the reasons why even some of the drivers won't wait and ask the affected person to file a case and go with the law. They don't wait to help the injured person. I got this information from the Policeman who came to investigate. He appreciated me for staying with the injured person and solving this problem smoothly. Usually, the Policeman also threatens and asks for a bribe to do their job. But today the policeman was quite a gentleman. He intended to solve the issue between the two parties and was not to make use of this opportunity to make money. 

There was also some damage to my vehicle during this event. When I hit someone in the front, someone hit my car in the back because of my sudden brake. I have damage to the back of my car. I guess today is a day when I ended up spending a lot of money on unnecessary things. One lesson that I learned from today's incident is that even though I go on the road carefully, I cannot be sure that everyone will be careful. Some people might make mistakes and get hurt, and unfortunately, we might become a reason for it. It is not enough if I'm very careful while driving on the road, but others might even create situations where we might get stuck. So we have to be extra cautious, is what I understood. But because of all these, I'm not in my best moods today, but I have work piled up till my neck.

links.title: Magpie - egg thief
links.body:
I knew that the magpie wanted to steal the egg and the chick. But I have never seen such a persistent magpie.
She is wary as soon as one of the household members is in the yard she flies out of the yard. Several times my wife and I have caught her coming out of the henhouse carrying eggs in her beak. She breaks the egg and carries it with the lower part of her beak. Several times she even dropped the egg.

I don't know if she ever had a fight with the rooster, but the hens have a hole to go out into the yard for them so they don't really see the coop unless they're in it.

![20260518_181358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKPmZ4JQDvGAfAJPyhi99VxyNWTQ7q8Y1bx5gBKRKLxhcUQpGcnC23QdXi2HibB.jpg)

And our magpie probably uses that while the hens are away.

The wife tried to scare her with bags that she hung around the chicken coop, she made a scarecrow, but that didn't help either. She even put a hat on her head.
![20260518_180614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/ALD7JAB4VxacJx8waRDajP8ENXkKYdPmxS3BQ63YSY2xmJaY8M35u12N7Pz5cLF.jpg)

We also hung up some old CDs. The refracted light helped us keep the sparrows away from one part of the yard. We'll see if that helps with the magpie.
![20260518_180606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKPkWWZbKtWe6Vi9RwwB5FtxVFGxF5AfHoiqrKZBaLoU6RxtioJxHZ7RTukDUJm.jpg)


Perhaps the location of the chicken coop itself helps our thief. The chicken coop is in the lower part of the yard, right next to the garden.

I decided to make it even harder for our thief. We have a wooden door on the chicken coop, in the evening we had to close the chickens because of the weasel. And in the morning we let the chickens out and the door is open all day. I decided not to open the door, but to cut a hole at the bottom of the door
![20260518_181337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKGbLNAW954Sa434z9sisiYKHq4bwA4y2McCyHLZCpKfrnvmbd6t4zMTALuxvN7.jpg)
And I added a piece of mesh for shade to that little entrance. I hope I won't confuse the chickens :) I'll have to keep an eye on the events in the chicken coop and this evening I'll place a masonry block over that little opening.
![20260518_182106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKLu1k7RPQFnC1r87B54ZzhdSqHpjfsYm9hgDq1Swyx5FiZxZiK5JRkQFXxyBkW.jpg)
Since I was cutting with a jig saw, which is noisy, the chickens got a little scared and knocked down the sleeping ladder.

Well, I hope we can drive the thief away from our chicken coop. I'm not a fan of extreme methods. Slingshots, rocks or air rifles. I still think we can outsmart these annoying thieves.


![20260518_180632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23xVPbCUkH3jAg4kr4tYgG5NFRodoDE4C9GcFgSkBAozZMG8kRhteZ1EytWMd4VEefLDb.jpg)

---


Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.

---

links.body: /> Today I want to share a **vector illustration** I created in **Adobe Illustrator** inspired by one of the most iconic childhood characters ever — **Pikachu** ⚡💛🎮

/>

This piece was a very fun project because I wanted to recreate Pikachu in my own artistic style while preserving the cheerful energy and adorable personality that makes the character so recognizable 🥹⚡

✨ **The Story Behind This Design:**  
Growing up, characters like Pikachu always gave me a feeling of adventure, friendship, and imagination 🌍⚡  
I wanted to create something nostalgic that reminded me of those moments of excitement watching animated adventures and dreaming about collecting creatures and exploring new worlds 🎮🌟

When I started designing, I focused first on **painting Pikachu**, carefully working on the color harmony and expression to make him feel alive and full of emotion 💛👀  
After finishing the character, I decided to create the **Poké Ball** as a complementary visual element to strengthen the composition and make the artwork feel more connected to the Pokémon universe 🔴⚪✨

🖊️ **Professional Design Process & Techniques:**  
This artwork was created in **Adobe Illustrator**, focusing on **vector precision, shape simplification, and stylized character design** 💻🎨

🎯 **Professional Elements Used:**

*   **Pen Tool and Bézier curves** for smooth, clean outlines ✒️
    
*   **Flat colors combined with simple shading** for depth and volume 🎨
    
*   **Controlled line weight** to improve visual readability 🖋️
    
*   **Shape stylization and silhouette clarity** for a clean cartoon appearance ✨
    
*   **Balanced composition**, using the Poké Ball to guide the viewer’s attention ⚖️
    

💡 **Design Details:**  
The facial expression was designed to make Pikachu look playful and full of energy ⚡😊  
The shadows and highlights help create volume while keeping the illustration simple and visually attractive 🌟

The Poké Ball was added after painting Pikachu to reinforce storytelling and complete the Pokémon-inspired atmosphere 🔴⚪⚡

🌟 **Meaning Behind the Artwork:**  
For me, this illustration represents nostalgia, happiness, imagination, and the power of childhood memories 💛✨

💬 Let me know what you think of this design!  
  
❤️ Thank you for supporting my creative journey

links.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc180d5fc93691cd51e85fb11e8477c15ccc34e2707ad8afb23bf5e61c109ea5ee0b334e5f750344b5bb52334e4aaf3dd_640.jpg)</center>On my last walk, I decided to explore the stunning countryside around the Cotswolds, a region famed for its picturesque villages and rolling hills. The weather was perfect, with a bright blue sky and just a hint of a breeze, making it ideal for a day of walking.

As I set off from the charming village of Bourton-on-the-Water, often referred to as the \

I was immediately struck by the quaint stone bridges and the gentle flow of the River Windrush. The bridges date back to the 17th century and really add to the fairytale feel of the village. My route took me through lush green fields dotted with sheep and hedgerows bursting with wildflowers. The vibrant yellows and purples of the flowers contrasted beautifully with the deep green of the grass. I couldn’t help but stop frequently to take photos and admire the beauty of the landscape. Along the way, I met a couple of locals who were out tending to their gardens. One elderly gentleman, who introduced himself as Mr. Smith, shared delightful anecdotes about the history of the village. He mentioned that parts of Bourton-on-the-Water date back to the Roman era, and I was fascinated to learn how the village expanded during the 19th century due to the rise of the wool industry. As I continued my walk, I encountered a small group of hikers who were also exploring the area. We struck up a conversation, sharing our favorite spots in the Cotswolds. They recommended visiting the nearby village of Stow-on-the-Wold, known for its antique shops and rich history. I took their advice and headed there after my walk. The NBA playoffs—not for the faint of heart—have just wrapped up a brutal week, setting the stage for the Conference Finals following an epic decisive showdown in the East.

The Cavs Strike First on the Road

Game 5 of the Eastern Conference Semifinals moved to Detroit, where Cleveland proved it had what it takes to fight for the series lead.

Detroit Pistons 113 - 117 Cleveland Cavaliers: In an extremely close game at Little Caesars Arena, the Cavs withstood the home-court pressure and secured a crucial 4-point victory, led by a dominant James Harden who nearly reached 30 points. With this win, Cleveland took a 3-2 lead in the series.

Detroit strikes back hard and San Antonio seals the series

Friday was a night of pure intensity with two games that changed the course of the Semifinals.


![gettyimages-2276285900-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23uFkVmb4GjZa7yry5cxYaiUZHjaV71e6VYkttaEfEf8nW3PyJEFsm7pXNdHNWTsSV85X.png)


Cleveland Cavaliers 94 - 115 Detroit Pistons: Just when it seemed like Cleveland was set to close out the series at home (Rocket Arena), the Pistons showed their pride. With suffocating defense and a devastating offense, Detroit crushed the Cavs by 21 points, silencing the arena and forcing the dreaded and decisive Game 7 after tying the series at 3-3.

Minnesota Timberwolves 109 - 139 San Antonio Spurs: A historic blowout! The Spurs wanted nothing to do with a Game 7 and came out to tear apart Minnesota’s Target Center. With a 30-point lead, San Antonio swept aside the Wolves’ resistance to take the series 4-2 and decisively advance to the Western Conference Finals, where the Oklahoma City Thunder await them.


![gettyimages-2276940092-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23wC1GFrbogfNhoKvdTZ38x5ezwLcgWamAwEH2ZyLmLPfcX6ubkz6kXYUu1bHwcJ9fZ4x.png)


Cleveland dominates the drama of Game 7

Yesterday, the decisive Eastern Conference game was played at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, and the mood swings of the Cavs’ stars leaned toward their superhero side.

Detroit Pistons 94 - 125 Cleveland Cavaliers: The magic is over in Detroit! Despite having home-court advantage and all the momentum on their side, the Pistons froze against a relentless Cavs team. Cleveland dominated from start to finish, winning Game 7 by a crushing 31-point margin. With this road victory, the Cavaliers officially advance to the Eastern Conference Finals after winning the series 4-3.


![gettyimages-2276770814-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23vsLKAd9pWeViZqhucWi8oJmX49N9VkHCsPKLgXTdV96tAL7WnaeQXp3BKhFusu7LidW.png)


Starting today, the conference finals begin, serving up the NBA’s main course as it continues to treat us to great matchups and more in this decisive stage that paves the way to the Finals.

#### NBA Playoffs: Cleveland silencia Detroit en el Juego 7 y San Antonio avanza con autoridad

La postemporada de la NBA no apta para cardíacos acaba de cerrar una semana brutal, dejando definido el panorama de las Finales de Conferencia tras un épico choque definitivo en el Este.

Los Cavs golpean primero en la carretera

El Juego 5 de las Semifinales del Este se mudó a Detroit, donde Cleveland demostró que tenía con qué pelear el liderato de la serie.

Detroit Pistons 113 - 117 Cleveland Cavaliers: En un partido sumamente cerrado en el Little Caesars Arena, los Cavs aguantaron la presión de la casa y se llevaron una victoria de oro por 4 puntos, de la mano de un James Harden dominante que rozó los 30 puntos. Con este triunfo, Cleveland ponía la serie a su favor 3-2.

Detroit responde con fuerza y San Antonio liquida la serie

El viernes fue una noche de pura intensidad con dos partidos que cambiaron el rumbo de las Semifinales.

Cleveland Cavaliers 94 - 115 Detroit Pistons: Cuando todo parecía servido para que Cleveland cerrará la serie en su propia casa (Rocket Arena), los Pistons sacaron el orgullo. Con una defensa asfixiante y un ataque demoledor, Detroit aplastó a los Cavs por 21 puntos de ventaja, silenciando la arena y forzando el temido y definitivo Juego 7 tras empatar la serie 3-3.

Minnesota Timberwolves 109 - 139 San Antonio Spurs: ¡Paliza histórica! Spurs no quisieron saber nada de un séptimo juego y salieron a destrozar el Target Center de Minnesota. Con una ventaja de 30 puntos, San Antonio barrió la resistencia de los Wolves para llevarse la serie 4-2 y clasificar de forma contundente a las Finales de la Conferencia Oeste, donde ya los espera el Oklahoma City Thunder.

Cleveland domina el drama del Juego 7

Ayer se jugó el partido definitivo del Este en el Little Caesars Arena de Detroit, y la bipolaridad de las estrellas de los Cavs se inclinó hacia su versión de superhéroes.

Detroit Pistons 94 - 125 Cleveland Cavaliers: ¡Se acabó la magia en Detroit! A pesar de tener la localía y todo el impulso de su lado, los Pistons se congelaron ante unos Cavs implacables. Cleveland dominó de principio a fin, llevándose el Juego 7 por una arrolladora diferencia de 31 puntos. Con esta victoria como visitantes, los Cavaliers avanzan oficialmente a las Finales del Este tras ganar la serie 4-3.

Desde hoy inician las finales de conferencia donde se empieza a servir el plato fuerte de la NBA, que nos sigue regalando grandes duelos y más en esta etapa de definiciones que trazan el camino hacia la final.

links.title: «Lo frágil también es hermoso»
links.body:
La vida no es una línea recta hacia la felicidad, sino un aprendizaje constante tejido con aciertos, errores, pérdidas y pequeños milagros cotidianos.

A veces creemos que vivir es llegar a alguna parte: a un título, una casa, un logro. Pero la vida ocurre en los intersticios: en ese café compartido, en la canción que te devuelve a un recuerdo, en el atardecer que no planeaste mirar. Es más proceso que destino.

También duele. Y está bien. Las grietas no son fallas, sino lugares por donde entra la luz que te reconstruye. No se trata de ser inmune al dolor, sino de aprender a habitarlo sin que él te habite para siempre.

Suelta la obsesión por tener todas las respuestas. No las hay. Solo preguntas que mutan mientras tú creces. Y crecer no siempre es avanzar: a veces es retroceder, pausar, cambiar de rumbo. Eso también es vivir.

Al final, la vida no se mide por lo que acumulaste, sino por lo que te atreves a sentir, por el amor que diste sin garantías y por la forma en que te levantaste una vez más, aunque temblaran tus piernas.

Quizás el sentido no está afuera, esperando ser descubierto. Quizás lo construyes cada mañana al elegir, entre el caos, una razón para seguir.

Vive sin miedo a la imperfección. Porque lo frágil también es hermoso. Y porque, al fin y al cabo, la vida no exige que seas eterno, solo que seas real.

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well and healthy by the grace of Allah. I am also well and healthy by your prayers. For this, I am thanking Allah a million times. Alhamdulillah, I am presenting this new video to you today, informing you all of the juicy fruits and the feeling of being refreshed in this late summer afternoon

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPopoafgXWc94hibfJnMeizZo4tuuHJKkG9LpX1vttCHp/1779120582517.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvSqpAjwzJiQBUKhFyPuHroykPQ33b8XhYc47gZGzGSY/1779120582849.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you. On the occasion of the upcoming Eid-ul-Adha, this video of mine is on the occasion of Eid-ul-Adha in our country. On this occasion, on Thursday, May 28th, a huge heart has been organized at our cemetery central complex. On the occasion of this heart, I will present my video today to you. Inshallah, let's start this video, friends. First, I will show you a beautiful banner that has been put up here, that is, a banner called the Big Cow and Goat Market. Our market will start from the 23rd to the 28th, that is, you can come at any time, but we have a large number of small and big cows and goats here. And those who are sellers can sell them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdMn5v3YjWAxzEWxPq1HwzfQsSuKrHXRsmTNhCc8hPtd/1779120612624.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTzdK56BLguh8M8zRE8WqHZWPB9TMtEp1hVMMcEVgBEAr/1779120612763.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmebKxr8KZUHB3tPRjxJ3HXD3opdkeTyVpKhfsb3mwW7xM/1779120612890.jpg)

So friends, you can see in this video that a large number of buses have been bought here, these will be used as shelters and a long bamboo will be tied between them, then the cows will be kept here in rows. Inshallah, I will try to show you those scenes later, that is, in the next video, so today I have made this video of mine just to show you that there is only an initial beginning of the heart going on here. Friends, here you can see many madrasa students. They are taking bamboos one by one and placing them in a specific place. They are doing these things, that is, some are burying the bamboos and some are tying the buses on top. In this way, every person, every student, is busy with work, but because there is not much time, we will hold a big one here in a few days.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT27iWcMy7Q3KQ73fz52P8Vxn6KKQC8GeSmhQNdtBrxMC/1779120627711.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvuARk28pV9NFuiY8Vahm3bsT1NkVamB2X4Ts64MUXRd/1779120627807.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgC2YRwaFCTRLkPhFFN7xoMNpYwr3JDc3qCMaVLAsuLd/1779120627951.jpg)

Like every year, this year too, a very busy market will be held here. Everyone believes that because every year a market is held here and this market is one of the biggest in our district. A large number of fathers and seller brothers come here and from here, cows are filled and taken to our capital again, that is, from here they are taken to different places in the country to sell them. That is, all types of cows, big and small, are available here. Especially the cows that we buy, we waste from here. If you want to buy a cow here, you have to pay 40 taka per thousand, which is used for the development of the mosque, madrasa and orphanage. That is, this money is used entirely for the development of the complex. So, no one has any personal interest here. Everyone works selflessly and I also cooperate here. That is, I also work here to cooperate with this institution.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvuARk28pV9NFuiY8Vahm3bsT1NkVamB2X4Ts64MUXRd/1779120644670.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdJqNC8EFX676BJLWavfMuNRyTmThryGniFGFY4Ki5bU/1779120644801.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4PCz7iR1RarYxeDHkGm5D9mLMWFoxH3ejzByRirL55i/1779120644941.jpg)

Friends, this hand is so big that this hand, the land that I tried to show you, is filled to the brim with cows, even covering the roads. Our traffic here is quite distorted because it is a development work. But the administration helps us in this work, since there is an alternative road to this road, vehicles can use that road, but for a while this road is closed, but here, a large number of cows are raised, I have seen it with my own eyes since the beginning of my life, and everyone cooperates here not for any profit, but to get closer to themselves and Allah Ta'ala, they work selflessly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmatmZLNN29bzC6RP4xeswEMnUrrUuVBcFhdLfjUQzVGCR/1779120672912.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFDwgbhHi8g2kdiW6833V4brmSqSyD2nWMYqekJfSHCC/1779120673052.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWEVrcMuFWxbsyXWtqcnora81sJ7RY3E2dJHXfmVyvv8/1779120673152.jpg)

So friends, how did you like the scenes of my preparation for today's initial haat? Of course, you will give your important opinions and later I will present the second part of this haat to you. Of course, if I am alive, InshaAllah, I will definitely try to show you the second part. How many cows are raised here? Until then, everyone will be well and healthy. I am saying goodbye to you like today. I request you to watch the next video. May Allah preserve you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPrQnR24GsC5CjfXWBceY26bmSWX43eBPj3n44ZGE4Cu/1779120719380.jpg)

Alhamdulillah, I am presenting this new video to you today, informing you all of the juicy fruits and the feeling of being refreshed in this late summer afternoon

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPopoafgXWc94hibfJnMeizZo4tuuHJKkG9LpX1vttCHp/1779120582517.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPrQnR24GsC5CjfXWBceY26bmSWX43eBPj3n44ZGE4Cu/1779120582615.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJ4Y7D6wvWnbdGSzcx3M4JztuFPiPBsiTtUAybj4tLiu/1779120582701.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVE7GUq8c63W21yukySrSQo6E7t4PADUZnhqjVLivh4hY/1779120582774.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvSqpAjwzJiQBUKhFyPuHroykPQ33b8XhYc47gZGzGSY/1779120582849.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you. On the occasion of the upcoming Eid-ul-Adha, this video of mine is on the occasion of Eid-ul-Adha in our country. On this occasion, on Thursday, May 28th, a huge heart has been organized at our cemetery central complex. On the occasion of this heart, I will present my video today to you. Inshallah, let's start this video, friends. First, I will show you a beautiful banner that has been put up here, that is, a banner called the Big Cow and Goat Market. Our market will start from the 23rd to the 28th, that is, you can come at any time, but we have a large number of small and big cows and goats here. And those who are sellers can sell them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdMn5v3YjWAxzEWxPq1HwzfQsSuKrHXRsmTNhCc8hPtd/1779120612624.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTzdK56BLguh8M8zRE8WqHZWPB9TMtEp1hVMMcEVgBEAr/1779120612763.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmebKxr8KZUHB3tPRjxJ3HXD3opdkeTyVpKhfsb3mwW7xM/1779120612890.jpg)

So friends, you can see in this video that a large number of buses have been bought here, these will be used as shelters and a long bamboo will be tied between them, then the cows will be kept here in rows. Inshallah, I will try to show you those scenes later, that is, in the next video, so today I have made this video of mine just to show you that there is only an initial beginning of the heart going on here. Friends, here you can see many madrasa students. They are taking bamboos one by one and placing them in a specific place. They are doing these things, that is, some are burying the bamboos and some are tying the buses on top. In this way, every person, every student, is busy with work, but because there is not much time, we will hold a big one here in a few days.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT27iWcMy7Q3KQ73fz52P8Vxn6KKQC8GeSmhQNdtBrxMC/1779120627711.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvuARk28pV9NFuiY8Vahm3bsT1NkVamB2X4Ts64MUXRd/1779120627807.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgC2YRwaFCTRLkPhFFN7xoMNpYwr3JDc3qCMaVLAsuLd/1779120627951.jpg)

Like every year, this year too, a very busy market will be held here. Everyone believes that because every year a market is held here and this market is one of the biggest in our district. A large number of fathers and seller brothers come here and from here, cows are filled and taken to our capital again, that is, from here they are taken to different places in the country to sell them. That is, all types of cows, big and small, are available here. Especially the cows that we buy, we waste from here. If you want to buy a cow here, you have to pay 40 taka per thousand, which is used for the development of the mosque, madrasa and orphanage. That is, this money is used entirely for the development of the complex. So, no one has any personal interest here. Everyone works selflessly and I also cooperate here. That is, I also work here to cooperate with this institution.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWvuARk28pV9NFuiY8Vahm3bsT1NkVamB2X4Ts64MUXRd/1779120644670.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdJqNC8EFX676BJLWavfMuNRyTmThryGniFGFY4Ki5bU/1779120644801.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4PCz7iR1RarYxeDHkGm5D9mLMWFoxH3ejzByRirL55i/1779120644941.jpg)

Friends, this hand is so big that this hand, the land that I tried to show you, is filled to the brim with cows, even covering the roads. Our traffic here is quite distorted because it is a development work. But the administration helps us in this work, since there is an alternative road to this road, vehicles can use that road, but for a while this road is closed, but here, a large number of cows are raised, I have seen it with my own eyes since the beginning of my life, and everyone cooperates here not for any profit, but to get closer to themselves and Allah Ta'ala, they work selflessly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmatmZLNN29bzC6RP4xeswEMnUrrUuVBcFhdLfjUQzVGCR/1779120672912.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFDwgbhHi8g2kdiW6833V4brmSqSyD2nWMYqekJfSHCC/1779120673052.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWEVrcMuFWxbsyXWtqcnora81sJ7RY3E2dJHXfmVyvv8/1779120673152.jpg)

So friends, how did you like the scenes of my preparation for today's initial haat? Of course, you will give your important opinions and later I will present the second part of this haat to you. Of course, if I am alive, InshaAllah, I will definitely try to show you the second part. How many cows are raised here? Until then, everyone will be well and healthy. I am saying goodbye to you like today. I request you to watch the next video. May Allah preserve you.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcPrQnR24GsC5CjfXWBceY26bmSWX43eBPj3n44ZGE4Cu/1779120719380.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPFUqpqx4xhNJdG41kbN46gbMLyGZtQbLPUPiExokGYba/1779120719504.jpg)

links.title: Shoplfiting is out of Control...
links.body:
Shoplifting has traditionally been treated as a low level crime that doesn't really matter that much, something businesses can just sort of scuk-up and a low level crime with not much of an impact. 

However the nature of the crime in the UK is changing - it's got to the stage now where shoplifting gangs can brazenly walk into stores and take armfuls of goods with the authorities seemingly powerless to stop them! 

### Who Really Pays for 'Petty' Theft?

Calling shoplifting a “victimless crime” is not particularly accurate. 

While small shop owners are obviously immediate victims and we can really feel their plight, even with Big Supermarkets the costs are passed on to shoppers - not only in the form of higher prices but also in tighter security - more guards and more locked up products, making a worse shopping experience for consumers. 

Then there are the people behind the counters. More and more, retail staff talk about being threatened or even attacked. What used to be the odd stolen item is now sometimes planned, brazen, and hostile. There has been a worrying increase in intimidation with shoplifting in recent years. 

And at a more abstract level, this might just make us all a bit less trusting of others in our daily interactions, which makes life both less efficient and more unpleasant. 

You see it already—essentials behind plastic, suspicious glances, everyday shopping feeling tense instead of ordinary.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23tm7Ju75SJeYDB1kpMp9UcB2pEt6JKSJNm1B2aCEeyR3mTe2t7Y8LTA7M5U6AAY7VREu.png)



### Why the increase...? 

Well possibly it's because there's hardly any chance of getting caught, let alone being prosecuted. 

And Shoplifting is increasingly for thrill-seeking, not economic survival. 

There's also the fact that people don't trust our public institutions any more and have no sense of commitment to anyone else outside of their immediate circle's. 

### A Society on Edge...?

Possibly this is a sign that Britain is getting too complacent with low-level disorder...? Maybe we're just not in a position to be able to chuck resources at it...? 

Either way it's another signifier of the uK in decline!

links.title: 🇪🇺 Ірландія змінює правила надання притулку: що таке новий Asylum Procedure Regulation і чому це важливо (Частина 1)
links.body: 12 червня 2026 року в ЄС почне діяти новий регламент — Asylum Procedure Regulation (APR). Це частина великого Пакту ЄС про міграцію та притулок.\n\n

/>  
  
Разом із ним запрацюють нові правила розгляду заяв на міжнародний захист, прискорені процедури та прикордонні центри.

Ірландія офіційно приєднується до нового регламенту.

Якщо коротко — ЄС хоче, щоб рішення щодо притулку ухвалювали швидше, жорсткіше та більш однаково в усіх країнах.

**❗️що саме зміниться.**

Чіткі строки розгляду справ

Раніше процес міг тривати роками.  
Тепер ЄС встановлює обов’язкові часові рамки.

**Нові строки:**

• 2 місяці — рішення про неприйнятність заяви  
• 6 місяців — стандартний розгляд  
• 3 місяці — прискорені справи  
• 3 місяці — повний цикл для прикордонної процедури (перша інстанція + апеляція + рішення про повернення)

При цьому рішення про депортацію мають видаватися одразу після відмови або «без невиправданої затримки».

І тут цікава деталь.

Станом на червень 2025 року в Ірландії середній час очікування першого рішення — 71 тиждень.  
Це більше 16 місяців.  
Апеляції — ще приблизно 10 місяців.

Тобто новий регламент фактично ламає нинішню систему й змушує державу працювати в зовсім іншому темпі.

Кого розглядатимуть у прискореному порядку?

Новий регламент визначає 10 категорій справ, які тепер ОБОВ’ЯЗКОВО підуть через прискорену процедуру.

Серед них:

• якщо людина подає суперечливу або явно неправдоподібну історію;  
• якщо надала фальшиві документи або приховала інформацію про особу чи громадянство;  
• якщо знищила документи, щоб ускладнити встановлення особи;  
• якщо заяву подано лише для затягування депортації;  
• якщо людина приїхала з так званої «безпечної країни походження»;  
• якщо не подала заяву одразу після в’їзду без поважної причини;  
• якщо країна має менше 20% позитивних рішень щодо притулку в ЄС.

**ЄС фактично вводить систему «швидкого фільтра».**  
Якщо країна вважається «малоризиковою» — справу можуть розглянути максимально швидко.

Прикордонна процедура: що це означає?

Регламент вводить обов’язкову border procedure — прикордонну процедуру.

Раніше країни могли її використовувати або ні.  
Тепер — повинні.

Вона стосується людей, які:

• надали неправдиві дані або знищили документи;  
• становлять ризик для безпеки чи громадського порядку;  
• походять із країн із рівнем схвалення притулку нижче 20%.

**Що це означає на практиці?**

Поки триває розгляд, людині офіційно НЕ дозволяється в’їзд на територію держави.  
Її справа розглядається в спеціальному прикордонному центрі.

На все — максимум 12 тижнів.

Якщо відмовляють — людина автоматично переходить у процедуру повернення, яка також має тривати не більше 12 тижнів.

Ірландія повинна створити такі центри та офіційно повідомити Єврокомісію про їх розташування до квітня 2026 року.

❗️Квоти для країн ЄС

ЄС встановлює загальну «потужність» системи — 30 тисяч людей одночасно в border procedure по всьому Союзу.

Кожна країна отримає свою квоту.

**Для Ірландії це:**

• 464 людини одночасно  
• або 1856 справ на рік

Після досягнення квоти держава сама вирішує, чи брати ще людей у прикордонну процедуру.

Попри жорсткіші правила, регламент додає й нові гарантії для заявників.

Серед них:

• безкоштовна юридична консультація;  
• більше доступу до інформації про процедуру;  
• оцінка вразливості людини протягом 30 днів;  
• окрема увага жертвам тортур, сексуального насильства та психологічних травм.

Також є важливий виняток:

Якщо держава не може забезпечити людині необхідну підтримку в прискореній процедурі — її НЕ повинні переводити в accelerated або border procedure.

Для людей із серйозними медичними чи психічними проблемами теж передбачені винятки.

ЄС також хоче створити єдиний список:

🔹безпечних країн походження;  
🔹безпечних третіх країн.

Тобто список держав, громадянам яких буде складніше довести потребу в міжнародному захисті.

Єврокомісія вже пропонує пришвидшити запуск цих механізмів.

**Що це означає для Ірландії?**

Ірландська система притулку зміниться дуже сильно.

links.title: Cuando la buena voluntad se convierte en obligación. / When goodwill becomes an obligation. ESP./EN.
links.body: >Image created by the Ecency AIImagen creada con la IA de Ecency para este post. / Image created by the Ecency AI for this post.
>Cuando la buena voluntad se convierte en obligación
>Pront: No voy a ofrecerme como voluntario.

>Una de las situaciones más interesantes que se me han presentado en el mundo laboral y comunitario se ha debido a la tal vez la mal entendida virtud que poseo, de preocuparme siempre por las personas y por el entorno que me rodea, y eso me ha llevado a ofrecerme como voluntario para realizar ayudas y apoyos, algunos de estos a personas y otros a las comunidades.

>Y aunque sí es cierto que, prestando el apoyo a personas necesitadas y diferentes comunidades, uno se siente muy bien a nivel personal, también es cierto que muchas veces hay personas que abusan de esa condición de buen samaritano que uno posee.

>De hecho, eso me pasó ya en un par de ocasiones, y la situación fue la siguiente: en el condominio de la comunidad donde vivo, se presentó un problema eléctrico, y varios vecinos saben que yo trabajé como electricista y obrero de construcción para pagarme los estudios universitarios, y por esa razón, le pidieron a la Junta de Condominio que me contactaran para resolver el problema.

>Y así lo hizo la junta; sin embargo, cuando pasé la factura del servicio para el cual ellos me habían contratado, no me quisieron pagar, ya que aludían que, al igual que siempre, ese trabajo había sido un apoyo que yo había hecho a la comunidad. Y por más que expliqué que no fue un apoyo, y que un miembro de la junta me había contratado, no quisieron pagarme, hasta que hice un reclamo formal.

>La segunda vez, se presentó cuando una vecina, una persona mayor, me exigió que debía ir a su piso a reparar la iluminación, ya que yo siempre ayudaba a las personas del edificio, y de hecho ella pensaba que me pagaban por eso. Y el problema no fue que la señora haya pedido ayuda, sino la forma en la que lo hizo.

>Eso, junto a otras situaciones que se presentaron por el apoyo continuo a las personas y la comunidad, me enseñaron a ya no ofrecerme de voluntario ni para apoyar a las personas, ni a las comunidades, debido a que al final, las mismas personas a las que uno apoya, intentan luego aprovecharse y exigir, como si el apoyo que uno da de buena gana fuese una obligación.
>Pront: I'm not going to volunteer.

>One of the most interesting situations that has presented itself to me in the world of work and community has been due to the perhaps misunderstood virtue that I possess, of always caring about people and the environment that surrounds me, and that has led me to volunteer to make aids and supports, some of these to people and others to communities.

>And although it is true that, providing support to people in need and different communities, one feels very good on a personal level, it is also true that many times there are people who abuse that condition of good Samaritan that one possesses.

>In fact, that has already happened to me on a couple of occasions, and the situation was as follows: in the condominium of the community where I live, an electrical problem occurred, and several neighbors know that I worked as an electrician and construction worker to pay for my university studies, and for that reason, they asked the Condominium Board to contact me to solve the problem.

>And so the board did; however, when I passed the invoice for the service for which they had hired me, they did not want to pay me, since they alluded that, as always, that work had been a support that I had made to the community. And even though I explained that it was not an endorsement, and that a board member had hired me, they didn't want to pay me, until I made a formal claim.

>The second time, she showed up when a neighbor, an elderly person, demanded that I should go to her apartment to repair the lighting, since I always helped the people in the building, and in fact she thought that I was getting paid for that. And the problem was not that the lady asked for help, but the way she did it.

>That, along with other situations that arose due to the continuous support to people and the community, taught me to no longer volunteer to support people or communities, because in the end, the very people one supports, then try to take advantage and demand, as if the support one willingly gives was an obligation.

links.title: There’s something truly magical about watching nature unfold right in your own backyard. 🌿✨
links.body:
![DSC05133.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKpZnKnnnM9DKQL1XMRCAhisuk7EwhSq2iALLEoe7upD/DSC05133.JPG)

There’s something truly magical about watching nature unfold right in your own backyard. 🌿✨

One of my favorite little visitors is the beautiful goldfinch bird. Their bright yellow feathers, soft chirping, and playful energy bring so much joy to my mornings. Every day, they come to my backyard, gently landing near the birdbath for a quick drink and a refreshing splash. It feels like they trust my little corner of the world, and that makes every moment special.

Recently, I was lucky enough to capture this beautiful moment through my camera lens—three lovely goldfinches resting on a branch, one mid-flight, creating the perfect natural frame. Moments like these remind me why I love bird photography so much.

Bird photography is more than just taking pictures for me—it’s about patience, observation, and connection with nature. You learn to slow down, stay still, and appreciate the tiny details we often miss in our busy lives. The way sunlight touches their feathers, the way they communicate with each other, and the peaceful rhythm of their daily visits—it’s pure therapy.

Goldfinches are especially fascinating because of their vibrant color and cheerful presence. They seem to carry sunshine wherever they go. Watching them drink from the birdbath feels like being invited into their little world, even if only for a few minutes.

Photography helps me preserve these moments forever. Every click tells a story—of trust, beauty, and the quiet happiness nature brings. Sometimes the best adventures don’t require travel; they happen right outside your window.

This simple backyard ritual has taught me to appreciate life’s small blessings. A branch, a birdbath, a few birds, and a camera—that’s all it takes to create a moment worth remembering.

If you ever get a chance, place a birdbath in your backyard and just watch. You’ll be surprised how much peace and beauty arrive with wings.

Nature always has a story to tell—we just need to pause long enough to listen. 💛🐦📸

links.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: MUÑECA DE TRAPO (2000).
links.body:
***Hola mi gente bella, espero esten todos super bien, he estado un poco ausente por cuestiones personales, pero bueno aqui volvimos otra vez para seguir trayanedo las historia dramaticas de nuestro pais, porque tenemos que completar toda esta colecciòn de dramaticos en este arichivo historico, y que aqui quede plasmasdo en la red. Ya pasamos la ediciòn n# 200 y seguimos mi gente.***

---

![201..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23wMmCUjKbPgzhzupim8uYkPgjznkut8ZdMUtAnJqnDer2eYowcmJzGSjYUtYz7GEgHjg.jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***Muñeca de trapo es una telenovela venezolana transmitida por Venevisión en el año 2000. Fue escrita por la reconocida autora Inés Rodena (en una adaptación moderna de sus clásicas historias melodramáticas) y producida por Laura Visconti. La producción destacó por rescatar la esencia del \

tradicional, enfocado en el romance juvenil, el contraste de clases sociales y los secretos del pasado.***

---

<center>![httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploadedf8e8adaf-32b4-4ada-ac6e-3f6962327c4d.jpeg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23wMkug8wZxVQQRsHqDtnQNyDvUBa9CPaoRmJ4fYQuSMSeUzn8fFyaTERtQduk2GnkZPM.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploadedf8e8adaf-32b4-4ada-ac6e-3f6962327c4d.jpeg)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***-Titulo Original: Muñeca De Trapo.
-Productora: Venevisión / Laura Visconti Producciones.
​-Año: 2000 (136 episodios).
​-Guion: Adaptación de una historia original de Inés Rodena.
​-Dirección: Claudio Callao.
​-Protagonistas: Karina Orozco y Adrián Delgado.
​-Antagonistas: Eduardo Luna, Lourdes Martínez y Susy Landaeta.
​-Elenco Estelar: Rodolfo Drago, Rebeca Costoya, Juan Carlos Vivas y Francisco Ferrari.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por MDO (Menudo).***

---

<center>![httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploadeddcffc65d-e823-4f62-8535-3e52f1524596.png&height=191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23y8oQnGR7DLu4L3j8PxBZDhgnYwUgnUaLkLxR29beBPcSWuYwXuRKQCXh8XHNTph4zJp.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actriz protagonista de la novela](httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploadeddcffc65d-e823-4f62-8535-3e52f1524596.png&height=191)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***La historia sigue la vida de Laura Arteaga (Karina Orozco), una joven hermosa, dulce y de origen muy humilde que trabaja incansablemente para sacar adelante a su familia. Debido a su timidez y su situación vulnerable, muchos a su alrededor la tratan despectivamente como si fuera una simple \

.***

***​Su destino cambia por completo cuando conoce a Alejandro Montesinos (Adrián Delgado), un joven apuesto, rico y de buena familia. A pesar de la enorme brecha social que los separa y de la feroz oposición de la estricta familia de Alejandro, ambos se enamoran profundamente. El conflicto central se desarrolla cuando Laura debe dejar atrás su fragilidad para convertirse en una mujer fuerte, enfrentando no solo el clasismo de la alta sociedad, sino también un oscuro secreto del pasado que une a ambas familias de forma insospechada.***

---

<center>![httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploaded5c01887f-90d4-45a0-ba96-74427456556c.png&height=191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23vi1YSLE1Yy3chnhQhZ2YjCUpbKY1NZBbViQy6Y5egH8Aq7KNt8nypffPS4H3EqjpvfX.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actriz Protagonistas de la novela](httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploaded5c01887f-90d4-45a0-ba96-74427456556c.png&height=191)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***​Esta telenovela es especialmente recordada por haber sido el gran trampolín protagónico para la actriz Karina Orozco, quien logró conmover al público con su interpretación de la sufrida pero resiliente Laura. Hizo una pareja televisiva muy fresca y juvenil junto a Adrián Delgado, quien para ese momento ya se había consolidado como uno de los galanes jóvenes más cotizados del país tras sus éxitos en A todo corazón y Mujercitas.***

***​La crítica de la época señaló que, aunque la trama seguía una fórmula clásica ya conocida en el género, la novela funcionó gracias al ritmo ágil de su dirección y al carisma de su elenco juvenil. Un factor clave en su éxito con el público adolescente fue su tema musical principal, interpretado por la famosa boyband internacional MDO, lo que le dio un gran impulso promocional dentro y fuera de Venezuela.***

---

<center>![httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploaded00c82ce2-13bc-49a4-9ab1-8f5f42efddc5.png&height=191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EorzGuHfgj5sBNou9BUGmrsQytXdZYXiCeSY3mVX5bEPvf28RaytzM9TCNSHUj8anR6.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actriz protagonista](httpsinsight-images-do.immergo.tvresizeurl=httpsvenevision.vod.immergo.tvvenevisionuploaded00c82ce2-13bc-49a4-9ab1-8f5f42efddc5.png&height=191)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Muñeca de trapo es recordada como una telenovela nostálgica y encantadora que cerró con broche de oro las producciones rosas de la época. Logró conectar con la audiencia gracias a la química de sus protagonistas y a una historia de amor directa y sin pretensiones. Su legado reside en haber sido una vitrina para el talento joven venezolano del nuevo milenio y un bonito ejemplo del melodrama clásico en su estado más puro.***

---

<center>![httpsencrypted-tbn0.gstatic.comimagesq=tbnANd9GcSud7LY9iJ9NXkKOBKD_hyVmS_p5_20RVdsOw&s.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23w2ueXFvMYLUYPtcdFRWp5vucXqSUvVvn9AG7d8euDza3gBkAN1bVRnmPvVHdwKPyijH.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsencrypted-tbn0.gstatic.comimagesq=tbnANd9GcSud7LY9iJ9NXkKOBKD_hyVmS_p5_20RVdsOw&s)</center>

---

links.title: Trump Visit To Iran
links.body:
Last week, Donald Trump went to Beijing. And pay attention, because this was not just another diplomatic trip. It was the first visit by a sitting American president to China in almost a decade. Bands at the airport, children holding flowers, a banquet at the Great Hall of the People, a walk through Zhongnanhai. At the same time, behind the scenes, multi billion dollar agreements were being signed, while other major issues were being carefully avoided.

THE SETTING

So, in order to understand what happened, we first need to understand how it happened. China rolled out its entire diplomatic arsenal. Bands, children with flowers, a private tour of the Temple of Heaven, and a closing walk through Zhongnanhai, the walled compound where Chinese leaders have lived and worked since 1949 and where very few foreigners have ever stepped foot. Xi even gave Trump rose seeds as a farewell gift.

And this is where things become even more interesting. At the banquet, they served beef ribs and tiramisu, an obvious nod to Trump’s tastes. Chinese CEOs were pushing each other just to take selfies with Elon Musk. Lei Jun from Xiaomi managed to get his photo, Musk visibly sighed, and the video went viral on Weibo with more than 20 million views.

Jensen Huang, the CEO of Nvidia ($NVDA), who joined Trump’s delegation at the very last minute, was seen the next day eating noodles in a traditional Beijing hutong, drinking bubble tea, and speaking broken Mandarin with locals. Musk’s son appeared wearing a traditional Chinese vest and carrying a tiger head shaped bag, which sold out online within hours.

THE TRADE DEALS

Nice optics and symbolism, but now let’s move to the serious part. What was actually agreed?

First of all, tariff reductions on agricultural products. In very simple terms, the two sides agreed to mutually reduce tariffs on a range of goods. And to understand how significant this is, consider that agricultural trade between the U.S. and China collapsed by 65.7% in a single year, falling to $8.4 billion in 2025. Analysts expect a 10% reduction in soybean tariffs, something that could reopen the door for Chinese private buyers.

But that’s not all. Beijing granted 5 year registration renewals to 425 American beef plants that had been excluded from the market last year, while also approving 77 new registrations. The U.S. trade representative stated that he expects China to purchase agricultural products worth “double digit billions” over the next three years. And let’s not forget that China also agreed to buy additional Boeing aircraft, along with more American oil.

“And how important is all of this really?” you might ask. It represents the normalization of a relationship that had reached rock bottom. In other words, billion dollar trade flows that had been frozen are now returning.

IRAN AND THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ

And this is exactly where the hottest issue enters the picture. The U.S.-Iran war is entering its third month. Trump himself said that the ceasefire is “on life support.” Meanwhile, the Strait of Hormuz remains closed by Iran, causing gasoline prices in the U.S. and oil prices worldwide to surge.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQaBqosGSLh5wWYdSqufb9jD8BSDm9f1iJwN6Fwmpwc1N/image.png)


So what did Xi say? That he wants to help diplomatically, but not militarily. “If I can help, I would like to help,” according to Trump’s comments later shared on Fox News. And China has every reason to care. Roughly 40% of China’s energy imports pass through that strait. The U.S. imports none.

Now you may ask… will China actually pressure Iran? This is where things get complicated. China is Iran’s largest trading partner and buys around 90% of Iranian oil exports. In other words, Beijing provides Tehran with tens of billions of dollars every year. Analysts are very clear about this. China has little incentive to step in directly, and it is also one of the countries best positioned to withstand an oil shock because of its massive renewable energy infrastructure and enormous domestic coal reserves.

TAIWAN

Now, Taiwan was officially on the agenda, but in practice… it was mostly avoided. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the issue “did not dominate” the discussions. The White House statement did not even mention Taiwan. On the other side, Xi warned that mishandling the issue could place U.S.-China relations in “great danger.”

What did Trump say? “China and Taiwan need to calm down.” He also added: “I don’t want to travel 9,500 miles to fight.” When asked whether he would approve another major arms sale to Taiwan, he answered: “maybe, maybe not.”

At the same time, Nvidia ($NVDA) appears to be regaining export licenses for its H200 chips to 10 Chinese companies. In other words, something also seems to be moving on the technology front.
