links.title: Mobile Phone Photography Contest Round #113 // A Little Beauty Among the Leaves
links.body:
----
Good evening to all my friends in this #FeelGood community. I hope you all have a nice day and that you can all carry out your daily activities as usual.
----

![IMG-20260518-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYfh1B2HH8TsWjDGM3qiNkM9pgEXEEgZ3xLJxSqy5kJwA/IMG-20260518-WA0011.jpg)

<div class=\

> In this blog, I want to share some images with this beloved community as my participation in the contest held in round #113. My friends... Sometimes beauty doesn't require a grand place; we simply need to stop for a moment and observe the small beauties found in nature. That's what I can say about the images I shared at this meeting in the mobile photography contest. One time, while I was in a plantation, I paused at a rest area and, without planning, I was drawn to a small insect perched on a green leaf. I slowly approached it and discovered it was a butterfly with eye-patterns on its wings, as if it were watching me back. My friends... Amidst the hustle and bustle of the fast-paced day, this tiny creature slowly taught me. I felt both calm and awe-inspiring at the beauty of nature. Therefore, I can say that beauty doesn't require a grand place; it arises from the simple place within ourselves, which we often overlook. Armed with this beautiful little insect, I entered the #113 contest held within this beloved community. This image was taken using a simple cell phone, no tricks, no excessive editing, just a small moment that I would be a shame to miss. Below are some images featuring this little insect. ![IMG-20260518-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYzm7uPuaDgEheGUcNk3QVkKiuwXDwjCh18qbiemKD9nN/IMG-20260518-WA0009.jpg) ![IMG-20260518-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSaHLHNeZchtbazZ7iC8akP9kQfZpNwmePpGVxn5sZPF/IMG-20260518-WA0006.jpg) ![IMG-20260518-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVKw49djVYBVTZYsWPRtSpVbDKbCaja7dRkcqYuqiD6ib/IMG-20260518-WA0007.jpg) ![IMG-20260518-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmchHcA7KPw28N1SyX96cKe4gvAuqVbDP2tWcyS2rHGQMg/IMG-20260518-WA0008.jpg) Alright, my friends, those are some pictures and a short post from me for this meeting. I hope you all enjoyed and were entertained by what I shared. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who took the time to view and read my blog to the end. Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can create a better blog in the future. That's all for now. Greetings, everyone. See you on my next blog. ---- ---- Camera used | Handphone | - | - Lens | 64 mp F-stop | Iso speed | ISO Focal length | MM community | feel good Photographer | @antonydossantos ---- A Little About Me ---- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUK9D9GN56JL2LmJ2ZZxysK9jAq3RbNqr2iqNCMy9bx9C/60476.jpg) *My name is Maulizar Mawardi, also known as @antonydossantos* *I am a student and nature lover who enjoys documenting my travels through writing and photography. While not a professional photographer, I believe that every journey and every simple image, no matter how small, has value and a story worth sharing* *Through this blockchain, I want to share my experiences, observations, and appreciation for nature and the simple moments that are often overlooked* ----

title.title: Phone Photography Contest Round -113
title.body: > Happy start to the week to all my Hivers friends! Thank you for sharing a new post here for the weekly contest number -113 #phonephotography, which is sponsored by our friend @untilwelearn, where we showcase excellent photographs captured with our cell phone cameras. >Feliz inicio de semana para todos los amigos Hivers agradecido por compartir una nueva publicación aquí para el concurso semanal número -113 #phonephotography el cuál es patrocinado por el amigo @untilwelearn dónde mostramos excelentes fotografías pero capturadas con la cámara de nuestro teléfono celular. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSaWqbfEaVBxZckfdqCA3Eo9RqY26DLdzxYetRJZftMVF/1779127994491.jpg) A few hours ago I was walking around the area where I live and I noticed that the nearby mountains, from below, don't look as green as they should be because it hasn't rained in a long time, which makes everything look kind of lifeless. Also, some trees have been cut down because, being so old and tall, we run the risk that they could fall at any moment and leave us without electricity, which makes the view even clearer. >Hace unas horas venía caminando un poco por el sector dónde vivo y ví cómo las montañas cercanas desde abajo no se ven tan verdes cómo deberían de estar ya qué no ha llovido en mucho tiempo lo cuál permite qué todo se vea así de no sé cómo sin mucha vida, además algunos árboles también han sido cortados ya qué al tener una gran cantidad de años y ser muy altos corremos el riesgo de qué en cualquier momento se puedan caer y dejarnos sin energía eléctrica de allí qué la vista sea aún más clara. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRPX8T6cnNra9nRbZ25ThApjWdKqiJTP4Ta6pux15CNC9/1779128205316.jpg) I took these other photos from the house, maybe from the top (on the roof), which isn't very high, but it definitely has a great view, although there are some houses that are bigger and take away some of the visibility, but it's still incredible to be able to have all these benefits and blessings that nature offers us for living on an island. >Ya estás otras fotografías las tomé desde la casa quizás en la parte superior (en el techo) el cuál no es muy alto y pero sin duda tiene una gran vista aunque hay algunas casa qué son más grandes y quitan un poco de visibilidad pero de igual manera es increíble el poder tener todas estás bondades y bendiciones qué la naturaleza nos ofrece por vivir en una Isla. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbVM2hJCniACf3mvoZoX2GDdFB55uYkoWeBy8LPsTWgCZ/1779128131746.jpg)

title.title: Purchased Wild Pass and getting started to play Battles
title.body:
Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!


I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world.


My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

In every season, some activities have to be done first so that I can start playing the battles on the battleground. The season has only started, and I don't want to waste any more time, so I just want to do those things first and get started in the game.


I have not purchased the Wild Pass, so the first thing for me is to buy the World Pass so that I'm eligible to play the battles in the game in this format. Once I do that, then the next activity for me will be to take the cards on the rent, which I will also be doing today, but before that, let's finish this task first of buying the World Pass.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tvCaQ72eyvJMW1sGqK2L5TTRbfduHCh16vvkh9jDbeeTKgFqn2W32t7xgRwjQDazGg7.png)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tRxij5Vn6kE4Mu29z2doZVt1ax8VTNvpSTKbm3Abp18Te2VWbyf9Ydrk3hw7CRxy6Wn.png)


Now the purchase for the wild pass is done, and I am all set to start the gameplay, as you can see that the battle option is enabled for me, and it's good, but I don't want to waste any more time, and let me spend some time on the rental also, which I will also do shortly. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/finpulse/23tm76snbsJzeDUWzQEv1WjaueqTSMPiWuhhCedbwVkWshFjyoFfMhyACjpqyBsTaAtTT.png)

Taking cards on the rental is a kind of activity that takes time, but as I have already mentioned that I will get this done today only so in the next blog I will talk about it and wild pass is an easy process where just I need to make the payment of 2000 tokens which gets done in less than a minute and the pass also gets activated instantly without any waiting.

The journey in the current season is also going to be challenging, I believe, because I am in the cold too as of now, and I will be trying to clear the gold and then diamond post that champion will be my next stop, which I will be trying to unlock if it is possible for me. Even though I am aware that it is going to be a challenging journey for me because Champion is something that is not easy to unlock, I'm still not going to give up, and it is also dependent upon what sort of cards I get from the market.

I will be trying to take the cards on rent on the Max level, whatever cards are available, and if not, then I will also try to take high-level cards on the basis of availability, because it helps me to win more battles. Let's see how this journey is going to be and how many battles I will win, which will take me forward in terms of rating and league, and when I can unlock the diamond first and champion thereafter. If the champion doesn't work, then I will also try to be in the top league of Thiemond if it is possible. So this is the strategy for me at the moment; however, I always believe that it's a game, and whatever plan or strategy I have for the season might not work. Thank you!

title.title: How Ecency is approaching SEO - what we changed, why, and what a sitemap can't fix
title.body:
_A transparency post on the technical SEO work we've shipped, the reasoning and evidence behind the choices, and the limits of what any single frontend can do._

Why we dug into this
--------------------

Every year we analyze traffic and performance of website. Ecency's organic search traffic declined slightly over the past year. The instinctive fix people reach for is \

Before doing that, we measured - and the data reframed the problem.

The most important distinction up front: **discovery is not indexing.** In recent discussions by @pharesim @louis88 and @asgarth sitemap came up again and we shared our thoughts on this topic but we thought dedicated post is essential for transparency not only about sitemaps but our recent changes.

Here is the decisive fact: ecency.com has **never had a sitemap**, and Google has still _discovered_ the vast majority of its URLs - millions of them. That's proof, not theory - discovery was never the bottleneck. The problem is that Google _chooses not to index_ most of what it found - the \

buckets in Search Console - because it judges much of that content as low demand or low quality. A sitemap does not change that judgment; it would only restate URLs Google already found and already declined.\n\n

/>

What a sitemap does and doesn't do
----------------------------------

This is well documented by Google and stated repeatedly by their Search team:

*   Sitemaps help with **change signaling** (`lastmod`) and **crawl prioritization on very large sites**.
    
*   The crawler **discovers linked URLs on its own** perfectly well - a sitemap is not how Google finds content on a well-linked site.
    
*   A sitemap does **not** make Google index pages it has decided aren't worth indexing.
    

Per Google's own SEO documentation, duplicate or thin content \

- it's simply not indexed or consolidated away. The lever is the content/quality signal, not the URL list.

Including millions of URLs in a sitemap when most are thin posts, auto-generated reports, or duplicate comment pages would make our signal to Google **worse, not better** - it would spend crawl budget reaffirming low-value pages.

We _did_ ship dynamic sitemap support into Web (Vision) - but for the one reason it genuinely helps: `lastmod`\-driven revalidation of **edited** posts. It is deliberately scoped (recent + traffic-bearing + curated, not the whole corpus) and is hygiene, not a ranking fix. We want to be clear about that so expectations are calibrated.

The actual lever: indexing quality
----------------------------------

The thing that meaningfully changes how Hive content shows up in Google is **reducing the low-quality footprint** so Google's site-level quality assessment isn't dragged down. What we shipped:

*   **NSFW / adult content** `noindex` - via tags, known adult communities, and conservative title heuristics (it catches legacy posts that deliberately omit the `nsfw` tag).
    
*   **Abuse-blacklist + effectively-empty content** `noindex` - folded into one shared indexability decision so it's consistent everywhere.
    
*   **Comment / short-form canonical consolidation** - adopting the model Reddit, Stack Overflow and Quora use: a reply is not its own indexable page; it canonicalizes to the root of its discussion thread. Short-form microblog container anchor posts are `noindex`; an individual short post is indexed only if it clears a content + engagement bar. This stops thin comment pages from diluting the domain.
    

These remove drag. They don't manufacture rankings - we want to be honest that no technical change does.

The canonical change - and the cross-frontend convention
--------------------------------------------------------

This is the change most relevant to other frontends, so we want to explain it openly.

Historically, Hive frontends follow a convention: point `rel=canonical` at the frontend a post was first published from. Ecency followed this for years. The intent is good - consolidate signals so the ecosystem isn't fragmented.

We tested whether it actually does that. **It does not.** On real ecency.com post pages where our HTML declared a cross-domain canonical to another frontend, Google Search Console's URL Inspection showed **no user-declared canonical recorded** and Google selecting **its own** representative URL (an ecency.com one). Google's documentation is explicit that a declared canonical \
and that Google picks the version it judges \

A second, measurable factor: rendering. Fetched as a crawler with no JavaScript, some Hive frontends are client-side rendered - the initial HTML is a near-empty application shell with the article body absent until scripts execute - while Ecency server-renders the full article in the initial response. This isn't a criticism; client-side rendering is a legitimate architecture with its own benefits. But it has a concrete SEO consequence: when Google chooses among duplicate copies, it favors the version it can parse immediately.

Net effect of the old convention for Ecency: we were declining our own indexable, server-rendered content in favor of a canonical Google was ignoring anyway. So we changed it:

*   Ecency now **self-canonicalizes** to a single clean URL per post.
    
*   We still **fully honor an explicit author-declared** `canonical_url` in post metadata - that is genuine syndication intent and is respected first.
    
*   We only stopped the **inferred, app-based** cross-frontend canonical - which was a frontend's guess, not the author's declaration, and which Google treated accordingly.
    

**Does this hurt other frontends?** Based on the evidence and Google's documentation, **no**:

*   There is no cross-domain \

Google clusters copies and picks one per query; the others aren't penalized, they're just not the one shown for that query.
    
*   The old convention wasn't actually consolidating signals (Google ignored it), so abandoning it doesn't remove protection that was working.
    
*   Nothing we changed affects another frontend's inbound links, crawlability, or how Google treats its pages. Google was already choosing per query regardless of the declarations.
    

We'd genuinely encourage other frontend teams to look at their own Search Console URL-Inspection data on shared posts - the cross-domain canonical behavior is observable, and an honest ecosystem-wide picture helps everyone. We're happy to share our methodology.

What's upstream of any frontend
-------------------------------

The largest Hive SEO gaps are not in frontend code:

*   **External backlink authority.** Hive content has comparatively little inbound link equity from high-authority sites. No canonical or sitemap change fixes this.
    
*   **Brand disambiguation.** \
(publicly traded, NASDAQ/TSXV) dominates branded search for the term \
crowding out the blockchain ecosystem. It did improve over last couple years but still requires attention/effort. This is anentity/brand-SEO problem - consistent naming (\

), entity signals, Wikipedia/Wikidata presence - and it needs ecosystem-level effort, not a single app.
    

These are worth tackling together, alongside the technical hygiene.

An open invitation: compare notes every 3-6 months
--------------------------------------------------

SEO on a platform like Hive is a long game, not a one-time fix. Google's systems change, re-crawl of large sites takes months, and - crucially - the frontends are a **natural experiment**: the same underlying content, rendered by different architectures (server- vs client-side), with different community mixes and technical choices. None of us sees the full picture alone; together the signal is strong.

So we'd like to propose a lightweight, recurring practice: **each frontend runs its own measurements and shares findings every 3–6 months.** Nothing heavy - from your own Search Console:

*   indexed vs. discovered counts, and the top \

reasons;
    
*   canonical behavior on a handful of shared sample posts (URL Inspection);
    
*   any structural change you shipped, and what you observed afterward.
    

Post it on-chain under a common tag - we'll use #hiveseo **\-** so it's discoverable and durable. **Ecency will go first and keep to this cadence publicly; this post is our first entry.** There's no competition on this layer: if Hive content ranks well on _any_ frontend, the whole ecosystem benefits. We're also happy to share the scripts and methodology we used so comparisons are apples-to-apples.

What we're watching, honestly
-----------------------------

*   Search Console convergence after canonical/redirect changes is **per-URL on re-crawl** - realistically weeks to months for very large URL buckets. We've set up weekly monitoring and will report back rather than declare victory early.
    
*   The short-form quality thresholds are deliberately conservative starting points; we'll tune them from real data and have a contingency checkpoint if they're too strict or too loose.
    
*   If our self-canonical choice turns out to be rejected by Google at scale (a metric we're tracking), we'll revisit.
    

We'd rather be transparent about the uncertainty than overstate the impact. The technical work removes drag and stops us handicapping ourselves; sustained improvement still depends on content quality and the upstream ecosystem factors above.

References
----------

*   [Google Search Central - SEO Starter Guide](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/seo-starter-guide) - duplicate content is \

*   [Google Search Central - Consolidate duplicate URLs](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/consolidate-duplicate-urls) - Google consolidates link signals onto a single preferred URL.
    
*   [Google Search Central Blog (2008) - \

title.title: Cycling Chit Chat, a week of NO cycling 🤔
title.body:
<center>
![temp1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/2432DPbYSsvPbrbR19GvLtJ3KcxDHuMmLTcKmpoxVKzGRv2UkRhhUyvDenZ9SEy8SELTk.jpg)
</center>


Hello fellow cyclists!

Lately I was telling all of you in my post I didn't have enough time to do all the things on my PC I liked, like making cycling posts, playing Splinterlands and making posts about it and creating video's for [my new YouTube cycling channel.](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMdRjf97q5Tpeioc7i7ZncA)

Well... @nanixxx is much more spiritual than I am and will probably say something like 'life provides what we need' and although this is NOT at all the way I would like to see things play out, I've got sick so life forced me to take it easy and pretty much abandon everything, including cycling for a while or else I will just be sick longer... 😒

Every con has it's pros and one thing I now DO have is time now I've called in sick for work, yesterday I couldn't do much else than watching Netflix all day because my head wasn't cooperating but today, so far it's better so why not make a cycling post! 😊

<center>
![MTB Banner 5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Ru5F1r3aaFmZzK2DegWTDyuR5XUAgawWt7CLvcwXF76qFZ74gZKQy7v3Y8TdB1.png)
</center>

# No riding...

So, what do I talk about in a cycling post when the last cycling trip I made was six days ago already, and it was just a short 'in between' virtual ride!? 👀

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo2BNsijcGmBJ3mzKYoU15FkJWEyX5D9h6QHnChM3SrMJLpBHLJtVeNcCeGYMXFcmf1.png)
</center>

Last Thursday and Friday were days off of work because of Ascension Day, and Friday my company was closed and because of the extra long weekend I planned to paint the second floor of the house where my indoor trainer is, to get rid of the blue paint.

On Wednesday my Fitbit watch started to alert me something was up, my resting heart rate was up slightly, I don't like to see this because many times my HRV (Heart Rate Variability) often indicates when I had a hard training, but when my RHR (Resting Heart Rate) is up, it usually means a virus is trying to mess with my plans... 😕

Thursday, the warning was still there so I decided to skip my cycling training and just concentrate on my painting, it wasn't really bad because I could use the extra time and by Saturday morning, I finished most of the paint work and decided not to push things, so I planned to finish the last corner in the next weekend. I could already feel my muscles through my entire body hurting, like doing a good all body work out... I had been standing in odd ways on a ladder for multiple hours so maybe it was because of that?

Wishful thinking of course, by Sunday morning my RHR was up 5 beats and it was clear I couldn't cycle again... OK back to this cycling post before it starts to be like a personal diary 😄

Well, first I want to nag about something [in this weeks cycling post](https://ecency.com/@hive-177745/cycling-chitchat-week-20-what-counts-is-showing-up) 😇

>Alright, no jokes. The experts say that: A cyclist who maintains average speeds between 28 and 31 km/h usually has great aerobic capacity, efficient biomechanics, and optimised aerodynamics. This level of performance reflects not only physical fitness, but also careful attention to posture, equipment, and pacing.

I think this is very true for the cyclists in this top 3, because they all do cycle a lot but it is something you have to be careful about, and not make the average speed the most important thing because the opposite is true; Cyclists who always push themselves hard to get to that 30+ average will never get faster, I wish it was like this because it feels so damn good, pushing hard, going fast and when you get off the bike you really have a feeling like 'I'm tired, I did good!'

Easy rides are boring, but really important and the most of your rides should be low intensity ones, I wish I had a little Southern American blood to make me so relaxed, we Western people always want to do things fast... 😅

<center>
![MTB Banner 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5m6hjPyTdTdGdySaQY6xPsWBd9e7bHaUrdRZ7UrBY5dtKt9T4toi3vDvVr26JNR.png)
</center>

# New video upcoming!

I have been working on my new video as well, and it's scheduled to launch next Saturday. It's my second ride while on holiday in Germany, and I got kinda lost... 😅

<center>
![bb13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23xp8i55h8rL3ZAEwnmHMsB617jPRPLSaFXKd1rEX8DAKYLqLcwkLFVvnDTJx9PtZxoWo.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![bb12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/241tb4PtViJih9yvhzas5w41r9e4qY3FHw7ikg8vmVsZZJeCoHnCv2uypcoEfcFuxmRhb.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![bb14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/243WTu2f9u724TKtaUN5atrb8rK6HqVGk5sCx7hsEF5pkmKoMaBbsJac8K3AJWCBTjow1.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![bb5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23yJ7nmHAaX45tbhBr748qwY1WaqzfP1cyTNEGGZczFrHihgoR6ERQVtspfKyRoRvGgem.jpg)
</center>

<center>
![MTB Banner 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Rj2bY9qyPxNf72wNLujSSg8KGBUnabrDpNwFbpnA48m4w41qXy59ieRzrvCMfF.png)
</center>

# Training room, almost finished

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23vi268tbFvasMBowEeKwKoZrUSEantE96o9tA8sj3M296w6ryTJDznT7SC1UoyYbLLzb.png)
</center>

Although the paint color is darker than intended (same RAL number than we used before, different brand probably) I'm quite happy with the result, later today the poster for that frame will be delivered together with a better saddle for the Zwift Ride, the stock one gives me numb private parts... 😅 

<center>
![MTB Banner 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Rj2bY9wtqkTLsNfFvjcM8c7BrVDwNkLsEAjotUAXUL6B2rCZyZWyZd2xpY9hbM.png)
</center>

# Cycling Chit Chat Topic

> It’s time to share your training sessions, your routines, or simply say what physical conditions an athlete needs to be able to sustain speeds of more than 30 km/h — and for how long they can keep it up.

Now I've been training on the Wahoo Kickr and have the luxury of a power meter I have to say, it's a lot of added value, and to answer this weeks topic - I think looking at your average speed to grade your training is all wrong, for cyclists like myself and friendlymoose, cycling in a flat country is easier to get to high average speeds compared to when you live in the middle of a large city, hindered by traffic lights or a lot of elevation around you.

As a mountainbiker, I have never focussed on speed, since 25 - 28 km/h is already pretty fast on a heavy MTB with big tires and a lot of extra air resistance because of our more 'open' bike position, I used heart rate as my primary tool which isn't perfect, I learned that from podcasts but it's better as nothing.

Power is much better, and to answer the question in what physical condition a cyclist has to be to sustain speeds of 30+ (on level terrain), we have to look at FTP, or Functional Threshold Power which is basically the maximum amount of power a cyclist can sustain for an hour, but in reality this will be closer to 45 minutes.

My FTP is 210 watts, and I wonder what numbers our community has if any of you are riding with a power meter, I reckon experienced cyclists that have been cycling for years, that number is a lot higher.

I can only look at my indoor numbers, but can indoor and outdoor be compared one on one?

>Average speeds on an indoor trainer are almost never the same as outdoor road cycling. Indoor speeds are arbitrary and tend to be higher due to the absence of real-world wind resistance, traffic lights, and coasting, though the actual physical effort usually feels harder indoors.

So, not really...

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo2BNsitiJ6r9mWaphuh556mGnaijpfrxahkWU1mT2omEvcKVgGXLVovycNyUtVvVph.png)
</center>

This was a ride three weeks ago where my average speed was 32.8km/h @175 watts average, back then I didn't knew my actual FTP but 175 watts is well within zone 3, considered 'junk miles' and trained in the grey area, it's better to either stay in your zone 2 for Aerobic base development, which for me is below 157 watts average, or in zone 4, which starts at 191 watts for a Treshold training, sorry to bore you.. I like this nerdy numbers stuff 🤣

#### 'I don't like to not know something' 😄

1186 words, so even without cycling, I can talk about cycling pretty long 😇

Time to wrap this up and make myself a lunch!

It’s burrata:

> Burrata is a fresh Italian cheese with a thin mozzarella shell and a soft, creamy center made of pulled curds (stracciatella) mixed with cream.[1]

Originating in Puglia (southern Italy), burrata is traditionally formed by making a pouch of stretched-curd (pasta filata) mozzarella, filling it with stracciatella and cream, then sealing it so the inside stays luxuriously soft and oozing when cut.[2][3]

Taste and texture: Burrata is mild, slightly sweet, and *buttery* in mouthfeel; the contrast between the chewy outer shell and the silky, creamy interior is its defining feature.[4][5]

How to eat it: Serve burrata fresh at room temperature with simple pairings — ripe tomatoes, olive oil, crusty bread, prosciutto, or salads — to highlight its creamy center; cut it open at the table to enjoy the visual and textural effect.[6][4]

Storage and notes: Burrata is a very fresh cheese best eaten within a day or two of production and should be kept refrigerated until shortly before serving.[7][8]

This card is a Fiend card from Death Splinter. The Mana Cost of the card is 6. At Level 1, this card has 1 Melee Attack, 2 Speed ​​and 3 Health. Although the stats are not very high at the beginning, its real strength is its Life Leech Ability.

The function of the Life Leech Ability is that when this card deals damage to the opponent, its own Health gradually increases. That is, the longer the match, the more powerful this card can become. I find this Ability very useful, because it becomes difficult to take down the card at the end.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfwtYWTYpqknmAr5fuGYLkFhvFYAbWTzokSbVCsXWkDK/1779127564337.jpg)

Still, I like the card quite a bit. It can provide good support, especially in the Death Splinter team. I want to play more matches with this card in the future. Hopefully, I will get better results in the future.

title.body:
![Unraveling NGC 3169](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2605/ngc3169_ngc3166_ngc3165px1024.jpg)

***

>Spiral galaxy NGC 3169 looks to be unraveling like a ball of cosmic yarn. It lies some 70 million light-years away, south of bright star Regulus toward the faint constellation Sextans. Wound up spiral arms are pulled out into sweeping tidal tails as NGC 3169 (left) and neighboring NGC 3166 interact gravitationally. Eventually the galaxies will merge into one, a common fate even for bright galaxies in the local universe. Drawn out stellar arcs and plumes are clear indications of the ongoing gravitational interactions across the deep and colorful galaxy group photo. The telescopic frame spans about 20 arc minutes or about 400,000 light-years at the group's estimated distance, and includes smaller, bluish NGC 3165 to the right. NGC 3169 is also known to shine across the spectrum from radio to X-rays, harboring an active galactic nucleus that is the site of a supermassive black hole.

If you’re building a routine too, don’t focus too much on speed — just keep showing up.

title.title: I'm seriously getting back into my Splinterlands account
title.body:
>When I first created my account on Splinterlands back in 2021, I honestly saw it as just another interesting blockchain game. I played a few matches here and there, opened some rewards, learned the basics, and then disappeared for long periods of time. Like many players during those early days, I was fascinated by the idea of owning digital cards and earning through gameplay, but I never truly committed myself to understanding the deeper strategy behind the game.

\n\n

>For years, my account simply existed in the background. I would occasionally log in, check the market, maybe play a couple of battles, and then leave again. But something changed recently.

\n\n

>Over the last few months, I started looking at the game differently. Instead of seeing it only as a casual distraction, I began studying team compositions, mana efficiency, abilities, and how experienced players approach ranked battles. Little by little, I started investing more seriously into my collection — buying key cards, accumulating some SPS, and building lineups that actually make sense strategically instead of randomly throwing monsters together.

\n\n

>And honestly, this process completely changed the way I experience the game.

\n\n

>One thing I’ve realized is that in Splinterlands, low-mana battles are often where the real skill shines. High-mana matches can sometimes feel chaotic because players have access to powerful combinations and massive frontline tanks, but low-mana encounters are different. Every single mana point matters. Every card choice becomes critical. A single ability can decide the entire battle.

\n\n

>That’s exactly why this particular card impressed me so much.

\n\n

>At first glance, some players might underestimate it because of its stats, but once you actually start using it in competitive low-mana battles, you quickly understand how dangerous it can become. Its Life Leech ability creates incredible scaling potential during longer fights. In battles where resources are limited and most monsters have relatively low health pools, gaining additional health after every successful attack becomes devastating over time.

\n\n

>What makes it even more interesting is how naturally it fits into compositions that include Shapeshift strategies. The synergy feels almost unfair in certain situations. While many opponents focus entirely on raw damage or defensive tanks, this card slowly grows stronger turn after turn, becoming harder to eliminate while simultaneously increasing its threat level.

\n\n

>I’ve had matches where the battle looked completely lost during the first rounds, only for this card to gradually absorb health, survive impossible situations, and carry the entire fight by itself. Those moments completely changed my perspective on how valuable utility and scaling abilities are compared to pure damage output.

\n\n

>And that’s probably the biggest lesson Splinterlands has taught me recently: some of the strongest cards in the game are not always the flashiest or the most expensive ones. Sometimes, the real value comes from understanding where a card performs best and building around its strengths intelligently.

\n\n

>My journey with the game still feels like it’s only beginning, despite creating the account years ago. Now, instead of casually playing without direction, I genuinely enjoy analyzing battles, experimenting with different strategies, and slowly improving my collection one card at a time.

\n\n

>Buying SPS and investing into cards no longer feels like random spending — it feels like building a long-term strategy inside an ecosystem I’m finally starting to understand.

\n\n

>And honestly, moments like these are exactly why blockchain gaming remains so interesting to me. There’s something deeply satisfying about discovering hidden value in a card, testing strategies yourself, and seeing your understanding of the game evolve over time.

\n\n

>This card may not be the most famous monster in the game, but for low-mana battles, I truly believe it’s an absolute monster — especially in the right lineup. Sometimes, all it takes is one well-designed ability to completely change the outcome of a battle.

title.body:

[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/health/) 

Why is it that until when the negative side effects starts reflecting, people refuse to take actions at the appropriate time. What I am trying to say for example is in the aspect of medication and medical checkup. 

There are times set aside for various reasons, just like checkups that are necessary to track the progress of our health. But somehow people seem to neglect this and live carelessly until it has become so bad, they end up spending more that usual.

The same thing I have also notices with the healthcare system especially the ART clinic that is responsible for dispensing TLD to patients. One thing that is for sure is that not all humans comply to rules especially one that affects that health, it is so bad that some people are aware of the repercussions they would face if they miss their doses but they still choose to be adamant.

From my recent experience, a lady started her medication last year when she detected and since then she has not been back. Only for her to default and return because she is having rashes and having some discomfort.

My point is that we should try to maintain our health the best we can as it is better to prevent health issues if it is managed.

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

## Still on my journey up the MODERN league ladder, I got to 400 points already and ranked up to the BRONZE II league. My aim now is to get to the BRONZE I. So I was able to claim a BRONZE II loot after ranking up and got three prizes in the LOOT. The first item was a RARE SCROLL, while the second item was 1 ALCHEMY POTION CHARGE and the last item was a card.

## This is actually the first time I will be owning this very card as I’ve never even set my eyes on it before. It is a RANGED Attack Card called the OSHANNUS UNMADE. It is capable of reducing an enemy’s life by 2. The card has a MANA of 6 and belongs to the DJINN bloodline. It has a health stat of 4 and a speed stat of 3. The card is a CONCLAVE ARCANA card as you can see from the symbol in the down left corner of the card with the green colour.

## I’m getting used to the MODERN league and it is actually interesting as the league is broadening my knowledge on the Splinterlands game and exposing me to new cards in the process. I haven’t gotten the time to get on the FRONTIER league yet but will do so when I settle down later in the day. So I also came across an update in the Hive-engine discord server and decided to share it on here for those who might not be in the server. Take a look at the announcement below guys.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUfuisBBUJbkRPSpQSwC1Ju7XQNkdZCkjB985Qohb1HNL/IMG_0234.jpeg)

## About three hours ago, @aggroed a hive-engine developer shared an announcement in the hive-engine discord server informing hivers that the hive-engine exchange has been hacked. He mentioned that it happened around 5am EST and that systems of EVM bridges were compromised. He added that the BNB and SOLANA bridges were being affected and that it goes across multiple server systems and projects operated by various devs.

## He stated that the damage done to the ecosystem includes 85 ETH, 58 BNB , 257 Solana and 33k POL, other underlying tokens like USDT, BUSD and GIFU were stolen too. He later added that the Eth/Hive bridge with the DAO looks ok. Community members are asked not to withdraw or deposit tokens for now as keys to the HBD account have been changed and we need to wait a few days for the service to be restored. He added that funds are safe and it is wise to take caution.

![ \
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkez67ddjNbjJrxfV1K61SXPTj4MB771tCVPfzNshVLE/IMG_0241.jpeg)\n\n## You can join the official Hive-engine discord server here: https://discord.gg/xsCBZSXps

title.title: De la granja del Corozo, estado Barinas al campo digital de Pixels: Cultivando plantas y Criando animales en dos mundos
title.body: >De la granja del Corozo, estado Barinas al campo digital de Pixels: Cultivando plantas y Criando animales en dos mundos ¡Hola nuevamente, mi gente bonita de Hive y de la comunidad Aliento! Qué alegría me dio leer cada uno de sus comentarios en mi presentación. Me disculpo por no responder antes pero Ecensy no nos da mucha energia al inicio jejeje. Saber que desde tantas partes del mundo valoran las vivencias de este llanero del **_Corozo_** me llenó el tanque de motivación para seguir escribiendo. Hoy quiero compartirles una curiosidad que me viene dando vueltas en la cabeza mientras atiendo mis quehaceres. Quienes vivimos del campo sabemos que la tierra tiene su propio ritmo. Si siembras una **mata de piña**, no esperas cosechar al día siguiente; necesitas paciencia, riego constante y buen ojo para cuidar la planta de las plagas. Curiosamente, esa misma disciplina que aplico **bajo el sol barinés** de cada mañana es la que me está sirviendo para avanzar por las tardes en una frontera totalmente nueva para mí: **_el mundo digital de Pixels._**

>La paciencia del llanero: de la azada al teclado En mi granja real, el día comienza temprano. Hay que alimentar a las gallinas, revisar los estanques de los peces y asegurarse de que cada rincón esté produciendo. Si me desespero o hago las cosas a la carrera, algo sale mal. **_Las guineas_** se asustan y el alimento se desperdicia. Cuando entro a Terravilla en Pixels, me encuentro con un panorama que, aunque digital, me resulta extrañamente familiar. Al principio, como todo novato, uno quiere hacer de todo: sembrar popberries, talar árboles y correr por todos lados. Pero el juego, al igual que la naturaleza, te pone un freno: **_la energía_**. Si te gastas la energía de golpe, te quedas parado viendo el paisaje. Allí es donde el chip de productor de **_El Corozo_** se activa. Aprendí que en Pixels, como en Barinas, la clave no es correr, sino administrar. Planifico mis siembras digitales con la misma calma con la que planifico la rotación en mis corrales.

>Cultivando y criando en dos dimensiones Es muy divertido ver las similitudes. En mi patio cuido mis plantas prestando atención al agua tras un buen chaparrón. En Pixels, tengo que estar atento al temporizador para que mis cultivos no se sequen y perder las valiosas semillas. En la vida real, disfruto el placer de cocinar lo que produzco para consentir a la familia; en el juego, uso las cocinas comunitarias para procesar los ingredientes y crear recetas que me devuelvan la energía para seguir trabajando la tierra de píxeles. Esta transición a la Web3 a mis 53 años me ha demostrado que las mecánicas de la vida no cambian tanto. Solo cambia el terreno. La constancia que me permitió ser el primero de mi familia en ir a la universidad es la misma terquedad bonita que hoy me lleva a entender cómo funciona una billetera digital y una economía de **_juego Play-to-Earn_**.

>El fruto del esfuerzo (Real y Virtual) Al final del día, la satisfacción es idéntica. Ver los huevos frescos en el nido de mis gallinas me da la misma sonrisa que ver mis recursos acumulados en la mochila digital del juego tras una jornada bien planificada. Estoy demostrando —y demostrándome a mí mismo— que desde este rincón de Barinas se puede evolucionar, adaptándose a las nuevas tecnologías sin perder la identidad ni el amor por nuestras raíces. Agradezco enormemente el cobijo que me da esta blockchain y la Comunidad que desde el primer dia me recibieron con tanto cariño. Seguiré compartiéndoles estas crónicas donde el olor a tierra mojada del llano se mezcla con los códigos de la Web3. ¡Nos vemos en los comentarios y en los campos de Terravilla * * *

title.title: An Advice to the Unknown
title.body:
If you’re reading this, I don’t know your name.  
I don’t know if it’s 2 AM where you are, or if your hands are shaking because of anger, fear, or just too much coffee. I don’t know what you said to them, or what they said to you that made the room feel too small.

But I know your body.  

I know the way your chest gets tight before you let yourself feel it. I know the shallow breathing that makes your head feel floaty, like you’re watching yourself from the ceiling. I know the urge to move, to run, to say something you can’t take back, just to make the pressure stop.

Don’t.  

Not yet.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7ECzjuABcc98dhx1gYHygN1K8kTsEBC3SvsohUByGo7/1779126630552.jpg)

Your nervous system thinks you’re in danger. It’s wrong, but it’s fast, and it’s loud. So borrow thirty seconds from it. Put your hand on your sternum. Feel that rise and fall. It’s slower than you think. Match it. In for four, out for six. Your heart will argue at first. Let it. It always calms down when you stop trying to outrun it.

You don’t have to be calm to be okay.  
You just have to stop making your body pay for a decision you haven’t made yet.

Whatever you’re facing out there, it won’t get smaller by tearing yourself up first. The unknown doesn’t need you sharp and bleeding to meet it. It needs you present. Even if you’re shaking. Even if your voice cracks. Especially then.

So breathe.  
Once. Twice. 

Then go do the thing you’re afraid of.  
I’ll be here, unknown to you, but not unfamiliar. I’ve been where you are. And I made it through.

You will too.
Shalom

title.title: An unforgettable evening / Soirée inoubliable
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbuKUv4ZGJZp7seAfEcUc8PvByWAP3HDLz1nJco6LgFwx/1779121479183.jpg)

##
##


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYWCVPHiHWZ9UH4t3rFunri5dE2JEc8TpPWHBEY981z1g/1779121499062.jpg)

##
##


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6qGUnWWdMqy1Q3dMgRKpkTw7rpHgmBhwNsBo4EYZ1uC/1779121514014.jpg)


##
##


Dinner at my aunt’s house was simply wonderful. As always, she welcomed the whole family with great generosity and a lot of care, especially towards my children, whom she loves to spoil. She truly did not spare any effort in preparing a meal worthy of special occasions.

The table was beautifully set: delicious stuffed chicken thighs, tender and flavorful, along with tasty minced chicken breast meatballs in an exquisite, comforting sauce with warm aromas. Not to forget the traditional homemade soup, carefully prepared, accompanied by crispy, golden puff pastry “bouraks” filled with minced meat.

To complete this wonderful meal, she also prepared a homemade strawberry and lemon juice, fresh, light, and especially refreshing. Every sip brought a real sense of freshness.

The children were delighted and fully enjoyed this beautiful family evening. As for us adults, we were immersed in warm conversations, catching up on news, and sharing many laughs. The atmosphere was so pleasant and convivial that we didn’t even notice the time passing.

We truly cherish these moments of togetherness as they strengthen our family bonds. It is always a pleasure to gather like this and create beautiful memories together.




////
Le dîner chez ma tante était tout simplement fabuleux. Comme toujours, elle a accueilli toute la famille avec une grande générosité et beaucoup d’attention, surtout envers mes enfants qu’elle adore gâter. Elle n’a vraiment pas lésiné sur les moyens pour nous préparer un repas digne des grandes occasions.

La table était magnifiquement garnie : de délicieuses cuisses de poulet farcies, tendres et parfumées, ainsi que de savoureuses boulettes de blanc de poulet baignées dans une sauce exquise aux arômes réconfortants. Sans oublier la traditionnelle soupe maison, préparée avec soin, accompagnée de bourreks en pâte feuilletée farcis à la viande hachée, bien dorés et croustillants à souhait.

Pour compléter ce merveilleux repas, elle avait préparé un jus maison à la fraise et au citron, frais, léger et particulièrement rafraîchissant. Chaque gorgée apportait une vraie sensation de fraîcheur.

Les enfants étaient ravis et profitaient pleinement de cette belle soirée familiale. Quant à nous, les adultes, nous étions plongés dans des discussions chaleureuses, des échanges de nouvelles et de nombreux éclats de rire. L’ambiance était tellement agréable et conviviale que nous n’avons même pas vu le temps passer.

Nous chérissons vraiment ces moments de convivialité, car ils renforcent nos liens familiaux. C’est toujours un plaisir de se réunir ainsi et de créer de beaux souvenirs ensemble.

title.body: I just received an on-chain bitcoin zap. On Nostr, \

are bitcoin sats given as tips to others. Until a day or two ago, they were sent over the Lightning Network (LN). They still are over LN, and that's likely the best way to do it, but they can now to sent on-chain. I just got one.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWoLGBRBoMEETQ6U6QHcTxN7CKWudHoT8B4JW3174aKd5/screenshot_20260518_131938.png)

I believe this ability is currently only on the https://ditto.pub front end with its integrated wallet, as below:

![screenshot_20260518-131719.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crrdlx/23wfp6vhSCCXZC4myQMxdi6ne4QkDQjQHoe5upucMphBiYuy84iGQScBxGSGvbcK2sR5G.png)

The transaction can be seen on any bitcoin explorer such as https://mempool.space/tx/5a8a598df01a5e28b180cb1b945ec8619dc06396a692d906fd8fd4e3a9f4f945

![screenshot_20260518-131606.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/crrdlx/23x9qif2RWzxkg7TY3TirGsedPnRxvFBS6zig3CLSe4ZPWwdPMoHhZ1QJ6mA8GM4DJbf7.png)

The Lightning Network is likely the better way to do zaps. It's much cheaper--seems it was a $0.24 fee for a $1.01 zap. And, I believe the address is reused which is not ideal in terms of privacy. But, to me, the cleverness lies simply in the fact that it can be done.

Bitcoin finds a way.

title.body:
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4mzAxfb7r4Zb7aKriwSmtQC5dj6NGyib3h2qNJdqTs9/imagen.png)
[Imagen propiedad @lanzjoseg](https://hive.blog/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-f07ec293f428e)
Y pensar que aquí en España hay una festividad de lanzarse tomates por la abundancia de la cosechas. Recuerdo que de pequeña le preparaba a mi hija jugo de tomate, no le gustaba mucho y ahora busca el tomate hasta en sopas, como cambia la vida y las vueltas que nos da. Acaba de ir a Polonia por trabajo y pidió una sopa de tomates, porque ahora es su favorita. Este es mi aporte al tema de la fotografía que nos ha regalado el profesor @lanzjoseg para la semana del concurso en topfamily [Concurso. Observa Piensa Escribe.](https://hive.blog/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-f07ec293f428e), lo conoces deseas unirte a esta iniciativa de cada semana donde tu creatividad y aporte puede ser la diferencia, entre historias, recuerdos y hasta recetas ¿porque no? Recuerdo a una prima española que coloco un frasco de tomattina en la mesa y a mi me encantaba, le pregunte donde la compraba y me enseño a prepararla, era tan sencilla como cocinar los ajos y los tomates, aquello sabía a gloria y era lo más sencillo del mundo. En otra ocasiones le agregaba albahaca, si esa misma planta que me encanta tener en mi jardín para agregarle a la salsa de la pasta o espagueti. La verdad es que quien ha aprendido a comerse un pan con tomate y aceite de oliva tiene el cielo hecho. No sé si será un proverbio español pero mi madre lo decía. Porque el tomate pega con todo y esta lleno de muchas vitaminas. Aquí en España los hay de todos los tamaños y formas que se puedan imaginar, se me van los ojos en las tiendas y mercados, menos mal mis hija tiene de todos los tamaños en la nevera y puedo disfrutarlos. ¿Y a ustedes les gustan los tomates?

title.body: Staying healthy biblically is all about taking care of ourselves both our physical and spiritual body. Human bodies are described as temples of God, so believers are encouraged to avoid harmful habits and live with self-control. Good health can come through proper rest, clean living, wise eating, and avoiding things that destroy the body. The Bible also shows that peace of mind, joy, and a thankful heart contribute to a healthy life.\nhttps://youtu.be/xbZj2iuFbEk?si=zAKhG2_qAztWbo1K\nSpiritual health is equally important. Prayer, faith, and obedience to God help people remain strong during difficult times. The Bible encourages believers to trust God, avoid anxiety, and live in love and forgiveness, since bitterness and worry can affect both the mind and body. A balanced life that honors God, treats others well, and practices moderation reflects biblical principles for healthy living.

title.body:
https://youtu.be/VFrc9WILyNs?si=gepIKwhp46MxUOT-

Training a child in the way of the Lord is a parental duty and obligation given to them by God. Training a child does not only involve providing material things, food, Education and other things that the child needs to live a normal life, but also impacting good morals in a child's life and training him or her in the ways of the Lord.
**The book of Proverbs 22:6 says:**

>Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

A well trained child  from childhood will grow up in better understanding of what he or she will face later in life, he or she will grow up in the ways of Lord. A child that's brought up in the ways of the Lord bring happiness to the parents, family and a blessing to society at large. But an untrained child will only cause  heartaches to the one who gave birth to him or her, a disgrace to the family and a reproach to the society.

The duty of the parents is to train their children in the way of the Lord, teach them what they need to know in life so that they will grow up well. Remember that training is a gradual process, it may take time for children to become perfect, so as a parent never get tired, continue training for frustrations come later when you deny your children the necessary training. I pray that God strengthens all parents as they carry out their parental obligation in impacting good morals in their children's life Amen.

**Thanks for your support**

title.title: nugBlog #21: May 18, 2026
title.body:
![NugBlog 21 May18-2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfuji/23ynp1dg6EnH6EhoEk4iyL7XRCfroE9ZYkGZ49adYuvm1uu88pt6gurQ3J6vswDWYBnAu.png)

Hello my Nug,

It has come to my attention that the “Nug” nickname is mostly for this blog now. Mom and myself don’t often refer to you as a nugget anymore. Probably because you’re becoming so much more of your own person.

I don’t think you’ve physically grown much since our last check in, but your development continues to amaze us. The big sentences continue, and you’re starting to really grasp time and future events. I am writing this from ‘downtown’ right now after work and I won’t be home for bedtime. Upon learning this was a possibility from Mom this morning, you specifically asked, “Can we talk to Daddy on the phone later?” (paraphrasing).

Other skills are coming along well too: counting is getting better, you can sing the days of the week, you recognize individual letters and words that go with them.

The weather is finally getting warmer and that is opening up many more outdoor opportunities. You are very good at climbing stuff on the playground, getting creative with ways to go down (or up) the slide… though the swing remains your go-to.

Gymnastics has been a hit. Once a week for an hour you get to do a big circuit of different activities and stations. You are talented at front rolls, hanging from bars and doing ab/leg work, and doing the “bum drops” on the trampoline.

Toddler negotiations are in full swing, meaning you always have a counteroffer ready for whatever restrictions we propose. You don’t quite get math yet, so sometimes your arguments are silly, but they are made passionately. In general you are very good about not getting your way. Sometimes if you’re tired or frustrated you will get sad and mad, but it doesn’t take much to get to a happy place again.

A good example of this: you graduated to the next ‘grade’ in daycare, and things were pretty hard for only about a week. But now you are perfectly settled in, used to the routine, and even wear a uniform every school day.

We are all ready for summer to arrive, to play with friends more often outside, and enjoy more interesting outings. As you get bigger and more independent, our options expand! In this vein, I also think I want to start to teach you some board games soon. Your Dad is a big board game nerd. We’ll see if you end up liking them as much as I do.

All my love,
Dad

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmazMWAQ7jxV6CWjDuVc1bD9PnJ2PRhTyLcmucV4y2GunC/nugbar.png)</center>

This series of blogs is to catalog the memories, milestones, and reflections of parenthood. Perhaps one day you (the Nug) will be curious to read them! In the meantime, they’re a nice way for Dad to process this whole parenting thing. He’s a writer, so putting words out into the world is relaxing, therapeutic, and fun!

<center>[See all the nugBlogs here.](https://peakd.com/@jfuji/posts?filter=dad)</center>

title.title: MOVIE REVIEW: KARATE KID
title.body: > ![Screenshot_2026-05-18-18-24-45-951_com.google.android.youtube-edit.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/EpJZxDeCA1PiNXoWQinVv7ZYtuHNnujJ2AHhgyxAsqknUi6mEMANyKoSu4ywpbFFVUT.jpg) One movie that I really enjoyed in the Karate Kid. Emotionally, inspirational, funny and packed with great life lessons from start to finish. The film follows the saga of a young boy named Dre Parker (Jaden Smith), and his mother, who emigrates from America to China. Initially, it all seems strange and challenging for him since he cannot understand the language, culture, or people he is surrounded by. In those early scenes I could really feel his pain and his loneliness. I loved that the emotions seemed so real in the film. Dre wasn't portrayed as a perfect boy. He was sometimes frightened, angry, stubborn, confused. This helped him to feel real and relatable. I'm not sure what was going on, but when he began to be bullied by some kung fu students, I was kind of sorry for him. The scenes with fighting were pretty extreme, and I felt like I could see the fear and pressure he's under on a daily basis. It made me continue to watch because I wanted to see how he was going to overcome everything. My favorite part of the movie was when Dre and the Mr. Han (played by Jackie Chan) get into a fight. Jackie Chan gave an amazing performance in this movie. Typically, most people would recognize him for his comedy and action scenes but, in this film, he also had a lot of emotion in them. Mr. Han was a quiet, wise, calm and very disciplined man. I liked all the scenes he portrayed. As the friendship between him and Dre gradually turned into a familial-like arrangement, it made the film even more charming. The scenes of the training were also very memorable. Initially, I believe that Dre was just doing mundane household tasks such as hanging and removing jackets, but then I realized that Mr. Han was training him in discipline, focus, balance and patience. The iconic “jacket on, jacket off” moments took on great significance in the narrative. I preferred the part where the movie demonstrated that martial arts isn't simply fighting people. It is also about self-control, respect, inner peace and confidence. I was also impressed with the beautiful environment in China. The film displayed wonderful mountains, temples, streets, schools, etc. There were some scenes that were quite cinematographic and serene. One of my favorite parts of the story was the trip to the mountain temple, as it gave the story a spiritual element. The movie has been enhanced with the visuals, making it larger and more emotional. I also enjoyed the little bits of Chinese culture I got to look at while watching the film. The action pieces were also great. The kung fu tournament towards the end was quite emotional and entertaining. Each confrontation was intense since Dre wasn't naturally stronger than anyone else. He had to work hard and have faith in himself. His wins were satisfying. I was particularly pleased in the last match as it was a game of courage, not strength. Even when Dre was injured, he still fought with determination. It was a wonderful moment to me. I believe that the film has a lot of life lessons in it as well. It helps people to not surrender if things get tough. It is for discipline, respect, patience and confidence. I know firsthand that growth can come in time and sometimes through the hardship. The character of Mr Han also demonstrated the ability of individuals to be hidden in tears inside themselves, and at the same time helping others overcome the hidden tears. There were also some moments which had to do with his past that were quite moving and it really made it more of a normal martial arts movie than it was a normal movie. The audio and music were in sync with the film. The music enhanced the emotional scenes and the action scenes were more exciting. The film blended comedy, tears, friendship, romance and action admirably. I was never bored while watching it. In general, The Karate Kid is a wonderful inspirational and emotional film, with action thrown in, and also has some great life and bravery teachings. It was an entertaining watch for me as much as it was about kung fu, it was about personal growth and fearlessness. I loved the acting of Jaden Smith and Jackie Chan and the plot was very interesting. I have rated the movie 8.5/10. It is an emotional, motivational and entertaining film and I will certainly watch it again. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@julie100/movie-review-karate-kid--jxy)

title.title: 1,5 USD Grilled Mackerel
title.body:
![Edited By 
Open AI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23vi3sKhJDvyVdpS8kNSuHCDhBVeGFgNFUyRqhQYnyBVnGW8Eia1H2bpKy7eoaWd5VtU8.png)


Hello Asean Hive Community

Two weeks ago I ended my $1 meal saga, because of two major reasons. The first one is about the inflation we have here, because of dollar rate and the gas price. Blaming the middle east war would not solve anything here. The second reason was my health issue.

After some days thinking about how to replace this, I have decided to come up with a new budget for my meal. It is a 1,5 USD, or in Indonesian Rupiah it is 26.500. I plan to set my budget to 25.000 rupiah because I believe I can have many alternatives for my meal, without sacrificing the nutrient I need and the place would not be so shabby and dirty.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23uQxp1cjgkAJtWzDDCsectt8kAVrbsmYEmUQS2MxuNdRsf1nipLEytD99pFwLqTfLzK7.jpg

So this was my meal from last week, it was a grilled mackerel with red chili paste. This was a Padang or Minang cuisine, so it was very spicy. Minang is the tribe and Padang is the region, and please do not expect to get non spicy food from there or them lol.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23wX3L7FmpjUpr8mKstwED7vtejdswJ7rcqNNxR2oFNh2jd6JuTTciTqKEannasJJUS9i.jpg

Anyway this rounded white thing is called as Kerupuk, a fish cracker. Basically it is a dough with some fish flavor, a very cheap one and full of carbo. It has no other benefit, a junk food, but it gives a boost for our appetite when bite and chew them.

This fish craker is one of my favorite junk food, but I know I should not eat it frequently. So I usually have them only one piece, during days that I feel I need to push myself to eat a lot.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EpJZcfKuZgSdxM7i7UCnWPLhZKD7Hf2d9umabir7TD3H8u51Vv96rNYdUELzDBpatKX.jpg

Another signature side dish for Minang Cuisine is sambal (chili paste) and some cassave leaves. Cassave leaves is good for your immune system. They have a good content of flavonoid , which help you maintain your cholesterol and sugar level. Minang Cuisine are full of coconut milk, sugar and many spices, so you do need to get this Cassave Leaves as part of the meal.

By the way, I have visited this outlet several time. The last time I came here, they scammed me with their Sweet Ice Tea. This time I came and be bold about having my Ice Tea served better.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23z7Dgaa2C5Gjc2cMHoay6dxdp6ogL5bfn6MgUir54acWZwiD8D788LAQwc3FBmwRVnGC.jpg

So this was how they responded, they put in more ice and let the sugar sunk below.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EpVBbMPcdjr6vyv27vK9UYUUvTvwK99DFUnrin8Vh4J6fWVEHN1EHQzTy89PzBg7Kpb.jpg

What I mean here, literally they gave me tea without dissolved Sugar. They let the sugar sunk, and of course due to the temperature which got cold due to those ice, I could not make those sugar dissolved. I asked them what they meant with serving this, what they answered was simple... \

That's another trait from budget meal outlet here. You send some complain, they will think that they deserve to stand for themselves by doing retaliation. Sometime the way they think is very simple, they think they are small people, they already sell you cheap food, so you should respect them more lol

Well, whatever... this is my first edition for my new 1,5 USD meal saga anyway. Atleast I know I still can get a good food with this budget. See you later!

---

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/48XetgSWyfBM2qUaM6DgxMupc8697f6fQQvnbVnxgvAwbF2DtDg8rzGXSFQs9M5YAX.png

Thank you for coming and reading my post. I live in Jakarta, Capital City of Indonesia.  I used to live by making money online, that's why I like being here, on HIVE, and in #PIMP - (Paper In My Pocket) community. Feel Free to leave any comment below

title.title: [EN/PT] Synonym For Power Venka The Vile
title.body:
> # [EN] ![cappa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23yTujTokg4Skf7zqEnxBCWFgwrvTgiMe6StsURU1vyiE9EacEZ6mJgM5Z1o2A7dJ2azW.png) # Hello Splinter Fans Splinterlands is the most popular game on Hive, even after such a long time, and through it many players discovered and started using this incredible ecosystem. Even after all these years, the impact of Splinterlands still echoes throughout Hive. In Splinterlands no battle is ever the same, because there are many combinations of cards, archons, and rulesets. There are so many possibilities that it is almost impossible for players to make the exact same card lineup. Generally, players choose their cards mainly based on the Rulesets and by looking at the previous lineups used by their opponents. One of my favorite Rulesets is **Stampede** ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/25x25/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AK7xNfEJk7eJFgsuT66X7xuGyVR9EXGgAtnkptT2v3bHkiYeartmSpuQc3JVLjL.png), which amplifies the offensive power of monsters or summoners with the **Trample** ability ![Trample.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AKKSXK9zruEeCnkbwUeg3A6SrUpwCmBWjaQU51bviAdSdKByihYfR3cRgHsZEHF.png). This is one of the most perfect combinations in the entire game. While the **Trample** ability ![Trample.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AKKSXK9zruEeCnkbwUeg3A6SrUpwCmBWjaQU51bviAdSdKByihYfR3cRgHsZEHF.png) delivers another attack to the adjacent enemy monster after defeating a monster, the Stampede ruleset makes it possible for Trample to activate multiple consecutive times if several monsters are defeated. This was an ability I really enjoyed using back when I played with monsters from the older sets. However, with the newer cards I ended up with almost no monsters that have this ability. One of the monsters that does have it is **Venka the Vile**, which is highly offensive and has melee damage along with the Piercing ability, which ignores any enemy shield. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wfn32sJG12aY7bZEAcpe1BKC6mt8v2TkKafy77oTok7dawq5XsSZHFPq6EuHio3MTQP.png) During this last end-of-season period I rented some stronger monsters. This was one of them, in an attempt to improve my win rate. So far it has not improved that much, because opponents now have cards I had never even seen before. In this post we will show a battle where **Venka the Vile** truly shined.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png)
The following battle featured the Water, Life, and Dragon Splinters, along with 32 mana available. In addition, the available rulesets were: **Are You Not Entertained**, **Stampede**, and **Up Close & Personal**.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5bTtZCDMfhyHjB2HKyVh6PLfkRwFuLyckPwRrrmvWnEsdYexFC9EUFa6q5Vcno78Vn.png)
With these rulesets in mind, we selected monsters to fully take advantage of their potential. My opponent also picked monsters very similar to mine. The lineup can be seen in the image below: # [Click Here to Watch the Full Battle!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_cff56168c20bfee2d0cd0673a1d90610) ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/244eGoKR31RZubAPwvuW9A668LsghVLNcm2MGhKX7KZ3TsWMnQFD6U4ueLdqz7mfBJW2C.png) My opponent chose some of the same monsters as I did in order to take advantage of the active rulesets. As a result, both players ended up selecting several identical monsters. **Venka the Vile** was one of them since this monster has the Trample ability. The main difference was the chosen Archon: while my opponent selected the Dragon Archon Akane, I chose the new Water Splinter Archon, **Loving the Moo**. ![f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/244y1gPusg2QSnJQXXGygQ8gdwAWe2hwk2x4Ukrhn3HPcimDxeFtKMQxPsg2CieFhZpRg.png) Even though my opponent had the advantage of attacking first, our team got lucky because our tank had high speed and dodge abilities, allowing us to evade some attacks. Unfortunately, my opponent did not have the same luck. As a result, during one of its attacks, **Venka the Vile** activated the Stampede Ruleset and ended up defeating three monsters in a single turn. This battle took place in the Champion II League, in the Modern format. It rewarded me with only 11.291 SPS because I had a low amount of SPS staked. In addition, I received 555 Glint.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23w28k4H8h4NBEkshULv4xcBTttj3tvHJbwFxhZrEA9y1CBxrse4CFH7LzmE898bRE3jJ.png)
I hope you enjoyed this post, which was made with great care. --- **If this post was useful, consider leaving your upvote, comments, and even a reblog on your pages! Thank you very much!** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGvyDT7ASwcw8K6yCRtkHFf7wLshNrkTrgKytk1atFUboxso73BsMUSQBtk5qozjXAM.png) # [PT] ![cappa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23yTujTokg4Skf7zqEnxBCWFgwrvTgiMe6StsURU1vyiE9EacEZ6mJgM5Z1o2A7dJ2azW.png) # Olá Splinter Fanáticos Splinterlands é o jogo mais popular da Hive, mesmo depois de muito tempo, e por ele vários jogadores conheceram e começaram a utilizar esse incrível ecossitema. Mesmo depois de tanto tempo os frutos de Splinterlands ecoam sobre a Hive. Em Splinterlands nenhuma batalha é igual, pois há muitas combinações de cartas, archons e rulesets. São tantas as combinações que é quase impossível que os jogadores façam a mesma escalações de cartas. Geralmente, os jogadores escolhem suas cartas em função principalmente dos Rulesets e olhando para escalações passadas dos jogadores adversários. Um dos meus Rulesets favoritos é é **Stampede** ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/25x25/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AK7xNfEJk7eJFgsuT66X7xuGyVR9EXGgAtnkptT2v3bHkiYeartmSpuQc3JVLjL.png), que amplia o poder ofensivo de monstros ou invocadores com a habilidade **Trample** ![Trample.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AKKSXK9zruEeCnkbwUeg3A6SrUpwCmBWjaQU51bviAdSdKByihYfR3cRgHsZEHF.png). Essa é umas das combinações mais perfeitas de todo jogo. Enquanto a habilidade **Trample** ![Trample.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/AKKSXK9zruEeCnkbwUeg3A6SrUpwCmBWjaQU51bviAdSdKByihYfR3cRgHsZEHF.png) difere outro ataque ao monstro adjancente inimigo, após esse monstro ser derrotado. A ruleset Stampede tem a possibilidade de fazer com que Trample seja ativado várias vezes consecutivas, caso vários monstros sejam derrotados. Essa era uma habilidade que eu gostava muito de utilizar quando eu utilizar monstros dos set antigos. Porém, com as novas cartas fiquei quase sem monstros com essa habilidade. Um dos monstros que possuem essa habilidade é **Venka the Vile** que é bastante ofensivo e possui dano melee e habilidade Piercing, que ignora qualquer escudo inimigo. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wfn32sJG12aY7bZEAcpe1BKC6mt8v2TkKafy77oTok7dawq5XsSZHFPq6EuHio3MTQP.png) Nesse último final de temporada eu aluguei alguns monstros mais poderosos. E esse foi um deles, para tentar melhorar minha win rate. Até agora não melhorou muito, pois os adversários possuem cartas que eu nunca tinha visto. Nesse post vamos mostrar uma batalha em que **Venka the Vile** brilhou.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png)
A batalha a seguir contou com com os Splinters Água, Vida e Dagão além de 32 de mana disponível. Além disso, os rulesets que estavam disponíveis foram: **Are You Not Entertained**, **Stampede** e **Up Close & Personal**.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5bTtZCDMfhyHjB2HKyVh6PLfkRwFuLyckPwRrrmvWnEsdYexFC9EUFa6q5Vcno78Vn.png)
De posse desses rulesets escalamos monstros para aproveitar todo o potencial dessa regras. Meu oponente também escalou monstros parecidos com o que escalei. A escalação pode ser vista na imagem abaixo: # [Clique Aqui para Assistir a Batalha Completa!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_cff56168c20bfee2d0cd0673a1d90610) ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/244eGoKR31RZubAPwvuW9A668LsghVLNcm2MGhKX7KZ3TsWMnQFD6U4ueLdqz7mfBJW2C.png) Meu oponente escolheu algumas monstros igual aos meus, com a finalidade de aproveitar os benefícios das rulesets presentes. Então, ambos os jogadores acabaram de escolher alguns monstros iguais. **Venka the Vile** foi um deles possui esse monstro possui a habilidade Trample. O que mudou basicamente foi o Archon escolhido, enquanto meu oponente escalou o Archon de Dagrãom, Akane, e no meu lado foi o novo archon do Splinter Água, **Loving the Moo**. ![f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/244y1gPusg2QSnJQXXGygQ8gdwAWe2hwk2x4Ukrhn3HPcimDxeFtKMQxPsg2CieFhZpRg.png) Apesar do meu oponente ter a vantagem de atacar primeiro nosso time deu sorte, pois nosso tanque com alta velocidade e habilidade de esquivas conseguimos desviar de alguns deles. Infelizmente, meu oponente não teve a mesma sorte. Dessa forma, em um de seus ataques **Venka the Vile** ativou o Ruleset Stampede e acabou derrotando três monstros de uma só vez. Essa batalha ocorreu na Liga Champion II, no formato Modern. Que me rendeu apenas 11,291 SPS, pois havia uma quantidade baixa de SPS staked. Além disso, recebi 555 Glint.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23w28k4H8h4NBEkshULv4xcBTttj3tvHJbwFxhZrEA9y1CBxrse4CFH7LzmE898bRE3jJ.png)
Espero que tenha gostado dessa publicação que foi feita com muito carinho. --- **Se este post foi útil considere deixar seu upvote, comentários e até mesmo reblog em vossas páginas! Muito Obrigado!**

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXxxnCtPvmQQ4Q8Kfq6gXmBbDvSFcdttfV4fCuSg2FUZ/image.png)

Greetings to all Splinterlands players and hive gaming community! This is my report for Pizza A Slice of Madness brawl. We are a guild that plays for fun, competitions and rewards. We play in the weekly guild brawls where we fight with other guilds for the fun challenge and rewards. This is our battle report for the week.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Overall Guild Rank: First Place***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNuGMWRvet8sbHreGU95pgxXcyXzTxqv66eR7PbjPwH6B/image.png)

We're back on the podium and this time even took first place! We finished below par last week at fourth place but we came back with a vengeance this week and took first. We had 98 wins, a narrow lead over second placer Lux Aeterna who had 96 wins. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Top Brawl Participants*** 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcjAhc1bkP2WbvWAkkjfcxyLYRCnL5XvVmTJRi1H6fjmg/image.png)

My score was good but not that great. I joined eighth to thirteenth place in our guild's top brawlers with a 6-2 score. Overall, our guild did well to take the pole position in this tournament. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Selected Games***

Here I present two of the games that I won.

**Game 1**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawR7nyuEB2dG5HKxePqwKgMHxrhP12tF3re6svJX4HbQ/image.png)

The first game saw a Water vs Water game. We almost had the same team as the opponent. I thought my opponent had the advantage because he had a legendary magic gladiator while I had common gladiator card. In this game, my gladiator killed the opponent's and that decided the game in my favor. 

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_ScLKxsWXmbj4FhH80oTb?ref=iamchessguy



**Game 2**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMndUhNWHZUrnXMMX7CwXL1snFqAb3jkVjJ4TcRgahmN/image.png)



Game 2 had a Thorns modifier. Because of this, I only had one melee unit in the team. My opponent ignored the game modifier and still had three melee units in the game. You see, Thorns returns melee attacks so it's prudent not to use melee cards in when the game has this modifier. This caused my opponent to lose the game. 

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_oK74xsEWooy7ug2A8MBn?ref=iamchessguy



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRoKRSm6kHp9dpHcS4G8qbEoAeXqRMfctBPzLi3kXMDb/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)



***Conclusion***

We earned 4,444 merits and 35 SPS from the brawl. The reward is generous that we get just from joining and playing brawls. With regular brawls, it adds to my weekly SPS stake. I'm grateful to the Pizza guild for accepting me as a member and gave me a regular spot to join the brawls and earn rewards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

If you are a player with few cards in your deck. Join a guild that can assist you to grow in Splinterlands. You can join brawls to earn SPS, enjoy reward multipliers and shop discounts. Since joining a guild, I'm adding my cards by buying from the shop and the market. This makes the game more fun and add progression. If you're not a guild member yet, now is the time to find one.

As a guild member do your part by having the right cards and showing up in the fray you have joined in brawls.
