title.title: Dealing with the hot tempered
title.body:
Greetings!
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP9JtM1ta59YFwZxCHqK56RnFdAqFv2ZYd7Ecy38tG7GV/IMG-20260518-WA0017.jpg 

All humans have their own characters and that's where the individual differences set in every human being. No human is the same in character as another, in fact, the so-called identical twins are not in any way the same or alike in character. One may be hot tempered while the other cool headed, it all depends on the nature of the individual as created by God.

So, characters are not the same in humans and also, we all humans have our own weaknesses and strengths. When I might be strong in one way, I might be weak in the other way. So, to some anger is their weak point and to some, it's not.

However, we as individuals must know both the area of our strengths and at the same time, the area of our weaknesses. 

Having said so much about humans and the differences in their characters, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, “ Tempered.”

As we all know that there's no human without character, one thing we must do is to manage ourselves and know others for who they are so that we would not be disappointed when they come with their human nature, most especially the ones with anger issue who with their hot temper destroy things, both life and properties whenever their anger or hot temper overshadow them.

Most of these people are always found of giving flimsy excuses when they destroy things such as lives and properties whenever they are unable to manage their uncontrolled anger.

Sometimes ago, there's was a woman who destroyed her husband gadgets just because she was angry with the husband. After she had destroyed her husband gadgets, her anger left her, but what had been destroyed had been destroyed already and there's nothing she could do to repair what had been destroyed. When asked what came over her, she couldn't reply, but later, she ascribed everything to the devil and not only that, she said it's her anger that overwhelmed her and that's the end of the incident. Had it been she had killed the husband in the process which could be irreparable, what would she has been saying?

So, since that even or scenario, I have made a point of importance to always avoid such kind of people most especially in my relationship with my fellow humans. Another thing is that, before I start any kind of relationship with anyone, I in most cases always try to study and understudy them and in that process, I would have known more about them and if the person I I want to be friend with is the one with anger issue, I would not have any kind of relationship with him or her. However, if the coast is clear and I discover the so-called is without hot temper, then, I would try to move close to the person and become his or her friend.

This is my entry to the week 218 episode 01 of the weekly featured contest in the Hive Learners community.

Thanks for reading.

/> After a long time, we find the exit. Here, we find a flower shop, an element that seems to be very characteristic of this adventure, and beyond a gate, a new city. What adventure awaits us there, I don't know yet, but are you ready?

/>

Pues chicos la última vez que nos vimos prácticamente estábamos encerrados en una parte de mi wte mundo sin saber cómo avanzar, pero tras muchas vueltas, lo hemos resuelto, quieres saber cómo? Pues ahí vamos

Un bosque realmente grande a su entrada como uno podía ser de otra manera un monumento a Celebi la voz del bosque. Está es un insignia de que en el futuro este será verdaderamente un sitio lleno de misterios.

Luego de mucho tiempo damos con la salida, en esta damos con una floristería elemento que al parecer será muy característico de esta aventura y tras un portón de acceso, una nueva ciudad. Que aventura encontraremos en ella, aún no se, pero ustedes están listos.

title.title: La vida es un emprendimiento:  Lecciones de reinvención, oficio y voluntad a cualquier edad (SPA-ENG)
title.body:
> Hace poco visité a una amiga que se inicia en la escritura. Su padre es alguien curtido de experiencias, próximo a cumplir 100 años: muy lúcido y de buena salud; nos atendió de manera espléndida. Deducirán que mi amiga no es ninguna jovencita; de hecho, ya pasa de los setenta y mantiene una jovialidad que muchos de nosotros envidiaríamos en lo más sano. Ambos demuestran que la edad no es un obstáculo para emprender. Sí, claro, en la actualidad las empresas establecen barreras, incluso para las personas jóvenes, basadas en absurdas preconcepciones nacidas de modernos estudios de la psicología organizacional y de exigencias de conocimientos y de experiencias que, por razones obvias, muchos no han podido adquirir ni desarrollar. Se pretende eliminar el espacio para el aprendizaje en el terreno. Y si sumamos el impacto de la automatización y la robotización que avanza sobre los espacios antes reservados para lo humano, la situación no pinta nada bien. No quiero desviarme de lo medular; quiero centrarme en lo esencial de lo anecdotario de esa visita, evitando el mero relato de la vivencia. Mi objetivo es compartirles un recordatorio y un ejemplo que sirvan de incentivo para emprender a cualquier edad. El autosabotaje en el que incurrimos al creer que la edad es un límite insalvable para emprender es una tontería. Si algo me quedó claro de aquella velada por partida doble, fue esa gran falacia. Al contrario, presencié que la experiencia vale mientras las fuerzas y la voluntad nos acompañan. El nonagenario nos dio —a mi esposa y a mí— un gran consejo: «Aprendan un oficio, algo que puedan hacer con sus propias manos». Esa tarde amena se extendió hasta altas horas de la noche, y salimos con obsequios producidos por sus envejecidas manos, aún diestras y precisas: unos portacelulares artesanales, exquisitamente pintados. El mío era amarillo y el de mi esposa, rojo intenso con bellos detalles ornamentales simétricos.
--- ![Portacelulares2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23vsBVHrPHkKrzGjSFPMmGY5LfTtRvQ9D5NbhUaP5Z9v7cYFGvdkusMtYMCR1n2wegko4.jpg) ---

> Por otro lado, su hija, una profesional con altas credenciales en ciencias, quiere legar su sabiduría a través de la literatura: ficciones repletas de ideas y de vivencias extraordinarias labradas durante una vida intencionada. No esperen que les cuente los detalles; sería antiético sin su consentimiento, aunque sí puedo testimoniar objetivos muy loables más allá de los incentivos económicos, pues sería hipócrita, deshonesto negarlo. No digo que no los haya (dinero), ¡claro que lo hay!, de algo hay que comer, no. Y en tal sentido, le deseo el mayor de los éxitos. Luego del encuentro, ideas recicladas se recombinaron con las nuevas asaltando mi mente. Revisé mi propia experiencia educativa y laboral: varios títulos universitarios y un área de desempeño muy exclusivo; empero, no me hice de un oficio en lo tangible, tal como la carpintería, la orfebrería o, por qué no, la cocina: ciencia y arte muy demandado y perenne. Si bien intento hacer de la escritura un negocio rentable, no es menos cierto que siempre ha sido muy difícil. No son pocos los que lo intentan. Veo con pena excelentes libros de ficción y de otros géneros que pasan desapercibidos en las vitrinas digitales disponibles en la web; nunca antes en la historia había sido tan fácil publicar para llegar a una gran audiencia y, sin embargo, parece estar tan distante e inaccesible que podría ser frustrante. Entonces recuerdo las palabras del viejo artesano, y recreo el destello, la chispa en sus ojos cansados al hablarme de su emprendimiento de portacelulares artesanales cuando me mostró la estantería llena con cientos de estos. Me habló de sus planes para colocarlos en el mercado. Sentí su formidable energía, cuando se supone que la suya debería estar menguada. ¡Pamplinas! Me atrevo a decir que la vejez no existe cuando hay flama en el alma. Tal vez podrían alegar que hablo de un caso excepcional. Y quizás tengan razón. Son pocos los que llegan a tan avanzada edad en tan buena salud. Lo importante es recalcarles lo que anima, eso que nos impulsa hacia adelante, y el padre de mi amiga es un excelente ejemplo a seguir. Pienso que su producto compite con otros metálicos fraguados en procesos industriales; probablemente más baratos, y es ahí donde el arte puede marcar la diferencia. En todo caso, si tendrá éxito comercial, no lo puedo asegurar, pero de que es un verdadero emprendedor, no albergo dudas. En lo personal, sepan que sentí la imperiosa necesidad de hablarles a mis hijos sobre lo aprendido en aquella memorable cita. Le dije convencido de que debían procurarse una profesión dentro de la dinámica sociedad actual. Eso está bien, y también aprender oficios manuales que sean fundamentales sin que estén arraigados a los designios de las organizaciones. Es curioso que, con el boom de la inteligencia artificial, la amenaza más latente apunte a las tareas administrativas e intelectuales, tales como las llevadas a cabo en las labores técnicas y que ahora rasgan a las creativas. Por supuesto, no desestimemos que pronto el trabajo manual también será afectado. Esto no conlleva que debamos abandonar nuestros quehaceres ante el auge de las tecnologías. Todavía no nos reemplazan; al contrario, nos potencian en áreas donde hasta hace poco era imposible acceder. Por ejemplo, hace cuarenta o cincuenta años, publicar un libro era inviable sin la asistencia de las editoriales. Yo también debería seguir ese sabio consejo y aprender un oficio que no dependa de la alta tecnología. Les confieso que no lo he tomado con la seriedad que amerita por estar inmerso en proyectos en desarrollo. Una vez salga de ellos, me pondré manos a la obra. Al cerrar estos pensamientos, medito sobre el significado de propósito y en su renovación. Comprendo que, mientras estemos vivos, no debemos sucumbir a los efectos de la jubilación ni a la falsa creencia de una vida cómoda en lo posible. No estoy afirmando que no la merezcamos; si es así, qué bien. No por ello debemos abandonar los nuevos comienzos, aquellos que nos mantienen en movimiento, que nos hacen sentirnos vivos y útiles para con nosotros mismos y para con los demás. Al final, la vida misma es un emprendimiento.
--- ![image_6062612b (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23wMWDWptGYMfwjHyS3V2tDehRXLfPHB9pwJrFkg3i6JU7WywWJfQ5uzs1YCYsCmgCs8t.png) Imagen generada por @janaveda utilizando el modelo de IA Nano Banana 2 de Google --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23t7d8MuE2EzUNYbaAPLG766bpxNjLbQVkMP1NWSFhtFVfyQYCrJN92h3L8wpFZyz7cpY.png) Un breve ensayo original de @janaveda Las fotografías fueron tomadas por mí desde un iphone 6 --- ¡Cansado! ¿Ya no te satisfacen las redes sociales tradicionales? Entonces, te invito a conocer Hive presionando [aquí](https://hiveonboard.com?ref=janaveda). Únete a nuestra comunidad global, en donde la libertad sin censura en nuestro norte. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23uFaCdgNzqKeuLNFNjHvHZenWRdNvm3cFtC5dffzbbtSYoF3VCLMUpS9B2TpxePvD8CA.png)
![Portacelulares1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23uQNhrdgwF91r5ZDYR5q2CsfhEs84fmFVuAZR8emTCJVEFmNsWvuSH6fKC4Wr5WthH52.jpg) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23tvaLskQZ4EWZjeaNkqv4ZRw1X733dZdJuZP3T2YNZV176Z5VhV7wzCzBc9xa4p6rw1A.png) #### Life is an undertaking: #### Lessons in reinvention, craft, and willpower at any age

>

I recently visited a friend who's just starting as a writer. Her father is a seasoned veteran, nearing 100 years old: very lucid and in good health; he treated us wonderfully.

You can probably guess that my friend isn't exactly young; in fact, she's over seventy and maintains a youthful energy that many of us would envy in our prime.

They both demonstrate that age is no obstacle to entrepreneurship. Yes, of course, nowadays companies erect barriers, even for young people, based on absurd preconceptions stemming from modern studies in organizational psychology and demands for knowledge and experience that, for obvious reasons, many haven't been able to acquire or develop. The aim is to eliminate the space for on-the-job learning. And if we add the impact of automation and robotization encroaching on spaces once reserved for human interaction, the situation doesn't look good at all.

I don't want to stray from the main point; I want to focus on the essential anecdotes from that visit, avoiding simply recounting the experience. My goal is to share a reminder and an example that will serve as an incentive to start a business at any age.

The self-sabotage we engage in by believing that age is an insurmountable barrier to entrepreneurship is foolish. If anything became clear to me from that evening, it was that great fallacy. On the contrary, I witnessed that experience is valuable as long as our strength and will remain.

The nonagenarian gave my wife and me some great advice: \

That pleasant afternoon stretched into the late hours of the night, and we left with gifts made by his aging, yet still skillful and precise, hands: exquisitely painted, handcrafted cell phone cases. Mine was yellow, and my wife's was a vibrant red with beautiful symmetrical ornamental details.
--- ![Portacelulares2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23vsBVHrPHkKrzGjSFPMmGY5LfTtRvQ9D5NbhUaP5Z9v7cYFGvdkusMtYMCR1n2wegko4.jpg) ---

> On the other hand, her daughter, a highly qualified professional in the sciences, wants to bequeath her wisdom through literature: fiction brimming with ideas and extraordinary experiences forged during a purposeful life. Don't expect me to tell you the details; it would be unethical without her consent, although I can attest to very laudable objectives beyond financial incentives, as it would be hypocritical and dishonest to deny it. I'm not saying there aren't any (money), of course, there are! One has to eat, right? And in that sense, I wish her every success. After the meeting, recycled ideas recombined with new ones, flooding my mind. I reviewed my own educational and professional experience: several university degrees and a very specialized area of ​​expertise; however, I didn't acquire a tangible skill, such as carpentry, goldsmithing, or, why not, cooking: a highly sought-after and enduring science and art. While I try to make writing a profitable business, it's no less true that it has always been very difficult. Many others try. I sadly see excellent fiction and other genres go unnoticed in the digital showcases available online; never before in history has it been so easy to publish and reach a large audience, and yet it seems so distant and inaccessible that it can be frustrating. Then I remember the old craftsman's words, and I relive the spark, the glimmer in his tired eyes as he told me about his handmade cell phone holder business, showing me the shelf full of hundreds of them. He spoke of his plans to put them on the market. I felt his formidable energy when supposedly his should be waning. Nonsense! I dare say that old age doesn't exist when there's a flame in the soul. Perhaps they could argue that I'm talking about an exceptional case. And perhaps they're right. Few reach such an advanced age in such good health. The important thing is to emphasize what motivates them, what drives us forward, and my friend's father is an excellent role model. I think his product competes with other metal products forged in industrial processes; probably cheaper, and that's where artistry can make all the difference. In any case, whether it will be commercially successful, I can't say for sure, but I do not doubt that he's a true entrepreneur. Personally, I felt a strong need to talk to my children about what I learned from that memorable meeting. I told them, convinced, that they should pursue a profession within today's dynamic society. That's good, and it's also important to learn essential manual skills that aren't tied to the dictates of organizations. It's curious that, with the boom in artificial intelligence, the most latent threat points to administrative and intellectual tasks, such as those carried out in technical work, which are now impacting creative work. Of course, we shouldn't dismiss the fact that manual labor will soon be affected as well. This doesn't mean we should abandon our work in the face of technological advancements. They haven't replaced us yet; on the contrary, they empower us in areas where access was impossible until recently. For example, forty or fifty years ago, publishing a book was unfeasible without the assistance of publishing houses. I, too, should heed that wise advice and learn a trade that doesn't depend on high technology. I confess that I haven't taken it with the seriousness it deserves because I've been immersed in projects under development. Once I'm out of those, I'll get down to work. As I conclude these thoughts, I reflect on the meaning of purpose and its renewal. I understand that, while we're alive, we shouldn't succumb to the allure of retirement or the false belief that a comfortable life is the best it can be. I'm not saying we don't deserve it; if we do, so be it. But that doesn't mean we should abandon new beginnings, those that keep us moving, that make us feel alive and useful to ourselves and others. In the end, life itself is a journey.
--- ![image_6062612b (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23wMWDWptGYMfwjHyS3V2tDehRXLfPHB9pwJrFkg3i6JU7WywWJfQ5uzs1YCYsCmgCs8t.png) Image generated by @janaveda using Google's Nano Banana 2 AI model --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janaveda/23t7d8MuE2EzUNYbaAPLG766bpxNjLbQVkMP1NWSFhtFVfyQYCrJN92h3L8wpFZyz7cpY.png) A brief essay by @janaveda in Spanish and translated to English using https://translate.google.com The photographs were taken by me using an iPhone 6

> The Hive Music Festival continues to be the stage for great artists who make music in this big, beautiful hive. It is these stars who have motivated us to make some changes that we are sure will be even more favorable for those stars who offer us their brilliance in every performance. Everyone has done a great job, and we are honored to have you as part of this great musical celebration. We want to start by continuing to thank you, the artists, audience, and sponsors, who with love have kept the Hive Music Festival stage shining as brightly as ever.
>

>El Hive Music Festival sigue siendo el escenario de grandes artistas que hacen música en esta gran y hermosa colmena. Son esas estrellas quienes nos han motivado hacer algunos cambios que estamos seguro, serán aún más favorables para esas estrellas que nos ofrecen su brillo en cada presentación. Todos han realizado un gran trabajo y nos honran en que sean parte de esta gran fiesta musical. Queremos comenzar por seguir agradeciéndole a ustedes, los artistas, público y patrocinadores, quienes con amor han hecho que la tarima del Hive Music Festival siga brillado como lo ha venido haciendo. \n\n

>The Hive Music Festival continues to relaunch its judging rounds to select the winners. Last week we wrapped up Week #187, and today we kick off Round 2 in Week #188, where we know you’ll continue to shine as always and that many artists will keep sharing their talent and bringing music to every corner of Hive.
\n\n>

>El Hive Music Festival continúa reiniciando las rondas de evaluación para elegir a los ganadores. La semana pasada cerramos con la semana #186 hoy damos inicio a la ronda 2 en la semana #188 donde sabemos que seguiran brillando como siempre y que muchos artistas seguirán compartiendo su talento y llevando la música a cada rincón de Hive.

>The Hive Music Festival continues to promote music by adding to the good initiatives that exist at the musical level on the platform and of course that motivates us to continue working for our artists inside and outside of Hive. We continue working to offer the best opportunities to our artists, so that we can help them to grow inside and outside of this great hive, offering them the best opportunities.
\n\n>

>El Hive Music Festival continúa impulsando la música sumándose a las buenas iniciativas que existen a nivel musical en la plataforma y por supuesto que eso nos motiva a seguir trabajando por nuestros artistas dentro y fuera de Hive. Seguimos trabajando para ofrecerles las mejores oportunidades a nuestros artistas, de tal manera que podamos ayudarles a su crecimiento dentro y fuera de esta gran colmena brindarles las mejores oportunidades. ![HMF_Cintillo_C63.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musiczone/23uQrELrRDtic8vfCB9yVyA2CdyoWS6Uzv7XnkCQbccEJpGSA3CSezPxsytE2n44rfioN.png)

> Since the 12th cycle we have been awarding a small weekly incentive, which is given to the artists selected by the judges so that the public has the option to choose the artist of the week and thus we give part of the protagonism to the public who, of course, are of utmost importance in the whole event. The Hive Music Artist is an honorable mention to the outstanding artists of the week of the Hive Music Festival. A way to thank them for being part of the musical party that we have in this community week after week.
>

>Desde el ciclo 12° hemos estado otorgando un pequeño incentivo semanalmente, el mismo se les otorga a los artistas seleccionados por los jueces para que el público tenga la opción de elegir el artista de la semana y así le otorgamos parte del protagonismo al público quienes por su puesto, son de suma importancia en todo el evento. El Hive Music Artist es una mención honorífica a los artistas destacados de la semana en cuestión del Hive Music Festival. Una manera de darles las gracias por ser parte de la fiesta musical que en esta comunidad llevamos semana a semana. \n\n

title.body:
This is sorta true.  However, were Hive (or Hydra, or some other label) to enable and support free speech in a world increasingly censored and permissioned, that is an essential - actually existentially necessary to life in an increasingly dangerous world - utility that will overcome any clunky UI, onboarding mechanisms, and even the stench of censorship Steem earned, and Hive inherited from it.  To this day creators here on Hive are being DV'd on every post and comment despite those posts and comments not being any kind of spam, scam, or harm.  Almost all of these authors are strong advocates of free speech, yet because they advocate policies or beliefs disapproved by powerful stakeholders, they are censored by the mechanism of being debanked on Hive.

I choose 5 such accounts to designate as beneficiaries on all my posts, and have done so ever since I discovered Peakd enabled me to do this, because tips cannot be flagged away.  I alone can do little, but were more of us to do a little for accounts being censored, we could together do a lot.  

This is the real issue that has caused the execrable user retention on this platform, and it is easy to ascertain that for yourself, by simply inquiring of influential people that once had accounts on Steem (and less so on Hive, because so few influential people have joined Hive) why they don't have accounts active here now.  Because these people are influential in their markets, the censorship they suffered penetrates the markets for social media platforms that follow them, and today Hive gets very few new users because our reputation as censorious and ruled by corrupt profiteers precedes us.

A rebrand might help, but it would only help bring in folks so unaware of the market as to not realize Hydra was simply a new name for Hive, and that's not the strongest base of authors in the free speech market.  If the rebrand were preceded by a strong reform of the code that presently directs >90% of inflation to the few dozen whales that now extract it to creators, an alluring aroma of upwards mobility would counteract the vile stench of censorship and profiteering that Hive reeks of today.

>\

There are dozens of ways to make money on Hive today.  However, most of them aren't earning money, but profiteering and rentier income.  So, what you really mean is honest ways of making money, not rentier extraction parasitizing the work of others, which is how the vast majority of Hive inflation is today extracted from the rewards pool.  Curation rewards are a prime example of rentier income on Hive, and this is why they have serially been increased across the history of hard forks, because those accounts that would most profit from increasing curation rewards are those accounts with the most substantial stake.  Conversely author rewards have consistently declined, and rewards from posting comments - the engagement that is critically important to a free speech focused social media platform - have almost been eliminated.  That's because rewards for posting require work, and profiteers and rentiers do not want rewards to be apportioned for work, because they don't want to work for their supper.  The rewards that are paid to 'the help' come out of their profits, as they see it.

This is the fundamental flaw of stake weighted governance: them with the gold decide who gets the gold.  Absent a different metric for governing the platform, or some miraculous reform of the profiteers that have been governing the platform since 2016, we're going to keep being parasitized into the grave, just as the US Congress keeps sucking the life out of the middle class in America while voting themselves ever greater benefits, and preventing the graft and corruption that is their most obvious skill and source of income from being justly adjudicated and penalized by law.  The fox being in charge of the henhouse does not create the most egg production.

>\

I suspect a trap.  KYC biometric digital ID for access to digital devices is a glaringly obvious means of turning surveillance into economic control and it's coming.  TIA (total information awareness) managed by AI algorithms using social credit scores will create absolute and complete enslavement, turning every letter you type, every syllable you speak, into groveling to your masters - or weapons that will be used against you.  Today every AI prompt is a window into your soul that is surveilled and analyzed by creepy stalkers for nefarious purposes, so I don't use AI for anything.  

Most of us are ignoring this, and most of us will be trapped.  Traps are made by trappers to take wealth from the trapped.  As a child I learned about fur trapping in Alaska, and I aim not to die like a furbearer in a trap, helpless to deliver my fury and delivering my fur instead.  I may get skinned, but it is far harder to skin a fox on the loose than it is to skin one in a trap, and I'll make it as hard as possible.  Another thing I've learned is that no furbearer is in as much danger as a fox in a henhouse.  The more financial assets you have the more trappers want to skin you, and if you're eating their lunch in their henhouse, you'll be their top priority.  I've learned the best way to protect your assets is to appear not to have any.  

An ancient dragon guarding a hoard of gold in a deep, dark cavern isn't fabulously wealthy, but impoverished by their utter isolation from everyone but thieves that have learned their secret.  The only company they get are their enemies, their only interactions violence and bloodshed.  The same will be true about billionaires in bunkers, that do not understand the good company of good people is the only thing that makes life worth living, and the only thing that makes assets valuable.  I hope the good will earned doing good work for good people in good faith will keep you in good company as the dividend of your good investments all your days.

Thanks!

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTdAdyMBfFFyJB1Q2joEEwZ7Q7sEq44FmcHCKWRu6VZUP/Torrens.webp)

<div class= 'text-justify'>

      Es mi primera publicación en @sportsblock, las cuales haré ocasionalmente, en vista de que no podemos abandonar nuestra comunidad @fulldeportes. hablo principalmente de béisbol y peloteros venezolanos. Una pesadilla terminó anoche para los Mets de Nueva York en Flushing Meadows. 96 juegos sin poder ganar un partido en el cual iban perdiendo al llegar al octavo inning. Es una cadena que se había prolongado desde 2024 ¿Saben ustedes quien fue uno de los toleteros que encendió la mecha? El recién renovado con una extensión por dos años y US$ 11.5 millones, el receptor venezolano Luis Torrens, quien por estos días es el titular de la posición, dada la lesión del Titular Francisco Alvarez. En la baja de la sexta entrada, consiguió las bases llenas y a su equipo perdiendo por marcador 5-1. Ante una \

de 89 MPH hizo un swing hacia la banda contraria y bateó la bola ceñida a la raya de cal, para un doblete productor de 2 que acercaba a los metropolitanos 5 a 3. Más tarde, la ofensiva de Queens haría 3 carreras en el noveno y una en el undécimo para dejar en el terreno a los Yankees, llevarse la serie del Subway y acabar con la racha de partidos perdedores. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     This is my first post on @sportsblock, which I’ll be dropping from time to time since we can't just walk away from our @fulldeportes community. I mainly talk baseball and Venezuelan ballplayers. A total nightmare finally ended last night for the New York Mets at Flushing Meadows. 96 straight games without a comeback win when trailing heading into the eighth inning. It was a brutal cold streak stretching back to 2024. Do you know which slugger sparked the rally? The newly extended backstop Luis Torrens—who just locked in a two-year, $11.5 million deal and is currently commanding the dish with Francisco Alvarez on the IL. In the bottom of the sixth, he stepped up with the bags packed and his squad down 5-1. He went opposite-field on an 89 MPH cutter, chopping it right down the chalk line for a 2-run double to pull the Metropolitans within two. Later on, the Queens offense put up a 3-spot in the ninth and added another in the eleventh for a walk-off win against the Yankees, securing the Subway Series and snapping that ugly losing skid.

# ---

![Torrens.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wMYTaH2VfGpu1xuqNokY6ZESrLC6i9MwC7PscNDDyFk7fUAduEeizwrB9GpTvBVcwEd.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/yankees-vs-mets/2026/05/17/823628/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Los Reales de Kansas City finalizaron su serie en Bush Stadium de San Luis, ganando el último juego para llevarse el del honor ante los Cardenales por marcador de 2 carreras a 0. En un auténtico recital de pitcheo de parte de ambos bullpens, solo un hombre fue capaz de descifrar la manera de producir anotaciones: el capitán y receptor titular venezolano de los nobles Salvador Pérez. Otro criollo, Maikel García, se embasó abriendo el partido y avanzó hasta tercera por rola de out y hit de Pasquantino, dejando la escena para un fly de sacrificio de \

, que le impulsó para la primera raya del juego. Luego, en su siguiente turno en la alta del cuarto, llegaría la carrera que definiría el marcador. Salvador pescó una curva de nudillos a 77 MPH y la depositó en las gradas del jardín izquierdo, lo que significó su séptimo cuadrangular del año y 40mo. bateado en San Luis. El abridor Stephen Kolek lanzó pelota de 4 hits sin carreras durante 6.1 episodios y ponchó a 4 oponentes, para su segunda victoria de la zafra y el bullpen mantuvo las cosas en cero, para obtener la blanqueada. Aún en el sótano, Kansas City no está lejos de la vanguardia en su división y está a 5.5 juegos de los Guardianes. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The Kansas City Royals wrapped up their series at Busch Stadium in St. Louis, taking the finale to avoid the sweep against the Cardinals with a 2-0 shutout. In an absolute pitching duel where both bullpens dealing, only one man figured out how to manufacture runs: the Venezuelan captain and starting backstop for the Royals, Salvador Perez. Another Venezuelan, Maikel Garcia, got aboard to lead off the ballgame and moved to third on a groundout and a Pasquantino knock, setting the stage for a \

sac-fly to drive in the game's first run. Then, in his next trip to the dish in the top of the fourth, came the run that iced the game. Salvador sat on a 77 MPH knuckle-curve and parked it deep into the left-field bleachers for his seventh big fly of the year and his 40th career bomb in St. Louis. Starter Stephen Kolek tossed 6.1 innings of 4-hit, scoreless ball while fanning 4 batters to secure his second W of the campaign, and the bullpen slammed the door to complete the shutout. Still in the cellar, Kansas City isn’t far out in their division, sitting just 5.5 games back of the Guardians.

# ---

![Salvador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23ynNXiejo1bC8jBawcmgxa6SxxhZUt3dADGwjmatKn64MThaEXDaQz6YWyyDpSK4v3eP.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/royals-vs-cardinals/2026/05/17/823058/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Y precisamente, los Guardianes recibían a los alicaídos Rojos de Cincinnati en el Progressive Field de Cleveland. Y no fueron nada hospitalarios con la visita. Con una de las ofensivas más calientes del momento -a pesar del apagón de Steve Kwan, quien fue bajado de la posición de primer bate- los tipos se ocuparon de llenar de cuadrangulares al pobre cuerpo de pitcheo de los Reds. El campocorto venezolano Brayan Roccio se unió a la fiesta de bambinazos y en la parte baja de la cuarta contribuyó con el marcador para poner las cosas 5-2, largando su 4to. estacazo por encima de la barda del jardín derecho. La felpa entregada al otro equipo de Ohio (rivales a muerte) fue de 10 carreras a 3 y los Guardianes se consolidaron en la vanguardia de la división central de la liga Americana con un juego de ventaja sobre los sorprendentes Medias Blancas, mientras que, los Rojos siguieron cayendo en la central de la Nacional, ahora a 5 juegos de los Cachorros. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     And right on cue, the Guardians hosted the slumping Cincinnati Reds at Progressive Field in Cleveland. They were anything but hospitable to the visitors. Packing one of the hottest lineups in baseball right now—even with Steven Kwan hitting a cold patch and getting dropped from the leadoff spot—they absolutely unloaded on the Reds' pitching staff with a barrage of homers. Venezuelan shortstop Brayan Roccio joined the home run party in the bottom of the fourth, extending the lead to 5-2 by launching his 4th big fly of the year over the right-field wall. The blowout against their in-state rivals was a 10-3 beating, cementing the Guardians at the top of the AL Central with a one-game cushion over the surprising White Sox. Meanwhile, the Reds continued their slide in the NL Central, dropping to 5 games back of the Cubs.

---

![Roccio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23uFYCqbPz3gyam8eTKcQ6tZArydfi3NxkRLofeUxq2H1qvpBeqZXyuPowvceBgKN8f3s.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/reds-vs-guardians/2026/05/17/824436/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     La que era llamada serie del \

antes de que los Atléticos se mudaran de ciudad, se resolvió a favor de los Gigantes de San Francisco, quienes andaban de visita en el pequeño Sutter Health Park de Sacramento. Y Tony Vitello dejó de experimentar con el line-up para ubicar al criollo y segunda base titular Luis Arráez como segundo bate del la alineación. Y parece que se siente cómodo allí, ya que ha vuelto a producir como siempre. \

entregó hoja de anotación de 4-3, con dos carreras anotadas, una impulsada producto de un cuadrangular (su segundo en tres días) y un boleto. La ofensiva de la bahía fue encabezada por Harrison Bader, quien largó un Grand Slam para sentenciar el marcador final de 10 carreras a 1. El abridor de los \

Adrian Houser lanzó pelota de 4 imparables permitiendo una sola carrera, a pesar de los 5 boletos que concedió. Con el triunfo, San francisco frenó su caída en el 4to. lugar de la división oeste de la Nacional a 9 juegos de Los Ángeles, Mientras que los Atléticos siguen liderando por un juego de ventaja sobre Texas, la división oeste de la liga Americana. Seguimos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The former \

series before the Athletics relocated went to the San Francisco Giants, who were visiting the small confines of Sutter Health Park in Sacramento. Tony Vitello stopped tweaking the lineup and penciled in Venezuelan starting second baseman Luis Arraez as the deuce hitter. It looks like he feels right at home there, as he’s back to producing like his usual self. \

put up a 3-for-4 line at the dish, scoring twice, drawing a free pass, and driving in a run with a solo shot—his second big fly in three days. The Bay Area offense was sparked by Harrison Bader, who launched a grand slam to ice the game at 10-1. Giants starter Adrian Houser tossed 4-hit, one-run ball despite issuing 5 free passes. With the W, San Francisco halted their skid in 4th place in the NL West, sitting 9 games back of Los Angeles, while the A's keep holding a slim one-game cushion over Texas at the top of the AL West. We keep moving.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] LOH # 289 When there isn't enough time / Cuando el tiempo no alcanza
title.body:
Feeling like time is slipping through our fingers is a common experience in modern life. However, behind this perception of constant haste often lies something deeper: the denial of our own physical and mental limits. It's not just a matter of packed schedules or accumulated commitments; often it reflects an internal demand that pushes us to perform beyond what we can actually sustain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyM89cY5tFBqtjZqDzkS8uaN3CJAEHdkNDoKsX9fropo/girl_1064659_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/11/26/22/27/girl-1064659_1280.jpg)

When we try to take on too much, our bodies and minds start sending signals: persistent fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, and a feeling of emptiness. These are reminders that energy isn't infinite and that strength isn't about endlessly pushing forward, but about recognizing when it's necessary to stop. Ignoring these signals can lead to burnout that affects not only our productivity but also our health and relationships.

The key question is: what situations make us feel like we're doing \

? Perhaps it's work that encroaches on every aspect of the day, family responsibilities that leave no room for rest, or even the self-imposed pressure to meet unrealistic expectations. Identifying these circumstances is the first step to regaining balance. Because it's not about giving up on dreams or commitments, but about learning to prioritize, to delegate, and to accept that not everything can be resolved at once.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUpqrTRVEi7WZRPiGYFiu3cqfxjrhzPk56iDRN5jiGKq4/girl_1142570_960_720.jpg)[source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/rostro-campesino-escrito-vela-1142570/)

Time, in reality, neither expands nor contracts: we are the ones who decide how we inhabit it. When we learn to recognize our limitations, we discover that true wealth lies not in doing more, but in doing what is essential with presence and serenity. Sometimes, the most valuable thing is allowing ourselves a pause, a moment of silence, a breather that restores clarity.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNzu3crHuaFqqfdKM5V75SqJbFCjoKuQ7y2NMcafbTJPc/girl_4882437_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/02/26/18/01/girl-4882437_1280.jpg)

Accepting that we can't do everything is not a defeat, but an act of honesty. It is opening the door to a more conscious life, where time ceases to be the enemy and becomes an ally. Because when we stop fighting against the clock and start listening to ourselves, we discover that fulfillment doesn't depend on the number of tasks completed, but on the quality with which we live each moment.

Credits: I used Google Translate.
Images from Pixabay.




ESPAÑOL

Sentir que el tiempo se escapa de las manos es una experiencia común en la vida moderna. Sin embargo, detrás de esa percepción de prisa constante suele esconderse algo más profundo: la negación de nuestros propios límites físicos y mentales. No es solo cuestión de agendas saturadas o compromisos acumulados; muchas veces es el reflejo de una exigencia interna que nos empuja a rendir más de lo que realmente podemos sostener.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyM89cY5tFBqtjZqDzkS8uaN3CJAEHdkNDoKsX9fropo/girl_1064659_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/11/26/22/27/girl-1064659_1280.jpg)



Cuando intentamos abarcar demasiado, el cuerpo y la mente comienzan a enviar señales: cansancio persistente, dificultad para concentrarse, irritabilidad, sensación de vacío. Son recordatorios de que la energía no es infinita y de que la fortaleza no consiste en resistir sin pausa, sino en reconocer cuándo es necesario detenerse. Ignorar esas señales puede llevarnos a un desgaste que no solo afecta nuestra productividad, sino también nuestra salud y nuestras relaciones.

La pregunta clave es: ¿qué situaciones nos hacen sentir que estamos haciendo “demasiado”? Tal vez sea el trabajo que invade cada espacio del día, las responsabilidades familiares que no dejan margen para el descanso, o incluso la presión autoimpuesta de cumplir con expectativas irreales. Identificar esas circunstancias es el primer paso para recuperar el equilibrio. Porque no se trata de renunciar a los sueños ni a los compromisos, sino de aprender a priorizar, a delegar, y a aceptar que no todo puede resolverse al mismo tiempo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUpqrTRVEi7WZRPiGYFiu3cqfxjrhzPk56iDRN5jiGKq4/girl_1142570_960_720.jpg)[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/rostro-campesino-escrito-vela-1142570/)



El tiempo, en realidad, no se expande ni se contrae: somos nosotros quienes decidimos cómo lo habitamos. Cuando logramos reconocer nuestros límites, descubrimos que la verdadera riqueza no está en hacer más, sino en hacer lo esencial con presencia y serenidad. A veces, lo más valioso es permitirnos una pausa, un silencio, un momento de respiro que nos devuelva claridad.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNzu3crHuaFqqfdKM5V75SqJbFCjoKuQ7y2NMcafbTJPc/girl_4882437_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/02/26/18/01/girl-4882437_1280.jpg)



Aceptar que no podemos con todo no es una derrota, sino un acto de honestidad. Es abrir la puerta a una vida más consciente, donde el tiempo deja de ser enemigo y se convierte en aliado. Porque cuando dejamos de luchar contra el reloj y empezamos a escucharnos, encontramos que la plenitud no depende de la cantidad de tareas cumplidas, sino de la calidad con que vivimos cada instante.

title.title: Як життя з’явилось з нуля: історія острова, який народився на очах людей
title.body: На уроках географії вам розказували про острови, які формувалися мільйони років. Типу: «ось тут тектонічні плити рухались», «ось тут льодовик пройшов», «ось тут боги щось психанули». Красиво, але нудно, бо ніхто того не бачив. А от у 1963 році Ісландія вирішила влаштувати прямий ефір для геологів. Просто посеред океану підводний вулкан почав так люто плюватись лавою, що з води виліз новенький острів — Суртсей. Свіженький. Ще теплий. Буквально молодший за деяких ваших батьків.

/> Вчені чуть не зомліли від щастя. Бо це був шанс побачити, як життя з’являється З НУЛЯ. Не в книжці, не в теорії, а от прямо зараз. Голий вулканічний попіл, жодної травинки, жодного жучка — стерильна каменюка посеред Атлантики. Острів миттєво закрили для людей. Туди пускали лише кількох науковців, і то майже як у операційну: стерильний одяг, продезінфіковані черевики, ніяких «ой, я випадково насіння соняшника в кишені забув». Природа мала заселяти острів сама — вітром, хвилями та птахами. Спочатку прилетіли чайки. І це були не просто пташки, а натуральні біологічні контрабандисти. На лапах, у пір’ї та в шлунках вони почали таскати насіння, бактерії й органіку. Потім підтягнулися мохи, лишайники й перші рослини. А далі — павуки. Причому павуки взагалі прилетіли на павутинках, як на парашутах. От це я розумію Ryanair природи.

/> Але найгеніальніша історія сталася з помідором. Одного дня серед чорного вулканічного попелу вчені знайшли томатний кущ. Справжній. Зелений. Живий. І всі такі: «ШОООО?». Бо помідори, як відомо, не літають і не плавають через Атлантику. Розслідування показало, що хтось із науковців приніс насіння… у власному кишечнику. Коротше, дядько поїв помідорів, сходив «по-великому» за камінчиком — і мало не зіпсував один із найчистіших наукових експериментів у світі. Томат безжально ліквідували. Не дали йому шансу стати батьком ісландської кетчупної цивілізації. А Суртсей тим часом жив собі далі. Сьогодні там уже справжня екосистема: гніздяться тисячі птахів, тусуються тюлені, ростуть квіти й трави. І все це — на острові, якого 60 років тому тупо не існувало. Але є нюанс. Океан Суртсей ненавидить. Північна Атлантика щороку відгризає шматки острова хвилями й штормами. Від початкової площі вже залишилась приблизно половина (останнє фото)

/>

І найіронічніше, що вчені тепер спостерігають не тільки народження острова, а й його повільну смерть.

Але навіть коли Суртсей майже зникне, його головний експеримент уже вдався.

title.title: ¿Por qué tu titulo universitario ya no es suficiente y qué buscan las empresas hoy?
title.body:
![Gemini_Generated_Image_rvu3yzrvu3yzrvu3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onezetty/23xVK9hu78QYovD5HLUqJLjSnpRddkpVino7ZziBVr4hjsfK5qpqZHApB4XBWqxZPJ2VY.jpg)<figcaption>Fuente de la imagen: Gemini IA</figcaption>
## ¿El fin de la titulitis? 

¿Te acuerdas cuando nos decían que estudiar una carrera universitaria era el boleto dorado al éxito laboral? **Bueno, creo que las reglas del juego acaban de cambiar por completo**.

Hace unos días, leí [una entrevista en El Sol de Toluca](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldetoluca/local/el-titulo-universitario-pierde-valor-frente-a-las-habilidades-blandas-advierte-especialista-30007626), la reconocida especialista en el mundo laboral *Mónica Flores* lanzó una advertencia que debería ponernos a pensar a todos: contar con un título universitario **ya no garantiza una ventaja competitiva en el mercado laboral**.  

> El peso de un diploma está disminuyendo drásticamente frente a algo mucho más dinámico e indispensable: **las habilidades blandas (soft skills) y la inteligencia humana y emocional al momento de resolver problemas**.

## Nos preparamos para un mundo que dejará de existir (o que ya no existe).

Una de las frases más contundentes de la experta fue: “Nos estamos preparando hoy para un mundo que no va a existir en 2030”. El ritmo al que avanza la tecnología y el mercado de los negocios es tan acelerado que, para cuando terminas una carrera de cuatro o cinco años, gran parte de los conocimientos teóricos que adquiriste ya están obsoletos o desactualizados.

Si a esto le sumamos los datos de la OCDE que señalan que en México solo cerca del 22% de los estudiantes universitarios logran titularse, el panorama nos obliga a replantearnos de inmediato la forma en que construimos nuestro perfil profesional.

## Las habilidades más deseadas por las empresas hoy en día

Ya no se trata solo de saber hacer una tarea técnica, sino de cómo te desenvuelves mientras la haces. Según Flores, el gran diferenciador actual y el verdadero escudo contra la automatización es la inteligencia humana (esa que la tecnología jamás podrá replicar).

Si quieres ser verdaderamente competitivo, estas son las capacidades que debes empezar a entrenar hoy mismo:

- Adaptabilidad y resiliencia: La capacidad de pivotar rápido cuando los planes cambian.
- Pensamiento crítico y curiosidad: Cuestionarlo todo y querer aprender constantemente.
- Comunicación y colaboración: Saber trabajar con otros seres humanos y transmitir ideas con empatía.
- Ética y profesionalismo: Tu brújula moral en la toma de decisiones.

Aprendizaje acelerado: Tener la flexibilidad de desaprender lo viejo para absorber lo nuevo de inmediato.

## La pelota está en tu cancha
La conclusión del artículo nos deja una lección vital: la capacitación constante es una responsabilidad personal. Ya no puedes sentarte a esperar que una universidad o tu propia empresa te capaciten. El aprendizaje debe ser un hábito diario.  

El título universitario sigue siendo una base valiosa, pero hoy en día es solo el boleto de entrada al estadio; lo que define si juegas el partido y te mantienes en la cancha son tus habilidades humanas.  

Y tú, ¿qué opinas? ¿Crees que las empresas en tu sector ya valoran más tu capacidad de adaptación que tu título profesional? ¡Déjame tu comentario abajo!

> Creo que este artículo toca una fibra muy sensible en la sociedad latinoamericana, donde históricamente el título universitario ha sido visto como el principal vehículo de movilidad social. Sin embargo, **la realidad nos está alcanzando**.

**La democratización del conocimiento técnico**: Hoy en día, cualquier persona con internet puede aprender a programar, diseñar, manejar finanzas o dominar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a través de cursos online. Lo técnico se ha vuelto accesible, casi un commodity. Por lo tanto, el diferenciador ya no es el conocimiento acumulado, sino la actitud y la agilidad mental.

**El peligro de la obsolescencia**: El sistema educativo tradicional es inherentemente lento. Cambiar el plan de estudios de una carrera universitaria puede tomar años debido a la burocracia, mientras que el mercado laboral cambia en meses. Esto genera profesionales frustrados que salen al mundo real con herramientas de ayer para resolver los problemas de mañana, y cuando llegan, llegan muy tarde.

**El verdadero valor de la \

**: En la era de la Inteligencia Artificial, delegar tareas operativas y técnicas es cada vez más fácil. **Lo que una máquina no puede hacer es inspirar a un equipo**, **resolver un conflicto con empatía**, tener ética ante un dilema complejo o mostrar resiliencia ante una crisis inesperada. Es ahí donde los humanos nos volvemos verdaderamente insustituibles. ![Gemini_Generated_Image_5fefkp5fefkp5fef.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onezetty/23wCC9ed5pFpQnu2UgMfYnPuSNhWXBtML669XccMDp53VMbeDhVghsQtSJ1qvxGyfxmyW.jpg) ## Mi conclusión No se trata de desmeritar la universidad, sino de quitarle el pedestal místico. Un título te da estructura mental, métodos y contactos, pero tu capacidad de aprender de forma autónoma, tu inteligencia emocional, tu capacidad de liderazgo, motivacional y de conectar con los demás, puede ser tan importante como un título en el éxito de tu carrera laboral, y es lo que realmente determinará tu éxito a largo plazo.

title.title: The classic feel of the old city of photography in the beauty of the falling dusk appears in quiet beauty
title.body:
Dusk fell slowly over the streets of the old city, like watercolors gently spilling into the evening sky. Clouds of light orange mixed with pale purple hang calmly above the rows of classic houses that stand close together on the side of the road.

The street lights started to turn on one after another, while the black asphalt reflected the remaining light of the sun that had not yet completely left. The city is not busy, but that's where its beauty grows, quietly like an old song coming back to an old radio.

At the corner of the street, several cars passed slowly as if reluctant to disturb the tranquility of the twilight. Houses with high roofs and small balconies look like time keepers who faithfully store stories for many years. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU37CE62hc78QXDDV591dJZYDjyaTKtFDBCcthbKDi45p/1779123450989.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNXAPgsMW1YwZfTADZdzK5EkS2kex7EeR2ivFNiEj7Uop/1779123451078.jpg)

The afternoon breeze carries the aroma of cold air mixed with city dust, making anyone who walks there want to slow down and enjoy every color of the sky that changes from minute to minute. That evening felt like not just a change in time, but rather a small show from nature for a city that was starting to get tired after a long day of life.

When the last light sank behind the distant hills, the sky still left a soft golden tinge between the clouds. The streets are starting to get quiet, but a warm atmosphere remains between the old houses and the calm curves of the roads.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfS8QJRTbK5hGDPfesGuMhsHadiu9Eici9EXhqJaaLkyX/1779123486651.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYdSFv2fbW32SiVgjoW5i49qGfDbq9LcL7aLhhGSCtD1D/1779123486707.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP8fPEFgyXc7f7rsvLzrKMeG8nQGVKSFtfkFdgegHLffa/1779123486764.jpg)

In that simple camera shot, the old city looks like a small world that forgot to run, where dusk always has a way of making anyone stop for a moment and fall in love with the tranquility.

title.title: Hot Tempers, Real Damage: When Does Anger Stop Being an Excuse?
title.body: > As human as we are, we all are different in our own way and that’s what makes us unique. Speaking of uniqueness, we all have our temperaments. Some of us are very calm people while others are very hot headed. Regardless, we all find a way to live together as one. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUtFKzx9shn7NEaqJCcged7HEUJNj79Ff2SfzumPdL15Z/885a8077_1f6a_4bb0_afb9_2726a515ade9.jpeg) However, we are all bound to step on each other’s toes once in a while. No one is perfect and that’s very okay. If we were perfect, we wouldn’t even qualify as human because our imperfections also are a part of who we are as individuals. Honestly, I’ve had to come into contact with different kinds of people due to what I do and I will tell you today that there are some people you will meet once and pray never to cross paths with these. Sometimes you see them somewhere by chance and you try to hide from them because God knows they’re so out of it. People can go overboard sometimes and we sometimes have to over look it, but not everything can be overlooked and for how long will you keep looking away. I always say that, if you know you have to say sorry after doing something, you know you’re doing something wrong so why do it in the first place. I’d like to believe some of us don’t respect ourselves enough and that’s why we are always those having to apologize for our wrong doings and messy behaviors. No matter who you are, you should know and learn how to carry yourself. Nothing is an excuse as to how you act because every one of us is hot tempered, we just chose to tone it down because some of us are actually really really mad out there. You step out and see people acting so out of character and their excuse is, they are hot tempered. Like we all aren’t. It tends gets so bad that people start to avoid you and before you notice ,it will be too late. But then again, to some people extent I would blame society for making such people believe they are hot tempered and so all their actions and misbehaviors should be excused. Once you refuse to call them out, the pattern continues and before you know it, it’s something else. But who suffers the most? # Learn Zig Series (#52) - HTTP Server: Router and Responses

![zig.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHuB6qTWHaSpJHQ1S8FCCRmNQuUxTcPZdU4yKHsJ7vEP/zig-banner.png)

**Project E: HTTP Server from Scratch (2/4)**

### What will I learn
- You will learn how to build a Response struct with status code, headers, and body;
- You will learn common HTTP status codes and when to use each one;
- You will learn how to construct well-formed HTTP responses: `200 OK`, `404 Not Found`, `500 Internal Server Error`;
- You will learn how to build a path-based router that matches URL patterns to handler functions;
- You will learn the handler function signature: `fn(Request, std.mem.Allocator) Response`;
- You will learn how to extract path parameters from URLs like `/users/:id`;
- You will learn how to build JSON responses with proper Content-Type headers;
- You will learn how to test your router by registering routes, sending requests, and verifying responses.

### Requirements
- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- An installed Zig 0.14+ distribution (download from ziglang.org);
- The ambition to learn Zig programming.

### Difficulty
- Advanced

# Learn Zig Series (#52) - HTTP Server: Router and Responses

Last time in [episode 51](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-zig-series-51-http-server-accept-loop-and-parsing) we built the foundation of our HTTP server -- the accept loop, a `Request` struct, buffered reading, header parsing, body reading, and basic error responses. We ended with a placeholder `sendResponse` function that just echoed the request info back. Functional, but not very useful. A real HTTP server needs two things on top of that: a **router** (matching URL paths to handler functions) and proper **response generation** (status codes, headers, content types, the whole deal).

That's exactly what we're building today. By the end of this episode you'll have a server where you can register routes like `/users/:id` with handler functions, and the router will match incoming requests, extract path parameters, call the right handler, and send back a well-formed HTTP response. If no route matches, you get a proper `404 Not Found`. If the handler crashes, you get a `500 Internal Server Error`. Here we go!

## The Response struct: status code, headers, body

Before we can build a router, we need to define what a handler returns. In [episode 51](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-zig-series-51-http-server-accept-loop-and-parsing) our `sendErrorResponse` function manually formatted HTTP response strings. That works for one-off error pages but it's not scalable -- we need a proper `Response` struct that handlers can construct cleanly:

```zig

title.\\n };\\n};\\n\\nconst Router = struc: )]`. $ curl -s http://localhost:8080/nonexistent
404 Not Found

$ curl -s -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/health
405 Method Not Allowed
```

Everything works. GET routes return JSON, parameterized routes extract the ID correctly, POST receives and acknowledges the body, and unknown routes get a clean 404. The DELETE request to `/health` returns 405 because we only registered a GET handler for that path -- the router checks the method and rejects mismatches. title.title: Bolso Primaveral 👜🌺🌹. Diseñando y confeccionando una bolsita de mano.
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTm8km7rDeWYtJAiLNaNDXKkHm2skdbEqqFkDeN6pVWz3/1779122835089.jpg)
*Buenas, buenas por aquí, gente linda de @jewelry, les deseo un maravilloso dia, cargado de buena vibra, de mucha alegria y sobre todo mucho amor. Estoy fascinada ante tanto derroche de talento que abunda en esta hermosa comunidad, agradecida siempre con todos sus integrantes por mostrar tan bellos proyectos y por siempre apoyarnos los unos a los otros. El dia de hoy les voy a compartir un lindo paso a paso, del diseño y confeccion de una hermosa cartera o bolsita circular con flores creadas a mano, un accesorio que sin dudas cautiva, enamora y desprende originalidad.* >*Hello everyone at @jewelry! I wish you a wonderful day filled with good vibes, joy, and above all, love. I'm fascinated by the abundance of talent in this beautiful community, and I'm always grateful to all its members for showcasing such beautiful projects and for always supporting one another. Today, I'm going to share a lovely step-by-step tutorial for designing and making a beautiful heart-shaped purse or bag—an accessory that will undoubtedly captivate, charm, and exude originality.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV8gnY7Dq8nHf9nZi3eQjkxxMVwEtJf4uaWEHLpZBN5yi/1779103823601.jpg)
*Debo decir que ame hacer este tipo de trabajo, hacia mucho moria por ejecutarlo, pero no me animaba por falta de herramientas. Su composición resulto ser bien entretenida y algo compleja, pues tenia una idea original que termino convirtiendose en otra e el transcurso del diseño. Es que cuando creamos, diseñamos y confeccionamos alguna prenda o accesorio, trabajamos con una idea, que puede modificarse o mantenerse igual en dicho proceso. No se si les oasa igual que a mi. Este trabajo fue un lindo detalle para mi prima por el dia delas madres. No hay nada que ame mas que regalar algo realizado por mi. Espero y os guste!* >*I must say I loved doing this kind of work. I'd been dying to do it for a long time, but I was hesitant because I lacked the tools. Its composition turned out to be quite entertaining and somewhat complex, as I had an original idea that ended up becoming something else entirely during the design process. When we create, design, and make a garment or accessory, we work with an idea that can be modified or remain the same throughout the process. I don't know if you experience the same thing as me. This project was a lovely gift for my cousin for Mother's Day. There's nothing I love more than giving something I've made myself. I hope you like it!*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVL1ikF62aQfXWtzKDETdTqjHNnjMZxXwEeQ29Sjq5mUN/1779104390107.webp)
*Aquí les dejo un minitutorial, con un pequeño collage de fotos, mostrando el paso a paso del mismo y los materiales que utilice para recrear esta prenda. Para los amantes del reto y la costura, espero que les sirva y ayude en sus creaciones futuras.* >*Here is a mini tutorial, with a small collage of photos, showing the step by step and the materials I used to recreate this garment. For those who love the challenge and sewing, I hope it will help you in your future creations.* ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Materiales / Materials

  • Tela roja
  • Tijeras
  • Hilo y aguja
  • Cinta de medir
  • Alfileres
  • Maquina de coser
  • Listones con lentejuelas para las flores
  • Botones
  • Linston de cinta verde fina
  • Broche
    • >Red fabric Scissors Thread and needle Measuring tape Pins Sewing machine Sequined ribbons for the flowers Buttons Linston of fine green ribbon Brooch ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ **Procedimiento:** **1er paso:** *Comence recortando cada pieza de mi bolsita. Obteniendo 4 circulos con la misma medida, dos listones que tuviesen un largo adecuado como para cubrir hasta mas de la mitad del circulo. Dos listones mas pequeños para las asas, esta debe ser con el largo deseado. Los rellenos de esponja para darle mas consistencia y firmeza. Otros.* >**Procedure:** **1st step:** *I started by cutting out each piece for my little bag. I got four circles of the same size, two strips long enough to cover more than half of the circles, and two smaller strips for the handles (these should be the desired length). I added sponge filling for extra structure and firmness. Other things.*
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSF9mkGxJW2ATvnC6mgjHS7LFVAAKMHLdXjXX46bJQQg5/1779105505540.jpg)
    **2do paso:** *Seguidamente procedi a unir el liston mas grande a ambos circulos, comenzando desde un poco mas de la mitad hasta el otro lateral, primero en una cara circular y luego en otra. Repitiendo este proceso dos veces, dejando la parte de arriba sin coser para poder voltearlo luego al derecho. Antes de unir dichas piezas, se deben colocar derecho com derecho por dentro, quedando el reves por fuera.* >**2nd step:** *Next, I attached the larger strip to both circles, starting slightly past the halfway point and working my way to the other side, first on one circular face and then on the other. I repeated this process twice, leaving the top unsewn so it could be turned right side out later. Before joining these pieces, they should be placed right sides together, with the wrong sides facing out.*
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUePSs7bZK269mPbcG27BgMAeNByKW67cmhydqrf2uUbT/1779105880329.jpg)
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXaDCu17Q6LUjyBSDgcq3Wn4QQ2uu9NE7HwHMiXff9jTT/1779105928004.jpg)
    **3er paso:** *Ya volteado al derecho le coloque los rellenos por dentro y cerre con una puntada decorativa para darle un toque mas estético. En el caso de las asas se colocan por dentro en los laterales antes de voltearlo, de manera tal que quede bien cosida y con las costuras por dentro cuando se voltee al derecho. Ya por ultimo pegue con silicona liquida y luego cosi las flores en el frente de la bolsa, haciendo honor a la primavera.* >**Step 3:** *Once turned right side out, I placed the filling inside and closed it with a decorative stitch for a more aesthetic touch. The handles are attached to the inside sides before turning it right side out, so they are sewn securely and the seams are on the inside when turned right side out. Finally, I glued the flowers to the front of the bag with liquid silicone and then sewed them on, in honor of spring.*
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVseFSsNRCsYBacAeEbrQ3pHJnkF4Nj8N7hHvXWrPVzQ2/1779106534658.jpg)
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLgAfQtDmDLCRTfNBBPQ89UGEXgdsdLNoBf8TzYGgrnA/1779106547822.jpg)
    ✨✨✨✨❤️❤️❤️✨✨✨✨ **Resultado/Result** ✨✨✨✨❤️❤️❤️✨✨✨✨
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfFPbnH5mZz3yFskKg1ECeqzHAwRaa2znNX7S4QCpzbX/1779106612239.jpg)
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYiLwTCFq3gHRHm9ueUJDXXHxXXXuNfeV917HdqAVxzpk/1779106637594.jpg)
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQajX4LCVgiwpAmb4UCbwv2qTHLGaTZZcfFLSdYT9p3mR/1779106667468.jpg)
    *Espero que les alla gustado y les sirva de alguna ayuda este pequeño minitutorial. Pido disculpas si no se entiende bien alguna informacion, pues no soy muy buena explicando estos procedimientos. Gracias de antemano, espero y os guste mi contenido, y agradeceria que dejaran sus lindos comentarios y se aventuraran conmigo en este proyecto. Bendiciones y lindo dia.* >*I hope you liked it and I hope this little mini tutorial will be of some help to you. I apologize if some information is not well understood, because I am not very good at explaining these procedures. Thank you in advance, I hope you like my content, and I would appreciate if you could leave your nice comments and venture with me in this project. Blessings and have a nice day.*

title.title: Down to Business.
title.body:
>

After selling some pelt to the Valentine butcher and visiting the doctor, I reunited with Abigail at the saloon. After a touching reunion and drinks, Abigail revealed she was on a bounty hunting mission. John agreed to join her, and we rode toward Strawberry to hunt a bank-robbing accountant.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHBNXCAqkeYZhLyPYTTEkToc2KRX4C1CwQp9rktqs5HG/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHVCgphNL5xymbrnNmPabjbEdaFva1u5gu1aCNb1m56u/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDkvGBRuL74tu3BV1QKkWrCemgof4NDxFnBeRvoPzM2S/screenshot_3_.png)

The first thing I did was selling the animal skin to the butcher that I was carrying on my horsebacks for a long time, after getting to Valentine. It felt good to finally get it off the saddle and pocket some decent cash for the quality hide.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbf6o9jBRyTFKbczmfGWnFc6Wo28oGevC6Cf2a5ErZvvX/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdxn3TjygTooJwyyGDqDmoWzXQs2AGBhUSaBiyxrBXCU6/screenshot_5_.png)

Then after hitching my horse in front of the saloon where I should have found Abigail, I went inside the doctor's store to buy some stuff. I stocked up on some medicine and tonics to ensure I was fully prepared for whatever trouble lay ahead.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXw4b6eFnLqh4oZEAR2iu7XhBCj794FuWghxKyFDmkVdy/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjsWxz3jNYx3y3MvHCXWmmz5GvkB3PCBYa3Z2R5ajDTN/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1jSJsgwV7TJED64c1g7j4TU2kZ4Lv7JHKoVdnzKrcs1/screenshot_8_.png)

When I was done with the doctor, I walked into the saloon and found Abigail was teaching some folks some manners in the center of the room. She was holding her own against some rowdy locals who clearly didn't know who they were messing with.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQfTWsTadA33sw4pCzMAfuBaRHH1VcXoopDWMCAcNB97/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZMm2uuj1MHH9iGvXBrD1ookWKsF2ibYzkc6HrYj1wpfX/screenshot_10_.png)

John calmed Abigail, and then they hugged each other, finding one another alive after so much time spent apart in the harsh wilderness. The relief on their faces was obvious as they held each other tightly, letting the saloon noise fade away.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6o8H34z3Xf5TZfkvJ5nWvtTj6XuervPx3cQYUFqYaC5/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRfudaHV6Ke1hKm2BXTBsLw33bx289qQoenUMhHUMWzKR/screenshot_12_.png)

Then they had a conversation over some drinks. What Abigail mentioned, how happy she was seeing John alive, as last time she saw John got shot, and she knew he was dead. It felt like a true miracle to her.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV2RLGKH45eVX8Gc4AytGdXLZV8FjmGgi6MNKM8bnF4W2/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcQ3aEVHH43AHzipvoXurwH5fYvR6QKjEME8KmpLFfGzA/screenshot_14_.png)

Then Abigail started talking all business and told John she was on a bounty hunting mission to make ends meet. And John decided to join her, pulling his hat down and draining his glass, ready to watch her back out on the trail.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXgKDjWvAF2jAWf7rondWM3Yx5KBUMFSBkmYGkqGLnGi/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNk64hiAZeLCqsEGXNzUoCmNhczPVgYorMaicQuVw3M8r/screenshot_16_.png)

So we are riding to Strawberry to find a man who is on the run from New York with a good price on his head. And he robbed a bank, being an accountant, using his knowledge of figures to slip away with a fortune.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

Here I'm finishing the post for today, and I'll talk about more special RDR 2 gaming moments in Gaming Photography.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png

title.title: The Swatch Fever: How the Royal Pop Collection Ignited a Global Watch Mania
title.body: In an era where luxury watches often feel out of reach for the average enthusiast, Swatch has once again proven that accessible design, bold creativity, and strategic collaborations can create genuine cultural phenomena. The latest spark? The Audemars Piguet x Swatch \

collection, a vibrant series of bioceramic pocket watches that has sent watch lovers, hypebeasts, and resellers into a frenzy in May 2026.

### From MoonSwatch to Royal Pop: Swatch's Hype Machine Evolves

Swatch first mastered the high-low collaboration game with the 2022 Omega MoonSwatch, which turned plastic watches into must-have items and drew massive crowds worldwide. Building on that success, the brand teamed up with another Swiss icon, Audemars Piguet (AP), known for its ultra-luxury Royal Oak timepieces that can command five- or six-figure prices.

The Royal Pop collection reimagines the Royal Oak's iconic octagonal bezel and integrated bracelet aesthetics through Swatch's playful, Pop Art-inspired lens. Instead of traditional wristwatches, these are innovative pocket watches available in eight cheerful, colorful bioceramic models. They feature hand-wound mechanical movements and come with versatile lanyards for wearing as pendants or in creative ways—blending fine watchmaking with joyful, everyday accessibility.

Priced between $400 and $420, the Lépine and Savonnette styles make a piece of AP heritage feel attainable, while nodding to Swatch's 1980s POP heritage. The result is a fun, provocative statement piece rather than a serious investment tool.

### Chaos at the Stores: Lines, Scuffles, and Viral Madness

The launch on May 16, 2026, was anything but ordinary. Crowds camped for days outside Swatch stores in cities like New York (Times Square), London, Paris, Milan, Singapore, Dubai, and more. Videos of pushing, shoving, and mosh-pit-like scenes went viral. Some locations saw police intervention with tear gas, while others forced temporary closures for safety reasons.

Swatch issued public appeals for calm, emphasizing ample stock and urging fans to avoid unnecessary risks. Despite initial resale prices skyrocketing (some listings hit thousands shortly after release), the market cooled quickly as more pieces became available, highlighting the power—and fleeting nature—of hype.

This isn't just about the watches; it's a reflection of broader trends. In a world dominated by smartwatches, analog pieces like these offer personality, storytelling, and community. The Royal Pop taps into aspirational luxury while staying fun and democratic.

### Why the Fever Matters

The Swatch Royal Pop phenomenon demonstrates several things:

- **Democratization of Luxury**: It brings elements of high-end horology to a wider audience without diluting the original brand's prestige.
- **The Power of Collaboration**: Pairing mass-market accessibility with iconic design codes creates instant buzz.
- **Social Media Amplification**: Hype builds online, turns into real-world frenzy, and keeps the conversation going even after the initial chaos subsides.
- **Nostalgia Meets Novelty**: Echoing Swatch's fun roots while paying homage to AP's legacy.

Critics may call it a gimmick or question the pocket-watch format, but the energy it generated is undeniable. Whether you're a collector hunting for the next flip or simply someone who appreciates colorful, wearable art, the Royal Pop has reminded everyone why watches still captivate us.

As lines thin and the watches become more readily available in stores, one thing is clear: Swatch has successfully reignited the conversation around affordable, exciting timepieces. The fever may cool, but the impact on watch culture—and the anticipation for whatever Swatch does next—will linger. 

If you're tempted, head to a Swatch boutique soon. Just don't expect to camp out this time—the Royal Pop is here to stay, at least for a while.

title.title: I Miss the Woman Who Held Me Together When Life Was Falling Apart.
title.body:
Indeed, there are a whole lot of people we can miss. Talk of our friends back then in school, colleagues at former places of work, neighbors and all. It's normal and it's very human if we miss people.



![1000131331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2cckBqSwrkKy2N7ht4Gm5bu2d7X6twPvTxdooeyL6vUWbnZzmkjj1GQZ85hCkcXXLp.jpg)



And thinking about this topic now, a lot of people came through my mind. A whole lot that I wasn't finding it easy to make mention of one person. But then, I decided to talk about these one person who means the world to me. I have found myself thinking about her a lot differently these past few days and I can't even help but to talk about her.




I'm talking of no other person but my mum. The most loving, sweetest, caring and understanding woman I know. She's the one who stood strong for me while I was scared, she kept her hopes alive for me even when mine was shrinking.





I just miss her kind of, I miss the way I call her *'Iya Ope.\

body.title: Steemhop gameplay:- The goal was to reduce the rank
body.body: > Hello friends, how are you all? I hope everyone is doing well. Those who know me know that I play the game Steem Hop regularly. It has now become my daily habit. Today too, when I entered the game, I had an insistence in my mind that I have to do something today. That is the story I have come to share with you today. ![IMG_20260507_202725.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmREfis7nW1uE7BSsUe6XG6vQGws8Tw8KzdqQAmH3QcC6z/IMG_20260507_202725.jpg) Like every day, my first task after entering the game dashboard was to claim the daily reward. Today was no exception. I got a 10 point bonus as soon as I logged in, which was a good start. Then I thought I would spin the spin wheel once and see what my luck had in store. To be honest, I didn't expect much, but as soon as the wheel spun, I saw that I had got 111 points! After getting these extra points, my mind became quite happy. ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201316.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdo3LRRYy9CKrnk1iCLiq1tTm95kEbS1UKvwS3euQTbJX/Screenshot_2026_0507_201316.jpg) ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201252.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdUzY77vxdoiBoFXnVrSVPKU5bHaHhtp27nCUUcxNAyz1/Screenshot_2026_0507_201252.jpg) Then when I checked my main dashboard, I saw that my rank is currently 42. To be honest, I felt a little bad when I saw the number 42. I immediately set myself a challenge—today, I had to reduce this rank to below 40 at any cost. My current level is 8 (Challenger). I needed many more points to move forward. Those of you who play this game know that as easy as it looks, it is just as difficult to play. Especially when you have to cross train lines or fast cars, a little mistake can be game over. I have also shared some screenshots of my game with you. Sometimes I score 45, and sometimes I get stuck at 29 or 30 after falling under a car or train. Especially crossing those red signaled train lines was quite stressful. ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201339.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmV6tkZFanFtmRGMtVu1qMkiyAZ9WMRx181uJwGAeGTu6x/Screenshot_2026_0507_201339.jpg) ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201330.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbfXUFP7LjHp5trQCY5CqvbQUphih5ecrURn62xSSXiHx/Screenshot_2026_0507_201330.jpg) But I didn't give up. After trying several times, my points started to gradually increase. When I saw that my total points had increased from 1768 to 2032, I felt a sense of peace. Then, when I refreshed the dashboard, I saw that my rank had jumped from 42 to 37! Moving up 5 steps in just a few hours of effort is a big win for me. Although my high score is 60 so far, I know that it is possible to increase it further if I play regularly. ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201529.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbYAKsvXDYmdqoiSvnEYj9tBD9CJEuYV4acjhxx6ksNPd/Screenshot_2026_0507_201529.jpg) ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201446.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYSwfJTzCJicdSDPXQcTQUNEcDEM63S6wprp4BXxSHbUa/Screenshot_2026_0507_201446.jpg) ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201426.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmPpdZjfKCWTZUE9QAWfdpA3tRoAGDnUfvnzGWeotvr9rv/Screenshot_2026_0507_201426.jpg) Overall, today's gaming session was great for me. The joy of being able to meet the target is different. Those of you who are not playing this game yet, you can try it once. ![Screenshot_2026_0507_201700.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVy4rSs2smeJTmof8uiBaapSryANDdhzQDrkseF6msVJh/Screenshot_2026_0507_201700.jpg) And those of you who are already playing, don't forget to tell us what your current rank is in the comments. I am ending here today, I will appear before you with a bigger score or rank in the future, God willing. Thank you all for taking the time to read this small blog of mine. Posted using [SportsTalkSocial](https://www.sportstalksocial.com/@mamun123456/steemhop-gameplay-the-goal-was-to-reduce-the-rank)
