body.title: Dive Safely
body.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Dive Safely](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/1ee2ef8d-d399-4143-83b1-22bf2bb81387.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/cqa4hXvSLGFj3McLMco6aB) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Lunes 18 de mayo, 2026

La relación del ser humano con el mundo sumergido es tan antigua como la curiosidad misma. Desde las primeras costas, mirando hacia ese azul profundo que ocultaba comida y misterios, la necesidad de bajar fue inmediata. Los primeros intentos no tenían nada que ver con la tecnología compleja; eran pura supervivencia y astucia. Se cuenta que en la antigua Grecia ya utilizaban campanas invertidas para atrapar aire, permitiendo a los trabajadores permanecer bajo el agua el tiempo suficiente para recuperar objetos o realizar reparaciones simples. Era un juego peligroso contra la presión y la falta de oxígeno, donde el margen de error era casi nulo.

Con el paso de los siglos, la ingeniería comenzó a tomar la relevancia que antes tenía la intuición. Leonardo da Vinci dibujó conceptos de trajes impermeables y sistemas de respiración, aunque muchos quedaron en el papel, más como sueños que como realidades tangibles. No fue hasta el siglo XIX cuando la revolución industrial permitió crear cascos de cobre pesados, conectados a bombas manuales en la superficie. 

El verdadero salto cualitativo llegó con la comprensión de la fisiología humana bajo presión. Antes, muchos pagaron un precio alto por ignorar cómo los gases se comportan dentro del cuerpo. La descompresión era un enemigo invisible que provocaba dolores atroces y parálisis. Fue necesario estudiar, experimentar y, lamentablemente, sufrir accidentes para entender que el ascenso debía ser lento y controlado. Paralelamente, la invención del regulador de demanda cambió las reglas del juego por completo. Ya no hacía falta arrastrar mangueras desde la superficie; el aire llegaba directamente a la boca del nadador, liberándolo de las ataduras físicas.

En la mitad del siglo XX, la combinación de aletas, máscaras herméticas y tanques de aire comprimido portátiles democratizó el acceso al submarinismo. Lo que antes era tarea exclusiva de militares, ingenieros o recolectores de esponjas, se transformó en una actividad accesible para cualquiera con la formación adecuada. El silencio bajo el agua, roto solo por el ritmo constante de la propia respiración, ofreció una perspectiva nueva sobre la vida. Ya no se trataba solo de extraer recursos, sino de observar. Los arrecifes de coral, los naufragios históricos y la fauna marina dejaron de ser mitos para convertirse en ecosistemas documentados y protegidos.

Hoy en día, la tecnología ha refinado cada aspecto de la inmersión. Los ordenadores de buceo calculan en tiempo real los límites de seguridad, los trajes secos permiten explorar aguas gélidas y las mezclas de gases especiales facilitan descensos a profundidades que antes parecían imposibles para el organismo humano. Sin embargo, la esencia no ha cambiado. Sigue siendo un acto de humildad frente a un entorno hostil que no nos pertenece. Cada vez que alguien se lanza al vacío azul, lleva consigo siglos de prueba y error, de innovación y respeto. 

Las normas que rigen la inmersión no son caprichos burocráticos, sino la cristalización de décadas de lecciones aprendidas, muchas de ellas escritas con tinta roja. La piedra angular de toda esta estructura es la formación certificada. Nadie debería sumergirse sin haber comprendido primero la física y la fisiología básicas que operan bajo el agua. Aprender a equilibrar la presión en los oídos, a controlar la flotabilidad y, sobre todo, a gestionar el aire disponible, son habilidades que se adquieren en piscinas controladas antes de enfrentarse al mar abierto. Esta educación inicial establece un lenguaje común, una serie de señales manuales y protocolos de seguridad que permiten a extraños coordinarse bajo el agua, donde la voz humana no tiene cabida.

El compañerismo es otro pilar innegociable. La regla de nunca bucear solo trasciende la simple compañía; se trata de tener un respaldo vital inmediato. Un compañero atento puede detectar un problema en el equipo, compartir aire en una emergencia o ayudar a mantener la calma si surge el pánico. Esta interdependencia crea un vínculo de confianza silenciosa. Junto a esto, la planificación previa a la entrada al agua es tan crucial como la inmersión misma. Definir la profundidad máxima, el tiempo límite, la ruta prevista y los procedimientos de emergencia evita la improvisación, que suele ser la causa principal de los accidentes. Se acuerda un punto de encuentro y se revisa el estado del equipo, asegurando que cada válvula y cada hebilla funcione correctamente.

La gestión del aire merece una mención especial, gobernada por principios conservadores como la regla de los tercios o el mantenimiento de una reserva mínima obligatoria. Subir a la superficie con el tanque vacío no es una hazaña, sino un fallo grave de juicio. El ascenso debe ser siempre lento y controlado, respetando las paradas de seguridad necesarias para permitir que el nitrógeno acumulado en los tejidos se elimine de forma segura. Ignorar estos tiempos de descompresión puede tener consecuencias devastadoras para la salud. Además, el respeto por el entorno es una norma ética y, increasingly, legal. No tocar, no perseguir y no alterar la vida marina ni los fondos marinos garantiza que esos ecosistemas frágiles perduren.

Finalmente, la honestidad sobre las propias limitaciones físicas y psicológicas es fundamental. No hay vergüenza en cancelar una inmersión si las condiciones del mar superan la experiencia del individuo o si el cuerpo no se siente bien. La prudencia no es cobardía, sino la manifestación más alta de profesionalismo y amor por la actividad. Las normativas, ya sean impuestas por agencias internacionales o por leyes locales, buscan únicamente preservar la vida y la integridad del medio ambiente. 

El cuerpo humano no fue diseñado para habitar bajo el agua, y esa disonancia biológica es la fuente principal de los riesgos inherentes a la actividad. La presión hidrostática ejerce una fuerza constante que comprime los espacios aéreos del organismo, lo que puede provocar barotraumatismos si no se equaliza correctamente la presión en los oídos y los senos paranasales. Los pulmones, aunque protegidos por el aire comprimido del regulador, son vulnerables durante el ascenso; una retención involuntaria de la respiración mientras se sube puede causar daños graves debido a la expansión del gas. Más allá de la mecánica inmediata, existe el riesgo silencioso de la enfermedad descompresiva, donde las burbujas de nitrógeno se forman en el torrente sanguíneo si el ascenso es demasiado rápido, pudiendo afectar desde las articulaciones hasta el sistema nervioso central.

La narcosis por nitrógeno, a menudo descrita como una embriaguez de profundidad, altera el juicio y la coordinación motora a ciertas profundidades, convirtiendo tareas simples en desafíos complejos. Además, el entorno térmico plantea un desafío constante, ya que el agua conduce el calor lejos del cuerpo mucho más rápido que el aire, lo que puede llevar a la hipotermia si no se utiliza el aislamiento adecuado. Estos peligros físicos requieren una vigilancia continua y un estado de salud óptimo, pues cualquier condición preexistente, como problemas cardíacos o respiratorios, puede amplificarse drásticamente bajo la presión.

Sin embargo, contrapesando estos riesgos, los beneficios físicos son significativos para quienes mantienen una práctica regular y segura. La resistencia natural del agua proporciona un ejercicio de bajo impacto que fortalece la musculatura sin estrés articular, mejorando la capacidad cardiovascular y la eficiencia respiratoria. La necesidad de controlar la respiración de manera lenta y profunda entrena el diafragma y aumenta la capacidad pulmonar, promoviendo una oxigenación más eficiente incluso en tierra firme. 

En el plano psicológico, la inmersión actúa como un potente catalizador para la reducción del estrés. El sonido rítmico de la propia respiración, aislado del ruido caótico de la superficie, induce un estado meditativo profundo. Esta desconexión digital y social obliga a la mente a centrarse en el presente inmediato, una forma de mindfulness forzoso que limpia la ansiedad cotidiana. La sensación de ingravidez libera al cuerpo de la tensión muscular acumulada por la gravedad, proporcionando una relajación física que se traduce directamente en calma mental.

Superar el miedo inicial y aprender a confiar en el equipo y en uno mismo genera una confianza robusta y una resiliencia emocional notable. Enfrentarse a un entorno hostil y salir ileso, habiendo gestionado los recursos y los imprevistos con éxito, refuerza la autoeficacia. Además, la exposición a la belleza sublime del mundo submarino, con sus colores vibrantes y su vida silenciosa, fomenta una sensación de asombro y humildad que puede reconfigurar la perspectiva vital. 

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción e información útil de lunes.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

body.body: My very specific and ridiculous fear is Macro-Bug-Judgment Phobia. It’s the constant, irrational anxiety that while I’m trying to get the perfect macro shot of an insect, the bug is actually judging my photography skills from behind the lens.\n​I live in fear that one day, a grasshopper will look directly into my camera, tap its tiny leg, and whisper, Your aperture is too wide and your focus is soft, amateur, before hopping away in total disappointment.\n​What triggers it? Any time an insect stays perfectly still for a photo. I’m convinced they aren't actually resting, they are just posing like supermodels and waiting for their modeling fee in high-quality organic leaf juice. If I don't deliver a 10/10 photo, I’m terrified they’ll find a way to crawl out of my phone screen at 3 AM and demand the RAW files. lol🤤😃😜

body.title: Amazon could have been a video game giant, but it failed [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbioDjZYYRumQws9PReznAjdwif4C1HPETMEULqrcZ7GQ1UBVpyFNu17niShoToDDPx.png) --- For years, Amazon possessed something that almost no other company has when entering the video game industry—and something I believe it actually managed to achieve, in a way: unlimited funds, technological infrastructure, and a platform capable of connecting millions of users worldwide. While other studios struggled to secure funding or simply survive from one launch to the next, Amazon had sufficient resources to build a giant comparable to Sony, Microsoft, or Valve. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23y8qZxyv36QApqHr6ee8arD31xb25MPJtbMNN7RvGAvuwtTzwhv4XwYmtMhtKhFNvzg7.png) --- But instead of leveraging that advantage, it ended up becoming one of the prime examples of squandered opportunities within the industry. The company entered the sector with enormous ambitions. It acquired studios, hired veterans from major franchises, and established Amazon Games with the intention of competing in the AAA market. The problem was that—according to multiple reports and employee testimonies—the company's vision appeared completely disconnected from how video game development actually works. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23y8oG6ptQvra1gHxe5mcmiHaNZCkEGYWBTdWnsN7FDdB2tLLG5RLHA6VtsDN9hx6eGX6.png) --- One of its biggest mistakes was believing that money could accelerate a creative process that typically requires years of experience, coordination, and patience. Amazon was chasing multi-billion-dollar franchises before it even understood how to build an identity of its own. Reports from former employees described unrealistic goals, a leadership team with scant experience in video games, and corporate decisions that constantly clashed with creative teams. And this is all the more surprising because Amazon actually possessed unique tools for success. No other company could combine a global storefront, cloud services via AWS, integration with Twitch, and massive marketing capabilities in the way that they could. In theory, they were ideally positioned to create vast ecosystems around their games. Yet they never managed to assemble those pieces into something coherent. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGe5eSJtLY7dXv82g3mqJmdLvHL1h7C36f7CTvXbEWTqXZJbC4MfdFRNU58QwaRqtaV.png) --- The prime example was *Crucible*, a multiplayer shooter that was pulled just months after its launch following a resounding failure. Later came *New World*, an MMO that did manage to attract millions of players initially—though over time, it lost much of its momentum due to technical issues, a lack of content, and design decisions that drew criticism from the community. Then came further troubling signs. Layoffs, project cancellations, and internal restructurings began to recur. Even initiatives backed by Amazon Games ended up shutting down quickly—as was the case with *King of Meat*, which barely managed to gather a tiny fraction of its projected player base before announcing the closure of its servers. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQP5WU64rJ2Q6nxQ7Dsrmh2fG53o2ynpkrC3bAhwYJjKtrnc4QTmTmNpBuYD1WsZeJL.png) --- Part of the problem also reflects something broader within the modern industry: many companies obsessively pursue the “games-as-a-service” model, hoping to create the next enduring phenomenon—the next *Fortnite* or *League of Legends*. However, maintaining active communities for years on end is far more complicated than it seems, especially when the offerings lack a distinct personality of their own. Gaming communities have long criticized this trend of prioritizing metrics and monetization over memorable experiences. The most frustrating part is that Amazon was never truly at risk of failing due to a lack of funds. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/245SvvmpPB7Stw162mLScYUC4LAfQozDqZKWqkqcvZhSbmE9K3oe5a9VYZkNoGQeiUqrr.png) --- It failed because it failed to grasp that video games do not function merely as an extension of a tech company. Creating successful games requires creative vision, clear leadership, and trust in development teams—lessons that long-standing companies in the sector spent decades learning. Perhaps Amazon still has room to reinvent itself within the gaming space. But given the cancellations, layoffs, and lost projects, one is left with the inescapable feeling of watching a company that held in its hands an opportunity that many studios would have killed to have... and simply let it slip away.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tbioDjZYYRumQws9PReznAjdwif4C1HPETMEULqrcZ7GQ1UBVpyFNu17niShoToDDPx.png) --- Durante años, Amazon tuvo algo que casi ninguna empresa posee al entrar en la industria del videojuego y creo que pudo lograrlo de alguna manera: dinero ilimitado, infraestructura tecnológica y una plataforma capaz de conectar a millones de usuarios en todo el mundo. Mientras otros estudios luchaban por conseguir financiación o sobrevivir lanzamiento tras lanzamiento, Amazon tenía recursos suficientes para construir un gigante comparable a Sony, Microsoft o Valve. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23y8qZxyv36QApqHr6ee8arD31xb25MPJtbMNN7RvGAvuwtTzwhv4XwYmtMhtKhFNvzg7.png) --- Pero en lugar de aprovechar esa ventaja, terminó convirtiéndose en uno de los mayores ejemplos de oportunidades desperdiciadas dentro de la industria. La compañía llegó al sector con ambiciones enormes. Compró estudios, contrató veteranos de grandes sagas y creó Amazon Games con la intención de competir en el mercado AAA. El problema fue que, según múltiples reportes y testimonios de trabajadores, la visión de la empresa parecía desconectada de cómo funciona realmente el desarrollo de videojuegos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23y8oG6ptQvra1gHxe5mcmiHaNZCkEGYWBTdWnsN7FDdB2tLLG5RLHA6VtsDN9hx6eGX6.png) --- Uno de los mayores errores fue pensar que el dinero podía acelerar un proceso creativo que normalmente requiere años de experiencia, coordinación y paciencia. Amazon buscaba franquicias multimillonarias antes siquiera de entender cómo construir una identidad propia. Reportes de antiguos empleados describieron objetivos poco realistas, una dirección con escasa experiencia en videojuegos y decisiones corporativas que chocaban constantemente con los equipos creativos. Y eso resulta todavía más sorprendente porque Amazon sí tenía herramientas únicas para triunfar. Ninguna otra empresa podía combinar una tienda global, servicios en la nube mediante AWS, integración con Twitch y capacidad de marketing masivo de la manera en que ellos podían hacerlo. En teoría, estaban en una posición ideal para crear ecosistemas enormes alrededor de sus juegos. Pero nunca lograron convertir esas piezas en algo coherente. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGe5eSJtLY7dXv82g3mqJmdLvHL1h7C36f7CTvXbEWTqXZJbC4MfdFRNU58QwaRqtaV.png) --- El mejor ejemplo fue Crucible, un shooter multijugador que fue retirado pocos meses después de su lanzamiento tras un fracaso rotundo. Más adelante apareció New World, un MMO que sí consiguió atraer millones de jugadores inicialmente, aunque con el tiempo perdió gran parte de su impulso debido a problemas técnicos, falta de contenido y decisiones de diseño discutidas por la comunidad. Luego llegaron más señales preocupantes. Despidos, cancelaciones de proyectos y reestructuraciones internas comenzaron a repetirse. Incluso iniciativas respaldadas por Amazon Games terminaron cerrando rápidamente, como ocurrió con King of Meat, que apenas logró reunir una fracción mínima de los jugadores esperados antes de anunciar el cierre de servidores. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQP5WU64rJ2Q6nxQ7Dsrmh2fG53o2ynpkrC3bAhwYJjKtrnc4QTmTmNpBuYD1WsZeJL.png) --- Parte del problema también refleja algo más amplio en la industria moderna: muchas compañías persiguen obsesivamente el modelo de “juego como servicio”, esperando crear el próximo fenómeno eterno tipo Fortnite o League of Legends. Sin embargo, mantener comunidades activas durante años es muchísimo más complicado de lo que parece, especialmente cuando las propuestas carecen de personalidad propia. Comunidades de jugadores llevan tiempo criticando esta tendencia de priorizar métricas y monetización por encima de experiencias memorables. Lo más frustrante es que Amazon nunca estuvo realmente cerca de fracasar por falta de dinero. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/245SvvmpPB7Stw162mLScYUC4LAfQozDqZKWqkqcvZhSbmE9K3oe5a9VYZkNoGQeiUqrr.png) --- Fracasó por no comprender que los videojuegos no funcionan únicamente como una extensión de una empresa tecnológica. Hacer juegos exitosos requiere visión creativa, liderazgo claro y confianza en los equipos de desarrollo, algo que compañías históricas del sector aprendieron durante décadas. Quizá Amazon todavía tenga margen para reinventarse dentro del gaming. Pero viendo cancelaciones, despidos y proyectos perdidos, queda inevitablemente la sensación de estar observando a una empresa que tuvo en sus manos una oportunidad que muchos estudios habrían matado por tener… y simplemente la dejó escapar.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante chévere, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos varias que me he tomado a lo largo de estos días. He comentado hace poco que he estado muy full de actividades tanto universitarias como laborales, he estado un poco cansada y quise aprovechar el fin de semana para descansar lo más que pueda, y honestamente me sentó muy bien. En los días que han pasado últimamente no he tenido muchos ánimos de tomarme fotos, igualmente siempre he sido de tomar fotos de otras cosas y no de mí, no porque tenga alguna inseguridad, sino que me gusta más tomar distintos planos de mi entorno a través de la cámara de mi celular, sobre todo si es de mis gatos, mi galería está llena de fotos de ellos. Algunas fotos que me he tomado me gustaron, y en otras siento que se ve un poco mi cansancio, sin embargo sigo cumpliendo con mis responsabilidades a pesar de ello. Una de las cosas que más detesto es tener que despertar temprano, y en la universidad y en mi trabajo tengo que hacerlo, y la verdad no me gusta nada ya que yo adoro dormir, a veces creo que si existen reencarnaciones, en alguna de mis vidas tuve que haber sido un koala de esos que duermen 23 horas. Quería compartir algunas de mis selfies que pude tomar en momentos de mi rutina, algunos momentos de buen humor, otros no tanto porque estaba cansada, espero que les guste!
Hello again! Today I’m come to your with a pretty cool new post, this time featuring a new collection of photos I’ve taken over the past few days. I mentioned recently that I’ve been really swamped with both school and work, so I’ve been a little tired and wanted to use the weekend to rest as much as possible, and honestly, it did me a world of good. Lately, I haven’t really felt like taking photos of myself. I’ve always been more into taking photos of other things rather than myself, not because I’m insecure, but because I prefer capturing different shots of my surroundings through my phone’s camera, especially of my cats. My gallery is full of photos of them. I liked some of the photos I took, but in others I feel like you can tell I’m a little tired; still, I keep fulfilling my responsibilities despite that. One of the things I hate most is having to wake up early, and at college and at work I have to do it, and honestly I don’t like it at all since I love sleeping. Sometimes I think that if reincarnation exists, in one of my past lives I must have been one of those koalas that sleep 23 hours a day. I wanted to share some of the selfies I took during my daily routine, some when I was in a good mood, others not so much because I was tired. I hope you like them!

Hi everyone! I hope you're all doing great. Yesterday I went on a trip with my family; we went to a wedding and had to walk 12 km, most of the way uphill, and now today I'm really tired, but the whole trip was worth it. I feel great, and I'll be posting photos from the day soon. By the way, any advice for dark circles under the eyes? People always tell me I look young, but my skin and the bags under my eyes make me look older. It’s a strange mix of youth and maturity, and to be honest, I don’t really like it.

>Hola hivers! Espero se encuentren muy bien, el día de ayer fui a un viaje con mi familia, fuimos a una casada y tuvimos que caminar 12km de distancia, la mayoría del camino fue de subida y ahora el díade hoy estoy muy cansada, pero todo el viaje valió la pena,me siento genial y pronto les iré subiendo las fotografías del día, por cierto, algún consejo para las ojeras? body.title: Streets of Murano
body.body: > Today I want to tell you about my visit to Murano. Luckily for me, the sun was shining brightly as I walked around the charming island. The water channels that served as streets were alive with boats sailing gracefully as people around enjoyed the warm day. From a small bridge, I photographed the boats tied to the sidewalks, waiting for their owners. ![Мu (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW3aSTbSmEcNU5huM7ew3JH9DG9XJYJJuALjCHzq27MDi/%D0%9Cu%20(1).jfif) Attracted by the pleasant aroma of freshly brewed coffee, I headed to a cozy cafe located right next to the canal. Its white umbrellas swayed gently over the outdoor tables, creating a relaxed atmosphere. As I sipped the aromatic drink, I watched the locals enjoying the peacefulness of the day. ![Мu (7).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbmUGkds3eXQ6eBJQhsgoZvfWm1GL4E18KCgwFhaYMxd9/%D0%9Cu%20(7).jfif) Next to the establishment stood an ancient clock tower whose rich history could be traced back through the centuries. The imposing structure stood as a testament to the enduring nature of the island and its people. As I gazed at the tower, I felt a sense of awe at the resilience and perseverance the people of Murano must have possessed to keep their culture alive over the years. ![Мu (6).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhSRucENraYy1zUxoCgZC1xfk3ftA37DrbBGBM6h7Bxn/%D0%9Cu%20(6).jfif) Continuing my walk, I came upon a beautiful sight. A magnificent tree, showered with lush pink flowers. Its branches stretched over the cobblestone streets, creating a beautiful canopy of color. I stopped to enjoy the moment and the aroma and take a picture. ![Мu (5).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVo2sxQMkgwUEMGqT39MinECCMNQbhd74z8P54gHXRgur/%D0%9Cu%20(5).jfif) As I ventured deeper into the maze of narrow streets, I was struck by the elegance of the old houses that surrounded me. Their painted facades were decorated with exquisite details, their balconies were filled with colorful pots of flowers. It was as if each building told its own story, testifying to the island's rich heritage. ![Мu (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWnFcA81314gNGhsWRoU4jvrsL6d5AoVbEXq4W19oR3eS/%D0%9Cu%20(4).jfif) I have finally reached the heart of Murano. Here, history intertwines with art as craftsmen continue a tradition of glassmaking that dates back centuries. One such piece of art caught my eye. Glass mosaic painting depicting two people blowing glass. This work was more than decoration. It was a symbol of the human ingenuity and passion that made Murano the center of the glass industry. ![Мu (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb3mvdpnn57xeHnediGmpXHPB4Wkq3CMndyRSdBH971SB/%D0%9Cu%20(3).jfif) As I made my way back to where I had started my walk, I realized that Murano is not just about picturesque scenery or historical landmarks. It was a living, breathing organism, pulsing with energy and creativity. And as I walked away, I felt energized and full of good emotions from this day and this place. ![Мu (2).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdfVHn4V4rBFzn8EwTTNkZA9o8eVUsdsLQARuPVZKM1M7/%D0%9Cu%20(2).jfif) [//]:# (!worldmappin 45.45610 lat 12.35258 long d3scr)

body.body: The AAVE TVL holding up despite the rsETH incident is worth noting — it suggests lenders are treating this as a contained event rather than a systemic risk to the protocol. One metric I'd be curious to see: what happened to the spread between AAVE's deposit rate and the risk-free rate immediately after the incident and then 48 hours later. If the spread normalized quickly, it means the market priced the risk and moved on. If it stayed elevated, there's lingering concern about LRT collateral quality that hasn't been resolved. The rsETH incident exposed a broader LRT risk that goes beyond AAVE.

body.body: The rank #682 number is jarring when you look at what other chains at similar market cap positions are actually delivering in terms of daily active users and transactions. Hive's on-chain activity per dollar of valuation is significantly higher than most L1s at that range. The gap between fundamentals and market perception is real. But I wonder how much of that discount is structural — Hive lacks the institutional access points (no major exchange listings in certain regions, no ETF narrative, limited coverage from mainstream data aggregators) versus just being undiscovered. If the fundamentals are solid but the capital simply cannot flow in, the discount persists regardless of merit.

by gecolocal on geco_channel 
View my bio on PeerTube: https://ptdev.selfand.com/c/geco_channel [![Can We Reverse Aging?](https://ptdev.selfand.com/lazy-static/previews/eefd55a8-a168-4882-9a65-427de42bad1d.jpg)](https://ptdev.selfand.com/w/8JNv4MWUihFW19B5Pfubo4) 
 
 The quest for a “cure” for aging — a way to remain youthful, even as we get older — is a project as old as humanity. It’s also a big business; products, therapies and treatments intended to moderate or reverse aging are part of a $2 trillion global wellness market that’s only getting bigger.

But there have been some recent breakthroughs in the science of longevity that could be pivotal for the field. These discoveries have to do with cellular rejuvenation, which is the idea that scientists could take a cell that has aged, and make it function like a younger version of itself.

On this episode of “The Sunday Daily,” the host Rachel Abrams talks with Susan Dominus, a staff writer at The New York Times Magazine, about this new research, the scientists behind it and who is funding this scientific quest for longer lives.

**On Today’s Episode:**

[**Susan Dominus**](https://www.nytimes.com/by/susan-dominus) is a staff writer at The New York Times Magazine.

body.title: Foodtrips: My Daughter and Niece Bonding Moments Filled with Milk Tea, Fries, and My Favorite Bread Ever
body.body:
![Retro Map Background Time to Travel Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48KbxdFrRVc4BMGYSk94XTEBxmqzxivF43VJrA2suCcNbCQqPUAEiMmNwLuqx24thG.jpg)

Hello everyone! One of my happiest moments as a mother is being able to go out and enjoy simple food trips with my daughter and niece. Life can become very busy and tiring, especially when you are already balancing responsibilities at home and work. That is why I truly treasure these simple bonding moments with them. Seeing their smiles and excitement instantly removes my stress. They are truly my happy pills. Their smile has a magic to relieve my stress. 

![IMG_20250918_094025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wCC4rfqnMr9pUm4YMGzoZudXfT7Ndekd6URmz5abazyvNkqkp2uH8GYqtEKRwCHNvmW.jpg)

We decided to go to the city for a little break. As a mom, I always feel happy whenever I can give my child simple experiences outside our usual routine. Before going to the park, we stopped first to buy snacks because the kids were already excited and hungry. Of course, they immediately asked for milk tea, their favorite treat whenever we go outside. Even if it is only once in a while, I love spoiling them with small things that make them genuinely happy.


![IMG_20250918_095959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23yd7nF65XYWdXfeiLwt6ZY4rUTPR6bUa72AK4GK8HzNmhWxjuXoYho3ZaV9UCevFbyrm.jpg)

We tried the trending Thai specialty milk tea with cream cheese that many people in our area have been talking about. The kids loved it because it was sweet and creamy. Meanwhile, I could not stop laughing because for me, it was already too sweet. Maybe this is really part of getting older as a mom. 


![IMG_20250918_100007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uFW3TH4aqgCVbHpdMWjmEoYEKJ52wFyfeWYjWN79KSyxLYFoafXvs7wTqTu2mmJNuoZ.jpg)


Before, I also loved super sweet drinks, but now my taste is becoming simpler.
I also ordered sushi, which is my sister’s favorite, while I chose the special ensaymada because I am still a batang 1990’s who loves bread and simple snacks. Of course, fries were also included because kids will never say no to fries. There were so many food choices around us, and honestly, we all enjoyed trying different foods together.

![IMG_20250918_095935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xKxmXCXd5btZ1mwmybtRuycd3dZs8dXoLBZr4mnuraST3m3awRRmdztGAm5rneabnRm.jpg)

![IMG_20250918_095819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsUkuPFy53BYiq4vN81RYy1Puei8Aq3qn2tSPtAMRowJYH8ixcCq3kMgrjrDTSgEhgf.jpg)

![IMG_20250918_100103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zbYa4qoVygxB4rPpmmq2TS3Y8yHcec4HcryQues9Rto6XzLyPr1tHQwfANiZcwLUXYG.jpg)

After eating, we went to the park and watched the kids happily play. As a mother, moments like these are very precious. Watching my daughter laugh freely while enjoying her childhood gives me a different kind of happiness that money cannot buy. Sometimes, mothers may feel tired from daily responsibilities, but simple bonding moments with our children remind us why we keep working hard every day.

![IMG_20250918_100110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wgQHbfk536eNXAPm2xjBReEcMejbG6rS7aiaC5FGjPRfwLXqboB98xbEMoDRa4ddG6g.jpg)



At the end of the day, we went home with full stomachs and happy hearts. I realized that motherhood is not always about grand vacations or expensive things. Sometimes, happiness can simply be found in a cup of milk tea, shared fries, laughter in the park, and precious time spent with the people we love most.

![IMG_20250918_100151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsNbHuGw7wXzJP9Y22bT1fCq7LTNbJKnjAe9w3ep6ovkgca7Fj67WyysfFABvL1ACvZ.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture and edited in Canva.

Time flies! Just completed the 273rd brawl with my awesome guild, which is none other than Pizza 2 The Deep Dish!

***

- *Moving Back To Bronze Fray*

Had 5 battles this time and it was not an easy round, especially when they have recently introduced 3 rulesets for each battle. Moreover, I have rented out most of my cards because I was playing lesser these days.

- We Got 4th!!!

So for the final result, we were 4th out of 9 guilds and got 300 Merits and around 11 SPS! Who knows how much one SPS would go to in this market?
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tkjvBAbwoBM2bmmnVQnfLFioCnxbYiiHzsc6kQPCuQEGBKdkeaxxkU2nPPs6rYwkSap.png)</center>



Individually, I had 5 fights this time and I won all 5 of them this time! Clean sweep! Finished 2nd within the guild. Due to change in format, wins are actually awarded to the players present in the fray if guilds decided to skip the fray. For this round, there were 3 additional wins for me.

***
**Battle 1 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Marisol Contuma*

Wow I managed to win a Quora Towershead! Chaos Dragon was the MVP all around, capitalising the Blast ruleset with its Scattershot ability. That meant a lot of Blast damage all around, and with Equaliser in play, it meant my team was quicker to take down the cards.

**MVP: Chaos Dragon**

***
**Battle 2 - WIN**


*Gladius Card Used: Relenor Cleaver*

How did I win this? This was so close to call. My opponent had such a strong team, with 2 Gladius cards and even Resurrection, along with so many hard hitters. Somehow my team stuck together and kept hitting and I think we won by a turn. Phew.

**MVP: Relenor Cleaver**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tRzxPKDXiYyUxSX6KrPC9deMvhR1kfPDRcEnRxDDnGumDNNUkRAVXzPDAcCMqjW2Cac.png)



***
**Battle 3 - WIN**

Opponent fled! Yay! Free win!

***
**Battle 4 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Larissa Kerato*

Wow this has got to be one of my best performances! Not only I had to fight against the summoner Eternal Tofu, my opponent's tank had 20 HP!?! What on earth is that? And then that tank was supported by 2 healers!? Till now I am still not sure how I did it, but I guess it all came together!

**MVP: Larissa Kerato**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t7DRaetroeMckJFm8WWvLwtgiVczBWCTuesJi5ndkbF2vPu45dQwXMYLNpfyo4XpX77.png)




***
**Battle 5 - WIN**


*Gladius Card Used: Sola Ranjell*

In a Poison ruleset, having an card with Immunity ability is very important and that's how Redwyrm Dragon won the battle for this one!

**MVP: Redwyrm Dragon**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGXrbdKZhzB33QisLS8M3nyRoqGQp8spUhrggdunkcwFhQ8d2akYskAXSfBzUE1JrGH.png)

body.title: Chinese rice grasshopper (Oxya chinensis)
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Oxya chinensis*** | May 14, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYR4fsEes8PazWBMfyXNAQinAPcovUJBUARgfgR9mW7Ei/mix_20260518_202829.jpg)

After taking the pictures, I uploaded them to the iNaturalist app and compared them. After looking at the app results, I learned a lot of new and unknown information about this wonderful insect, which I am sharing with you today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbq91PFdErhZ7ZSFkho42p6Zwqd3y71szVBBpPWDgDxvE/mix_20260518_202732.jpg)

Name and Family: The common English name of this bright green insect is the **Chinese rice grasshopper**. In zoology, its scientific name is ***Oxya chinensis***. It is originally a member of the Acrididae family and is a well-known species of the **Oxya** genus. The biggest characteristic of grasshoppers in this family is that the antennae on their heads are quite short compared to their bodies, so they are also called short-horned grasshoppers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaBkT8Q2R7GaWnECws32WsFyoCgpohm3tGc3XMkS1FqNk/mix_20260518_202550.jpg)

Native and Habitat: This species of grasshopper is native to various parts of our Asian continent. They are found in large numbers in Bangladesh, India, China and Southeast Asian countries.
They usually prefer to live in damp grassy fields, large weedy bushes and low-lying crop fields. Especially rice fields and the land around them near water bodies are the most ideal habitat for them, because there is ample food and hiding places.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNoYm9p4xFsTVaBHYQXekd6Hb9SM1HXjvENay5HWPmhng/mix_20260518_202441.jpg)

​Food and Reproduction: Their diet is completely vegetarian or herbivorous in nature. They mainly eat young green grass, soft rice leaves and the tops of various small wild trees. They are quite voracious insects and can be seen chewing leaves most of the day.
In terms of reproduction, female grasshoppers usually make small holes in damp soft soil or near mud and lay eggs. They choose a place to lay their eggs that is safe and has the right humidity. After a few days, the eggs hatch into nymphs or wingless young. These young gradually reach their full size by changing their shells several times and once they grow wings, they start flying.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjw8qyQcZjPcKY3WkKgy9C6HsWrVaoRPGrX6ZbvPhweF/mix_20260518_202302.jpg)

​Beneficial and harmful aspects: Although this insect is somewhat harmful to agricultural land, it plays a very important role in maintaining the balance of our nature's vast food chain or ecosystem.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYasMPbqBdEHVddTvFbwEqr7TgdzYb2SC4a2Sea7QTwYo/mix_20260518_202502.jpg)

​Benefits: When these grasshoppers jump around in the fields, they serve as the main food for predators such as various species of wild birds, frogs, lizards and large spiders. Many beneficial animals in nature survive by eating them, due to which the biodiversity and balance of our natural environment is maintained beautifully.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQCasZHJarMbLx1zjD1v5ENzRgGYW1kJR4ovLkKucAJUv/mix_20260518_202521.jpg)

Harm: They often cause big problems for farmers, because they attack rice fields in groups and eat the young leaves of rice in such a way that the crop is severely damaged. Due to their attack, the normal growth of seedlings often stops and the yield decreases alarmingly, so they are considered as harmful insects or 'pests' in agricultural science.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVkD8tNZbXNAqicCDCSUGkjyssBpmETLgXmyEzuePPUst/mix_20260518_202904.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXt8BFhCVwTdZaVZHqVxkTZckBUECC1Pa6ZPNomzbeJpL/mix_20260518_202937.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCBkeUfPpHx8kqNra9p5KMuddjLjJ6gKCu1VimSpFyjA/mix_20260518_202612.jpg)

​All in all, this small member of nature is not only a cause for concern for crops, but also essential for the environment. Do you see such green grasshoppers with black spots on both sides in the fields and ghats of your area? You can tell us in the comments.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

body.title: Anger Should Explain, Not Excuse
body.body:
>
![B1932543-CB57-46F8-9E01-4EAC441286CD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/242ryFLzLRygtrzi7nLBbJT9dDKL1b4ESmFbDqeyFGPQ45JZ8YHKBA3ps27QppfFvCEW4.png)
Anger is normal but when it’s uncontrolled, it becomes dangerous. When one exhibits a hot temper, it affects a lot of things: relationships, trust, homes and even can lead to taking someone’s life if care isn’t taken. An angry person is likened to a city whose walls are broken and prone to dangerous outcomes. I have had this issue for years until I started helping myself to curb it before it gets too late. Then, I used to justify my anger with the excuse, “That’s just how I am.” It even affected many areas of my life until I made the decision to change. Having a hot temper shouldn’t become a license to hurt people. Some people naturally react quickly due to how they were brought up in their homes, so they see nothing wrong in being angry, up to the point of causing violence around them. There are some whose hot temper is triggered by stress, trauma or personality. For some, when they are angry, they shout, insult, become violent and intimidate others, which leads to emotional damage and eventually breaks relationships. But here is the thing: being emotional doesn’t automatically make someone evil, but when the anger becomes a repeated cycle, it becomes hard to deal with. However, with all of these, I would say everyone is responsible for learning how to manage their emotions. Just like I said above, I had to discipline myself with prayers and take intentional steps towards dealing with it. Many people regret what they say when they are angry, but at that point, the deed has been done and cannot be undone. **Should a hot temper be an excuse?** No, anger should explain behaviour, not excuse it. For example, “I was angry,” does not take away the emotional abuse that had been done. Also, a person cannot continue to hurt others when they are angry and expect to be forgiven every time without working on themselves to avoid such cases next time. There are ways people with a hot temper can be accountable for their emotions towards others: They can apologise quickly or when the tense situation has subsided. They can seek help from a trusted person or psychologist, learn to control themselves when they are being triggered and most of all, work on changing harmful habits. **How then should society address the issue of hot temper?** Society should teach emotional intelligence early in schools and homes. Children are best taught this when they are still very young rather than when they are grown up and cannot be changed easily. Parents should model healthy communication. It is what children see their parents doing that they do. They learn faster by observation — from things around them, especially things done by their parents. So, when this happens, they believe or assume it’s the right thing to do. Society should stop glorifying aggression. We live in a world where people immediately defend those who exhibit a hot temper without cautioning their attitudes. But when society is keen on addressing such issues in the right way, things become peaceful. Therapy, counselling, anger management and honest conversations should be encouraged to make people want to go for them. Lastly, the role of religious bodies, schools and communities should not be ignored, as they also have a responsibility to teach morals like patience and self-control. A society thrives and becomes healthier when people learn to respond instead of react. Everyone gets angry, but the place of maturity is when they are shown how to handle it, rather than glorifying it and making it look like it’s the right thing to do. When people can control themselves, they protect their relationships and do not destroy them. A hot temper should never in any way become an excuse for hurting people.
> *Image generated by ChatGPT*
![1000414885.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/AK2C7dr7CG9amqSNarRKhrFGqPF8Ybcwt5PM5t352JKw1xMTByAzPkuAARjrqQw.png)

>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy start to the week to everyone, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography. I hope you’re all doing great and had a wonderful weekend. Today I’m sharing a selection of photos I took on the streets; I hope you enjoy them as much as I do.

Feliz inicio de semana para todos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro, espero que se encuentren genial y hayan tenido un estupendo fin de semana. Hoy les comparto una variedad de fotografías que hice en las calles, espero que las disfruten tanto como yo.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbKBJMojka63CY6LiLBcdCRFpKDwdqDi9F3Sr7oPhTYZPMv5mqzqyDdGMHX9YsKEAky.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tkpMDtA7BGU81DZwGtLhiKDWVVvf6nSZhuABb3gUsAG9NgUV3DQ5yPgofDiwqZacGts.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbiDzCQUeA87Ci2413GDnriHyvHhW3JmbXYWNRGcVGXsJZNDDzF1LJQPekUx8Yzn6eQ.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wByQBPxmrxPQz5jwmabgSDiKoetAnM56HXZZ58QR3p9bi1zsCkqQHMatGJVW3rpnket.jpg

>

Most of the time when I take street photos, I try to focus heavily on people, and while I do share some photos in that style, this time I’m also sharing some photos I took of store signs with their names on them, as well as some photos of the streets at sunset.

En la gran mayoría de ocasiones que hago fotografías callejeras, intento centrarme mucho en las personas y si bien comparto algunas fotografías de ese estilo, en esta oportunidad también comparto algunas fotografías que hice de alguna publicidad de locales con sus nombres y también algunas fotografías de las calles en el atardecer.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tSL9raEi55NdzEWJQRQSvJggGJkcGf8Av3bqBpi9jfp2AkXCWpo5ki7P27chhuEYyUC.jpg

>

Taking photos at sunset can be a bit tricky because of the low light, but I took these while I was waiting for my girlfriend. It helped pass the time, and even though they were spontaneous shots, I ended up really liking them. I’d like to take more street photos like this in the future.

Las fotografías al atardecer suelen ser un poco complicadas por la falta de luz, pero estas las hice mientras esperaba por mi novia, de esta manera maté un poco el tiempo y aún siendo unas fotografías espontaneas, me terminaron gustando bastante, quisiera volver a hacer más fotografías en la calle de este estilo.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/243WMN4UPRzEAcGVPoherPXeQiTo2Ag4uXWbW8ADr5YenQTLA18QN1UVBNkb7QGTqGUt2.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQvQj2jY4jEhSWSFzY2smciyQNfbyrj9Y1hANGPjtPaEtySyHXkbKyoBLqr56QP37gs.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23zkhuBkfm3s97NmY8tabfvjgTTDvxrtMBnmdJfee41bGtWitm2NsdFfethhbr6m4r2ky.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/244KMCzT1VuzFjmJD1ApJUUEWbMQCBYazCLTcZGZaEmTz8GjVjDqecxiHDQiKbaHEGqYB.jpg

>

That's all for today. Thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos, I really appreciate it. I hope you all have a wonderful Monday. See you next time, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy, muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías, lo aprecio bastante. Deseo que todos tengan un estupendo lunes. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro!

body.title: HOT TEMPER CAN BE DESTRUCTIVE
body.body:
/>

\### picture is mine

God created every human being with a particular temperament even though one could on himself or herself to improve it and make it better. One of the temper I dislike is the hot temper. Hot temper can be so destructive if it's not properly managed. I was thinking what's the difference between hot temper and anger? If you are reading this and could help me that would be fine in the comment section.

Anger is natural emotion that everyone has but when it's not controlled it can cause a serious damage to relationships, ruin even opportunities which could even lead to death. I know and I have heard of several people that became of anger did some terrible things. I had a cousin that almost burned my uncle's house because he was angry. Thank God some neighbors were around and came to intervene over the situation.when we truly consider the emotional, physical, and social damage uncontrolled anger causes, we must ask ourselves whether such behavior should continue to be tolerated or excused.

Most people that are hot temper hurt others deeply through their actions, words and other aspects. Anyone who can't manage his or her anger may threaten, abuse or humiliate others whenever they are angry. Some families today suffer simply because of their inability to control temper. In the society today, many marriages break apart due to hot temper. Some children raised in such environments develop anxiety, low self-esteem, or even become aggressive themselves because anger becomes normalized to them.

In organizations, other workplaces hot temper can be toxic and even create toxic environments. There are cases where people lose job and other important relationships because of uncontrolled temper. Many things that took years to be build or constructed could be destroyed by just anger. With all the damages that this attitude causes should it be used as an excuse? Or something need to be done?

We have varied experiences and our emotions too differs hot temper should not become an excuse for harmful behavior. Understanding a person’s background or emotional pain can help explain their behavior, but explanation is not the same as justification. Society must learn to show compassion without removing accountability. If someone constantly hurts others because of anger yet refuses to seek help or change, then the issue goes beyond personality — it becomes a responsibility problem.

I think people with this kind of challenge shouldn't be left alone instead counseling and mental health support should also be encouraged rather than stigmatized. Many people suffer silently with emotional struggles that later explode through anger. Therapy, mentorship, and support groups can help individuals understand the root causes of their temper and develop healthier coping mechanisms. Seeking help should be seen as strength, not weakness.

As I conclude, hot temper is not something society should casually excuse because its effects can be devastating. While anger is a normal human emotion, uncontrolled anger becomes destructive to individuals, families, and communities. Society must balance compassion with accountability by helping people address the roots of their anger while refusing to normalize harmful behavior. Emotional education, counseling, good parenting we can raise people who can apply wisdom to solve conflict instead of anger.

Thanks

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

links.body: South Africa extending the comment period on crypto capital flow management is interesting in a global context. Most jurisdictions are moving toward classification frameworks (MiCA, CLARITY Act), but direct capital flow controls are a different approach entirely — more about macro FX policy than investor protection. One angle I haven't seen discussed: if South Africa designates crypto as a cross-border capital movement rather than a commodity or security, it creates a third regulatory bucket that could influence how other emerging markets treat the asset class. Would that fragment compliance further, or force a more harmonized global standard?

Julley Everyone,

Starting this beautiful day out here today in the Himalayas as the journey, it begins something just like this somewhere near about 8 AM when we thought about going for a drive around the place and all that we thought in our mind, it was about this particular moment that I saw that there was the trail that just went all the way to the top of the mountain nearby, and I thought why not to just go and wonder around the place and capture the beautiful moments around this particular location, so I started my journey all the way and started capturing these beautiful moments so that I could share it with you guys through this post.

![IMG_0407.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRTfAZgKFQyvd76GsahDng4H6qqMdQHA2TPMEN5uPdMTF/IMG_0407.jpeg)
It was somewhere near about 1 PM later in the afternoon. When we reached at this particular place, we had all the way from Kullu to this particular place and all the way we even stopped at certain point, and this was the end point that we had planned for today over here at this place. Currently, we were at an altitude of near about more than 2000 m above the sea level and still going on, it literally felt so beautiful and so peaceful standing over here, somewhere at the top of the mountain rather than we have to climb the mountain by ourselves doing hiking, but we were now driving all the way through the Crisscross zigzag Road, all the way to the top of this particular location, and everything looks so fantastic and so amazing.

![IMG_0408.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTfJGgji6ephss7iEarrgNkn1fhgDDvrSRrX2DFrdPPZz/IMG_0408.jpeg)
It literally felt that we were driving somewhere in the sky as on the other side of the place. There was this mountain that we saw, and on the other side, it was the endless sky. Indeed, we literally felt that we were driving all the way up and up as literally that was the type of feeling that we were getting since we started a journey from a plane location and then went all the way to the top of this mountain and literally my friends the road it was so crazy and so full of adventure

![IMG_0409.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkH6ognqteg15gxWS1sS1uaNobwFS3h5VgUEsYEYaBW5/IMG_0409.jpeg)
The road was a bit narrow, hardly just a single vehicle could pass, but there were few points if we had to give pass to another vehicle, we had several options, but moreover my friends it was just a trail a single trail that was just for a vehicle and my friends, such locations. They were very few overhead at the place as literally my friend just think about going to top of the mountain and that two from this narrow Trail was something that was that we choose all the way around this particular location and literally enjoying the whole view. It felt so dreamy around the place.

![IMG_0410.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdDM3MZ7XVFn83g3amyT4rH1fnqe65knumbAKzeh1GYwx/IMG_0410.jpeg)
<center>*The clouds forming up.*</center>

![IMG_0411.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9rhQd7cLD2v2gJjjgAdUVMpBE9TyyCqFyJusYjnsUXa/IMG_0411.jpeg)
<center>*The trail.*</center>

![IMG_0413.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTKBaVgXSAyJDqGYhfTsonzPuXYKuqgYkQV3z4Q1sXk9i/IMG_0413.jpeg)
*Once we reached  at this particular portion of the mountain we saw that there was this valley, and then it was the view of the other side of the place. The place was full green with these tall trees and the beautiful views around the place.*

![IMG_0414.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWHixrGDMVfTPR436esce2HY9gw3F9FJPuLGvsoMZwfX/IMG_0414.jpeg)
>We wondered around the place for quite a while captured these photographs and now sharing it with you guys through this post. I have captured all of these photographs using my Apple iPhone 12 mobile phone and editing them using iPhone photo editor. Do let me know my friends the photographs of the part of my adventure that you like the most in the comment section, and I would love to hear it from you.

links.title: Zucked
links.body:
Big Tech is obviously evil
We are all Zucking ourselves
And the race to digital sobriety
Becomes an endless race
My mind speaks in agony
Because it is limited throughout
And there is nothing we can do
Without a rebellion to take it back

The internal solace I have entered
Is not the type of solace I wanted
And the overall feeling of cabin fever
It still stings and urges me to go out
I always focus on the past and future
No focus on the present moment
Trying to be grateful to get stuff
Rather than to enjoy what I already have

It's either buy this or die refusing
The fears of overspending seep in
And the habits of spending do seep in
Thanks to being online all the time

I just want access to my favorite media
No need to buy physical copies of it all
But at the same time I want there to be
Some way to compensate the artist
You can declutter and still compensate
But be wary of those Big Tech sharks
As they will take every last penny
And leave no one with their worth

links.title: Renuncié a mi trabajo, de vuelta en casa de mi padre [SPA/ENG]
links.body: > **ESPAÑOL** Hace poco por conflictos familiares entre en un colapso de inmovilidad, no hablaba, no gesticulaba y me la pasaba en automático. El estrés fue tanto que no quise causar más daño del necesario, tomé una decisión casi en silencio, irme; de vivir en la ciudad con mi abuela, abandonar a mi sobrino perruno y volver a casa de mi padre con la cabeza baja. El trabajo en el que estaba me tenia cansada, la paga era baja, el trabajo exhausto, hacia más de lo necesario y en otras labores que no eran las mías, con un horario donde pasaba el día entero en la oficina y solo iba a casa a dormir. Pero era mejor ir al trabajo que estar en casa con conflictos del día a día e incomodidades. Mi único día libre era limpiar toda la mañana hasta la tarde casi noche, donde podía reunirme con mi pareja y aun estando en su compañía seguía cansada y queriendo dormir. Pasé mucho tiempo en eso, que hasta evitaba verme en el espejo porque sabia que mi aspecto no era el mejor. La situación se volvió seria en casa, los conflictos con mi abuela materna se volvieron constantes y mi familia no hacia nada, esperé lo suficiente por mi pago del mes y así volver con algo de dinero para no depender tan rápido de mi papá. Igual ahora dependo de él, y aunque me pesa un poco no tengo de otra hasta conseguir otro trabajo y volver a la ciudad.

> **ENGLISH** Recently, due to family conflicts, I fell into a state of paralysis—I didn’t speak, I didn’t gesture, and I just went through the motions. The stress was so overwhelming that I didn’t want to cause any more harm than necessary, so I made a decision almost in silence: to leave—to leave my life in the city with my grandmother, abandon my dog-like nephew, and return to my father’s house with my head bowed. The job I had was exhausting me; the pay was low, the work was draining, I was doing more than necessary and taking on tasks that weren’t mine, with a schedule where I spent the entire day at the office and only went home to sleep. But it was better to go to work than to be at home dealing with daily conflicts and discomfort. My only day off was spent cleaning from morning until late afternoon, when I could finally meet up with my partner—and even in his company, I was still exhausted and just wanted to sleep. I spent so much time like that that I even avoided looking in the mirror because I knew I didn’t look my best. The situation at home got serious; the conflicts with my maternal grandmother became constant, and my family didn’t do anything about it. I waited long enough to get my monthly paycheck so I could come back with some money and not have to rely on my dad so quickly. I still depend on him now, and even though it bothers me a little, I have no other choice until I find another job and move back to the city --- ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23xejg6Qrm8AZtUGfpamzgpJT6jG1aVkd43grFPRhQqVYmpo6WwpJJhYGKYp7hxVPp1n9.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23tvgfBoLWPiZqAKfgLP6CFxjtv3BNTGFLUpDMgy1qo83y7HHWbTen2FCpwZqxZEfyi4s.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23y8uf9f8AGutKsCXZnMZgg8uzdxP7McxZaEH5To5JxUzuYETLfyxbHnwEXEMpGa5oXfE.jpg)
![Divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/48FDvGhme6ZfCsCs15pruz9iTPxNLHix8kdTySMyVEDco5tqZgVFdcTwjUPsoCnTyN.png)

> En mi familia materna, yo quedé como la mala, como si la conflictiva siempre había sido yo, y sé que hablan de eso hasta el día de hoy. Renuncié un viernes y el sábado por la noche ya estaba en el pueblo, en casa de mi padre, pensando si lo que hice era lo correcto o no. Hoy día la calma y recuperar el sueño me dicen que todo estará bien. En mi antiguo trabajo quedé bien con mis compañeros, aunque mi jefa quedó algo negativa y me sigue escribiendo para pedirme favores, que ya dejé de hacerle, pues, no me ha pagado la liquidación y esos “favores” me quitan tiempo y en ningún momento se habla de dinero, pero igual me sigue escribiendo o le pide a la gerente que me escriba, a veces pienso que esa gente no siente vergüenza. Volver a Punta de Mata, al pueblo, me ha afectado enormemente, pero sigo durmiendo bien, despertando temprano y de buen humor, cosa que en Maturín era sorprendente para mi familia el humor tan caótico que siempre tenía. Agradezco todo lo que hice en la ciudad, el ambiente laboral era agradable, lo malo era el horario y la paga, ellos me enseñaron mucho y se los hice saber, se notaba el ambiente algo triste, pero debía irme. Aquí he hecho muy poco, me he dedicado a descansar, pero ya es momento de activarme con mis estudios y mis prácticas, mejorar mis habilidades para comenzar a trabajar en un mejor lugar. El proceso ha sido lento y algo tedioso para mí, pero creo que lograré crear algo, no sé qué, pero lo haré.

> In my mother’s family, I ended up being the bad guy, as if I’d always been the one causing trouble, and I know they still talk about it to this day. I quit on a Friday, and by Saturday night I was already back in town, at my father’s house, wondering if what I’d done was the right thing or not. Now, with some peace of mind and a good night’s sleep, I know everything will be okay. At my old job, I left on good terms with my coworkers, although my boss was a bit negative and still texts me asking for favors—which I’ve stopped doing, since she hasn’t paid me my severance, and those “favors” take up my time. She never mentions money, but she still texts me or asks the manager to text me. Sometimes I think those people have no shame. Returning to Punta de Mata, to the town, has affected me greatly, but I still sleep well, wake up early, and am in a good mood—something that, in Maturín, surprised my family because of the chaotic mood I was always in. I’m grateful for everything I did in the city; the work environment was pleasant—the downside was the schedule and the pay. They taught me a lot, and I let them know that. The atmosphere felt a bit sad, but I had to leave. Here I’ve done very little; I’ve focused on resting, but now it’s time to get back on track with my studies and internships, to improve my skills so I can start working at a better place. The process has been slow and a bit tedious for me, but I think I’ll manage to create something—I don’t know what, but I will. --- ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23xefWeJcKb94Ecfpuzdy2zZ6Uk1phdyaYyTRMjssE4kRhPFvrhtHCuKTBJY5B8LcEQhN.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23yJJY4h9bgGj7QeoyptE8LARAG1oZKuGiBuABeUPa2RVP6F1xgjGe6AyKNiW5dgtvLHG.jpg)
![Divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/48FDvGhme6ZfCsCs15pruz9iTPxNLHix8kdTySMyVEDco5tqZgVFdcTwjUPsoCnTyN.png)

> Por mi antiguo trabajo dejé Hive, intenté subir contenido cuando tenia tiempo, pero no logré crear el espacio para hacerlo como me gusta, ahora aprovechando mi tiempo libre y teniendo la mente despejada vuelvo a mi rincón de internet donde puedo compartir con ustedes mi vida y lo que me gusta. Realmente quiero hacer las cosas bien y contarles cosas bonitas, porque aquí puedo ser más transparente y sincera sobre lo que pienso y siento, verán más de mi con el paso de los días, sin más que decir gracias por leer. Saludos.

> I left Hive because of my old job; I tried to post content when I had time, but I couldn’t find the space to do it the way I like. Now that I’m making the most of my free time and have a clear head, I’m returning to my little corner of the internet where I can share my life and the things I love with you. I really want to do things right and share beautiful things with you, because here I can be more transparent and sincere about what I think and feel. You’ll see more of me as the days go by. Without further ado, thank you for reading. Best regards. --- ![photo_2026-05-18_11-16-32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23wWpwRbajVQXsbFUV9jfqpKWZK6qkZLyCu95K16EG8pJsHkkqQm4coFMnNzVaDhqmWug.jpg)
![Divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/48FDvGhme6ZfCsCs15pruz9iTPxNLHix8kdTySMyVEDco5tqZgVFdcTwjUPsoCnTyN.png)
![photo_2025-08-06_12-34-54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amatorrs/23wCEHwUXyvSadffmbBHFUa5uak3x13zmgxKBGTx1et92WRDnfegMGd4LhYbFcimawGL8.jpg)

links.title: Pokémon Legends Arceus: Night in the Village - Gaming Photography
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbuKUW2iHAMk5ZmnCyWCndEuZ8hsPHGMqBqP3z9FHaWvq/00_title.jpg)

Hello friends and lovers of capturing photographs in video games. I hope you had a week visiting many virtual worlds. The images I want to show today are a reflection of the unique atmosphere that is lived in the village at night in the times of Arceus. When darkness covers the houses and the paths the pokemons decide to come out and live this nocturnal life. Every corner is filled with mystery, every corner is filled with magic. The village is full of energy and life both in the day and in the night, but the truth is the night feels different, maybe because of the mantle of stars and the snowy peaks of the region. With my photos I wanted to transmit that, the beauty in the everyday moments of a primitive world that opens its way through a nature that at first was dangerous, but that by loving and protecting made civilization advance.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYhYRqx8MLCp5irFuwaUPjAZgjHovJfdKQALzvm1UeLWr/1.jpg)

We start with a friendly duel between Magmar and our starter in the dojo and under the starry sky, there is nothing like beginning the night with a battle to warm up the energy. While some sleep I decide to fight. Did someone bring an extinguisher? A night full of sparks tonight!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4jisxEyvMcUr6Wk9jEwakZy98wTnzj4t2CoJbrj2BEp/2.jpg)

The night market is full of life. Magmar seems to want to buy something, although everyone doubts if it is a good idea to leave him near the fire. The sellers watch with curiosity. Among pots and vegetables, the scene mixes humor and warmth under the starry sky.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf7J1oLRwycxcARXdAnF7jk2YmhjKFB8cYST4P39pooj2/3.jpg)

The night remains calm in the village and Dustox floats curiously in front of the trainers. It seems to inspect the market as if searching for something sweet. One of the villagers watches it cautiously, maybe fearing it will mistake the lamps for flowers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVdcRWPrn2tgpjjFD14rAiHtpdAoJSqfUs3E2dJ1pdjz/4.jpg)

Under the starry sky the trainer stands in front of Rhyhorn in a moment of calm. It seems like a silent conversation between strength and serenity. Maybe Rhyhorn just wants to know if there are more rocks to eat. But he has spent the whole day in the field walking around.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb6uqk6hweMHSia7tWVeJYxGNEKLV7v9Ut5aooxRpZPwQ/5.jpg)

Under the starry sky the trainer shares a quiet moment with Gastrodon. Both seem to contemplate the landscape like old friends enjoying the silence. The Pokémon looks at the mountains with curiosity, maybe wondering if there is also sea over there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWoE3swBRnnmwirqCDdyBKKNyxRSAVh5Pea9npVfdwx1N/6.jpg)

The night brings unexpected encounters. Zubat floats among the villagers as if it wanted to join the humans’ conversations. There is a mix of humor and curiosity in the air, or maybe it is just the smell of Zubat.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEQfEw6jrhsCQKumeBhmDgjPzLeZsJU5cGZ2BuTRWgxv/7.jpg)

Geodude is always floating behind the trainer as if he were ready to show off his strength. The night is serene, but it seems that the Pokémon cannot stay still for even a second. Maybe he is looking for a more comfortable rock to rest on.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVj9jUWpVpYPwqTTa74YFFS6h2kUebY4WV6hztW1dQGa2/8.jpg)

The trainer watches a wind chime swaying gently under the starry sky. Its sound seems to blend with the night breeze, bringing peace to the village… wait, it is not a bell… it is a Pokémon.


|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSD6WNKQwTsQFqqJrMK25FyErhbRuhKuSztgP2gWozk75/9.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT41smAKuArecBfkYzsbcD8SVvsx5BE75LUVeHxcz8UYZ/10.jpg)|
|------------|------------|

Under the starry sky we talk with two Buizel who seem attentive and curious. Their tails move with the rhythm of the wind, as if waiting for a battle command or simply for us to tell them a story.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNkHmdiNUyBnsqh52kp3Pj4G8edBG7nSm8TJRqEJ5jE3C/11.jpg)

We stand before Snorlax, who seems to sleep while standing. The calm of the moment contrasts with his imposing size. Maybe he is just waiting for dawn to rest again.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWY1dnQhAHd3Kear7eCXAc3rXxbSVbxoTQ8YCzZac2pQW/12.jpg)

Among the flowers, we hide carefully while Roselia watches from the center of the garden. Its petals seem to shine under the starlight, blending with the wild blossoms. The night remains silent, as if nature itself were listening to the soft murmur of the wind. It is the Sweet Scent.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd6bQaFeXjYvrjubp2GwQrHMzemR8rJz54XqS9EdjqcMm/13.jpg)

We watch from below the imposing Mamoswine, who keeps guard from the top of the hill. His gaze seems to challenge the night wind while the stars illuminate his fur. There is respect in the silence: two different forces, one human and one ancestral, sharing the same night under the infinite sky. Both sharing the same universe.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbqdc74c1sA8Gij5MAnd8KFLqZrcb6N4gU4K5aKFMQ3V7/14.jpg)

Under the starry sky, the trainer stands between two giants: Snorlax and Mamoswine. Both seem to measure their strength in silence.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQVvpLc5ZnwtqVPQPG2zCAjRADmJbMZ2igWCh59ey4qk2/15.jpg)

Together with Luxray, I gaze at the sea in silence. The light on the water reflects the end of the day, and the wind carries with it the stories we’ve lived. It’s time to rest… until the next adventure.

links.title: AI & The current Tech Market
links.body:
![273976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/EoyNcbeW16QddJfsP4Fi4XGEusf2t3krPPNXcpjSU9zDqKU4okFEwgYxwxBEVLudMi8.jpg)







<Hr>

I was helping someone today crowdsource for a tech gig, and found some great gigs for fun, unfortunately I know it wasn't going to thrill him because he's been applying for months now and still hasn't gotten anything decent. 


He was doing a great tech gig in his final year of university but he couldn't match the stress of studying engineering with doing tech work and had to stop, unfortunately after graduating he couldn't go back to the job as others had filled the role and there was no vacancy. 


So while I was trying to look for jobs for him, I discovered that even though the job platform was relatively, new a lot of people had already registered and submitted application for these gigs. This platform shows the number of applications that people submitted and the number of roles were available. 


I saw a particular opening where about 20 people or so *(can't remember)* and over 2k people had already submitted applications, and believe me, with this particular role, I think the employers are going to be having a field day because since applicants are so much, they're either going to decrease their pay per hour, or are probably going to be strict with their employment methods since there are so many people. 



There were also other roles too that weren't as saturated, but my point tallies with the post I made yesterday; AI is successfully stealing jobs and we're not even scared enough. You might think \

? 

### I'll tell you. 


I know of people who applied for foreign jobs overseas, and got these jobs easily in 2022/23, but the truth is that even AI can do even better except providing human labor, in 2025, a lot of company's workload and workforce is done 80% by AI. 


Hell, a Claude AI monthly subscription is 31$, and most companies will prefer not paying $8k a month when they can get company Claude for 100$ a month and higher physical cheaper labour for 2k$ a month. 


Saving them over 5k$ a month. What this does is saturated the market since many people are already put of soft skill jobs, the remaining roles in the market becomes overly competitive. This excessive competition means that people can actually apply for a lot of roles without actually being chosen no matter how qualified they are. 


> Aren't you thrilled?

Some days ago, someone talked about using a 15$ Claude to recover a BTC wallet phrase that contained $400k, now imagine Claude being able to do that. This isn't me saying it's a bad development.



 People are currently looking at how comfortable AI makes life, how immaculate and how efficient AI handles automation, while people are built to be analogical or simplistic in how we process things, AI also compartmentalizes these things and gives us accuracy and efficiency, but then, no one is currently looking at the price we might need to pay for all these. 


Perhaps we won't all be alive to witness all these and perhaps this is why no one is looking at this, and even these AI model developers are not even drawling lines, perhaps in the future we'd get AI that can comfortably tell people if their suppose cheated or not, or things like body count but the reality is that while these sounds so appealing, the consequences are actually going to be unimaginable.


 This isn't just a work saturation thing. I just think we'd take AI training and model development too far, and someday and perhaps humanity might not be able to handle the consequences
