links.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Kwasa Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/dbcf727f-79af-4bc4-a37d-ce235e9520b7.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/kbW5Ra4MvigNvyc5jZZEdB) 
 
 La kwasa kwasa nació entre el polvo de las calles de Kinshasa y los ritmos que ya corrían por las venas del Congo, una evolución orgánica más que una invención repentina. No fue un compositor quien la dictó desde una partitura, sino bailarines y guitarristas que, a finales de los años ochenta y principios de los noventa, comenzaron a acelerar el soukous tradicional. La gente necesitaba moverse con más urgencia, con esa cadencia rápida que obligaba a la cadera a trabajar sola, aislada del resto del cuerpo, mientras los pies apenas tocaban el suelo. De ahí viene el nombre, una onomatopeya del movimiento, del roce de la ropa o quizás del sonido seco de los pasos sobre la tierra seca.

Los músicos de la época, cansados de las estructuras largas y pausadas del rumba congoleña clásica, empezaron a recortar los arreglos. Las guitarras, esas protagonistas absolutas, dejaron de llorar lentamente para convertirse en máquinas de percusión melódica, repetitivas, hipnóticas, entrelazándose con unos bajos que marcaban el pulso cardíaco de la fiesta. Ya no se trataba tanto de contar una historia larga, sino de crear un trance colectivo. En París, donde muchos artistas congoleños habían encontrado refugio y estudio, esta fusión tomó forma definitiva. Lejos de casa, la nostalgia se transformó en energía eléctrica, y la kwasa kwasa se convirtió en el sonido de la diáspora, pulido en estudios europeos pero con el alma intacta de los barrios populares de África Central.

Lo interesante es cómo este género ignoró las fronteras. Mientras en Europa se bailaba en clubes elegantes, en Nairobi, Dar es Salaam o Kampala, la juventud apropiaba ese ritmo y lo mezclaba con sus propias influencias locales. La kwasa kwasa dejó de ser propiedad exclusiva del Congo para convertirse en la banda sonora de toda una región de África Oriental y Central. Los teclados ganaron protagonismo, añadiendo capas brillantes y sintéticas que contrastaban con la madera cálida de las guitarras acústicas. Era música hecha para sudar, para olvidar las dificultades económicas y políticas de la época mediante la catarsis del baile.

Con el paso de los años, la pureza del estilo inicial se diluyó, absorbida por el afrobeat, el dancehall y luego por el afropop globalizado. Sin embargo, su ADN permanece visible en casi cualquier éxito contemporáneo que provenga de la región. Esa línea de bajo característica, ese patrón de guitarra que parece no terminar nunca, sigue siendo la columna vertebral invisible de mucha música africana moderna. No murió, simplemente se transformó, dejando una huella imborrable en la manera en que el continente entiende el groove y la celebración.

La resonancia de la kwasa kwasa trascendió el ámbito puramente sonoro para infiltrarse en la textura misma de la vida cultural, actuando como un catalizador estético que redefinió la narrativa visual y escrita de una generación. En la literatura, especialmente en las obras de autores congoleños y de la diáspora africana de los noventa, el ritmo se convirtió en una estructura narrativa. Las frases comenzaron a imitar la cadencia acelerada de las guitarras, con prosas fragmentadas y urgentes que reflejaban la velocidad de la vida urbana en Kinshasa o París. Los personajes ya no solo bailaban; sus conflictos internos se resolvían al compás de esa cadera que se mueve sola, simbolizando una liberación corporal frente a la opresión política o social. La palabra escrita intentaba capturar esa efervescencia, esa capacidad de encontrar alegría extrema en medio del caos, convirtiendo la pista de baile en un espacio sagrado de resistencia literaria.

El cine, por su parte, encontró en la kwasa kwasa una herramienta poderosa para definir atmósferas sin necesidad de diálogos excesivos. Directores africanos y europeos utilizaron la música no como simple fondo, sino como un personaje más que dictaba el montaje. Las escenas de fiesta dejaron de ser meros interludios decorativos para convertirse en momentos cruciales de trama, donde la cámara seguía el movimiento frenético de los cuerpos, adoptando un lenguaje visual vibrante y dinámico. La estética de los videoclips de la época, con sus colores saturados, la ropa brillante y la coreografía sincronizada, influyó directamente en la dirección de arte de películas que buscaban retratar la modernidad africana, alejándose de los estereotipos de miseria para mostrar una juventud sofisticada, consciente de su estilo y conectada globalmente.

Esta conexión con la imagen impulsó una revolución en la moda. La kwasa kwasa exigía vestimenta que resaltara el movimiento, especialmente de la cintura hacia abajo. Surgió una tendencia hacia tejidos ligeros, cortes asimétricos y accesorios que brillaban bajo las luces de neón. Los diseñadores locales empezaron a integrar elementos tradicionales con siluetas modernas y atrevidas, creando un estilo \

o kwasa que era tanto una declaración de identidad como una necesidad funcional para el baile. La moda se volvió performativa; no se trataba solo de vestir bien, sino de vestir para moverse, para destacar en la multitud mediante la elegancia kinética. Esta influencia se extendió a las pasarelas internacionales, donde la estética africana urbana comenzó a ganar terreno, desafiando las normas europeas estáticas con su fluidez y energía.\r\n\r\nMusicalmente, la huella es aún más profunda y visible. La kwasa kwasa actuó como puente hacia géneros posteriores como el ndombolo, que llevó la velocidad y la sensualidad a extremos aún mayores, pero también alimentó el crecimiento del afrobeat contemporáneo y el afropop global. Artistas que hoy llenan estadios en todo el mundo beben directamente de esa fuente rítmica; la estructura de llamada y respuesta, la preeminencia de la guitarra eléctrica como instrumento rítmico-percusivo y la obsesión por el \

bailable son herencias directas. Incluso en fusiones inesperadas con el jazz, el house o la electrónica, los productores buscan ese patrón hipnótico que caracteriza a la kwasa, demostrando que su legado no es una reliquia del pasado, sino un lenguaje vivo que sigue evolucionando, adaptándose y contaminando positivamente cualquier género con el que entra en contacto.

La kwasa kwasa se erige como un testimonio vibrante de la resiliencia cultural, demostrando cómo el arte puede florecer incluso en los contextos más adversos. No fue simplemente una moda pasajera, sino un mecanismo de supervivencia emocional para millones de personas que encontraron en ese ritmo acelerado una vía de escape y afirmación de su identidad. En una época marcada por inestabilidad política y crisis económicas en la región de los Grandes Lagos de África, la pista de baile se transformó en un territorio autónomo, un espacio donde las jerarquías sociales se disolvían y la única ley era el movimiento corporal. Esta capacidad de generar comunidad a través del sonido consolidó a la kwasa como un pilar fundamental en la construcción de la modernidad africana urbana, redefiniendo lo que significaba ser joven, moderno y africano en un mundo globalizado.

Su impacto trascendió las fronteras nacionales para convertirse en un símbolo de panafricanismo cultural antes de que el término se popularizara en los círculos académicos o políticos. Al unir a jóvenes de Congo, Kenia, Tanzania, Uganda y más tarde de la diáspora europea bajo un mismo código rítmico, la kwasa tejieron una red de solidaridad invisible pero poderosa. Los bailarines no necesitaban hablar el mismo idioma para entenderse; el lenguaje de la cadera y los pies era universal dentro de ese contexto. Esta unificación a través del cuerpo desafió las narrativas externas que a menudo retrataban al continente fragmentado por conflictos, mostrando invece una realidad de intercambio creativo fluido y constante. La música actuó como diplomacia informal, suavizando tensiones históricas y creando puentes donde la política había construido muros.

Además, la kwasa kwasa marcó un punto de inflexión en la autonomía económica de los artistas africanos. Demostró que era posible producir cultura de alto consumo masivo sin depender exclusivamente de las estructuras de la industria musical occidental tradicional. Los circuitos de cassette, las radios locales y los bailes populares crearon un ecosistema autosuficiente que permitió a los músicos mantener el control creativo sobre su obra. Este modelo de producción y distribución, basado en la proximidad con el público y la adaptación rápida a sus demandas, sentó las bases para la independencia artística que muchos creadores africanos defienden hoy en día. La kwasa enseñó que el valor cultural no se mide solo por la aprobación crítica internacional, sino por la adhesión visceral de la comunidad local.

Como hito, también representa la reivindicación del cuerpo negro como fuente de conocimiento y expresión estética sofisticada. Lejos de las miradas exotizantes o primitivistas, la kwasa presentó una técnica corporal compleja, disciplinada y altamente estilizada que requería años de práctica para dominar. Esta excelencia en el movimiento elevó el estatus social del bailarín, convirtiendo la danza en una forma de arte respetable y codiciada. La celebración de la sensualidad y la libertad corporal que promovía el género desafió tabúes conservadores y religiosos, abriendo espacios para una conversación más amplia sobre la sexualidad, el género y la expresión individual en sociedades tradicionales. Así, la kwasa kwasa no solo cambió la música, sino que alteró la conciencia colectiva, dejando una marca indeleble en la manera en que las generaciones posteriores entienden su propio poder creativo y su lugar en el mundo.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

Hola a todos los amigos de la comunidad de Hive. Es un verdadero placer saludarlos una semana más en este espacio dedicado al arte. , una composición del maestro José Mercedes Charmelo que resuena con el sentir de nuestra tierra y la nostalgia de los paisajes llaneros. In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

links.title: Whole grain pancakes with yogurt [ENG/ESP]
links.body:
> Happy and blessed day, my lovely friends and food lovers! What better way to start the day than with a good breakfast? And the perfect accompaniment for that, without a doubt, would be some delicious pancakes—tasty and, most importantly, healthy.
![post hive (60).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/24246X5vk88v2siSW1cu2DsrUuwuk6ieS71qYZoVbEwRXqGWv12iudaH9kvcdC7SsHrh3.png)
Today I’m sharing this recipe with you. It’s very similar to others I’ve shared, but there’s always a different ingredient. In this case, we’re using whole wheat flour and Greek yogurt—a healthy combination that will give our pancakes that fluffy texture. --- **The ingredients I used were as follows:** - 1 cup whole wheat flour - 1 egg - 1 tablespoon yogurt - olive oil - 1 teaspoon brown sugar - salt - 1/2 cup almond milk - 1 teaspoon baking powder --- ## Preparation: The preparation is very simple. The first thing I did was sift the flour, removing any large lumps.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAaB4nav9wN3R4rnUanN2HHCrsLzttEqor2vPtS5qynYyZPmbtZ3dJKguXTedB8yTh.png)
Now we're going to add the rest of the ingredients: yogurt, an egg, sugar, a pinch of salt, baking powder, and a splash of olive oil.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eoc71A4de3nMtwczW81kPZb5n25RZyT4nKJW4H1su2LGsM1gsycLnWoSDzkWNRi1YxG.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoK5NVHkjjzzJksd74FXWwT9dGq55oB3aQhSj3ur1MzCowDcYZnH2tT1fgkhaKXcDfF.png)
Let's blend everything together to make this mixture.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo6KVDm4f4p6ixMjbQrEjU8w8BnMvc8a1Q6BfTRDFBnWmocGRUAEAdWC538XJi2YpNB.png)
Place it in a preheated, greased skillet and cook for a few minutes on both sides.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoeDsmCcc6sSQP56iwMrMPdobPWSKCQx31qAecxDHtqxzvK1e59QfSrPdVfLfbfv1Kz.png)
And that’s how our delicious pancake turned out. With this batter, I made two—one small and this large one—both delicious and fluffy.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoeGuVMdcYdBWSr3F93nrgd6AsG4Gzdn1TzcDY6dcrtS1ZKbcKnRdkeiZcEVX3aGvDE.png)
What do you think? You can eat them with whatever you like, add a touch of honey—but not too much, haha—well, whatever you prefer. I hope you like them and feel inspired to make them. See you next time. ---
SPANISH VERSION

Feliz y bendecido día mi gente bonita, amantes del buen comer, que mejor forma de empezar el día, que con un buen desayuno, y las acompañantes perfectas para esto sin duda, serian una buenas panquecas, ricas, y lo mas importante, saludables.

![post hive (60).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/24246X5vk88v2siSW1cu2DsrUuwuk6ieS71qYZoVbEwRXqGWv12iudaH9kvcdC7SsHrh3.png)
Hoy les comparto esta receta, la cual si es muy parecida a otras que he compartido, pero siempre hay un ingrediente diferente, en este caso, tenemos la harina integral con el yogurt griego, una mezcla saludable, la cual le dará esa esponjosidad a nuestras panquecas. --- **Los ingredientes que use fueron los siguientes:** - 1 Taza de harina integral - 1 huevo - 1 cucharada de yogurt - aceite de oliva - 1 cucharadita de azúcar morena - sal - 1/2 vaso de leche de almendras - 1 cucharadita de polvo de hornear --- ## Preparation: Para la preparación, es muy simple, lo primero que hice fue cernir la harina, eliminando los grumos grandes.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAaB4nav9wN3R4rnUanN2HHCrsLzttEqor2vPtS5qynYyZPmbtZ3dJKguXTedB8yTh.png)
Ahora le vamos añadir los demás ingredientes, que seria el yogurt, junto con el huevo, el azúcar, una pizca de sal, polvo de hornear, un chorrito de aceite de oliva.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eoc71A4de3nMtwczW81kPZb5n25RZyT4nKJW4H1su2LGsM1gsycLnWoSDzkWNRi1YxG.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoK5NVHkjjzzJksd74FXWwT9dGq55oB3aQhSj3ur1MzCowDcYZnH2tT1fgkhaKXcDfF.png)
Vamos a batirlo todo, para obtener esta mezcla.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo6KVDm4f4p6ixMjbQrEjU8w8BnMvc8a1Q6BfTRDFBnWmocGRUAEAdWC538XJi2YpNB.png)
Lo llevamos al sarten previamente calentado y engrasado, dejamos cocinar por unos minutos, por ambos lados.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoeDsmCcc6sSQP56iwMrMPdobPWSKCQx31qAecxDHtqxzvK1e59QfSrPdVfLfbfv1Kz.png)
Y así nos quedara nuestra rica panqueca, con esta mezcla me salieron dos, una pequeña y esta grande, ricas y esponjosas.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoeGuVMdcYdBWSr3F93nrgd6AsG4Gzdn1TzcDY6dcrtS1ZKbcKnRdkeiZcEVX3aGvDE.png)
Que les parece, puede comerlas con lo que gusten, añadirle un toque de miel, pero no mucha jeje, bueno a su gusto. Espero les guste y se animen a prepararlas, hasta la próxima.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

这两天一直都是在游戏里面泡过日子。特别是昨天是周日。更是在浩方对战平台打游戏。
有朋友们一起玩，那心情就不一样了。不过我们打的有时候有输有赢。
大部分的时间都是在赢的。除非是遇到那些实力很强的选手。

不过今天晚上发生些不愉快的事。住在广州的一个队友他出了点交通事故。
他现在没有职业只是在送外卖。经常和交警在斗智斗勇。日子过的挺难的。
他玩游戏也是玩的挺好，我们也是挺喜欢他的的。这是一个年轻仔。

不过今天晚上他在群里面叨叨了很久的时候，我们倒是没有在意。
因为我们正在游戏之中。等到她叨唠完之后，我们才去看了聊天信息。
他发了很多图片，放在里面摔得全身都是伤。看起来应该非常的疼。

![Screenshot_2026-05-18-22-29-00-93_e39d2c7de19156b0683cd93e8735f348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23ynmMuSDhG9RLkwAjpJ6h5N6GVCb7m86A5AjdDPaT4CpUGZV6yKN5EGb9fuMtfXhTiBD.jpg)

看到他这么不容易，还在为生活这样拼命的奔波。拿命在挣钱。
结果好多朋友们都给他发了红包。都是资助他这一段时间可能没有收入。
也就是人多力量大，能帮一点是一点。所以也好多人发了红包。

![Screenshot_2026-05-18-22-28-36-44_e39d2c7de19156b0683cd93e8735f348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23wr9nUMB7A2ysS9NQQLbwe9eh4GM5JVdXaYdPv1KbpqeVPKpriaFPCqt9nvvxN6H1fTR.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-05-18-22-28-12-52_e39d2c7de19156b0683cd93e8735f348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23uFuCYSAPmSJz5WUi9TwPdB6TcYdU2TfWhvUYdwEByaNzWVBgmq2ZGX1pive31vRu6TE.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-05-18-22-27-07-60_e39d2c7de19156b0683cd93e8735f348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23wgmVKN4odNoNngx2npqMR7FCNevAHis98e51wZfT4GpWCoZ81UfhJ7tni5AAh8cqPGe.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-05-18-22-26-42-17_e39d2c7de19156b0683cd93e8735f348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aellly/23wMwobGD5A9NeqvjFiUeusBo8Kow274ST5R2oQYdhyt61hgfr9RxTKPPvpcQB76Xb3Ty.jpg)

之前我也接触过一些需要帮助过的人。都是生活比较困难的。
甚至是一些得了病之后，治疗费用比负担比较大。我也会多多少少支援一些。
只是按照我的能力，能资助的不多，也就是一点意思。量力而为。

然后我点开他们的红包，看看资助我多少。如果是支数太多的话，可能我没有那个钱。
还好是大部分的人，不是100就是好几十。所以我也是尽力的发了个红包。
大家都是玩了多年的游戏，都很熟悉。如果能帮的话，尽量就帮一下。

links.title: Splinterlands - Opening 4 gladius cases with blood stones
links.body:
![eg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wMRzaMVafkTNxKL77HrykbR5uFroDfg85UVdH5iTwXFPeYC5CnJN8eHgTZUNuAvzEdE.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening 4 gladius cases with blood stones so my chances of getting legendary gladiators will increase by 0.8%. Thanks to my guild's discount, I only spent 54 merits for each blood stone.

|||
|-|-|
|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23u5XNg4x2QsQctqPLJndMSnryTTN33eX6VeaXqDPfSkJTFppt9waCJGHRcngPY8iFbj7.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tki4FhUPWsnD2a1NXvoX7BnvNnjA9UZhAb7RAdWkMTNFXx8yUy9EEnTpxk9EwDVrv9w.png)|  

---

Unfortunately, I didn't get any legendary or gold gladiators, but I did get an epic one, Marisol Contuma, so it was not bad after all.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkmmoJHEBZ6SKzPn4WFWDtnPN1q3T4wrvxiRfX7qcPMd7feYovm5dtVVSfd8qVTunrw.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tbPFYd7HMiKo9RE7ipsdp6JvHz5x5NHnBvgCwuwx28SvEBwQxUMnA3tsQUcLUZe4ki8.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/mana-well?t=3b8e42ea8a46c8f13bf4469fdf0c44c6e83886d4&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my Marisol Contuma only needs three more copies to reach the level 5, where she will gain +1 melee attack power. And when she reaches the max level, she will learn the Trample ability, which allows her, when she defeats an enemy unit to perform another attack on the next enemy unit.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo44sKQ6XifCUTQu1a27aBrJbQwSaACBzQFGjCrZvtacjSn6Sma2GwnDU4UrkBzdiSR.png)

---

And, my rare Cutter Brieze only needs five more copies to reach the level 7, where he will gain +1 speed stat. And when he reaches the max level, he will gain +1 ranged attack power, so he will be able to be summoned when the Might Makes Right modifier is active, which only allows units of 3 or more attack power on the battlfield.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23swiJjU9gDLEEkFg78fGCBkfzM8uDo2htxtkAESgc3L3JeFcvK35Mgi4cGMUL1RiVqUR.png)

---

Currently, I only have one legendary gladiator at level 3. Three at level 2, and the rest are level 1. I hope I have better luck next time and find at least one legendary gladiator, and I wish you the same in your gladius cases; have fun playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uQfxS25syH6taiGNtfh9Tfx7JtodFauP1dr6s56zRr5J5bzrmCL5SybHojMuqvAzCKk.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

links.title: Dreams Beyond Borders
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX2HsrhRpvXjCTFy9ukpbbty4zQD5SEHh2jVmDvfjpgxM/img_0131.jpg)
If you ask anybody on earth, they will tell you they have a goal they want to accomplish in life. Everyone has an idea of what they intend to become in the future. The only difference is that these goals vary from one person to another. For some, it is to become great in life and make a positive impact on the world, while for others, it is simply to live life without really caring about what happens.

The truth is that many people are simply living life by default, doing whatever comes their way. As the adage says, “where the head leads, the body follows.” Some of us had the opportunity to be born in places where life is easier, like many countries in the Western world, where systems and structures are already in place for people to thrive and succeed. Others, however, are born in countries where the systems do not really favour them.

For example, imagine someone in this part of the world who dreams of becoming the best in ice hockey. It would be very difficult because such opportunities hardly exist here in Nigeria. Unless the person travels abroad, such a dream may remain unachievable due to geographical limitations and the environment they were born into.

It is easy to say you want to become something, but can we really become what has never existed before? Almost every area of human endeavour is already occupied, and most people can only strive to become great within an existing field or break records already set in that field.

Our location and background have a way of influencing our lives and shaping what we are likely to become in the future. Most social vices and negative behaviours people are exposed to are often a result of the communities and societies they find themselves in. It is difficult to become what does not exist around you. Unless something already exists as an example or possibility, it becomes harder to pursue it.

Yet, we can still leverage opportunities because the world has almost become one global community. Today, people can become whatever they want regardless of barriers or location. One can travel, study abroad, or seek opportunities elsewhere to follow the path they truly desire.

Our future is in our own hands, and no one will build it for us if we do not do it ourselves. We have to stay active, work hard, and set achievable goals. It is good to dream big, but we must also understand that circumstances and many other conditions may arise and influence both our lives and the way we see the world.

- Level it up: Take that basic doodle and turn it into something extraordinary. Let your artistic skills shine.
- Keep the heart of it: While you’re adding your flair, keep the essence of the original intact. Let it grow into something new while honoring where it started.
- Have fun with it: This challenge is all about exploring ideas, experimenting, and enjoying the process.
- There’s no wrong way to approach this. Whether you draw, paint, or just describe your vision, the goal is to express yourself. Share your work and show us how you see the world through your art.

We’re so excited to see what you come up with. Your creativity always inspires us! Let’s make some magic happen.

links.title: DIY- I braided my daughter's hair for the week.
links.body:
Hello everyone @diyhub community,it's been a long time,a stressful weekend,lots of responsibilities,
and life itself.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYJzcf4aqc7x2PxeMa1peit8UjoVZDpmU4G8prCZZbzh/1779041970719.jpg)

It's really difficult each time I try to balance my family and job responsibilities l, sometimes it's challenging and sometimes it's fun and interesting.
But in all,am always grateful for life.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRaATW8GCBRDaZe65bn3aPDrVfUnRS77xfq2SYXGTBakQ/1779041971305.jpg)

Today I want to share with you all the hair style I made for my daughter 
Her previous hair was rough and I needed to make something new for hair.
Trust me,time wasn't favourable because it was getting darker and I was already tired from all the chores I had done,so I thought of a unique style that will save time.

**First step**
After washing her hair,I had mistakenly left it unattended to,it was dry after some hours though I didn't have any dryer.
But the process made the hair stiffed and tangled 
I got my comb and I combed the hair to detangle each strands of hair.

links.title: 32 Bieg Fiata 🏃‍♂️🌧 / 🇬🇧 32 Fiat Race 🏃‍♂️🌧 : May 17 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/461744d1-1fa0-4c52-bf74-e8857e34d107.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/18943477-2583-4a7a-b2d1-80dea1ffd138.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3e1c2b07-510b-4c44-8dba-92f630677c08.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/243a92a2-f8e6-464f-8806-efd0e58b9b39.jpg)
🇵🇱 Jeszcze rano kawa, lekkie śniadanie i ostatnie sprawdzanie prognoz. Deszcz od rana nie odpuszczał, ale paradoksalnie takie warunki lubię coraz bardziej. Chłodno, mokro, ciężkie powietrze i ponad półtora tysiąca ludzi na starcie 32. Biegu Fiata w Bielsku-Białej. Dla wielu to był po prostu kolejny start, ale dla mnie ten bieg miał trochę inny klimat — lokalny. To moje tereny, ledwie kilkanaście kilometrów od domu, więc w tłumie co chwilę trafiało się na znajome twarze. Rozgrzewka odbyła się klasycznie — trochę truchtu dookoła parkingów, trochę przebieżek, kilka minut skupienia i ustawiania głowy pod plan. Tym razem celem nie było rzucenie się od początku na wynik za wszelką cenę. Priorytet był prosty: oddech, kadencja, kontrola i chłodna głowa. --- 🇬🇧 Morning coffee, a light breakfast and one last look at the weather forecast. The rain had been falling since early morning, but strangely enough I’m starting to enjoy these conditions more and more. Cold air, wet roads, heavy atmosphere and over fifteen hundred runners at the start of the 32nd Fiat Run in Bielsko-Biała. For many people it was just another race, but for me this one felt different — local. These are my home areas, barely fifteen kilometers from where I live, so everywhere in the crowd there were familiar faces. The warm-up was classic — easy jogging around the parking areas, a few strides, a few quiet minutes to focus and prepare mentally. This time the goal wasn’t to attack the result recklessly from the start. The priorities were simple: breathing, cadence, control and a calm head.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/23cd9677-2a30-4cc6-a122-dce3dae3b69f.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/345fa29a-f058-4188-90f2-914abcad3e45.jpg)
🇵🇱 Początek biegu pobiegliśmy z koleżanką Patrycją. Każde z nas biegło swoje, swoim rytmem i swoim wysiłkiem, ale jednocześnie cały czas mieliśmy świadomość swojej obecności gdzieś obok w tłumie ludzi. Umówiliśmy się wcześniej, że spróbuje trochę podholować się za mną i dokładnie tak to wyglądało. Nie ramię w ramię i nie but w but, tylko kilka metrów za sobą, w zasięgu wzroku. Około czwartego kilometra dogoniliśmy Henia i wtedy sytuacja się odwróciła — ja zacząłem holować się za nim, a Patrycja dalej trzymała się za mną. Taka mała biegowa współpraca bez słów. Dzięki temu przetrwaliśmy najtrudniejszy fragment trasy bardzo spokojnie i bez paniki. Wokół było widać ludzi, którzy przepalili początek i zaczynali mocno płacić za tempo z pierwszych kilometrów, a my po prostu cierpliwie robiliśmy swoje. --- 🇬🇧 I started the race together with Patrycja. Each of us was running our own pace and effort, but at the same time we were always aware of each other somewhere nearby in the crowd. Before the race we agreed that she would try to draft behind me a little, and that’s exactly how it worked. Not shoulder to shoulder and not step for step — just a few meters apart, always within sight. Around the fourth kilometer we caught up with Henio and the roles changed. I started following his rhythm while Patrycja stayed behind me. A small unspoken teamwork during the race. Thanks to that we survived the hardest section of the course calmly and without panic. Around us you could already see runners paying the price for going out too hard in the opening kilometers, while we simply stayed patient and focused on our own race.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/409d2591-0e44-4e4f-95eb-0c8748238d09.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/79a04bdd-c901-4278-bd75-0017af0b2f6c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/28a910d8-e136-49c1-bbf9-ac4e4457ab96.jpg)
🇵🇱 Najważniejsze było to, że przez większość biegu wszystko było pod kontrolą. Nie walczyłem z tempem z zegarka. Pilnowałem przede wszystkim rytmu biegu, oddechu i kadencji. Na podbiegach świadomie odpuszczałem chwilowe tempo, żeby nie zapłacić za to później. To był chyba pierwszy start od dawna, gdzie naprawdę czułem, że nie biegnę chaotycznie tylko świadomie zarządzam wysiłkiem. Kadencja trzymała się bardzo dobrze praktycznie przez cały dystans, noga pracowała równo mimo mokrej nawierzchni, a organizm długo zachowywał zapas. Nawet gdy tętno rosło, nie było nagłego odcięcia. Dopiero w okolicach siódmego–ósmego kilometra oddech zaczął robić się naprawdę ciężki. Wtedy wiedziałem już, że zbliża się moment przejścia z kontroli do walki. --- 🇬🇧 The most important thing was that almost the entire race felt under control. I wasn’t fighting the numbers on the watch. I focused mainly on rhythm, breathing and cadence. On the climbs I consciously let the pace drop a little so I wouldn’t pay for it later. It was probably the first race in a long time where I truly felt that I wasn’t running chaotically but actually managing my effort with awareness. My cadence stayed stable almost the entire distance, my legs worked smoothly despite the wet surface and my body kept a reserve for a long time. Even when the heart rate was rising, there was no sudden collapse. Only around kilometer seven or eight did the breathing become really difficult. That was the moment when I knew the race was moving from control into pure fighting mode.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/129a2e9a-705b-4985-8aae-d2fa0eef9fde.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/914abbc7-4fa4-4a35-95a5-7f7b8f0b0989.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/af87b7ef-7938-4153-93f4-cf265f3ee830.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd0d5ca8-38c7-4214-b19d-2dae798d1f5c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/53be13ee-fd4c-4f59-8aa9-6a297b25fee2.jpg)
🇵🇱 Plan był prosty — przetrwać spokojnie pierwszą część i odpalić po szóstym kilometrze. I dokładnie tak się stało. Ostatnie kilometry weszły już mocno na limit oddechowy, ale mięśniowo organizm dalej chciał biec szybciej. Końcówka 4:25 → 4:20 → 4:19 → 4:15 mówi chyba sama za siebie. Bez ściany, bez rozsypania techniki i bez dramatycznego spadku tempa. Na mecie 45:15 i nowy rekord życiowy na 5 km po drodze — 22:03. Niby nadal trochę brakuje do złamania 45 minut w Biegu Fiata, ale mam wrażenie, że ten bieg był ważniejszy niż sam wynik. To już nie była walka o przetrwanie od połowy dystansu. To było świadome ściganie i bardzo duży krok do przodu w projekcie SUB40. --- 🇬🇧 The plan was simple — stay patient through the first half and start pushing after kilometer six. And that’s exactly what happened. The final kilometers were already deep into breathing-limit territory, but muscularly my body still wanted to run faster. The finish split sequence of 4:25 → 4:20 → 4:19 → 4:15 speaks for itself. No wall, no breakdown in technique and no dramatic pace collapse. At the finish line: 45:15 and a new 5K personal best along the way — 22:03. I’m still slightly short of breaking 45 minutes in Fiat Race, but honestly this race felt more important than the raw time itself. It was no longer a fight for survival from halfway onward. It felt like conscious racing and a very meaningful step forward in the SUB40 project.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9c637c5a-8243-418e-b43b-14c4d31ce08e.jpg)
🇵🇱 Czasami progres nie wygląda jak spektakularny wynik. Czasami wygląda jak chłodna głowa w deszczu, cierpliwość wtedy, gdy wszyscy wokół szarpią tempo, i świadomość, że jeszcze masz z czego przyspieszyć na końcówce. Ten bieg właśnie taki był. --- 🇬🇧 Sometimes progress doesn’t look like a spectacular result. Sometimes it looks like staying calm in the rain, being patient while everyone around you is forcing the pace, and realizing you still have enough left to accelerate near the finish. That’s exactly what this race felt like.

_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ptaku/actifit-ptaku-20260518t144430367z)_

links.title: The Day Equalizer Changed Everything
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpAxgZCyztoYs8QKVbqQzCusi5dPgq9tTncczdF2uuQ7/thumbnail_battle_of_the_day.png)

Greetings, Splinterlands warriors. Sometimes victory doesn’t come because we bring the most expensive, rarest, or flashiest monsters—like a wedding car bumper polished to a shine. Sometimes it comes from something simple: reading the ruleset correctly. And in today’s Battle of the Day, I felt like the arena gave me a small lesson on how monsters usually considered “fragile” can turn into champions when the Equalizer ruleset steps in.

This battle used the Equalizer, Blood Moon, and Broken Arrows rulesets with a 73 mana cap. As soon as I saw Equalizer, I smiled a little—the kind of smile you get when your favorite food stall is still open late at night. Because Equalizer is where low-HP monsters regain their dignity.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZpvaLjQmnQsdyYWKi9wZAaQ5F4ZyZYZMdDCfynEfy9a/ambush_round.png)


I used Archon Nomos and brought a lineup that, at first glance, might look like a group of starving poets: Conjurer's Hubris as the front tank, followed by Withered Old Sage, Mindless Thrall, Chaos Evoker, Ballista Deadshot, and Emberguard.

Why this formation? Because Equalizer sets all monsters’ HP based on the highest HP on the field. That means monsters that usually crumble like crackers in soup suddenly become durable. And that’s where I saw a big opportunity to maximize brutal magic and ranged damage.

On the opponent’s side, it was no joke. Sheng Xiao showed up with Commander Slade, Wailsworn Specter, Nalara Geinek, Torrent Sniper, Songale, and Calamity—a lineup that looked like it was heading into a serious board meeting: composed, structured, and intimidating.

Once the round started, all monsters’ HP became 10, following Commander Slade. Suddenly, Conjurer's Hubris felt like a nobody who just inherited a royal fortune. Normally just passing through the arena, now it became a real tank.

I decided to reduce the magic damage of Calamity and Torrent Sniper since they posed the biggest threat to my backline. Nalara Geinek also reduced my team’s magic, so from the start, this fight felt like a heated argument between two Facebook commenters—each weakening the other.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZeYfXD2Ww13uK7Gwcnt92SgLqdo4B6wZCPx9bPbbxnxS/round_2.png)


Then the first clash happened.

Songale, with its taunt ability, absorbed all attacks. Chaos erupted. Magic attacks flew everywhere like sandals during a heated neighborhood meeting. Conjurer's Hubris fell in the first round—but that’s exactly when my secret weapon began to shine:

Ballista Deadshot.

This monster is like a parking attendant who used to be a boxer. Looks ordinary, but when it moves, it hits hard. Because its attacks are random, it ignores taunt. And with every shot, enemy monsters started falling apart.

When Songale finally went down, Blood Moon began to show its fangs. Bloodlust activated, but poison also started spreading through my team. The arena turned into something like a hospital waiting room during flu season—two of my monsters began coughing under the poison effect.

But this is where Equalizer proved its value again.



If my monsters had their normal low HP, round two would’ve been the end. But with boosted HP, they survived for a few extra rounds—and in Splinterlands, a few extra rounds can be more valuable than a long motivational speech.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqgFaqJkuR1W1YpJQW8H53S2EWj8UXEZSyEkJByiiRAa/round_3.png)

Round three fully belonged to Ballista Deadshot. It triggered Bloodlust again after taking down Torrent Sniper. Its damage grew even more savage. I even thought, “If this monster could talk, it’d probably be yelling for more opponents.”

Meanwhile, Emberguard also went wild. My team’s magic attacks started to feel like a rain of stones from the sky—not elegant, but effective.

Round four became a dramatic turning point. Mindless Thrall managed to eliminate Commander Slade. Bloodlust triggered again. Poison kept eating away at everyone. But at that point, it was 3 versus 2.

And honestly, that’s when I started to feel confident about the win.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXxejHi9B28HBm6SixypdUoxMzC8nE9dFaTgZ4CKuGAXE/round_6.png)


Nalara Geinek kept holding on. That monster was like an old utility pole—battered by storms but still standing. But the total magic damage from my team was just too much. One by one, the enemies fell, until victory was finally mine.

Full battle can be seen here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_5a12156394d20b5a2920b5b6463d4e11?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

What’s most interesting about this battle is how Equalizer changes the logic of the game. Monsters that are usually ignored suddenly become major threats. Conjurer's Hubris, typically fragile, can act as a temporary tank. Ballista Deadshot, with its low HP, gets enough time to stack Bloodlust. And my magic monsters can perform at full capacity before poison wipes them out.

I also learned that in rulesets like this, consistent damage matters far more than flashy defense. Because in the end, poison consumes everyone. So whoever eliminates the enemy faster is the one who survives.

For new players, understanding rulesets like Equalizer is extremely important. Many players focus too much on expensive cards, when sometimes victory comes from reading the situation correctly. A simple strategy can completely change how we see certain cards.

And in this battle, Ballista Deadshot truly proved that ranged monsters can become a nightmare if given enough time to live.

If I have one takeaway from this battle, it’s simple: don’t underestimate low-HP monsters. In Splinterlands, rulesets can feel like fate. Today they’re cheap, forgettable units—tomorrow, they might be the heroes of the arena.

And if Equalizer shows up again, I might just call on Ballista Deadshot once more. Some monsters, after all, are born for chaos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___

links.title: III: La arquitectura del refugio | 4 lunes de escritura 🏠🕯️
links.body: >¡Feliz lunes! Nos acercamos al corazón de mayo, casi como el ombligo del mes y del reto. Si es tu primera vez por aquí, te invito a recorrer nuestras estaciones anteriores:<a target=\
> I: Donde habitan las raíces y
>II: Tras el rastro del destello.

>A veces, el mundo exterior se vuelve demasiado ruidoso, o ese invitado no deseado del que escribí la semana pasada intenta ocupar demasiado espacio. Es ahí cuando la escritura deja de ser solo un ejercicio y se convierte en una arquitectura: el diseño de un refugio donde nada ni nadie puede dañarnos. Hoy no escribimos para el mundo, escribimos para construir las paredes de nuestro propio lugar seguro.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.

></center>

Nuestra palabra para guiar esta tercera semana es:

<h5 style=\

>Piensa: Si pudieras diseñar un espacio mental o físico donde ese enemigo silencioso no tuviera entrada, ¿cómo sería? No pienses en lo que debería ser, sino en lo que tu alma necesita hoy.

\n\n*

>¿Hay un diario esperándote sobre la mesa?

\n\n>

>Tu refugio no es un lugar al que vas; es un estado de gracia que construyes con cada palabra de amor que te dedicas.

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.

>La vulnerabilidad compartida es una forma de fortaleza. Me encantaría asomarme a los refugios que están construyendo:

\n\n*

>Escribe: Dedica 10 minutos a habitar ese lugar a través de tus palabras.

\n*

>Comparte: Una foto de tu rincón de escritura o una frase que te haya dado paz.

\n*

>Etiquétame: Como siempre, estaré del otro lado de la pantalla, acompañando sus procesos con todo mi cariño.

\n\n

>Llegué con las sombras de un espíritu que me perseguía, le cerré la puerta aún con miedo, el pecho me vibraba, como si mi corazón con cada palpitar se saldría y todo se acabaría. Respiré y afirmé que todo estaba bien, porque puse el candado más seguro que jamás podría existir y eso representaba la más grande certeza de aquel valiente acto. Tomé mi caja de seguridad, ahí estaban mis implementos de emergencia: audífonos para evadir mi realidad, un libro con una historia de aventura en donde los dragones eran derrotados con gallardía y una barrita deliciosa de chocolate, que aunque me daría calorías que debía quemar corriendo, escapando de mis problemas en vez de enfrentarlos, me salvaban por unas horas.

>No podría olvidar el más poderoso remedio para todo mal, el calmante instantáneo para remover la tristeza, el odio o el rencor guardado: el amor. Cualquier acto no podría ser más fácil, como un abrazo, capaz de activar las emociones más dulces y sensibles que cualquier alma necesitaba; o las palabras de afirmación, más sinceras que alentaban mi desilusión en medio de la oscuridad; o el obsequio inesperado, pero útil, que por tantos meses desee, y ahora estaba en mis manos, como una herramienta para crecer.

>Supongo que la suerte viene de muchas maneras, y todos en el mundo tienen algún problema, prueba o reto, pero yo, adquirí el poder de superarme y eso, por ahora, era lo único valioso.

\n\n

>Happy Monday! We’re approaching the heart of May, almost like the center of the month and of the challenge. If this is your first time here, I invite you to explore our previous installments: <a target=\
>I: Where the Roots Lie and
>II: In the Wake of the Flash].

>Sometimes, the outside world gets too noisy, or that unwelcome guest I wrote about last week tries to take up too much space. That’s when writing stops being just an exercise and becomes an architecture: the design of a refuge where nothing and no one can hurt us. Today we’re not writing for the world; we’re writing to build the walls of our own safe place.

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>Our guiding word for this third week is:

>Think: If you could design a mental or physical space where that silent enemy had no entry, what would it be like? Don’t think about what it should be, but about what your soul needs today.

\n\n*

>Does it smell like fresh coffee?

\n*

>Is there a journal waiting for you on the table?

\n\n>

>Your refuge isn't a place you go to; it's a state of grace that you build with every loving word you speak to yourself.

\n\n
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.

>Shared vulnerability is a form of strength. I’d love to peek into the safe spaces you’re creating:

\n\n*

>Write: Spend 10 minutes inhabiting that space through your words.

\n*

>Share: A photo of your writing nook or a phrase that has brought you peace.

\n*

>Tag me: As always, I’ll be on the other side of the screen, accompanying your journeys with all my love.

\n\n

>I arrived with the shadows of a spirit chasing me; I closed the door on it, still afraid, my chest pounding as if my heart would burst with every beat and everything would end. I took a breath and told myself everything was fine, because I’d locked the door with the most secure lock that could possibly exist, and that was the greatest assurance of that brave act. I took my safety box; there were my emergency supplies: headphones to escape my reality, a book with an adventure story where dragons were defeated with gallantry, and a delicious chocolate bar, which, although it would give me calories I’d have to burn off by running—escaping from my problems instead of facing them—saved me for a few hours.

>I could never forget the most powerful remedy for all ills, the instant balm to dispel sadness, hatred, or pent-up resentment: love. No act could be simpler—like a hug, capable of stirring the sweetest, most tender emotions any soul could need; or words of affirmation, so sincere they lifted my despair in the midst of darkness; or the unexpected yet useful gift I’d longed for so many months, now in my hands as a tool for growth.

>I suppose luck comes in many forms, and everyone in the world has some problem, trial, or challenge, but I gained the power to overcome myself, and that, for now, was the only thing of value.

\n\n

links.title: Crypto Cooking - Wild Game Skewers
links.body:
Game is game! Today I cooked a pheasant, venison and partridge dish in under a few minutes, and getting that balance right made all the difference. It’s all about the transformation.

I picked up a pack of diced game meats from the butchers... but had no real plan for them at first! It had seasoned venison, pheasant, and partridge... so a strong protein combo! 

After staring at it for a bit, I decided to keep it simple and go for wild game skewers. It just felt right! Something rustic, a bit bold, and perfect for mixing flavors.

I started by throwing the meat into a marinade overnight. Nothing too complicated, just elements that will enhance the game! Left it all to soak in properly and do its thing

Just fresh herbs straight from the garden, a blend of spices, plus few slices of orange to bring a bit of brightness and cut through the richness of the game.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBbdEmvx9LWYhF6Nrry4qARMw6eCGCPyrPzWgZCZqMRN/image.png)


One day you’re searing pheasant to get that crisp golden skin, the next you’re working with venison or partridge and trying to balance each's character and quirks.

It's hard! Ever notice how balancing flavors with game feels like walking a tightrope? Too much heat and it toughens up, too little and you miss that deep, rich flavor.

Next day, it was time to build the skewers! I went full Vlad Dracula mode, threading chunks of venison, pheasant, and partridge onto the skewers with zero hesitation.

I broke it up with vegetables in between, baby corn, chunks of onion, and peppers, so everything cooks evenly and you get that mix of flavors in every bite.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdMBNVXWMLtwsfdxUXiNyFZihbqGeXPsitXe6qGJxFJur/image.png)


While that was coming together, I got the potatoes going. Chopped them up, tossed them lightly in spices and a dusting of flour so they’d crisp up properly like on TV! 

Added rosemary for that deep earthy flavor and  straight into the oven to roast until golden and crunchy on the outside, but soft in the middle. Roast potatoes are an art! 

The skewers hit the grill next. Gave them about five minutes and was enough to get a solid sear on the outside while keeping the inside juicy. You could smell it straight away!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYGfEWNQhFgEjMSJmEEYCjAVr83KnkgaGivcaMhak4hEK/image.png)


Cooking and game meat share some surprisingly rich similarities… both demand the right ingredients, perfect timing, and just enough experimentation to keep things interesting.

My neighbors could smell that mix of char, herbs, and slightly sweet citrus from the marinade coming through. In a way was similar to flexing top airdrops on X! 

The story was not done yet! I served everything up with an extra side of baby corn and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce for a bit of contrast. I feel hungry even when I remember! 

The richness of the game, the crisp potatoes, the slight heat and sweetness! It all just came together in a way that felt way more thought-out than it actually was.

No long cooking time, no complicated technique! PVM needs just heat, timing, and a few good ingredients. Here's the poof that the simplest dishes hit the hardest.

Whether it’s the kitchen or crypto charts... it’s all about reading the moment, trusting your instincts, and knowing when to let things ride.  Don't forget... game is game!

links.title: Proposals, code blocks, Hive projects page and a sitemap revamp on PeakD
links.body: This was one of those PeakD release batches where work landed in a few different areas at once.\n\nSome of it is the kind of thing you notice immediately when opening a page, some of it is more in the category of \

😄

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23vhwMQN449L6baSbbHX6f4shchh7ETGiUrdpFGXoDK1jSaR3A8uNMV7nBkEwmh39HGpo.jpg)

### DHF Proposal details page got an usability upgrade

The proposal details page has been reworked quite a bit.

The layout is now cleaner and easier to read, with a better split between the proposal post and the governance details around it. Payment info, support level, creator/receiver details and vote-related actions are all presented in a more practical way instead of feeling like pieces bolted together over time.

Mobile got some attention too. On smaller screens the proposal view now behaves much better, with a tabbed split between the post content and the proposal details instead of trying to force everything into one awkward long layout.

Also we have better vote visibility around proposals now:

- a clearer **all votes** modal
- a separate **recent vote activity** modal
- fixed an old bug that could lead to some inconsistency in reported support level target

That makes the DHF section a lot more useful if you actually follow proposal activity instead of just occasionally clicking into it. 

Using Hive Keychain new proposal to showcase the new page layout as the rework on this page sparked from a bug report by @stoodkev 🙏

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/2424Aha81knvRP87V5eESMfVxjrzpXL4qwEAUh81STUdXL21g6Kc2hpfUUXSjqyeWDHcx.png)


### The old Services page is now a much better Tools page

The old Services page has been redesigned and renamed to **Tools**. Not sure how many users were aware of that old page, but @friendlymoose suggested to add \

section and I decided to revamp the old list.

The page is now much closer to what it should have been in the first place: a curated directory of Hive tools, apps and games that is easier to browse and less like a forgotten utility page.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/48SKX3Vw8kjagf7yucerd1pKU8qvJNZym27mp5owhRhyNrtZUmY2dtbAsuMLJAZRbn.png)

Of course it's pretty difficult to be sure we have everything listed there right from the start (and I expect a few typos as well). Please reach out with feedback and suggestions on what should be added.

### Code blocks are much easier to deal with now

This is mostly tuning on the new code blocks introduced last week. You can now collapse and expand oversized blocks, and you can also switch wrapping on and off when a long line would otherwise blow up the layout.

The result is that technical content feels a lot less clumsy to read, especially when the alternative is either horizontal overflow everywhere or giant code walls taking over the whole post.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23vsp77xhQFkrhdpQaSxckM9VT7bTPaMgekJJTLMBFUtqFcgMWmkVw5Q6b2shqy6Jwedy.png)

### PeakD now has a proper sitemap setup

This one is less visible in the UI, but it still matters. Kudos to @louis88 and @pharesim for brainstorming about this.

PeakD now exposes dedicated sitemap XML endpoints for the main site, communities, user pages and posts, with a sitemap index tying them together: https://peakd.com/sitemap.xml

The practical goal here is straightforward: make it easier for search engines to understand what should be crawled on PeakD, and give them cleaner signals around important public pages instead of leaving discovery too implicit.

There is also some filtering and structure behind it, but I don't expect it to be perfect right away. This is the kind of groundwork that we can use as a starting point and improve over time.

### A few smaller updates that still matter

A bunch of smaller changes landed too. If you want you can review the full changelog for the current month here: https://peakd.com/about/changelog

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgarth/23tmmEVjnpfRNLq4cbojL4DcUBSGBBkX54v9tFSwBwJxVJLydGa7zkfWxzLJ85qJuRRF5.png)


---

As always if something feels better, worse, confusing, or broken on your side after this update, let me know.

links.title: A Day at the Shore
links.body:
![boats with bee in frame.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/243q6qJQCVdNZyH1phAmidiefMxEC1PZuSVHGnEfs4rhvUJ5jMAV8May3Ep9qkAwRKCSp.jpg)
 I had my first beach outing of the season with my family (husband, daughter, dog) the other day.  While my husband and I don't usually go in the water, we do love the shore. I took many pictures, but the one above is my favorite.  That critter in the upper right hand corner, the one that looks like a bird, is a carpenter bee.  I had tried to capture a picture of the bees that were swarming around a wooden gazebo, but couldn't get a shot. When I got home and looked at my phone I realized one of the bees had photo-bombed me.  


![gazebo from a distance.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EoPLc6TSb6aQieQLMppozp9iFq5V5HUvveDwDdLHhAwytGmrCmawVmbcFQADxFADCD2.jpg)

We saw the gazebo from a distance and thought it would be a nice place to enjoy the sights.  



![gazebo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/Eos1NhTp5iD23HSP4mXToivGB7uVTYumXrRDeMhne7kzmkMf74eEL3VxxdUazKo3u4B.jpg)
Although the bees were swarming and seemed to be diving at us, only a couple are visible on the left side of the gazebo photo (above)

Here's a really short video I shot that shows some bees swarming, but nothing beats the photo-bombing bee in my top picture.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SwZyuDLa4_M

I stayed away from the gazebo because I didn't want to get stung. Those bees were mighty big.  I wondered how much a bite from one of these could hurt. It seems these are carpenter bees.  While they are large and do have impressive mandibles (because they burrow in wood, and need to chew it out) [they are not aggressive and their sting might be less painful than a bumble bee's sting, or a wasp's](https://www.terminix.com/blog/bug-facts/do-carpenter-bees-sting/).  They can however, sting multiple times because their stinger is not barbed.  Females sting.  Males do not.

Barbed stingers remain in a wound and cannot be pulled out by the bee.   Here's  picture from Wikimedia Commons that shows clearly how this bee appears:

Eastern Carpenter Bee (*Xylocopa Virginica*), the only species of carpenter bee in my area.
https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3b/Xylocopa_virginica_P1150864a.jpg?utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org&utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original
[Robert Webster / xpda.com / CC-BY-SA-4.0](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Xylocopa_virginica_P1150864a.jpg)


 Please note that in the picture at the top of my blog you can actually see the bee's face (@whatisnew used to love catching the insect's face), as shown in the Wikimedia picture.  In the picture from Wikimedia, the antennae are folded down, but in my picture they are raised.  A bee at rest may fold down its antennae.  Otherwise they will be raised. These are one of the bee's most [important sensory organs.  They use these to 'hear', see, and smell.](https://beezzit.com/blogs/news/bee-antennae-explained-the-super-sensors-behind-their-survival)
![IMG_20260516_141926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EoeENbtxDaHwNk7NgCFUQfuCiPxnaEas1i9bmFh43111dQScMMXFF6NrGHvESnYNbLv.jpg)

Here is a closer shot of the floating pier, shown in the top picture.  You can see the different boats that are for rent. 

Here is the ramp leading to the boat rental's floating pier.  I was standing on the stationary pier when I shot this.  

![gate sign.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EpXHyLH7Gx1mX8TZJ75Xz5paQ5UNWuKXFUAn7YPJvsubmMjVGaWv3kKtpoe7MtQ71gT.jpg)


Here I am, taking a picture I believe of my husband.  My daughter snapped this photo.  We hadn't planned to go to the beach that day, but the weather was so beautiful, it seemed a pity to waste the sunshine. So, we hopped in the car and drove the couple of miles to the beach. We live close enough to hop over to the beach when we want, and far enough to avoid flooding from the bay.  That's why we chose this neighborhood when we moved back in 2023.  
![me beach may 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23ynWku8A5c8BgAt6vEVWs1EX12GSCG1Mbeu4XYz9rxck5Qmj2YK7KFuRcXZbnkeZiBcQ.jpg)

This is a North Shore beach, which means it has higher elevations than South Shore beaches.  In the future, it is predicted many areas in the South Shore will be swallowed up by the sea. That is not the case on the North Shore.  

You can see in the picture below that, though we are on the beach, we are also in close proximity to trees.  The area around the shore is quite hilly in some places.  That's my daughter's dog in the foreground. The beach across the bay has few people on it, although there are boats (mostly kayaks) in the water further out.  
 

It looks like a bee photo-bombed this shot also, although you can barely see it in the top right corner. I did notice that the bees had begun to take an interest in the wood rails of the pier.  Whoever manages the beach should put an end to that invasion because no one will walk on the pier with those dive-bombing carpenter bees. 

![dog on pier trees in distance.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EqDj65FwDfLabR11gW3L5mvr5HozCn6wkymGKG78zDNZiNGEJGvpU7pArWQbkaLrqQx.jpg)

On our way to the viewing area/pier visible in my former pictures, we had to cross a marshy area that separated the shore from the bay.  As I looked down from the passageway I saw water, and a particular species of grass.  Here's one of the shots I got of that grass.  

![grass in marshy area 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23yJGg8snFVAgN5F9mTkHSj3U3pG7L1ape1S4FmZeSPTZMmSFJdyc7eKEx3K7m9yvpZUY.jpg)
  Here's another shot that shows how far into the bay this grassy, marshy area extends.  

![graxxy maarshy area.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EnYQs4EqU3jkFgfBikkVALi8sA1SNWiHYNGLcJzJ22b49gA92byP5DDJNRFds1BRP7K.jpg)


I looked up pictures of marsh grass in my area and this seems to be saltmeadow cordgrass.  It might be another species of shore grass, but whichever it is this grass serves an important function. 



According to the website [South Shore Blueway](https://www.southshoreblueway.com/saltmeadow-cordgrass/):
>Saltmeadow cordgrass is primarily used for shoreline protection and marsh restoration. This plant is great at dissipating wave energy along low shorelines and marsh areas. 
utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org&utm_campaign=index&utm_content=originalhat 

The beach we visited is a little off the beaten path.  It is less crowded than the more accessible area.  That's why we like it.  Very quiet.  Here's a picture that shows the larger beach, which is east of where we were sitting.  
![view of larger beach.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EpnBR5QBBFAGKP5y53hVjx3YS36G9XuvCgbZCyDSptt85jfyfpeoC2CtM1MSRwbQKfN.jpg)

There is a lovely promenade that invites a leisurely stroll.  This promenade will take you to the larger beach or to one of the several fishing piers that dot the bay area.

![promenade2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EppJoGZs6pbViyhe1yF6YZ6Dv6FKKVbntTiF6PHWuWEoMC9Bn4BjabjTT7jKxjHi4oa.jpg)

Everything about the beach is inviting.  Among the invitations is one that asks people to deposit their used fishing lines in a recycle bin.  

There is a bike rack, for people who want to use a little people power instead of fossil fuel to get to the beach.  Many people do use their bikes.

![bike rack.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/Ep1Xr3REVgbiqAmAG3rkcde6U7M5WKu5vxGBHK6BmLu3WLmBYryqgSizUXphECtddAm.jpg)

Finally, on our way out we noticed a sign.  My husband and I stopped to read it.  The sign was a dedication to a local resident who had died in Vietnam.  The pier on which we had been enjoying ourselves that afternoon was named after Sgt. James A. Harrington, Jr. Interesting coincidence. My husband was in front-line combat in Vietnam, at the very same time.  One of my husband's boyhood friends, Joe Strippoli, was killed in Vietnam just 11 days before Sgt. Harrington, on March 17, 1968. There is a [Strippoli Square](https://www.nycgovparks.org/parks/strippoli-square/highlights/223) in my husband's childhood neighborhood, named after the fallen hero.

I'm glad we saw that sign.  We gave a thought, in that moment to Joe Strippoli, Sgt. Harrington and all the other soldiers who did not return from Vietnam. We thought about them and realized how very fortunate we were. 

![james harrington memorial pier.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23x1DgomRrFZVTg8SiBqscuH8TwPqNmoLyEbQZdKVypCLcr8TiGpsq2KqNtVPkzTYFnXe.jpg)

I'll leave off with a picture of the beautiful bay.  No matter how many buildings we construct, how many parks we design, nothing we humans do can top the wonders of nature.  

![wide shot beach.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/243q6HxhvsGjFVdCW2SifnFpr11nfBBywPCBFdp6vDcuQPVP9Hf2j6ELJzkYrmrudsG6h.jpg)


Thank you for reading my blog.

Health and peace to all.  Hive on!

links.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUx23WY5UH8qQ83dN5pJEgbfJg3gn2eqcGF2zUEe2XgoN/IMG_0224.jpeg) 
Good day Fellas,

How are y’all doing today? It’s a fresh week and I’m super pumped up already as I’m slowly making thing right in the MODERN league. It only took me some courage to start playing on the league as I was actually delaying out of fear that my cards were not strong enough but I guess the battles are going great already and I’m taking note of the cards that are missing in my collection and will be getting them added gradually as owning the right cards is capable of easing player’s stress on Splinterlands. 

Earlier today, I also noticed someone using an Archon card that I do not own yet so I took note of it. The Archon card is called PRUNDA UNDERVESCH and today happens to be the first day I’m coming across it. From my observation, the unit cards under it happen to be strong and reliable. So currently I’m still in the BRONZE III rank in the MODERN league. My score is 300 at the moment and I need 100 points to rank up to BRONZE II. We still have 13 days to go before the end of this season.

My total amount of GLINT is now 3867 while the amount that I’ve been able to accumulate this season so far is 1287. I’ll check out the FRONTIER league today to try winning battles and earning rewards as I’m checking out possible ways to add extra cards to my card collection. My challenge right now is power supply but I will sort that out when I get home. Consistency is key and that is what has brought me this far on Hive as well as Splinterlands and I’m not planning to give up anytime soon. 

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUZ3137y7MGv1AWqQs2BRCi5raoEkdqCMz1RTPdrXtpQ/IMG_0225.jpeg) 

So I’ve got 62 more battles to play to qualify for the leaderboard this season and my highest streak is 3 presently in the MODERN league battle. Guess I’m enjoying the league already but they are a lotta pros on there whose collection are off the hook but I’m courageous and trust that my collection will be better equipped with time. My target was hitting 5k GLINT this season so I’m still working towards that. Will still do more battles in the league tonight to accumulate more GLINT while still making plans to stake more SPS so I can be able to claim my daily rewards. 

I’m getting back to dedicating more time on Splinterlands so as to get good result. Hive is my most trusted decentralized social media platform and most times I regret staying inactive for a while but all well everything happens for a reason. Some of my friends whom I referred on here called me the other day and asked if I was still active and I replied yes! There were actually shocked but guess now they now that Hive is here to stay. When they get back on I’ll introduce them to my favorite game on here too so they can join in on the fun. 

Let me go play some FRONTIER league games for now and see what I can do over there. It’s about to be a Super week for me actively playing in two leagues but I’m equal to the task. Will be sharing updates on my progress here so my followers can stay updated and also get to learn one or two things from my experience. Feel free to ask me any questions and for those who haven’t signed up on the game yet. My referral link will be shared so you can join me in this adventure. The official Splinterlands discord server is also active for you to join and keep in touch with the team, community members and developers.
