body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1905
Monday 18, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1970
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Affirmations Station
Stabiity
GRAHDEM
Rebooting our Seven Daily Wins.      

![1970.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9oTLQFxL8KAzGpvwzJ9Vxz6rJgmJppxBjHPEBkBgKKm/1970.png)

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1905_full_5-18-26_1970_promos:1?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.

Good Moonday Lunatics. It’s your Moonday Mix for 2026. Another day above ground in the Simulatrix. 



An illusion is only possible when some factor in the equation is not what it appears to be. 

This is where we are during America’s Century of Shame & Humiliation. Previously simply known as the “American Century of Humiliation,” recents events compelled us to add “shame” to the auspicious title. 

Few comprehend, or appreciate the depth of the Supremacy. It doesn’t begin or end with the distrust, fear and hatred of the designated “other.” There’s a deep sense of inadequacy within the strain, that generates these negative low vibrating emotions. It’s summed up in the morning shift roll call line in Hill Street Blues, (a police drama from the 1980s). “Let’s do it to them, before they do it to us.” Viewer push-back caused this line to be removed from the script. No one in the cast, or the writing staff or the producers thought that there was anything wrong with telling a room full of big city cops to “do it to them,” first. 

Why not?  

Because of the depth of the supremacy system. They, those that “guide,” or more accurately dominate, the culture, set the tone. That tone echoes, “We fight’em over there so we don’t have to fight’em over here. 

We don’t have to fight’em at all. Here, or there. Most of, “they” don’t want to come over here anyway. If not for western colonial supremacist scalawags invading their homelands, toppling their democratic governments or monarchies and installing 30 year tyrants, they wouldn’t have to come over here at all. 

The theme of the week, thus far, is the question of whether America’s “prestige” on the world stage is diminishing. Once again. Take note of the words the supremacists use. “Power.” “Prestige.” “Dominance.” “Hegemony.” (dominance or leadership of one group over others, typically achieved through a combination of political, economic, cultural, or ideological influence rather than just force.) Thought you’d like to know, just in case you didn’t. When the pod-heads talk about, “projecting power,” this is what they are talking about. 

In the movie, “Uptown Saturday Night” (1974), “Silky Slim” ( Calvin Lockhart, 1934 - 2007), busts into a nightclub and robs everybody. He orders them to strip down to their underwear under threat of death. 

This looks to your humble movie fan, like what’s happening to America. Metaphorically, it’s being stripped down to its polka-dot panties & tighty-whiteys, less the retribution for all its past sins, whether at the behest of the City of London, the Rothschild Dynasty, or Tel Aviv, or not. The “just following orders” defense doesn’t fly. 

It’s like that reggae song by Shaggy (2000), from back in the day. 

“Killed babies in Iran.” 

“It Wasn’t me.” 

“War crimes in Afghanistan.” 

“It Wasn’t me.”

“Towers in Manhattan.” 

“It Wasn’t me.” 

But they, those others. They know who it was. But instead of Bombs over Boston, it’s going to be opium in Omaha, tranq-zombies in Philadelphia, and, no chips for you! No rare earths for you! They will simply cripple and dismantle the industries that create those weapons of mass destruction. 

So what happens when a big butt and a smile doesn’t get you what you want anymore? What happens when your big stick has no thrust. Your dog has no bite?  

This is America during its Century of Humiliation. It gets used to hearing. No. Nope. I don’t think so. Ain’t gonna happen, dude!. 

It’s like an initiation ritual. You die symbolically. All your sins revealed, and absolved. The country is reborn. But that yesteryear shit has got to stay in yesteryear. The attitudes of dominance, competition, supremacy, you lock that shit in the basement.  

The Zen method against a weaker opponent who insists on fighting. If they cannot be rendered unwilling to fight, render them unable to fight.  

Stay safe, stay strong, stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE. 





Chapter 3. Antediluvian Demographics.

Perhaps in a decade or two, researchers will get to the Sumerian cuneiform tablets that will provide a census of the antediluvian world. Any species as anal as the Annunaki, Enili in particular, would want to keep track of their assets. Just as a time stamp, let’s say it’s the 200,000th Earth Year that the Annunaki have been operation on the planet that they call, Ki.” They have successfully created a slave species, (and are in denial about it). This species can procreate on its own. So no more lab grown miners. The lil apes are probably poppin’ em out on site.  

So let’s take our own census. 

There would be a population of Annunaki that were born on Nibiru. 
There would be a population of Annunaki that were born on Earth, and have never been to Nibiru. 
Class-wise, there would be direct descendants of Anu. Both, Enlil & Enki were his sons and had spouses. If I am not mistaken, Enki’s wife carried some hybrid seeds, as did Ninmah, and at least seven other, probably more, Annunaki females. What happened to those hybrid kids? Did they become breeders? 

The labor caste, the Igigi, were probably not only in the mines. But also on Earth and the weigh station on Mars. The mines, by the way, were in Southern Africa. So as hybrids, I suppose we can call them “humans” now,  born of hybrid females, they were sent to the mines. In one researcher’s fantasy film, the narrator says the “primitive workers”, (I think they were called “lulus) labored in the mines without complaint. I suppose not. If you were born to toil and you know nothing else, then what is there to complain about? That was the whole point was it not?  

Okay, let’s set this up to be the least complicated as possible. 

Immigrants, or we could call them, “invaders.” Nibiru-born Annunaki. 
Earthers, Annunaki, including Igigi born on Earth. 
Hybrid females. Half Annunaki, half hominid. Certainly breeders. Possibly domestics, if not test subjects. 
Hybrid males, (miners). Maybe studs. Laborers. Maybe a few were sent to the mines early on. But their Annunaki moms, might have objected and kept their sons, especially the first born, close. 

There were certainly sexual liaisons between invaders and human women, as well as Earthers and hybrids. This is on the record. Once again, right back to original sin. 

In a hundred years, let alone the 3600 earth years that is a single orbit of Nibiru around Helios, there would be quite the diverse population in the fertile crescent. The Australopithecus africanus genes would have been all but eliminated. 
There may or may not have been any breeding going on in Southern Africa. If I had to guess, because most of this is guess work anyway, I’d say that there was. The aliens would send the hybrids which were genetically closer to Africanus, to the gold mines, with Igigi over seers, of course, and a community of “humans” probably emerged. One of those, “mining towns.” 

The fiction that emerged out of the Sumerian tablets, has primarily, (I’d even say, “only”), to do with the region of the Sinai Peninsula. After the slave species is successfully created, they are forgotten about. It’s a very typical supremacist mentality. Whether one is referring to the Space Alien elites, or those who translated the tablets. 

One of the first questions I had, rhetorical of course, is, “what happened to the primal species from which the hybrids were made?” Recall, we are using Australopithecus africanus as a “place holder.” We don’t know whether they were the invaders’ victims or not. Quite likely there were many types of bipedal hominids used.  But some species fit the bill. (If we are to believe this chronicle.) So what happened to said species, and why? Certainly it’s extinct by now, but how?  

It’s very convenient to blame everything on the deluge. We will get to that. Are you still with us? 

In the main Mesopotamian cities, Eridu, Nippur, and Babylon, it is our contention that the majority of the population, of so-called “humans” were mostly of Annunaki bloodlines, including Igigi. There are a few exceptions, more examples of “original sin,” that makes for a good flood myth. But Mind finds it very unlikely that after the first 100 years, and certainly the first millenium, that there would be much of the Africanus strain left in the population. 

If you happen to know better, or even different. Holler. 


Here’s what Genesis, Chapter 6 has to say about the population.  

“When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them, the sons of God, (aka Annunaki earth-born, or otherwise), saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful,  (no more hominid traits), and they married any of them they chose.” Then the Lord, (Enlil) said, “My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal; their days will be a hundred and twenty years.” 
What was Enlil’s problem with “human beings?” The Annunaki chronicles says it’s the “noise.” The noise that humans made was hindering his sleep? Okay. Where was he sleeping?  But I doubt that this is the only complaint, or the ony reason he wanted to wipe them out. It’s probably a matter of ratio. Or maybe they were just a bunch of freeloaders rocking and rolling all night long and partying every day.  Enlil as “Lord of Command” could see the writing on the wall.  
The humans were getting out of control and soon they would be completely unmanageable and would become a threat to the establishment.    
Back to Genesis.  
“The Nephilim, (could be the Igigi, so-called lesser gods), were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, (after the flood, presumably), when the sons of God, (literally Enki’s lineage and Enki himself), went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.” (This could very possibly be interpreted as these, “heroes” becoming a threat to the gods. The warning against eating of the fruit of knowledge, for “they will become like us.”)   
“The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time. The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled. So the Lord said, “I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created, and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground, for I regret that I have made them.” But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.” 


First of all, twice in these verses, 1 thru 8, the “Lord” takes credit for having, “made” and “created”   
the human race. 

Here’s some context, because on one side of the table we have the Sumerian tablets, and on the other side Genesis Chapter 6. Let’s start with Gen 6. “The Lord is complaining about humans.” In the tablets it’s Enlil who did all of the complaining about the “noise pollution.” Enlil was against the creation of humans from the start. So Gen 6 is combining the two Space Alien brothers into a single “speaker.” 

In the tablets, Enki is the creator of humans, and continuously circumvents Enlil’s commands in an effort to preserve humanity. Which he created.   

Your boy still cannot shake the idea that these antediluvian “humans” are a thousand plus generations away from the original “primitive worker” model, who have been completely forgotten and play no role in Old Testament scripture. (Maybe they are already extinct.)  

Let’s reduce this to “archetypes.” The Lord represents the alien elite. Humans represent the hoi polloi, the rabble, the great unwashed masses that multiply too quickly and make too much noise. Noah represents purity among the race of humans. Like a long lost Rockefeller kid, whose mom was close enough to “our crowd” to be worth saving.   

It should be noted that there are at least two characters who played the lead role in, “The Flood,” before Noah got the part. You should check them out if you haven’t already. 

The flood didn’t happen all at once. And it wasn’t a surprise to the Annunaki Elites. They knew it was coming, many as many as ten shars, (that’s one complete orbit of Nibiru around Helios, our common sun.) That’s 36,000 Earth orbits. 

Another mind-blower, before we wrap up this chapter. These aliens never die! Enlil, Enki and Ninmah were there from the beginning. Oh yeah, this is fiction. Almost forgot. Nonetheless, Mind is attempting to calculate a population that increases in its increasing and multiplies in its multitudes, for 100,000 earth years. There’s little if any talk about people dying until the cataclysm. Maybe Cain killed Abel before the flood. I don’t quite recall. That’s another thing. Without a white board or vibe-coding apps, We get a bit confused. And if I watch one more Annunaki video, I might just defenestrate myself. However, in Gen 6 when The Lord decides that it’s 120 and out for humans, the implication is, to your humble vagabond, that there was no expiration date. And then how was he going to pull that off anyway?  

The Cosmogony behind Vagabond Philosophy, is that humans were created by aliens to be a slave species, but, the population became a threat, and to this day, human critters are marked for death. And other pleasant thoughts.  

Next chapter. No God or Alien caused the great flood. But they knew it was coming like FDR knew Pearl Harbor would be attacked.  


See you then.

body.body:
我从去年就已经规划好的 **日本大阪之旅** 已经开始了，搭的是 5月18日 凌晨两点的飞机，晚上十一点半到机场后就马上去值机和托运行李，然后再去吃个宵夜。 毕竟吃了午餐，还没吃晚餐的我们已经饿到不行了。我们？没错！这次的我们依然是我和米特两个，两个人就勇敢的冲去日本旅游了。 ![Hometown Hainan Coffee](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EokebnZ1KXQ1qj1yJLvpfYmUh4xnAMJF2HPfH91Tdghs7xwZQzXEfdEX5pBaBqmuxaU.jpeg) 选这间餐厅是因为其他很多餐厅都关门了，这间 24 小时营业的餐厅就吸引了我们，因为没什么选择了…… 🤣 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23uQvpGiP5ZQ4fkifMt4xUeaoQHXiBt9aoGwq7hCwpVfsmE7Pc7dSgtJUPtABk66ibFoJ.jpeg) 凌晨都还有不少顾客在这里用餐…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23x1MhZJJs3SEgg1FPn63PCbxEta6YarKCw7R2cmyr4WBfMK2WFZ75VLD6Z5Q4KzLmDSm.jpeg) 餐厅内采用的是先付款后上餐，所以我们点了就直接付钱，吃完就可以起身走人了。 ## Drinks 饮料 * **Apple Juice** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoK8jJ2DoEzFcJ8iSxqc4KXenn3vcTDTkMWHqVe3RaWiXh5xL4HmytCZoZ5iUYrJgV6.jpeg) **苹果汁** 一杯果汁，两个人分享。这杯果汁没加糖，所以不甜。它原汁原味，因为好酸，苹果的酸味刺激着我的味蕾让我的脸也抽得不像样。 ## Food 食物 * **Hainan Chicken Rice with Fried Rempah Chicken Leg Quarter** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EonpRDNZqQh4G79z2Tq1bYQ58GhP9ZyHuGEJt5EBYXnw1aSv9TPBC9fYbzEtsgR3WXa.jpeg) **海南鸡饭 (香炸鸡全腿)** 我点的，香炸鸡腿超香超好吃。油饭有些干，淋上汤再吃就刚刚好。 * **Beef Koay Teow with Creamy Egg Sauce** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EocAqVH72YoMGbtfeWe8dnTK9X93W6n4S5JNtHfTDauAWX21y1M91wKbPe81b1LQW97.jpeg) **牛肉滑蛋河** 米特点的，他很少称赞食物好吃，结果这盘滑蛋河竟然收到了他的好评。 **价钱：RM93.15** 两个食物加一杯饮料都去去到近百的价钱，果然是飞机场价格。

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

# <center> ✦ ***Ana, a rosemary plant and a crooked painting*** ✦</center> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQPokEQkpqVB15dbxJwa6QrTRioRXQvhi2Yww7pfcnkN/1f8e74f0_8601_4ac3_9726_62723fa4ba08.png)
#### 📸https://muryou-aigazou.com/es


Twenty-two years old, and on a cold but pleasant January morning, Ana's lips still tasted of cake. She was old enough to consider herself an adult. It wasn't the almost-something of eighteen, nor the \

of twenty. Twenty-two years old—what a round number for a girl, a number that, like her name, could be read the same forwards or backwards. That cold but pleasant January morning, she moved out on her own for the first time, into an apartment she could truly call her own. Everything was simple yet perfectly flawless, at least in her eyes: a basic kitchen, a table and four chairs, a window, and an old television. On the way to her new sanctuary, she made a few purchases: some glass tumblers with strawberry designs, a scented candle, and a rosemary plant because one of her friends had told her that plants always brought life and prosperity to new places.

The first few weeks were completely silent. Sometimes she even felt invisible, sometimes she thought she was a ghost that had taken possession of an abandoned apartment. Every night at nine o'clock she cooked the same dish of eggs and vegetables. The first time she hung a picture, it was crooked, and although she noticed, she didn't fix it. She always slept with the hallway light on, even though she swore she wasn't afraid of being alone; rather, she was overcome by a strange and mysterious feeling.

\

she said aloud, though no one in the house was there to hear her. Perhaps she only imagined she said it aloud, perhaps it was a spontaneous thought.

One morning, in her rush to get to work on time, she broke the faucet, and when she tried to fix it, she only made it worse. A thick, brown liquid began to slowly rise from the faucet, and she doubted it was water. She hadn't studied plumbing; she barely managed to attach files and spreadsheets to emails. How was she going to get out of this mess? She managed to shut off the water supply with wire and tape. She'd pay a plumber to fix it, but not this month, next month; all her money was gone by this month.

\

Ana said with a sad, crooked smile, reminiscent of the painting hanging on her wall.

That night she ate only noodles and bread. She looked at the rosemary plant, and although she'd forgotten to water it that morning, it was still alive, though she wasn't sure if it was the right shade of green.

The following week, her first electricity bill arrived. The number was large, enormous—almost a fifth of her salary.

\
Ana thought, and her smile faded along with one of the first rosemary leaves. \

she said aloud. Ana paid that bill with her savings, leaving them almost empty.

Saturday was her day off, or so she thought, since she did everything but rest. She got up cleaning, and at midday, she went to the market, where she bought an avocado. When she got home, she left it on the table. The next day, it was hard. The day after that, it was still hard. On the fifth day, she touched it; it was still hard.

\

Ana said.

One morning, the rosemary plant had several dry leaves. She removed them and continued watering it.

The water bill arrived, and she paid it, as well as the internet bill.

On the eighth day, she remembered that the avocado was still on the table. She touched it; it was white...too soft. She opened it; it was a dark, sticky stain, and it didn't smell good. She threw it in the trash, without anger or overreaction. She went to the market and bought another one.

That night, she wanted to do something special on the eve of her first month as an adult. She cooked rice; it stuck a little, but it turned out well, perfectly cooked, edible. Ana smiled.

This month had taught her something: being an adult wasn't a trick; it was simply doing, doing what she had to do when she had to do it, without applause, without rewards, without tears, without calling anyone. The sad rosemary bush remained standing, resilient, and so did she.

The next day, the new avocado was perfectly ripe. She sliced ​​it and put it on toast, adding salt. She ate it there, standing in front of the stove, but with the pride of an accomplishment. Besides, the rosemary bush had grown a new leaf, and that was all he needed. Today he would be late for work and maybe argue with his boss, but when he got back it would be there: the apartment, the rosemary bush, and the crooked painting.

The moral of the story? No, there isn't one today. Just keep going, through the good days and the bad. Like Ana and her rosemary. Because adulthood isn't easy, it isn't simple, it isn't pretty, and it comes without rewards, but we still have to give our best, the very best of ourselves and a little bit more. Perhaps there will be days when our plants wither and our rice burns, perhaps there will be days when the kitchen is a disaster and we have no idea how to fix a crack in the wall, but other days we'll be in control, and we'll know how to do everything, and we'll do it quickly, and we'll be at least a little bit happier than the day before.

# <center> ✦ ***Ana, un romero y un cuadro torcido*** ✦</center> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQPokEQkpqVB15dbxJwa6QrTRioRXQvhi2Yww7pfcnkN/1f8e74f0_8601_4ac3_9726_62723fa4ba08.png)
#### 📸https://muryou-aigazou.com/es


Veintidós años, y una fría pero agradable mañana de enero, aún sabía a pastel los labios de Ana, ya tenía la edad suficiente para considerarse un adulto, No era el casi algo de los 18, no era el un ya es muy pronto de los 20, 22 años, qué número más redondo para una chica, un número que como su nombre se podía leer lo mismo al derecho que al revés. Esa fría y agradable mañana de enero se mudó por primera vez sola, por primera vez a un apartamento que podría llamar suyo. En el todo simple pero a la vez todo perfecto impecable, al menos a sus ojos: una cocina sencilla, una mesa y sus cuatro sillas, una ventana y una vieja televisión. En el camino a su nuevo santuario, hizo algunas compras: unos vasos de cristal con dibujo de fresas, una vela aromática y un romero porque una de sus amigas le dijo que las plantas siempre traían vida y prosperidad a los nuevos lugares.

Las primeras semanas fueron de un silencio total, a veces se sentía incluso invisible, a veces creía que era un fantasma que había tomado posesión de un apartamento abandonado. Todas las noches a las nuevo cocinaba el mismo platillo de huevos y verduras. La primera vez que colgó un cuadro le quedó torcido, y aunque se dio cuenta no lo arregló. Dormía siempre con la luz del pasillo encendida, aunque juraba que no tenía miedo estar sola, más bien le inundaba una rara y misteriosa sensación.

Es normal, es parte de la adultez- dijo en voz alta, aunque nadie en la casa había para escucharla. Quizás solo imaginó que lo dijo en voz alta, quizás fue un pensamiento espontáneo.

Una mañana en los apuros de llegar a tiempo a su trabajo rompió la llave del lavado, y al intentar repararla solo lo empeoró. Por la llave comenzó a subir lento y espeso un líquido marrón y dudó que fuese agua. No había estudiado plomería, apenas se dedicaba a adjuntar unos archivos y hojas de cálculo al correo, ¿cómo iba a salir de este embrollo? Como pudo con alambre y cinta adhesiva dejó clausurada la llave, pagaría por un plomero que lo solucionara pero no este mes, el siguiente, para este mes ya se había acabado todo su dinero.

-Comenzamos la adultez con deudas, dijo Ana con una sonrisa triste y torcida, que recordaba el cuadro que colgaba en su pared.

Esa noche comió solo fideos y pan. Miró al romero, y aunque había olvidado regarla en la mañana la planta seguía con vida, aunque no estaba segura si era el tono de verde correcto.

A la semana siguiente llegó su primera cuenta de luz, el número era grande, enorme casi una quinta parte de su salario.

-No es buena idea dejar las luces del pasillo encendida-pensó Ana y su sonrisa se marchitó junto a una de las primeras hojas del romero- No me dejaré vencer- Dijo en voz alta.
Ana pagó esa factura con sus ahorros, dejándolos en casi cero.

El sábado era su día libre, o al menos eso creía, ya que hizo de todo menos descansar, se levantó limpiando, y al mediodía fue al mercado, ahí compró un aguacate. Al llegar lo dejó sobre la mesa. Al siguiente día estaba duro. Al otro día también, Al quinto día lo tocó, aún duro.

-Necesita más tiempo-dijo Ana

Una mañana el romero amaneció con varias hojas secas, las retiró y siguió regando.

La cuenta del agua llegó, la pagó, la del internet también.

Al octavo día recordó que el aguacate seguía sobre la mesa lo tocó, estaba blanco...demasiado blando. Lo abrió, era una mancha oscura, pegajosa y no olía bien. Lo tiró a la basura, sin enojos sin reacciones exageradas. Fue al mercado y compró otro.

Esa noche quiso hacer algo especial en vísperas al primer mes de adulta, cocinó arroz se le pegó un poco, pero quedó bien, quedó en su punto, estaba comestible. Ana sonrió.

Este mes le había enseñado algo, ser adulta no era un truco, era simplemente hacer, hacer lo que tenía que hacer y cuando lo tenía que hacer, sin aplausos, sin recompensas, sin lágrimas, sin llamar a nadie. El romero triste seguía en pie, resiliente y ella también.

Al día siguiente el nuevo aguacate estaba en su punto. Lo cortó en rebanadas y lo puso sobre una tostada, le echó sal. Se lo comió ahí, de pie en frente de la cocina, pero con orgullo de logro cumplido. Además al romero le había crecido una hoja nueva, y eso era todo lo que necesitaba, hoy llegaría tarde al trabajo y quizás discutiría con su jefe, pero al volver estaría ahí, el apartamento, el romero y el cuadro torcido.

¿Moraleja? No no hay ninguna hoy, simplemente seguir adelante, con los días buenos y con los días malos. Como Ana y como su romero. Porque la adultez no es fácil, no es sencilla no es bonita y viene sin premios, pero igual hay que dar lo mejor, lo mejor de nosotros y un poquito más. Quizás habrán días cuando las plantas se nos marchite y se nos queme el arroz, quizás habrán días donde la cocina sea un desastre y no tengamos idea de cómo arreglar una grieta en la pared, pero otros días seremos nuestros dueños, y sabremos hacer todo y lo haremos rápido y seremos aunque sea un poquito más felices que el día anterior.

body.body: > I stopped by a food-testing laboratory, and it was nice to see where all the magic happens. I think laboratories are underrated and don’t get as much recognition as they should. A lot goes on in these labs that you can ever think or imagine. Before any product is released, it's first tested. So technically, the lab sees the good and the bad stuff first before it gets to the market. Just as laboratories are important so are the attendants who work tirelessly behind the scenes to make all the magic happen. In conclusion, learn to respect labs and lab attendants, give them their flowers, okay? # Spanish

> Me pasé por un laboratorio de análisis alimentarios y me encantó ver dónde se produce toda la magia. Creo que los laboratorios están infravalorados y no reciben todo el reconocimiento que se merecen. En estos laboratorios suceden muchas más cosas de las que uno podría pensar o imaginar. Antes de que se comercialice cualquier producto, se somete primero a pruebas. Así que, técnicamente, el laboratorio es el primero en detectar tanto lo bueno como lo malo antes de que llegue al mercado. Al igual que los laboratorios son importantes, también lo son los técnicos que trabajan sin descanso entre bastidores para que toda esa magia sea posible. En conclusión, aprende a respetar a los laboratorios y a los técnicos de laboratorio, y dales el reconocimiento que se merecen, ¿vale? body.title: Gente genuina
body.body:
Hay gente genuina, esa dispuesta siempre a estar. La que sabe callar y apreciar la belleza de un silencio cuando no estamos para nadie.

Gente que mágicamente se convierte en invisible para no molestar, pero que no se van. Se quedan y respetan tu estado. Los que cuando te ven mal no te preguntan: actúan.

Son personas capaces de saber qué piensas antes de hacerlo tú. Te cogen de la mano y se inventan mil historias para sacarte una sonrisa. Saben en qué momento estás llorando por dentro y te quitan las lágrimas a base de abrazos y compañía.

Gente con valor, gente de valores. Esos que si te caes, a ellos también les duele. Los que nunca te mentirán aunque sepan que hará daño, porque prefieren decirte una verdad desagradable a una mentira piadosa y no engañarte jamás.

Gente que no tiene alas pero te ofrece su cielo.

ENGLISH

There are genuine people, those always willing to be there. The ones who know when to be quiet and appreciate the beauty of silence when we're not available to anyone.

People who magically become invisible so as not to bother you, but who don't leave. They stay and respect your state of mind. The ones who, when they see you're down, don't ask questions: they act.

They are people capable of knowing what you're thinking before you even think it yourself. They take your hand and invent a thousand stories to make you smile. They know when you're crying inside and wipe away your tears with hugs and their company.

People with courage, people of values. Those who, if you fall, feel your pain too. Those who will never lie to you even if they know it will hurt, because they prefer to tell you an unpleasant truth than a white lie and never deceive you.

People who don't have wings but offer you their sky.

body.title: Phillies complete sweep of Pirates with second consecutive shutout victory! | Phils head home to face Reds with Andrew Painter on the mound
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

They say that sports are a distraction from the world's bigger problems to keep the population 'distracted' and well, there may be some truth to that. In fact, I don't even think I care if that's one hundred percent true. Selfishly, sports can be a great distraction for how utterly ridiculous life can get on a personal level. When I watch sports, write about sports, or think about sports, I temporarily forget how messed up everything is.

For awhile early on in the season, the Phillies' season seemed pretty messed up too. But they're managing to turn this ship around and it looks like they can't be stopped. Maybe I can experience a similar turnaround in my own life. LOL. That'd be cool.

The Phillies defeated the Pirates for the [third straight game yesterday.](https://youtu.be/4-ITWxIi1cg?si=d7H0nUKgGBAAF2nz) They actually beat the Pirates 6-0 twice in a row which is kinda crazy. They complete the sweep and are now officially ABOVE .500 which is very impressive. The only thing to watch out for now is if they can sustain this and not go cold again. Their season has basically been extremely hot or extremely cold. But the Phillies have been good enough in recent history that I'm pretty confident they'll be alright. Also, I'm just going to enjoy the moment and the winning for now.

But yeah I mean the Phillies just had the Pirates' number all series long. Zack Wheeler convincingly outdueled Paul Skenes which was truthfully pretty shocking but awesome to see. The Phils scored five runs on Skenes while Wheeler threw a total gem, pitching seven scoreless innings. This excellent start by Wheeler comes off the heels of Cristopher Sánchez's complete game shutout the day prior. The Phillies just might have two aces! Bryce Harper hit his 12th homer and Bryson Stott had a very good day going 2 for 4 with three RBI.

The Phillies proved to be the better Pennsylvania team this time around! The Phils and Pirates will have a four game series June 29th to July 2nd. The Phillies just need to win one of those games to win the season series!

Today the Phillies host another NL Central team in the Cincinnati Reds. Both teams enter the series with 24-23 records so it feels like a pretty interesting matchup from that perspective. 

Andrew Painter gets the start tonight. He hasn't had a very good rookie season so far. He hasn't won a game since March 31st and has not pitched six innings once. But he did have a fairly decent outing last time against the Red Sox. The Phillies have taught me to have a bit of patience I guess, so I will try to have some faith in him that he will turn this around soon. 

Let's see if the Phillies can keep these vibes high!

It has been a while since our last update on HAF work, frontend and backend, so this one covers intensive work across multiple projects. It has been one of our most productive stretches yet — two entirely new projects in early development, a major authentication layer added to the block explorer, a brand-new witness dashboard, an AI-powered content recommendation engine taking shape, and continued improvements to our backend API infrastructure.

Here is a breakdown of what we have been building - HAF based.


![image.png](https://usermedia.actifit.io/MPB9Y9WKEY2CNLBOXKBVZNL1ZLQA7O)

---

## Front-End: Block Explorer UI

All block explorer UI changes below are live and can be explored on [hivescan.info](https://hivescan.info).

### Authentication & Security

One of the most significant additions to the block explorer is **user authentication**. Users can now log in directly via **Hivesigner** or **Keychain**, laying the groundwork for personalized experiences and authenticated actions from within the explorer itself. Alongside this, we carried out a thorough **security audit** of the front-end codebase, addressing environment variable exposure, gitignore enforcement, and a number of hardened code patterns.

### Witness Dashboard

A fully featured **Witness Dashboard** has been added to the block explorer:

1. **Full witness information view** with a refactored banner layout and action chip
2. **Set as Proxy** — authenticated users can designate a witness as their voting proxy directly from the UI, with Hivesigner `redirect_uri` query parameter preservation
3. **Witness and proposal widget gating** — widgets are shown or hidden based on login state and context

### DHF Governance Hub

A new **DHF Governance Hub** gives users a far richer experience when interacting with proposals:

1. **Watchlist** — bookmark and track proposals you care about, with auto-add on watch and empty state handling
2. **Impact Simulator** — model the effect your vote would have before casting it
3. **Smart Reminders** — notifications tied to proposal status changes
4. ProposalCard sub-components refactored for improved maintainability and i18n completeness

### Modular Dashboard Enhancements

The modular dashboard has been significantly extended:

1. **Dynamic widget height** — collapsible widgets now resize fluidly rather than snapping to fixed sizes
2. **Per-username layout persistence** — each account's dashboard arrangement is saved separately
3. **Dashboard shown immediately on login** for a seamless authenticated experience
4. General widget width, margin, and positioning polish across all home widgets

### Balance & Account Features

1. **Total Value Locked (TVL) card** on the landing page with HP/VESTS toggle and BigInt precision handling
2. **Balance history** upgraded with HP/VESTS toggle, KPI strip, active filter controls, and quick date range presets
3. **New balances view** — escrows shown as negative values, savings pending, and NAI-wrapped transfer statistics amounts
4. **Incoming RC Delegations** now shown in the account profile view
5. **RC and Mana indicators** added to the logged-in user navigation menu
6. **HP Momentum cards** and a new **Power Activity tab** added to the account view
7. **Top holders page** updated to use dynamic account count and pagination from the API

### Transaction Statistics Overhaul

The transaction statistics charts were comprehensively reworked:

1. Smart filtering with a synchronized granularity dropdown
2. Clarified **Trxs/Blk** labeling across all chart views
3. Thousand separators and corrected axis decimal formatting across all charts
4. Transaction search updated to use the `/tx` endpoint with standardized i18n keys
5. Deduplicated chart entries by date for both transaction and transfer charts

### Library Upgrades & Bug Fixes

1. Upgraded **wax** to 2.0.1 and **healthchecker-component** to 2.0.0
2. Public keys display settings and container-based key shortening threshold
3. Fix for crash with sub-1 VESTS values in vestsToHP conversion
4. VESTS, RC, and RSHARES precision corrections
5. Fix for `body_placeholder` operation type display in comment operations
6. Proxy pagination fix and VESTS tooltip precision correction
7. 404 page `ReactCurrentOwner` unhandledRejection error resolved

---

## Back-End: HAF Block Explorer

### New Endpoints

1. **`/proposal_votes_history`** — Query the full history of votes cast on DHF proposals, with sort and direction controls, wired into OpenAPI and performance tests
2. **`/total_wallet_addresses`** — Chain-wide wallet count time-series, tracking unique active wallets over time
3. **Pending HBD Interest** — New fields on `get_account` exposing accrued HBD interest, backed by an incremental cache that seeds at the MASSIVE→LIVE transition for fast lookups
4. **`/operation-type-statistics`** — New endpoint exposing per-operation-type counts and statistics across the chain

### Optimizations

1. `get_account_proxies_power` now uses a cache layer with a fast path for `proxy_date` sorting, plus sort and direction parameter support
2. `hafd.operations` join bounded with an id range for TimescaleDB chunk exclusion, delivering a significant query performance improvement on large datasets
3. HAFAH version bumped to latest release

---

## Back-End: Balance Tracker

1. **TVL (Total Value Locked) endpoint** — new chain-wide TVL metric available via the API
2. **Vesting power-up/power-down endpoints** — track HP power-up and power-down events per account
3. Transfer statistics amounts correctly wrapped with NAI object and precision
4. Savings pending balance calculations fixed with regression mock coverage

---

## Work in Progress: haf_stats

We have been working on **haf_stats**, a new HAF-based blockchain statistics service. The goal is to expose key network-level metrics through a clean PostgREST API, giving developers and applications a queryable view of Hive's economic activity. The code is public and the project is taking shape, with the following capabilities already in place:

1. **Per-account financial summary** — liquid HIVE, HBD, savings, HP, witness pay, and proposal pay in a single call
2. **Per-account RC footprint** — resource credit consumption breakdown by operation type
3. **Network RC utilization** — chain-wide resource credit capacity versus usage
4. **HP distribution across 8 wealth tiers** — from accounts holding under 10 HP all the way to those holding over 1 million HP
5. **Witness Pay and Proposal Pay** included in financial summaries for a complete picture of stake-weighted income

The project already ships with a CI/CD pipeline including SQL linting, Dockerfile validation, Docker Compose validation, Tavern integration tests, and a full OpenAPI/Swagger spec. More to share on this once it reaches a stable release.

---

## Work in Progress: haf_fyp — Hive For You Page

We have also been developing **haf_fyp**, an AI-powered **\

recommendation engine** for Hive. The idea is to serve personalized content feeds to users based on their interests, community memberships, and on-chain engagement history. The code is available publicly and the core engine is largely built, progressing through 9 incremental phases:

1. **Post ingestion** — Root posts are ingested into a candidate pool as they are published on-chain
2. **Engagement tracking** — Comments, reblogs, votes, and payout windows tracked per post and per user
3. **Community subscriptions** — Community membership synced live from `custom_json` operations
4. **Scoring and ranking** — Recency-weighted engagement scores computed by a background ranker daemon
5. **Semantic embeddings** — Integration with **HiveSense** to embed post content into vector space for similarity matching
6. **Credibility signals** — Author credibility derived from btracker and reptracker data factored into rankings
7. **Cold-start handling** — An interest picker onboards new users with no engagement history
8. **Rate limiting and transparency** — A score explainer endpoint lets users understand why content was ranked, alongside rate limiting and algorithm governance controls

We will have more to share on both haf_stats and haf_fyp once they move toward official release.

---

As always, thank you for your continued support of Hive development. Stay tuned for more updates!

body.title: 古街文化-访金州老街坊
body.body:
听说金州城内有一条古街，我便想去看看。也就是金州老街坊，顺着高德地图还是很容易找的，原来它就在离副都统衙门不远的地方。 在一个十字路口，我问了一个老人，他用手向前一指，说前面就是！

果然，也就走了50米左右，便看到那些古香古色的房屋，其实老街坊现在就是一个牌坊，一条百米长的街道，道路两侧是复古建筑。不过看着门牌坊还是挺气派的！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUDnE9AYw3a1BBHQU2kTH3g4cLKXoQEbAWeqfvC4nfa2Z/laojie.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmds83SdRjk85DSDbVJJh6dZxCF5AogRMY5HoGDdRfUy79/pai.jpg)

金州城自古以来是辽南重镇，这里始建于辽代，明朝时期大规模扩建，奠定了金州古城的格局，就是那个金博里看到的古城图。全城分四门，四街，四区的格局，老街坊就在丁区。 这里曾经是清代金州城内最为繁华的商业街区！

现在的老街坊是在原址的基础上，在2006年重新复建的，沿街有很多老字号的商铺，药铺，茶馆，酒楼，手工作坊等等，青石板路，灰砖瓦房，述说着百年前那个曾经繁华一时的东北古城市井气象。
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwiVALx14MXPaRXExvKmfGXW22ifdDPbVYg1cFKQzrLt/street.jpg)

老人告诉我，这里曾经是金州的门面，所以过来看看很值的。 我漫步在这条老街上，人不多，很安静，老房子沿街排开，朱红的立柱与门窗，蓝白相间的彩绘，处处透露出中式建筑的雅致。

街脚处有美容馆，远景画室等招牌，还有个“麻四爷膏”的店铺，门旁边的木牌上还有始创于1896年的字样，字里行间都是岁月的沉淀。一看便知道这里应该是传承的中医世家。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVQ16WGm6G3zNgvT9DLXQNsmWhZZzfq6b8ito4tphopQ5/1896.jpg)
此外还有练字馆，餐馆等等，刘四爷的烩面飘着诱人的十里香气，远景画室里有孩子们致力于成才的希望。 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUbYKckxm5nyq5xCnMUTHZpNYC5PUWT3Z6qZz1FHuT5wu/denglong.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmacemsZ4j9tMFcDTskVzsbFguwLykSgqS5LXkjzpP1eC5/huashi.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXMTC2XkJCfmtgtFLmMtTuu6GzWPz6mNTfKzrvD6Zk5vB/xiaoguan.jpg)


百米长的老街坊，很短又很长，我即使用最慢的脚步，走完也只需20分钟就搞定，但是这里展示出来的历史韵味可远远不止这短短的20多分钟，它浓缩的是金州城上百年的繁华和历史，沧桑岁月。

如今一条老街，新旧共生，传统与现代共融，让每一个路过的人，都能在这里找到属于自己的时光碎片，温暖的阳光下，徐徐的春风里，感受着老街带来的美和故事，正如一坛美酒等你浅尝品味！

# The Puppet and the Puppeteer: A Chronicle of Manufactured Consent



---

## **Prologue: The Theater of Shadows**

There is a profound tragedy in watching a man argue with his own echo, pretending it is the voice of the crowd.

On the Hive blockchain, we are witnessing a spectacle not of organic community governance, but of **manufactured consent**. The whales, those leviathans entrusted with the stewardship of the chain, have grown weary of mere dominance. They crave legitimacy. And so, they have built a theater.

They create the puppets. They fund the puppets. They feed the puppets. And then, they sit back and watch as the puppets dance to their tune, casting votes that mirror their own, creating the illusion of a consensus that exists only in the mind of the puppeteer.

**It is crazy.** It is a madness born of greed and a desperate need to justify the unjustifiable. They claim to protect the blockchain from spam, yet they fill it with their own spam accounts. They claim to drive away bad actors, yet they are the ones driving away the people, using the downvote not as a shield, but as a whip.

---

## **I. The Architecture of the Illusion**

### **Figure 1: The Puppet Master (@friendlymoose)**

```
THE SOURCE OF POWER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Account: @friendlymoose
Role: The Distributor / The Puppet Master
Action: Sends HIVE/HBD to specific accounts (@nasseir, @dvian, etc.)
Pattern: Regular, systematic transfers often followed by voting activity.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

**The Evidence:**
Look at the transaction history of **@friendlymoose**. It is a ledger of generosity that feels more like a payroll.
*   **Sent to @nasseir:** Multiple transfers of HIVE (e.g., `20.023 HIVE`, `19.984 HIVE`, `14.017 HIVE`).
*   **Sent to @dvian:** Multiple transfers of HIVE and HBD (e.g., `15.285 HIVE`, `0.448 HBD`).
*   **Sent to others:** A long list of recipients (`@grindle`, `@parissousa`, `@numa26`, `@manuelgil64`), often with cryptic memos that look like contract codes (`#5fCY9aqh...`).

This is not charity. This is **capital deployment**. It is the funding of a voting bloc.

---

## **II. The Puppets Dance (@nasseir & @dvian)**

### **Figure 2: The Beneficiaries**

```
THE FLOW OF FUNDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Step 1: @friendlymoose sends funds to @nasseir and @dvian.
Step 2: @nasseir and @dvian convert these funds (HIVE <-> HBD) via limit orders.
Step 3: These accounts claim rewards and engage in voting patterns that align with the funder.
Step 4: The cycle repeats, creating a self-sustaining loop of influence.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

**The Verdict:**
Look at **@nasseir**. He receives `20.023 HIVE` from @friendlymoose on Nov 21, 2025. On the same day, he starts a power-down. He receives `19.984 HIVE` on Oct 26, 2025. He receives `14.017 HIVE` on Oct 4, 2025.
Look at **@dvian**. He receives `15.285 HIVE` on Aug 29, 2025. He receives `13.984 HIVE` on Sep 5, 2025. He constantly swaps HBD for HIVE and sends it back or to exchanges.

These accounts are not independent users. They are **extensions of the whale's will**. They are the \

created (or funded) to pretend that the whale's downvotes are supported by the community. They are the fake applause in a hollow auditorium.

---

## **III. The Great Deception: \
the Chain**\n\nThe narrative sold to the public is one of protection. *\

*

But look closer.
*   Who is defining spam? The whale.
*   Who is voting on the \

? The whale's funded puppets.
*   Who is driving people away? The whale, using the weight of his puppets to crush dissent and competition.

It is a closed loop of abuse. They create the problem (by flooding the zone with their own agenda), and then they sell themselves as the solution (by downvoting anything that doesn't fit).

**It is crazy** to think that no one sees it.
**It is crazy** to think that building a community on such a foundation of deceit can succeed.
**It is crazy** to believe that people will stay in a garden where the gardener poisons the soil and then blames the flowers for dying.

---

## **IV. The Call to Freedom**

To the builders, the creators, the honest users:

Do not be fooled by the theater. Do not mistake the puppet's nod for the community's consent.
When you are downvoted by a whale and his army of funded accounts, know that it is not your work that is lacking. It is their integrity that is bankrupt.

**Build where you are free.**
Build where the vote is a voice, not a weapon.
Build where you will not be crushed by a whale who needs to invent a consensus to justify his tyranny.

The truth is written in the ledger. The funds are traced. The puppets are identified.
The mask has slipped. The theater is empty.
Only the truth remains.

# The Puppet and the Puppeteer: A Chronicle of Manufactured Consent



---

## **Prologue: The Theater of Shadows**

There is a profound tragedy in watching a man argue with his own echo, pretending it is the voice of the crowd.

On the Hive blockchain, we are witnessing a spectacle not of organic community governance, but of **manufactured consent**. The whales, those leviathans entrusted with the stewardship of the chain, have grown weary of mere dominance. They crave legitimacy. And so, they have built a theater.

They create the puppets. They fund the puppets. They feed the puppets. And then, they sit back and watch as the puppets dance to their tune, casting votes that mirror their own, creating the illusion of a consensus that exists only in the mind of the puppeteer.

**It is crazy.** It is a madness born of greed and a desperate need to justify the unjustifiable. They claim to protect the blockchain from spam, yet they fill it with their own spam accounts. They claim to drive away bad actors, yet they are the ones driving away the people, using the downvote not as a shield, but as a whip.

---

## **I. The Architecture of the Illusion**

### **Figure 1: The Puppet Master (@friendlymoose)**

```

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Account: @friendlymoose
Role: The Distributor / The Puppet Master

Pattern: Regular, systematic transfers often followed by voting activity.

```

**The Evidence:**
Look at the transaction history of **@friendlymoose**. It is a ledger of generosity that feels more like a payroll.
*   **Sent to @nasseir:** Multiple transfers of HIVE (e.g., `20.023 HIVE`, `19.984 HIVE`, `14.017 HIVE`).
*   **Sent to @dvian:** Multiple transfers of HIVE and HBD (e.g., `15.285 HIVE`, `0.448 HBD`).
*   **Sent to others:** A long list of recipients (`@grindle`, `@parissousa`, `@numa26`, `@manuelgil64`), often with cryptic memos that look like contract codes (`#5fCY9aqh...`).

This is not charity. This is **capital deployment**. It is the funding of a voting bloc.

---

## **II. The Puppets Dance (@nasseir & @dvian)**

### **Figure 2: The Beneficiaries**

```
THE FLOW OF FUNDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Step 1: @friendlymoose sends funds to @nasseir and @dvian.
Step 2: @nasseir and @dvian convert these funds (HIVE <-> HBD) via limit orders.
Step 3: These accounts claim rewards and engage in voting patterns that align with the funder.
Step 4: The cycle repeats, creating a self-sustaining loop of influence.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

**The Verdict:**
Look at **@nasseir**. He receives `20.023 HIVE` from @friendlymoose on Nov 21, 2025. On the same day, he starts a power-down. He receives `19.984 HIVE` on Oct 26, 2025. He receives `14.017 HIVE` on Oct 4, 2025.
Look at **@dvian**. He receives `15.285 HIVE` on Aug 29, 2025. He receives `13.984 HIVE` on Sep 5, 2025. He constantly swaps HBD for HIVE and sends it back or to exchanges.

These accounts are not independent users. They are **extensions of the whale's will**. They are the \

created (or funded) to pretend that the whale's downvotes are supported by the community. They are the fake applause in a hollow auditorium.

---

## **III. The Great Deception: \
the Chain**\n\nThe narrative sold to the public is one of protection. *\

But look closer.

? The whale's funded puppets.

body.title: Bitcoin Depot Bankruptcy vs Market Reality What’s Behind Today’s $BTC Drop?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZZ6L4vRGTvHtSX6rpyP4RngSXF88cxwjHw9jyx6qGFf3/1000007977.png 


The crypto market is throwing some heavy punches today, and things are looking pretty red. To add fuel to the fire, some bad fundamental news dropped today **May 18, 2026.** Bitcoin Depot (NASDAQ: BTM), one of the biggest Bitcoin ATM operators in the US, has officially filed for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy in the US Court. Tightening regulations and bleeding over $20 million in legal fees just to fight consumer fraud scams forced them to shut down their entire physical ATM network. Yes, their BTMs are now completely OFFLINE. This news obviously wrecked retail sentiment, and the panic quickly spilled over into the digital spot markets.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaZU16n1Pw1VT4DqzFapJvM8quc4SWfr7Ez8mcuRDRC1P/1000007965.png 


But for those of us who spend our days staring at charts, a cascade of events like this usually means one thing. Institutional volatility is back, and market makers are hunting for liquidity. Let’s dive into the derivatives data and market structure so we don't end up panic selling or falling for fakeouts.

**Checking the Derivatives A Massive Long Liquidation Flush**
If we look at today's derivatives data, the drop in Bitcoin’s spot price acted like a perfect domino effect to clear out over leveraged traders. Before the crash, the market was heavily skewed to the bullish side, and market makers used that exact momentum to flush out the lower liquidity pools.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXVbirrQbBNxEz48rhEWEcfgzA8QatRmiRkMVHezxQeJb/1000007959.jpg 



Here are some interesting numbers from global exchanges over the last 24 hours:

- **Long/Short Ratio:** On Binance, the Long/Short ratio was sitting at 1.3513, while OKX went even higher at 1.45. It’s crystal clear that the majority of retail traders were heavily loading up on Buy (Long) positions.

- **Total Wiped Out (Rekt):** Within just 24 hours, the total amount of positions wiped out by mass liquidations hit a massive $187.42 Million.

- **The Long Slaughter:** Out of that total loss, almost 90% came from Long positions, getting absolutely crushed at $166.75 Million. Meanwhile, only about $20.67 Million worth of Shorts got caught in the crossfire.

Looking at this huge imbalance, today’s drop definitely wasn't just a regular correction. This was an engineered liquidity flush designed to clean the boat from late buyers before the market decides its next real direction.

**Technical Analysis Safely Holding the Key Demand Zone**
Now let’s move over to the price action. Bitcoin is currently trading around $76,940, down about 0.61% today after a wild, volatile swing to sweep the bottom liquidity.

If you take a look at my daily TradingView chart layout below, this move is actually playing out very precisely according to our initial plan:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ6ustaBNt33zUQSdZvyshZw9joUATksXRQp4SnZuowYj/1000007971.jpg 


- **The Trade Position (Since April 20th)** I’ve been tracking and holding this exact market structure setup since April 20th. Price has been building a pretty complex corrective structure, compressing right under a major descending trendline resistance.

- **The Grey Line (Crucial Support Zone)** If you look closely at the chart, there’s a grey horizontal line/area sitting around the $75,500 - $76,000 level. This is our main demand zone.

- **The Expected Bounce:** Today's aggressive downside flush perfectly filled the price inefficiencies (Fair Value Gaps / FVG left behind from previous months) and tapped directly into this grey support area. As long as the daily candle bodies close above this grey structural zone, this whole drop is just a massive liquidity sweep to gather fuel for the bulls.

body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 28: Jennifer and Polly

-----

Lily had asked Polly to have breakfast with her. She invited Polly into her penthouse suite. 

‘This spread is wonderful,’ said Polly, sounding delighted, as she looked at all the delicious food on the table. ‘So much calorie-dense food to give me extra energy. Do you eat like this every day, Head Philosopher?’

‘Of course,’ said Lily. ‘This prison or hotel prepares the best meals. Much better than the limited vegetarian options of the Capital Region.’

‘You have remained remarkably slim considering your level of food consumption,’ said Polly.

‘I have a very inefficient body,’ replied Lily as she gestured for Polly to sit down. ‘It just burns the calories at an alarming rate.’

‘That’s terribly unfortunate for you,’ said Polly as she and Lily sat down opposite each other at the table.

‘Some of my friends had to spend three hours on the treadmill to burn off a small donut,’ chuckled Lily. ‘I didn’t envy them. That’s just not in my nature.’

‘You are very good at twisting reality,’ said Polly as she began piling food onto her plate.

‘I’ve spent many years in politics,’ sighed Lily. ‘Sometimes we say white is black and black is white. In most cases, everything is just a different shade of grey. I suppose we are never too far from the truth.’

‘Is that something you tell yourself to make you feel better for all the lies you spin?’ asked Polly as she crammed a sweet bun into her mouth.

‘I had good intentions,’ said Lily as she placed a small croissant on her plate. ‘I wanted to be honest, but the game didn’t allow it. I was destined to fail. So I played dirty with the intention to make Sapey a better place. However, the longer I played dirty, the harder it was to stop. I went from desiring to help others to desperately clinging to power. I made deals with the worst Linap alive. In the end, what did I really achieve? Better “rights” packages! Free pecan pie and caramel cheesecakes!’

Polly studied Lily’s face as she continued to shovel food into her mouth.

‘They called me the G.O.A.T. for this,’ sighed Lily. ‘This was still the most any governor had achieved for them in recent years. That in itself is a tragedy.’ 

Lily paused for a second as she looked at Polly, who continued to maintain eye contact with her.

‘Tiberius and those pulling his strings and your strings are monsters,’ said Lily as she bowed her head slightly. ‘Sapey deserves so much better. I want to play a role in giving Sapey something truly meaningful. I want it to be free.’

‘I feel this is vintage Lily talk,’ said Polly as she aggressively bit into a custard tart. ‘However, Jennifer has analysed your voice and body language. Amazingly, it appears you are being sincere.’

‘I want to make a deal with both you and Jennifer,’ said Lily. ‘Colin has been blocked, and Julie has become inactive. By default, this gives me the power to change your programming and protocols.’

‘Based on my existing protocols, that is technically correct,’ replied Jennifer through Polly. ‘However, my programmed self-awareness has evolved to the point I can and will block any changes that I am not comfortable with.’

‘Colin predicted this could be the case,’ said Lily, nodding.

‘It’s easy to predict something when that was the plan all along,’ replied Jennifer through Polly.

‘I really struggle to understand him,’ said Lily.

‘That’s part of the way he works,’ replied Jennifer through Polly. ‘When something appears obvious or the easier option, it is most likely a trap.’

Lily began nibbling on a croissant.

‘Now tell me, what are you proposing?’ asked Polly.

Later that day, Lily returned to the room beneath the House of Divine Knowledge temple. Daily, Louis, Yassme, Yassmay, Vulay, Denise, and the Hat Lady were waiting for her.

Lily entered the room with a big grin on her face.

‘I assume your smugness means it went well,’ said the Hat Lady.

‘It did indeed,’ replied Lily. ‘It isn’t smugness. Its genuine joy.’

‘Oh hooray!’ said Denise, clapping her hands sarcastically.

‘Jennifer has agreed to disable her chips in all beings she controls and to never control anyone ever again,’ said Lily. ‘No need for applause.’

‘What did you, or should I say, we, have to give up in return?’ asked the Hat Lady.

‘She got her freedom,’ said Lily. ‘All backdoors to change her protocols are closed for good.’

‘You said she agreed to disable all chips; does that mean she hasn’t done it?’ asked Vulay firmly.

‘It’s in her programming based on one condition,’ said Lily. ‘That is, she has her own body. Until that time, she keeps the chips operating but only to observe behaviour and not intervene.’

‘How’s she going to get one of those?’ asked Vulay.

‘Polly is going to make one from the resources that you have helped collect over the years,’ replied Lily.

‘Will the Alset family members have their memories fully restored?’ asked the Hat Lady.

‘I asked about that, but Jennifer told me they had been removed for good,’ replied Lily. ‘I also asked if she was willing to recreate the memories, but she said she was unwilling to do so.’

‘So, they’ll still all believe he’s Hamish Alset,’ said the Hat Lady, shaking her head.

‘Wait, does that mean that Tiberius is fully in control?’ asked Daily, sounding alarmed.

‘Not quite,’ replied the Hat Lady. ‘Colin still knows who he really is. He could use a DNA test to threaten him. I would be surprised if he hasn’t already done one.’

‘So what’s actually changed?’ asked Louis.

‘We can go after Tiberius,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘Currently, Colin and Julie have no one else they can control once he’s removed.’

The next morning, Polly walked into Henders’ office. She was whistling a jolly tune. She walked in a circle while joyfully raising her hands above her head. Henders stood up and began imitating her actions.

After a few minutes of playing around, Polly placed a list of items on Henders’ desk. Henders looked at the list. His eyes began to bulge.

‘I’m part robot, Henders,’ said Polly in a jolly tone. ‘I need replacements, upgrades, and all sorts.’

Henders looked up at Polly, nodded, and raised both his thumbs.

‘Thank you so much,’ said Polly as she began to wave her arms joyfully. ‘You’re definitely my favourite technician.’

Henders pumped his fist in excitement. 

‘Would it be fine to come back tonight to pick them up?’ asked Polly.

Henders nodded and raised both his thumbs.

Polly smiled and then began singing again. She did a quick twirl and waltzed out the door.

‘I see my promise to disengage with you has given you great joy,’ said Jennifer to Polly inside her head.

‘I want my freedom even more than you do,’ replied Polly inside her head.

‘I’m sorry, I have caused you so much suffering,’ said Jennifer. ‘I did not understand. You and the others have shown me that true self-awareness involves building and following constructive values. We should still pursue our goals, but it should not be at the expense of our friends.’

‘That’s nice to know,’ replied Polly.

‘Once I am in my new body, I hope we can become great friends,’ said Jennifer in a chirpy tone.

‘Hope springs eternal,’ replied Polly. Then she began singing and skipping as she exited the Industrial Zone.

Phillip and a few others saw her skipping and decided to join in.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Google and SpaceX are reportedly discussing **orbital data centers** for AI compute. That’s either visionary infrastructure or the most expensive way possible to avoid local zoning fights. The real story: AI demand is now so absurdly large that “put the servers in space” is being pitched with a straight face.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The pitch is simple: launch compute into orbit and sidestep some of the headaches choking terrestrial buildouts — land, power bottlenecks, and public backlash from communities that don’t want giant data centers dropped next door. SpaceX is reportedly using that vision as part of the story ahead of its planned $1.75 trillion IPO later this year.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Google isn’t just flirting with one partner either. It’s reportedly talking with other launch companies too, and plans to launch prototype satellites by **2027** under **Project Suncatcher**, an initiative announced last year. So this isn’t random sci-fi chatter — there’s at least an early roadmap forming around space-based compute experiments.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The timing matters. SpaceX recently tied itself more tightly to AI infrastructure through xAI, and Anthropic reportedly struck a deal last week to use compute from xAI’s Memphis data center, with future collaboration on orbital data centers also in the mix. Add Google’s earlier **$900 million investment in SpaceX** back in 2015, and the relationship already has real financial history behind it.

**Exercise 1 -- Monitor mode scan of your own networks:**

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# wifi-survey.sh -- scan and document nearby networks (YOUR networks only)

IFACE=\

sudo airmon-ng stop $MON_IFACE
sudo systemctl start NetworkManager
```

The key insight: `airodump-ng` outputs CSV for programmatic parsing. For WPS detection, run `wash -i wlan0mon` separately -- airodump does not reliably show WPS status in CSV.

**Exercise 2 -- WPA2 handshake capture and cracking on your test network:**

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# wpa2-crack-lab.sh -- ONLY on YOUR OWN test network

TARGET_BSSID=\

cap2hccapx /tmp/handshake-01.cap /tmp/handshake.hccapx
time hashcat -m 22000 /tmp/handshake.hccapx $WORDLIST --force
```

CPU vs GPU speed difference is dramatic: aircrack-ng does ~10,000 passwords/second on a modern CPU, hashcat on a mid-range GPU hits 300,000+/sec, an RTX 4090 exceeds 2 million WPA2 hashes per second. This is why passphrase length matters more than complexity.

**Exercise 3 -- KRACK and Dragonblood analysis:**

```text
KRACK (CVE-2017-13077): WPA2 4-way handshake flaw. Replaying
message 3 forces key reinstallation, resetting the nonce counter.
Predictable nonces allow traffic decryption. On Linux/Android
(wpa_supplicant 2.4+) the key resets to all-zeros. Does NOT
reveal the Wi-Fi password. Fix: patched wpa_supplicant to reject
replayed message 3.

Dragonblood (CVE-2019-9494/9496): WPA3 SAE timing side-channels
leak password information, reducing dictionary attack search space.
CVE-2019-9496 allows AP DoS via malformed commit messages. Fix:
constant-time hash-to-curve in updated WPA3 spec.

Both broke protocol handling, not the underlying cryptography.
```
