In the end, right now besides cooking we need to buy food or dish that cheaper. My money is really depleted right now. So, if i can paid something for someone there is not my money. Its trully help from heaven which is i really dont know from where the money comes. My calculation is not working at all in this moment. It feels like when Jesus gives people with bread and fish that unlimited until they are full. It really similar with my life right now. It feels like all filled by God. I really dont know from where the money comes. When i see my bank account i think it never filled or debet on my account but it feels like never trully empty. Thats really miracle from God i believe. So, I wont worry anymore. The worst case is i got fine in 1 month or so. Thats is what i believe right now

body.title: To be successful in life, you have to prepare yourself properly.
body.body:
by Jamal70 on Jamal70 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/jamal70 [![To be successful in life, you have to prepare yourself properly.](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/e87e25fd-4d7c-4c12-b004-51006dd75fc9.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/dxSmtQDR27idXASpWHTML5) 
 
 A boy once told his father that he wanted to grow up to be very rich. Then his father told him, “Then study hard.” The boy immediately replied, “But my uncles became rich without studying much!” Then his father explained to him with a smile, “It is not right to build your future by looking at the lives of others. Not everyone succeeds in the same way. Some succeed because of luck, some through hard work. But education not only shows people the way to earn money, it also teaches them to be good people.”

The father also said, “The lives of your uncles can be an example for you, but being like them should not be your goal. You have to create your own identity with your own abilities and hard work.” The boy then understood that the purpose of life is not only to be rich; to gain respect through knowledge, education and your own hard work. This education changed his way of thinking in life.

body.title: Lakeside / Göl Kenarı ( EN-TR)
body.body:
![IMG20260321152554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVSmLPP1kN8JaunxBXo2WTVDcJeQRru2JtFPeKLmrHF3/IMG20260321152554.jpg)

That day, I just wanted to get away from the city for a bit and be alone with my thoughts.  I realized that in the crowd, I was constantly thinking the same things and preoccupied with the same routine events.  I was always in a rush to get somewhere or deal with tasks that had to be done on time.  Who knows, maybe more than anything, I was escaping the noise in my head.  After this escape, the road led me to the shore of this quiet lake, hidden among the pine trees and mountains. 

>O gün sadece şehirden biraz uzaklaşmak ve kendimle başbaşa kalmak istedim.  Kalabalıkta sürekli olarak aynı şeyleri düşündüğümü ve rutin gelişen olaylarla ilgilendiğimi fark ettim.  Üzerimde sürekli bir yerlere yetişme ve saatlerinde yapılması gereken işlerle uğraşma hali vardı.  Kim bilir belki de en çok, zihnimin gürültüsünden kaçıyorum.  Bu kaçış sonrası yol beni, çam ağaçlarının ve dağların arasında saklanan bu sessiz golün kıyısına götürdü. 


![IMG20260321152405.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6hQfKNDNTHckXWwr9hm1eUYXAE8VX35t3ECRMjZEnWo/IMG20260321152405.jpg)

The moment I first saw this lake, I stopped and stood there for a long time, doing nothing but watching the scenery.  Because some views leave you completely speechless. This was exactly that kind of place.  The heavy clouds covering the sky were trying to drift slowly over the lake.  A breeze of unknown origin swept over the mountain peaks, gently swaying the branches of the pine trees.  Sounds I rarely hear in the city echoed in my ears. I was focused on the distant calls of the birds, the earthy scent of the soil, and the sound of the water gently lapping against the shore. 

>Bu gölü ilk gördüğüm anda durup uzun süre hiçbir şey yapmadan sadece manzarayı izledim.  Çünkü bazı manzaralar insanı tamamen susturuyor. Burası da tam da öyle bir yerdi.  Gökyüzünü kaplayan ağır bulutlar gölün üzerine yavaşça süzmeye çalışıyordu.  Nereden geldiği belli olmayan rüzgar dağları tepeleri aşarak çam ağaçlarının daalrını hafifçe sallıyordu.  Kulaklarıma şehirde kolay kolay duyamayacağımız sesler yankılanıyordu. Kuşların uzaktan gelen çağrısıa ve toprağın mis kokusuna ve kıyıya usul usul vuran suyun sesine odaklanmıştım. 


![IMG20260321152333.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVd3om4PLYWqG3eN4qzt5EgYMS6SkzmM335GgVcq5L5ak/IMG20260321152333.jpg)


![IMG20260321152324.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeKzZWeaBgvm3xydG9SdRsXaTgRLJz6CA36yivjWirRxM/IMG20260321152324.jpg)

Amid these beautiful landscapes that nature offers us, one truly feels time slowing down. As I walk along the reddish-brown dirt path, I can feel the weight on my shoulders—and most importantly, the stress—slipping away from me.  Because nature expects nothing from us. It doesn’t demand that I work, strive, be strong, or rush to get somewhere. It simply allows me to be myself. Perhaps the feeling they call freedom emerges in these landscapes. 


>İnsan, doğanın bize sunduğu bu güzel manzaralarda zamanın gerçekten yavaşladığını hissediyor. Kırmızı rengine çalan topraklı yolda adımlarımı atarken üzerimdeki ağırlıkların ve en önemlisi stresin benden uzaklaştığını fark edebiliyorum.  Çünkü doğa bizden hiçbir şey beklemiyor.  Çalışmamı, çabalamamı, güçlü olmamı ve bir yerlere yetişmemi istemiyor.  Sadece olduğum gibi kalmama izin veriyor.  Belki de özgürlük dedikleri his bu manzaralarda ortaya çıkıyor. 


![IMG20260321145216.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXrtnyS6w5gHc7q2F7AojRqKRPdWju13RpnaQFpAEipz/IMG20260321145216.jpg)

That day, I had planned to leave my phone and the internet behind, sit by the lake, talk to nature, and return home feeling happy, fueled by the energy I drew from it. That day, I fully achieved my goal. I simply wanted to breathe in the atmosphere of that beautiful scenery and feel as though I belonged nowhere. 
 
>O gün, telefonu ve  interneti unutup, bir göl kıyısında öylece oturup, doğayla konuşmayı ve doğadan aldığım enerjiyle eve mutlu dönmeyi amaçlamıştım.  O gün tamamen amacıma ulaştım.  Sadece bu güzel manzarada havada var olan atmosferi içime çekerek, hiçbir yere ait olmadığımı düşünmek istedim. 

![IMG20260321145257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYVZtbigcjjrSMVbF5mAkya9d1MdtvjB76hdKbCaZB8n/IMG20260321145257.jpg)

 Although people have certain responsibilities, they need time to be alone and let their thoughts wander.  People need to step away for a while to relieve the stress they feel inside and the physical fatigue they experience. They should escape from concrete walls, the lights that come on when it gets dark, and endless conversations, and hide among the trees. 


 >İnsanların bazı sorumlulukları olsa da yalnız kalmaya ve düşüncelerini serbest bırakmaya ihtiyacı var.  İnsanlar içindeki stresi ve bedenen oluşan yorgunluğu  üzerinden atmak için biraz uzaklaşmalıdır. Beton duvarlardan, hava karardığında yanan ışıklardan hiç bitmeyecek sohbetlerden kaçıp, ağaçların arasına saklanmalıdır. 

![IMG20260321142106.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVPgg541537BvmXVTCZxmKraA1a9P51uueZjQyKJEMzBy/IMG20260321142106.jpg)


I strolled slowly around the lake. The lake’s greenish hue, the pine trees surrounding it, and the sunbeams struggling to break through the clouds—it all looked like a painting. I didn’t want to leave this beautiful scene I was walking through. This was true peace—something I could touch and walk right into. 

>Gölün etrafında ağır ağır adımlarla dolaştım.  Gölün yeşile çalan rengi,  etrafını saran çam ağaçları ve bulutların arasından süzülmeye çalışan güneş ışınlarıi hepsi birer tablo gibi görünüyordu. İçinde yürüyüş yaptığım bu güzel manzaradan hiç çıkmak istemedim. Burası tam da dokunabildiğim içinde yürüyebildiğim gerçek bir huzurdu. 

![IMG20260321142120.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdow9EgnRQ2MnVaiH2giBMVEVGtTDfeKTFzyQS7pKmbLr/IMG20260321142120.jpg)

 >As I was leaving the shores of this beautiful lake, a strange sense of melancholy settled over me. My mind was telling me to stay, while my body was urging me to go home.  In that moment,  I realized that some places give us back not just a view, but also the peace of mind we sometimes forget. 

 Bu güzel göl kıyısından ayrılıkken, içimde garip bir hüzünlük oluştu. Zihnim burada kalmamı, bedenim ise eve dönmemi söylüyordu.  O an  anladım ki; bazı yerler insana sadece manzara değil, zaman zaman unuttuğumuz huzuru da geri veriyor.

​ILLIT – \

Even though it is their debut song, it remains powerful on both the charts and social media platforms. It is a cute and extremely catchy song that is pleasant to listen to.

​AESPA – \
\nIf you love cool concepts and unique song rhythms, AESPA's \
is another hit track that has been constantly trending among K-pop fans up to this very moment.\n\n​NewJeans – \

With its retro vibe, this song is easy-listening and has light, breezy choreography, placing it among the most-streamed songs on music platforms lately.

​BABYMONSTER – \

The song by BABYMONSTER, YG Entertainment’s new rookie girl group, is also trending due to its intense beats and powerful rap, sparking numerous dance challenges among dance enthusiasts.

https://youtu.be/n6B5gQXlB-0?si=QoejvX69xKp8y7a9

​If you want to listen to something more lighthearted and trendy than the rest, I highly recommend checking out LE SSERAFIM’s \

first.
​The next topic I’d like to share is some essential tips and tricks for those who are just starting out with the Rising Star Game and want to achieve long-term profitability.
​The core concept of the game is to progress from a street busker to a world-famous superstar by completing missions and earning STARBITS and STARPRO tokens.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAk2cTof4a3hm4yJ5rmPNMp7HEtDkuPoA6sG5tVeujWg/1778387232876.jpg)

​Reach Level 10 and Level 15 as quickly as possible: Although you won't earn many STARBITS at the beginning, you need to continuously do missions to level up first.
​Upon reaching Level 10: Music Lessons will be unlocked, allowing you to permanently improve your skills.
​Upon reaching Level 15: The Ego system will be activated, so you must prepare to manage it.

​In this game, Energy is life for completing missions. Therefore, if you can afford a small investment or use your earned STARBITS, I recommend collecting the following cards first:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVLyThM3Fqa8wJw2mFubfxxh8MkuvrLTa1JfLyyLELRf/1778387201786.png)

​Pizza Slice (Energy Boost): Instantly refills your Energy to 100%.
​Pizza Box: Allows you to store extra pizzas found along the way, enabling you to play missions consecutively.
​Coffee Cup: Accelerates your energy recovery rate.

​Once you pass Level 15, your Ego tends to rise as you gain more Fans. If your Ego increases, the STARBITS rewards you receive from missions will decrease.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)

You must maintain roughly a 1:1 ratio between your Fan count and Skill points. (For example, if you have 300 Fans, your Skill should also be around 300).

​To increase your Skill, play Music Lesson missions or purchase and collect instrument cards that offer high skill points.
​You can open a card pack once you reach 10,000 STARBITS. Each pack contains 3 cards, and if you get lucky, you might pull Rare, Epic, or Legendary cards, giving your gameplay an instant boost.

​If you are lacking Fans, buy cards with Fans; if you are lacking Skill, buy cards with Skill. Directly choosing and purchasing what you need from the Marketplace is much more strategic.

​There are many Daily Giveaways offering free STARBITS and cards every day within the Hive Community and on Rising Star pages (such as blogs on the Ecency or PeakD platforms). If you don't want to invest capital, you can regularly comment on these giveaways to collect free cards and tokens.

​If there is anything unclear about the Rising Star game, or if you want to know the detailed steps on how to open an account or buy cards, please feel free to ask! By the way, do you enjoy playing games?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)


မင်္ဂလာပါ။ ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ ၂၀၂၆ ခုနှစ် မေလပိုင်းအတွင်းမှာ Trend ဖြစ်ပြီး လူကြိုက်များ ရေပန်းစားနေတဲ့ K-pop သီချင်းအသစ်တွေနဲ့ Chart တွေမှာ နေရာယူထားတဲ့ သီချင်းအချို့ကို မျှဝေပေးချင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။

​LE SSERAFIM – \

အခုတလော Tik Tok နဲ့ Social Media တွေပေါ်မှာ Challenge တွေနဲ့အတူ အရမ်း Trank ဖြစ်ပြီး လူသုံးအများဆုံး သီချင်းတစ်ပုဒ်ပါ။ Dance Beat က ခပ်မိုက်မိုက်နဲ့ စည်းချက်ညီလို့ လူငယ်တွေကြားထဲ တော်တော်လေး ရေပန်းစားနေပါတယ်။

AESPA – \
\nအမိုက်စား concept နဲ့ သီချင်းစည်းချက်ဆန်းဆန်းလေးတွေကို ကြိုက်နှစ်သက်တယ်ဆိုရင် AESPA ရဲ့ \
ကလည်း လက်ရှိအချိန်အထိ K-pop fan တွေကြားထဲမှာ အမြဲမပြတ် ရေပန်းစားနေတဲ့ အောင်မြင်ကျော်ကြားတဲ့ သီချင်းတစ်ပုဒ် ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။\n​\nNewJeans – \

Retro vibe (ခေတ်ဟောင်းပုံစံ) အငွေ့အသက်လေးနဲ့ အေးအေးလူလူ နားထောင်လို့ကောင်းပြီး ကရတာလည်း ပေါ့ပေါ့ပါးပါး ရှိတာကြောင့် Streaming platform တွေမှာ အခုတလော လူနားထောင်အများဆုံး စာရင်းထဲ ပါဝင်နေပါတယ်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)

BABYMONSTER – \

YG Entertainment ရဲ့ လူငယ် Girl Group အသစ်ဖြစ်တဲ့ BABYMONSTER ရဲ့ သီချင်းကလည်း ပြင်းထန်တဲ့ Beat တွေ၊ အားကောင်းတဲ့ Rap တွေကြောင့် Trank ဖြစ်နေပြီး အကဝါသနာရှင်တွေကြားမှာ Challenge တွေ အများကြီး လုပ်နေကြပါတယ်။

​ဒီအထဲကမှ အားလုံးထက် ပိုပြီး ပေါ့ပေါ့ပါးပါးနဲ့ ခေတ်စားနေတာကို နားထောင်ချင်ရင်တော့ LE SSERAFIM ရဲ့ \
ဒါမှမဟုတ် ILLIT ရဲ့ \

ကို အရင်ဆုံး နားထောင်ကြည့်ဖို့ အကြံပြုချင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။

နောက်ထပ်မျှဝေပေးချင်တဲ့ အကြောင်းအရာကတော့ Rising Star Gameကို ခုမှစဆော့မယ့်သူတွေနဲ့ ရေရှည်အတွက် အကျိုးအမြတ်ရချင်သူတွေအတွက် အရေးကြီးတဲ့ အကြံပြုချက် (Tips & Tricks) တွေကို မျှဝေပေးချင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfVLyThM3Fqa8wJw2mFubfxxh8MkuvrLTa1JfLyyLELRf/1778387201786.png)


​ဂိမ်းရဲ့ အဓိက သဘောတရားကတော့ လမ်းဘေးဂီတပညာရှင် (Busker) ဘဝကနေ ကမ္ဘာကျော် Superstar ဖြစ်အောင် မစ်ရှင် (Missions) တွေလုပ်ပြီး STARBITS နဲ့ STARPRO Token တွေကို ရှာဖွေရတာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

​Level 10 နှင့် Level 15 ကို အမြန်ရောက်အောင်လုပ်ပါ: ဂိမ်းစစချင်းမှာ STARBITS အများကြီးမရသေးပေမယ့် မစ်ရှင်တွေကို စဉ်ဆက်မပြတ်လုပ်ပြီး Level တက်အောင် အရင်လုပ်ရပါမယ်။ 

​Level 10 ရောက်ရင်: Music Lessons တွေ ပွင့်လာပြီး ကိုယ့်ရဲ့ Skill ကို အမြဲတမ်း တိုးတက်အောင် လုပ်လို့ရပါပြီ။

​Level 15 ရောက်ရင်: Ego (အတ္တ) စနစ် စတင်ပွင့်လာမှာမို့လို့ ဒါကို ထိန်းချုပ်ဖို့ ပြင်ဆင်ရပါမယ်။

​ဒီဂိမ်းမှာ မစ်ရှင်လုပ်ဖို့ Energy က အသက်ပါ။ ဒါကြောင့် ရလာတဲ့ STARBITS ဒါမှမဟုတ် အရင်းအနှီးအနည်းငယ် သုံးနိုင်ရင် အောက်ပါကတ်တွေကို အရင်ဆုံး ဝယ်ယူစုဆောင်းဖို့ အကြံပြုချင်ပါတယ်။

​Pizza Slice (Energy Boost): Energy ကို 100% ချက်ချင်း ပြန်ပြည့်စေပါတယ်။

​Pizza Box: လမ်းမှာတွေ့တဲ့ ပီဇာအပိုတွေကို သိမ်းထားနိုင်လို့ မစ်ရှင်တွေ အများကြီး ဆက်တိုက်ဆော့လို့ရစေပါတယ်။

​Coffee Cup: စွမ်းအင်ပြန်ပြည့်နှုန်းကို မြန်ဆန်စေပါတယ်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)

​Level 15 ကျော်သွားရင် ကိုယ့်မှာ Fans (ပရိသတ်) များလာတာနဲ့အမျှ Ego (အတ္တ) တွေ တက်လာတတ်ပါတယ်။ Ego တက်လာရင် မစ်ရှင်ကနေရမယ့် STARBITS ဆုကြေးတွေ လျော့နည်းသွားတတ်ပါတယ်။
Fans အရေအတွက်နဲ့ Skill အရေအတွက်ကို 1:1 အချိုးနီးပါး ရှိနေအောင် ထိန်းရပါမယ်။ (ဥပမာ- Fans ၃၀၀ ရှိရင် Skill ကလည်း ၃၀၀ ဝန်းကျင် ရှိနေရပါမယ်)။

​Skill တက်ချင်ရင် Music Lessons မစ်ရှင်တွေကို ဆော့ပေးပါ ဒါမှမဟုတ် Skill များများပါတဲ့ တူရိယာကတ် (Instrument Cards) တွေကို ဝယ်ယူစုဆောင်းပါ။

STARBITS ၁၀,၀၀၀ ပြည့်ရင် ကတ်ထုပ်ဖွင့်လို့ရပါတယ်။ တစ်ထုပ်မှာ ကတ် ၃ ကတ်ပါပြီး ကံကောင်းရင် Rare, Epic သို့မဟုတ် Legendary ကတ်တွေပေါက်ပြီး ဂိမ်းဆော့ရတာ ချက်ချင်း အရှိန်တက်သွားနိုင်ပါတယ်။

 ကိုယ့်မှာ Fans လိုနေရင် Fans ပါတဲ့ကတ်၊ Skill လိုနေရင် Skill ပါတဲ့ကတ်ကို ဈေးကွက် (Marketplace) မှာ တိုက်ရိုက်ရွေးဝယ်တာက ပိုပြီး စနစ်တကျ ရှိစေပါတယ်။

​Hive Community နဲ့ Rising Star စားမျက်နှာတွေ (ဥပမာ- Ecency သို့မဟုတ် PeakD platform ပေါ်က Blog တွေ) မှာ နေ့တိုင်း STARBITS တွေနဲ့ ကတ်အလကားပေးတဲ့ Daily Giveaways တွေ အများကြီး ရှိပါတယ်။ အရင်းအနှီး မစိုက်ထုတ်ချင်ရင် အဲဒီ Giveaway တွေမှာ ပုံမှန်ဝင်ရောက် Comment ပေးပြီး အလကားကတ်တွေ၊ Token တွေ စုဆောင်းနိုင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။

​Rising Star ဂိမ်းနဲ့ ပတ်သက်ပြီး မရှင်းလင်းတာ၊ ဒါမှမဟုတ် Account ဖွင့်နည်း၊ ကတ်ဝယ်နည်း အသေးစိတ်ကို ထပ်သိချင်တာ ရှိရင်လည်း မေးမြန်းနိုင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ မိတ်​ဆွေတို့ကော

body.title: Save Google money ?
body.body:
![915c4390-f9f9-41f1-af9f-ba5b0a9b43c8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bitcoinman/EqSZNKWb2JrxRBgMaoo3mt12ovqXfcVqJQCyR5KWmhLawPaSnuUabheJMRHCSRYfK6Q.png)
<sub>An image I generated with AI </sub>



# Backstory 


There are some stories and many upset customers right now, as folks discover that Google has been installing local AI models for compatible machines and when users first use chrome AI tools.

A 4 GB Gemini nano model , since most folks lack logic and are clueless about the Tech and AI I figured I give y'all an actual run down.

Lots of misleading information out there, like you can't even delete it it just install itself...

Delete a file and disable a feature is not the same thing, some folks removed the model file but chrome just downloads it again, that may seem nefarious to someone not technical, but that's not necessarily the case.

You have to turn the feature off in chrome settin not just delete the file 🤣

# Why 

Why is Google doing this ?  To save money naturally.

Running AI models is fairly expensive,  and Google is trying to offload the compute to the consumer devices, this Gemini nano model they push on devices is fairly lightweight and can run on a fair bit of devices, it's fairly negligible resources in most cases but at scale those tiny bits of resources add up and it's compute that Google is not paying for.


# Practical guide 

Here is a breakdown to see if your device is \

and how to disable. - Check for the model: Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\OptGuideOnDeviceModel Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/OptGuideOnDeviceModel Linux: ~/.config/google-chrome/OptGuideOnDeviceModel If you see a ~4 GB weights.bin, that’s the local Gemini Nano model. - Turn it off properly: Go to chrome://settings → System → On-device AI (or On-device generative AI). Toggle it off. This removes the model and disables features like AI scam warnings, page summaries, “help me write,” and AI tab organizing. Deleting the file alone isn’t a real opt-out; Chrome will just download it again if the feature is still on. # Closing thoughts Is it shady sure ? But nothing illegal, folks upset that Google just installed it without consent, those folks don't understand how updates or terms of service work. Google is free to build their app how they see fit (within the law obviously) and you are free to not use their tools, there are many alternatives. Capitalism is about making profit not sure what folks expect from Google
![2816696b41bf42f7acc3e9a8781460fd.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bitcoinman/23tvXv5ze5tXbBJXm1BVGvgfrhV8MjNL3BpETBLXnpmWUCQ3msxJtTfdKW8JCX4nc3FuK.gif) My inleo subs can have something like 1080 version with sounds included made! and much more for only 5 HBD!

If you can't take personal responsibility for you investing, I hate to brake it to ya, but you ain't nothing but a sucka, you supposed to lose your shit. @bitcoinman's bits of wisdom * Invest only what you can afford to lose and be mindful of the potential risks. * Unless you can accept delivery stay away from futures and stick to physical. * Leverage is a great tool for losing money fast. * Numismatics for the lows stick to smart stacking baby. * Be cautious of new schemes in crypto, like ICOs, DeFi, and NFTs, do your research before investing.

body.title: Delayed Dreams: God Wants Us To Wait
body.body: /> When we are young, we always talk about what we want to become. We want to have a car, a decent job, and a house in 5 to 10 years. Suddenly, everything falls into something we didn't plan or dream about. Certain circumstances were delaying our settlement. To live, we have to strive hard to reach our dreams. We exert too much effort to become something that we dreamed of being. We calculate time; we make our period. You're rushing to get things all done.

/> As time goes by, you notice that everything is different. Everything that you planned becomes unclear. It started to break all your effort. The more you work hard, the more instances your plan is ruined by its own time. You are frustrated with everything, and then you begin to lose all hope. The reason why it sometimes happens: your dreams are being delayed. Even if you give everything, if it's not for you, it will never be yours. But there are delayed dreams that teach us, and God wants us to wait. Sometimes, Jesus showers us with hardships and struggles to test our faith in Him for what we dream.

/> He let us down, teaching us how to get up when everything falls apart. And suddenly, we throw our dreams away and choose to forget everything. Jesus gives us opportunities to walk the path we choose. It's up to you whether you continue to walk on it or turn your back on it. We can never say what tomorrow could bring. Even a thousand downfalls, if it's you, will fall into your arms. The causes of the delays may be our greatest strength and weapon in fighting. Those happenings sharpen us and motivate us to strive more. Those circumstances serve as a milestone in our long journey, helping us become more productive. It serves as a stairway that leads to your dreams. Jesus wants us to appreciate every little step we take and to treasure the hardships we endure. God wants us to cherish all our silent cries and silent battles.

/> If you are dedicated and enthusiastic about pursuing your dreams, everything will fall into place. If you are committed and have a positive outlook about everything, the positive results will surround you. Even if God gives you months or years to wait, everything will be worth it in God's perfect time. Remember that God blesses your life for a specific reason. Do not be afraid; stand still and believe in God's promise. Someday it's going to make all sense, the fruit of all your labor and hard work will come your way, and that will never be taken by anyone else. If everything seems complicated, change your plan, but never change your goal. Fight for it and claim your victories. Pray and know that God is there guiding your way.

/> * * * **_Author's Message:_**_ I am Moxie, a woman who writes down her thoughts and life reflections. My adventures in this world will be shared with everyone. Through my words, I want to let the world know that I exist, and so do my written pieces. Thank you so much for reading. It is nice to know that you came across my blog and spent a few minutes reading my story. See you on the next one!_

body.title: one of the most evocative medieval villages in Friuli
body.body:
![_202605181041.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23yJVRdQF1Wh9bEhtWvweArkzBBDtds1pHBgtWAviTncvf7ipKhRsZ7wNvrER88ZvzamW.jpeg)
edit by canva

***

In the last few days I haven't been able to make any new posts, because I had a lot to do at work, but this last weekend I went to visit an aunt of mine who lives in Friuli Venezia Giulia and I stopped almost by chance. In my opinion, one of the most beautiful villages is the Borgo di Valvasone, and I had the opportunity, almost by chance, but every now and then it's necessary, to visit its castle.

![692038188_1357720549563401_8853124139102821022_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/245T39SNj3SWY9Pn8VUXfyxszHmmkhF3e3YxmLkSTF1pdMzLR6RE7utyzNqKZpgqDJ9LU.jpg)


The castle has medieval origins like many castles in the area, it is always something architectural that fascinates me a lot, in fact when I go around I try to go and see some castle, this one is linked to the family of the counts of Valvason, located right on the Tagliamento river which is one of the most important rivers in Friuli - where it was certainly a military and control route for trade.

![689239845_1357720722896717_3042773602474682597_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23uQvpGiQcd2YpJurhYkdPNo4ExZgjvLV3UmZ86bYbsxjrNmcs9VkTnMNdK745p5ySCzR.jpg)

It's beautiful because this place, which was initially a simple castle, was then expanded and embellished with rooms with frescoes, dignified frescoes and coats of arms. In short, real reception rooms. It's a bit of an evolution that happened to several castles in Italy, which from a simple military manor became almost a villa in all respects.

![692119552_1357720836230039_1866694803056516555_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23tbs41v49vacqsvuM2NPpcSqwq1mMpQpE3KJLV6TZby5utqD6mwZmcPuE6GLrDbS6w3F.jpg)

Unfortunately, this castle suffered devastating damage during the 1976 earthquake, but fortunately, as in many cases, it was recovered and restored with great attention to conservation, maintaining the original layout of the Castle.

![689842600_1357834352885354_639195807938026871_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23uFKdVUdVSMoqfziwM83p5eVVSnWRJjD9J4Z9uraigH2GrH3yCh31sGyDbh2ENdCS6Rw.jpg)

to visit this castle you can only do so when they organize guided tours, it does not work like a typical museum which has pre-established times and is practically always open, in fact below I will leave you some websites and some telephone numbers that you can contact to organize your visit visits that mostly take place on weekends, I basically paid a ticket of around 6 euros + €5 for the guide, and it was a very interesting visit and I always think that the guide enriches and also explains a little about what you see.

![cambia_leggermente_l_angolazione_di_202605181043.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/AKPjdThTNuXzJnzhrhF2EhPGN2yfXjVoY7ZM4opr6HVUiCKakvg8ETgctAJy1Vi.jpeg)

I hope that this discovery of mine has been a nice discovery for you too and I hope that you can visit this place as soon as possible. I wish you all a nice day.

![689256269_1357721216230001_4964409164775256_n.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23u62xjRT2jsTzjahbNxYYj4NTEjVbGnwScKwzYS9tLnJLPzSvecTuBrb9f7cP36budUi.jpg)

**18-05-2026 - Principles of Economics - The Ten Principles of Economics [EN]-[IT]**
With this post, I would like to provide a brief introduction to the topic mentioned above.
(Lesson/Article Code: LS-02)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPD5RzkW2xKGGgXMC6dQizPf9LYTbHArKGRF7BZ5X23u5/image.png)

*Image created with artificial intelligence, the software used is ChatGPT*

**Introduction to the 10 Principles of Economics**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma9koEyECQWzknYWYFKPNPojpQBhTbe2njaRHR8Gvu45z/image.png)

*Image created with artificial intelligence, the software used is ChatGPT*

In this post, I will try to discuss of the 10 principles of economics.
First of all, you might ask, what purpose do these ten principles serve?
Yeah, what purpose do they serve? It's not a simple answer.
We can say that the 10 principles of economics serve to build a sort of mental framework for understanding four fundamental aspects that revolve around an economic structure:
- how individuals make decisions
- how businesses operate
- how markets work
- how an economic system behaves as a whole
We can say that they are the logical foundations of economic analysis.

**The 10 Principles of Economics**
Below are the 10 principles of economics:
• Principle 1:
Decisions involve choices between alternatives (trade-offs)
• Principle 2:
The cost of something is what must be given up to get it,
called opportunity cost
• Principle 3:
Rational individuals and firms think about the margin
• Principle 4:
Individuals and firms respond to incentives
• Principle 5:
Exchange can be beneficial to everyone (Pareto optimality)
• Principle 6:
Markets are usually an effective tool for
organizing economic activity
• Principle 7:
Sometimes government intervention can improve the outcome
produced by the market
• Principle 8:
A country's standard of living depends on its capacity to
produce goods and services
• Principle 9:
Prices rise when the government prints too much money
• Principle 10:
Society faces a Short-run trade-off between
inflation and unemployment.

Below, I'll discuss the three principles that I personally believe are the most important to understand.

**1-Decisions involve choices between alternatives**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX1LSC4N1ygVXaL895i5j1PN2kh33yA3HoSBPS8JdbGc3/image.png)

*Image created with artificial intelligence, the software used is ChatGPT*

The first principle is extremely important. This principle states that \

The concept is immediately obvious and seems simple, but in reality, very few people respect this principle.\nThe profound meaning of this principle is that you can't maximize everything at the same time. In economics, choices must be made with alternatives, and this means deciding what to pursue and what to forgo. It must be clear from the outset that choices involve sacrifices. How many times have we seen companies make a choice between two alternatives and then the next day implement both the \

and the alternatives? Only to end up doing everything poorly!

**2-The cost of something is what you have to give up to get it**
In second place, I put what is considered the second principle.
The cost of something is what you give up to get it (opportunity cost).
How many times have you heard managers talk about \
when faced with a problem? 100? 1,000?\nIt's wrong... I repeat, WRONG!!!!\nOpportunities don't exist in economics or business economics; there's what's called \

We can say that the concept, expressed simply, is that if a company uses a machine to produce A, it gives up producing B.
What is called an opportunity has a cost and also includes:
- wasted time
- sacrificed alternative
- lost profit

Therefore, there is not an opportunity, but **an opportunity that has a cost**, and addressing it means having done the math to understand when this cost will be recovered. Therefore, it is not only necessary to be clear about the cost, but also about the cost recovery plan.

**8- A country's standard of living depends on its capacity to
produce goods and services**
Now, in third place, in terms of importance, I would have placed point 8.
This is a very important principle because in a capitalist system, in the long run, a country's wealth depends on its productivity.
In a nation, technology, innovation, education, and industrial organization have a significant impact on a nation's productivity.
You can't live on air, a good standard of living doesn't grow on trees, but it's a country's productivity that makes us live well.


***Conclusions***
We can conclude by saying that the 10 principles of economics represent the foundation through which we can understand the behavior of individuals, businesses, markets, and the entire economic system.

***Historical Notes and Questions***
The 10 principles of economics did not all emerge at a single historical moment. However, we can say that the birth of modern economics is generally linked to 1776, the year Adam Smith published his book \
\nDid you know that although Adam Smith is considered the \

he was actually first and foremost a moral philosopher?

**18-05-2026 - Principi di economia - I dieci principi dell’economia [EN]-[IT]**
Con questo post vorrei dare una breve istruzione a riguardo dell’argomento citato in oggetto
(codice lezione/articolo: LS-02)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPD5RzkW2xKGGgXMC6dQizPf9LYTbHArKGRF7BZ5X23u5/image.png)



*immagine creata con l’intelligenza artificiale, il software usato è ChatGPT*

**Introduzione sui 10 principi dell'economia**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma9koEyECQWzknYWYFKPNPojpQBhTbe2njaRHR8Gvu45z/image.png)

*immagine creata con l’intelligenza artificiale, il software usato è ChatGPT*

In questo post proverò a parlare dei 10 principi dell'economia.
Innanzitutto vi chiederete, ma a cosa servono questi dieci principi?? 
EEhhh già, a cosa servono? Non è una risposta semplice.
Possiamo dire che i 10 principi dell'economia servono a costruire una sorta di struttura mentale  per comprendere 4 cose fondamentali che ruotano attorno ad una struttura economica:
-come prendono decisioni gli individui
-come operano le imprese
-come funzionano i mercati
-come si comporta un sistema economico nel suo insieme
Possiamo dire che sono i fondamenti logici dell’analisi economica.

**I 10 principi dell'economia**
Qui di seguito elenco i 10 principi dell'economia:
• Principio 1: 
Le decisioni comportano scelte fra alternative (trade-off)
• Principio 2:
Il costo di qualcosa è ciò a cui si deve rinunciare per ottenerlo,
cosiddetto costo opportunità (cost opportunity)
• Principio 3:
Gli individui e le imprese razionali pensano al margine
• Principio 4:
Gli individui e le imprese rispondono agli incentivi
• Principio 5: 
Lo scambio può essere vantaggioso per tutti (Pareto ottimale)
• Principio 6:
I mercati sono di solito uno strumento efficace per
organizzare l’attività economica
• Principio 7:
A volte l’intervento dello Stato può migliorare il risultato
prodotto dal mercato
• Principio 8:
Il tenore di vita di un paese dipende dalla sua capacità di
produzione di beni e servizi
• Principio 9:
I prezzi aumentano quando lo Stato stampa troppa moneta
• Principio 10:
La società si confronta con un trade-off di breve periodo tra
inflazione e disoccupazione.

Qui di seguito andrò a parlare dei 3 principi che io personalmente ritengo i più importanti da comprendere.

**1-Le decisioni comportano scelte fra alternative**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX1LSC4N1ygVXaL895i5j1PN2kh33yA3HoSBPS8JdbGc3/image.png)

*immagine creata con l’intelligenza artificiale, il software usato è ChatGPT*

Il primo principio è di un importanza estrema. Questo principio afferma che \

. Il concetto arriva subito e sembra anche semplice, ma in realtà, sono in pochissimi che rispettano questo principio. \nIl significato profondo di questo principio è che non si può massimizzare tutto contemporaneamente. In economia vanno fatte delle scelte con delle alternative e questo significa che bisogna decidere cosa portare avanti e cosa rinunciare. Da subito deve essere chiaro che la scelta implica delle rinunce. Quante volte abbiamo visto in ambito aziendale prendere una scelta tra due alternative e poi il giorno dopo eseguire sia la \

ed anche le alternative? Riuscendo poi alla fine fare tutto male!

**2-Il costo di qualcosa è ciò a cui si deve rinunciare per ottenerlo**
Al secondo posto metto quello che è considerato il secondo principio. 
Il costo di qualcosa è ciò a cui si rinuncia per ottenerlo (costo opportunità).
Quante volte avete sentito che di fronte ad un problema i responsabili parlano di \
? 100? 1000?\nE' sbagliato... ripeto SBAGLIATO!!!!\nNon esistono le opportunità in economia o in economia aziendale, esiste quello che viene chiamato  \

.
Possiamo dire che il concetto, espresso in parole povere è che se un’impresa usa una macchina per produrre A, rinuncia a produrre B.
Quella che viene chiamata opportunità ha un costo e conta anche:
-tempo perso
-alternativa sacrificata
-profitto mancato
Quindi non esiste un'opportunità, ma **un'opportunità che ha un costo** ed affrontarla significa che si sono fatti anche i conti per capire quando questo costo verrà recuperato. Quindi non bisogna essere chiari solo sul costo, ma anche sul piano di recupero dei costi.

**8-Il tenore di vita di un paese dipende dalla sua capacità di
produzione di beni e servizi**
Ecco, al terzo posto, a livello di importanza io ci avrei messo il punto 8.
Questo è un principio importantissimo perché in un sistema capitalistico Nel lungo periodo la ricchezza di un paese dipende dalla sua produttività.
In una nazione tecnologia, innovazione, istruzione e organizzazione industriale agiscono in maniera incisiva sulla produttività di una nazione.
Non si campa di aria, un buon tenore di vita non cresce sugli alberi, ma è la produttività di un Paese che ci fa vivere bene.


***Conclusioni***
Possiamo concludere dicendo che i 10 principi dell’economia rappresentano le fondamenta attraverso cui è possibile comprendere il comportamento degli individui, delle imprese, dei mercati e dell’intero sistema economico.

***Cenni storici e domande***
I 10 principi dell’economia non sono nati tutti insieme in un unico momento storico. Possiamo però dire che la nascita dell’economia moderna viene generalmente collegata al 1776, anno in cui Adam Smith pubblicò il libro \

.
Sapevate che nonostante Adam Smith sia considerato il “padre dell’economia moderna” lui in realtà era prima di tutto un filosofo morale?


**THE END**

body.title: Why I Believe The Next Economic Crisis Will Be Different From Previous Ones
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQme4iNuUjtQaLnJUVNaTMPejqHbBRvXtpNCy6BiG5NLPoA/1000701596.png 

When most people hear the word “crisis,” they usually imagine one major event.
A stock market crash.
A recession.
A banking collapse.
A housing bubble.
But I think the next global economic crisis may look very different.
Instead of one massive explosion…
it may happen slowly, layer by layer, across multiple systems at once.
And that is what makes it dangerous.
Because slow crises are harder for people to notice until the pressure becomes overwhelming.
Right now, the world is already showing warning signs:
rising debt
weakening purchasing power
geopolitical instability
declining trust in institutions
automation pressure
mental health deterioration
and increasing economic inequality
Individually, these problems may seem manageable.
But together, they create systemic pressure.
And history shows that when too many pressures build simultaneously, societies eventually change dramatically.
The Debt Problem Nobody Wants To Talk About
One of the biggest risks ahead is global debt.
Governments worldwide owe enormous amounts of money.
Corporations carry massive liabilities.
Consumers increasingly depend on credit.
And modern economies have become deeply dependent on borrowing to maintain growth.
But debt creates a hidden long-term problem.
Eventually, debt must either:
be repaid
inflated away
or restructured
And none of those solutions are painless.
This is why inflation may remain a major issue for years.
Because inflation quietly reduces the real value of debt over time.
But while governments may survive inflation…
ordinary people often suffer the most from it.
Especially people holding cash without assets.
That is why I believe future generations will increasingly realize something important:
Saving money alone may no longer be enough.
People may need to understand:
investing
ownership
digital economies
and financial systems themselves
The Era Of Cheap Comfort May End
For many years, the global economy was built around convenience and abundance.
Cheap products.
Cheap entertainment.
Cheap borrowing.
Cheap dopamine.
But the next decade may become more selective.
Not everyone will maintain the same lifestyle expectations.
As costs rise globally, people may slowly be forced to rethink:
consumption habits
priorities
career paths
and long-term security
This could psychologically shock many societies.
Because generations raised during periods of abundance often struggle adapting to scarcity.
And scarcity changes behavior.
People become more emotional.
More defensive.
More polarized.
More reactive.
We may already be seeing early signs of that today through:
political division
social anger
online hostility
and rising distrust everywhere
Economic stress eventually becomes social stress.
The Rise Of Digital Economies
At the same time, an entirely new economic layer is forming online.
And I think many people still underestimate how massive this shift could become.
In the future, people may increasingly earn through:
digital assets
online communities
AI-assisted businesses
tokenized systems
creator economies
remote services
decentralized finance
and internet-based ownership
This changes everything.
Because for the first time in history, one individual with:
internet access
creativity
consistency
and leverage
can potentially build global income streams without traditional gatekeepers.
That is revolutionary.
But it also means competition becomes global too.
Which is why attention, trust, and reputation may become future currencies themselves.
The Human Attention Crisis
I personally believe one of the biggest hidden crises ahead is attention destruction.
Modern systems constantly compete for human focus.
Social media.
Algorithms.
Notifications.
Advertising.
Entertainment.
Fear-based news.
Everything wants attention.
And distracted populations become easier to influence emotionally.
That creates a dangerous environment for long-term thinking.
Because wealth usually requires:
patience
discipline
consistency
emotional control
and delayed gratification
But modern digital systems often reward the opposite:
impulsiveness
outrage
short attention spans
emotional reactions
and instant stimulation
This psychological conflict may become one of the defining battles of the future.
The war for human attention may become more important than many physical wars.
Why I Think Adaptability Will Become The Ultimate Skill
Many people ask: “What skill will matter most in the future?”
Honestly…
I think adaptability itself may become the most valuable skill.
Because industries will evolve faster.
Technology will evolve faster.
Economic systems will evolve faster.
And people emotionally attached to old systems may struggle the most.
The future may reward people who can:
learn continuously
stay emotionally calm
adapt quickly
think independently
and remain patient during uncertainty
Not everyone will succeed financially.
But people who combine adaptability with discipline may gain extraordinary advantages over time.
My Final Thought
I do not believe the future will be entirely negative.
Humanity has survived enormous transitions before.
But I do believe the next decade will challenge people mentally, financially, and emotionally more than many expect.
The world is changing faster than human psychology can comfortably process.
And because of that, many people may feel lost during the transition.
But within chaos, opportunities also emerge.
Every major economic shift in history created:
new industries
new wealth
new systems
and new leaders
The question is not whether change is coming.
Change is already here.
The real question is:
Who will adapt early enough to benefit from it?
#EYS | Turning Patience Into Power 🌍💎

body.title: DemoniCore: A play-to-earn HIVE game
body.body:
![](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/rand/demon/5.png)

[DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com) is a simple and fun [play-to-earn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blockchain_game) game, where you conjure demons to battle in [PvE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_environment) turn-based [RNG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random_number_generation) combat, reminiscent of old-school [RPG games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Role-playing_game).

![Battle](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/rand/battle/2.png)

Slay demons to earn [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE), the native token of **DemoniCore**! You can trade **DCORE** on [Hive Engine](https://hive-engine.com/), similar to tokens of other HIVE games such as **Splinterlands** and **Rising Star**.

![DCORE](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/logo/dcore-logo11-trans.png)

In addition to slaying demons in 1:1 [battle](https://www.demonicore.com/battles), try these **DemoniCore** game modes:
* [Exorcise](https://www.demonicore.com/exorcisms) demons who are possessing and tormenting villagers in an [idle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incremental_game) play-to-earn mode.
* [House Demons](https://www.demonicore.com/house_demons) is an exciting new feature, providing an interactive dimension to the HIVE gaming ecosystem! Summon your own loyal demons, powered by AI, whose looks and personas are limited only by [your imagination](https://www.demonicore.com/about_house_demons). Your house demons will generate income and communicate with you - even responding to your messages - with the personalities that you crafted for them!

![House Demon screenshot](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/assets/house-demon-message-frida.png)

Try [DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com) today, and join our community on [Discord](https://discord.gg/DxD2WEkZk5)!

body.title: One is good. Two is better. Three is awesome.
body.body:
<center>[NBC 5 Chicago](https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/how-and-where-to-find-3-movies-tickets-in-the-chicago-area-for-national-cinema-day/2930617/)</center>
Cinematically speaking, the month of June will be very intense for me. While some people can go weeks, months, and even years without seeing a movie in theaters... Next month I will go to the movies three times, and even though I'm a movie addict, it's been a long time since I've had this triple pleasure (because the movie sequences on my list usually have some more distant release dates from each other, but not during this period).
***Scary Movie***, ***Disclosure Day*** and ***Toy Story 5*** are the three movies I intend to watch. They all premiere only a week apart, making me go to the movies three times. I could do a double feature, or even a triple feature, but besides not being able to wait that long to watch the movies, I could easily end up reading some spoiler that might be spread across the internet (and yes, I hate reading spoilers... especially when they're about movies I'm really looking forward to seeing, because it becomes a very frustrating experience).
Without a doubt, having the opportunity to go to the movies translates into one of my greatest pleasures. Basically, because it's something that makes me genuinely happy. Although ticket prices are increasing (and economically speaking, this is not at all interesting for any consumer's pocket, regardless of the type of good or service being purchased), the pleasure of going to the movies (combined with planning) is something that always overcomes this difficulty.
Fortunately, companies are launching sporadic promotions and some special combos (this option, specifically, for purchasing tickets in pre-determined quantities). This makes ticket prices more accessible, even if they remain a little more \

In any case, when you consume something that makes you feel good, all the effort becomes worthwhile because you are doing something that will make you happy. Experiences with this purpose should always be a priority in our lives... Because they are what make everything more enjoyable.
---
<center>**Una está bien. Dos es mejor. Tres es increíble.**</center>
Cinematográficamente hablando, junio será un mes muy intenso para mí. Mientras que algunas personas pueden pasar semanas, meses e incluso años sin ver una película en el cine... El próximo mes iré al cine tres veces, y aunque soy un cinéfilo empedernido, hacía mucho que no disfrutaba de este triple placer (porque las películas de mi lista suelen estrenarse con bastante diferencia de tiempo, pero no durante este periodo).
***Scary Movie***, ***El Día de la Revelación*** y ***Toy Story 5*** son las tres películas que pienso ver. Se estrenan con solo una semana de diferencia, lo que me obliga a ir al cine tres veces. Podría ver una sesión doble, o incluso una triple, pero además de no poder esperar tanto para verlas, podría acabar leyendo algún spoiler que circule por internet (y sí, odio leer spoilers... sobre todo cuando son de películas que tengo muchas ganas de ver, porque se convierte en una experiencia muy frustrante).
Sin duda, tener la oportunidad de ir al cine es uno de mis mayores placeres. Básicamente, porque es algo que me hace genuinamente feliz. Aunque los precios de las entradas están subiendo (y económicamente hablando, esto no es nada interesante para el bolsillo de ningún consumidor, independientemente del tipo de producto o servicio que se compre), el placer de ir al cine (junto con la planificación) siempre compensa esta dificultad.
Afortunadamente, las compañías lanzan promociones esporádicas y algunos paquetes especiales (esta opción, específicamente, para comprar entradas en cantidades predeterminadas). Esto hace que los precios de las entradas sean más accesibles, aunque sigan siendo un poco más \

. En cualquier caso, cuando uno consume algo que le hace sentir bien, todo el esfuerzo vale la pena porque está haciendo algo que le hará feliz. Las experiencias con este propósito siempre deberían ser una prioridad en nuestras vidas... Porque son las que hacen que todo sea más placentero. ---
**Um é bom. Dois é melhor. Três é incrível.**
Cinematograficamente falando, o mês de junho será muito intenso para mim. Enquanto algumas pessoas conseguem ficar semanas, meses e até anos sem assistir a um filme nos cinemas... No próximo mês eu irei ao cinema três vezes, e ainda que eu seja viciado em filmes, já fazia um bom tempo que eu não tinha esse prazer triplo (porque as sequências de filmes na minha lista geralmente têm alguma data de estreia mais distante umas das outras, mas não neste período). ***Todo Mundo Em Pânico***, ***Dia D*** e ***Toy Story 5*** são os três filmes que eu pretendo assistir. Todos eles estreiam com apenas uma semana de diferença entre eles, me fazendo ir três vezes ao cinema. Eu poderia fazer alguma sessão dupla, ou até mesmo tripla, mas além de eu não conseguir esperar tanto tempo para assistir aos filmes, eu poderia facilmente acabar lendo algum spoiler que pode estar espalhado pela internet (e sim, eu odeio ler spoilers... principalmente quando são sobre filmes que eu realmente estou aguardando muito para assistir, porque se torna uma experiência bem frustrante). Sem dúvidas, ter a oportunidade de ir ao cinema se traduz em um dos meus maiores prazeres. Basicamente, porque é algo que me deixa genuinamente feliz. Embora o preço dos ingressos esteja aumentando (e economicamente falando isso não é nada interessante para o bolso de qualquer consumidor, independentemente do tipo de bem ou serviço que está sendo comprado), o prazer de ir ao cinema (aliado a um planejamento) é algo que sempre supera essa dificuldade. Felizmente, as empresas estão lançando promoções esporádicas e alguns combos especiais (esta opção, em específico, para compra de ingressos em quantidade pré-determinadas). Isso faz com que os preços dos ingressos se tornem mais acessíveis, ainda que continuem um pouco mais “salgados”. De qualquer maneira, quando você consume algo que faz você se sentir bem, todo esforço se torna válido porque você está fazendo algo que vai te deixar feliz. Experiências com essa finalidade sempre devem ser uma prioridade em nossas vidas... Porque são elas que tornam tudo mais prazeroso. body.title: Financial Insights from Nauru Island
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNenPvaKHVFUVQGZwHYv2KRQFJ6u5rx7Cc3N9iZfg5G5G/insights_from_nauru_island.jpg) The island of Nauru is located in Oceania, northeast of Australia, and has an area of ​​21 square kilometers, with an estimated population of 10,670 inhabitants (according to Wikipedia). Understanding the location and size of Nauru Island, let's now delve into the economic aspect, where we can gain some insights into what happened, what could have been done, and some suggestions that can be applied to everyone's daily life. I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

## The Dutch Disease x Nauru Island

Nauru was an island with a considerable phosphate reserve, with phosphate extraction and export being the main economic activity since 1907. With this brief history of Nauru's economy, we can already draw a parallel with the Dutch Disease, which tells us that when there is a large influx of money from a single resource, a curse comes along with that capital.

The curse, or Dutch disease as it's called, occurs because when a large resource reserve is discovered, or when a country has a valuable natural resource, it ends up no longer financially compensating the local population and workers to pursue other professions not directly or indirectly linked to the extraction of the natural resource, which in Nauru's case was phosphate.

In this situation, imagine a worker weighing the options: Is it more worthwhile for me to work on a plantation or extracting phosphate? The answer is that they will choose what yields the highest return, causing all the labor to go to phosphate extraction, resulting in a migration of industries, companies, and agribusiness, all shifting to a single area. And in this scenario, since the owners of other businesses cannot afford similar wages, they end up being forced to close.

The first consequence of focusing on a single natural resource is that the island loses innovation in other areas, development in other sectors, and becomes completely dependent on a single resource. The problem is that natural resource reserves are finite, meaning they have a limit, and if extraction is not well managed, the country will be without revenue stream as soon as the resource runs out.

Nauru isn't a very large island, and with the entire population focused exclusively on extracting a single resource, its fate couldn't have been any different... The phosphate reserves were depleted, and worse, because the economic activity was mineral extraction, the island's environment became severely degraded. The population and the country found themselves without a source of income, and after a while, they began accepting support from the Australian government, offering the region as a place for those seeking asylum in Australia.

The Dutch disease, or the resource curse, has a rather \

solution. Focusing on production and resource extraction is unavoidable; it will always happen. However, what to do with the resource is where many end up getting it wrong, because there's inefficiency in managing the revenue obtained from exporting the resource.

## Insights from Nauru Island

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8ymB4WUVqR3zjrMaZqt1qivWvzWCH2mWmTwy5YwffoL/image.png) </center>
<center>[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/)</center>

The best path forward is to create a so-called Sovereign Wealth Fund for the country, which will manage the capital from the sale of resources. This fund is responsible for diversifying revenues, investing in other areas and businesses, so that there is a better distribution of the nation's resources and ensures that even after the reserves are depleted, there are investments that guarantee revenue for the country.

The insight that can be drawn from this story for people is that, just like countries that discover a reserve and don't know what to do with the money, people often manage to get extra money by doing extra work, selling something, and end up spending it without thinking since it was \

But just as countries have sovereign wealth funds, they could save at least a portion to invest in other sources of income or even in professional development, specializing, or taking a course. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNenPvaKHVFUVQGZwHYv2KRQFJ6u5rx7Cc3N9iZfg5G5G/insights_from_nauru_island.jpg) A ilha de Nauru fica localizada na Oceania, ao nordeste da Austrália, possuindo 21 km quadrados de área, com uma população estimada de 10670 habitantes, segundo dados do Wikipedia). Entendendo a localização e a dimensão da Ilha de Nauru, vamos agora adentrar na parte econômica em que poderemos retirar alguns insights do que aconteceu, do que poderia ter sido feito e algumas sugestões que podem ser aplicadas no cotidiano de cada pessoa. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

>

## A Doença Holandesa x Nauru Island

Nauru foi uma ilha com uma reserva considerável de Fosfato, sendo a extração e a exportação de fosfato a atividade econômica principal desde 1907. Com esse histórico breve da economia de Nauru, já podemos fazer um paralelo com a Doença Holandesa, que nos diz que quando há um grande fluxo de dinheiro vindo de um único recurso, junto desse capital vem uma maldição.

A maldição ou doença holandesa como chamam, acontece porque quando há uma descoberta de uma grande reserva de recursos, ou quando um país tem algum recurso natural de valor elevado, acaba deixando de compensar financeiramente a população e os trabalhadores locais, exercerem outras profissão, que não sejam aquelas ligadas direta ou indiretamente à extração do recurso natural, que no caso de Nauru foi o Fosfato. 

Nessa situação, imagine que um trabalhador vai colocar em uma balança: Compensa mais eu trabalhar em uma plantação, ou extraindo fosfato? A resposta é que eles vão escolher aquilo que dá o maior retorno, fazendo com que a mão de obra vá toda para a extração de fosfato, causando uma migração das indústrias, das empresas, do agronegócio, indo completamente para uma única áreas. E nesse cenário, como os donos dos outros negócios, não conseguem pagar um salário similar, acabam sendo forçados à fechar.

A primeira consequência do foco em um único recurso natural é que a ilha perde a inovação em outras áreas, desenvolvimento em outros setores e fica completamente dependente de um único recurso. O problema é que as reservas de recursos naturais são finitas, ou seja, possuem um limite e se a extração não for bem administrada, o país ficará sem o fluxo de receita assim que o recurso acabar.

Nauru não é uma ilha muito grande, e com toda população focando exclusivamente na extração de um único recurso, o destino não poderia ser outro... As reservas de fosfato foram esgotadas, e o pior é que como a atividade econômica era extração mineral, o ambiente da ilha ficou bem degradado, a população e o país se viu sem uma fonte de renda e depois de um tempo começou a aceitar apoio do governo australiano, oferecendo a região para ter um local para quem busca asilo na Austrália. 

A doença holandesa ou a maldição dos recursos naturais possui uma solução bem \

. O foco na produção e na extração do recurso é algo que não pode ser evitado, sempre vai acontecer, só que o que fazer com o recurso é o que muitos acabam errando, porque há uma ineficiência na gestão dos valores obtidos com a exportação do recurso.

## Insights da Ilha Nauru

<center> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8ymB4WUVqR3zjrMaZqt1qivWvzWCH2mWmTwy5YwffoL/image.png) </center>
<center>[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/)</center>

O melhor caminho até então é criar o chamado Fundo Soberano do país, que fará a gestão do capital que vem da venda dos recursos. Essa fundo fica responsável por diversificar as receitas, investindo em outras áreas e negócios, para quem haja uma distribuição melhor dos recursos da nação e garanta que mesmo depois do fim das reservas, hajam investimentos que garantam uma receita para o país.

O insight que pode ser retirado dessa história para as pessoas, é que assim como países que descobrem uma reserva e não sabem o que fazer com o dinheiro, as pessoas costumam conseguir um dinheiro extra, fazendo um serviço a mais, vendendo alguma coisa e acabam gastando sem pensar já que foi \

. Só que assim como os países tem o Fundo Soberano, elas poderiam guardar pelo menos uma parte para investir em outras fontes de renda ou até mesmo na melhoria como profissional, se especializando, fazendo um curso. ---

The morning air felt quite pleasant and gave me the energy to return to my daily routine. Once everything was ready, I began delivering bread to several regular shops, heading towards the Pusong area. This journey took me through residential alleys along the coast. The atmosphere in coastal areas always has its own story. Rows of wooden houses perched on the water, moored fishing boats, and residents busy with their respective activities created a captivating sight. In one corner, I could see fishermen mending their nets before heading back out to sea to earn a living. However, behind the constant flow of life, I also saw the environmental conditions were quite concerning. Trash was still floating around the settlements and waterways. This sight made me think that maintaining environmental cleanliness is a shared responsibility to ensure coastal areas remain comfortable and healthy to live in. After completing my bread delivery job, I resumed sewing peci (traditional prayer caps) for worship. This work requires precision and patience, but I enjoy it because it has become part of my daily routine. As the afternoon approached, the atmosphere began to feel calmer. I chose to sit and relax after a long day of activities. Today taught me again that life is full of colors. There are activities, struggles, beautiful views, and also lessons about the importance of protecting the environment. 军训结束了，其他人无所谓，最舍不得的就是我们教官了——但是我好像没什么舍不得的很正当的资格名分（这两个词很不对劲，但我没想找到更恰当的词汇）

十四天就这么匆匆过去了，前七天掰着手指头在过，后七天因为一场大雨被击散得七零八落，淅沥哗啦地流走。今天的太阳很大很毒，仅剩余的一点水渍也蒸干了，我一个人来，一个人去，又回到按部就班的独属于我的日子了。
 
“我会牢牢记住你的脸，我会珍惜你给的思念，这些日子在我心中，永远都不会抹去。”前几天下训时我自然而然想到这首歌，我想拿它来告别是最合适最奇妙的，我好想把它唱给你，可是以我的性格我是唱不出来的，也没有这个契机，但是正如词中所说：“我会牢牢记住你的脸，我会珍惜你给的思念，这些日子在我心中永远都不会抹去。”
 
我看大家都在找你拍照留个念想，但是看她们三三两两去，还有帮忙拍照，我一个人还不好拍呢，那就这样吧，就像歌词那样罢。
 
我好像越来越冷漠，或者说越来越理智了，不那么感性了，别的先不论，我挺能接受的，就同我之前所说的，我这样的人，好像从小到大，就这样了，都是命定，就这样吧。
 
——为什么这么说，即使今天负责人专门提醒我们说，这可能就是我们最后一个2025级全体学生聚集在这片蓝天下的夜晚了——下次再聚齐，就是毕业典礼了，到时候恐怕是白天也聚不齐了吧……

可是我对这个事情无感呢。也许感慨落寞了两秒吧，理智就占据主权了——为什么要对几千仅仅碰过几面的人浪费感情呢？
 
我好久没哭了，好久好久了，我真想大哭一场，纯粹的哭也行，为任何事大哭都行，我好想哭——可我哭不出来。
 
今晚就突然想哭一场了，没什么事，就……唉……

body.title: A tour of Montecatini East, beautiful parks and buildings./Un recorrido por Montecatini Este, con sus hermosos parques y edificios.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnJ671G3uWhMtEszFWiRGqX7ErcGPnn74mmG76eEb3Tf/1779105167979.jpg)

Good morning blog friends, how are you? Today I'm taking you on a tour with me again. As you know, I've been exploring the Montecatini area quite a bit lately, and today I'm taking you to explore a bit of eastern Montecatini, a very affluent area just off the road to Montecatini Alto. This area was once much loved by celebrities, especially for the still-operating, though less frequented, hippodrome where horse racing is still held, and also for some of the city's most beautiful hotels. Many hotels are now closed due to the decline in tourism, but the buildings where they once stood remain very beautiful.

The eastern part of Montecatini is a residential area consisting of large tree-lined avenues and well-kept houses. There are several small parks and green spaces that intersperse the houses. Unfortunately, it was a gray and rainy day. Otherwise, in my opinion, the area would have been much prettier with sunshine, especially the green areas. However, it's still a nice place to visit even in the rain. In addition to the houses, there are also various buildings, both simple apartments and more modern and unusual buildings with somewhat abstract and colorful shapes. They're not among my favorite types of architecture, but some people like them.

> Buenos días, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Hoy los invito a un recorrido conmigo. Como saben, últimamente he estado explorando bastante la zona de Montecatini, y hoy los llevaré a descubrir un poco del este de Montecatini, una zona muy acomodada justo al lado de la carretera a Montecatini Alto. Esta zona fue en su día muy popular entre las celebridades, especialmente por el hipódromo, que aún funciona, aunque con menos afluencia, donde todavía se celebran carreras de caballos, y también por algunos de los hoteles más hermosos de la ciudad. Muchos hoteles han cerrado debido al declive del turismo, pero los edificios donde se ubicaban siguen siendo muy bellos.

> La zona este de Montecatini es residencial, con amplias avenidas arboladas y casas bien cuidadas. Hay varios parques pequeños y zonas verdes intercalados entre las viviendas. Desafortunadamente, era un día gris y lluvioso. En mi opinión, con sol, la zona habría sido mucho más bonita, sobre todo las zonas verdes. Sin embargo, sigue siendo un lugar agradable para visitar incluso con lluvia. Además de las casas, también hay diversos edificios, desde sencillos apartamentos hasta construcciones más modernas e inusuales con formas algo abstractas y coloridas. No son de mi estilo arquitectónico favorito, pero a algunas personas les gustan.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR4xsWHeaPM6AUBy5ZwiTJdyhfHecxMqBqT4oXdX3wiUy/1779105168184.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZiM4deMSmobi4fSX9daF28yruQwmYfPgPZj1EK61j3zz/1779105168382.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdM5zwcQXCUCta3ssCUJWQzztUHHd17UorQigZVo5JyUg/1779105168550.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTNuSTfBQnXtt5pJ54hRXHfEgHkvSYqLzzbsdESB5BtDQ/1779105168736.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWZGgWRPj9K33FVkc6vkRk45DVf2Yvpb9B2iZEgwUTMd2/1779105221872.jpg)

Honestly, my favorite part were the Art Nouveau buildings. This city seems to be full of them. Everywhere you turn, there are old, elegant buildings surrounded by trees. We also saw a large park with typical Tuscan trees, a lovely place to take a walk and have a picnic when the weather is nice. This area is also popular because of the many doctors' and lawyers' offices. It's still an affluent area where houses are quite expensive, and you can tell by the fact that they're almost all very well-kept villas. It's a lovely place to stroll, thanks also to the shade provided by the trees. If you happen to be in Montecatini and want to walk in a quiet, beautiful area full of green spaces and charming buildings, I recommend heading here. It's about a half hour from the center, and if you like walking, you can also get there on foot, although it's a bit of a walk. I hope you enjoyed walking with me. See you soon, blog friends!

> Sinceramente, lo que más me gustó fueron los edificios modernistas. Esta ciudad parece estar repleta de ellos. Mires donde mires, hay edificios antiguos y elegantes rodeados de árboles. También vimos un gran parque con árboles típicos toscanos, un lugar encantador para pasear y hacer un picnic cuando hace buen tiempo. Esta zona también es popular por la gran cantidad de consultorios médicos y de abogados. Sigue siendo una zona acomodada donde las casas son bastante caras, y se nota porque casi todas son villas muy bien conservadas. Es un lugar precioso para pasear, gracias también a la sombra que proporcionan los árboles. Si estás en Montecatini y quieres pasear por una zona tranquila y bonita, llena de zonas verdes y edificios con encanto, te recomiendo ir aquí. Está a media hora del centro, y si te gusta caminar, también puedes ir a pie, aunque es un paseo un poco largo. Espero que hayas disfrutado del paseo conmigo. ¡Hasta pronto, amigos del blog!
