body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 26: True Footage
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 26: True Footage

-----

In the underground temple, Angelo, Julio, and Orcilla were watching video footage captured by Volo’s wing camera. 

‘Well, Hamlet’s alive; that’s a true silver lining,’ said Angelo as he looked across at Orcilla.

‘I’ll have to let Yassmay know; she’ll be so relieved,’ said Orcilla, nodding.

‘You’ll have to forward the video footage of the West Camp and construction site to her,’ said Angelo. ‘The Downs’ residents need to know the abuse is real.’

‘Those outfits have a lot of technology built into them,’ remarked Orcilla.

‘Julio makes sure we have the best technology,’ said Angelo as he looked at Julio while nodding.

Julio nodded back in acknowledgement.

‘At least we know who our lower power friend was trying to kill,’ said Angelo as he turned to Orcilla. ‘Do you know anything of him?’

‘He’s Octavius Spiro,’ replied Orcilla. ‘He owns the Spiro Company. He was the second richest Linap before the collapse of Sapey. No one ever saw him. I understand why now.’

‘He grew too big and is losing some of his strength,’ replied Angelo. ‘Hence, he can’t shapeshift like our guest.’

‘She obviously considers him a threat,’ added Orcilla. ‘It appears he can control at least one Sentray, and I’m guessing probably more as they move in packs.’

‘She guessed correctly that he would pump Hamlet’s stomach and poison himself,’ said Angelo as his eyes grew a little wider. ‘He could become an important ally. We just need to heal him.’

‘The seaweed treatment might work,’ said Orcilla.

‘The seaweed, of course,’ said Angelo. ‘It has healed the Sentray before. I’m sure it’ll work on him. I’ll get Volo to convey the message to him. He’s heading back to him now anyway.’

Team foodies had stopped to rest for the day. The Sapiods had helped them set up a temporary camp. 

‘We had a great day, friends,’ said Alex proudly. ‘We collected three quarters of what we need to make our first drop-off.’

‘It better not be all gone in the morning again!’ said Walter in a grumpy tone as he stared and leaned towards Hamlet, who was biting on a mango.

‘Tomorrow, I was thinking about making some blog-worthy creations for our hard-working friends,’ said RJ with a big smile on his face.

‘I’m not sure we can do that, friend,’ said Alex, sounding concerned. ‘Our carts don’t stay full for long.’

‘You’re right for once, friend,’ chuckled Walter as he hugged Alex. 

RJ sighed as he watched Scott dishing out the fruit to both Rico and fluffy Lily. 

Volo appeared out of the dark and landed at the campsite.

‘Haha, he’s back,’ said Octavius as he stood up. ‘Tell us… I mean, show us what’s happening at the camps.’

Volo held his hands up to form a square.

‘Hey Alex, I think he wants to borrow your tablet,’ said Octavius.

Alex jogged over to Big Blue and pulled out his tablet. He held it up to show Volo, who nodded in response.

Alex handed the tablet to Volo, who began tinkering with it and the buttons on his outfit.

‘I hope the technology is compatible,’ sighed Octavius.

After a few minutes, the screen began to flash. Volo looked up and smiled.

‘Haha, I think he’s figured it out,’ chuckled Octavius as he looked at the others.

A video began to play. Team foodies and the Sapiods gathered around Volo, who was holding up the tablet.

Volo had spent about an hour flying over the camp and construction site. He had recorded the Downs residents’ living conditions and working areas as well as how the enforcers were treating some of them. 

‘I can’t believe this!’ shouted Walter. ‘Those bastards are roughing up our friends.’

‘I won’t tolerate this,’ said Octavius. ‘I’m going to pay the superintendent a visit.’ Octavius turned to Ducky. ‘I think I might need some of your family backing me up.’

Ducky roared ferociously. 

‘Haha, that’s it,’ said Walter, waving his fist. ‘Let’s put a list of demands together.’

‘Thank you, Volo,’ said Octavius.

Volo pointed at the tablet. A message had appeared. It read, ‘Take the seaweed treatment. It’ll help you.’

Octavius frowned, then nodded and said, ‘I handed it all over. Maybe I can get some from the camp.’

Early the next morning in the Downs Region, Louis was almost finished compiling the video footage into a twenty-minute edited video to show to the Downs residents.

Yassmay, who was flying invisible, had arrived back in Downs and was searching for someone she could trust. She saw the Hat Lady enter the hotel. Yassmay landed on the road and entered the hotel behind her. She entered the lobby but could not see where the Hat Lady had gone. Then she noticed the lift had just left the ground floor. She watched the numbers. The lift stopped on the floor Louis was staying on.

Yassmay called the lift. She waited and then she got in when it arrived. She went up to the floor Louis was living on. 

The lift doors opened. The Hat Lady was standing in front of them. She was still invisible.

‘Welcome home, Yassmay,’ whispered the Hat Lady.

‘You can see me,’ whispered Yassmay.

‘No, but I can hear you,’ whispered the Hat Lady. ‘Following me up in the lift was a little obvious.’

‘Okay,’ whispered Yassmay.

‘Quick, follow me,’ whispered the Hat Lady. ‘We’re going to Louis’ room.’ 

They walked down the corridor and then stopped at a door. The Hat Lady opened the door with her hotel key. Then they both entered. Louis was sitting on his bed watching his edited video. The Hat Lady closed the door and became visible, and so did Yassmay.

‘Yassme, it’s great to see you’re okay,’ said Louis, sounding relieved.

‘I’m Yassmay, silly,’ said Yassmay. ‘Why? What’s happened to my sister?’

‘Your sister is fine and so are the others,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘Louis needs to catch up with yesterday’s events.’

‘How’d you do it?’ asked Louis. 

‘I let them be caught and rescued them in one go,’ replied the Hat Lady. ‘We need to be a little more cautious now. They would’ve worked out their gear is a little defective.’

‘I found her very quickly with my goggles,’ said Yassmay.

‘I like the wings,’ said Louis. ‘We don’t have anything like this.’

‘Julio is a true genius,’ said Yassmay.

‘The dreaded cult leader?’ asked the Hat Lady.

‘No, that’s Angelo,’ replied Yassmay. ‘He prefers to be called the High Philosopher. He’s very funny.’

‘We really need some friends right now,’ said the Hat Lady.

‘Volo, another great guy, has captured some video footage of what’s happening in the West Camp and construction site,’ said Yassmay. ‘I haven’t been able to watch it yet.’

‘Great, I can add it to my video,’ said Louis excitedly.

‘Absolutely not,’ replied the Hat Lady sternly. ‘You must only use what they gave you. I have an idea what we can do with the new footage.’

‘Well, let’s see what we have,’ said Louis. ‘I’ll convert it into a format I can work with.’

Two hours later, Louis had converted Volo’s video footage into a format compatible for viewing. During that time, Yassmay and the Hat Lady shared all the information they had. Then the three of them watched both Louis’ video and Volo’s footage.

‘The videos tell two very different stories,’ said Louis. ‘I think what they’ve given me is fake.’

‘Around halfway through Freddy’s interview, it appears he has an extra finger on his left hand,’ said Yassmay.

‘Oh, I better edit that,’ said Louis, sounding worried.

‘No, don’t,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘We can use this.’

‘The metadata is all messed up as well,’ said Louis. ‘I’m not sure how they made this video footage.’

‘It must have been Jennifer,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘Okay, now I want you to make a second video.’

The Hat Lady explained her plan, and both Yassmay and Louis listened.

That evening, in the Downs Region town square, a stage and a big screen had been set up. A large crowd of technicians and the remaining Downs residents had gathered. The executive council was in the front row.

Tiberius made his usual grand entrance. He was wearing his royal robes minus the cape and crown. He was standing in his grand chariot, which was pulled by his large Sape. His imperial guards jogged beside him. They were no longer wearing the helmets.

The chariot stopped by the side of the stage. Tiberius slowly climbed down and walked up onto the stage. The imperial guards formed a line behind him at the back of the stage.

The crowd began to cheer as Tiberius raised his hands in the air. The executive council stood up and applauded loudly. 

‘Thank you! Thank you!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘My subjects! My subjects! I love all of you!’

The crowd roared with joy as Tiberius walked to the front of the stage and stood behind a podium that was behind a large sheet of plexiglass.

Tiberius watched the crowd with glee as the roar gradually began to die down.

‘Building an Empire is no easy task,’ said Tiberius. ‘All of us must play our part. And I know all of you here today are doing exactly that.’

The crowd briefly cheered.

‘Not everyone supports us,’ continued Tiberius. ‘Not everyone shares our great values. My life and the lives of my executive council have been threatened many times.’

The crowd became quiet.

‘If they succeed, they will come for you next,’ said Tiberius forcefully. ‘I will not allow that. I will not let them threaten our way of life. I know all of you will stand with me.’

‘Yes! Yes! Yes!’ chanted the crowd.

‘The enemies are the traitors that exploited you up here,’ said Tiberius. ‘The enemies are the cult that terrorised you down below. These enemies have joined forces to destroy us and destroy all that is great about the Downs Region.’

The crowd booed angrily.

‘Our brave enforcers have fought off an aggressive assault from the cult, which is now led by the traitor Orcilla,’ shouted Tiberius. ‘They did so amazingly without any loss of life or casualties. This was only possible because of their dedication and the blessing from the higher power.’

The crowd began to cheer.

‘They’re not the only heroes working hard and blessed by the higher power,’ said Tiberius as a broad smile came over his face. ‘The Downs residents, with the support of our great technicians, are building the new settlements. And they’re doing it with smiles on their faces.’

The crowd began to applaud.

‘I know many of you are concerned because we haven’t established reliable communications with the camps and construction sites,’ continued Tiberius. ‘To put you at ease, our Head of Communications has put together a video of the Downs residents’ experiences at the West Camp and construction site.’

Tiberius stepped back, and the video began to play on the big screen set up behind the stage.

The video showed Downs’ residents energetically working on the construction site. They were singing as they carried and laid bricks. They high-fived technicians who were operating machinery. In the evening, they danced with the technicians and joined in with their dance performances. Freddy, the leader of the Downs residents, was interviewed.

‘How are the Downs residents coping with the longer hours?’ asked the interviewer.

‘It was daunting at first, friend,’ replied Freddy. ‘However, the great support from the technicians and our wonderful superintendent helped us fully harness the spirit of Downs. The eight hours a day just flew by.’

The crowd began to cheer.

‘What are the living conditions like here?’ asked the interviewer. 

‘They’re fantastic!’ replied Freddy energetically. ‘Our little cabins are as good as any you would find on vacation.’

The video showed a quick clip of a luxury cabin. Outside the cabin, it showed two Downs residents sipping fruit juice from giant novelty coconuts while seated in a hot tub.

The crowd gasped in joy.

‘Our time working here has been great, but we still miss Downs,’ said Freddy while grinning. ‘We all thank the Emperor for increasing our working hours so we can come home sooner. I miss you, Mummy, Daddy, and big brother Eugene.’

‘Awww!’ sighed the crowd.

The video ended. Tiberius was about to walk back to the podium when another video began to play. 

Tiberius groaned in annoyance as he heard the Hat Lady begin to talk.

‘What you have just watched is the biggest load of Sape shit imaginable,’ said the Hat Lady.

The crowd began to boo loudly. 

‘You’re just proving to the whole world what a traitor you truly are!’ shouted Tiberius.

'Six-Finger Freddy and the rest were generated by artificial intelligence,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘This is what’s really going on in the West Camp.’

The video switched to aerial footage showing Downs residents covered in dirt. Many of them looked malnourished and sick. Then the video showed an enforcer hitting a Downs resident with a stick because she was moving too slow. 

‘This is all lies and propaganda from our enemy,’ shouted Tiberius. ‘Louis shut this down now!’

Louis got up and rushed over to the technicians who were looking confused.

The video showed aerial footage of the sleeping area. There were no cabins. Instead, there were piles of hay, and the toilets were just holes in the ground.

‘Cut the power to the screen, damn it!’ shouted Louis to the technicians. ‘You heard the Emperor.’

Finally, a technician pulled the power. The crowd was now booing loudly.

‘Do not be alarmed!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘This is all lies!' The first video is one hundred percent real. That female who appeared on screen is a wanted criminal. She’s attempted and failed several times to assassinate me and my loyal executive council. She wants to divide us.’

The crowd finally began to calm down.

Eugene walked over to Louis. ‘I need to see your video, friend,’ said Eugene as he held his hand out.

‘No problem, Head Enforcer,’ replied Louis as he handed Eugene a thumb drive.

The Hat Lady and Yassmay entered the basement below the House of Divine Knowledge temple together. 

‘Ah, sister!’ said Yassme in a surprised tone.

‘You know, we’ve always been better together,’ said Yassmay as she looked at Yassme.

Yassme ran over to Yassmay, and the two sisters hugged.

‘Hey, I like the wings,’ said Yassme as she squeezed her sister.

‘Then you’ll just have to get your own,’ chuckled Yassmay.

‘So what happened up there?’ asked Denise.

‘I think we’ve stirred the pot a little,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘There’s still much to be done.’

Meanwhile, Tiberius had called an emergency executive council meeting in the town hall.

‘Yet again, our security has failed,’ said Tiberius angrily as he looked at the council members with his eyes stopping at Lendall. ‘Head of Security, doesn’t this responsibility fall on you?’

‘I’m sorry, Your Imperial Majesty,’ said Lendall in a slightly nervous tone. ‘I haven’t been quiet myself recently. I’ve had these terrible…’

‘Blah, blah, blah!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘All I hear is excuses. I need for these acts of terrorism to be squashed for good.’

‘We’ll have a dozen helmets working by tomorrow,’ said Miro. ‘Your imperial guards will soon have their hands on L1.’

‘That’s better,’ said Tiberius, nodding.

‘Once she’s caught, we’ll soon bring the other traitors to justice,’ continued Miro.

‘Sleuthing is the best approach, friend,’ added Eugene. ‘I’m investigating that suspicious video of Freddy.’

‘That video is real, idiot,’ shouted Duffo. ‘Are you so stupid that you would listen to the words of a traitor?’

‘I can see you’ve never sleuthed,’ replied Eugene as he leaned forward. ‘All leads must be investigated and fingers must be counted.’

‘We cannot afford to waste resources on this nonsense,’ said Tiberius angrily as he turned to Eugene. ‘In recent times, you and your family have become a great disappointment.’

‘Oh friend, I don’t understand,’ said Eugene, looking surprised.

‘Damn it!’ shouted Tiberius. ‘You address me as “Your Imperial Majesty”, “my liege”, or even just “Emperor”. But not “friend”!’

Eugene gasped and looked at the others who just shook their heads.

‘You acted foolishly and immaturely during the “Friends Not Food” vote,’ said Tiberius. ‘Very unforthcoming of a Head Enforcer.’

‘This law is the backbone of the Downs world,’ said Eugene as his eyes bulged.

‘A law you had no right making, arsehole!’ shouted Duffo.

‘It’s not just you,’ continued Tiberius. ‘Your mother is not giving the Downs children the hard lessons they need to serve the Empire.’

‘Mummy knows best,’ said Eugene, smiling.

‘You’re a complete joke, even by Downs’ standards,’ laughed Duffo.

‘You’re Head Enforcer because the Downs residents respect you for some unknown reason,’ said Tiberius, shrugging his shoulders. ‘If you devote any more energy investigating nonsense. I will have you removed from your position.’

‘Don’t worry, friend,’ said Eugene proudly. ‘I have a list of solid priorities.’

Tiberius’ face turned red with anger.

‘The terrorists’ video is entirely made up of aerial footage,’ blurted out Louis. ‘They must be using the stolen flying vehicle they used to kidnap Julie.’ 

‘Or maybe Julie is just another traitor,’ sighed Tiberius as he looked at Colin.

‘I don’t think she ever learnt to fly one, Your Imperial Majesty,’ replied Colin, smiling.

‘Whatever!’ said Tiberius angrily. ‘Things are getting worse. I want you to draw out the cult using any means necessary.’

Tiberius turned around and walked out of the town hall.

## Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide

Sapien Loop: Worlds Collide is the final book in the Sapien Loop trilogy. It continues directly after the events of the second book. The world above and the world below merge into one world. The conflicts in the underground world are brought to the surface. The new ruling elite attempt to crush any resistance from above and below in an attempt to create a new global empire.

body.title: Mcgi review - Holy week is it biblical
body.body:
https://youtu.be/pPci63IrEQs?si=f3-yAOKnSvxHGcYv
Holy week is the time that talks about the crucifixion, resurrection and death of Jesus Christ in the bible. These thing is carefully told in the bible most especially his suffering before death and his resurrection. However, the Bible does not command or outline a specific yearly holy Week observance as a structured religious calendar event.

From a biblical perspective, what is clearly emphasized is the remembrance of Christ’s death and resurrection. Jesus instructed His followers to remember His sacrifice, especially through practices like communion, but He did not establish a fixed week of ceremonies or rituals around it. This means Holy Week as a tradition developed later in church history to help believers reflect more intentionally on these key events.

body.title: Input wanted-Less Buybacks, More Liquidity?
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEEHJpxB1oSRQKCHmLXB2LRm1bkffjEw13ynAdyM1ahT/padlock_172770_1280.jpg)

Image from pixabay
This post is not financial advice

Also I am discussing the schedule buybacks, not the guaranteed buybacks.  No change to that is being considered.

Quarterly scheduled buybacks are on or before June 1st. If you'd like to sell your tokens, place a sell order for 1.03 before that date or the arbitrage bots will beat you to it.

I have noticed for basically this whole year that most of the folks participating in the scheduled buybacks are the trading bots. 

People for the most part are not selling their UNICOIN. I don't blame them. With  the LP APR being so high (even before the recent bump) why sell for 2-4% when the LPs earn 10x that on average? 

Speaking of LP the real average APR right now  is just over 100% but with adding THREE it looks higher. The bump up to 100%+ is because someone donated their tokens (a surprise to me- so grateful) in addition to what I put in.

**My question to the community**- Would you be alright if moving forward the amount of tokens bought back quarterly (sometimes more often) is reduced but the liquidity is increased?

Our HPH ratio is the highest it's ever been. HP alone is covering roughly 3x the tokens in circulation and that is only HP not any other  tokens.

**What I am proposing:  To mint and pair 200-400 UNICOIN to put into the LP over time**. Not all at once. That pairing would be on this account. However, I would reduce the percentage of buybacks down to less than 10% of circulating supply each round.

The reason for this is new tokens would be minted then locked into the pool. This would increase the circulating supply. People aren't selling for the most part anyway so it seems silly to budget for buybacks people just aren't interested in. It already is kind of silly because roughly 50% of tokens in circulation are held on my main account in the LP yet I still base the buyback amount on total circulating supply.

Buybacks will still take place quarterly  sometimes more frequently but will be based on less of a percentage than right now. I don't have an exact percentage in mind and it may vary.

What do you think? Should I reduce buybacks but increase liquidity (while keeping the price balanced)?

 This seems like it may the the most beneficial overall, but I want to hear your thoughts. Feel free to comment or find me on discord or whatever and let me know what you think.

body.title: Actividad de día de las madres en la escuela de mi hijo/Mother's Day activity at my son's school [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @Motherhood, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para hablarles sobre un día especial y entretenido que tuve con mi hijo, aunque ya había pasado la fecha su escuela programo para el viernes pasado lo que fue el día de las madres, para celebrar en conjuntos las madres y maestras este lindo día compartiendo actividades y comiendo un rato juntos. --- ![REVIEW (5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23yTjdi45hVfNKFxBcMjQPZJrhD68BdjN6yfWsmRBViWjya8gidRWpEGRLjCYt8pcwdEZ.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

> Ese día toco ir temprano a un censo de la nueva escuela a la cual irá luego de terminar este preescolar, pero lo habían pospuesto para el lunes, así que aproveche y fui arreglar a mi hijo para ir a la reunión, como cosa rara llegamos algo tarde jeje, pero no habían empezado aún, lo cual nos permito no desorientarnos del todo, al principio nos reunieron en la sala grande del comedor para ahí hacer diferentes actividades, a lo que escogían un representante de cada grado para poder cumplirlas, en mi caso preferí solo verla jeje ya que mi hijo tenía como sueño, bueno el día anterior nos habían quitado la luz hasta casi las 2 am, con el calor y ello se nos dificulto dormir, por lo que era comprensible que estuviera algo soñoliento. --- ![IMG-20260515-WA0085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EpA3Xd6u4QSKc2DwkZ9i6shMc3sVgZe2LzqbkRM2T195JkSh7ShrPaeFadg1mRy3LpM.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

> Así que aprovechamos y nos pusimos a ver lo que hacían, la primera actividad era cantar, la mamá que representó nuestra sección, gano, luego era bailar pero toda sensual, la maestra explicando a los niños y otras mamás que uno por ser mamá no tenía que dejar de ser carismática y sensual, ahí nos reímos mucho porque la mamá que le toco por parte de nosotros se movía y hacia unas caras graciosas para hacer el ambiente más agradable, también ganamos esa actividad jaja, ya luego vino uno de bailes los niños también participaron y las mamas que estaban ganaron a la final todas. --- ![REVIEW (14).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xp2ZQhGJyaXVzESgk1DPET9vUrPqkc6KoMtvUdDqq9VzYqndCeyXf5fVKKdCfuXPQU8.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

> Era cada actividad entretenida y diferente, los niños también hicieron bailes para nosotras, me gustó mucho que mi hijo pese a que no le gusta mucho bailar frente a todos, se paró y le siguió los pasos a la maestra, tal cual iba la coreografía, yo quería ponerme adelante para grabarlo pero preferí quedarme atrás donde estábamos originalmente sentados ya que de vez en cuando el volteaba y era como sintiéndose seguro que estaba ahí, así que preferí apoyarlo desde ese punto para que no le diera pena, bueno también aprovechando que otras mamas grabaron no había problemas. Ya luego nos reunimos cada sección en su salón para comer un refrigerio, para darnos unos detalles, un reloj con una pintura para labios nos pareció muy tierno el detalle, también una torta que estaba bien sabrosa fue un día diferente, con cada detalle y gesto que nos hizo sentir felices sobre todo al ver sus caritas entusiasmados por ello. --- ![IMG_20260515_114553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoK5rezez5mFBzTeWwysyCRTMpRi5Q8w6suEG9HdyEoFBBHFrTNagfXdk6pvk4Xvfeu.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBUvDS4VGUSKXZtnq7Ra7tfg5djZFshgd11HGrP2RvQ1PutmYjxStDen15aEed2vLg.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @Motherhood! Greetings and blessings. Today I’m here to tell you about a special and fun day I had with my son. Even though the date had already passed, his school scheduled a Mother’s Day celebration for last Friday so that mothers and teachers could come together to celebrate this lovely day by sharing activities and enjoying a meal together. --- ![REVIEW (5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23yTjdi45hVfNKFxBcMjQPZJrhD68BdjN6yfWsmRBViWjya8gidRWpEGRLjCYt8pcwdEZ.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

> That day, we had to go early for a registration at the new school he’ll be attending after finishing this preschool, but they’d postponed it until Monday, so I took the opportunity to get my son ready for the meeting. Strangely enough, we arrived a little late, haha, but they hadn’t started yet, which meant we didn’t feel completely out of the loop. At first, they gathered us in the large dining hall to do different activities, for which they chose a representative from each grade to carry them out. In my case, I preferred just to watch, haha, since my son was sleepy—well, the day before, our power had been out until almost 2 a.m., and with the heat, that made it hard for us to sleep, so it was understandable that he was a bit sleepy. --- ![IMG-20260515-WA0085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EpA3Xd6u4QSKc2DwkZ9i6shMc3sVgZe2LzqbkRM2T195JkSh7ShrPaeFadg1mRy3LpM.jpg) **Image by me** ---

> So we took the opportunity to watch what they were doing. The first activity was singing, and the mom representing our class won. Next was dancing, but it was all very sensual. The teacher explained to the kids and the other moms that just because you’re a mom doesn’t mean you have to stop being charismatic and sensual, We laughed a lot because the mom who represented us was moving around and making funny faces to liven up the atmosphere. We won that activity too, haha. Then came a dance segment where the kids also participated, and in the end, all the moms who were there won. --- ![REVIEW (14).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23xp2ZQhGJyaXVzESgk1DPET9vUrPqkc6KoMtvUdDqq9VzYqndCeyXf5fVKKdCfuXPQU8.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

> Every activity was fun and unique. The kids even put on a dance performance for us. I really liked that my son—even though he doesn’t usually like dancing in front of everyone—stood up and followed the teacher’s steps exactly as the choreography went. I wanted to go up front to record him, but I decided to stay in the back where we’d originally been sitting because every now and then he’d turn around, and it was as if he felt reassured that I was there, so I chose to support him from there so he wouldn’t feel self-conscious. Plus, since other moms were recording, it wasn’t a problem. Later, each class gathered in their own classroom for a snack and to exchange small gifts. We thought the gift—a clock with a lipstick—was very sweet, and the cake was delicious too. It was a special day, with every little detail and gesture making us happy, especially seeing their excited little faces. --- ![IMG_20260515_114553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoK5rezez5mFBzTeWwysyCRTMpRi5Q8w6suEG9HdyEoFBBHFrTNagfXdk6pvk4Xvfeu.jpg) **Image by me** ---

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions, and if you’d like to know more about me, here’s my:**

body.title: [EN/PT] Watching A Fish Tank
body.body: > He just placed his elbows on the small wooden table. With both hands placed on his cheeks, in a pause that seems like he was pausing for a painter to draw a new sculpture. He was looking at this fish tank. There are many of them in that small tank and they all look the same. He kept watching their movement for a while, and he started wandering, if they are watching him back. Or, if there conscious has realized that he is on the outside. The room was too quiet for him to keep thinking. He thought, all creatures share the survival instinct. But, what level of conscious do they have? He thought that, we are unique because, of our awareness that life is a journey with an ending. He thought, what if he took one fish out of the tank? It may not be noticeable, especially in the perspective of, their species lifetime from existence till now. Then he stopped for a moment, to realize that it might be similar to any other living. # PT

>

Ele simplesmente apoiou os cotovelos na pequena mesa de madeira. Com as mãos nas bochechas, fez uma pausa que parecia esperar um pintor desenhar uma nova escultura. Observava o aquário. Havia muitos peixes naquele pequeno aquário, e todos pareciam iguais.

Continuou observando seus movimentos por um tempo, e começou a se perguntar se eles o observavam também. Ou se suas consciências haviam percebido sua presença do lado de fora. O silêncio do cômodo o impedia de continuar pensando. Pensou: todas as criaturas compartilham o instinto de sobrevivência. Mas qual o nível de consciência que elas possuem? Refletiu sobre o fato de sermos únicos por termos consciência de que a vida é uma jornada com um fim. Pensou: e se eu tirasse um peixe do aquário? Talvez não fosse perceptível, especialmente considerando a trajetória da espécie desde sua origem até o presente momento. Então, parou por um instante, percebendo que talvez fosse semelhante a qualquer outro ser vivo.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/enpt-watching-a-fish-tank-3pk)

body.title: Better safe than sorry
body.body:
<center>![PXL_20260508_220848064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xL2eaj2o3GitQBSFEGNZqoRc2tXn1ZTvoycYPaYUTsWHMxCzMjbS4aLRnA1nkqij5x1.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

It's been a crazy couple of weeks.  Between all the fun stuff that @mrsbozz and I have been doing, we also have a lot of prep work to get our travel trailer ready for the summer camping season.  On top of that we have been helping her parents move and it's amazing how much stuff people can acquire over a 45 year period.  

Let's get back to the trailer though.  During the Winter we store our trailer at my parents house.  They have a nice little spot on the side of their garage where their trailer used to sit when they weren't using it.  Now that they no longer have one, we have taken over the parking spot. The ground tends to get a little mushy over there with the Spring rain though, so I usually have to wait a little bit before I can get it home.

Once I get the trailer home, the first order of business is pulling the wheels apart to clean the bearings, inspect them for damage, and then re-grease them and put it all back together.  I've written posts about it in the past if you are interested in going back and looking for them.


<center>![PXL_20260508_220851648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wX1dEkgRyQUZWirvQmUp5wmJr2v2X91EZAEy4NwXrgYVTmbhVcr5kfs9yFwmzPR7W9K.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

Usually things go pretty smoothly and I have the process down to the point where I can do a wheel in about twenty to thirty minutes.  On a two axle trailer that means it takes me about two hours to get the job done.  This year, as I was pulling apart the second to the last wheel, I noticed this little mark on the bearing you see in the photos.  At first I thought it was just some extra grease that I didn't get cleaned off with the diesel fuel.  

I rubbed it a few more times and used my old toothbrush to scrub away at it, but the mark wasn't coming off.


<center>![PXL_20260508_220851648~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wgPfQy998m8GEEUoxoYihmyhFfP3rmczjYyW6SW7RcF5dTb5pWD8BWkJ4sG9qumck3k.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

You might think it doesn't look like much, but as I was looking at it I remembered that I have a couple spare bearings that I keep in my truck just in case, so out of an abundance of caution, I decided to replace it.  With the new bearing in place, I just had to do the last wheel and I was finished up.  Bearings aren't that expensive, so as long as you don't have to replace the race that it sets into, it's not too big of a deal to swap them out.  

However, things like this are the main reason that I do this each year.  A lot of newer trailers have an EZ Lube feature where you just pull a cap off and you squirt some grease into the hub and you go about your merry way.  If you aren't pulling them apart and inspecting them, things like this can get missed and cause you bigger headaches down the road (pun intended).


<center>![PXL_20260508_221106684.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tbpxysr5MfxTRF8zuuSwGSwshvzh7KNM6NAfNAYHxfDSef5vGtqRoEadXJtfoC1PWL8.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

For a job well done, I decided to treat myself, so right before I started the last wheel I fired up the Weber Kettle and threw some wings on.


<center>![PXL_20260508_222310513.NIGHT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23w2kgQgv2j6RhFHBWW8SPG1y9aNt91z15j3BU5cN9GPayGNps7Nhr1eAWyLZFAz6MycR.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260508_222313705.NIGHT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tvkSeLiAimTxCrBZspp8f5KFBVp5PBqUTatAwhKrrqM1RVZ7ZHH2g7WZCELwAJS9GjN.jpg)</center>

--------------------------------

They turned out fantastic, probably one of my best cooks yet with wings.  The skin was nice and crispy without being deep fried and the flavor was totally on point.  I have been buying some rubs from Dizzy Pig seasonings lately and this one in particular was called [Tsunami Spin](https://dizzypigbbq.com/product/tsunami-spin/).  It's an Asian inspired rub that has a nice sweet and savory flavor with just a bit of heat.  

When you take away the cost of the rub, the wings were less than $3 per pound, so when you figure I bought about 2.5 pounds of wings the total cost for this cook was about $10.  I should also point out, those 2.5 pounds of wings were enough for me to get three meals out of it.  Yes, I could have eaten them all in one night, but I tried to exert a bit of self control.  It was hard given how amazing they were.

If @mrsbozz ate chicken on the bone, I'd be cooking a batch of these once a week for us.


<center>![PXL_20260508_232621237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xVEmhKdat654YLg7QxaierANnyvDGjzDrg7JtfqbdDD78tKEcMFhmfUp78FRQ5VoASS.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260508_232630525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xVCz8FUjaQcKPn7kQMV6ZAxQ7yPf7T8AApKJEG9PhXnCm46PPyzDSwUfVvgHus9e8ys.jpg)</center>


--------------------------

Along with my wings, I cracked open this bottle of bourbon that I picked up when we were over in Grand Rapids the weekend before.  I've seen ads for [Wilderness Trail](https://www.wildernesstraildistillery.com/en-us/) in the past, but I have never tried it before now.  It was deliciously smokey and for the $50 to $60 USD price point it is a really good bourbon.  I'd totally buy a bottle of this again.  If I were the sort of person who kept a constant stock of specific brands, this would probably be one of them.

If you ever get the chance to try it out, I highly recommend it.  If I ever make it back down to Kentucky, I am going to make a point of visiting their facility.

Believe it or not, that's only a fraction of the stuff we have been doing lately.  Check back for more excitement and fun with my wife and I!

body.title: I Was the One Laying the Burden on Myself  #LOH289
body.body:
![508227587_2237495376699910_4014985934955848077_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/23wC7Z9utsbEnQZhnBYBZx84hwAhuFBA3zNjj4iNSRvET8DstJkx2sVMCh6XCDWUTL8pA.jpg)

I was so tired I had to drop it all. I feel relieved just saying that out loud.

I had just graduated. No money, no clear plan, just that very familiar Nigerian pressure of figure it out and figure it out fast. So I got a teaching job that was paying me next to nothing. Added a part time news writing job on top of that. Was leading in different spaces, showing up for people, being responsible everywhere I turned.

And underneath all of that was this voice that had been with me my whole life — be more. Do more. Be the perfect daughter. The best student. The financially stable one. The one who always makes the right decisions. The responsible one in every room she enters.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZj4xkeUz3R.png)

I thought that voice was helping me survive. It was actually wearing me out.

The headaches started first. Then I kept falling sick — the kind of sick that comes back before you even fully recover. I stopped sleeping properly. My body couldn’t take it anymore, and I still kept moving because stopping felt like failing.

Until I stopped anyway. Not because I planned to. Because I had nothing left.

I packed up and went to stay with my aunt. I won't pretend it was some peaceful healing retreat — I didn't particularly enjoy it. But the expectations there were different. Lower. The pressure was a different kind and somehow that made it survivable. So I stayed.

For four months I just existed. For once, nobody expected me to have answers.

Here is what those four months taught me that nothing else could:

The burden I was carrying? I had put most of it there myself.

Nobody actually told me I had to be all of these things at the same time. That was just me. My own fear of what people would think if I slowed down, if I wasn't enough, if I needed rest like a normal human being.

I had been so busy trying to meet expectations that I never stopped to ask which ones were even real and which ones I created in my own head.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestbeauty/Eoc5d5a6pcVykRmtpUUQnxRxxGVMoHJgb6twsFDAust283fVygDonEF7gZj4xkeUz3R.png)

I came back eventually. Not because I was fully healed or had everything figured out. NYSC was calling and life doesn't wait for you to be ready. But I came back knowing something I didn't know before — I am not a machine.

Pretending otherwise doesn’t make me stronger. It only makes the fall harder when everything finally catches up with me.

If you are reading this while running on empty, constantly chasing a version of yourself that is never satisfied, I understand that feeling more than I wish I did.

And maybe that was the lesson in all of this.

I just needed to learn how to live for me.

body.title: An amazing discovery...
body.body:
...as apparently a manager told us that it is a Harry Potter theme.
![049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep5p9GCzdAin2UKdjNvd7NQCn4t9nzywHuEfNDA8YvNgQBDY6zLk3bQr84fPpyZ8ngt.jpg)

No, we have not seen the Harry Potter movie, but I know that it was very popular according to the reviews in the media.

This is a two-part post, as the first half consists of the Potter theme, and then in the second half, I will show you a use for another ingenious homemade car. We saw the Harry Potter car in a favourite sports bar, and I was so impressed that I almost immediately asked for permission to take shots of the scene. We were welcomed and after I had taken the shots we sat to have some coffee. They make great cafe latte coffees. 

In the second part I will show you how some wooden planks can be used to build something extraordinary. It was on display in a parking bay next to the road in front of a local nursery, and I just had to take some shots of it. People can get up to all wonderful things here, in order to attract clients and word of mouth is a very effective sales promoter. 
So come and see. 

I love old cars, but I have never seen one driven by a skeleton :)
![043.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoiUg9Ng2JuYSv89D6xUxUZP8u6xaA1KroCNTDUzR9PBDcve8pSioQPi5GA5mRUMGZE.JPG)

I don't know if that guy was panicking or if he was happy. 
![050.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wC7Z5DXgCqotuTYAcwjEvspzL28eqkfnHMri4qwMxhWmWnEte6RW4W2DysnLA3LsKg4.JPG)

No, this one below shows that he has a happy face. I would also have a happy face if I was a skeleton that could drive an old car. Maybe one day :)
![046.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoiUmNH96bb8q7xV5Xa1CoaKr6XVJ9ng7zA8hgcvgW6Jc8s9yBrDS6GothaT8RkDMEf.JPG)

The car is a genuine old Packard. 
![042.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eops1v1USJxbPnpeeSzEA2PJKDXzrUhoY3YGpou576ECHPewLYhNfj494EjtRYyQbse.JPG)

**Now for the second part below.** 

Ever seen a homemade VW (Volkswagen) van that consists of wooden planks?
![045.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xejpECUTUsncSyiY1mmoF7ScbwQH63bbdYu6p8KaKGqrcbWCYBGE71Qp8pXzsjviBTb.JPG)

![044.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23zkpaEoEVHxJspP9AczHzxSbWdWJ8fidZib8RkqoPJbCvvGAMDx2XK4VQRUYFFXBbhQr.JPG)

![046.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23yJGPCk6LM1yunQ3PtSHtPdX4zaEZERjoybTAKwsvrBQA237xTj4AdgKjXsdYhPKuFNh.JPG)

![047.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/242hU9LjQWLzYjz4siTpRdpAm7tX5hNSpsJCs3asWdjuzmhrBfrLFsKQU6fsfZzL3BgmZ.JPG)

Yeah! That's certainly a very lovely artwork and a great way to advertise the sales of succulents. Low maintenance and all, and that's why I called it a silent salesman. 
![049.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpA34RtoDqEAwmnbrvhxWn3pce1zGFXEwHUPCTGpdAZDJvyvEXkPASqYwoWsfhdk1Wo.JPG)

A long time ago I showed you a car, that was covered with green artificial grass to advertise a company that sells the things, and in other areas the same company even had grass covered elephants and rhinos with their brand name on it. No, the elephants and the rhinos were not real, as they were artificial figures, but it also drew a lot of attention. Salespeople can certainly find new avenues to advertise their products, and I wonder what they would come up with next. 

That's what I love about the world of photography, especially when one never knows what one can find as subjects on any given day. It is a very relaxing hobby, and at times it could also get very trying, as so many issues such as the weather, the lighting, and a host of other small things can make things difficult. But I love challenges and most times I will be able to overcome it. It all just takes constant practice. 
Such is life.

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

body.body: I know that feeling so well. Coming back to CS after years away, especially with old friends, is such a unique experience. Before I trust any bot with my inventory, I always check https://skinkings.com/cs2-trade-bot-sites/ to see which sites are actually reputable and have fast payouts. Their breakdowns saved me from a couple of sketchy-looking bots that had terrible reviews about stealing items or holding trades for days.

body.title: Controlling Anger Before It Controls You
body.body:
Hello everyone I be writing on this week prompt on Hive Learners. 
Tempered is also know as anger lol it funny that there would be a prompt as such usually people with hot temper are not to be messed with.

![IMG-20260518-WA0004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mathewdaddywah/23wMj8xkb7mrvu67YjmmeK2qGxhNsX8SD5tNspo57HsLTKVYFdJUoVvEgjYhi4RtaYpa9.jpg)

Images generated with meta AI 

When you see one do as much as possible to avoid them because they can cause harm without even realizing what they have done. I have seen someone that went to separate fight between two hot tempered people and before you know it he lost one of his sight because one of them used bottle to hit him mistakenly.Ever since that day I realized that anger can destroy many things within few seconds.

In my own opinion, people with hot temper normally act before thinking. Small argument can turn into serious fight because they don’t know how to control their anger. Some people will later calm down and start apologizing after destroying things or hurting someone badly.

The painful part is that sorry cannot always repair the damage already done. Some people have lost friends, family members, relationships and even jobs because of anger issues.

Although some people use hot temper as excuse by saying “that is just how I am,” I don’t really think it should always be accepted. Yes, every human being gets angry sometimes because nobody is perfect, but when someone keeps hurting people again and again because of anger, then it becomes a serious problem. 

Imagine someone beating their wife, insulting people everyday or causing harm outside and later blaming it on temper. To me that is not a good excuse because every adult should try to control themselves no matter how angry they are.

I also think many people with hot temper are passing through stress, frustration or personal problems. Some grew up in violent homes where shouting and fighting was normal, so they continue behaving that way outside. 

That is why society should not only blame them but also try to help them. People need better anger management and they need to learn how to walk away from situations when they are getting too angry.

As a society, I believe we should teach children from young age how to control emotions and settle problems peacefully instead of violence.
 
Parents also need to lead by example because children copy what they see at home. Schools, churches and communities should also educate people more about anger and its dangers. Sometimes just talking calmly can solve problems better than fighting.

At the same time, people should also avoid provoking others unnecessarily because some arguments start from disrespectful words. But no matter the situation, violence should never be the answer. 

A person with hot temper may think their anger makes them strong, but in reality lack of self control can destroy lives within seconds.
For me, the strongest person is not the one that fights the most, but the one that can control anger even when upset about it.

In my own opinion anger should be controlled not loose cause it could cause a lot of damage without releasing it and later end with regret.

Thanks for reading hope to see you again @mathewdaddywah blog.

Hello everyone, welcome to Hive Music Festival Week 188 - Round 2.

For this week, I chose to do a cover of “The Steadfast Love” by Pure Worship. This song deeply inspired me because it reminds me of one of the greatest truths we can hold on to as believers—that God’s love never fails, never changes, and never runs out.

Lately, I have been reflecting on how faithful God has been to me through every season, both in moments of joy and in challenging times. There are days when words are not enough to express gratitude, and worship becomes the best language of the heart. This song became very meaningful to me because it speaks directly about God’s constant love and mercy, which are renewed every morning.

As I prepared this cover, I wasn’t just focused on singing or playing the guitar; I was meditating on the message behind every word. It was a moment of personal worship and thanksgiving, remembering how God has sustained me and remained steadfast even when life felt uncertain. That reflection inspired me to share this song, hoping it will also encourage someone to trust in God’s unfailing love.

Music has a beautiful way of connecting hearts and lifting spirits, and I’m grateful for the opportunity to express my faith through this platform.

A heartfelt appreciation to the Hive Music Festival community leaders, curators, and rewarders for your dedication, encouragement, and support for musicians and creators across the world. Your efforts continue to make this community a place where talent and worship can flourish.

Thank you all for listening and for your support. God bless you.

body.title: Sunsets on Lviv Lakes
body.body:
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXFiE3pc3KUaZGaSQn7JpcXPJsWkgY5WBE2tpHt9jVFi/20260502_173349135_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbXFiE3pc3KUaZGaSQn7JpcXPJsWkgY5WBE2tpHt9jVFi/20260502_173349135_ios.jpeg) I had an interesting trip this year to visit my daughter. On April 30, when I drove up to their house, I saw snow in the fields. But it was already summer weather on May 2, and in general, I was pleased with all 6 days when I was visiting. Every day I saw sunsets right at my daughter's house. Why haven't I seen them in years past?
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVYWTE7YCwAw3qxnDaoBX3Ah1CmwdpSb3qingbv2YfWsw/20260502_180013441_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVYWTE7YCwAw3qxnDaoBX3Ah1CmwdpSb3qingbv2YfWsw/20260502_180013441_ios.jpeg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNS7xUY44ApwfcDguJzZkbZ8u4fky3dkKCmCfTNqk91w1/20260504_163618209_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNS7xUY44ApwfcDguJzZkbZ8u4fky3dkKCmCfTNqk91w1/20260504_163618209_ios.jpeg) When the children bought a plot to build a house, there were many large trees on it. They removed most of them, and even I helped dispose of 2 trees. But they still left a dozen birches and a few willows and alders growing. This creates its own positive aura, but creates some inconveniences in the form of foliage and old branches. The kids really don't like it, but it makes me laugh a lot. This year, rooks flew to their site and collected branches to use them in building their nests.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBdkcLRmsAVRCGdctSxiEWfHEiTkFgTo9hX3E7jWcaaq/20260503_165951670_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBdkcLRmsAVRCGdctSxiEWfHEiTkFgTo9hX3E7jWcaaq/20260503_165951670_ios.jpeg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHsQcYmRPYdXa3ZJdxCzsRdtRFbds6jwXG4jpzzwrHD4/20260503_170004125_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHsQcYmRPYdXa3ZJdxCzsRdtRFbds6jwXG4jpzzwrHD4/20260503_170004125_ios.jpeg) The son-in-law built a bird feeder that holds more than 10 kg of sunflower seeds. The birds in the area were delighted with this feeder.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPcPFrSMKkry5F2aTU15ERTkS4Qw8JUhT2kNM2Gr49yf9/20260503_165835237_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPcPFrSMKkry5F2aTU15ERTkS4Qw8JUhT2kNM2Gr49yf9/20260503_165835237_ios.jpeg) View of the sunset from the bedroom window. There are cars outside the fence. These are fishermen who have come to fish.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxgz9GQuwvwhpCPxDYAGUMwUSsAShbSGmEVoVRsu3sGw/20260503_170827002_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxgz9GQuwvwhpCPxDYAGUMwUSsAShbSGmEVoVRsu3sGw/20260503_170827002_ios.jpeg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqo4S4nVgivHsa2LFUjLGEa9aDc3jbsjPAcsi7oa1nME/20260503_164949954_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqo4S4nVgivHsa2LFUjLGEa9aDc3jbsjPAcsi7oa1nME/20260503_164949954_ios.jpeg) This is the view from the gazebo window. More precisely, I would call it not just a gazebo, but a real small house, which now has a refrigerator and a full set of furniture.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzV5EtHUFDdKNiXamxb79bcj4EJgPc9d4KFnQSd6TbT9/20260503_170516171_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYzV5EtHUFDdKNiXamxb79bcj4EJgPc9d4KFnQSd6TbT9/20260503_170516171_ios.jpeg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctUHiMG9u5KGWHRje3udQ5rqRcMiQeJFrxbTJaztwk6P/20260504_163008738_ios.jpeg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmctUHiMG9u5KGWHRje3udQ5rqRcMiQeJFrxbTJaztwk6P/20260504_163008738_ios.jpeg) My son-in-law is sometimes very funny. He said he would cook kebabs for dinner, but in the end I had to cook because he found something else to do. He always finds something to do.
***Friends, goodbye! Until the next walk.***
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png) ***Don’t Worry, Be Happy*** (C) Bobby McFerrin Text & Photography by @apnigrich With love @apnigrich Good luck and have fun ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaptAjVsgabYkFsYE2HhYkehE8Xyx6T7Ud2En1ELgm4g/image.png)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 18 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7802c57128b6f3778c985c045db413c59eb1613a5eaf60a08e619cc39108a9c11bff4f06e1d7ba726fb0f479e5db0c3d_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue muy inspiradora. Empecé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde vi a un grupo de personas haciendo yoga al aire libre. Un par de ellas me contaron que se reunían todos los sábados para mantener la motivación. Me impresionó ver cómo el ejercicio y la conexión con la naturaleza los unía. Mientras caminaba por una de las calles más concurridas, me detuve a observar a un artista callejero que pintaba un hermoso mural. Conversé con él por un momento; me contó que estaba trabajando en una serie de piezas para representar la diversidad cultural de la ciudad. Estaba utilizando colores vibrantes que realmente daban vida a la pared en la que estaba trabajando. Cada día es una nueva aventura en la ciudad, y me encanta conocer a nuevas personas y descubrir pequeñas joyas escondidas en el camino. ¡No puedo esperar por la próxima caminata! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

The Sambil Walk unites Venezuela


![coversambil.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ynX4JLbVZnYQooitNdjqkPsHtGNb92mC2qez8sNRVKDgU4zQXjNDve4NCxUzePifo57.png)


 

> Edit in Canva & Photoshop

------



<div class=\

> The new edition of the Sambil Unites Venezuela Walk has been promoted for several months, and a few weeks ago a press conference was held at the Lidotel Barquisimeto to provide details about this event, which attracts more participants each year. Athletes, runners, families: anyone can participate; you don't need to be a super athlete. It's an event open to everyone. The walk covers a total distance of five kilometers and will take place on May 31st at seven Sambil locations simultaneously. The locations are Caracas, Valencia, Margarita Island, San Cristóbal, and, of course, Barquisimeto. Caracas will participate with its two Sambil locations, as well as Chacao and Candelaria. The walk falls on a Sunday, and the scheduled start time, as announced, is 7:30 a.m., so participants should arrive before the start time. ---- > Desde hace varios meses se promociona la nueva edición de la Caminata Sambil Une Venezuela, y hace unas semanas se realizó una conferencia de prensa en el Lidotel Barquisimeto para brindar detalles sobre este evento, que atrae a más participantes cada año. > Atletas, corredores, familias: cualquiera puede participar; no es necesario ser un superatleta. Es un evento abierto a todos. La caminata tiene un recorrido total de cinco kilómetros y se llevará a cabo el 31 de mayo en siete sedes de Sambil simultáneamente. > Las sedes son Caracas, Valencia, Isla Margarita, San Cristóbal y, por supuesto, Barquisimeto. Caracas participará con sus dos sedes de Sambil, al igual que Chacao y Candelaria. Ese día cae en domingo y la hora programada, según lo informado, es a las 7:30 de la mañana, por lo que quienes participen deberán llegar antes de la hora de salida. ![IMG_20260505_110413_654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EopqXybjsbCVRYvtHvBRX6bTNvMqPy2rfB7ZXPL6DNH66nMDeLknM9KsWWXifj2F88Z.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_105751_227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EoniYGKMXdW7GLRdrqXQcyRr3YUu13xD6x34TuHBeD18MKHkQ8B7awJiWaqfUMuEMEV.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_110504_446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EokcZe82Bo6o79tj6nvfNfRqMGN3CVSRgNqzMygmAVqu9xzN8mvyZrmhGGArU7zxzqm.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260505_120412_854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ynSSnWEnYcE36vMuhuq5JTobwHeB7aFmyTEaDJWeoNL6xcCBe3ja59DBisPVD2SviE3.jpg)|![IMG_20260505_110712_878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23wqnaodMk77fMP4jubqqhpKEC5AaQns5LS291qA6DUfZTrbqVWQPMfbW5q1d84DpGCWJ.jpg) || ![IMG_20260505_114704_821.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23y8jeuajdCnMHYJkuS59SJ519UHpkToKkDP5ty1GNoHz14CC3z8bij4rUJ5SGWVbuEyt.jpg)
----
The press conference was brief. I arrived early, as always, to get a good spot and take some photos beforehand. The manager of the Smabi Barquisimeto Shopping Center and the marketing director were the two people present to provide information about the event and, of course, answer questions and concerns from the journalists, media professionals, content creators, and digital media representatives in attendance. The event was held in the lobby of the Lidotel, which is quite spacious, and everything was already set up when I arrived. The organizers did an excellent job, attending to the media and having everything ready before the scheduled time. ---- > La rueda de prensa fue breve. Llegué temprano, como siempre, para conseguir un buen sitio y sacar algunas fotos antes. El gerente del Centro Comercial Smabi Barquisimeto y el director de marketing fueron las dos personas presentes para informar sobre el evento y, por supuesto, responder a las preguntas e inquietudes de los periodistas, comunicadores, creadores de contenido y medios digitales presentes. > El evento se celebró en el vestíbulo del Lidotel, que es bastante espacioso, y todo estaba ya preparado cuando llegué. Los organizadores hicieron un excelente trabajo, atendiendo a los medios y teniendo todo listo antes de la hora prevista. ----- ![IMG_20260505_113102_668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EowF9ezrae9byDrbUXnA2P8WujKGroA53qQxa2haQqdFPdE4ggS2n8EpHmxzQdnSAp4.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260505_113732_476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpxqKeaxGKPeJX8Sq5aA8akAupvrGcyQYT4WKX8MRXfPdrxNLFxf8eoMqXtdPc2Co84.jpg)|![IMG_20260505_113419_101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpxrHF4Y1MfmwmSuzF6vC83qJXeH9nqzZfSuoMjVLXR1EZqEaHqbENeYzAU1ZjrxUpC.jpg) || ![IMG_20260505_122638_726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpvhpbYCjz7aT73vmFtGJJh9cuogzNZHR5Suy3HtG7z4ZEftwf9mwDjewt71juxD5oP.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_122742_343.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpxqPhvUfds2WrszsNJgKtG5rkBK12pD21gU3hdQryab4pV1btU2pEsV99ktN6RqMso.jpg) ![IMG_20260505_122824_375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpLfTT1yMBn8HMpiT5ez3CSy2jmJutsmUG1cJN7VfeLXfRyJ3qNHadwqb5dSPAUQuzP.jpg) ---- To participate in this walk, you must register, and of course, there's a fee. You can register through the Sambil website. The fee mainly covers the t-shirt. It currently costs $25, although it was on pre-sale for a while at $20. This includes registration, participation, hydration, etc. To attract more people and encourage more to register, there's a grand prize. Sambil Venezuela has partnered with the car brand Changan, and everyone who registers will receive a raffle ticket for a new car. So, those who participate will have a great chance, if luck is on their side, to win a new car. It's like playing the lottery, but that's what makes it so appealing. For $25 just for participating, the possibility of winning a car is very tempting. I might stop by on the day of the walk to watch and take some photos of the event. ---- > Para participar en esta caminata, debes registrarte, y por supuesto, hay una cuota. Puedes registrarte a través del sitio web de Sambil. La cuota cubre principalmente la camiseta. Actualmente cuesta $25, aunque estuvo en preventa por un tiempo a $20. Esto incluye la inscripción, la participación, la hidratación, etc. > Para atraer a más gente y animar a más personas a registrarse, hay un gran premio. Sambil Venezuela se ha asociado con la marca de autos Changan, y todos los que se registren recibirán un boleto para la rifa de un auto nuevo. Así que, quienes participen tendrán una gran oportunidad, si la suerte está de su lado, de ganar un auto nuevo. Es como jugar a la lotería, pero eso es lo que lo hace tan atractivo. Por $25 y solo por participar, la posibilidad de ganar un auto es muy tentadora. > Quizás pase el día de la caminata para verla y tomar algunas fotos del evento. ---- **Photographs taken with mobile phone Tecno Neo 2 - Cover made with the Canva application - Gifs and separators made by me in photoshop** ![bannerjc (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ydNhQkF3nzktNsBY1ibWXpop8Yk6PHgAdZvB1yNp7LqWrGnWNVEwnUxrQUGdfnXD1yh.jpg)

body.title: Film Review: Forty-First (Sorok pervyy, 1927)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/cExcM4sGwWMDMvRjQVc4055JfQ2.jpg)


The Soviet cinematic genre later dubbed the “Ostern” or “Red Western” by Western observers—action‑adventure narratives set in the remote, often desert, frontiers of the young USSR during the Civil War—found its golden age in the decades following the Second World War. Yet its roots dig deeper into the silent era, and one of the earliest, arguably the very first, exemplars of this distinctly Soviet genre is Yakov Protazanov’s 1927 silent film *The Forty-First*. While later works like Mikhail Romm’s *[The Thirteen](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-the-thirteen-trinadtsat)* (1937)—explicitly described in critiques as an early Ostern—would codify the tropes of a desperate band holding out against overwhelming odds in a harsh landscape, Protazanov’s film presents a more intimate, psychologically nuanced prototype. It blends the adventure of survival with a tragic romance, set against the exotic backdrop of Central Asia’s deserts and the Aral Sea, thereby establishing a template that future “Red Westerns” would both follow and simplify.

Protazanov himself is something of an unsung hero of early Russian and Soviet cinema. He was a pre‑revolutionary commercial director who emigrated after the Bolshevik takeover but returned during the comparatively liberal New Economic Policy (NEP) period. His *Aelita*, though a flawed and loosely‑adapted science‑fiction piece, remains immensely influential for its Martian fantasy sequences and its subversive, almost cynical, view of revolutionary zeal. Protazanov was not burdened by the official Soviet ideology that would later rigidify under Stalin, nor was he driven by the formalist experiments of contemporaries like Eisenstein. He was, at heart, a storyteller attracted to compelling narratives and exotic settings. *The Forty-First* offered him precisely that: an adaptation of Boris Lavrenyov’s 1924 novel, written while the author—a futurist poet who had served as an armoured‑train commander in Turkmenistan—was editing the Red Army newspaper *Krasnaya Zvezda*. Lavrenyov drew on his own Civil War experiences in Central Asia, as well as the character of a young female soldier named Anya Vlasova who had pestered him to publish her poetry. This blend of authentic military detail and poetic sensibility translates directly into the film’s unique tone.

The plot is set in what is now Kazakhstan during the Civil War. A Red Army detachment, led by Commissar Yevsukov (Ivan Shtraukh), breaks out of encirclement but must trek through a waterless desert to reach the Red stronghold of Kazalinsk on the Aral Sea. Among them is Maria “Maryutka” (Ada Voytsik), a crack shot who has already killed forty enemy soldiers. After a sandstorm depletes their water, they stumble upon a caravan carrying a single passenger: White Lieutenant Vadim Nikolaevich Govorukha‑Otrok (Ivan Koval‑Samborsky), a courier bearing a vital message from Admiral Kolchak to General Denikin. Capturing him, Yevsukov decides to deliver the prisoner to headquarters. With the aid of sympathetic local herdsmen, they reach a coastal village where only one boat is available for the final leg; Maryutka is ordered to escort Otrok. A sudden storm shipwrecks them on a small, deserted island. There, stripped of the war’s ideological framework, they struggle to survive, gradually shedding their enmity and succumbing to an irresistible physical attraction. Their life together becomes an idyllic, almost utopian interlude—a Robinson Crusoe fantasy mingled with the melodrama of Romeo and Juliet. This idyll shatters when a White aeroplane spots them and a rescue party arrives. As Otrok runs towards his comrades, Maryutka, in a moment of instinctive political duty, shoots him dead. The film closes on her mourning over the body of her lover, the “forty‑first” kill that now carries a profoundly personal cost.

Protazanov’s direction is competent within the technical limits of the era. The Central Asian locations—reportedly authentic, with locals employed as extras—lend the film a palpable sense of place and an ethnographic value rarely seen in Soviet cinema of the time. The depiction of Muslim herdsmen and peasants as sympathetic, ordinary people is noteworthy, offering a precious document of a way of life soon to be altered by collectivisation. However, the film is not without the flaws characteristic of silent cinema. The acting, particularly in the early scenes, tends towards broad, gestural overacting. The editing is occasionally clumsy, and the second half, after the shipwreck, feels somewhat rushed; the transition from enmity to romantic devotion could benefit from more nuanced development. These are, however, minor quibbles in a film that excels in its atmospheric setting and the potent simplicity of its central conflict.

Where *The Forty-First* truly distinguishes itself is in its daring defiance of what would later become the dogmas of Socialist Realism. Made during the NEP period, when artistic control was relatively lax, the film presents Maryutka not as an idealised Bolshevik heroine but as an uneducated, rough‑edged woman who allows herself to fall in love with a class enemy. Her commitment to the cause is portrayed as almost instinctual, a product of her environment rather than polished ideological conviction. Only in the final moment, when she pulls the trigger, does she conform to the Soviet framework—and even that act is followed by grief, not triumphalism. This psychological complexity was out of step with the soon‑to‑be‑enforced Stalinist aesthetics, which demanded unambiguous heroes and clear moral dichotomies. Unsurprisingly, *The Forty-First* was largely forgotten or suppressed during Stalin’s reign—a fate not helped by the fact that Ivan Koval‑Samborsky, who played Otrok, was sent to the Gulag in the late‑1930s purges.

The film’s legacy, however, endured. After Stalin’s death and the ensuing “Thaw,” the story was deemed ripe for remake. Despite ideological objections, the politically connected director Ivan Piriyev—husband of Ada Voytsik—pushed the project forward. The 1956 colour and sound version, directed by Grigori Chukhrai as his feature debut, would become a classic in its own right, but it is Protazanov’s silent original that retains a raw, pioneering power. For enthusiasts of silent and early Soviet cinema, *The Forty-First* is a fascinating curio: a film that straddles genres, blending adventure, romance, and political drama while inadvertently birthing a genre that would later flourish. It may lack the polished craftsmanship of later Osterns, but it possesses an authentic, unvarnished soul that makes it a compelling and historically significant work. Its exploration of love and duty, set against the vast, indifferent desert, remains strikingly resonant nearly a century after its release.


RATING: 5/10 (++)

body.title: 🏖️👔 If you swim, then only with clothes on!
body.body:
/>

This is my skin, unfortunately. And yes, I actually live in Thailand! 😆

Many people look at me and ask, _\

_ Well, what can I do? No amount of high-SPF sunscreen, no special ointments, absolutely nothing helps me. I burn like a match in the sun within 3 to 5 minutes flat. The doctors told me it’s a severe sunlight allergy, but honestly, I'm still not entirely sure. Because of this, whenever I'm outside now—whether I'm just walking down the road, going for a swim, or working out in the fields—I have to be completely covered. I always wear tights, a T-shirt, a thick long-sleeved shirt, a proper hat, and sometimes even gloves. It all depends on the activity and exactly how long I’ll be exposed to the open air. I look like a ninja, but it's pure survival! * * * ### 🚴‍♂️ The Day I Learnt My Lesson (The Laos Nightmare) I didn't always respect the sun this much because I am from Siberia, and we don't have the sun like in Thailand. I actually got these specific, brutal burns during a trip to Laos, and it was a lesson I will never forget.

/> I was out cycling all day, happily drinking beer, and ended up riding about 65 kilometres through the remote villages just outside Savannakhet. Because the beer kept me relaxed, I didn't even realise how badly I was cooking until it was far too late.

> The aftermath was a total nightmare: * **7 Days:** Completely unable to walk. * **0 Movement:** I couldn't turn over or move an inch without agonising pain. My lips and chin were blistered and the skin was so tight that every time I moved my lips I felt pain in my eyes and ears. * **Hospitalised:** I ended up in a local Lao hospital, where the doctors did what they could. They gave me pills, slathered me in heavy ointments, and literally wrapped my legs and hands in bandages.

/>

That is exactly how I had to cross the border and return to Thailand—looking like a mummy (I also had my shins and hands bandaged, but I couldn't find those photos...). In the end, it took about a full year for my skin to properly recover from that single day on the bike.

* * *

### ⚠️ The Moral of the Story

If there is one thing you can learn from my experience, let it be this: **don't drink alcohol in the extreme heat**, or at the very least, wrap up completely first—especially if your skin tends to burn easily.

Please take care of yourselves out here. The sun in Thailand and Laos is incredibly harsh, with UV levels off the charts. Even on days when there is a clear absence of direct sunlight—like when it's completely cloudy or overcast—don't let it fool you! The UV rays cut right through the clouds, reach your skin, and you _will_ burn before you even realise it.

Stay covered, stay safe, and respect the tropical sun! 🙏

body.title: The Thursday Murder Club [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Brown Vintage Retro History Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23wCQpnEC7igNskzx9KEXBxuDGd8Ka8H27dvXM24depLpRXV4kmaRqqFaSaV99c5YaXH3.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

The entire novel takes place in a retirement community in England, where four friends: Elizabeth, Joyce, Ibrahim, and Ron dedicate themselves (every Thursday) to investigating unsolved cases, cases that have already been filed away by the police, and the truth is that they all have a knack for it and, according to their professions, can contribute well-founded opinions; Elizabeth, for example, was a spy in her youth, Joyce was a nurse, Ibrahim is a retired psychiatrist, and Ron is an activist. However, their golden moment arrives when a crime occurs in their community. It's not an isolated case, nor something that happened years ago (like all the crimes they analyze), but one that happened recently. A local real estate developer named Tony Curran suddenly turns up murdered. Then the club of retired friends gets to work on their own investigation, as if it were Scooby-Doo's Mystery Inc. And their investigation isn't in vain; they actually discover clues, like some bones they found in a cemetery, which somehow connect the developer's murder to the previous cases that the protagonists in the club always analyze. >Toda la novela trascurre en un complejo de personas jubiladas de Inglaterra, allí, cuatro amigos: Elizabeth, Joyce, Ibrahim y Ron siempre se dedican (Cada Jueves) a investigar casos no resueltos, casos que ya han sido archivados por la policía, y la verdad es que todos tienen madera para ello y según sus profesiones pueden aportar opiniones con mucho fundamento, Elizabeth por ejemplo fue espía en su juventud, Joyce fue enfermera, Ibrahim es un psiquiatra jubilado y Ron un activista. Sin embargo su momento de oro llega cuando ocurre un crimen en su comunidad, no es un caso aislado ni tampoco algo ocurrido hace años atrás (como todos los crímenes que ellos analizan) sino uno que ocurrió actualmente, un promotor inmobiliario local llamado Tony Curran de pronto apareció asesinado, entonces el club de amigos jubilados se pone manos a la obra en su investigación particular como si se tratase de Misterio a la Orden de Scooby Doo, aunque su investigación no es vano, realmente descubren pistas como unos huesos que encontraron en un cementerio y que de alguna manera conecta el asesinado del promotor con los cimentes anteriores que siempre analizan los protagonistas en el club.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23yxCKFkMk9896ewTazFk9W1zMcmms9NYuNKmsgiMGv3NrXEGAfPfrzPdAsv5gDafLAam.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/53550683063852415/)

I think what attracted me most to this novel is the vindication of the rights of the elderly, mainly the right to be recognized as valuable members of the community, who regardless of their age can still contribute something good to the world. The seniors in the club never let criticism stop them, much less did they think that they were like useless furniture or that because of their age they could no longer do the same things as before. On the contrary, it was when they became even more determined in their purpose, and that is admirable. And the best thing of all is that these activities helped to strengthen their friendship and their skills.

>Creo que lo que más me atrajo de esta novela es la reivindicación de los derechos de las personas de la tercera edad, principalmente el de ser reconocidos como seres valiosos de la comunidad, que sin importar su edad aún pueden aportar algo bueno al mundo, los ancianos del club nunca se detuvieron ante críticas y mucho menos pensaron que ellos ya eran como muebles inservibles o que por su edad ya no podían hacer lo mismo de antes, al contrario, fue cuando más se afianzaron en su propósito y eso es admirable, y además lo mejor de todo es que estas actividades ayudaron a consolidar su amistad y sus habilidades.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uQNhq8u4QxXUyZaFxAM8ATTsQfvxtRGJe4HKRzpBPtqU8aPE1EnG1LxWgqgEtEjaGvZ.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/680888037452889416/)

The characters aren't one-dimensional; on the contrary, they're nuanced and distinct from one another, which leads to rich and dynamic dialogue. I also appreciate the novel's structure, which alternates between third-person narration (my favorite style) and Joyce's diary entries, offering a more personal perspective on the situation. This format is particularly interesting, even more entertaining. I also like the touches of humor in the novel, as they help to lighten the mood during darker situations, such as the crimes themselves.

>Los personajes no son planos, al contrario, tienen muchos matices y son diferentes entre si, lo que genera diálogos muy ricos y dinámicos. También me gusta la estructura de la novela que se alterna entre la tercera persona (mi estilo de narración favorita) y el diario de Joyce, con lo cuál encontramos una visión un poco más personal de la situación, resulta muy interesante este formato, incluso más divertido. También me gusta que la novela tenga muchas pinceladas de humor porque ayuda a distender las situaciones más oscuras, como los crímenes en sí.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/242NirE99JMUv5VbySZqrLeYwNuuTJELJAgfB4zAFz1ZDSwZoQEoFEXb28rvFGPbd5aVN.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/438749188719204978/)

The narrative style of this novel is also quite fast-paced and has many unexpected twists that keep you engaged and excited while reading, so I highly recommend it. Thank you very much for reading my review.

>El estilo narrativo de esta novela además es bastante ágil y tiene muchos giros inesperados que te mantienen muy animado y entusiasmado con la lectura, así que la recomiendo totalmente. Muchas gracias por leer mi reseña.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

body.title: I went to a Greek ice cream shop [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Pink Black Scribbles Doodles Idol Ranking Fandom Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xVRjyQgGAem9JPVmsVnDsRXdTdKMsrfJkzuHehRVrPNnnaorVq8h5gDgq72z2KptpS5.jpg)

Hello everyone! I want to show you a place I absolutely love ever since I first visited it. I think I've shown it to you before, but I'm not entirely sure. It's called Myconos, an ice cream shop with a really interesting concept. All their ice cream is made with Greek yogurt, and obviously, I don't know the recipe or the method, but honestly, it tastes like nothing I've ever had before, not even yogurt-flavored ice cream. This is literally frozen yogurt, completely delicious and also completely healthy (although, of course, it all depends on the toppings you want to add, haha). The ice cream prices range from $1.50 for a small cone to $6 for the larger ones. They also have completely healthy options sweetened with Stevia and low in lactose, although these are obviously more expensive. >¡Holaaaaa! quiero mostrarles un lugar que me encanta y amo con locura desde que lo visité por primera vez, creo que ya se los había mostrado antes pero n estoy muy segura, se trata de Myconos, una heladería con un concepto muy interesante, todos sus helados están hechos de yogurt griego, y obviamente no conozco la receta ni el método pero la verdad es que no sabe a nada que yo haya probado antes, ni siquiera a los helados con sabor a yogurt, estos literalmente son yogurt helado, completamente deliciosos y además completamente saludables, (aunque obviamente todo dependerá también de los toppings que quieras añadirles jaja) Los precios de los helados oscilan desde 1.5$ la barquilla pequeña hasta los 6 $ los helados más grandes. También tienen opciones completamente saludables que están endulzados con Stevia y son bajos en lactosa, aunque obviamente estos son más caros.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-14 at 11.09.01 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23zbRq8R5dBWzCy6MBxfQb7cLKkHbubRXNQZvLFZCZmo9kvwYo3VeH3eXjcxZrS6KQnLh.jpeg)
