The base is frozen Greek yogurt, but you can put any topping you want on top. They give you two options to choose from for toppings and one for syrup, so I immediately thought of chopped brownie because I LOVE IT 😃 😍 and also sliced ​​strawberries, and for syrup I chose a delicious peanut butter cream with pieces that was frankly exquisite.

>La base es Yogurt griego helado pero encima puedes poner el topping que quieras, te dan dos opciones para elegir en toppings y una para elegir sirope, así que enseguida pensé en Brownie troceado porque ME ENCANTA 😃 😍 y también fresas cortadas, y como siroppe elegí una deliciosa crema de mantequilla de maní con trocitos que estaba francamente exquisita.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-14 at 11.09.05 AM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eoc8v5qfuc7A6WdMEkk1E6RUJhWMU9CiREy6K9MZZ4zcgfsMLmGuGNHgDzLsDNJtweF.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-14 at 11.09.06 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eonmv4MDdmLvKxg6RHqwRH24WG863fmde2LE22tcRpmxjXu1AWkpkkNNnsysxuxPWUM.jpeg)

The mix of textures and flavors is incredibly interesting and delicious. The sweet brownie contrasts beautifully with the slight tartness of the strawberries, and the yogurt adds that magical touch. It truly is a magical experience. Furthermore, I really love the concept of the ice cream shop, not only in terms of the flavor of their product but also in terms of the decor. It's as if you were actually on the island of Mykonos in Greece. There are even faux windows with screens that give the impression of an \

It's a shame I didn't take pictures so you could see them.

\n\n>La mezcla de texturas y sabores es sumamente interesante y deliciosa, contrasta el sabor dulce del brownie con la ligera acidez de las fresas y el yogurt da ese toque mágico, la verdad es que es una experiencia mágica. Por otra parte me gusta mucho el concepto de la heladería, no solo en cuanto al sabor de su producto, sino también en cuanto a la decoración del espacio, es como si realmente estuvieses en la isla de Myconos en Grecia, incluso hay ventanas falsas con pantallas que dan la impresión de \

es una pena que yo no le haya tomado fotos para que ustedes pudieran verlas.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-14 at 11.09.05 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EogPfsPsqiqpkTzrS78Vb3H8zQYA4WCdWd63sdSCyExyyp6UVosgG4kQm4bxFHd2Xtw.jpeg)

Whenever I crave a delicious and unique dessert, I come to this place because it truly offers a one-of-a-kind experience. It's also a very peaceful spot where you can relax and unwind. I understand they already have several franchises in Venezuela, but I don't know if they're in other countries.

>Cada vez que se me antoja comer un postre delicioso y diferente vengo a este lugar porque ciertamente me ofrece una experiencia única, además es un sitio muy tranquilo donde da gusto estar y te llegas a sentir relajado. Tengo entendido que ya tienen varias franquicias en el país (Venezuela) pero no sé si estén en otros lados.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-14 at 11.09.05 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23yTmRR8NSJnZm1T1VJBtdeZ1nVdvXK6MhYSedGPCkiuGnaW8EMjiPV9PqtGkb7KxUsc8.jpeg)

Thank you so much for your attention, for reading the post and for commenting if you wish to do so. I send you a big hug.

body.title: White Chick [Movie Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Red Black Modern Cinema Movie Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uFVvLvyjY8RgcLsbzfXM5rcsXyrXpz4CjodCEp3gbiVd9ykkSJv4WuYNndUkYZRK46S.jpg)
[Fuente](chicks)

Hey everyone! How are you? Today I'm going to analyze a cult classic film—because honestly, we can't deny that it's a true cult classic—released in 2004, starring Shawn and Marlon Wayans and directed by their brother Ivory Wayans. In Latin America, it was better known as \

It tells the story of Kevin and Marcus, two FBI agents who, after participating in a failed mission, were punished by their boss with the tedious and almost absurd task of escorting the Wilson sisters (Brittany and Tiffany). They're the typical rich, good-for-nothing girls who treated them like slaves, but to top it all off, they have an accident on the way and both refuse to go to their destination, sporting a broken nose and a split lip, respectively. So Kevin and Marcus decide to replace them, dressing and acting like them so as not to raise suspicion. That's where everything gets out of control 😄.\n\n>¡Hola Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Hoy me voy a dedicar a analizar una película de culto porque honestamente no podemos negar que esta es hoy en día toda una película de culto, lanzada en el 2004, protagonizada por Shawn y Marlon Wayans y dirigida por su hermano Ivory Wayans. En Latinoamérica fue mejor conocida con el nombre: \

Nos cuenta la historia de Kevin y Marcus, dos agentes del FBI que luego de haber participado en una misión fallida fueron castigados por su jefe encargándoles la tediosa y casi absurda misión de escoltar a las hermanas Wilson (Brittany y Tiffany) ambas son las típicas niñas ricas y buenas para nada que los trataron como esclavos, pero para colmo sufren un accidente en el camino y ambas se niegan a llegar a su destino luciendo una nariz rota y el labio partico respectivamente, de modo que Kevin y Marcus deciden reemplazarlas, vistiendo y actuando como ellas para que no haya sospechas, ya ahí es donde todo se descontrola 😄.

https://youtu.be/aeVkbNka9HM

The entire film is filled with satire and physical humor, so it's easy to make us smile and even laugh out loud. Almost all of the Wayans brothers' films are like this, as are Adam Sandler's movies. However, something sets this one apart: it was very bold for its time in addressing stereotypes so openly. The FBI agents working for the Wilson sisters are treated like slaves, partly because of their skin color and partly because they don't share the same social and economic status, without considering that both women's lives were at their mercy. This exposes the superficiality and hypocrisy of high society, although there are also quite a few gender and age stereotypes (women who worry about their weight or what men think of them, etc.). >Toda la película está llena de sátiras y humor físico, por eso no cuesta para nada arrancarnos una sonrisa y hasta una buena carcajada, casi todas las películas de los hermanos Wayans son así, al igual que las películas de Adam Sandler, sin embargo hay algo que diferencia esta del resto y es que fue muy audaz en su época por hablar tan abiertamente de los estereotipos. Los agente del FBI que trabajan para las hermanas Wilson son tratados por ellas como esclavos, en parte por su color de piel y en parte por no ser de su mismo estatus social y económico, sin tomar en cuenta que la vida de ambas estaba a merced de ellos, y esto expone la superficialidad e hipocresía de la alta sociedad, aunque también hay bastantes estereotipos de género y edad (mujeres que se preocupan por su peso o por lo que los hombres opinen sobre ellas etc).

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wCBrkTNGV1amNGj93UajsgBV2hr3iTz44tZUfvoDFuqMFsLJqYyvcbLiDNCDjHueFax.png)
[Fuente](https://aldialogo.mx/queretaro/2019/07/03/actor-terry-crews-confirma-secuela-de-y-donde-estan-las-rubias)

And we also have characters like Latrell, brilliantly portrayed by Terry Crews, haha. Who doesn't love Latrell? He's kind of like Johnny Bravo: the big, strong guy who thinks he can conquer the world but is really just a persistent pest who doesn't take no for an answer. However, Latrell represents those people desperately trying to fit in. He belongs to the African American community, but because he has money, he tries to fit in with the white Californian community, becoming a classist and racist to the point of absurdity. Here are two of my favorite Latrell moments that made me laugh the most and were the most iconic in the movie.

>Y también tenemos personajes como Latrell interpretado grandiosamente por Terry Crews, jaja ¿Quién no ama a Latrell? es una especie de Jhonny Bravo: el tipo grande y fuerte que cree que puede conquistar el mundo pero realmente es un pesado insistente que no conoce un no por respuesta, sin embargo Latrell representa a esas personas que buscan desesperadamente encajar en algún lado, él pertenece a la comunicad afrodescendiente, pero como tiene dinero pretende encajar en la comunidad blanca californiana, volviéndose él también un clasista y racista hasta rayar en lo absurdo. Por aquí les voy a dejar dos de mis momentos preferidos de Latrell que fueron los que más me hicieron reír y fueron los más icónicos de la película
https://youtu.be/TPj9f7PsFh4
https://youtu.be/mkgcMi3JWgI

I have no doubt that the Wilson sisters are inspired by Paris and Nicky Hilton 😄 but the truth is that I think the Wayans did a good job. Maybe it's not the best comedy film of all time, but in the end it stayed in the memory of everyone who saw it at any stage of our lives (in my case, childhood) and it remained forever, as classics do. >A mi no me cabe dudas de que las hermanas Wilson están inspiradas en Paris y Nicky Hilton 😄 pero la verdad es que creo que los Wayans hicieron un buen trabajo, tal vez no sea la mejor película de comedia de todos los tiempos pero al final quedó en la memoria de todos los que la vimos en cualquier etapa de nuestras vidas (en mi caso la niñez) y se quedó para siempre, como lo hacen los clásicos.

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

body.body:
# Hello hive.

Happy and blessed needleworkmonday and happy new week to you all of my colleagues in the @needleworkmonday community, how are you all fairing, i hope everything goes perfectly and smoothly with you all, I'm so excited for being here with you all and i will be sharing with you all on how i cut and sew this beautiful and fitted maxi long gathers gown for my new client, using vintage material.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZj8PpJygjHNLU2pv6Nm6mVPqSSnd7DPcf9uk2dZeeJRn/1779097942256.jpg)

So there was this beautiful flare gown i posted recently that i sewn for my client, she is about 6 or 7 month pregnancy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcH7oc19k8eHo7ghcuYiJRcVbV5C2pk9JpXwWKrS8MEGc/1779098129043.jpg)

So likes the gown very well, so according to her, she came back and told me that one of her friend likes the gown and she's pregnant also, so she wants me to make something like that for her and her own will be long, well i told her to come with her so are we from the her mouth, so after she went out two days later they came back which i didn't have hope that they will come again, then her friend gave me the vintage material and shown me the picture of what she wants, the only problem there was that she needed a urgent work which is not really good for me, i wanted to reject the work but my friend called me out and i said i should try and make it for her that she needed a personal customer, i told her that i will be going for chior rehearsal by 5pm, which was on Saturday, we all know how some customers behave, they joined voices together mistake that is nothing there is something to cut and join doing the gathers will not even take much time, I was like hmmmmm let me see if I will be able to meet up in time because it's already late, i collected the material and then I quickly start working, since the material was 4 yards only i then used only three and a half yeards because she said she don't want it to be too flow or wider, i divided it by two which is the front and the back, i folded them together and measured out the armhole length then i cut it out and I took the full length by 60 of the material then I start stitching the front and the back gathers line, then after that I use my hand and shift it to her complete back and the front body measurements, so i cut out 2 inches pieces of the material i then used it and bind the off shulder neck part, after that i quickly cut another 2 inches pieces and bind the armhole by removing the 14 inches which i off from the upper shulder part then i bind the two side armhole properly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVjsU5t6VgBCPWDWpMZd3L55kp8Nm3GGXWMK6zhJ1JFR/1779100139445.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZBwp7kbhfkyuCuDfuqb7MTB3vk71spRKH2oCWrr8vdFU/1779100139633.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexg6vTRAWZ5dK6na1xRbUUpwQ2qEdFKe5ZpTd5gVd5bC/1779100139847.jpg)

I then joined the front and the back body together.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4Tq1oYXaWYWR4zttPQKd8BMaQwbSErqTiN1qXTTonDM/1779100140016.jpg)

# So here is the outcome of it.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZao4yEzuneSX4viD4S3jiGaw6ksX5EQcQyr8sgbGvWpC/1779101365225.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbo7NmzUQfXWfHKF7ginYcA4ujSVuXrhK5PU31eACxZ4/1779101365406.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmakdC7sTd9qGCneNPjiPHNmCBuLoPGNyjMdmsR7y2ccjz/1779101365582.jpg)

This was so nicely done, they was even in shocked when i called and told them that I'm done with it and I'm going out to weaved it that i will deliver it to them once I'm done with the weaving, it was so beautiful on her, exactly what she wanted, so was so excited that i didn't disappoint her, even though i want to the chior rehearsal late i was really excited that i didn't disappoint her and the gown didn't has any problem.

body.title: Proving That God Exist || MGCI Topic Review
body.body:
The Bible shows us a clear evidence that God is real, powerful and present everywhere. Many people have experienced the hand of God through miracles, protection, healing and answered prayers, these experiences help to strengthen our faith in God’s existence.

The Bible says in the book of Psalm 19:1 that, “The heavens declare the glory of God”. When we look at the beauty of the sky, the sun, the moon, the oceans, and human life itself, we can clearly see that there is a great Creator behind everything. A building cannot exist without a builder and creation cannot exist without a Creator, this is one of the strongest proofs that God exists.

Another proof of God’s existence is the life of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ came into the world, performed miracles, healed the sick, raised the dead and gave hope to hopeless people. His teachings changed lives, and even today millions of people still follow Him. The Bible records His death and resurrection which showed God’s great power over sin and death.

Human conscience also proves that God exists. Deep inside every human being is the knowledge of right and wrong, even when nobody is watching, people often know when they have done evil. This moral understanding did not come by accident, it came from God who created mankind in His image.

Faith in God brings peace, direction and hope to mankind. Although we may not see God physically, His works speak loudly every day. As Christians, we should continue to trust Him, worship Him and share His love with others because God is truly real and forever alive.

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexwNi5q1DCWVAHXcs34pB8qNenmzMFSDYLY5y1roRuyp/img_4735.png)


# Microsoft Copilot ROI: Was die Lizenz wirklich bringt

30 Euro pro Nutzer, pro Monat. Multipliziert mit 50, 200 oder 500 Mitarbeitern.
Das ist kein Kleingeld – und trotzdem haben viele Unternehmen Microsoft Copilot
eingekauft, ohne eine klare Antwort auf die entscheidende Frage zu haben:
**Was bringt das eigentlich konkret?**

Hier meine ehrliche Einschätzung aus der Praxis – keine Marketing-Prosa.



---

## Was Copilot wirklich kostet

Der Listenpreis liegt aktuell bei rund **30 Euro pro Nutzer und Monat** –
zusätzlich zur bestehenden Microsoft 365 Lizenz.
Für ein Unternehmen mit 100 Mitarbeitern: **36.000 Euro pro Jahr**, nur für die Lizenz.

Dazu kommen Kosten, die oft unterschätzt werden:

- Interner Aufwand für Einführung und Change Management
- Schulungen und Enablement der Mitarbeiter
- Externe Begleitung, wenn internes Know-how fehlt
- Zeit für Use-Case-Entwicklung und Pilotprojekte

Wer nur die Lizenzkosten im Blick hat, rechnet sich arm.
Der echte ROI entsteht erst, wenn Copilot tatsächlich genutzt wird –
und das passiert nicht von allein.

---

## Was in der Praxis wirklich funktioniert

Aus meiner Arbeit mit Unternehmen: Diese drei Use Cases bringen den
schnellsten und messbarsten Mehrwert.

### 1. Meeting-Nachbereitung

Copilot fasst Meetings automatisch zusammen, extrahiert Aufgaben und erstellt
Follow-up-E-Mails. Wer drei bis vier Meetings täglich hat, spart damit
**locker 30 bis 45 Minuten pro Tag** – pro Person.

Das ist einer der am einfachsten messbaren ROI-Hebel überhaupt.

### 2. Erstentwürfe für Texte und Präsentationen

Angebote, Statusberichte, interne Kommunikation – Copilot liefert einen
belastbaren Erstentwurf in Sekunden. Die Zeit für Überarbeitung statt
Neuerstellung ist deutlich geringer.

### 3. Informationen aus dem Unternehmens-Kontext finden

*„Welche Vereinbarungen haben wir mit Kunde X?\

*

Copilot durchsucht E-Mails, Teams-Chats und SharePoint-Dokumente und gibt
eine Zusammenfassung zurück. Wissensarbeit wird damit deutlich schneller –
besonders in Unternehmen mit gewachsenen Dokumentenstrukturen.

---

## Wann sich die Investition rechnet – und wann nicht

Copilot rechnet sich, wenn drei Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind:

**1. Die Datenbasis stimmt.**
Copilot ist nur so gut wie die Informationen, auf die es zugreifen kann.
Wer SharePoint nicht pflegt oder wichtige Inhalte nur in E-Mail-Anhängen
vergraben hält, wird wenig davon haben.

**2. Die Mitarbeiter werden aktiv eingeführt.**
Kein Onboarding, kein Nutzen. So simpel ist das.
Wer Copilot einfach aktiviert und wartet, verbrennt Lizenzkosten.

**3. Es gibt konkrete Use Cases.**

body.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g78f66689b8943edd2e71cfe7734f40d72863ef140bd4931b121b6743fd48696929e79025595ce9d642cf00f50f4f746a96f7bc3e87ad7389959a898af21ed80f_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 시간 여행자의 사랑
### 줄거리
미래에서 온 시간 여행자, 지훈은 과거의 아름다운 도시에서 우연히 만난 소녀, 수아와 사랑에 빠진다. 하지만 시간의 법칙에 따라 그들은 함께할 수 없는 운명이다. 지훈은 수아를 지키기 위해 과거와 미래를 오가며 사랑을 지키려 한다.

## 2. 이웃집 소녀
### 줄거리
대학교에 진학한 민수는 옆집에 사는 어린 시절 친구, 지혜와 다시 만나게 된다. 서로의 마음을 알아가는 과정에서 우정이 사랑으로 발전하지만, 지혜의 가족 문제로 인해 두 사람은 갈등을 겪는다. 그들은 서로를 위해 어떤 선택을 할 것인가?

## 3. 반짝이는 별빛 아래
### 줄거리
도시의 소음에서 벗어나 자연 속에서 힐링을 원한 소연은 별이 빛나는 캠핑장에서 우연히 만난 여행자, 태현과의 짧은 만남을 통해 진정한 사랑의 의미를 깨닫게 된다. 그들은 서로의 상처를 치유하며 특별한 인연을 만들어간다.

## 4. 사라진 기억
### 줄거리
교통사고로 기억을 잃은 주희는 자신의 과거를 찾기 위해 노력한다. 그러던 중, 그녀의 기억 속에 남아있는 한 남자, 상민과 다시 만나게 된다. 그들은 서로의 기억을 되찾기 위해 함께 노력하며, 사랑이란 무엇인지 다시 한 번 생각하게 된다.

## 5. 두 세계의 사랑
### 줄거리
인간 세계와 마법 세계가 서로 다른 두 세계에서 태어난 소녀, 리나와 마법사, 카엘은 서로의 세계를 오가며 사랑에 빠진다. 하지만 두 세계의 갈등으로 인해 그들의 사랑은 큰 시련을 맞이하게 된다. 과연 그들은 사랑을 지킬 수 있을까?

## 6. 첫사랑의 재회
### 줄거리
고등학교 시절 첫사랑이었던 두 사람, 하늘과 준호는 우연히 재회하게 된다. 서로의 삶은 많이 변했지만, 그들은 여전히 서로에게 특별한 감정을 느낀다. 과거의 상처를 극복하고 다시 사랑을 시작할 수 있을까?

## 7. 디지털 사랑
### 줄거리
온라인 게임에서 만난 두 사람, 민재와 소희는 가상의 세계에서 깊은 유대감을 형성한다. 현실에서의 만남이 불가능한 상황 속에서도 그들은 서로의 마음을 나누며 사랑을 키워간다. 과연 그들은 현실에서도 사랑을 이룰 수 있을까?

## 8. 사랑의 편지
### 줄거리
전쟁 중 서로에게 편지를 주고받으며 사랑을 키운 두 사람, 연우와 세진은 전쟁이 끝난 후에도 서로를 찾지 못한다. 수십 년 후, 한 여성이 우연히 그들의 편지를 발견하게 되면서 두 사람의 사랑 이야기가 다시 시작된다.

---

이와 같은 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리를 통해 독자들은 각기 다른 사랑의 형태와 감정을 경험할 수 있습니다. 각 이야기의 주인공들이 겪는 갈등과 극복 과정을 통해 사랑의 진정한 의미를 다시 한 번 생각해보는 기회를 제공할 수 있습니다.

***

***

body.title: SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions: Why Memorizing Payroll Rules Fails in Dynamic SAP HR Conversations
body.body:
A lot of candidates walk into payroll-related SAP exams believing success depends on memorizing rules, wage types, deductions, and payroll schemas. That approach may help with basic theory questions, but it starts falling apart once the conversation becomes dynamic and human. That is exactly what surprises people in SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions. The exam no longer focuses only on whether you remember payroll rules. It checks whether you can apply them naturally when employees, managers, and business situations start creating pressure around the discussion.

## Why real payroll conversations become complicated

Payroll issues rarely arrive in clean textbook form. An employee may be frustrated about overtime calculations, confused about tax deductions, or worried about missing payments during a sensitive personal situation. In those moments, simply repeating policy rules does not solve the problem. People expect clarity, reassurance, and practical guidance not robotic explanations copied from documentation. That is why [modern C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions](https://www.certshero.com/sap/c-thr86/practice-test) are designed around realistic conversations instead of static payroll theory alone.

## The hidden problem with memorization strategies

Memorization creates confidence only when the situation stays predictable. The moment a conversation becomes emotional or layered with multiple concerns, candidates often freeze because they are waiting for an exact rule to apply. But HR and payroll discussions do not always follow perfect logic. Sometimes the challenge is deciding how to explain a policy without escalating tension or confusing the employee further. This is one of the biggest mindset shifts inside SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions understanding that communication matters just as much as payroll accuracy.

## Why SAP exams now feel conversational

Older SAP exams mostly rewarded technical precision. Modern AI role-play formats are moving closer to real workplace behavior, where the ability to communicate clearly under pressure becomes part of the evaluation itself. You may know the payroll configuration perfectly, but if your explanation sounds cold, defensive, or disconnected from the employee’s concern, the response feels incomplete. That human-centered approach appears constantly throughout SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions, especially in scenarios involving payroll disputes, corrections, and employee misunderstandings.

## Emotional pressure changes how people respond

One thing candidates underestimate is how emotions affect workplace conversations. Employees dealing with payroll issues are often already stressed before the discussion even begins. A delayed salary payment or incorrect deduction can quickly become emotional because it affects someone’s personal life directly. In those situations, technical correctness alone is not enough. This is why SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions evaluate empathy, listening skills, and response tone alongside HR process knowledge.

## Why flexibility now matters more than scripts

Candidates who rely too heavily on scripted answers usually struggle when the role-play changes direction unexpectedly. Real HR conversations shift quickly depending on how employees react, ask questions, or express frustration. Strong candidates adapt naturally. They stay calm, explain clearly, and adjust their communication style without sounding rehearsed. That practical flexibility is exactly what modern SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions are trying to measure in today’s SAP certification environment.

## Real preparation now means practicing conversations

Reading payroll documentation is important, but it is no longer enough by itself. Candidates improve faster when they practice realistic HR discussions where technical rules and human reactions collide together. That is why many learners now use platforms like CertsHero to prepare with realistic SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions that reflect the communication-heavy style of modern SAP HR certifications.

## Final thought

Payroll may seem technical on the surface, but real payroll conversations are deeply human. Employees care about clarity, trust, and understanding just as much as system accuracy. That is why memorizing rules alone no longer guarantees success. Modern SAP C_THR86 AI Role-Plays Questions are designed to test whether you can combine payroll knowledge with communication, empathy, and practical decision-making in real workplace situations.

body.title: An Exotic, Cultural, and Religious Hike in Vietnam [Eng-Esp]
body.body: > ### English _______ # An Exotic, Cultural, and Religious Hike in Vietnam ______ Hello, dear friends! I hope you’re having a great day. Today I want to tell you about Vung Tau, in Vietnam. When I was in that country, this was one of my favorite places to visit, and the hike to the Christ statue was the part I enjoyed the most. I arrived in Vung Tau partly to escape the noise and skyscrapers of Saigon—now Ho Chi Minh City—and I took the ferry. I loved this place because it was incredibly authentic; it hadn’t been overrun by mass tourism, and it was surrounded by nature. It’s not a highly developed city—let’s say it’s small—but it has restaurants, trails, and beautiful boardwalks. One really beautiful thing is that on one side of the coast, on Little Hill (Núi Nhỏ), there’s a Christ statue watching over the area; there’s also a giant Buddha watching from the mountain, and on the other side, right across from it, is the Virgin Mary holding the baby Jesus in her arms. I found this amazing because it’s the only place in the world—at least that I’ve seen—where Buddhism and Catholicism coexist in such a vivid way.

> > ### Español ______ > # Un trekking exótico, cultural y religioso en Vietnam ______ > Hola, queridos amigos! Espero que estén teniendo un gran día. Hoy les quiero hablar de Vung Tau, en Vietnam. Cuando estuve en ese país, uno de mis lugares preferidos para visitar fue justamente este, y específicamente la caminata hacia el Cristo fue la que a mí más me gustó. > Llegué a Vung Tau un poco escapando del ruido y los edificios de Saigón —actualmente Ho Chi Minh— y lo hice en ferry. Me encantó este sitio porque era sumamente auténtico, no estaba tan golpeado por el turismo masivo y además tenía mucha naturaleza. No llega a ser una ciudad demasiado desarrollada; digamos que es pequeña, pero cuenta con restaurantes, senderos y paseos marítimos preciosos. Algo muy bonito es que de un lado de la costa, en el Cerro Pequeño (Núi Nhỏ), hay un Cristo protegiendo; también hay un Buda gigante que cuida desde la montaña y, del otro lado, justo enfrente, está la Virgen María con el niño Jesús en brazos. Esto me pareció alucinante porque es el único lugar en el mundo, al menos que yo haya visto, donde conviven de una manera tan viva el budismo con el catolicismo. ________________________ ![IMG_1315.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqFsy6cS4ByuRPw8P2DR8FUncUXkgjxXMHiXpiZyFTDCn3KLFa7sKknPAtrXXcnFGpG.jpeg) ![IMG_1316.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EptcPXMXjtLBshrwJinjqiWTbSBk6SiApSBmNV2yPwjKhxxCaoWQvd19Lks3EsQpBiz.jpeg) ![IMG_1314.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqJ1JMmLGzuiq73kVaz2C4fkc7751zj3NriGD7V6pk2zf2GKzKUQ2n6o3FqJyMfNt2k.jpeg) ![IMG_1317.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpT64PhoH9Br2Z2effZYiwFzNyejyMiXwP2dpacgJCAssMhyMLk3u1VyKppCoLpm65T.jpeg) ![IMG_1322.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eos2K5iUspNhKG7s642xawXMvbve9KF6Vu713o4RMuYKRBjpGjYHnBaEPfV9DA8PXBv.jpeg) ![IMG_1319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eptby9vK9fQwQwMYDW6ZdgXhG5EcDZZYjZrdF5E2kBUEWcj5U4S2WM1CLPw3WMm6mz2.jpeg) ![IMG_1325.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23xyVECe3hZ6TTozXexgMxQ7QZs1YMpxV8yPVdVV2SN1d1oHGFmg2tKCdRYhz2EZMaVhC.jpeg) ![IMG_1324.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpEHik6Vn1r5WvfCeBwgpZEJ3Lhbv5dAVmSgVfFWK7Ds68zRo1KHEoTzM2TZTWMomvY.jpeg) _______________

> While I was there, and since I love everything about religion, culture, and going on walks—whether in the city or out in nature—one of my outings was to the Christ of Vung Tau (Tượng Chúa Kitô Vua). Of course, it reminded me of the one in Rio de Janeiro because it’s very similar: it stands high up with its arms outstretched. The only difference is that in Rio you take a cable car or a little train up, whereas here you have to hike up a pretty steep climb. I walked there from my accommodation, the three-star Hotel Rex, which became my little home and refuge for the seven days I stayed in the city, a bit removed from all the hustle and bustle. The trail ran entirely along the coast, a beautiful seaside promenade. The day was a little cloudy; maybe it would have been better if it had been clear, but I still enjoyed it a lot. Plus, it worked out well for me because it was very hot, and if the sun had been beating down, I might not have been able to handle the hike.

> > Estando ahí, y aprovechando que me encanta todo el tema de la religión, la cultura y hacer caminatas tanto urbanas como naturales, una de mis salidas fue hacia el Cristo de Vung Tau (Tượng Chúa Kitô Vua). Por supuesto que me hizo acordar al de Río de Janeiro porque es muy similar: está en lo alto con los brazos abiertos. Nada más que en Río se sube con teleférico o trencito, y acá se sube caminando por una subida bastante intensa. Me fui a pie desde mi alojamiento, el Hotel Rex de tres estrellas, que se convirtió en mi casita y refugio por los siete días que me quedé en la ciudad, un poco alejada de tanto alboroto. El sendero era todo por la costa, un paseo marítimo bellísimo. El día estaba un poquito nublado; quizás hubiese sido mejor si estaba despejado, pero igual lo disfruté un montón. Además me vino muy bien porque hacía mucho calor y, si hubiese estado el sol a pleno, tal vez no me aguantaba la caminata. ___________ ![IMG_1333.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqUdviMTaZwyENrMiYVEShkABTUxqr2MTEgG1ApJXhi6Qxa829LBNkhCrd5uBMXo5yM.jpeg) ![IMG_1346.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23wX5mjc9fW3GtzbXdYaVnpyZuvev5G5171MyATayAw2p7fGSKPpVi7y1S7oQXk23SZdc.jpeg) ![IMG_1330.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eou9kfdtgV7WjKr45gqJxDBB8zqKP3kVf86p24bPDWT44Q8stHFL62ezievGpg3Qrvc.jpeg) ![IMG_1337.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23uQvSi7ybdWp1NiSn4kWKhk2k44EXGCZPqM6WZs1otoD3mMX4aBcHm6tYq1GYb4onpbY.jpeg) ![IMG_1334.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqfFx6iPtgHxx83U3JokUa9V1g3hmtwQYuP6yiKMK8gfV5HGxbdHbgUMz8Gdjgixo4u.jpeg) ![IMG_1338.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eoc7TgW9GCnnNwWprEFcUXFNEj3oYEUXS2Tjb1BG4DR8RM2rXr3G2Vxu51jzxsiFToG.jpeg) ![IMG_1335.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpLgXh5Zr55ftAAZ9nQBkbrzCChBNFn6yWtygYj5r71nKfBa8UxJk2ot8YXEkUPsyUM.jpeg) ![IMG_1339.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Ep5ncgrfrXN26g7vLVwzB6MXyVJGDV7pdQhFXXDAyzuQru6wDB5YNsmbXjKPbK7bLAL.jpeg) ![IMG_1340.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Epvip9NwxMHBKGkBDVua7hQYtKiGcUXuRFatLF6T12HpC7StLH3wMFPMeXZeGV5sEfd.jpeg) ___________________

> When I reached the base of the statue, I found out that admission is free, but there is a strict dress code. I had to buy a pair of pants and a shirt right there because they wouldn’t let me in wearing shorts or with my shoulders exposed. After spending money on that and looking pretty funny because nothing matched, I began the climb. As I climbed, I discovered different panoramic views and passed by various Catholic religious images depicting angels, the Virgin Mary, and Jesus with Joseph. Once I reached the top, I saw that you could go inside the Christ statue, so I went in. On that last stretch, I felt a little uncomfortable because a Vietnamese man had started following me. Since I was alone, I noticed right away: if I stopped, he did too. I didn’t sense him as a violent person, but it did stress me out to feel like I was being followed. Luckily, when I reached the structure, there was a security guard there, since they make you leave absolutely everything in a locker and only allow you to go up with your phone and passport. When I asked for the key, I told the guard about this man; the guard said something to him in his language, and the guy left.

> > Al llegar a la base de la estatua, me enteré de que la entrada es gratuita, pero sí hay que cumplir con un código de vestimenta estricto. Me tuve que comprar un pantalón y una remera ahí mismo porque no me dejaban pasar con pantalón corto ni con los hombros descubiertos. Después de gastar en eso y quedar bastante graciosa vestida porque nada combinaba, empecé el ascenso. A medida que iba subiendo, descubría distintos paisajes panorámicos y pasaba por diversas imágenes de la religión católica que hacían alusión a los ángeles, a la Virgen y a Jesús con José. > Una vez que llegué a la cima, vi que se podía entrar al Cristo, así que ingresé. En ese último tramo me sentí un poco incómoda porque un hombre vietnamita me había empezado a seguir. Como yo iba sola, me di cuenta enseguida: si yo me detenía, él también lo hacía. No lo sentía como alguien violento, pero sí me dio estrés sentirme perseguida. Por suerte, al llegar a la estructura había un guardia de seguridad, ya que te hacen dejar absolutamente todo en un locker y solo te permiten subir con el teléfono y el pasaporte. Al pedir la llave, le avisé al guardia sobre este hombre; el seguridad le dijo algo en su idioma y el tipo se fue. __________ ![IMG_1359.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23wgL5k63PMGQk27o1RVf4Xh528B3ZpF6UnWFXNNduxd1SnkXD7X5bSgNndQavszVmche.jpeg) ![IMG_1357.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpQvigJhUiTSft9w4Xq7vNYHX5wzdMvWE1yJS3L2AiSLcUrQD961a9Aqpy3RVS6up49.jpeg) ![IMG_1351.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqL7Kd7rjb7oevJdUnWPZp88UnPSgdYvDUqnizBp3EKu9SsrtVDbaD9DrX5cgDs4Aex.jpeg) ![IMG_1348.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/2432J3bGDVwk8YfBw8EdNN9kWcey5KA5ySnRwAEk2XANcwikh3Gq4pJPJnwx2PxSppTPP.jpeg) ![IMG_1350.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqNFkR5TyBkfLkvmdtSGxEgRZcRJfwcf4KF4Gvy2ERGb3dTsNr3T3HVfVGJtxNJypLW.jpeg) ![IMG_1355.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23vi1YsLeWG5VecSVxUL6m8Xr8chFKKbcYobVd2RtdMUAeeHNK2fEMeCsXkrZBRJJqMLQ.jpeg) ![IMG_1363.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23tvkRcHrFA55J9cGNCgKKpPimEm9A9K7yQFd1Ajv5Fj6bWEahdJGZXZfdC7DAHvwrCAf.jpeg) ![IMG_1349.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23xVMPM1N6gxqNzQ579x8Cy3CvjifX81BjRDEjgYYBg2x3W66GBefC4hQi2bmabAtj7AZ.jpeg) ________

> Once in the Christ statue, I climbed up to the two arms, where you really get a sense of the vastness of the landscape. I was struck by the fact that there were what looked like nails protruding from both sides of the shoulders—a somewhat jarring detail that I didn’t quite understand; if anyone knows the reason, I’d appreciate it if you could share it in the comments. The view from up there, next to the sculpture’s head, was beautiful and very moving. On the way down—after I don’t know how many steps—it was nice to find some super-clean restrooms, something basic but very necessary at that point in the day. It’s also worth mentioning that before climbing up to the Christ statue, there’s another short ascent where you can see the Pietà sculpture and then the Ascension sculpture. In total, the climb took me about 40 minutes to an hour of pure stair-climbing—some of the steps were quite old—plus another 40 minutes of walking on flat ground beforehand.

> > Ya en el Cristo, subí hasta los dos brazos, donde sintonizás con la inmensidad del paisaje. Me llamó mucho la atención que en ambos lados de los hombros había como unos clavos saliendo, un detalle un poco violento que no terminé de entender; si alguien sabe el motivo, le agradezco que me lo comparta en los comentarios. La vista desde ahí arriba, al lado de la cabeza de la escultura, era preciosa y fue muy emocionante. > Al bajar —después de no sé cuántos escalones— estuvo bueno encontrarme con unos baños súper limpios, algo básico pero muy necesario a esa altura de la jornada. También vale comentar que antes de subir al Cristo hay otro pequeño ascenso donde se puede ver la escultura de la Piedad y luego la de la ascensión. En total, la subida me habrá tomado unos 40 minutos o una hora de puro escalón, algunos ya bastante viejos, más otros 40 minutos de caminata previa en terreno llano. ________ ![IMG_1366.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eq5E2CH1CDoJPLKUmnG7EAWQ7dNSyJj365JyFGKuGShAPizTTz8p73mmaAgYZw3zFmn.jpeg) ![IMG_1401.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/243ftQQL3RFz3nWrbCHra2Lk6y2uamJf4ZgDnzDk6WKLzCsmVBoyD3ngCD1YoJD79HyB1.jpeg) ![IMG_1365.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23ynWksTmwdK9nuvV4FaE2AE8yVZiA1K11BM7nUYZnmXzxRo7eCyAMfevAQ9KrXjpp8b2.jpeg) ![IMG_1388.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqQPZss7Xo3yghVfE9xbrApryyojHuZVoRs6syJ1ZQkySTVJnb5q8nkVFKtcjAho4VY.jpeg) ![IMG_1387.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqUdp2Y4xpCwjMhvb9Zsym5JHNjj7CAFB76MFWjtccH6CFvnZ2imSGqXECV3C4QYmK5.jpeg) ![IMG_1400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eq37XrXNAFWieUCQ2E5xBw7wy2JyR98Mj6rPWb6xnJghQJMnUiKzLrCy9yBQo9DxMrZ.jpeg) ![IMG_1404.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EnmCFaRJJWHtQBPHzRux7KmURz6Fc3VA4t4eGdkG5eriuKxdM3NYNdpxFfFSAfTXaDC.jpeg) ![IMG_1395.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoiXbC5G9NaVBKqVw3iQwUQhaufBPbbTmnBBVcTQtU58dRsbjB9q2tbuEgtZA8ooEMi.jpeg) ![IMG_1374.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EppN8EQSMctJdp2VUTdJaG5sCofVm8uwKd5bfwapjVcBKygi5ZeSq5z5WnK88m3CtLg.jpeg) ![IMG_1375.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/244xz4muL32SJ8CN6juDykqWsL1cKmB3C2bKpAYzxNYQKBfvKe9jwD2tycKKNhVFcN1gi.jpeg) ______

> I have very fond memories of this little adventure. Something similar happened to me at a Buddhist temple I visited nearby—which I’ll tell you about in another post—but it was on this hill where I felt most sheltered and supported. The energy of the entire mountain was so beautiful; I felt like I was in my own world, connecting with nature, the mountain, and the Catholicism I grew up with—even though today I have a mix of different beliefs.

> > Recuerdo con mucho cariño esta pequeña aventura. Me pasó algo similar con un templo budista que visité cerca de ahí, del cual ya les hablaré en otro post, pero en este cerro fue donde me sentí más refugiada y sostenida. La energía de todo ese monte era muy bonita; sentí que estaba en mi mundo, conectando con la naturaleza, la montaña y con el catolicismo con el que crecí, más allá de que hoy tenga una mezcla de distintas creencias. _________ ![IMG_1412.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqFsYdJsTo3Ja73st9Bu9jPK6KiwAJSL3MUdp4tpaN4LD1btMuWNGTeRHPbBsKSFMh6.jpeg) ![IMG_1414.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eqd9zmC9EboFZwUGuN22dZg6P597TdQoQCd32cca9uZ56PyCd3kTyxM9GbCbxsrkSEg.jpeg) ![IMG_1421.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eq365DMhL4zvJErTDvS7Yme8Bk89LMocfmqLS53AQgGVjbBDkU1vXek5Qrvu2Yzta7D.jpeg) ![IMG_1420.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EoAdAAKi4PMsnUwXSvpSyTHP9ZUszQiaF34EvYyY2GMFcSLB5jEV15oqma66APGvgn1.jpeg) ![IMG_1423.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23yTgyv8XoHx6ADjKe6ii6PM6iyxetnwToWwFk59iaxdcibt7RQAB32vqGAFxQzgpsctC.jpeg) ____________
> I hope you enjoyed this hike I took on a beautiful day of travel, and I’d love to hear from you. Thank you so much for being here!
> > Espero que les haya gustado esta caminata que hice un hermoso día de viaje, y me encantaría leerlos. ¡Muchas gracias por estar acá! ______

body.title: Antoni Słonimski artysta
body.body:
![Zrzut ekranu z 2026-05-18 12-41-41.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helcim/23t84fBJnHpSZ5x8h691UaAq3GZiqRk2GCtE1z1UVDqGNwdfSP9yo1iYXTKt72AEz8yyT.png)


Zadziwiające, że mimo że Antoni Słonimski jest jedną z najbardziej znanych postaci polskiej kultury XX wieku całkowicie zapomniano, ze miał w swoim życiorysie epizod artystyczny. Rzeczywiście, nie sposób dziś znaleźć jego prace. Ten projekt reklamy opublikowany w 1913 roku w „Sztuce” (z. 10) to pierwsza jego praca, na jaką się natknąłem. Widać, że miał niewątpliwe zdolności artystyczne. Trochę szkoda, że zrezygnował z rozwijania ich.

body.title: Monday some shots of the ships at Battleship Cove
body.body:
# some shots of the ships at Battleship Cove No Monochrome post today since i shared it on Saturday Today I will share a few shots of some of the ships at Battle Ship cove Located in Fall River, MA, Battleship Cove is the world’s largest naval ship museum, featuring 5 National Historic Landmarks including the USS Massachusetts (BB-59). Perfect for a day trip, it offers hands-on tours of WWII vessels, PT boats, and a submarine, with tickets around $25 for adults (often including two-day access That all said I still have yet to actually go into the museum, just see the ships from heritage state park when I visit there Lets start witha wider shot showing it slocation under Brage Bridge its quite an impressive view and one day I do plan to actually go during the day when its open and check out the museum proper.
![battleship cove.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23sdT5o6D63yNqgJHzQTbGGvqJCrd7VYmZTgKG8qu6KNmN7T1zuXJeJaFavYz8taesisX.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F11 1/20 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23sdT5o6D63yNqgJHzQTbGGvqJCrd7VYmZTgKG8qu6KNmN7T1zuXJeJaFavYz8taesisX.jpg)**

a closer in shot of one of the ships Destroyer Joseph P. Kennedy, Jr., known by her crew as the \

was laid down April 2, 1945, by the Bethlehem Steel Company at the Fore River Shipyard in Quincy, MA. Launched on July 26, 1945, and commissioned on December 15, 1945, she was completed in only 8 months, reflective of the fast pace of shipbuilding during the last year of WWII also in this shot you may notice the submarine It is a Balao-class submarine, USS Lionfish was laid down on 15 December 1942, launched on 7 November 1943, and commissioned on 1 November 1944. Her first captain was Lcdr. Edward D. Spruance, son of the famous World War II admiral, Raymond Spruance
![battleship cove-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ynKvKdQTEBYLNJPZpapxHhKHyCbPUsohT8jRY8c1PVEVA6AbSss4oMwwLspacfVj8YM.jpg) **Sony A7iv 51mm F11 1/20 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23ynKvKdQTEBYLNJPZpapxHhKHyCbPUsohT8jRY8c1PVEVA6AbSss4oMwwLspacfVj8YM.jpg)**

#### Saludos amigos bienvenidos a mi blog 🌟

> Una de las cosas que pienso y siento, es que nosotras las mujeres siempre tenemos mucho que hacer, no se si a ustedes les pasa pensar eso, pero es que nosotras llevamos algunas cargas o varias actividades que no son negociables pues nos corresponden de alguna manera, por ello siento que el tiempo no me alcanza y muchas veces me hacen faltan horas del día para hacer todo. Siempre he tratado de hacer de todo en mi tiempo, ya que el tiempo es valioso y debe ser productivo, algunas veces pienso que también no soy tan productiva como antes pues la edad no es la misma, pero ahora con el tema de la luz en mi país siento que me atraso aún más, que ese tiempo lo pierdo en cosas que no quiero hacer o que no son tan productivas.

> Siempre me ha gustado planificar el tiempo para que me alcancé y busco aplicaciones que me ayuden y escribo las cosas que debo hacer sin embargo últimamente siento que hay cosas que me desenfocar del tiempo planificado, todos los días sale algo nuevo que debo hacer, alguna diligencia que me saca de mi zona de confort, por ejemplo en el trabajo ya las horas que planifico algunas veces no pueden ser posible porque no hay luz, por lo que debo hacer otra cosa. Otro de los ejemplos es que en casa hay una sola computadora que tiene la pila dañada y muchas veces la usa mi hijo, y cuando por fin me decido hacer trabajos en ella cuando la toma que tengo el tiempo para dedicarle a hacer actividades extras se va la luz y no puedo hacer más nada, así que mi teléfono es una gran herramienta de trabajo que se está quedando corto pues ya es viejito y no posee un buen almacenamiento.

> Cuando me doy cuenta debo dejar actividades a medias porque es la hora de hacer desayuno limpiar la casa, almuerzo y dedicar tiempo a los chicos, el que dijo que ser madre, trabajadora y ama de casa, es fácil miente, ya que el tiempo para todas estas actividades pasa muy rápido y cuando veo ya es hora de hacer otra cosa.

>


Siento que debo buscar otra forma de planificación que me ayude, he tratado de hacer las cosas por dias, pero igual al dia siguiente algo pasa y no culminó lo que comencé, entre una y otra situación necesito encontrar un equilibrio que me ayude a cumplir con todas mis tareas.



<center>







</center>

<div class=\

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >! [ENGLISH] > >One of the things I think and feel is that we women always have so much to do. I don’t know if you ever feel that way, but the fact is that we carry certain burdens or juggle various activities that aren’t negotiable because they’re our responsibility in some way. That’s why I feel like there aren’t enough hours in the day to get everything done. > >I’ve always tried to do everything in my own time, since time is valuable and should be productive. Sometimes I think I’m not as productive as I used to be because I’m not the same age anymore, but now with the power outages in my country, I feel like I’m falling even further behind—that I’m wasting that time on things I don’t want to do or that aren’t very productive. > >

> > >I’ve always liked planning my time so I can get everything done, and I look for apps to help me and write down the things I need to do; however, lately I feel like there are things that throw me off my planned schedule—every day something new comes up that I have to do, some errand that takes me out of my comfort zone. For example, at work, the hours I plan sometimes aren’t possible because there’s no power, so I have to do something else. > >Another example is that we only have one computer at home, and its battery is broken. My son often uses it, and when I finally decide to do some work on it—when he’s using it and I have time to focus on extra tasks—the power goes out and I can’t do anything else. So my phone is a great work tool, but it’s falling short because it’s getting old and doesn’t have enough storage. > >

> > >Before I know it, I have to leave tasks unfinished because it’s time to make breakfast, clean the house, prepare lunch, and spend time with the kids. Anyone who says that being a mother, a worker, and a homemaker is easy is lying, since the time for all these activities goes by so quickly, and before I know it, it’s already time to do something else. > >

> > >I feel like I need to find another way to plan that works for me. I’ve tried organizing things by day, but the next day something always comes up and I don’t finish what I started. Between one thing and another, I need to find a balance that helps me get all my tasks done. > ---

Withdrawal limits ja payment methods kertovat aika paljon siitä, sopiiko kasino pienelle pelaajalle vai enemmän ison budjetin tyyppiin.

Minimum deposit auttaa testaamaan sivuston ilman isoa riskiä. Low stake casino on silloin järkevämpi vaihtoehto kuin paikka, jossa minimitalletus on heti turhan korkea.

Mä tykkään aloittaa pienellä, katsoa toimiiko sivu ja nostaa panosta vasta sitten. Se säästää hermoja ja rahaa.

### Maksutavat Ja Wallet Connection

Payment methods kertoo suoraan, mitä maksutapoja kasino oikeasti tukee. Wallet connection ja crypto wallet compatibility pitää katsoa tarkasti, jos pelaa useammalla eri lompakolla.

Mä en koskaan oleta, että kaikki lompakot käyvät kaikkialle. Se on helppo tapa törmätä turhaan ongelmaan jo ennen ekaa talletusta.

### Fiat To Crypto Ja Takaisin

Fiat to crypto conversion näkyy pelaajan kukkarossa aina kuluina tai kurssieroina. Crypto to fiat cashout on helppo ajatus, mutta paikallinen valuuttatuki vaikuttaa siihen, paljonko oikeasti jää käteen.

links.title: Oil Price Pressure and Ethereum Volatility — What's the Inside Story?
links.body: > Looking at the cryptocurrency market from the outside, it often seems like everything depends only on demand and trends. But if you dig a little deeper, you can see that this market has an invisible relationship with the world economy, energy markets, and even the international situation. Many people are giving various explanations for the unusual pressure that has been seen in the price of Ethereum over the past few weeks. Some say investor fear, some say market manipulation. However, after reading some recent analysis, I feel that the matter may be deeper. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYHpuQRkjECo4tpG3GskQvWoyXbx7xpeVShwrXRxX7zsD/kanchanara-7cmA9ZL5dDk-unsplash.jpg [Src](https://unsplash.com/id/foto/ornamen-bulat-cetak-bintang-emas-dan-hitam-7cmA9ZL5dDk) One thing in particular surprised me quite a bit. Usually, we think that there is no connection between the oil market and cryptocurrencies. But now it turns out that the more crude oil prices rise in the international market, the more pressure is being put on Ethereum. Although it may seem a little strange at first, looking at the charts, it is clear that these two markets have been moving in opposite directions in recent times. The volatility in the oil market over the past few months has led to large investors gradually moving away from risky assets. And a large part of that pressure has fallen on Ethereum. Especially from mid-April to May, when oil prices rose, Ethereum prices have also fallen steadily. What seems most important to me is that many people do not see this situation as a long-term crisis. Rather, it is seen as a temporary instability. Because the foundation that Ethereum has built from a technical perspective is still very strong. Developer activity, network usage, and the interest of large institutions — everything is still working in Ethereum's favor. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVBn86v3yfHWT9jB73LtijofFWpDSbJoaMfwiPQMyGFPJ/kanchanara-YiPxoWzkHfI-unsplash.jpg [Src](https://unsplash.com/id/foto/koin-bulat-emas-dan-perak-YiPxoWzkHfI) However, the reality is that markets are never driven by technology alone. Human psychology also plays a big role here. When uncertainty increases in the global market, investors naturally seek safe havens. Rising oil prices often indicate pressure on the global economy or political tensions. As a result, the impact of that panic also affects the crypto market. Another thing that I personally find quite important. Many still think that Bitcoin and Ethereum will behave in the same way. But in reality, the two have become very different. The Ethereum-Bitcoin ratio has also recently dropped, which shows that investors currently consider Bitcoin to be safer than Ethereum. However, I think that such times in the market are actually indicative of major changes in the future. Because history shows that when everyone is overly afraid, new opportunities gradually begin to emerge. If the oil market calms down a bit in the future and the pressure on the global economy decreases, Ethereum can bounce back strongly. Finally, I would like to say one thing: nothing is permanent in the crypto market. What seems to be a decline today may be the beginning of a new rise tomorrow. Therefore, it is much more important to understand the internal factors of the market than to make decisions based on panic alone. To me, Ethereum's current situation seems to be exactly that - a story of a powerful technology under temporary pressure. links.body:
# Tanning Salon Advertising: 

The indoor tanning industry continues to evolve as customer expectations, competition, and digital marketing trends change over time. For salon owners, providing high-quality tanning services is only one part of running a successful business. Effective **Tanning Salon Advertising** is equally important for attracting new clients, building customer loyalty, and increasing long-term revenue.

Today’s customers have endless options when searching for tanning services. From social media recommendations to online reviews and local search results, people often decide where to tan before ever walking into a salon. This means salon owners need strong advertising strategies that help their business stand out in a crowded market.

## Why Tanning Salon Advertising Is Essential for Business Growth

[Tanning Salon Advertising](https://sunalparts.com/product-category/advertising-posters/) plays a major role in helping salons attract new customers and maintain a strong reputation in the beauty and wellness industry. Even the best tanning salon may struggle to grow if potential clients are unaware of its services.

One of the biggest reasons advertising matters is visibility. Modern consumers search online before visiting local businesses. A salon with strong digital marketing, positive reviews, and active social media pages is more likely to attract attention than one with little online presence.

Advertising also helps salons build trust. Customers are more comfortable choosing businesses that appear professional, active, and well-reviewed. Consistent branding and marketing create confidence in the quality of services offered.

## Digital Marketing for Tanning Salons

Digital marketing has become one of the most powerful tools for tanning salon advertising. Most customers now discover local businesses through online searches, social media, and mobile apps.

### Social Media Marketing

Platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok are excellent for showcasing tanning results, salon interiors, customer testimonials, and promotional offers. Posting engaging content regularly helps salons build stronger connections with potential customers.

### Google Business Profile Optimization

A well-optimized business profile helps tanning salons appear in local search results and map listings. Adding updated business hours, photos, services, and customer reviews can significantly improve visibility.

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

SEO helps tanning salons rank higher in search engine results when people search for tanning services nearby. Using targeted keywords, local content, and optimized website pages increases online traffic and visibility.

### Email Marketing

Email campaigns remain an effective way to promote special offers, seasonal discounts, and membership plans. Personalized communication helps build customer loyalty and encourages repeat visits.

## Traditional Advertising Still Works

While digital marketing is essential, traditional advertising methods still provide value for many tanning salons.

### Local Flyers and Posters

Distributing promotional flyers in gyms, beauty salons, spas, and shopping centers can help attract local customers.

### Radio and Local Print Ads

Local radio stations and community magazines can still generate awareness, especially in smaller cities and neighborhoods.

### Referral Programs

Word-of-mouth marketing remains one of the most effective forms of advertising. Offering referral rewards encourages satisfied customers to recommend the salon to friends and family.

### Event Sponsorships

Partnering with local fashion shows, fitness events, or beauty expos can increase brand visibility and attract new clients.

## Building a Strong Tanning Salon Brand

Successful tanning salon advertising is not only about promotions—it’s also about branding. Customers remember salons that create a professional and welcoming image.

### Consistent Visual Identity

Using consistent logos, colors, and messaging across websites, social media, and printed materials helps build brand recognition.

### Professional Customer Service

Advertising may attract customers initially, but excellent customer service keeps them coming back.

### Clean and Modern Facilities

Customers are more likely to recommend salons that appear clean, stylish, and well-maintained.

### Positive Online Reviews

Encouraging satisfied clients to leave reviews improves credibility and helps attract new customers through online searches.

## Common Advertising Mistakes Tanning Salons Should Avoid

### Inconsistent Marketing

Posting randomly or abandoning social media pages can make a salon appear inactive or unprofessional.

### Ignoring Customer Feedback

Negative reviews should be addressed professionally rather than ignored.

### Poor Website Design

Outdated or slow websites may discourage potential customers from booking appointments.

### Overusing Discounts

Constant discounting can reduce the perceived value of salon services over time.

## Why Customer Experience Matters in Advertising

Advertising brings customers into the salon, but customer experience determines whether they return. Positive experiences naturally generate referrals, reviews, and repeat business.

Salon owners should focus on creating a comfortable environment, maintaining clean equipment, and offering friendly service. Happy customers often become the salon’s best advertisers through social media posts and personal recommendations.

## The Future of Tanning Salon Advertising

Marketing trends continue evolving as technology changes consumer behavior. Video marketing, influencer partnerships, mobile booking systems, and personalized advertising are becoming increasingly important in the beauty and wellness industry.

Artificial intelligence, customer analytics, and targeted advertising tools are also helping businesses create more effective marketing campaigns. Salons that adapt to modern advertising strategies are more likely to remain competitive in the future.

# Conclusion – Why Smart Advertising Matters for Tanning Salons and sunal parts

Effective tanning salon advertising is essential for attracting customers, building trust, and growing a successful tanning business. From social media marketing and SEO to referral programs and customer loyalty strategies, smart advertising helps salons stay competitive in an evolving industry. Consistent branding, professional customer service, and quality equipment all contribute to long-term business success. Whether upgrading salon systems or improving marketing efforts, many businesses continue to rely on [sunal parts](https://sunalparts.com/) for dependable tanning solutions and industry support.

## FAQs About Tanning Salon Advertising

### 1. Why is tanning salon advertising important?

Advertising helps tanning salons attract new customers, build brand awareness, and increase business revenue.

### 2. What is the best advertising method for tanning salons?

A combination of digital marketing, social media, SEO, and local promotions usually works best.

### 3. How can social media help tanning salons?

Social media allows salons to showcase results, promote offers, and engage directly with customers.

### 4. What role does SEO play in tanning salon marketing?

SEO helps tanning salons appear higher in search engine results, increasing online visibility and website traffic.

### 5. Are customer reviews important for tanning salons?

Yes, positive reviews build trust and influence potential customers when choosing a salon.

links.title: Pay You, Pay Me
links.body: >\n\nI was reading about how Anthropic has settled a copyright case for 1.5 billion dollars after it used a database of pirated books to train Claude AI. For instance, a Finnish author whose book was in the set will get about 3,000€ out of the settlement. However, I believe that this proves the usecase for blockchain copyrighting, where \

can be proven immutably. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23tRzKjefodDXvfFb4McB7EDKAc5XyyEJboE164RPwW9v8EvG4mqk3YoBUTJ4jXJYYKWo.png)


---

I also think it raises the case for micropayments to original authors of *any content* that is discovered by searches or is used to train AI or to provide any kind of AI-generated response. While the AI companies can own the algorithms and infrastructure, the content they are generating is not theirs, and is derived by normal people globally. 

This also raises another possibility, where people who *use AI* to generate content that they earn from, will also be subjected to micro pay original authors whose work went into the AI amalgamation. Because even if the outcome of the work is original to the AI, what went into creating it isn't. And this is more than an artist who gets inspired by the work of another, because *there is no inspiration* in the AI, there is no work done by the AI or the content creator prompting it, it is just an algorithm that delivers a predictable result, even if not predictable to the human observer.

Artificial Intelligence is going to decimate almost *every industry* that is currently in existence, as it will increasingly and rapidly encroach deeper and deeper into all human domains, replacing not only human thought, but human action also. AI will be able to design machines that replicate our movements and program the machines to think enough like us to be consistently better, with improving accuracy all of the time and at some point, we will not be able to add value of any kind.

As I was saying to someone the other day, even in \

fields like electrical and plumbing, a large part of what makes them safe is the inconsistencies in standardisation. Once standards have complete compliance, it will be only non-compliant systems that will need human intervention, and these will decrease as they are brought *up to standard.* If *earning* has to be part of the human ecosystem and we can assume for a little while at least that it will, it means that we are going to have to find new ways to earn, and those who have created in the past something that is still getting used, should get royalties from it. AI companies shouldn't be able to earn based on the content they have stolen and that content gap of earning should be pushed back to the original creators. And a creator earning from the AI creation, should be able to earn on their ideas for content, but should have to factor in remuneration for original authors too. This seems like an impossible task, but it is not, because *we have the technology* to not only store the required information, but also track and retrieve all of the information required in order to distribute earnings fairly. And not only would this improve the distribution of equity in content, but it will also improve the information sources themselves, and be able to feed a *web of trust* directly to validate all kinds of data, from content to event, so that a reliability confidence score can be applied. While I am not a huge fan of all this data driving our lives, it isn't going to change at scale because it comes with a massive amount of value and convenience as well. As much as I don't like it in many respects, I still benefit from ease of use and information availability, so we should be designing the information ecosystem to work for our wellbeing, not against it. Wellbeing *should be* the focus of everything we do as a society, and business activity should be looking to maximise our wellbeing - and in so doing, maximise profits. And this is where the ability to measure impact really matters, because if we are only looking at corporate metrics as success factors, we are going to miss the damage done to humanity to reach those same numbers. We need to look at betterment for humanity first, and then see what activity leads to improving it further - and monetise that. As the activities change, so do the incentives. But to do this requires a lot of data and processing power, which means that the AI companies will stull be earning from providing infrastructure and improved algorithms that help us make better decisions, and act on them. Ultimately, the only measurements that matter are those that lead to improving humanity and can be used to keep us advancing, keep us growing, keep us innovating, and *evolving ourselves* for the better. AI definitely can play a massive role in this journey, not as a content creator, but a facilitation tool that helps us build the systems required. The trouble is, if monetary profit is the only focus, the tools are not used for wellbeing improvement, because with the society we have currently established, there isn't enough money in it. > I wonder if any of my content has been used to train an AI. Can I find out and if it has, should I be compensated? # The Social Dynamics of Penguin Colonies: Communication, Bonding, and Parenting

Penguins, often seen waddling across icy landscapes, are not just charming creatures; they exhibit fascinating social dynamics within their colonies. This post explores the intricate communication methods, bonding behaviors, and parenting strategies that define the lives of these remarkable birds.

## Communication in Penguin Colonies

### Vocalizations

Penguins are known for their diverse range of vocalizations, which play a crucial role in maintaining social bonds and coordinating group activities. Each species has its own unique calls, and even individual penguins can be recognized by their specific vocalizations. For example:

- **Emperor Penguins** use a series of trumpeting calls to locate their mates in large colonies.
- **Adélie Penguins** have a variety of squawks and brays that help establish territory and communicate with neighbors.

### Body Language

In addition to vocalizations, penguins also utilize body language to convey messages. They may engage in behaviors such as:

- **Bowings**: A common greeting behavior where penguins bow to each other to establish social connections.
- **Head Tucking**: A sign of comfort and trust, often seen when penguins are resting or bonding with their mates.

## Bonding Behaviors

### Pair Formation

Penguins are known for their strong pair bonds, often forming lifelong partnerships. The bonding process typically involves:

1. **Courtship Displays**: Males and females engage in synchronized movements, vocalizations, and mutual preening to attract each other.
2. **Nest Building**: Once a pair is formed, they work together to build a nest, which serves as a foundation for their future family.

### Social Interactions

Within colonies, social interactions extend beyond mating pairs. Penguins engage in:

- **Group Huddling**: To conserve warmth and protect against harsh weather, penguins often huddle together, reinforcing social bonds.
- **Grooming Rituals**: Penguins spend time preening each other, which helps strengthen their relationships and maintain feather health.

## Parenting Strategies

### Shared Responsibilities

In many penguin species, both parents take an active role in raising their chicks. The parenting process typically involves:

- **Egg Incubation**: After laying eggs, both parents alternate between incubating the eggs and foraging for food, ensuring that the eggs remain warm and protected.
- **Chick Feeding**: Once the chicks hatch, both parents are involved in feeding them regurgitated food, providing essential nutrients for their growth.

### Protective Behavior

Penguin parents are fiercely protective of their young. They exhibit behaviors such as:

- **Aggressive Defense**: Parents will defend their chicks from potential threats, including predators and rival penguins.
- **Vigilant Monitoring**: Parent penguins keep a close watch on their chicks, ensuring they are safe and not straying too far from the nest.

## Conclusion

The social dynamics of penguin colonies are a testament to the complexity of animal behavior. Through effective communication, strong bonding, and dedicated parenting, penguins create a thriving community that supports the survival of their species. Understanding these dynamics not only enhances our appreciation for these remarkable birds but also highlights the importance of conserving their habitats for future generations.

links.title: Knitted Heart Therapy./Терапія в'язаними сердечками (En/Ua)
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTWgo7NBvfHubpuNeDHcMKteWHzbvsxqdBuKmNYSF1nJM/1779098766516.jpg)

Привіт усім. Нещодавно я почала в'язати сердечка. Це такі милі брелоки для Гавареччини, а моєму синові я зв'язала більше серце-подушку. Співробітниця попросила для племінниць, і я з радістю зв'язала рожеві об'ємні сердечка і для неї. А ще жне серденько поїде до сонячної Італії.
​Ось зараз я продовжую в'язати й згадала одну цікаву історію. Одного разу в дитячій бібліотеці на Патона я побачила, як працівниця перекладала щось з одного великого мішка в кілька менших пакетів. Це були довгі, як змії, кольорові в'язані шарфи. Я спостерігала за цим і все ж вирішила розпитати:
— Для чого вам стільки шарфів?
— Це для жінок, яким зараз тяжко, — відповіла вона.
​Я ще більше здивувалася, а жінка продовжувала розплутувати перекручені шарфи й розкладати їх.
— Одна жінка пережила велике горе, і я їй запропонувала терапію в'язанням. А тепер їй стало краще, і вона повернула пряжу для інших, кому потрібно покращити внутрішній стан.
​Бібліотекарка напихала кожен пакет до краю, розбирала нитки по кольорах, щоб вони не повторювалися. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRMaBYWw2LA5HmL92yzA1pN1g3ciP74rtZxMS6Mp9HQ9/1779098820161.jpg)

Вона продовжувала свою розповідь:
*• ​спочатку потрібно розпустити пряжу, а потім починати в'язати;*
*• ​саме ці одноманітні повторювані рухи дають людині самозаспокоєння;*
*• ​це діє як медитація, під час якої можна впорядкувати власні думки, перемкнути увагу, знизити стрес та покращити настрій.*
​І ось я в'яжу свої сердечка і думаю: яке це щастя мати таку людину, яка не осуджує тебе за твій стрес, яка не шукає «легких» шляхів у вигляді ліків, а знаходить пряжу і розповідає про терапевтичне в'язання.
​Мене навчила в'язати моя бабуся. Вона в'язала усе: від головних уборів до шкарпеток. Декілька речей ми зберігаємо в селі — це те, що зігріває тіло і душу. Вона не знала про терапію, просто речей не було в продажі, як тепер. Доводилося розпускати одні светри, щоб «сплести» нові. Але це був цілий проєкт для неї. Я ходила в школу у светриках, які в'язала моя мама. Але найулюбленішою в мене була в'язана спідничка — ні в кого такої не було.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzK3bDCcD4quPoG1rPKhNCz93HCK4wb6z72FPXD6UJqf/1779098820305.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZi4SiwURyGoSe6ywu4YQRrscU6taqYBXW9q7stc9SKiJ/1779098820427.jpg)

Можете побачити, що я використовую підручні засоби, а замість спиць ткористоую палички від чупа-чупсів, які люб'язно зібрав мені син.
​ Я виділяю кілька основних позитивних моментів для себе:
• ​можливість створення завершеного виробу;
• ​зниження рівня стресу;
• ​тренування дрібної моторики;
• ​покращення роботи мозку (в старшому віці це рятує від деменсії);
• ​загальне заспокоєння.
Цікава тема, правда ж? У час, коли ШІ робить усе за нас, людину рятує просте в'язання спицями. 
Спокійного і продуктивного вам тижня! До зустрічі!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2KzSeLUvYvfdLsxQWLWFzfXRJxhwTaJo2nDk9tSaQwf/1779098820560.jpg)

> *​Hello everyone! Recently, I started knitting hearts. I make such cute keychains out of them for Havarechchyna, and I also knitted a larger heart-shaped pillow for my son. A colleague of mine asked for some for her nieces, so I happily made some plush pink hearts for her too. And another little heart is about to travel all the way to sunny Italy.
​As I sit here knitting, an interesting story came back to me. Once, at the children's library on Patona Street, I saw a librarian transferring something from a large sack into several smaller bags. They were long, colorful knitted scarves that looked almost like snakes. I watched her for a moment and finally decided to ask:
\
she replied.\n​I was surprised, and the woman continued to untangle the twisted scarves and sort them out.\n\

The librarian packed each bag to the brim, sorting the threads by color so that each set was unique.
​She continued her story:
​First, you have to unravel the old yarn, and only then start knitting anew.
​It is precisely these monotonous, repetitive movements that bring a sense of inner calm.
​It acts like meditation, allowing you to organize your thoughts, shift your focus, lower stress, and lift your mood.
​And now, as I knit my own hearts, I catch myself thinking: what a blessing it is to have someone like that in life. Someone who doesn't judge you for your stress, who doesn't look for \

ways out in the form of pills, but instead finds a skein of yarn and shares the healing power of knitting.\n​It was my grandmother who taught me how to knit. She used to knit everything, from hats to socks. We still keep a few of her handmade pieces in our country house—they are things that warm both the body and the soul. She didn't know anything about \
; back then, clothes simply weren't available in stores like they are today. People had to unravel old sweaters just to \

new ones. But for her, it was a whole creative project. Later, I went to school wearing sweaters knitted by my mother. But my absolute favorite was a knitted skirt—nobody else had anything like it.
​As you can see from the photos, I use whatever materials I have on hand. Instead of traditional knitting needles, I am using Chupa Chups sticks that my son kindly collected for me.
​I can point out a few key benefits that this practice brings me:
​The joy of creating a finished product from scratch
​Lowered stress levels
​Fine motor skills training
​Improved brain function (in older age, it is known to protect against dementia)
​An overall sense of peace and calm
​It’s a fascinating topic, isn’t it? In an era where AI can do almost everything for us, a human being finds salvation in simple hand-knitting.
​Wishing you all a peaceful and productive week ahead! Until next time!
Translated into my AI assistant.*

links.title: Does God support evil to happen//Mcgi topic review
links.body:
From a biblical perspective, God is described as sovereign over all creation, meaning nothing happens outside His ultimate authority. It does not mean that God approve evil to happen because God doesn't support evil. The Bible consistently portrays God as holy and good, and therefore not the author of sin or wrongdoing.

But from the bible perspective God allows evil to happen with Him being the cause of the evil. Human free will plays a major role in the existence of evil, as people often choose actions that go against God’s will. In this sense, evil can occur within God’s permissive will, where He allows human decisions to unfold while still maintaining ultimate control over history.
