# ‎Mi desesperación comenzó a ser evidente. Temiendo lo peor y con la agonía en la voz de quien espera confirmar una tragedia, pregunté: ‎ ‎-*¿Y cómo está mi hermano?*-. ‎ ‎-*Cálmate*- me respondió Junior- *Tu hermano está bien. Le dió tiempo de llamar al vecino para pedirle que lo ayudara a apagar las llamas pero el agua de la tubería llegaba con muy poca fuerza y el fuego les ganó ventaja. No pudieron salvar nada*-. ‎ ‎Pocas veces en mi vida he respirado tan hondo como en ese momento. Sentí que la presión en mi cabeza comenzaba a distenderse. Poco a poco regresé a la realidad y, en consecuencia, a reconocer lo que estaba sucediendo. # https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png # Carayaca es la parroquia más grande de todo el estado La Guaira. En ella converge la producción agrícola más significativa de la región; pero las condiciones rurales y el difícil acceso a los asentamientos campesinos desperdigados obligan a emplear los recursos locales para construir. ‎ Por eso, es normal que buena parte de las casas sean de bahareque. # ___ ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme1FYh9BpMzaGB7xQEWSXNvRudLTnxBTcivLLhJwxnCRU/1779093801079.jpg)

*‎Para tener una idea, el paisaje en Carayaca es similar al de esta imagen/ Fotografía de [juandiegorojasrueda004](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/campesino-colombia-campesinos-4962831/)/Cortesía de Pixabay*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcUcaC4kDEocedRqy6aJX5SvFgpBMHg6oXeyYkQqxMLPE/1779087860194.jpg)
*Esta es una representación visual de cómo pueden ser las casas en la zona.* *Fotografía de [Duc Nguyen](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/edificio-refugio-cabana-destruido-20813493/)/ Cortesía de Pexels*
___ # Mi hermano y yo vivíamos juntos desde un año antes. El había llegado huyendo del hambre que se pasaba en Cantaura -donde estaban mis padres- por la espantosa crisis económica que se vivía en todo el país. El día que lo recibí me costó una barbaridad aguantarme las ganas de llorar. El traía los ojos amarillos por la hepatitis y estaba flaco como un gancho de colgar ropa. De haber pasado más tiempo en Cantaura aquel año... no sé. Tal vez la historia hubiese sido otra. A causa de la hepatitis el médico que lo atendió en la consulta antes de viajar le dijo que debía comer mucho dulce, preferiblemente frutas: tamarindo y cambur. ‎ ‎Y como por acto de la providencia, Carayaca es el paraíso de los cambures. Ni cuenta nos dimos cuando relevaron los síntomas y ya estaba bien repuesto. Una dieta rica en verduras y granos y casi cinco kilos de cambur bien maduro al día lo pusieron como una bestia: resistente y fornido. Habíamos hecho una casa con techo de acerolit y paredes de bahareque; muy fresca y cómoda. Pero nunca pensamos que esa \

se nos volvería cenizas.

No teníamos electricidad; pues al ser una zona agrícola de difícil acceso, el suministro eléctrico era un lujo: había que gastar mucho dinero en alambre de aluminio para hacer una conexión rudimentaria que atravesara el bosque de la montaña desde nuestra casa hasta la linea de transmisión mas cercana (aproximadamente 2 km de distancia) y la verdad, para nosotros era imposible. ‎Obviamente sí habían casas con electricidad, pero con un sacrificio significativo de sus habitantes.
‎
‎Esa era nuestra realidad. 

‎La noche del incendio acordé quedarme en la casa de Junior (a quince minutos caminando de donde vivíamos; un poco más cerca de la entrada del asentamiento) porque justamente Cheo y María, sus padres, saldrían al amanecer y yo aprovecharía para irme con ellos y no andar solo por la oscuridad de la madrugada.

Un autobús que cubría la ruta desde los caseríos hacia Carayaca, salía dos veces a la semana (casi siempre una sola vez) desde la entrada del asentamiento, a casi una hora caminando desde donde vivíamos. Y justamente ese autobús era el que yo tomaría esa madrugada para salir al pueblo. 

#

<centro>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>

#

Traté de pensar. 
‎
‎-*Solo necesito unos minutos*- les dije después del shock-
‎
‎Sin mediar palabras, salí corriendo. A medida que me alejaba cerro abajo me imaginaba como habría sido para mi hermano observar impotente la destrucción de la misma casa que me ayudó a levantar. Pocos minutos después me hallaba golpeando la reja de nuestro vecino, Victor, donde había pasado la noche mi hermano, Abraham.
‎
‎
‎Víctor no consiguió palabras; supongo por la pena, y hasta cierto punto, lástima. Aún era de madrugada y seguía oscuro. Recuerdo que le pedí prestada una linterna y seguí caminando, absorto, hacia mi casa. Mi hermano me acompañaba en medio de un profundo silencio cargado por la culpa de no haber podido evitar lo que pasó.  
‎
‎En mi interior forcejeaba con la idea de que todo aquello no era más que una pesadilla y que al despertar, todo acabaría. Me levantaría, prepararía café sobre el fogón, y mi casa seguiría en pie, intacta. 

Pero fuera de mi cabeza, lejos de ese forcejeo, en la realidad la noche era fría, la brisa soplaba con tranquilidad y los grillos junto al camino chirriaban inmersos, como cada noche, en el vaiven de su acostumbrada velada, completamente ajenos de que hacían la obertura precediendo a la luz de un amanecer que dejaría al descubierto los escombros de aquella noche voraz.
‎
‎Dejamos la calle de tierra para tomar el sendero por el cual pasabamos todos los días: durante las primeras horas de la mañana para ir a la faena y  después de una pesada jornada bajo el sol de la montaña, donde nos sentábamos frente a la casa a calmar el calor sofocante de mediodía antes de bañarnos.
Solo que esta vez yo tomaba ese mismo sendero para comprobar que nuestro lugar de paz había ardido hasta los cimientos. 
‎
#
___


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVTUUQ1Lz9LLNHP4SJaWsm4tzKB1Xd9aTkRWJ7SrURcSt/1779090660474.jpg)
<Center>*Representación visual para transmitir la idea de cómo pudo haber sido el incendio. 
Fotografía‎ de [Vladimir Shipits](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/noche-fuego-picante-caliente-11688876/). Cortesía de Pexels*</Center>


___

#

‎Apunté con la luz de la linterna rasgando la oscuridad como si en ese momento un velo macabro cubriese la evidencia de mi desesperación. Comprendí que el desastre había sucedido muy rápido. Me sorprendió sobremanera ver que las paredes de barro seco se habían cocido hasta volverse rojas y durísimas como ladrillo. 

Entonces entendí la magnitud de tragedia: mientras las llamas lo devoraban todo, la casa se transformaba en un horno. 
‎
‎
Me detuve de frente a‎ la casa: cara con cara. El techo había caído hacia adentro al colapsar los travesaños de madera que los mantenían sobre la estructura. Percibí un aroma flotante a carbón y plástico quemado. No distinguí nada entero entre los escombros aparte del jergón de la cama donde horas antes había una colchoneta. Ahora se había estirado tanto por el efecto del calor que parecía un chinchorro surrealista tejido de alambre.  ‎ 
‎
‎Pensé en algunas de tantas cosas que se habían perdido: ropa, zapatos, libros, una biblia de estudio de edición limitada que pertenecía a mi papá, corotos, sábanas, las notas certificadas de mis años en el liceo, el unico título firmado que demostraba que yo era bachiller... 
‎Sentí que perdía las fuerzas en mis piernas. Me agaché para no perder el equilibrio y me agarré la cabeza con ambas manos al tiempo en que imaginaba que podía haber sido peor. 
‎
‎
‎Lo único que me importaba en ese momento era que mi hermano estaba ileso y vivo. Me obligué a levantarme y caí en la cuenta de que todo ese rato el estuvo a mi lado mientras yo me perdía en la contemplación de lo inaudito. Lo miré, lo abracé y le dije: 
‎
‎-*Una casa se puede construir varias veces en la vida...*- suspiré profundamente sin soltarlo y continué- *...pero un hermano solo se tiene una vez.*
‎
‎
‎El me correspondió el abrazo sin decir nada. Volví a contemplar las ruinas de nuestro esfuerzo y musité en un susurro aquellas palabras del fiel Job: 

>*\

.* 
‎

Aún era de madrugada y seguía oscuro. Con la linterna encendida daba los últimos vistazos... ‎Se me antojó pensar cómo reaccionaría mi mamá al enterarse. 



Entonces Abraham empezó a contarme qué fue exactamente lo que pasó. 
‎
#

*Continúa en el próximo capítulo...*

links.title: MCGI Topic Review | Why Do People Die
links.body: > https://youtu.be/0vWzEY3NPKc?si=IIB8qT00M3nDml4t Mortality is a universal experience of all human beings. I have wondered on many occasions why people die. It's heart-wrenching when you have to ask it, particularly when you're losing someone you love. Sometimes death comes suddenly and the grief it leaves is too much to bear. But I am learning through the word of God that death was not God's purpose for man. In the Bible it is written that Sin came through one man, and death through sin (Romans 5:12). Sin entered the world into Adam and Eve's life when they disobeyed God in the Garden of Eden, and death entered into the world in mankind's life. This means that man's separation from God, the source of life, is the cause of death. Unfortunately, due to sin, all people are required to die at some time in their lives. But I am also comforted by the promises of God! For those who believe in Him, death is not the end. Jesus said in John 11:25, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.” This verse is an encouragement to me because I know that God has a plan for eternity for those who are faithful to Him. I know God cares for us, and has the ability to understand our suffering and pain, even when I'm afraid or heartbroken. Death sometimes teaches us to appreciate life and to get closer to God. Teach us to number our days, for we are wise in our own eyes, says Psalm 90:12. This scripture is a reminder to me to live a life of love and kindness and obey God every day. So, in summary, people die due to sin having entered the world, but through Jesus Christ, there is a hope beyond death. Death may cause tears and sorrow but God's promises bring us peace of heart. In my mind, God will take away pain and death – “There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.” (Revelation 21:4).

links.title: White oriental hyacinth.
links.body:
White oriental hyacinth.
We went to the flower shop, and I bought this beautiful flower. I planted it at home.
The flower grows like a bunch of grapes or lilacs. It reminds me of exactly that. The bush has small bell-shaped flowers.
For planting, you'll need water, fertilizer, and beetle poison, as beetles can gnaw the flower.

Dig a small hole large enough to accommodate the flower's roots, sprinkle some fertilizer, such as nitroammophoska, and a small pinch of fertilizer. Then water it, wait for the water to soak into the soil, and then plant the flower. It's important not to cover the leaves; only the roots need to be buried in the soil.

After planting, water the area around the flower again, being careful not to splash water on the leaves or the flower, especially in hot weather, as splashing water on the leaves in direct sunlight can scorch the flower.
Wait for the flower to take root. Watering is needed about twice a week on hot days. When it rains, the plant doesn't need watering. It likes moisture but doesn't like waterlogging.
I'll continue to care for my flowers, and they will delight me with their beauty.

links.title: Las diferencias no son antagonismos [Esp-Eng]
links.body:
_Saludos comunidad @holos.lotus._

_En un mismo solar de La Habana Vieja, dos hombres llevan tres semanas sin hablarse. El moreno Cheo dice que Alfredo el flaco es un caso perdido, el Flaco dice que Cheo tiene un genio que no hay quien lo aguante, su problema no es la pared que están levantando —esa va derecha y firme— sino el andamio. A Cheo le gusta poner las tablas horizontales primero; el Flaco jura que es más seguro empezar por los verticales, llevan discutiendo desde el primer día, y el dueño de la casa ya ni los mira._

_Hace una semana, Cheo declaró la cosa como algo puramente antagónico. \

, le dijo al dueño, y se fue a trabajar solo en una punta del solar, con el Flaco rezongando en la otra. El resultado es que llevan algunos días de retraso, la mezcla se les seca antes de tiempo porque no se ayudan a cargar los cubos, y el dueño anda buscando un tercer hombre que haga de puente, mientras tanto los dos siguen en lo suyo, convencidos de que el otro es el problema._

>Hello, community @holos.lotus

>In a same lot in Old Havana, two men haven’t spoken to each other for three weeks. Cheo, the dark-skinned one, says Alfredo the skinny one is a lost cause; the Skinny says Cheo has a temper nobody can stand—their problem isn’t the wall they’re building (that one is straight and sturdy) but the scaffolding. Cheo likes to lay the horizontal boards first; the Skinny swears it’s safer to start with the verticals. They’ve been arguing since day one, and the homeowner doesn’t even look at them anymore.

>A week ago, Cheo declared the situation purely antagonistic. “We’re like oil and water, boss—there’s no way this is going to work,” he told the owner, and went off to work alone at one end of the lot, with the Skinny grumbling at the other. The result is that they’re several days behind, the mortar dries out too quickly because they don’t help each other carry the buckets, and the owner is looking for a third man to act as a bridge. In the meantime, the two keep doing their own thing, each convinced the other is the problem.
**********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/2714073/pexels-photo-2714073.jpeg</center>
**********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/persona-resolviendo-la-distancia-de-los-puntos-2714073/)</center>

_Nadie en su sano juicio le va a discutir a Cheo que él y el Flaco son diferentes. Uno es callado y metódico; el otro habla hasta por los codos y resuelve todo a las carreras. ¿Será la diferencia el verdadero problema, o es que ninguno de los dos está dispuesto a ceder ni un centímetro de su orgullo? Porque lo que tienen delante no es un concurso de personalidades, sino una estructura que hay que dejar derecha antes de que venga la temporada ciclónica._

_Con bastante frecuencia los antagonismos se usan, para justificar por qué un chofer y su ayudante no se soportan en una ruta de camiones, por qué dos socios terminan dividiendo el local arrendado con una cortina, por qué un soldador y un electricista no pueden coordinar el mismo hueco en una obra. Detrás de cada \
suele haber, en el fondo, un \

._

_Una buena parte de esas supuestas relaciones antagónicas se desarman con una conversación, pero una conversación de verdad, no de esas donde cada uno espera su turno para repetir su postura, sino en la que uno acepta hacer la prueba del otro. Un día se hace a la manera de Cheo; al otro a la del Flaco, y quizás al tercer día los dos descubren que una tabla horizontal bien puesta y un vertical firme no se pelean, se complementan, que ser antagónicos en los métodos no significa tener que estar en guerra; y es que tal vez juntos pueden cubrir más errores._

>No one in their right mind would argue with Cheo that he and the Skinny are different. One is quiet and methodical; the other talks a mile a minute and does everything in a rush. Is the difference the real problem, or is it that neither is willing to give an inch of their pride? Because what they have in front of them isn’t a personality contest, but a structure that needs to be set straight before cyclone season arrives.

>Quite often, antagonisms are used to justify why a truck driver and his helper can’t stand each other on a route, why two partners end up dividing their rented space with a curtain, why a welder and an electrician can’t coordinate on the same opening at a construction site. Behind every “we’re polar opposites,” there is usually, deep down, an “I don’t want anyone telling me how to do my job” or a “I can’t be bothered to explain anything to the other person.”

>A good number of these supposed antagonistic relationships can be dismantled with a conversation—but a real conversation, not one where each person waits their turn to repeat their position, but one where each agrees to try the other’s way. One day you do it Cheo’s way; the next, the Skinny’s way; and maybe by the third day, both discover that a properly placed horizontal board and a sturdy vertical one don’t fight—they complement each other. That being antagonistic in methods doesn’t mean you have to be at war, and that perhaps together they can cover more mistakes.
***********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/8793779/pexels-photo-8793779.jpeg</center>
**********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/arte-creativo-amarillo-colores-8793779/)</center>

_Hay personas que confunden \

, y eso no es más que un error de percepción, se puede venir de la montaña o de la costa, se puede ser de los que ordenan las herramientas al terminar o de los que las dejan tiradas, se puede tener la sangre fría o el corazón ardiente, y aún así construir algo juntos, lo que no se puede es remar junto a alguien que ya decidió hundir el barco antes de subirse._

_Los antagonismos no son una profecía que se cumple sola, más si crees que no hay manera, como tal actuarás y efectivamente todo puede salir mal. Pero también funciona al revés, si los dos albañiles del solar aceptaran —aunque sea por una semana— que la posibilidad de trabajar juntos se construye con pequeños gestos: avisar antes de mover una tabla, preguntar la opinión del otro, cargar juntos el saco de cemento, aunque a cada uno le parezca que el otro lo hace mal, la susodicha estructura ya estaría un poco más adelantada y los dos estarían tomándose un café en la acera en vez de mirarse de reojo._

_Poder hacer algo juntos no es un don de nacimiento, sino una decisión que se toma todos los días, podríamos elegir el orgullo y la incomodidad eterna, o bajar las armas, hacer el intento y comprobar algo que muchos han logrado, que juntos aunque sea a regañadientes, se avanza mucho más rápido. La pared no espera, menos por aquí con los materiales contados y los plazos apretados, el tiempo no espera por antagónicos e incompatibles._

>Some people confuse “being different” with “being enemies,” and that’s nothing more than a perceptual error. You can come from the mountains or the coast, you can be the type who puts away the tools after finishing or the type who leaves them lying around, you can have cold blood or a burning heart, and still build something together. What you cannot do is row alongside someone who has already decided to sink the boat before getting on board.

>Antagonisms are not a self-fulfilling prophecy—actually, if you believe there’s no way, you’ll act accordingly, and indeed everything can go wrong. But it also works the other way around: if the two bricklayers on the lot accepted—even just for a week—that the possibility of working together is built with small gestures (giving a heads-up before moving a board, asking for the other’s opinion, carrying the cement sack together, even if each thinks the other does it wrong), that damned structure would already be a little further along, and the two would be having coffee on the sidewalk instead of glaring at each other.

>Being able to do something together is not a birthright, but a decision you make every day. We could choose pride and eternal discomfort, or lower our weapons, make the attempt, and verify something many have achieved: that together, even if grudgingly, you move forward much faster. The wall won’t wait—especially not around here, with materials running short and deadlines tight. Time doesn’t wait for antagonists and incompatibles.
*********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/17695677/pexels-photo-17695677.jpeg</center>
********

links.title: Currency conversion deductions
links.body:
I am reading so much about Japan and from that I am feeling like every second person on this planet is going for a holiday to Japan. Trust me if you see the Insta stories, it is overwhelming. If so many people are going, then, it means the currency is easily available. 2 days back I went to one of the money exchange offices in my area. Normally I visit here to get currency during all my travels. Their conversion rate it always very good. There are around 5 exchanges in my area and this one always has the best rate.

The current Omani Rial to Japanese Yen rate is 1 OMR = 408 JPY. The conversion rate this exchange gave me is 357 yen to 1 omr. I was quite shocked because this is like 13% deduction. I was expecting somewhere between 5% to 8%, because I know in Oman not many people are travelling to Japan and nor do we get many Japanese tourists here so the inflow and outflow both are less. I thought of just going and checking with other places also. The other exchange offered me a further ridiculous rate, giving me a quote of 325 yen to 1 omr, which is like 20% deduction. I would be in a good loss with this kind of exchange rate. Finally, one exchange gave me a quote of 375, which is also 9% deduction, but then I have no choice. I have to take some cash with me.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU5bu22QtMr7yp5HvmRMb6938kcvpBrHWqwcZNjnDV7tn/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/money-exchange-foreign-exchange-148668/)

Most of the payment I would prefer to do by credit card because that's 4% interest rate for me, so it's much better then 9% deduction. Also, I have read that 7/11 ATMs are best for cash withdrawals; they have around 4% interest as well. But going to a new country, I would need some cash in hand to start with, then later I can figure out these things. So as of now, I got some exchange, that too they gave me big denomination, now that's another headache to change into smaller currency. Normally I prefer to carry cash rather than spending card, but not with this much loss. Let's see how it goes there.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

links.title: Rice and Pepper soup and My Local vegetable soup with eba
links.body:
Eating my local food on a Monday morning brings me so much  joy and satisfaction. I am someone who loves eating food, most especially eba and vegetable soup.

Eba and vegetable soup is not just a delicious meal but a very nutritious meal that is rich in different minerals the body needs. 

The Vegetable soup is primarily made up of pumpkin leaf, water leaf, stock fish, palm oil, crayfish and other ingredients. These five ingredients alone are very rich in different vitamins that is nutritional for the body.

So, yesterday I travelled to my friend’s house, on reaching there in the afternoon, I branched the food park over there and bought a plate of rice and pepper soup.


![IMG_20260517_165430_808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/EokdcThXuKjqsjZHHidpzerRNzbPE4f6UQGVid2nceo4JUR6UA7xu21ksM6v47qRvv2.jpg)


The rice and pepper soup is what I ate and it was very delicious. This pepper soup was filled with lots of beef meat too which I chewed to my satisfaction. 

After eating, I headed to my friend’s home where I was informed that they cooked this delicious vegetable soup which we call “edikaikong” in my local dialect.


![IMG_20260518_083530_767.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/EowH9ZCRFSLndibbqPcLccPqi3yYg7jRNCVq5dM7BSSCyVtSvqE5GDzULifaFQBx4Qh.jpg)


My stomach was very full, so I couldn't eat the soup yesterday and decided that I will eat a lot of it the next morning with eba also known as garri in my place.

I slept like a log of wood simply because I was very tired of the rice and pepper soup I ate at the food park and woke up this morning feeling very energetic.

I stepped into the kitchen, removed the soup from the refrigerator, warmed the soup and dished into a plate. I started gulping one ball to another untill I finished eating everything.

This food refreshed my soul and made me look this happy. I believe I will be smiling throughout my day because I have eaten one of my favourite meals. 

This is me looking happy 

![IMG_20260518_095456_987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23ydGPYtH4vYhSb1cW79rNwy6YadP9E8qQGzw8oUDmffE6uLHnfWMuG8GiWEq2iDRyBFX.jpg)

Below is the photo of what the fresh vegetable from the farm looks like taken with my phone.


![IMG_20260515_093140_048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/Ep1WueuFkycsjH7YxqCPxV5XsESkE6it8Vccwr1UTzirpBqrgXNNVzyfnMAcsYgheJL.jpg)


Have you had a great meal today or are you planning to have one? you can have a great meal to fill your taste buds. I enjoyed my own meal and I know you will enjoy yours too. Thank you for reading, see you in my next post.

links.title: Can Smart Contracts Replace Traditional Legal Systems?
links.body: Being a crypto and decentralized economies enthusiast you can already guess that my answer is yes.\n\nBut the real question isn't \

Or more specifically: will it be allowed to?

Most of what we debate when it comes to what crypto and blockchain can and cannot do, boils down to what current systems allow to manifest.

Of course, we must understand that we are a part of this system. As much as the politicians and select wealthy individuals hold significant power over the legal and governance systems of global economies, nothing can really withstand an angry public that's had enough and want change.

As such, if we want smart contracts to be a part of the future of nations governance systems, we'd have to be prepared to do what it takes because the limitations aren't the tech, but the system it's aim to replacing or improve.

Speaking of improvements, let's talk:

### Integration

It is important to understand that smart contracts won't replace but improve the legal system.

It's like ed-tech. What gets replaced is the manual work, not what makes up the system.

By the system here, I'm generally referring to the laws, in the case of the legal system, and for the school system, we are looking at education itself.

Ed-tech automates what can be automated, records, scoring, student data analysis, these things can be handled by software.

In the same way, smart contracts will handle the manual tasks that can be automated and to the greater benefit, the legal system will earn more transparency and credibility since records will be immutable and publicly accessible.

This is a merit that's worth to have, smart contracts will handle the predictable, high-volume, low-ambiguity execution of agreements, while lawyers and courts will handle the complex, high-stakes, ambiguous situations that require human judgment.

Ultimately, smart contracts simply become the execution layer of the legal system, a solution that it's fundamentally designed for.

title.title: The Sandwich
title.body: Raghu stood outside the small bakery every evening, staring through the glass window at the fresh sandwiches lined neatly on the shelves. The smell of toasted bread, butter, and spices floated into the cold street, making his empty stomach ache even more. He was only ten years old. His clothes were torn, his slippers broken, and his face carried the tiredness of someone much older. After his father’s death, Raghu spent his days collecting plastic bottles and newspapers from garbage piles to help his sick mother survive. That evening, rain poured heavily over the city. Raghu had not eaten since morning. He pressed his hand against his stomach and looked at the sandwiches one last time before turning away. “Wait.” A soft voice stopped him. The bakery door opened, and a woman in a simple blue saree stepped outside. She looked around forty, with kind eyes that somehow noticed pain others ignored. “Have you eaten anything today?” she asked gently. Raghu lowered his eyes. “No.” Without another word, she went inside and returned with a warm vegetable sandwich wrapped in paper and a cup of tea. “Here,” she said. Raghu hesitated. “I don’t have money.” “I know,” she smiled. “Sometimes people need food, not questions.” The warmth of the sandwich spread through his frozen hands. Raghu ate slowly at first, then faster as hunger took over. Tears mixed with the rain on his cheeks. No one had treated him with kindness in a very long time. “What’s your name?” the woman asked. “Raghu.” “I’m Meera,” she replied. “Promise me something, Raghu.” He looked up. “When life becomes better for you one day, help someone else the same way.” Raghu nodded silently. That sandwich became more than food that night. It became hope. Years passed. Life did not suddenly become easy, but Raghu never forgot Meera’s kindness. He studied at night under streetlights, worked during the day, and slowly changed his destiny. A local teacher noticed his intelligence and helped him continue school. Later, scholarships carried him through college. Twenty years later, Dr. Raghu Verma became one of the city’s most respected heart surgeons. People admired his success, but nobody knew the real reason behind it—a sandwich given on a rainy evening by a stranger with a kind heart. One winter night, after a long surgery, Raghu walked through the hospital corridor when he noticed an elderly woman arguing weakly with the receptionist. “I’ll pay somehow,” she pleaded. “Please start my treatment.” The receptionist shook his head. “The operation is expensive.” Raghu glanced toward the woman casually— —and froze. The blue saree had faded with time. Her hair had turned white. Her face carried wrinkles now. But those eyes… He recognized them instantly. “Meera ji?” he whispered. The woman looked confused. Raghu walked closer, his eyes filling with tears. “You may not remember me… but twenty years ago, you bought a hungry boy a sandwich in the rain.” Meera stared at him silently. “You told me to help someone when life became better,” he continued, his voice trembling. “Everything I became started that day.” Tears rolled down Meera’s cheeks as memory slowly returned. “Raghu?” she whispered. He nodded. She had been living alone after losing her husband. Her savings were gone because of illness, and now she needed heart surgery she could never afford. Raghu smiled softly and held her hands. “This time,” he said, “let me buy you the sandwich.” Meera broke down crying. A few days later, the surgery was successful. When Meera woke up in recovery, she found a small tray beside her bed. On it was a freshly made vegetable sandwich and a cup of tea. Along with a note: > “Kindness never disappears. > It returns when the heart needs it most.” > > [

title.title: Hiking in the Bitlis Mountains, Gathering Wild Herbs
title.body: With the melting of the snow, I regularly go on mountain hikes. This year, spring was a little late, so I go to the mountains with more excitement, eagerness, and desire. Especially on weekends, the areas I go to, such as Karataş and Duav Plateau, are flooded with people. Some come to satisfy their longing for the mountains, some to harvest beets, and others to have picnics. _Karların erimesi ile birlikte dağ yürüyüşlerini düzenli şekilde yapıyorum. Bu yıl ilkbahar biraz geciktiği için dağlara daha heyecanlı , arzulu, istekli şekilde gidiyorum. Özellikle haftasonları gittiğim taraflarda, Karataş ve Duav Yaylası bölgesi insan akınına uğruyor. Kimi dağlara olan özlemini giderirken kimisi pancar toplmaya kimisi piknik tarzı şeyler yapmak için buraya geliyor._
/>\n\nMy friend and I left home at 11:30 AM. We drove about 2-3 km, then started climbing the mountain. Our goal was to collect a sour-tasting plant called \

which is peeled and eaten. Since there had been people who had been there before us, they had collected the best, ripest uçkun. We were able to collect the remaining uçkun, the ones hidden among the grass. As you can see in the photo, the valley is huge. A stream runs through it. The stream's flow is very high right now. In the summer months, the stream's flow is quite low. This year there was a lot of rain, but not enough sunshine. Therefore, the grass hasn't grown sufficiently. _Arkadaşım ile birlikte saat 11:30'da evden yola çıktık. Yaklaşık 2-3 km mesafeyi araba ile gittik. Sonrasında dağı tırmanmaya başladık. Amacımız ''uçkun'' adı verilen ekşimtrak , soyulup yenilen bitkiyi toplamaktı. Gittiğimiz bölgede bizden önce giden insanlar olduğu için en güzel, en olgunlaşan olan uçkunları toplamışlardı. Biz de arta kalan, insanların otların arasında göremediği uçkunları toplayabildik. Fotoğrafta da gördüğünüz gibi vadi devasa. Vadiden bir dere geçiyor. Derenin debisi şu an çok yüksek. Yaz aylarında derenin debisi oldukça düşüyor. Bu yıl yağış çok fazla oldu ancak güneş yeterince yoktu. Bu yüzden otların yeterince büyümemiş._
. It gets its name because its summit is covered with black stones. _Fotoğrafta görünen dağın ismi ''Karataş'' . Dağın zirvesi siyah taşlarla kaplı olduğu için bu ismi almış._
/> The snow in the valley is melting rapidly. The water has split the snowdrift in two. _Vadideki karlar hızlı bir şekilde eriyor. Su kar birikintisini ikiye ayırmış._

/>

And we're in an area where wild garlic grows. The wild garlic is visible among the large leaves. Sometimes you have to look between the leaves to see it. Generally, the most beautiful wild garlic is observed among the leaves. According to research, wild garlic is quite beneficial for diabetes. Because it grows quite far from settlements and its harvest season is very short, its price is quite high. While it was 750 TL (16.5$) per kilo in the early days, it is now sold for around 500 TL in the markets. Those who go and collect it gather about 40-50 kg, and if they can sell it all in the markets, they earn a good amount of money daily. This was the Karataş region. After this, we moved on to Duav Plateau. I will share a post about that soon.

_Ve uçkunların olduğu alandayız. Büyük yaprakların arasında uçkunlar gözüküyor. Bazen uçkunu görebilmek için yaprağın arasında bakmak gerekiyor. Genelde en güzel uçkunlar yaprakların arasında gözlenmiş oluyor. Uçkunlar yapılan araştırmalara göre şeker hastalığı için gayet faydalıymış. Yerleşim yerlerinden bayağı uzakta yetiştiği için ve hasat mevsimi çok kısa süreli olduğu için fiyatı oldukça fazla. İlk dönemler kilosu 750 TL (16.5$) iken şimdilerde fiyatı 500 TL civarında pazarlarda satılıyor. Gidip toplayanlar yaklaşık 40-50 kg topluyor ve pazarlarda hepsini satabilirlerse günlük iyi miktarda para kazanmış oluyorlar. Burası Karataş bölgesiydi. Buradan sonra Duav Yaylasına geçtik. Bununla ilgili gönderiyi yakında paylaşacağım._

title.body:
![w2.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/web2.support/870946a659c0bdd4c154e8829fdbec643908a39b.png)

title.title: My Magi Network tryout
title.body: Hello Hivians!\n\nWe are gathered here today to be trying out [link url=\

]https://altera.magi.eco/[/link], created by @magi.network - a service that allow native swaps from Hive to Magi itself or to the Bitcoin blockchain. Todays focus is Hive/Magi.
[b]Without further ado, let's get into it![/b] ---
[h2]First impression[/h2] [img url=\

] Upon first login, everything seems pretty organized and straight up. [b]What caught my eye?[/b] That was the [i]Witness Assistant![/i] Why? Not quite sure why that was it, but it was.
It is worth noting that I have done no research prior to trying out the service as I like to learn by doing. [img url=\

]I have absolutely no clue what that actually is, but I deposited 30 HIVE into it and will see what happens with it.
[h2]Further tryout[/h2] I deposited HIVE and HBD to see how this would work and what it would do. The HIVE didn't really do much. I guess it just makes it possible to stake into Witness Assistant, and also perform swaps directly from Magi. The HBD increased my [b]Magi Resource Credits[/b]. These are used to perform actions on Magi. 1 HBD = 1 MRC. [img url=\

]If we compare the MRC from the first image with the image above, we clearly see that: 1. MRC has increased by the same amount as HBD 2. MRC is not at 100% since I've performed actions on the service. This means we can perform more actions if we have more HBD on the Magi Network.
[h2]Staking HBD on Magi[/h2] This is, for most people I guess, straight forward. You click on [i]Staking[/i] right in the middle of the page. For me, this isn't logical. It should, in my opinion, be located with the Deposit and Withdraw actions. When staking, you can choose \
(which should probably be changed to the new Magi name too).\n\n[img url=\
]This is, for me at least, checked by default and seems to mean \

. Uncheck it, and you stake from Magi.
When staking directly from Magi, it will remove some of your MRC, if you stake HBD. I'm unsure whether this is intentional or not. We clearly see it here: [img url=\

]Notice how 1 HBD moved into sHBD removed 1 MRC too.
[h1]Conclusion[/h1] The @magi.network is definitely building something useful to the entire crypto space. With the right marketing strategy and a proper reach, it will change how crypto currency is transferred, swapped and maybe even stored. [b]Well done, team![/b]
--- [b]Thank you for reading[/b] --- Images are screenshots from my use of the website [link url=\

links.title: Can I Park My Car at Bikas Park in Budapest?
links.body:
So, you’ve watched this fitness video, suddenly felt inspired to become a healthier version of yourself, and now you are planning a trip to Bikas Park in Budapest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=292-oCPCcDs

Maybe you have already read about the park itself and its outdoor fitness areas, running tracks, and relaxing atmosphere in this article about [Bikas Park in Budapest](https://www.hungarybudapestguide.com/bikas-park-in-budapest-running-tracks-outdoor-fitness-a-relaxing-green-escape/).

But then the practical question arrives:

**Can I actually park my car there?**

The answer is yes.

And honestly, compared to many other places in Budapest, parking at Bikas Park is surprisingly painless.

## Yes, There Is a Big Parking Lot

Bikas Park has a large parking area right next to the park itself, making it extremely convenient if you arrive with:

- running shoes
- gym clothes
- bicycles
- yoga mats
- protein shakes
- unrealistic expectations about how many pull-ups you can do

Unlike downtown Budapest, where parking can sometimes feel like participating in a psychological experiment, Bikas Park is refreshingly easy.

On weekdays, there are usually plenty of free parking spaces available.

Even during weekends, finding a spot is normally not difficult.

## What Does Parking Cost?

The current parking fee is:

- **300 HUF per hour**

That is actually quite reasonable for Budapest, especially considering how easy the parking situation is.

If you want more information about parking rules, free parking opportunities, and how parking works in the Hungarian capital in general, check this guide about [free parking and parking in Budapest](https://www.hungarybudapestguide.com/free-parking-in-budapest/).

## Important Warning About Saturdays

Now comes the very important part.

Every Saturday, there is a large market held in the area.

And this changes everything.

Cars must normally be removed from the parking area by **Friday evening**, because the market takes over the parking lot during Saturday morning and midday.

So if your genius plan was:

> “I’ll leave my car here overnight, explore Budapest, sleep somewhere downtown, and come back Sunday…”

…then no. Bad idea.

You might return to discover that your car has had a more exciting Saturday than you did.

## Free Parking After the Market and on Sundays

The good news?

After the market ends on Saturday afternoon — usually around **15:00** — parking becomes free again.

And on Sundays, parking is also free.

That makes Bikas Park a pretty attractive option if you are visiting Budapest during the weekend and want:

- easy parking
- a calm environment
- access to Metro Line 4
- a place to start your run or workout before sightseeing

## Parking Hours During the Week

From Monday to Friday:

- Paid parking starts at **08:00**
- Paid parking ends at **18:00**

Outside those hours, parking is generally free.

That means if you arrive early in the morning for a run, or stay into the evening after your workout, you might avoid paying at all.

Suddenly fitness becomes financially rewarding.

## Can You Leave the Car There While Sightseeing?

Technically, yes.

Bikas Park is located directly on Metro Line 4, which makes it very easy to continue into central Budapest afterward.

You can quickly reach places like:

- Kálvin tér
- Gellért tér
- Fővám tér
- Keleti Pályaudvar

So many people combine:

- exercise in the park
- relaxing in the green areas
- sightseeing afterward

Honestly, it is not a bad strategy.

You burn calories in the morning, then immediately earn them back later with chimney cake, goulash, and giant Hungarian desserts.

links.title: Hive Top Holders 1.3.0 Update: Small Changes, Much Better Experience
links.body:
Since the release of **Hive Top Holders v1.2**, it has gradually become one of the tools I personally use the most.

Whenever I have some free time, I often open it just to check my HP ranking. Watching the numbers slowly climb gives me that strange feeling of grinding levels in a game 😳

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNSNbxpoNyH37tpXCZa5MFYmEhLdCD2awKdgnpxeDtDd2/image.png)

## The More I Used It, the More Issues I Noticed

As I started using it more frequently, I gradually noticed some small usability issues.

For example, I often browse in:

**VESTS → Show as HP**

But every time I refreshed the page, I had to:

- Click VESTS
- Turn on the Show as HP toggle again

After repeating this over and over, I realized I was doing the exact same actions way too often...

The same applies to people who mainly follow:

**HBD Savings rankings**

They also have to repeat the same series of steps every time.

These are tiny issues on their own, but once repeated frequently, they start affecting the overall experience.

> Often, what hurts user experience isn't the big problems — it's the tiny actions repeated every single day.



## Adding Route Support

So I started thinking:

Maybe adding route support would make more sense.

That way, refreshing the page would no longer reset everything back to the default view, and users could directly jump into their preferred section through URLs.


For example:

![4f3a93776ad321688cf28b405041642a.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUpHmYihv81R4fPccULB1Xe2kWieTftpLxqc7T1tED5ej/4f3a93776ad321688cf28b405041642a.png)

Now you can go there directly in one step.

## HP Ranking Is Now the Default View

After AI helped me implement the routing feature, another thought came to mind:

Most people are probably more interested in the **HP rankings** anyway.

So I made two additional changes:

✅ Moved VESTS to the first asset category

✅ Enabled HP display by default

Now when you open the tool, the first thing you see is HP Rankings:

![f3ca5d70cd4e5346d6fbaab8c1a35a1b.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWaqXN8Pp1fUzcKpYMva7f49tHWwmbjFfSW41ik5QMVn/f3ca5d70cd4e5346d6fbaab8c1a35a1b.png)

No extra clicks needed anymore.


## URL Pagination Support

Later, while continuing to tweak things, another issue crossed my mind:

What if your ranking isn't on the first page?

So I also added pagination support to URLs.

For example:


![ef560b199f1337440140677834f34369.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUqYgdnKbHz6xE5UHVTBB5GPLA2KqZ8TTNbjz7vjv9RnY/ef560b199f1337440140677834f34369.png)
![74d2f9b18eb6092d4f573f4e2587e561.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQuWk6zHFHAGs4bEpezzytnDNerRPNAY3x79maCwBtyT/74d2f9b18eb6092d4f573f4e2587e561.png)


Now you can jump directly to a specific page.

This should be especially useful for users whose rankings are a bit further down the list.



## What's Included in This Update

Hive Top Holders 1.3.0 mainly includes:

- Added route support
- Page refresh now preserves current state
- URLs can directly access specific sections
- HP rankings are now the default view
- Moved VESTS to the first position
- Added pagination support in URLs

These all seem like small changes, but together they noticeably improve the overall user experience.


Hope you'll enjoy this update. And I wish everyone bigger assets, higher HP, and rankings that keep climbing 🚀



## 🔗 Try It Now

👉 https://top-holders.cutehive.com/

Feel free to try it out and share your feedback.

links.title: Bitcoin Price Broke Down the Middle Line of Ascending Channel
links.body:
Bitcoin price is in an ascedngin channel for a few months. Bitcoin price was going up slowly. After touching 200-day moving average, it reversed down from this level. The middle line of this ascending channel is the first support level after reversing down. It could not support Bitcoin price and Bitcoin price broke down this level. 

Here you can see daily chart of Bitcoin price. The bottom line of this channel is waiting Bitcoin price to support. There is also great support level at 75K. Bitcoin price should be supported at 75 USD or 73K USD.



![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swiP6d38hUFsZLBkDiXU3McggWbgC6yTkv5dHQG1oxxVvJfCG95Uz1DGyzQUboPQc7r.PNG)

Here you can see the indicators on daily chart of Bitcoin price. Even RSI Indicator broke up great downtrend line, we could not see bulish pattern on RSI Indicator. There was mini uptrend line on RSI Indicator and It is broken down. I shared lots of analysis and said we may see another beariah wave on Bitcoin price chart. It may be started. 

MACD Indicator reversed down from the top. Fisher Indicator is close to the bottom. If the bottom line of this ascending channel supports Bitcoin price, Fisher Indicator will reverse up from the bottom. 

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swkEbmW4XYiBH3g94k7GZsK8xb3qka2ki5jUCsiqSjrcU4R61LorHGFebeTp9QK6afq.PNG)

It’s approx. 2 kgs from the condominium, it’s a great exercise for me. ;D When I arrived at Wat Rat Burana, it didn’t disappoint me and my tiredness disappeared immediately. This was the first time that I went there, so I said WOW at my first sight of the temple’s entrance door.

/> When entering the entrance door, my eyes were attracted by the two big sculptures of Vessavana; the green and the white one. They look sacred. There were many garlands from people who used to worship the sculptures.
/> Wat Rat Burana is located by the canal and along the banks of the Chao Phraya River.
/> There are two pagodas, built in Mon and Khmer architectural styles. There are also two viharas (prayer halls).
/> There are many sacred sculptures at Wat Rat Burana for people to worship. They are all beautiful.
/> Before I left the temple, I saw a temple dog standing on the temple ground, so I made a video of him…

/>

P.S. There are many other interesting things in Wat Rat Burana, I’ll show you more photos in my next posts.

links.title: MegaETH Terminal Weekly Recap: S01 - W01
links.body:
Week 1 on MegaETH is already wrapped up and looking strong! We’ve been diving deep into the MegaETH Terminal and stress-testing an ultra high-performance EVM.

The new Layer 2 blockchain built on top of Ethereum officially went live last week with $MEGA, aiming to make crypto apps feel as fast and responsive as traditional web apps.

The core idea behind MegaETH is “real-time” execution and it's clear since day one that the Terminal is essentially the execution-layer playground where we're cooking! 

We’re focused on the pattern-recognition game, where transactions are processed almost instantly with ultra-low latency and massive throughput, instead of users waiting around for block finality.

Got some skin in the game and my new rank is 3,672th, which is a gigantic leap of 23579 spots. As they said.. I am climbing the leaderboard and got a strong position! 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeoBx2ZWxXCnEG1gNLr13Sqor6MKnGy8tkd6BixvwCzHj/image.png)


MegaETH isn’t tracking raw transaction count but they’re looking for behavioral signatures that signal you’ll become a high-value long-term user of the ecosystem.

It’s still very early for MegaETH, and a lot of the excitement is driven by its technical potential. The real test will be whether developers build compelling applications on top of it users actually stick around! 

I discovered all 22 dapps and explored five of them, going deeper and expanding my views of the ecosystem. [Pump Party](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) is a real-time onchain game built on the MegaETH ecosystem. 

The idea is that MegaETH’s ultra-fast execution makes everything feel instant instead of laggy like most blockchain games. Let's enjoy the [Pump Party](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) cannon app then! 

It's an experimental arcade-style mini-games with gambling mechanics layered in. Players pay $ETH to launch the rabbit and may win prizes depending on the outcome.

tl;dr: you [shoot the rabbit out of the cannon](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) and you may get prizes for the $ETH you're paying. I played 6 times, with 0.001 $ETH per go, and managed to be 0.002 $ETH in profit! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcExeJNny5Hu2AfNTkPirmjt1nVF7ybdZKjuDUT28iG8/image.png)


Over $40 million will be distributed over the next 8 weeks for Terminal users. Depending on how you rank against others, you will receive a share of the total airdrop!

There's 2.5% of [$MEGA ](https://x.com/search?q=%24MEGA&src=cashtag_click)supply so let's do it together and show what team work is the best. I started my MegaETh journey on [Hit One](https://app.hit.one/r/65JB2W)! Start spinning or arcade finance! 

This is a fun perps app, where you can put in between $1 and $50 USD per round and [Hit One](https://app.hit.one/r/65JB2W) will open a random high leverage (400x and more) short or long for you!

What about the new cohort of dapps added this week? I don't do perps so had to look for the easy ones! No-loss scratch cards? You got my attention with this one! 

My 19 points got me a nice rank so the show must go on! I made a strategy to slowly build a stash of $MEGA, and the plan is to add 50-100 tokens into Flux each week. 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcddaVw4i5bHvqTDM4iCpPCZdThx56CYF6S2BGVucdxKw/image.png)


Having some fun on [Prism](https://prismfi.cc/?ref=PVMBOSS) by predicting the price of WTI Crude Oil, market ending soon! This dapp is both a DEX and a prediction market, built by the BadBunnz team! 

I thought [Prism](https://prismfi.cc/?ref=PVMBOSS) will be my main playground but it's built on top of Polymarket and that's not available for UK users! So I moved to opening pokemon packs on [Mnstr](https://mnstr.xyz/?ref=PVMIHALACHE)!

Packs are priced between $50 and $1,250 USD, and expect an average loss of 10-20% per pack... unless you get lucky! You connect to [Mnstr](https://mnstr.xyz/?ref=PVMIHALACHE) your X account. Good luck!  

[ITS](https://itstheseason.xyz/?ref=FLPNNK) on MegaETH is a trading card game, you can buy booster packs and use them in-game. The booster packs have dynamic pricing, meaning with each purchase the price goes up.   

Farming requires you to burn some capital unless you play it super safe by providing USDm/USDT0 liquidity. Pokémon packs, Fantasy Football, perps ... expect losses.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRkwZuUxV69ViBfpiUdx4wZQtgNFPiJ9aTuXG9HfzC112/image.png)

links.title: Building Scalable Visual Systems in EdTech: Ouch Versus Custom Illustration
links.body:
![mmmm.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/5bd322d272fb19973eebddee7ae12ce1afc34affb0614a1430075f23996cda0e)

Rainy Thursday evenings rarely bring good news. Month four of a six-month product cycle just hit a massive wall. Silas sits in his dimly lit office staring at a dense project management board. His upcoming beta release for a gamified math module requires 14 distinct UI screens. Empty states, success modals, connection timeouts, and complex onboarding flows all need graphics.

One glaring problem stands in the way. That external freelance illustrator contracted three weeks ago just asked for a timeline extension. Capacity limits struck again.

Silas needs a cohesive set of visuals by Monday morning to keep frontend development moving. Waiting for custom vector art isn't an option anymore.

He opens Ouch. Can off-the-shelf assets plug the gap? Fingers crossed. Nobody wants their learning app looking like a patched-together prototype.

## The Economics of Long Term Visual Production

Startups routinely face a specific bottleneck during prolonged product cycles. Design teams establish a visual language early on. First, they contract an artist to create core hero graphics for a homepage. Next comes reality. Fifty more minor visual assets are suddenly required for application edge cases. Drop-down menus look bare. Password recovery screens feel disconnected. Teacher portals need onboarding tooltips.

Evaluating illustration libraries against a freelancer comes down to balancing velocity against absolute control. Freelance contracts guarantee exact brand alignment. Every character matches your proprietary style guide perfectly. But custom art burns through budgets rapidly. Revisions add serious lead times. Waiting two weeks for five modal graphics kills momentum. EdTech companies can't afford stalled development schedules right before a school year begins.

Relying on an off-the-shelf system shifts that dynamic entirely. You're trading absolute bespoke uniqueness for immediate volume. Thousands of professional illustrations live across over 101 distinct styles. Instead of waiting days for one empty state graphic revision, product teams pull pre-made files fitting an established aesthetic.

Curating existing assets becomes the primary challenge. Managing a contracted artist takes a backseat to maintaining consistent user experience coverage.

## Mapping the User Journey With Consistent Vector Sets

Constructing an educational platform rarely involves downloading isolated images for decorative purposes. Modern interfaces demand cohesive styles covering an entire user experience flow. Students notice jarring shifts in visual language. A reading comprehension app feels fractured when the login screen looks cartoonish but the dashboard feels corporate.

Typical implementations start by establishing a visual baseline. A design team might select a simple line graphics style for a student dashboard. Next, they download SVG files for core learning modules. Ouch builds files as layered vector graphics broken down into searchable objects. You aren't stuck with exact pre-made scenes.

Open Mega Creator directly in your browser. Swap out specific elements instantly. Take a standard business scene. Delete a generic office desk. Insert a chalkboard or an interactive tablet object from that exact same style family. Move characters around to create a fresh narrative. Add a stack of textbooks or a microscope to contextualize the lesson.

Recolor remaining elements to match your brand palette. Small teams build highly specific visuals for add-to-cart sequences or login screens without drawing a single line. Output matches frontend needs perfectly.

## Evaluating Market Alternatives

Deciding on an asset strategy requires analyzing the broader ecosystem of available tools.

Hiring custom illustrators gives you total narrative control. Exclusive artwork looks great. But paying hundreds of dollars per scene burns cash. Rigid revision cycles often stall development sprints.

UnDraw offers a highly popular open-source alternative. Adjusting primary brand colors directly on the site takes seconds. Grab an SVG immediately. Ubiquity ruins the magic, though. Tech companies everywhere use unDraw. Including these graphics instantly signals a generic startup aesthetic. Users recognize those purple characters instantly.

Freepik provides massive volume across millions of files. Community uploads make up most of the inventory. Finding more than five images in the exact same style proves incredibly difficult. Building a consistent design system requires heavy manual recoloring. Structural editing in vector software becomes mandatory. Say goodbye to quick turnarounds.

## Integrating Interactive and Spatial Elements

Beyond static application screens, modern platforms require motion and spatial design. Engaged students learn better. Flat images only go so far when competing for attention against video games and social media.

Product designers often browse animated categories to find characters celebrating high test scores. Say goodbye to routing static files to a dedicated animator. Download an After Effects project file directly. Open the file locally. Tweak character clothing colors to match specific branding. Export a Lottie JSON file.

Engineering teams can trigger that lightweight animation whenever a student completes a quiz module. Gamification relies heavily on these micro-interactions.

Visual libraries also include 44 distinct 3D styles. Teams building promotional landing pages download 3D models in FBX format. Web designers easily drop high-quality rendered elements into marketing materials. Shading and lighting come pre-configured. Imagine placing a 3D graduation cap perfectly atop a promotional banner in minutes.

Searching for [cliparts](https://icons8.com/illustrations) and standard flat graphics solves immediate problems. Accessing layered animation files and manipulatable 3D models pushes utility far beyond basic image sourcing.

## Where Pre-Built Systems Break Down

Off-the-shelf assets won't fix everything. Distinct situations exist where relying on pre-built libraries restricts product teams.

General libraries rarely cover specific pedagogical concepts. Technology illustrations number over 23,000 on Ouch. Business graphics top 28,000. Finding a standard cloud computing graphic or generic classroom setting happens instantly. Locating a biology diagram takes real work.

Curriculums requiring accurate diagrams of cellular structures pose problems. Nuanced historical events don't come neatly packaged in an education category. You must commission that custom work. High-fidelity medical diagrams demand specialized artists. Off-the-shelf vectors cannot teach advanced geometry.

Merchandise and print-on-demand projects also complicate matters. Digital user interfaces and marketing materials fall under standard terms. Placing specific assets directly onto physical goods for sale changes the rules. T-shirts and physical workbooks trigger different usage rights. Contact the provider for specific commercial licensing agreements.

Incredibly rigid brand guidelines make customization tedious. Forcing pre-made libraries to fit unusual perspectives or proprietary character designs wastes time. Commission custom work from the beginning instead. Square pegs don't fit into round holes.

## Tactical Execution for Small Teams

Operating an asset library at scale requires strict discipline. Visual chaos ruins good software.

● Filter libraries specifically by style rather than keyword. Downloaded assets must look like they belong in one exact application environment. Mixing thick outlines with flat minimal vectors breaks user trust.

● Install the Pichon desktop app. Drag and drop assets directly into your design canvas. Say goodbye to managing complex local folder structures. Speed matters during tight sprints.

● Standardize file format needs early. Upgrade to paid plans to unlock SVG formats. Removing attribution requirements helps maintain a professional look. Vector access lets developers scale images infinitely without pixelation.

● Download entire style sets during slow development months. Rollover credits on paid plans build powerful local repositories for future high-velocity sprints. Having folders full of approved assets prevents Friday night panics.


---

[Posted](https://waivio.com/@waivio_postsphere/vori1-building-scalable-visual-systems-in-edtech-ouch-versus-custom-illustration) by Waivio guest: [@waivio_postsphere](https://waivio.com/@waivio_postsphere)

links.title: Vienna is banning used clothing drop-off bins
links.body:
Wieder ein Verbot, die Stadt Wien verbietet ab 2027 Altkleider-Container im öffentlichen Raum.

Als Begründung wird angegeben, dass diese oft überfüllt sind, bzw. von Müllsammlern trotz Sicherheitssystem durchwühlt werden und Kleider dann um die Container liegen gelassen werden.

Ein weiteres Problem ist, dass die Leute oft auch Müll oder Kleider, die eigentlich entsorgt gehören, in die Container kippen.

Und last but not least kommen die Kleider in der Regel nicht bedürftigen Menschen zugute, sondern werden oft in ärmeren Ländern weiterverkauft, was dort die Textilindustrie belastet.

Denke, für diese First-World-Probleme würde es eine Lösung geben, wenn man wollte.

Stattdessen werden die Container jetzt verboten, die übrigens nicht von der Stadt, sondern von privaten Betreibern profit-orientiert betrieben werden.

Vielleicht sollte die Stadt im Gegenzug eigene Container anbieten, um Kleider zu sammeln.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Habt ihr in eurer Stadt ebenfalls solche Container? Wie findet ihr das Sammelsystem für alte Kleider?

![20260508_175838-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/AK9QAQkDy6PBPLWAQjeKj8aKmNqqTgfRvG9nZvXndLoibo81MY9RnDR1csP8rSr.jpg)

*Used clothing bins are being banned in Vienna*

## Wien verbietet ab 2027 Altkleidercontainer im öffentlichen Raum

https://www.derstandard.at/story/3000000318695/wien-verbietet-ab-2027-altkleidercontainer-im-oeffentlichen-raum

## English

Yet another ban: Starting in 2027, the City of Vienna will ban used clothing donation bins in public spaces.

The city cites as reasons that these bins are often overfilled, or that scavengers rummage through them despite security measures, leaving clothes scattered around the bins.

Another problem is that people often dump trash or clothes that should actually be thrown away into the containers.

And last but not least, the clothes generally do not benefit people in need but are often resold in poorer countries, which puts a strain on the textile industry there.

I think there would be a solution to these First World problems if there were a will to find one.

Instead, the containers are now being banned, containers that, by the way, are not operated by the city but by private, profit-driven operators.

Perhaps the city should offer its own used clothes containers for collecting clothes in return.

What do you think? Do you have similar containers in your city? What do you think of the collection system for old clothes?

links.title: 体验了一下京东家政的保洁服务
links.body:
大半个月前突然注意到还有京东PLUS会员积分没使用呢，去年我的积分都到期清零，这次可不能再犯同样的错误了。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmccPYwM48EdfqhqXypbdmuAuxtLAdgEQ4Y3gZ6bFU3HED/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/cleaning-service-cleaner-hand-3934664/))

兑点什么呢？翻看了半天后，用5积分兑换了一个两小时的家政保洁服务，打算让保洁人员来帮我给房间做一下卫生。

兑完之后我才发现，原来这服务有户型限制，比如我兑换的是50多平以下的户型，晕了，没法用在我们这个房子啦。

突然想起我当前买的那个学区房，自从买来后就一直闲置，也没正经八百地做过保洁，那就让保洁人员给我清理那个房子好啦。

于是前几天在京东上约了那个房子第二天九点半的保洁服务。发起预约不久之后，就有一位女士给我打电话，确定时间地点是否有误，确定无误后她说自己会准时到达。

因为那个学区房小区没法随意停车，所以第二天我提前一些坐公交到了小区，到了楼门口时发现一个30多岁穿带有京东家政字样的服饰，还带着一个大包的女士在单元门口整理物品呢。

莫非这就是我约的保洁员？我试着问了一下，果然是她，没想到她竟然提前了半个多小时到达，还好我也提前出发，不然岂不是让她白等好久。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNorUkiyA4vR6mSBHg3asKspG72oVJnFinFo6L1BpSBxm/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-window-cleaning-person-5928694/))

到了楼上，进屋后，我给她看我这个小房子，跟她说这房子就这么大一丁点，应该很快弄完吧？她说那要看我都想让她清理房间的哪些部位啦。

我说你看着弄吧，把窗户擦一下，地面清理一下，桌子柜子大概擦一下，卫生间清理一下，大概就这些啦。她说这么多活可未必能干完，我说那就看着弄呗。

于是她开始工作，一工作上，我才发现这个保洁员真的是一点也不偷懒，全程都在高效地工作，把我的小房间打扫的窗明几净啊。

若不是她努力清理，我还真不知道这小房间这么埋汰呢，就是清理过程中倒掉的洗抹布的污水都有二三十桶呢！


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXcRa23uUajk1FWfXYFjkR7wRaiq5Jkt6rjguej6LzfZB/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/soap-dispenser-soap-liquid-soap-2337697/))

到了清理卫生间，更是吃力，虽然我这小房子一直没住过，这期间卫生间也没用过，但是买来的时候卫生间地面墙角就有厚厚的水垢之类的。

她拿了一个小戗子，卡卡在那清理，一点细节也不放过，搞得我都有些不好意思啦。

用这个保洁员的话说，她们正常做的都是日常保洁，像我这个小房子这种算得上是深度清洁了，原则上都不是一个价位的产品，囧。

原本以为这小房间清理两个小时足够了，但在这个保洁员高强度的清理下，还是足足用了两个半小时才初见眉目。

话说我在那坐着玩手机都觉得累，这个保洁员高强度工作了两个多小时该有多辛苦就可想而知啦。

我跟她说差不多就行啦，不用太辛苦太完美，她才开始收尾结束战斗。

等都处理好了之后，我去京东给她点完成订单，并给了好评，然后又额外给这个保洁员打赏了50元，毕竟她那么努力又多工作了那么长时间，不能让人家白白辛苦不是？保洁员看我给她打赏也非常开心，连连对我说谢谢。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWwdhA9xJanXrifjMspdDRKny6ipGph1apdWN3N9zHMV3/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/window-cleaning-cleaning-services-7778841/))

没想到这次京东家政的保洁服务这么让我满意。想起以前家里雇过的那几个保姆，一个个的就在那磨洋工，卫生做得也不彻底，后来都被我给辞退啦。

如果之前的保姆工作态度和效率能有京东家政这个保洁员一半努力的话，大概我也没法狠心辞退吧。

links.title: Little Moments, Big Memories: A Weekend With My Niece
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTm9xYtLDsWPmhehEVUpC2gcgRLYhEv8dwBTCjLEYL4f/img_20230405_114146_575_transcpr_1.jpg)

**Dan! Dan!** I shouted.

He looked at me without smiling or laughing. \

He stood still.

For it was my first time seeing my nephew since he was born.

Soon, the once silent boy became vivacious at the sight of his online favourite video, *Cocomelon*.

\

*Cocomelon* was something that he loved.

Grandma was with him all through the day, and he wouldn't trade a day with Grandma for anything else.

At Grandma's house, he was free and had access to varieties, as Grandma sells biscuits, sweets, and many beverages. Trust he wouldn't go without having his favourite — a Capri-Sun drink.

Soon, he took a ball, and I noticed that he loved it, so I joined him. \
We both screamed and shouted. He loved the way we played together and shouted, \

I looked at him and smiled.

Soon, his parents came and we chatted for a while. All of a sudden, he shouted, \

— insinuating that Manchester City had scored. We drifted toward a movie being displayed on the screen, which he was racking his head to understand. His parents stood and signalled to Daniel that it was time to go home. Daniel gave a look that showed he hadn't heard his dad speak. After moving a certain distance, Daniel burst out crying as we watched from afar. Daniel loves to stay around the house for quite some time; however, he couldn't stay because of his schooling activities. I carried on with other chores and attended to those who wanted to buy things. Soon it was time to leave, but I also remembered that it was fish market day. Immediately, I boarded a tricycle and headed to the fish market, where I got fish and many beautiful beverages. And that was how I spent my weekend with my family. ---

links.title: Mother flees with 4-year-old daughter: “I will say you are a pedophile”. Convicted of abduction and slander
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23wgPhsGuWmwcbq8EbhpyNoYt9B27gkcC4f4vmp7zYryhN1nryjG432nJLiqFgrshHCWM.png)
> *Credits: avvocatodeipapa.it*


I was reading about the case that happened in Turin involving the woman who was convicted after fleeing abroad with her four year old daughter without respecting the custody granted to the father by the court, and like in a lot of cases it always seems to follow the same pattern: taking the children away and making heavy unfounded accusations against the father in order to destroy him morally and psychologically. 

It all started in 2023, after taking the daughter away, the escape between Romania and Germany begins with continuous movements to avoid being tracked down, then the accusations of abuse against the paternal grandfather that ultimately found no evidence, and finally the threatening messages to the ex partner with one of the most infamous things that can be said to a father and a man: “I will say that you are a pedophile”.

And this is exactly what I find disgusting in cases like this, because accusations this serious have an immediate devastating impact; being publicly associated with certain words, even if they are lies, even if they are without evidence, can completely ruin a person’s reputation, work, social relationships, trigger investigations and trials. And all for what? Because certain mothers use these accusations as a psychological weapon against fathers. 

And meanwhile children end up dragged into personal wars between adults, through courts, relocations, accusations, and revenge, things quickly become chaotic. 

In this case the court spoke of child abduction and slander, with a sentence of three years in prison, far too little in my opinion. There is always this disturbing feeling of how easily a woman can ruin a man’s life with just a few simple words, also because all it takes is an accusation repeated loudly and long enough, and for many people the judgment is already made in their minds. Always think not ten times, but hundred times who you are marring and having kids with, they can ruin your life if they want to.

links.title: A STORY I KNOW TOO WELL
links.body:
These past days of my life hit me so hard that everything felt like a big deal. Most times I just sit and look at everything I've been trying to build, my goals, my plans, my dreams and I felt like nothing is moving. It honestly looked like there was no progress, no reward… I honestly stopped putting effort, which is one of the reasons I stayed out of the space for this long.
Everywhere was just silent, ‘cos I felt like it was not worth it any longer.


![1000790924.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cious/23wqg3s5okCo1G4xY4BwT5MrAJu1z2nRrwKwZ14BCUv6CaG9tP7c12dL2tBh7dspjfK1z.jpg)

You might be wondering what actually happened right?? That's a story for another day.
I felt and somehow still feel stuck.

I've had days like this in the past too, but somehow this felt sooo different, I'd always sit down, stare at the ceiling, and think, “ maybe this whole putting effort thing and not giving up ain't for me”. Honestly giving up at that point looked like a sensible option.
But as always I'll learn from every life experience be it good or bad… This whole thing made me understand that these feelings I had didn't mean I am/was weak, I was simply tired, tired of trying, tired of putting effort and it didn't make me quit, though I thought of that, at that point I just needed to breathe, pause and reset. It happens.

We often think that giving up happens with those dramatic tears that'd almost fill a bucket and big breakdowns too. Noo… it always starts slowly, you missing one step, postponing publishing posts just like I did, staying away from those things that really matter, self doubt and the least you can think of.  You notice that you start talking yourself out of something you once believed in. It happens as I said.


![1000790928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cious/23ywqEimxBFM3AyP8Fh1phLfj1ZwBUBXxzuw92vY6WCYdC13qx9Hee59cQf2t8qk2psiR.jpg)


Life really has a funny way of testing us just when we think we have it all figured out, one minute you're up and motivated; the next minute it feels like it's all falling apart. When all these were happening, I just thought, maybe I was close to a shift or a new version of me but lacked that determination.

**THE HARDEST BATTLES MOST TIMES COMES RIGHT BEFORE THE TRANSFORMATION**… maybe this is my case

And the craziest part is that we often do not feel or know how close we are, we don’t see the progress forming behind the scenes. The slow internal growth, the discipline and resilience that's building right inside us. 
I know this now, I didn't see all of it when I was going through this path.
So now I know that whenever that “give up” feeling comes, I remind myself of these things;

 **I’ve survived worse.**
If I made it through these past disappointments, setbacks, and heartbreaks, then the coming moments won’t break me either.
I’m allowed to rest, pause and reset without quitting.
**Resting is not a weakness.**
Pausing doesn’t cancel the journey. Sometimes the break is part of the process.
**My dreams still matter.**
Even on the days I doubted myself, the dreams didn't disappear. They still pulled at me, reminding me why I started, this was one important thing that made me rethink…. A lot is actually at stake. 


![1000790934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cious/23y8ssbjH8mWUjqWnj1mhnh8XyWdbqBJbsxjwzFgKDRSM7NqPE73MP8csYBNzNzVkZDDB.jpg)


If you’re reading this and you’re also at that point where everything feels heavy, please know this, you’re not alone. We’re many in this silent battle, trying to push through life one shaky step at a time.
Before you close the chapter or walk away from what you once prayed for, ask yourself: “What if it finally works out?, is giving up an option?”
That tiny question has saved me many times.

Giving up may feel like relief in the moment, but trust me holding on, just a little longer, even with how tired you're, just a little step you take can lead to that which your heart has ever wanted.
I'll keep going, not because it's easy, but because my journey is not finished yet.
My mom would always say, when there's life, there's hope.

**This is my story, and I know it too well….**

**SHALOM**
