links.title: Two major celebrations of art, marked by a spectacular exhibition. (EN-ES)
links.body:
--- Today, 18 May, is International Museum Day, but the city is also celebrating the 175th anniversary of the San Telmo School of Art. To mark the first event, several museums will be opening their doors free of charge today and will also be hosting other special events, particularly as Málaga is a world-renowned city of art, boasting the highest number of museums per capita in the world. To mark the second celebration, a brilliant exhibition on the history of this art school is currently being held at the Palacio or Customs Museum. >Hoy 18 de mayo es el día internacional de los museos, pero también en la ciudad se está celebrando el 175 aniversario de la Escuela de arte de San Telmo. Con motivo del primer evento hoy varios museos abrirán en forma gratuita y también realizarán otros eventos especiales, sobre todo porque Málaga es la ciudad del arte a nivel mundial, es la ciudad con más museos per cápita del mundo. Con motivo de la segunda celebración en el Palacio o museo de la Aduana se está realizando una exposición brillante sobre la trayectoria de esta escuela de arte. --- ![20260518_000041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvuCa8Kh27YxRowMFw5Mn4ysjD1BXHpFFDxaTR5mvggzoo69DMiMVYZGZwsn6m1H96q.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Para mí hoy es un día muy especial, tengo la dicha de estar en esta ciudad que me ofrece arte en cada lugar, en cada rincón, museos variados, muestras de arte cada cierta cantidad de tiempo, galerías de arte gratuitas y mucho más. Por eso hoy es un gran día. Pero además haber podido participar de esta fabulosa exposición dedicada al arte y a un aniversario tan importante me llena de alegría. Se realiza bajo el slogan “La escuela que hizo ciudad” y está en exhibición hasta el 24 de junio de este año. Si bien todos los textos explicativos de la exposición están en español, trataré de contarles acerca de ellos.

Today is a very special day for me; I am lucky enough to be in this city, which offers art everywhere I look, in every corner, with a wide variety of museums, regular art exhibitions, free art galleries and much more. That is why today is such a great day. But also, having been able to take part in this fabulous exhibition dedicated to art and such an important anniversary fills me with joy. It is being held under the slogan “The school that made the city” and is on display until 24 June this year. Although all the explanatory texts for the exhibition are in Spanish, I’ll try to tell you about them. ---
![20260507_185026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCL6XetTD7nr28TEPZ6MobsDpRbqdAUEy2tVzfwYHRBa7FVGV8vUALQnV5wZPAJ17LH.jpg)
![20260507_185117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48SMA9mwfDTXyrLxK24psVRMihEcKnsjYgpTwSXNboaTiX6savTrD9PgDUqwXFUHWD.jpg)
![20260507_185146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7GDAgAcB6p8tu2kw8ECURridLyDSZ9DTnfo7d61MuCttj6Vi34yqCFWnaY7acq2jXy.jpg)
![20260507_185349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmQN3Ly8NUAU1GSL7j3tSsXnPAFa2YPXTFJmMeiZRmG3jFjyxXNTAMSTk6r6GhgjFXu.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

La entrada ya era impresionante, donde me esperaba una gran escultura. A mediados del siglo XIX, Málaga era uno de los grandes focos de la Revolución Industrial en el país. Su puerto tenía un intenso comercio internacional y gran industria, tanto textil, metalúrgica y agro-alimentaria. La prosperidad trajo toda clase de profesionales y entre ellos artistas, sumado al surgimiento de la burguesía ilustrada, desarrollando así mucha actividad cultural. Así surge la necesidad de enseñanza artística y es como se crea en 1851 la Escuela de Arte de San Telmo dando formación en dibujo, técnica dentro de la modernidad. Hoy es referente de la vida cultural y proyección artística de la ciudad. La sala era enorme y había entradas o secciones dedicadas a un tema en especial. Pero en todos estos lugares había la explicación suficiente, además de la presencia de guías y guardia de seguridad ya que las obras de arte expuestas son de mucho valor. Para realizar esta exposición se valieron de muchas obras que se encuentran en la segunda planta del museo, la zona de las bellas artes. De esa manera explicaban la evolución y la historia de la Escuela de San Telmo. Como a fines del siglo XVIII todo lo referido a enseñanza de oficios se realizaba en forma particular y eso era una enseñanza lenta e irregular, el estado es quien asumió la formación de los artesanos. Esto se llevó a cabo en el siglo XIX. Así se crearon muchas escuelas de bellas artes y academias tanto de primera o segunda clase, sea que se tratara de artistas o artesanos. La escuela de Bellas Artes de Málaga esta catalogada como de segunda clase. Pero se dispuso que las de segunda clase podían ascender a primera. Todo esto significó una gran transformación a nivel artístico. La academia y la escuela se abrió por primera vez en la calle Compañía en un convento jesuita y el éxito fue tal que debieron abrir lista de espera.

The entrance was already impressive, with a large sculpture awaiting me. In the mid-19th century, Málaga was one of the major centres of the Industrial Revolution in the country. Its port was a hub of international trade and major industry, including textiles, metallurgy and agri-food. This prosperity attracted all manner of professionals, including artists, alongside the emergence of an enlightened bourgeoisie, thus fostering a vibrant cultural scene. This gave rise to the need for art education, leading to the creation in 1851 of the San Telmo School of Art, which provided training in drawing, a technique at the forefront of modernity. Today, it is a benchmark for the city’s cultural life and artistic influence. The hall was enormous and there were sections dedicated to specific themes. But in all these areas there were sufficient explanations, as well as the presence of guides and security guards, given that the works of art on display are of great value. To stage this exhibition, they drew on many works located on the second floor of the museum, the fine arts section. In this way, they explained the evolution and history of the San Telmo School. As by the end of the 18th century, all vocational training was carried out privately—a slow and irregular process—the state took over the training of artisans. This took place in the 19th century. Thus, many fine arts schools and academies were established, both first- and second-class, whether for artists or artisans. The School of Fine Arts in Málaga is classified as a second-class institution. However, it was stipulated that second-class institutions could be promoted to first class. All this signified a major transformation in the artistic sphere. The academy and school first opened on Calle Compañía in a Jesuit convent, and its success was such that they had to introduce a waiting list. --- ![20260507_185213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w346jNKFDuQmnQX2WY8qWsn8WE9NBRAQER347C6ocZBwu8LQ9UtyD4gE5qH91Yh2a3R.jpg) ![20260507_185237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCXGoUuTacUd1Ftd7a2QFq9rhski6KrymV5VGWi74QczmgkZAngzwdkunYVFacKzkcH.jpg)
![20260507_185333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xf2wDnUHWpBrkQeUtu3u4VntNE4ZQNaftWK9L6kNUwikvsGNfGGmnkxPuw78ZKRSBSm.jpg)
![20260507_185246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y96dV5gyczmM8AHWC3T4Q63Yc4w4HtaHMukcQ6vLspkPBxmDcgyYrifttAHCx9GXG7F.jpg) ![20260507_185254.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsfX7SLwV6PAvWN7Z3oxpxF2tU3ZvsYYGuHZQSE5eM63pjYyFbY3cQvYiLSohbCnz1v.jpg) ![20260507_185301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/48RQCUeA3va4CuoukrsMHWkyjp4i3qifph598v7NXnT7Eog3du32oHFBsQ9FXprzQX.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Una de las primeras secciones de la exposición estaba dedicada a los primeros años de la escuela y más precisamente al dibujo. Esto me recordó mis años de estudiante y como era prioritario aprender a dibujar cada parte del cuerpo humano. También me recordó lo difícil que era dibujar manos, pies, rostros, los detalles. Muchos recuerdos vinieron a mi mente. La escuela abrió con un plan sencillo de estudios, cinco asignaturas centradas en el dibujo, modelado, vaciado del adorno, nociones de aritmética y geometría aplicada. El dibujo era el eje central. La escuela era modesta, pero cumplía con el objetivo cultural. Se generaba una nueva sensibilidad artística. Tal como aprendí en mis comienzos, la metodología se basaba en la copia, al carboncillo y lápiz graso, de modelos de escayola y también se utilizaban láminas litografiadas. Había un apartado dedicado a la clase de modelado y vaciado y sobre todo hablaba de las figuras de barro como una tradición arraigada y en pleno auge en esa época.

One of the first sections of the exhibition was devoted to the school’s early years, and more specifically to drawing. This reminded me of my own school days and how learning to draw every part of the human body was a priority. It also reminded me of how difficult it was to draw hands, feet, faces and the finer details. Many memories came flooding back. The school opened with a simple curriculum: five subjects focused on drawing, modelling, casting of ornaments, and the basics of arithmetic and applied geometry. Drawing was the central focus. The school was modest, but it fulfilled its cultural purpose. A new artistic sensibility was emerging. Just as I had learnt in my early days, the methodology was based on copying, using charcoal and soft pencil, from plaster models, and lithographic prints were also used. There was a section dedicated to the modelling and casting class, and above all it spoke of clay figures as a deep-rooted tradition that was in full swing at that time. --- ![20260507_185522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVVjQx3hFe5jo1Z3nfFmPhz8iPmKDu76F6RNuJt61aFnw6KJLRLD8rv5rcWwRJVG2Uz.jpg) ![20260507_185437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zSDpmNiJ7EsURAbZMJ2pQoqNJG424NuWY3fqmwYfbujUdaMz7FGTzsixxdtFH1fT9ya.jpg) ![20260507_185534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2uCTgNkE7xtQGjAtq9mMYVgU2Jwd98KMnXhL1Nyrbu4xjYay8FnN9NvdTfFx5FGLhq.jpg) ![20260507_185652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAc3oegxjFK9jbppCgd5JiKr63u2pecT5ryoSMZPByoahj7dCfBxmaTGTPGCnHp6VbV.jpg) ![20260507_185701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAeQqxnjhGzpbrKLC9HZb75WDzHLwNouso5LwYeAj96jxeZYqtoQ8ud35rTiFpNVLZy.jpg)
![20260507_185738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EoEtrRQd8vqVr76Bq4wH3DtsZMFJ75wJZSLrXfmtzd3XcrjoXQRwM4d1sLVEhgj7r5f.jpg)
![20260507_185748.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tviXCYjj3qBFPv7CQvVt2VckdFAuEY4WuMBXVwbfSPWn1U7LEUWjyAec1c8RufoYGMU.jpg) ![20260507_185806.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgMqvGkhMkxQj4tmDySKHwBqVAsSchYAbZFkkqtty3erg5a4LWgzwdgjtNYFnr713tU.jpg) |![20260507_185817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2unBDinxXF1CL4AH9wo258ZuYB74Cvmbfbh5BEqhVNrKpaH34Pv76ZimQC84PBLsCS.jpg)|![20260507_185826.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMeXWknzEBWVbJCRVf177VrimP9SAPpkJmXgu9NWr76RLVk14FQ2sKvAAePks1v9Upv.jpg)| |-|-| ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Con la era de Ferrándiz se aplicó una nueva enseñanza no basándose solamente en el copiado, ya que promovió un cambio grande en el plan de estudios. Se introdujo la litografía y el método basado en la observación, memoria y composición. Quería que la escuela subiera a primera clase. Buscaba unir arte, ciencia e industria. Así en 1878 se creo la clase de señoritas, y de esa manera ahora el arte podía ser desarrollado por mujeres también. Al comienzo la orientación fue doméstica: bordado, decoración textil o pintura de flores o bodegones. A pesar de eso la iniciativa fue pionera.

During Ferrándiz’s tenure, a new teaching approach was introduced that was not based solely on copying, as he promoted a major overhaul of the curriculum. Lithography was introduced, along with a method based on observation, memory and composition. He wanted the school to rise to the highest level. He sought to unite art, science and industry. Thus, in 1878, the girls’ class was established, meaning that art could now be pursued by women as well. Initially, the focus was on domestic arts: embroidery, textile decoration, and the painting of flowers or still lifes. Nevertheless, the initiative was pioneering. --- ![20260507_185933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xpPp2i2g58T8YyhGEkbUmnfXgjnhpQBs4WTaatVJAc5BqQYnSTYF5HwQNUqPKvnTDXy.jpg) ![20260507_190011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uR9h4q9UcFoA3dkgdewg1B4KAeQqTGx2DyG9Vzazti62QeRoSRc82ZQKsFyNq4MG7VH.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Una de las partes de la exposición que también me emocionó fue la dedicada al diseño gráfico y como nació en la ciudad. Fue gracias a la litografía que se hizo posible y que además ella es la que ayudó en la creación de imágenes para la industria y el comercio. Los carteles eran los ejemplos más visibles y así se anunciaban fiestas, espectáculos y productos. Muchos de los que se dedicaban a hacer carteles fueron primeramente artistas.

Another part of the exhibition that really moved me was the section devoted to graphic design and how it came about in the city. It was thanks to lithography that this became possible, and it was also lithography that helped create images for industry and commerce. Posters were the most visible examples of this, and they were used to advertise festivals, shows and products. Many of those who worked on creating posters were, first and foremost, artists. --- ![20260507_185922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6JDhHuk2hggEb1gvgS8DdLmzp2u7CSKQa56ZuS5uCLv9eBVnrchwmkppiXXHuHfA3C.jpg) ![20260507_190031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJZiq12zmzi3J3gfTkvKkdqmaJqSpzKmhvgqVG41h4qPQXdBjLMTA6gKG8annfmNPW5.jpg) ![20260507_190054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6NF2VeHahSp7jXaFWoEK4XPaaFNwJjizRSMKwp7AuBFwUHGrUfPkBC8v9XE8ve62u2.jpg) ![20260507_190110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6QXBeSPFJWJNmzaF2BTQNSxNqYdw5ZiXpMX4cb6hCLBXHUqcd9ydJVg8vwcd5iR7rd.jpg) ![20260507_190116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viGuFQugWJFa45hPmRsDwV4ZsHrRdWZq5jbiYMGWFnUXjPkoy8RBQCJjaAG3dn3bC5o.jpg) |![20260507_190122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvyHMQWFbWo6N57fxXLjFXwqAnyzDyo4G9WpDQdNHyNSufysrs3K4Hqq7WHK7YXXRQo.jpg)|![20260507_190127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgat8fPnG2n2DPtQFD9TJL3weK6afDyJxJXxT9bncNc3r7CyDDrCw8s7JoDfsP4ZvBH.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260507_190154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTqvhUVuaUZ81cMrosAfLEnB1JKStWouqyNy42MgBPHvQ6RyVUm2rYZvEBKrHD4xN3t.jpg) ![20260507_190139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/EopvsvbGrmy8HCdQ9bEoT9bYbCoEy8u8VviWWimhijtUKWQB4N5FvQ9vUqayABnH2dV.jpg) ![20260507_190203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFeaBV1hWkcKVcYPnmg52v4QbnFU4geFqBFMHkEFGL6coY4sLLn8kkCh6tX5s7YQzRf.jpg) |![20260507_190208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wXC8vsSeoJpeVkY1ry2qYmKcMwutEQje8JG4gRTJN5DKF4ym8uJizumfZiycxhaVp56.jpg)|![20260507_190214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVZm8tt9MJcMoe7wCFLio7h4c53oBm3pNGUMFu4P9nnGzk39NauMPpSuHCxWYuhF1Dz.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260507_190226.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6NAE8FMDPjQSi8EPpn6zvBUug4xnyNNopzxnfJ9DQ2svKxyfzCHWihkVuGQZSr4FST.jpg) |![20260507_190234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/AKNMHvJq1dVuAC62suE6kMGo17RHmMrvNELWy7FWMXy42SKLCJpWhCEFvmhtVYu.jpg)|![20260507_190251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCUuuH4eGEV4BZjqsVNZBLzZS2ddCo9S6CuFqzoFprjghRpdYrtDDDhwj8GZ1PFvK4S.jpg)|![20260507_190258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xL56JYz7ygYEwrPVNm5t9RdmjTypc8Mmms67ws1PQ7osNJqdi7BGhzobUWd6V8itY89.jpg)| |-|-|-| ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

La siguiente sección estaba dedicada al impulso del siglo XX. Había habido una gran evolución y avance, la academia se separa de la escuela. La escuela de San Telmo entró en una gran transformación, reorganizando las enseñanzas profesionales bajo la denominación de Escuelas de industrias y bellas artes. Esto trajo una mejora en la formación de los pintores. Luego se separó los estudios industriales de los artísticos, apareciendo así asignaturas prácticas y talleres especializados, como imprenta, cerámica, carpintería y mucho más. Hay muchas consideraciones respecto de las litografías y su avance como así muchos ejemplos en la exposición desde carteles, cuadros y muchos trabajos que estaban expuestos en vitrinas.

The following section was devoted to the developments of the 20th century. There had been significant evolution and progress, with the academy separating from the school. The San Telmo School underwent a major transformation, reorganising vocational training under the name ‘Schools of Industry and Fine Arts’. This led to an improvement in the training of painters. Industrial studies were then separated from artistic ones, leading to the introduction of practical subjects and specialised workshops, such as printing, ceramics, carpentry and much more. There are many considerations regarding lithographs and their development, as well as numerous examples in the exhibition, ranging from posters and paintings to many works displayed in showcases. --- ![20260507_190530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvuPnTJxA4WiGQ1RKVDBySnYrJNfa1TwnDuiny6YMgngXfkxDkrDnc4rdLuAAX8fysa.jpg) ![20260507_190451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvoBcS6Xnq2NUZ5PyoVrYmRmVAPxpZ4UVcubFHiVukPVqbBwvhF3VFEdj776xQB1naf.jpg) ![20260507_190548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yx5d9GEXhG6TswMRdzGxhiGoaCPBk8JnxLu1ZDrRkXhincULmCKpUmV9kZiZem929WX.jpg) ![20260507_190603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6G4pH5Et18ZeyDwRt1cf3Vyd5HTxzB3LMWn3XzPMkzU1sME4XYZaFRRHgfRtWYE2UY.jpg) ![20260507_190628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCJ1T77Ym453tQWK12gwXQozGUWR8kGFGV7RzAW97Qv1AbT47Ty6usXPcxX9W36czvM.jpg) |![20260507_190616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wX5QcGBnHxDXmJ1X4NQ4JD7H7uy6SDV7aJyTPaPcXeWbHDstU6GwzAfvXVMCUDTdhk9.jpg)|![20260507_190558.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ywyQesR4shrRAK5hEupN9aZhw9QrqFdVd6iYtHVwHtDdd5rPNAM2sdfxVeZXJVY9hMW.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260507_190603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6G4pH5Et18ZeyDwRt1cf3Vyd5HTxzB3LMWn3XzPMkzU1sME4XYZaFRRHgfRtWYE2UY.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Uno de los acontecimientos más importantes de la escuela fue estar presente en la exposición iberoamericana de Sevilla en 1929. Significo una proyección para la ciudad. Se presentaron obras del profesorado y alumnado que reflejaban el nivel de la escuela, la amplitud de la enseñanza, la variedad de trabajos, como escultura, forja, azulejería, encuadernación. Y aquí en la exposición lo que más pude ver fueron esculturas, capiteles y encuadernaciones. Unos libros antiguos de gran tamaño que llamaron mucho mi atención. Libros de enseñanzas artísticas del año 1929 con encuadernaciones en cuero repujado.

One of the school’s most significant events was its participation in the Ibero-American Exhibition in Seville in 1929. This brought the school to the city’s attention. Works by both staff and students were displayed, showcasing the school’s high standards, the breadth of its teaching, and the variety of disciplines, such as sculpture, metalwork, tile-making and bookbinding. And here at the exhibition, what I saw most were sculptures, capitals and bookbindings. Some large, old books really caught my eye. Art education books from 1929 with embossed leather bindings. --- ![20260507_190643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAZe69L1q4XbVZemK3Y3AaAzzdxNxfJSaSUyarb1JwPo95vfotTVSNJ2KTvHPKqCpZJ.jpg) ![20260507_190647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkrRKt77bhuWDxqqMCnWP2QbVcoRTzwjP8D4SQp4Y7nGVnSpqQ27bgXeYveiPRMYgkL.jpg) ![20260507_190656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbTu4Lt8nyywqxaFkWav1k7oaP7Q6xLNCV3m4Gmm1yf5Vj67WVSTzYWa28sxXcF8swU.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Un aparatado mostraba la litografía y la relación con la escuela, su desarrollo durante el siglo XIX. Las artes crecían al ritmo de la industrialización y la escuela se convirtió en el principal espacio de aprendizaje de saberes técnicos y artísticos que exigía esta disciplina. Hubo una gran producción gráfica de extraordinaria calidad tanto técnica como visual y Málaga se convirtió en uno de los grandes centros de litografía española.

One section showcased lithography and its connection to the school, as well as its development throughout the 19th century. The arts flourished alongside industrialisation, and the school became the primary venue for learning the technical and artistic skills required by this discipline. There was a wealth of graphic work of extraordinary technical and visual quality, and Málaga became one of the major centres of Spanish lithography. --- ![20260507_185638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xenFW1izDFpggDS8bXUrF2paRvXm6eQXA59Kpix2Vzp61WY12SoSbcfK3fG8oVLETbY.jpg) ![20260507_190853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viAcj1axVNyskPbtFELa55STJDwrWsLF7SXZAP3UrZor9rqHRCGfjEshAURWuXHLvM4.jpg) ![20260507_190917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvuVSryxMFTwU1PedrD8fYEx946aXz9DYFtTdFPF3rz91NBMCE92itG2PL64P3LGfUd.jpg) ![20260507_190925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xerGMFgbUNhag4bCJ8ERKswvUHYQBQCAnNmWJpN4cpwu17u6Z9cGAASckYFYdqGyFdJ.jpg) ![20260507_190940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQzpAhgf3zn4K8q2b1fvVrhfSNssRCHmbrFFax7eBiQYjD5jEd4E8CX6Zx2bCxvvx8i.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Un gran espacio de la gran sala fue dedicado a exponer obras de arte de la zona de bellas artes. Una belleza para la vista.

A large section of the main hall was set aside to display artworks from the fine arts department. A real feast for the eyes. --- ![20260507_191214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yx3wLLjfzgyzrSYcuZSEafqZsBwhhK8efgxdFjr5TxYFgkfLoh8yNxP6pEQmd6EVG9j.jpg)
![20260507_191207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJRH1k9Y9ip2NKa6YZZoEk8fkNCDd7VgFxKkuEsBkZHp1Z8jhXFBgCyfUEgEPUJh3HZ.jpg)
![20260507_191116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFnySg78RKavK1iPSspJJkPkunCGqX9QcxKqiuiDdLFtLtV5WeoVZrxHced4JzcQWcy.jpg) ![20260507_191259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yx7roYw3hb9ZXjLNFUNu86SHnXxJHpz2PwHt1hRahh8DUzgGyaDCmAeAF1RQvSX7ZfP.jpg) ![20260507_191513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgN4Ngc2Y71yP3ebs8S1Zi3m1BgoxdZsgnxCA8fdFC7aJBvJY55mHdzTGbejo9g8VUX.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

La última sección trataba sobre las exposiciones y la modernidad, ya que la burguesía se encargó de convertir las exposiciones en símbolo de progreso y modernidad. Surgieron certámenes de arte, industria y agricultura. Se desarrollaban exposiciones de bellas artes en fiestas cívicas o visitas reales, eran un espacio de encuentro para los artistas, instituciones y el público en general. A partir de 1870 las exposiciones tuvieron más calidad por la participación de profesores y alumnos de la Escuela de San Telmo, obteniendo mucho reconocimiento. Todo ello reforzaba la idea de que el arte como la industria eran expresiones del progreso y orgullo colectivo de una ciudad en transformación. Toda la exposición ha sido brillante y me encanta haber participado de ella, aprender y salir de allí sabiendo la historia de esta escuela y hoy en el día internacional de los muesos es mi manera de festejar este gran evento. Muchas gracias por acompañarme el día de hoy, les envío un gran saludo. Hasta pronto. Amonet.

The final section dealt with exhibitions and modernity, as the bourgeoisie took it upon themselves to turn exhibitions into a symbol of progress and modernity. Competitions in the arts, industry and agriculture began to emerge. Fine art exhibitions were held during civic festivals or royal visits, serving as a meeting place for artists, institutions and the general public. From 1870 onwards, the exhibitions improved in quality thanks to the participation of teachers and students from the San Telmo School, earning them widespread recognition. All of this reinforced the idea that art, like industry, was an expression of progress and the collective pride of a city undergoing transformation. The whole exhibition has been brilliant and I’m delighted to have taken part in it, to have learnt and left knowing the history of this school; and today, on International Museum Day, this is my way of celebrating this great event. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

links.title: The Tax Nobody Made Him Pay
links.body:
<div  class=text-justify>





Back then in school, there was this guy in my department who was well known for his hot temper. Not infamous, I mean famous. People always say something about him, like close to admiration. “You know how he can be,” they say this in almost an affectionate way. 
As his course mate, then, I see it as something very confusing, because what I noticed about him was that he says some things that will leave people not talking to him for days while he goes on with his life like nothing happened. 





And here is the thing that no one really talked about when it comes to these hot-tempered people: that individual who has the hot-tempered nature never pays the full cost of it. It is those around them that get the share of the cost. Maybe their friends, family members, colleagues take in those words like nothing happened in order to let peace reign. 

And if they are married, the kids they have might probably carry that interaction till when they grow older, and their partner will continue to process it quietly. When that hot-tempered person flips the table, it mostly has no effect on them because they move on perfectly while those around them are bothered. 

The funny thing is that some people who are usually hot tempered won't see the big deal in it, because they will say, “It's my character; take it like that.” They will never see it as a flaw. Some will even call it their passion or way of life. When most hot tempered people do something, they are feared at the same time, and also respected for their actions. People will begin to get more careful around such people, and they will call it love. But what is likely to happen is that most people who are always hot tempered got it from their parents. And this is how this pattern will continue to be inherited and passed on to every generation, which is very destructive if we think deep.




![240199.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23tknCJtUzXPDHM24bYFZZsncjQBY2LGv7GjEc6LJ2phAxwjBZfX48tjvZMAccunZbeJy.png)




And in my honest opinion, this can be used as an excuse in any way. Yes, temper is very real, and there is a way we all struggle with it than the other. But what I know is that there is always a difference between giving excuses and explanations towards trying to do anything to control it or stop it. 

I have met people who will say, \

body.body:
Liebe Leser,
hier eine bunte Mischung von Fotos aus dem letzten Griechenlandurlaub (Bericht dazu [hier](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@stayoutoftherz/fruhling-am-peloponnes)), in dem diese Fotos keinen Platz mehr gefunden haben, auch weil die meisten davon gar nicht im Peloponnes aufgenommen wurden, sondern in [Attika](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attika_(griechische_Region)) (die Gegend rund um Athen), also dort, wohin sich normalerweise kaum ein Tourist verirrt.

Wenn immer wir in Kifissia sind (ein Vorort nördlich von Athen), ist ein Besuch des [Varsos](https://peakd.com/food/@stayoutoftherz/patisserie-varsos-near-athens-awesome-food-and-great-tradition) Pflichtprogramm. In diesem Traditionskaffeehaus, das berühmt ist für seine Strudel und süßen Köstlichkeiten, scheint die Zeit stehengeblieben zu sein.
![IMG_4945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23z7BphNvCRqLhTV5AD26pAofnLcJeXL2kyyL7Mjetw6BH794m6ZG9KiFLQkL7kXU8RVt.jpg)
![IMG_4948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/Eoc8W5oVDYbwN5ygscEJkMrrxqtFR2NagK5c3fKjzmaisc6ZckTZsPRSfPdj2JVH1Eg.jpg)

Kaffee und [Galaktoboureko](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galaktoboureko).
![IMG_4952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23u6BZceJbU15PLRBUJu5RTiVRopBxoUvVYU814aPVqCD3yFgXwhu9tJvrPSuAkqkdCr1.jpg)

Unsere Schidkröte (\

) bei ihrer Lieblingsbeschäftigung.
![IMG_4998.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23uQnVRWoyt2iNp5vziHRNEtJKS56cZsirfFFSJDy9K4dLWRbTvwST1WnW1KGwDf1w63D.jpg)
Wenn wir nicht im Haus sind und über den Winter kümmern sich Nachbarn um sie und werfen ihr ab und zu was Grünen über den Gartenzaun. Ansonsten ist sie aber sehr selbstständig und lebt seit mindestens 20 Jahren in unserem Garten.
![IMG_5005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wMgp86m8aYeY2kcYPkYJy9ayeEZCiAgPyUx19AwwbzT4Ecwd9a4CC4mMXQVEBWMrGdT.jpg)

Erdbeerzeit! Diese Erdbeeren aus der Gegend schmeckten phantastisch!
![IMG_4874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23uQrW7bPck5UE7JijeJxkN4Z6buHgf83P643ZtYS7u1MUdViMoFa2mgpauAUC1wMhXra.jpg)

Honigverkauf mit echten Bienenwaben als Hingucker. Ich würde dort nichts kaufen, da diese Bienen kein Ausflugloch haben und de facto eingesperrt sind. Angeblich nur für einen Tag, laut Verkäufer. Ist das gängige Praxis oder nur Tierquälerei? @beesmartblog, was meinst Du dazu?
![IMG_4962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23u69FdaZVm3zQK6nVRuec9kRfK9f5VD7XTfvdkf81sLnwkN2LpE5aVPhrksC3duRGMEP.jpg)

Ein [Gewöhnlicher Judasbaum](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gew%C3%B6hnlicher_Judasbaum) (*Cercis siliquastrum*) in voller Blüte.
![IMG_4939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xyLuEzVVQBtj7VeiCvFd9LEJLi9Z3t8zw41pYqZ3Rz6yw296Kat383Hiyfk2G3MzQi5.jpg)
Er ist einer der wenigen Pflanzen in Europa, bei denen die Blütenstände direkt aus dem Stamm wachsen, **Kauliflorie** genannt.
Detail der Rinde mit Blüten und Besuchern.
![IMG_4932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23vsWpTZjgd5G9bSn82pUoRXkjixyxFBcfnBm6GfYM3mmW7UDX8fe1ysCGcPJTMuoSD7F.jpg)

Malereien im Inneren einer der Kirchen im Penteli-Kloster ([Koimisi tis Theotokou](https://www.religiousgreece.gr/de/sehensw%C3%BCrdigkeiten/kloster-koimisi-tis-theotokou-mariae-himmelfahrt-von-penteli-kloster-von-penteli) (Mariä Himmelfahrt) von Penteli).
![IMG_4842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23tm9BP8rZ6ZL4U73zjQpErTb1ZQ2fb4eKsE9qLGcLvMZCzWEbVovhRUMAd9DgYSDUhfa.jpg)

Am Fuß des Hymettos, eines anderen Berges in/um Athen, mit Aussicht auf das Häusermeer.
![IMG_4908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23zv6hpezusptScyUf6tUT4xWL77Xk4SfhGGFbTSddkVdg22wAVehZrDs5rA1kUUaqqkC.jpg)

Apropos Häusermeer, hier ein nächtlicher Ausblick auf Athen vom Fuß der Akropolis.
![IMG_8567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/241tJb1ZDwwCCYdGTUtqhX6J9hSj7ZNaS2BWZkUCDXBEvz29H7ag7jwgu2qWKzhEFXCGL.jpg)

Eine Gazanienart. Sie  muß eine verwilderte Zierpflanze sein, denn Gazanien kommen nur in Südafrika vor. Diese rubusten, trockenheitsverträglichen Korbblütler sind hier daher typische Neophyten.
![IMG_4942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wgUMEJpPvqCFiqs37u8FZgghXJLa5fYXoG6CKXZukSgKt3Ddj16bmp6w5HxaGPN9VpD.jpg)


Farbenpracht in einer Blumenhandlung.
![IMG_4960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wWw7XcSbk4PQ91pYvMNQKoCaExewqiA74PnbUHr3eYZ4r4q1VXEdtF1T7vzrSNDhafS.jpg)

![IMG_4969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wgHkHVnjzmZvKF5Xkxzm6vatorKEh5yzpApURWBoNQAZwjRedtp4Tf498NRqDXam2Fv.jpg)

Ein altes Auto erfüllt noch einen Zweck als kreativer Blumentopf.
![IMG_4977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23vsFw9jTk93rubP9Uha2ZhyGDW6rBJLhoHf22bZaZfcTiwBST2yuSJtFkz2nfUs2ghVK.jpg)

Was wäre Griechenland ohne Oliven?
![IMG_8656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23x12iWPXgk3t2A3vFiwPsMSdHRVCM2ZN6yTRmXvpLdi2ZZk53VNvq4q1wphajK2MkZbR.jpg)

In einer Fischtaverne in Loutraki, einem Kurort nahe Korinth, wo wir noch kurz Halt gemacht hatten.
![IMG_5415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/243qKNDxPmceSp7kM2kvcjih66XUM4BL5aKrLgkJ9k3ywNNmeBEqF7EiCC3gcp3V5NreQ.jpg)
Die kleinen, (in Mehl und Olivenöl) frittierten Fische im Vordergrund werden „Marides“ (μαρίδες) genannt und als Ganzes gegessen, also mit Kopf und Gräten - die \

Die letzten Fotos sind nicht aus Attika, sondern aus Nafplio.

Katze mit einer (noch lebenden) Maus als \

. Als die Maus schliesslich einen Fluchtversuch unternahm, war die Katze sofort hinterher und hat sie gepackt.
![IMG_5081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23z7QfQBuokUyXtch3kKapgqYwYGoFoU6QtcnBi25bXx1D4ci1EaqLk3ziRRKbMCLVtbK.jpg)

Katzenversorgungs- und Wohlfühlstation, Hunde müssen draußen bleiben 😆
![IMG_5171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23yThVJMAmPBtm7FN6DzMBqY7VDg5s3Ds4ZYgRn6SLLPxdjaXSRpqng6K51opk1f1Bk6v.jpg)

Ein Sandschurfüßer? @jaki01, eventuell kennst Du Dich da auch aus?
![IMG_5344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23tSU4KPt6R8WqrfkdJZxndAicjwRgsxUdKhnvAwnFwq9i3oXEygAK8CuMmtBHQVUGBaD.jpg)


Abendstimmung in Nafplio

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![UejP67dqFN2ZUMoh_1779092918196.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/UejP67dqFN2ZUMoh_1779092918196/UejP67dqFN2ZUMoh_1779092918196.webp)
![SZLC1ewZaYcM0vMP_1779092932437.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/SZLC1ewZaYcM0vMP_1779092932437/SZLC1ewZaYcM0vMP_1779092932437.webp)
![G5ncGXvzUR5AGqYv_1779092975955.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/G5ncGXvzUR5AGqYv_1779092975955/G5ncGXvzUR5AGqYv_1779092975955.webp)
![U3b9xlRRG2NoKdbJ_1779092994009.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yueliang/images/U3b9xlRRG2NoKdbJ_1779092994009/U3b9xlRRG2NoKdbJ_1779092994009.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

长大的感觉好像并不怎么太好，越大越不太好，真的是越大越不值钱了。就是没有青春的那股活力和什么都不怕的冲劲儿！日子在不知不觉中一天一天的匆匆儿而过，事情一个接一个的袭来，真的是让人应接不暇，分身乏术，成年人的世界真的是很辛苦。

手机什么时候停机了，早上哥哥就给我打电话，说断网了。想着是欠费几天了，一查果真是，又充了一百多的话费，每个月都要养着这个手机，因为是网线捆绑手机，每个月都要有一百多的固定话费，我是早就想停了，停了店里的网线就要断。一件一件的事情不仅消耗着我的身体还有精神上的……

周六回老家婆婆在那埋怨俺姑，一个月了也不回来看她娘一次，光想自己清就。其实确实，人太好了是不行的，痛苦的永远都是自己。俺奶都九十了，一直都是俺公婆伺候看病，现在也不会走了。俺奶三个儿子一个闺女，一个儿子在外地，没回来过，另一个儿子是晚上在这住一下，闺女嫁的也在隔壁村。只要俺公公不打电话，谁也不会主动来，真的是人老了没人会待见。但话说回来了，谁家不都是有一大家子，就不能相互体谅一下，都是搁着一家使劲的薅。

话说回来了，这老人心里也可清楚，他那几个孩子不来，她也不埋怨。她之前清醒时就跟俺公公说，我就一直叮你了，谁叫你的胳膊比他们粗了。是啊，做为母亲也太了解自己的孩子了，谁可以拿捏，谁拿捏不了，她比谁都清楚，亲生父母还如此，又何况外人呢?

愿每一个善良的人都能有好的福报吧，生活再难也是要过的呢。

---

body.title: Close Calls.
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779093885069-cfdebac706c4bf05.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/8b8a93be)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=siaaam/8b8a93be)


---

After hiding under a tank, Lara and Jonah coordinated stealth takedowns on Trinity patrols. We survived back-to-back ambushes by saving each other from armed soldiers. After Jonah secured a handgun, we navigated a cave and used a fire arrow to burn a barrier, finally reaching the village.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBQtvzxcRNUt6oyLfFsjqsGNDXJNqDqSrT881xZr34RC/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPiRanb7kp3XZDxRZmWdsZivpoqDYpEsq9h7u7EWfz5e8/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZ7b6EdMsxyC8teyuoX7AN2ghVAyWsNHveNMxR6jBK6y/screenshot_3_.png)

After taking down some trinity soldiers, the remained ones started looking for their fallen comrades as it has been quiet. So we had to get under the tank to stay hidden from the sweeping searchlights that cut through the jungle canopy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXFvaiDa9QpQD7oKNfn8g1icCpXBbZwY9rEHymn2cNCe/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUCo7wu2HQxr7M3iuzs2fJavbXvKAHEMVcE4QU5Rc8r8/screenshot_5_.png)

On our way, we noticed there were more people ahead guarding. So both Lara and Jonah planned to take them down simultaneously before they could alert the rest of the camp.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYnJiSesPaQRLZjCBF26RA6ofvbkZsocHY9meCrXQCg6w/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTaYAxDS9Sbo4CrWnGQsUAJETbfGBWsC6iX8ySD6FiwfX/screenshot_7_.png)

There were two remained as the third one went to the backside. So Lara took one down first with her knife when Jonah held the other one tightly, and then they took care of the next one without a single sound.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXCzR9gBxC3DvZrvtFVt9uBbum2SMDmyrrYCDVXKD8j2/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVoVQRAp4bKWABXq3S1LzS3itzknZSa6WQdU4eoMgEukr/screenshot_9_.png)

But Jonah had to escape into the ferns as an armed soldier saw him moving. And from cover, I took down this armed one before he could pull his radio out to call for help.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZYLh1Ys9K3GcXhXvhTjgBTsrvXyNJkRkBWNW87oRaPpV/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHD9AxTYUTcnPf5R7itNWvZNWqNhSmg1zeewnUpowwHc/screenshot_11_.png)

When I was going for Jonah to make sure he was alright, I was almost ambushed by this armed soldier. But Lara was strong enough to take him down from that situation, turning the blade against him in a struggle.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePdpYHnAYLHqdQfDkc3G8VCGRiJidtpxwmGk1bMr7Fjy/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawhVVXQz3Jv4ikxBHRVNzMXjRkTDV1GYDT6tZxjrWQJo/screenshot_13_.png)

But suddenly there came this Trinity soldier who was a little far from Lara's position, and he could take down Lara easily with his gun. But there came Jonah who became the savior.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTGKFSer3WhgRHckwvTYZENT6HRnAsP1PDRxGu4HevwTx/screenshot_14_.png)

body.title: A Quiet Morning in the Homestead: The Gift of Free-Range Chickens
body.body:
There is something deeply satisfying about walking through the homestead early in the morning and discovering a hidden nest full of fresh eggs. Today was one of those special moments that remind me why I love raising free-range chickens. As I moved around the yard checking on the birds, I found one of my hens carefully sitting on her eggs beneath dry grass and leaves, protecting them with patience and determination.
This hen has been quietly laying her eggs in a hidden spot away from the main coop. Chickens naturally look for safe and peaceful places to lay, especially when they want to hatch chicks. Seeing her comfortably settled over the eggs reminded me how strong nature’s instincts are. No machines, no complicated systems—just simple life continuing the way it has for generations.
I gently counted the eggs and found several healthy-looking ones with smooth shells and good size. Fresh eggs collected directly from the homestead always feel different from store-bought eggs. They represent hard work, patience, and proper care of the birds. Our chickens roam freely around the compound, scratching the soil, eating insects, green plants, and grains. Because of this natural lifestyle, they remain active and healthy.
One thing I appreciate about free-range poultry farming is that it requires observation and connection with the animals. Every hen behaves differently. Some prefer laying inside nesting boxes, while others create hidden nests under grass, bushes, or dry leaves. If you are not observant, you can easily lose eggs without knowing where the hens are laying.
These moments also teach patience. A brooding hen becomes very protective and committed to her eggs. If the conditions remain safe and peaceful, she may hatch healthy chicks after about 21 days. Watching a mother hen raise chicks naturally is one of the most rewarding experiences in homestead farming.
For anyone starting a small homestead, I always encourage keeping local chickens. They are hardy, adaptable, and valuable in many ways. Besides providing eggs and meat, they help control insects around the farm and contribute manure for the garden. They fit perfectly into a sustainable farming system.
Today’s discovery brought joy and motivation to continue improving the homestead little by little. Farming may not always be easy, but moments like this make the effort worthwhile. Nature has a beautiful way of rewarding consistency, care, and patience.

body.title: What Is the Best Time to Travel Across India by Road on a Bike?
body.body:
##

![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/19207c7d05f0696905eb2ef1476d888a4ed94ec509a80d7a79df686861cd84f0)

India offers different riding experiences throughout the year, but choosing the right season is important for comfort and safety. The ideal time depends on the region you plan to explore during your India motorcycle tour.

## Best Seasons for Motorcycle Riding in India

For Himalayan regions like Ladakh, Spiti, and Himachal Pradesh, the best riding period is from June to September. Roads remain open, weather conditions improve, and mountain passes become accessible for riders interested in [Exploring India on Motorcycle](https://www.indiamotorbiketour.com/).

For Rajasthan, Gujarat, and South India, the winter season between October and February is considered perfect. Cooler temperatures make long-distance rides more comfortable and enjoyable.

## Why Timing Matters for Riders

Choosing the right season helps riders avoid extreme heat, heavy rainfall, and road closures. Many experienced travelers booking Motorcycle Tours in India prefer planning months in advance to secure the best routes and accommodations.

A reliable best motorcycle tour operator in India also helps international riders select the ideal tour according to weather and riding experience.

For those interested in Motorbike travel India, seasonal planning improves road conditions, sightseeing opportunities, and overall riding comfort. Whether riding through deserts, coastal highways, or Himalayan passes, the right timing makes every journey more memorable.

body.title: Xổ số miền Nam thứ 3 thường quay ra số nào? Dò nhanh số thường xuất hiện
body.body: Vào mỗi ngày thứ 3 hàng tuần, không khí mua bán vé số tại khu vực miền Nam lại trở nên nhộn nhịp với ba đài mở thưởng là Bến Tre, Vũng Tàu và Bạc Liêu. Trong quá trình chọn cho mình một tấm vé ưng ý, rất nhiều người mang chung một thắc mắc: Liệu có những con số nào thường xuyên được xướng tên trên bảng kết quả hay không?\n\nTheo kinh nghiệm của những người chơi vé số kiến thiết lâu năm, việc theo dõi nhịp độ xuất hiện của các con số mang lại rất nhiều lợi ích. Việc biết được số nào đang có \

tốt, thường xuyên nổ trong thời gian gần đây sẽ giúp bà con có thêm cơ sở vững chắc để lựa chọn, thay vì chỉ nhắm mắt chọn bừa. Tuy nhiên, để đếm được số lần xuất hiện của từng cặp số bằng sổ sách thủ công là điều bất khả thi. Nhằm giúp bà con tiết kiệm thời gian và công sức, bài viết này sẽ chỉ dẫn cách tra cứu nhịp độ xuất hiện của các con số một cách nhanh chóng nhất.\n\n<h2 style=\

>3 bước nhanh chóng để xem tần suất các con số đài miền Nam thứ 3 Chỉ với một chiếc điện thoại thông minh hoặc máy tính có kết nối mạng, bà con có thể tự mình kiểm tra xem con số nào đang ra nhiều nhất thông qua ba thao tác vô cùng ngắn gọn:
></center>\n\nBước 1: Đầu tiên, bà con mở trình duyệt mạng và truy cập vào trang web xosodaiphat.com. Ngay trên màn hình trang chủ, bà con hãy tìm và nhấn vào chuyên mục có tên là \
(đây là nơi tập hợp các bảng tính toán số liệu).\n\nBước 2: Trong mục này, bà con tiếp tục nhấn chọn vào công cụ mang tên \

. Chức năng này được sinh ra để đo lường xem một con số cụ thể xuất hiện dày đặc hay thưa thớt ra sao.

Bước 3: Ở bước cuối cùng này, bà con sẽ điền các thông tin cần thiết. Trước hết là chọn Đài mà mình muốn mua vé (Bến Tre, Vũng Tàu hoặc Bạc Liêu). Tiếp theo, chọn Ngày mà bà con cần xem làm cột mốc. Cuối cùng là điền Số ngày muốn xem (tức là khoảng thời gian lùi về trước tính từ ngày đã chọn). Sau khi chọn xong, bảng danh sách sẽ phơi bày rõ ràng mức độ xuất hiện của các con số, giúp bà con nắm bắt ngay số nào đang ra nhiều nhất.

<h2 style=\

>Điểm tựa tin cậy cho niềm vui dò vé số mỗi ngày Để công cụ đo lường nhịp độ các con số hoạt động mượt mà và trả về kết quả trong nháy mắt như vậy, trang web đã phải xây dựng một nền tảng vô cùng vững chắc với nhiều điểm sáng đáng nể: Điểm đáng quý đầu tiên là kho lưu trữ dữ liệu khổng lồ. Tất cả kết quả của ba miền Bắc, Trung, Nam từ những tháng trước hay nhiều năm về trước đều được hệ thống ghi nhận và cất giữ cẩn thận. Chính nhờ nguồn dữ liệu phong phú này, các công cụ phân tích mới có thể đúc kết ra những bảng danh sách chi tiết, hỗ trợ bà con tra cứu mọi lúc mọi nơi. Yếu tố thứ hai khiến người dùng gắn bó chính là phần nhìn của trang web. Giao diện được sắp xếp cực kỳ gọn gàng, chữ số to và rõ nét, màu sắc hài hòa không gây chói mắt. Ngay cả những người lớn tuổi, mắt kém cũng có thể lướt xem dễ dàng. Thêm vào đó, đội ngũ kỹ thuật viên luôn túc trực ngày đêm để duy trì tốc độ đường truyền, đảm bảo trang web luôn chạy nhanh, không để bà con phải chờ đợi bực mình khi đang cần xem số gấp.

></center>

Và điều làm nên sự tự hào lớn nhất của hệ thống chính là khả năng tường thuật trực tiếp kết quả ngay khi nhà đài đang quay. Đúng vào các khung giờ quen thuộc: 16h10 (miền Nam), 17h10 (miền Trung) và 18h10 (miền Bắc), một đội ngũ nhân viên sẽ có mặt ngay tại hàng ghế của trường quay. Ngay khoảnh khắc quả bóng mang số rơi xuống, nhân viên tại hiện trường sẽ đọc to kết quả. Đồng thời, 1 đội ngũ khác sẽ nhanh tay đưa ngay con số đó lên bảng điện tử. Sự phối hợp nhịp nhàng và liên tục kiểm tra chéo lẫn nhau giúp cho từng con số hiện lên màn hình điện thoại của bà con luôn đạt độ chuẩn xác cao.

Mua một tờ vé số không chỉ là cách để thử vận may mà còn là một niềm vui nhỏ bé, tô điểm thêm cho cuộc sống thường ngày. Khi biết cách tự mình tra cứu những con số hay về, bà con sẽ thấy việc dò vé số trở nên chủ động và thú vị hơn rất nhiều.

Nếu chiều nay, khi đồng hồ điểm đúng giờ mở thưởng và bà con muốn biết tấm vé trên tay mình có phải là tấm vé may mắn hay không, hãy nhớ mở ngay trang web xosodaiphat.com. Bà con sẽ được sống trong không khí hồi hộp, tận mắt nhìn thấy từng con số hiện ra nhanh chóng và chuẩn xác y như đang ngồi trực tiếp tại trường quay!

> Two centuries ago Wraithvine helped the folk of a river valley with a carnivorous fish problem. Imagine hir surprise to hear in a tavern on the far side of the continent that ze has helped them once again only a season behind and settled down in the valley with the prettiest child of the valley chieftain. Clearly this must be investigated at once… -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Walk far enough and long enough, some legends say, and you will meet yourself coming the other way. Sometimes, somehow, that can come true... for interesting definitions of 'true'.

Fish River Valley used to be Blood River Valley before Wraithvine helped the people there solve the issue of the carnivorous fish. Hearing about that on the other side of the local land mass, two centuries and a decade or so after the fact, was not entirely alarming. It was a good story worthy of the penny players' stage.

It was the epilogue that struck like an assassin at midnight.

body.title: pianos falling, wanting more & talking about it
body.body: i kinda feel it. this amalgam, jumble of thoughts. wings on my feet and wishing for a safer tomorrow. in a world that makes increasingly less sense by the minute, the need to know is vast, and often misunderstood. the narrow, suffocated constrictions of not knowing misunderstand, often, the multiplicities of what if. but hey-ho, what can you do. i admit there's a terrible beauty in absence, but i don't think you'll find much hope in it, when life calls on you. and what is life, if not the frantic scrambling for something to give you hope in dark, terrible nights? between you and me, for all the terrible things, i think i liked it better when we were angels. obviously. i'm safe and far enough away to gloss over the fact that it was either delusion or manipulation that said it. still. i liked it better when we did it as angels.

> someone put it to me they were old, though looking now on this past tangent, they couldn't have been that old. someone put it to me young people had no patience. are we guilty of wanting it all and too fast, and how do i wrap up that conversation in three minutes or under? how much of my future is it safe to want now? was one question for yesterday, and for those chronically non-committal like i. i try not to take more alms than i can carry in the words of people older than myself, on sheer account of mistrusting nostalgia, and the things down the years, they've forgotten how to say. i'm worried if enough well-meaning people tell me i got time, it'll cure me eventually of this gnawing fear that i secretly don't. i'll lose momentum, and forget how to gallop. or is lust for life more like riding a bicycle, really? am i just another late-coming teenager, stumbling over myself? think on it a second, because i never think about things for more, and decide i agree. but at the same time, i don't live in the ordinary world. i've never had people just in one boat or the other, and i've never run with people my own age, but rather transcending ages, have seen patience in various forms of completion. i like to think it's given me a better view of hills. that i am not bound by the pangs and twinges of my own timeline and impending mortality. i lie. trick and twist myself. lie down on a bed of mud. i decide if it'll swallow me whole or teach me flow. i bought finally the book, but struggle with foreign words still. i fall often for thick, round glasses, a look, a line, then am left to bear the brunt of it disproportionately. this morning, i heard a man talk about how we were all still quite stuffed, but how now we're talking more about it, and maybe that makes it a bit better because that means we know. or does awareness secretly just make it all worse? men with big guns. big gods. god's man on earth. heaven on earth. hearths stuffed with guns. angels wielding ak47s. strangle-hope children propping up the pianola. belief. belief? maybe aliens have met us already, hated what we were wearing, and jim carried us.

body.title: My Splinterlands Grail: Collecting Gold Foil Legendaries Money Can't Buy
body.body:
![SPLGrail.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/EoEo8DsYGD9JdhDYKFW6DEvwxvcbxUEXwhxcrvmXsgab8H6V4uYpPVmnMp1v8txtHjR.png) One can think of a grail as the object of a difficult, extended quest, and in the digital world of NFTs, there are so many grails to chase. As a card collector in the Web3 TCG #Splinterlands, I've got a few grails I've been after ever since I started playing the game in December 2021. At long last, I've finally accomplished one of these grails, collecting at least 1 Gold Foil BCX of each Legendary Gladiator -- ALL SEVEN of them! This is no easy feat since Gladiators are soulbound cards that you can't buy with funds or other crypto. The only way to earn these cards is by opening the Gladius Cases, which can be earned by spending soulbound Merits earned as rewards from Brawls and Loot Chests. ## The Legendaries Four-and-a-half years of opening Gladius Cases with Blood and Power stones on the hunt for premium Gold Foils to add to my brawling collection. The last GFL I needed, Fina Voxom, was on my hit list for over a year before I finally found her on Friday, March 15. Here she is alongside the other six legendaries. ![Screenshot 2026-05-16 035115.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23wqXXtFJ9TGa8CCLWYWT6gvwyoh2HDfco3rju2YjbgFEvPunkntNNk1GBAPLmtKp5dSR.png) I've also only opened 1 GFL BCX of the Death legend Xulax and the Dragon legend Larissa. I've combined 2 GFL BCX to make a Level 3 legend for the Water, Earth, and Neutral legends. I'm only 1 BCX away from a max Sola Ranjell, as I've opened the most GFL BCX of the Life legend. This got me thinking about how I'm doing with the Gold Foils at the other three card rarities. ## The Epics ![Screenshot 2026-05-18 004938.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23w2eSnhMropzKnfVAR7AiLfXwf4YncWyetDKQGDDARLQDBYZLRnLS63iBGMc3sVDyYLD.png) There are only five different epic gladiators since there isn't one for Dragon or Neutral, and we're all rooting for the same Gold Foil when we open the packs -- the all-powerful Earth Gladiator Quora Towershead! Of course, Quora is the epic I've opened the least of in Gold Foil. I've only opened 3 GFE BCX of Quora, as well as the Life epic Marisol, both stuck at Level 3. On the other hand, I've now opened a staggering EIGHT BCX of the lovable loser, Gorth, twice as many as any of the other epics. Gorth is a constant reminder that he could have been a dang Quora! Gorth is ironically my only Level 5 epic, joined by Trapp and Edith as Level 4 Gold Foil epics. ## The Rares ![Screenshot 2026-05-18 005007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23uQhpWbD1ntNNaXnTmNBDSzcPnw1Wg9auQNVbj6J4nm7DGpHQmS8m5UfPLhL1edypALz.png) Looking at the 10 rares in the Gladiator card set, I've opened the most of the Water and Life units, with Level 7 cards for all four of the gladiators: Alfredo, Relenor, Ajax, and Katie. Thankfully, Katie is the best gladiator of the 10 rares, but I still need 6 more GFR BCX to max her out for that fifth point of magic damage. I seem to have opened the fewest of the Earth rares, with only Level 5 versions of those units, as well as a Level 5 Liza in Death. The 1-mana Cutter Brieze can be handy in low-level range battles, so I'd love to level it up higher in Gold Foil. Both of my Fire rares, Orella and Sarius, along with K.Rayne in Death, are combined to Level 6, which makes them the ideal level to use in my Advanced Gold Foil brawl fray. ## The Commons ![Screenshot 2026-05-18 005026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23uFGqY8awmWMYNWhztc6KL3cDrBrMPMHTR7MfHF8p6juDATqrbSq9xzda68ncknzcHt1.png) Well, would you look at that. Over 4.5 years, I've managed to fully max out four of the common gladiators with a whopping 38 GFC BCX! Very thankfully, I've managed to max out both of the deadly Gobson melee units, the double-striking sneak attacker Katrelba, and the opportunistic Bertrol. Unnecessarily, I've opened 8 extra GFC BCX of Whistling Damon, 46 in total. If just 3 of those had been the powerful Water common, Isgald Vorst, then I would have her maxed out as well, and wouldn't think twice about saving my merits for a new set of gladiators. But I'm such a fan of Isgald Vorst, I'm considering continuing my Gold Foil quest until I have the last 3 BCX I need to get to 38, so I can max her out for that 5th point of melee damage. Finally, I'm 10 BCX away from a fully leveled Helmet Kharafax for the helpful Return Fire ability, as he is a very handy null attack unit to pair with Rage or Shiraza, but that seems so far away now that I've completed my Gold Foil Legendary grail. I just can't see myself continuing to chase Gold Foil BCX to max out commons and rares when I could instead be stacking Merits if we ever get a new set of Gladiator cards to collect. ## The Next Grail What's the next grail for me to collect? At this point, I'm not exactly sure. I've really enjoyed this quest for 1 BCX of each Gold Foil legendary Gladiator since it has been entirely based on my persistence to purchase and open Gladius Cases with my extra merits on the hunt for soulbound GFLs. These are Gold Foil gladiators that money can't buy, which makes it even more special to achieve. I've long since completed a fully maxed regular foil set of Gladiators at all rarities, but as a Gold Foil collector, I badly wanted at least 1 BCX of all of the cards at my disposal, especially for Brawls and @sps.dao tournaments. Here they are in all their glory: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23tbkLV5LVqyN9zAcvJDwJ2t4B9JJ2wRZHhyyGeKZVsTGSpraJssYaRHMNsRd8rNbPjXN.jpg) What grail are you working on? Let me know in the comments, and I'll see you around Praetoria. Until next time... ![SPL divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23t7YkFmVUsPmKt3qas5ZnaBbsBckvaqnYAQMBgZhEEfpRBkLYLh3ZP4zT8U4FJ8mcdL4.png)
Check out my affiliated guild alliance for open positions. Discord invite linked to the picture! @ducecrypto & @treycrypto & @shaelien Proud members of Splinterlands' top-rated guild, the original guild in the KoG alliance, @shield-of-glory! [![image0.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ducecrypto/23y8v2qyzHzYRNZKSj1zhXXXJdAu3Jf2HfVe8xPVPvJ66bCuUJ7R2eSumKqr2mm1tuqiD.gif)](https://discord.gg/xbKHdJxfqM)

body.title: WorldMappin at Hive Open Days Alicante [Eng][Esp]
body.body:
![IMG_0597.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/242rwANfanKquNCJzy2jQ1gmvJxZkDPrUrCiiRP97QvVeW2JrcfWGqK1iWKHdtsMvxCdU.jpeg)
[Léelo en **español** aquí](#spanish)

Oh my god - did you see that the next Hivefest has been announced? It will be in Barcelona, Spain - and we are already so excited to join the party. But first things first - to get a little taste of what it may be like, we went to The Hive Open Days in Alicante two weeks ago. Yes - As you may know, the Hive Community came back together on a big event already this year. And as always, it was a great pleasure, very interesting, and so much fun to meet Hiveans from all over the world, sharing and exchanging thoughts and ideas about the ecosystem and its initiatives. Every single time the Hive Community comes together in person, feeling the spirit is so special. Here you can truly feel what Hive is about (at least for us) - and of course what Worldmappin is about. -> bringing people from all over the world together to talk about the future! So here is a little report about what happened that days for those of you that couldn´t join: # Day 1 - Waterproof stickers for everyone! ![IMG_9657.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xKxvXLX2WNfSJJTXN61rJn7hoViGpT4fMSMD32RAUShs8pqqK62oZDmA4LD3LaHMCLD.jpeg)|![IMG_0758.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wC9iMVbV9SeWMetZM6WzNJWWUSVQkGHSinqPeJ6g1k2MHuQPztSpcV9apFHupDkbEPg.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_9822.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23vi62BL7bC2CspiLUmCFhtWsCieoLKsa9MvtCDhnMNk2R6rCdGUpcaT718b6g4ZWoWTk.jpeg)|![IMG_9846.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23u65K3zjk5PK99ybg9amYX9bKEtZySPJ3H78MACfscqG7CX6UXa97jdwYy6tSAiyJChH.jpeg)| ![IMG_9717.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23uFc5xsvmXgiAKvSX11N1eDBFDHn5MybfuzH8S6V2khLMCUuWegKNyKdqmigbdzMQqqa.jpeg) ---|---|--- We were there from the very first day of #HODAlicante, greeting and welcoming both Hive users and attendees from outside the ecosystem. For some Hivians, it was even their first time experiencing an event of this kind, so #worldmappin was there representing one of Hive’s largest and most active communities—one that strives to engage with its users and make them feel connected. We came to this event packed with new features, one of which was handing out hundreds of waterproof #worldmappin pin stickers. We’d done some tests beforehand that showed good results, and now we’ve brought this version for everyone—in two sizes—which is even more weather-resistant and ensures greater longevity for users who mark locations on our map to document their visits. The feedback was incredible, as many users mentioned that they had thought about durability when leaving the #worldmappin stamp around the world. So, after the official presentations, we went out with several users around the city, stamping the badge in various places for testing! *Thanks @honeydue for helping us out with that! # Day 2 - New version of WMP and upcoming goals ![IMG_0570.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2oVKKsbNoswCPk5Ex8ae79WH1LBwetA7a8K1AqafGEHYHhsQE5W1E7AGQ2kvi6JVT9.jpeg) The second day of the event was dedicated to official presentations about the Hive ecosystem: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6I4M0ap6vA We had the great responsibility of closing the event, so we decided to focus on two main aspects: welcoming the new Hivians who created their accounts the day before the event, introducing them to the project as a useful tool for their new journey within Hive, and devoting a large part of the presentation to a tour of all the new features we’ve been working on lately. We showcased all the new features of the recently launched [WorldMappin V2](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@worldmappin/exciting-news-worldmappin-v2-is-live), the project’s new face. We thanked all the users who have helped us so much with their feedback, showing how we’ve incorporated into our interface the details and tools that users care about most, letting them know that this is just the beginning of the new phase of #WorldMappin and that we’ll keep working to bring improvements for everyone. So now you know—don’t hesitate to support our proposal ([Peakd.com](https://peakd.com/proposals/348) / [Ecency](https://ecency.com/proposals/348) / [Hive.blog](https://wallet.hive.blog/proposals/348) / [HiveSigner](https://hivesigner.com/sign/update_proposal_votes?proposal_ids=%5B%22348%22%5D&approve=true)) to help us keep working on this wonderful project. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23vsb96t8FUyD4PHBgWGgVsiRcVRhGcysGhssvSeWsT3UdBacjsKqKNUsasCyuFsFzf2S.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23tvsFr9j1Xcf1cfv9XSXsZZjcidKUhBdEod6FjUYSV8qP1XmQTP2FhfcGtVGr3k3ghLn.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xpAnfLHxz3NWN1WkoszCo4niSbU1apobHUwiA6MTkWjZU4VJFbPvVTx3egajonM2JE4.jpeg) Another highlight of the day, which we joined in celebrating with the @mantequilla-soft team, was putting into practice the wonderful real-time translation tool that @tibfox brought to the event and made available to all speakers, thereby helping everyone understand the information being shared even if they didn’t speak the language. The mobile app also provided access to many more languages to facilitate live translation for each user and, to allow them to have private conversations in different languages, breaking down that barrier that can sometimes be so frustrating. On our side, @ninaeatshere put it to the test by presenting our talk in Spanish, to make the information accessible to new Spanish-speaking users and, of course, to honor the place where we were, as we know that the Spanish-speaking community is a major part of our HIVE ecosystem and also of our Worldmappin Community. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Ep5mHUbDd3Ezbng5Z5FvU8ro9ioGtm4PsfHu7H8L2pXczpxU3o8oZF8a6y24Rj63su3.jpeg)|![IMG_0599.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yTji5XrrfTaYmqBTuauKZD4hX89iGrhG24wRUXGgabw9E8v8EqtYMGmwVfpvKJsQaUT.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_0565.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xAgVEX4cDLxh9tceSAKZcP8rvmELVWLuKGJAkTQcHCuWBCWEycyFoTuxUMdxPMf6DSt.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/242DdHTEeAUveRsP2jhbSGqUgN2MCSgcgYweSimVrZrswdEqT1ZJnJrytzAQ4RXx3AGWW.jpeg) # Day 3 - Sponsoring the Clean Planet Challenge prizes! ![IMG_0087.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23zS5cQx5t1QrU8aesdsJc4dobjET49MBVkLLTzwVZNWGqBPsbBMXgdzuRE28d2kWwoLC.jpeg) Just like every year, during the #BuzzParty events organized by @tibfox, the wonderful #CleanPlanetChallenge took place, and of course, we were there to explore the island where it was held, plant a few pins in the surrounding area, and also motivate the participants with some backpacks full of Hive goodies for the challenge winners. Our team was there for the challenge, helping to clean up Tabarca Island, but, above all, encouraging participants to compete in a healthy spirit. That day, after @ninaeatshere took the pin out to eat, the team made sure to be present throughout the challenge so we could ultimately reward those who put in the most effort that afternoon. The keeper of the prizes was @godfish, who kept a watchful eye on everyone involved and presented the prizes to that day’s winning team. We handed out backpacks filled with goodies to the team of @gissse and @juanmatrader, two of the new users who fully immersed themselves in the Hive experience! ![IMG_0011.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Eoc8QckLcLNQCYJFG5eT1HmKrBND8PwapeoGr5V9SK7gtmZC2iSgdJBhkAMeG9gDig9.jpeg) ![IMG_0029.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoEtN2zHRJ11zVJ5s2Jv8j1r5MuV6wi38tiBPqh6hsVqqLpiyX7U8VAwNXr3fSmANqT.jpeg) ![IMG_0595.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yThC4RP9VMjYMWEQsS75TqvcoWbAoeJDsYnAEGfJSXZ2bctiwLe7Q66BDa75pPcECqH.jpeg)|![IMG_0117.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23y8zTpy6DdrCB1C66dLv9yLcaWbNop1QeY9nM5d7WD2brADsrcNYPpqw37QDSkHvRaUg.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_0105.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yd85xf1MTamt39PatWojHu7XVXU8PW8qGniSoHiUd8bBDA2tHiT8pJot6QJrSkeCqTS.jpeg) # Day 4 - Exploring the city with riddles! ![IMG_0249.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Eoke1Pn2xPKfhG6DYsrhQueoi6MoTb1VvcjQBLMLSvmob8Q8dnmVkGpirywauFZFZrh.jpeg) For our final day at #HODAlicante, we wanted to take event attendees on a tour of part of the city, immerse them in Alicante’s culture, and encourage them to post their travel content in the [WorldMAppin community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-163772/created). The goal of the tour was to visit some of Alicante’s landmarks while @ninaeatshere quizzed our dear Hivians with some travel riddles. It was the last day of the event, and attendees were really exhausted from the previous days; plus, there were local festivities in the city that limited our schedule and access to certain places, so we decided to take it easy, scale back the itinerary a bit, and ask very simple questions for the challenge. We met at the entrance to Ulab, the convention center where the talks took place, and headed out to visit three nearby spots:
**The Basilica of Santa María**
![IMG_0253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EprV5sqGSt9pYQYvNrFmVgBg5dxUBoLv3gkQopS7mPkqHTjCzmSjDmQYY3KzPP2Knrh.jpeg)
**The Alicante Museum of Contemporary Art**
![IMG_0267.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EouBcgcUNP56YECZEydKKTsweNhz4bNfSnuwC7su4hr9p26tRrMwDx4J2Bz16BYx4qG.jpeg)
**Santa Cruz Cultural District**
![IMG_0303.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Ep7s6UvvnDYqqizYxFMbxZaC6wSfQLfotftCJn1LKuVKvffB1Pi55HSQsc6thmgJ1nU.jpeg)
😃 **The Santa Cruz Viewpoint is labeled with a WorldMappin pin**
![IMG_0298.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23x1DBQZdwN3VBYtEa9VqiyJz98W9nEPwwjAJ1PxzqmZkPrMSKUnp4iKxm5nMnmB3JaUT.jpeg) Since the end of the walk involved carrying our bags, we stopped to rest outside one of the picturesque little houses in the Santa Cruz neighborhood, where @godfish—the keeper of the prizes—was conveniently staying, and we settled in to share some snacks and hand out prizes to the three winners of the riddles we’d posed along the way. This time, another new user emerged as a winner: @anamz took home one of our backpacks full of prizes, accompanied by the victorious @edje and @palomap3 for being the fastest at solving the riddles that day. Here’s a photo of the scene where we raided @godfish’s place to award the three winners on the final leg of the journey. Some winners enthusiastically shared the contents of the famous backpack, so here’s a glimpse of what was inside. In the backpack, we included a couple of T-shirts: one from the previous HiveFest we sponsored and our nice black T-shirt. The winners also took home a good batch of Hive stickers, a water bottle, a small wallet (the **cold wallet**), and a couple of packets of **summer flower seeds**—a nice promotional initiative with a real purpose ( [click here](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@detlev/hive-merch-with-results-smart-seed-marketing) if you’re interested in learning more about **Hive Seeds** or if you’re one of the winners and want to find out how to plant them) ![IMG_0282.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoGyrB1vUGaXZCWmkedUj9MFSrBLt23FHxiitcm9quYrz3zd8QwnpW71dABNtuVdofq.jpeg) ![4e179531-2ae5-4ccf-a3f7-90d594b4477c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2eJgxLW3SpsJcUSkaaJRRLXnCuBUNpFgAwtUsQxEpXPDmD1iX9cdQ26cfeTs4HCyUb.jpeg)| ![77e48ea0-b9c8-4a07-af1c-6b36393790f5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2ktvC2bvrftTrUvWbu4wXgUARuALsamMPYJFM6fCSrsxRhkThRSA88sAqX8vtuD4cR.jpeg) --|-- (Photos by winners Ana and Paloma) The WorldMAppin team is extremely grateful and proud to be able to participate in events like this one, which are full of initiatives that encourage users of our ecosystem to engage more deeply with the blockchain in various ways. We are pleased to say that we thoroughly enjoyed sharing this experience once again with the event organizers and all the users who attended. We want the users to feel close to us and to know that they can reach out to the team with any questions, suggestions, or feedback. It was a pleasure to be in Alicante, and we can’t wait to see you all again at the upcoming [HiveFest XI – Barcelona, the Heart of Catalonia! September 17–20, 2026](https://peakd.com/hive-106258/@hivefest/save-the-date-hivefest-xi-barcelona-the-heart-of-catalonia-17-20-sept-2026). Until then, travelers! — **The Worldmappin Team** ![IMG_0525.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EpxqFqjZsep8TjMMivRoVu33HCzReFCLxkd8yybw3GS6RK1LnXfGb7AoLx9B9CZqbgu.jpeg) *Photo credits: We would like to thank @ninaeatshere, @gisse, @schmidi, @haastrecht, @palomap3, and @anamz for sharing the photos featured in this post.*
