**Español**

> ![IMG_0597.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/242rwANfanKquNCJzy2jQ1gmvJxZkDPrUrCiiRP97QvVeW2JrcfWGqK1iWKHdtsMvxCdU.jpeg) ¡Dios mío! ¿Ya vieron que se ha anunciado el próximo Hivefest? Se celebrará en Barcelona, ​​España, ¡y ya estamos sumamente emocionados por unirnos a la fiesta! Pero lo primero primero: para hacernos una idea de cómo podría ser, asistimos a los *Hive Open Days* en Alicante hace dos semanas. Sí; como tal vez ya sepan, la comunidad de Hive volvió a reunirse en un gran evento este mismo año. Y, como siempre, fue un inmenso placer —además de una experiencia muy interesante y tremendamente divertida— conocer a *Hiveans* de todas partes del mundo, compartiendo e intercambiando pensamientos e ideas sobre el ecosistema y sus iniciativas. Cada vez que la comunidad de Hive se reúne en persona, resulta verdaderamente especial sentir ese espíritu. Aquí es donde realmente se puede percibir la esencia de Hive (al menos para nosotros) y, por supuesto, la esencia de Worldmappin: ¡unir a personas de todo el mundo para conversar sobre el futuro! Así que, aquí les dejamos un breve resumen de lo que pasó durante esos días, pensado especialmente para aquellos de ustedes que no pudieron asistir: # Día 1: ¡Pegatinas resistentes al agua para todos! ![IMG_9657.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xKxvXLX2WNfSJJTXN61rJn7hoViGpT4fMSMD32RAUShs8pqqK62oZDmA4LD3LaHMCLD.jpeg)|![IMG_0758.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23wC9iMVbV9SeWMetZM6WzNJWWUSVQkGHSinqPeJ6g1k2MHuQPztSpcV9apFHupDkbEPg.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_9822.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23vi62BL7bC2CspiLUmCFhtWsCieoLKsa9MvtCDhnMNk2R6rCdGUpcaT718b6g4ZWoWTk.jpeg)|![IMG_9846.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23u65K3zjk5PK99ybg9amYX9bKEtZySPJ3H78MACfscqG7CX6UXa97jdwYy6tSAiyJChH.jpeg)| ![IMG_9717.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23uFc5xsvmXgiAKvSX11N1eDBFDHn5MybfuzH8S6V2khLMCUuWegKNyKdqmigbdzMQqqa.jpeg) ---|---|--- Estuvimos presentes desde el primer día del #HODAlicante saludando y dando la bienvenida tanto a usuarios de Hive como a las personas externas al ecosistema que asistieron a las jornadas. Incluso para algunos Hivians era la primera vez que experimentaban un encuentro de este estilo, asi que #worldmappin estuvo allí representando a una de las comunidades mas grandes y activas de Hive que mas intenta involucrarse con sus usuarios y hacerse sentir cercana. Para este evento vinimos full de novedades, siendo una de ellas el reparto de cientos de pegatinas resistentes al agua del pin de #worldmappin, habiamos hecho algunas pruebas antes mostrando buenos resultados y ahora hemos traido esta version para todos, en dos tamaños, que es mucho mas resistente a la intemperie y le asegura mas longevidad a los usuarios que registran lugares en nuestro mapa reseñando sus visitas. El feedback fue increible, pues muchos usuarios manifestaron haber pensado en el aspecto de la durabilidad cuando dejaban la estampa de #worldmappin por el mundo, así que después de las presentaciones oficiales, nos fuimos junto a varios usuarios por la ciudad estampando el sello en varios lugares para hacer las pruebas correspondientes! # Día 2: Nueva versión y próximos objetivos ![IMG_0570.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2oVKKsbNoswCPk5Ex8ae79WH1LBwetA7a8K1AqafGEHYHhsQE5W1E7AGQ2kvi6JVT9.jpeg) El segundo día del evento estuvo dedicado a presentaciones oficiales sobre el ecosistema de Hive y nosotros tuvimos la gran responsabilidad de cerrar el evento, por lo que decidimos enfocarnos en dos aspectos principales, dar la bienvenida a los nuevos Hivians que crearon su nueva cuenta el día anterior del evento, presentandoles el proyecto como una herramienta util para su nuevo viaje dentro de Hive y, además, dedicamos gran parte del discurso a hacer un tour por todas las novedades en las que hemos estado trabajando ultimamente. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6I4M0ap6vA Mostramos todas las nuevas caracteristicas de la recien lanzada [WorldMappin V2](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@worldmappin/exciting-news-worldmappin-v2-is-live), la nueva cara del proyecto. Agradecimos a todos los usuarios que tanto nos han ayudado con su feedback, mostrando como hemos incluido a nuestra interfaz esos detalles y herramientas que tanto interesan a los usuarios, dejandoles saber que esto es solo el comienzo de la nueva etapa de #WorldMappin y que vamos a seguir trabajando en traer mejoras para todos. Asi que ya lo sabes, no dudes en apoyar nuestra propuesta ([Peakd.com](https://peakd.com/proposals/348) / [Ecency](https://ecency.com/proposals/348) / [Hive.blog](https://wallet.hive.blog/proposals/348) / [HiveSigner](https://hivesigner.com/sign/update_proposal_votes?proposal_ids=%5B%22348%22%5D&approve=true)) para ayudarnos a seguir trabajando en este proyecto tan bonito. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23vsb96t8FUyD4PHBgWGgVsiRcVRhGcysGhssvSeWsT3UdBacjsKqKNUsasCyuFsFzf2S.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23tvsFr9j1Xcf1cfv9XSXsZZjcidKUhBdEod6FjUYSV8qP1XmQTP2FhfcGtVGr3k3ghLn.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xpAnfLHxz3NWN1WkoszCo4niSbU1apobHUwiA6MTkWjZU4VJFbPvVTx3egajonM2JE4.jpeg) Otro aspecto en el que nos involucramos ese dia y celebramos junto al equipo de @mantequilla-soft fue poner en practica el uso de la maravillosa herramienta de traducción directa que nos trajo @tibfox al evento y a disposición de todos los oradores, para facilitar asi la comprensión de la información transmitida a pesar de no hablar el idioma. La aaplicación movil además permitía acceso a muchos mas idiomas para facilitar la traducción en vivo a cada usuario y, además, para que estos mantuvieran conversaciones particulares en distintos idiomas rompiendo esa barrera que a veces resulta tan molesta. Por nuestra parte @ninaeatshere hizo el test presentando nunestra charla en español, para facilitar la información a los nuevos usuarios españoles y, por supuesto, para honrar el lugar en donde estamos, pues sabemos que la comunidad hispanoablante es gran parte de nuestro ecosistema. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Ep5mHUbDd3Ezbng5Z5FvU8ro9ioGtm4PsfHu7H8L2pXczpxU3o8oZF8a6y24Rj63su3.jpeg)|![IMG_0599.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yTji5XrrfTaYmqBTuauKZD4hX89iGrhG24wRUXGgabw9E8v8EqtYMGmwVfpvKJsQaUT.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_0565.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23xAgVEX4cDLxh9tceSAKZcP8rvmELVWLuKGJAkTQcHCuWBCWEycyFoTuxUMdxPMf6DSt.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/242DdHTEeAUveRsP2jhbSGqUgN2MCSgcgYweSimVrZrswdEqT1ZJnJrytzAQ4RXx3AGWW.jpeg) # Día 3: ¡Patrocinando los premios del «Clean Planet Challenge»! ![IMG_0087.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23zS5cQx5t1QrU8aesdsJc4dobjET49MBVkLLTzwVZNWGqBPsbBMXgdzuRE28d2kWwoLC.jpeg) Como cada año, durante las #BuzzParty organizadas por @tibfox, se llevó a cabo el maravilloso reto #CleanPlanetChallenge y, por supuesto, estuvimos allí para recorrer juntos la isla en que este se llevo a cabo, anclar unos cuantos pines en los alrededores y además motivar a los participantes con unas mochilas llenas de Hive goodies para los ganadores del reto. Nuestro equipo estuvo presente en el reto, ayudando a limpiar la Isla de Tabarca pero sobre todo, motivando a los participantes a competir sanamente entre ellos. Ese día luego de que @ninaeatshere llevara nuestro pin a comer, el equipo se encargó de estar presente durante todo el reto para al final premiar a los que más se esforzaron esa tarde. El guardían de los premios fue @godfish, nuestro responsable de apoyo al Modelo de Negocio, quien mantuvo ojo avisor sobre cada involucrado y facilitó los pemios a la familia ganadora de ese día. Hicimos entrega de mochilas con regalitos a la familia de @gissse y @juanmatrader, dos de los nuevos usuarios que se involucraron totalmente en la experiencia Hive! ![IMG_0011.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Eoc8QckLcLNQCYJFG5eT1HmKrBND8PwapeoGr5V9SK7gtmZC2iSgdJBhkAMeG9gDig9.jpeg) ![IMG_0029.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoEtN2zHRJ11zVJ5s2Jv8j1r5MuV6wi38tiBPqh6hsVqqLpiyX7U8VAwNXr3fSmANqT.jpeg) ![IMG_0595.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yThC4RP9VMjYMWEQsS75TqvcoWbAoeJDsYnAEGfJSXZ2bctiwLe7Q66BDa75pPcECqH.jpeg)|![IMG_0117.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23y8zTpy6DdrCB1C66dLv9yLcaWbNop1QeY9nM5d7WD2brADsrcNYPpqw37QDSkHvRaUg.jpeg) --|-- ![IMG_0105.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23yd85xf1MTamt39PatWojHu7XVXU8PW8qGniSoHiUd8bBDA2tHiT8pJot6QJrSkeCqTS.jpeg) # Día 4: ¡Explora la ciudad resolviendo acertijos! ![IMG_0249.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Eoke1Pn2xPKfhG6DYsrhQueoi6MoTb1VvcjQBLMLSvmob8Q8dnmVkGpirywauFZFZrh.jpeg) Para nuestro último día presentes en el #HODAlicante quisimos llevar a los asistentes del evento a recorrer parte de la ciudad, adentranos en la cultura alicantina y motivarles a publicar su contenido viajero en la [comunidad de WorldMAppin](https://peakd.com/c/hive-163772/created). La intención del recorrido era visitar algunos lugares de interés en Alicante mientras @ninaeatshere iba cuestionando a nuestros queridos Hivians con algunos acertijos viajeros. Era el último día del evento y los asistentes estaban realmente agotados de los días anteriores, además había festividades locales en la ciudad que limitaban el horario y acceso a ciertos lugares, así que decidimos tomarnoslo con calma, reducir unpoco el itinerario y hacer preguntas muy sencillas para el reto. Nos encontramos en la entrada de Ulab, el centro de convenciones en el que se desarrollaron las charlas y nos dirigimos a visitar tres puntos cercanos:
**La Básilica de Santa María**
![IMG_0253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EprV5sqGSt9pYQYvNrFmVgBg5dxUBoLv3gkQopS7mPkqHTjCzmSjDmQYY3KzPP2Knrh.jpeg)
**El Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Alicante**
![IMG_0267.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EouBcgcUNP56YECZEydKKTsweNhz4bNfSnuwC7su4hr9p26tRrMwDx4J2Bz16BYx4qG.jpeg)
**Barrio de Santa Cruz**
![IMG_0303.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/Ep7s6UvvnDYqqizYxFMbxZaC6wSfQLfotftCJn1LKuVKvffB1Pi55HSQsc6thmgJ1nU.jpeg)
😃 **El Mirador de Santa Cruz está marcado con el pin de WorldMappin**
![IMG_0298.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23x1DBQZdwN3VBYtEa9VqiyJz98W9nEPwwjAJ1PxzqmZkPrMSKUnp4iKxm5nMnmB3JaUT.jpeg) Como el final de la caminata era a cuestas, nos detuvimos a descansar a las afueras de una de las pintorescas casitas del Barrio de Santa Cruz, en donde convenientemente se alojaba @godfish, el guardian de los premios, y nos dispusimos a compartir algunos snacks y hacer entrega de premios a los tres ganadores de los acertijos hechos por el camino. En esta oportunidad otra de los nuevos usuarios resultó ganadora @anamz se llevó una de nuestras mochilas llena de premios y la acompañaron los victoriosos @edje y @palomap3 por ser los más rápidos adivinando acertijos ese día. Aquí podemos ver una foto de la escena en la que allanamos la morada de @godfish para hacer la entrega de premio a los tres ganadores de esa jornada final. Algunos ganadores compartieron con entusiasmo el contenido de la famosa mochila, así que aquí tienen una muestra del contenido. En la mochila incluímos un par de camisetas, la del anterior HiveFest que patrocinamos y la bonita camiseta negra de nuestro equipo. Los ganadores tambien se llevaron una buena tanda de stickers de Hive, una botella de agua, una pequeña cartera **la billetera fria** y un par de sobres de **semillas de flores de verano**, una bonita iniciativa promocional con propósito real ( [accede aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@detlev/hive-merch-with-results-smart-seed-marketing) si te interesa conocer más sobre las **Semillas de Hive** o eres uno de los ganadores y quieres enterarte de como plantarlas) ![IMG_0282.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EoGyrB1vUGaXZCWmkedUj9MFSrBLt23FHxiitcm9quYrz3zd8QwnpW71dABNtuVdofq.jpeg) ![4e179531-2ae5-4ccf-a3f7-90d594b4477c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2eJgxLW3SpsJcUSkaaJRRLXnCuBUNpFgAwtUsQxEpXPDmD1iX9cdQ26cfeTs4HCyUb.jpeg)| ![77e48ea0-b9c8-4a07-af1c-6b36393790f5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/23w2ktvC2bvrftTrUvWbu4wXgUARuALsamMPYJFM6fCSrsxRhkThRSA88sAqX8vtuD4cR.jpeg) --|-- (Fotos de las ganadoras Ana y Paloma) El equipo de WorldMAppin está sumamente agradecido y orgulloso al poder participar en eventos como este, lleno de iniciativas que motiven a los usuarios de nuestro ecosistema a estar más presentes en la blockchain de distintas maneras. Nos complace decir que disfrutamos mucho de compartir esta experiencia una vez más junto a los organizadores del evento y todos los usuarios que asistieron a él, queremos que los usuarios delproyecto nos sientas cercanos y tengan la seguridad que puedan acudir al equipo ante cualquier, duda, sugerencia o aporte. Fue un gusto estar presentes en Alicante y ya no podemos esperar para verlos a todos nuevamente en el próximo [HiveFest XI – Barcelona, the Heart of Catalonia! 17-20 SEPT 2026](https://peakd.com/hive-106258/@hivefest/save-the-date-hivefest-xi-barcelona-the-heart-of-catalonia-17-20-sept-2026) hasta entonces viajeros! **-El equipo de WorldMappin** ![IMG_0525.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ninaeatshere/EpxqFqjZsep8TjMMivRoVu33HCzReFCLxkd8yybw3GS6RK1LnXfGb7AoLx9B9CZqbgu.jpeg) *Crédito de fotos: Agradecemos a @ninaeatshere, @gisse, @schmidi, @haastrecht, @palomap3 & @anamz por compartir las fotos que ilustran esta publicación.*

body.title: Las baldosas de mi casa
body.body:
Las baldosas de mi casa han visto tanto...
te vieron llegar y luego despidieron a tu sombra,
             sin el amor de la primera vez.
Han visto tanto.
Vieron mis llantos, 
            mis alegrías, 
                          al viento 
       soplar las velas de muchos aniversarios;
recibieron a mi abuela al caer
        consolaron a mi madre 
cuando sus piernas no soportaron su peso.
Las baldosas enfriaron mis calientes noches de verano.
Ahora las veo 
             recuerdo la primera vez que me contaron los secretos de la casa.
Hablaron de los abusos de mi padre, 
       la sansónica fuerza de mi madre 
             y de la bendita ignorancia de la infancia;
ellas, tan sabias por sus años,
hablan de la relatividad del tiempo, 
los amigos 
oportunidades perdidas, 
                          de la leche derramada y el llanto 
su ausencia.
Me hablan de días en que fuimos nuestra única compañía, 
          siempre a mi lado.
Mi madre no entiende que no quiera cambiar el piso de la casa.
Han cambiado muchas cosas, 
   lo sé 
                    ustedes ahora, 
Muchas cosas cambiaron
         cambiarán, 
pero las baldosas de mi casa
                            siempre han sido las mismas.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbupD7c9YfHpe2DSpYfkddxp1rmdtWQgDjUeuHWJFAnyF/1779092940097.jpg)

body.title: What is Magi Network? An Easy Solution for Liquidity Pools and Swaps
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 18, 2026, 01_14_40 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGVGDyKA5Zrv4kbsh4k52jfssTjM4R3Ldm8V9Q7dtE9Jcmcj4D6SfsHjXm8eJreHaBZ.png)

![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


What an amazing thing the Magi Network is! Hive users were eagerly waiting for this technology and now we can finally see it live. The Magi interface is very user  friendly allowing you to easily access every feature.

### What is Magi Network?

In my opinion Magi is a platform that provides a strong bridge between Hive and centralized exchanges. You can use it as a wallet, perform swaps and transfers, access BTC through cross chain functionality, invest in liquidity pools and even deploy your own token or project...

### What are the drawbacks of centralized exchanges?

Whether it is Solana or Ethereum chain, high gas fees are a common issue you always have to pay them. Moving assets from one blockchain to another is also difficult and during this process there are security risks involved.

Often, users receive wrapped Bitcoin but in Magi you receive real Bitcoin directly in your wallet.

### How does Magi solve these problems?

Magi removes many of these risks. You can make transfers in just a few simple steps without using any centralized exchange.

You can either deposit into the Magi network or send assets to any address. For example if you want to transfer from Binance to KuCoin you can also do it through Magi using the proper address.

### HBD usage and benefit

Previously HBD was limited only within the Hive ecosystem but now Magi has made everything easier. Every transfer uses HBD which increases its liquidity. You can easily swap HBD and HIVE which is a big advantage for Hive users.

### My favorite feature in Magi Network

Hive deposits have zero fees while other Hive exchanges usually charge fees. Here you can deposit and withdraw Hive with zero charges (as shown in screenshots).

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 114939.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tkfzmSmhsM5kgYT5opN7MVjPHvPAtivBQSPxzEkrS4PC2LUeZ5k5MwUFUqu71pZQvzH.png)
**Go to the Hive mainnet deposit section and enter the amount of HIVE you want to deposit.**
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 114949.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/48J87CD9jJwVzJuPDMFHV76jqrNWbTC2cJVDpYtQWa5A41R3iLS6CiQeQvmWXLcZFH.png)
**Check the fee section — no fee will be charged. You will receive it instantly through the swap.**
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 115008.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23ywyUzNpioUQjZHBdb5hSkHm34cDcjUwL4PHgJUw2itF819FmSGpP4fhQnL44wLMXzaQ.png)
**Proceed with the transaction through Hive Keychain.**
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 115104.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EoEhsBQQq3G7vfiT795aowceJ2qLwJSW62USJQ8UmFCkesiSrDjdNUM3b9WrMJ1FcXk.png)
**Deposit Done**
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)



Honestly it feels like Magi is not just Magi but magic. And this is just the beginning there are many more features coming. Now there is no worry about fees you can deposit and withdraw Hive freely.

### Best features overall

All features are strong but especially:

1. Excellent transfer options
2. Cross-chain swap feature
3. Liquidity pool investment
4. Easy token deployment

### My personal experience (What featured I like)

Among all of these I personally liked the cross-chain swap and liquidity pool features the most and I will also try them practically and share my experience.


#### STEP BY STEP PROCESS
![Screenshot 2026-05-18 115411.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGTZ146ko2c5eXgUmW2bNfDynAUoSRgwxhDcv7gpMRJX5ZjRTzDnEY3oR2oQp9UWrqh.png)

![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

I tried converting Hive to HBD. I converted around 120 Hive and received almost 7 HBD. I also checked the same amount on Binance and there I was getting slightly less (around 6.9 HBD). This shows there are no hidden charges here.. you receive almost exact real value.

Only about 0.02 protocol fee is charged for such swaps which I think is very low and reasonable. I would highly recommend it.

### Liquidity Pool feature

Another feature I really liked is liquidity pools. Earlier I used to do this on Tribaldex but now it has become much easier with Magi Network. Very clear to see in the dashboard (not complicated)

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 120431.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGTdoskEVXKsBwZkVyt5maQcM1G9W7sZVE4npEU7V5TfpM7EPxjnLKuVG1vH9LKCrxc.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

![Screenshot 2026-05-18 120410.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23t76kWZjDFFd2xoXpEwg7q4fVdb23iVmqJLSQKTg7fXBRbKTp1iVrQYotpKw2ES1CZf5.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

#### What are liquidity pools?

If you are a long term investor this is best for you. You provide liquidity by locking Hive and HBD into a pool allowing other users to trade.

In the long term Hive price is expected to grow so your wealth can also increase. On top of that you earn from every transaction. The estimated APR is around 15–21% which is considered a strong return.

### Final thoughts and suggesstions for you

We all want the Hive community to grow and Magi Network can play a major role in that. So why not support it? Vote for its proposals, support it and use Magi Network to take advantage of its features.

https://peakd.com/me/proposals/378

Also this is my entry to the contest @magi.network 

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![jG9yratYVyyywmeS_3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/jG9yratYVyyywmeS_3/jG9yratYVyyywmeS_3.webp)
![C0syqFIYWR35uw8M_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/C0syqFIYWR35uw8M_2/C0syqFIYWR35uw8M_2.webp)
![KSoI8fLKGbdoxvvu_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/KSoI8fLKGbdoxvvu_4/KSoI8fLKGbdoxvvu_4.webp)
![HEoilisA3rLy3f7p_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/HEoilisA3rLy3f7p_1/HEoilisA3rLy3f7p_1.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

新的一周来了哈，周一愉快，朋友们，话说这本地的气温也逐渐上升了，不过也还算是凉爽，夏装肯定是穿上了，至少低温天气应该不会再来了，除非有什么特殊天气情况。。

看到热搜了，张雪机车又又又获得冠军了，真是好样的哈哈，这都第五个冠军了吧，就当当机车手德比斯他就拿了四个冠军，看到赛后采访，这丫达那个开心的皱纹都笑出来了，只能说张雪机车牛皮，当然法国这名赛车手车技也很在线，你有技术，搭配上张雪机车，就是强强联合，你不拿冠军，谁拿冠军，，当然，也有不少人酸的，还说是昙花一现，可这都昙花五现了都。。打脸不。。

话说，根据积分版来看，目前张雪机车总积分在排行榜第三名，咋就说，说不定这昙花能一直开到总冠军呢，一些皆有可能嘛。

比赛视频我也看了，过程可是相当刺激啊，我最喜欢的就是一开始张雪机车是落后的情况下，后续弯道超市，最牛的就是直线生吃雅马哈，甚至有一场比赛是背后跟着四辆雅马哈，就是追不上张雪机车的车速，如果说弯道超车是看赛车手的技术，那么直线爆拉全场那么就是张雪机车本身的性能最优了。。恭喜张雪机场，希望后续比赛再创佳绩，争取获得WSBK总冠军。。哈哈。

午餐，是在允允汤咖喱吃的，也是好姐妹推荐来这家汤咖喱餐厅，店面虽然不大，却是小而美的精致风格，来这里用餐的人还真不少啊，我已经是避开用餐高峰期了，点了一份招牌汤咖喱套餐，对于不怎么吃咖喱的我来说，也算是一次新的尝试，吃货本尊在此，美味咖喱快入我口，哈哈。。

你们吃汤咖喱喜欢米饭搅拌所有食材混搭一起吃呢，还是喜欢白米饭一口，然后，汤咖喱肉一口这样分开吃？我呢，之前吃咖喱肯定是各种混搭，搅拌，看起来就是那一坨又一坨，当然，即便是那样折腾，口感也是尚可的，但，这一次，我两种方式都尝试，各有美味，后者更能品出食材本身的口感，整个来说，都OK，下次再来要试试手枪鸡腿汤咖喱，还有其他小食。。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周一愉快，愉快一周。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

body.title: A plena vista | Poesía [ES/EN]
body.body: >Roxana Peña Olmo Sostuvo la mirada cuando pidió el café. Lleva una camisa a cuadros con los primeros botones abiertos al descuido. Sus ojos muestran el reflejo de una emperatriz que intenta ocultarse a plena vista. Bebe un sorbo, mueve el cuerpo al compás de la música y pide un cigarro. La camarera coloca en el cenicero el cigarro con el filtro al revés; ella lo toma en sus manos sin darle vuelta. Sus piernas, a tono con el delineado de sus ojos, la nariz, la comisura de sus labios y el color de su voz, contrastan con su camisa a cuadros. La camisa, no es importante. La blasfemia, está en que tú y yo nunca jugamos al parchees ni al ajedrez.

body.body:

Józef Czajkowski, Kościół zimą, ok. 1900 (?)

Czym zasłużył Józef Czajkowski na krytykę, z jaką spotkało się jego malarstwo w październikowym numerze „Przeglądu Powszechnego” z pażdziernika 1917 roku trudno zgadnąć. Rzeczywiście czasem tematami jego obrazów bywały cmentarze, ale trudno w nich dopatrzeć się dziś skrajnie pesymistycznego nastroju, o jaki został oskarżony.

>Józef Czajkowski jest malarzem nastrojonym na ton minorowy. Wszystkie jego pejzaże przepojone są beznadziejnym smutkiem. Artysta czuje się tak dobrze w tym środowisku, że nawet jeżeli kiedy umieści promień słońca w swoich widokach, to i promień ten nie świeci wcale wesoło.

Czy takie sądy mogły sprawić, że ostatecznie porzucił malarstwo  i skoncentrował się na sztuce zdobniczej i projektowaniu mebli? Nie wydaje mi się, żeby ktokolwiek twierdził, że jego meble są „beznadziejnie smutne”.


![kir.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/helcim/23zS11SB7Z8fA9UAY2gHyj5hbrT4gUpBVrneDBSGF9NvRsigX6bWmLNdVyvx8YcNLfDTd.jpg)

body.title: Home gardening after two weeks of continuous rain.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5JiFJXBr5DGrwnobfc44z2uznx1VsyckLKWVRumAmFp/1779085230870.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. Today the weather is finally clearing up after two weeks of continuous rain. Even though the fruits and vegetables are growing nicely, the home garden is still full of weeds and long grass. And today is the first day of the new semester for my granddaughter too. And my autistic son's school started two weeks ago. My wife and I no longer have childcare responsibilities, allowing us more leisure time. After my wife and I took our granddaughter and autistic son to school, we planned to take care of the home garden. We start by removing the grass and weeds with the hoes. The grass and weeds are quite overgrown and it takes a long time to remove them with the hoes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeeoexsBpQH5MuCir1sAm3peA6p6GNWea2RjFeMgAjXAq/1779085231062.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5JiFJXBr5DGrwnobfc44z2uznx1VsyckLKWVRumAmFp/1779085230870.jpg)

And we also prune the plants along with removing weeds and grass. Especially pea eggplant, The pea eggplant plant has gotten too bushy. There are two of them in our home garden. And they are rather difficult to prune due to their thorns. So I took on the task of pruning the two pea eggplant trees all by myself, while my wife continued removing the grass and weeds in the garden. Besides pruning the pea eggplant plants, I also gather the pea eggplants in plastic bags to use for cooking on other days. I got two plastic bags full of pea eggplants this time.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmetFskg386UQsLN26J8qxeM5uKuPof8bpfskNKz8QNfCn/1779085231198.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdMWnAT8StQ4NoGqcJtskC1b86t6M6VmV45DNXeLhGq8B/1779085231312.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYPoZDpG4XWfTK2niBEucxkBTXMiz3Zs1hviBHpqTWpnV/1779086500051.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT9ME7unZpNiHqPe13LMSq2wtCgsg7qz7XJ5tKRQ8YYFa/1779086500165.jpg)

Finally we trimmed back the veggies and weeds growing along the fence, Although it was looking a bit overgrown, But it took us quite a long time.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQou5PKSp5aVxPj2VjwtDKrrPPcbtFNnwVcrNthSJZ379/1779086500290.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1AEb3BPmveKGhrwY8PPF2gGoGWkdJzFeeMTCvxXzp5A/1779086500414.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbevew9QLZCfAU3wrxtXNqktGBQ9aJyABAVvasjzpNUZ1/1779086500584.jpg)

We was very exhausted this morning, so I took just a few photos and the wife doesn't cook. But our gardening isn't finished yet, and we'll do it another day. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

body.title: Comenzando la semana con pastaºººººStarting the week with pasta
body.body:
Hola a todos los que componen esta maravillosa plataforma social, en lo personal me siento excelente luego de hbaer pasado un hermozo fin de semana y la verdad comenzar la seamana o sea lunes degustando pastas, la verdad es muy bueno, porque bien sabemos que consumir carbohidratos es muy saludable para nuestro horganismo, asi que al tratarse de fideos espaguetis, con una salsa de tomates naturales, a la que le agregue crema de lecha convirtiendola en salsa rosa, dandole de esa manera un sabor mucho mejor.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tSaRvZs8TofBzpvGnAgm9GVMQceo9dN4hRBhMmphB39YCFTna39vcqTwxvwfirgLx2c.png)

Como bien les comente amigos referente a la salsa, la cual para cocinarla, agregue la holla en la hornalla luego le verti un poco de aceite, luego cebolla cortada en trozos pequeños, sal a gusto, una pisca de pimienta y la mejor parte agregue en la licuadora tomates bien maduros, luego agregue todo junto, una ves de haberle dado una copcion, le agregue la crema de lecha, para lo cual todo salio muy sabroso.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wX3ghgzNDzw8r6spYg9fQQrMcWARYTTRt2ebDq7psGGDWsfH7ymjcso2sJVrVH2saYm.png)

Asi qu luego de haber cocinado el fideo, para lo cual agregue una olla con agua en la hornalla de la cocina, le agregue sal a gusto y luego el fideo antes mencionado, para eso a medida que lo agregaba en la olla, lo revolvia muy despacio para que no se formaran grumos, para despues una ves cocinado le quite el agua y lo agregue en una fuente con un poco de salsa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wMYfCtEQrvpWN32nKgDiXimDXZQwBZrGpm41a6JvF7G5Dei1JiYgqs4QBWhQUsKXzka.png)

Como pueden ver el detalle, esta ves solamente salsa y fideo y nada de carne, bueno como les comente es para tener un comienzo diferente de semana jajaja.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN UN BUEN DIA.

ENGLISH

Hello to everyone on this wonderful social platform. Personally, I feel great after having had a wonderful weekend, and honestly, starting the week—that is, Monday—by enjoying pasta is really great, because as we all know, eating carbohydrates is very healthy for our bodies, so when it comes to spaghetti noodles with a fresh tomato sauce, to which I added milk cream to turn it into a pink sauce, giving it a much better flavor.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tSaRvZs8TofBzpvGnAgm9GVMQceo9dN4hRBhMmphB39YCFTna39vcqTwxvwfirgLx2c.png)

As I mentioned earlier, friends, regarding the sauce: to make it, place the pan on the stove, then pour in a little oil, then add the finely chopped onion, salt to taste, a pinch of pepper, and the best part: put some very ripe tomatoes in the blender, then add everything together. Once it’s blended, add the cream, and the result was very tasty.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23wX3ghgzNDzw8r6spYg9fQQrMcWARYTTRt2ebDq7psGGDWsfH7ymjcso2sJVrVH2saYm.png)

So, after cooking the noodles—for which I put a pot of water on the stove, added salt to taste, and then added the noodles—I stirred them very gently as I added them to the pot to prevent lumps from forming. Once they were cooked, I drained the water and transferred them to a serving dish with a little sauce.

body.title: Висадила огірочки
body.body:
![IMG_20260515_194708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23xp6QCnmTQ9s1MEBzqQSU5TfG6h4MCBekb1whTTwgqbLgJo3pTLRKHJprorucf4JLfXd.jpg)

Привіт, друзі! Через насичену роботу останні кілька днів були доволі виснажливими. У суботу в нас виникли проблеми з водою, тож я допомагала чоловікові витягувати насос і розбиратися, що ж там сталося. А неділю ми вирішили зробити максимально спокійною та відпочинковою, бо вже просто заколупалися від постійної метушні. Хотілося провести час із родиною й трохи перепочити, тому навіть не було бажання писати дописи.

Але все ж хочу розповісти про огірочки, які я висадила ще в п’ятницю.

Розсада в мене вже була підготовлена заздалегідь — я вирощувала огірки в пластикових стаканчиках від сметани та йогуртів. Уже другий рік користуюся таким методом, і мені він подобається. Потім просто висаджую готову розсаду в ґрунт.

Парничок у нас простенький — дуги з поліпропіленових труб і накриття з агротканини. Мені подобається саме тканина, бо вона пропускає воду й водночас створює доволі стабільні умови для росту: трохи тримає тепло й захищає від перепадів температури.

Огірки я посадила у два рядки. Хоч місця наче й багато, але сам парничок невеликий, тому, як і минулого року, довелося викручуватися саме так.

Зараз найбільша проблема — це волога. Земля надзвичайно суха, і доводиться практично все постійно поливати. Саме тому наші проблеми з водою зараз особливо критичні, бо без поливу хороший урожай отримати буде дуже важко.

Добре, що поки вдалося зробити хоча б тимчасове рішення і вода є. Але я розумію, що проблему треба буде доводити до пуття, бо в будь-який момент усе може знову зламатися.

А огірочки тим часом ростимуть — сподіваюся, парничок додасть їм трохи тепла. Бо надворі зараз доволі прохолодно: лише близько +20, сонця майже немає. Ця весна загалом якась несприятлива для рослин — ні нормального тепла, ні достатньо дощів. ((

Та все ж сподіваємося, що хоч якийсь урожай буде.

body.title: In need of some green =/= Wir brauchen mehr Grün - Kyoto Impressions 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_5155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoK3xMV9eviwbBjQBWc915HpvJMmjG4rmh7Fawo9HfGaVvRhhay8TWF8k4msnYhwNtb.jpg) Every time I browse through my hard drives and look at my pictures, I am amazed at how many photos I have taken over the years. And since I am constantly adding new ones, I unfortunately don't have enough time to look back at everything I have captured in the past. But it feels so good to linger a little in your own history and indulge in those warm, sentimental feelings. And that's exactly why today I'm sharing three pictures that I took quite a long time ago. All three were taken in Kyoto during the height of summer. But despite the hot temperatures on that day, they have a calming and refreshing effect. It's probably the color green, which clearly dominates all three pictures, that creates this wonderful effect and prompted me to post these photos here today. And even though I can't remember the exact place and time, it immediately brings back warm memories to my mind and heart. Memories of my first trips and experiences here in the Land of the Rising Sun, when everything was still new and exciting, and I couldn't stop marveling. That time may be gone, but every now and then, that very feeling comes back. And that's exactly what I intend when I look through my collection of pictures and embark on a little journey through time. It just feels good, and that's why I'll expose myself to this great feeling again and again. And every now and then, I'll share one or two pictures with you here at this place... ![IMG_5146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EopqXQVPkN6BFZ4M4ue6guX7u4EPwboNAKTc1KAqBwTn9BSWLywdLkQvMH7h2qCjSYp.jpg) DEUTSCH Jedes Mal, wenn ich durch meine Festplatten forste und mir meine Bilder anschaue, staune ich, wie viele Fotos ich im Laufe der Jahre bereits gemacht habe. Und da natürlich auch immer wieder neue dazu kommen, habe ich dann leider einfach nicht genug Zeit, um mir all das, was ich früher einmal festgehalten habe, noch einmal anzusehen. Dabei tut es doch so gut, ein wenig in der eigenen Vergangenheit zu weilen und sich diesem warmen, sentimalen Gefühlen hinzugeben. Und genau aus diesem Grund gibt es heute drei Bilder, die ich vor ziemlich langer Zeit gemacht habe. Alle drei stammen aus Kyoto und wurden im Hochsimmer gemacht. Aber trotz der heißen Temperaturen an jenem Tag wirken sie ruhig und erfrischen. Es ist wohl die in allen drei Bildern dominierende Farbe Grün, welche diese wunderbare Wirkung erzeugt, die mich dazu gebracht hat, diese Fotos hier heute zu zeigen. Und auch wenn ich mich nicht ganz genau an Ort und Zeitpunkt erinnern kann, kommen doch auch sofort warme Erinnerungen zurück in meinen Kopf und auch in mein Herz. Erinnerungen an erste Reisen und Erfahrungen hier im Land der aufgehenden Sonne, als alles noch neu und aufregend war, und ich vor Staunen meinen Mund nicht mehr geschlossen bekam. Diese Zeit mag vergangen sein, aber ab und zu kommt eben genau dieses Gefühl dann doch wieder zurück. Und genau das beabsichtige ich ja auch, wenn ich durch meine Bildersammlung schaue und mich dabei auf eine kleine Zeitreise begebe. Es tut einfach gut, und deshalb werde ich mich diesem tollen Gefühl auch immer wieder aussetzen. Und dann ab und zu das eine oder andere Bild hier mit euch teilen... ![IMG_5148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoEjFG3fK6wEcfhfsEiJbMaKbGKRfmUqucBg5gapBch9cqZa77AAjg1G7zvb4BAG4uQ.jpg) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

昨天是娃12周岁生日，这次生日是娃自己安排的，包括日程活动和请客吃饭，由他自己一人完成，他提前半个月就开始考虑他生日该怎么过了，大概也是参考之前参加的同学生日会，所以他目标很明确。

安排好了以后，到上周也只是通知我一声，这也好，省得我考虑这考虑那，只要我出钱就行，最省事儿。12岁，一个周年，是应该好好庆祝一下，那就随他吧，他开心最重要。

他的安排是生日当天早起，然后把小区里邀请的同学都走一遍，我们一起到印象城吃饭，小区以外被邀请的同学则是自行到店，吃饭的大概有七个，包含了小学同学和初中同学。

接着吃完饭就在印象城完switch，按时间计时，开两台机器，大概有五位同学，因为是对战的，所以可以轮流玩。最后再到家里打游戏，当然都是自带设备，最后再吃蛋糕。

我娃要去新发现吃，他爸给他订餐厅，这人有点蠢，万达也有这家店，然后他打电话订的是万达的，不是印象城，还好我们出发的早，所以去印象城还有位子，但是印象城没有包间，这点不如万达，吃到一半万达那边还打电话来询问还去不去。印象城唯一不好就是没有大桌没有包间，十来个人全挤在角落，我们点的菜桌子都放不下。

都是孩子，特别热闹，一桌子菜，他们吃饭真的好利索，不像成人吃完还得聊天聊一会儿，或者边吃边聊，他们吃饭十分钟搞定。因为有一位同学中午有课外班，吃饭的时间点到了他还没下课，以至于我们一直等，等了差不多四十分钟，所以等那位同学到了的时候他们应该也是饿了，吃的特别快。

吃完他们去玩switch，他爸爸在那陪着，我回家去休息会，然后准备点水果小吃等他们玩好回到家里来。现在看来一切都很太平，再寻常不过地进行着生日节目，但是后来却变得曲折起来。

明天再分享接下来的事，一两句都说不清，我千算万算没算到娃生日当天我会报警找儿子。

*Not every obstacle we face is a punishment; some are just a lessons for us. At times yiur pain can  generate strength, and postponement can build patience.*

>What seems insurmountable now could become a monument tomorrow. 

*Don't let anything to define your future. Stay strong, be patient, have faith and keep moving forward.*

*Not all seems what it is. The most difficult periods sometimes hide the greatest gifts. Though life seems to appears unpredictable, always trust the process  even  when the road is rough just keep moving.* Shalom*

*Thank you for your time*

body.title: Fortuitous and unexpected / Fortuito e inesperado (eng-esp)
body.body:
Greetings, fellow photography enthusiasts.

Sometimes nature surprises us with the most vibrant and unexpected colors imaginable, compelling us to take out our cameras and snap a picture.
That's what happened to me with this tree, completely in bloom, with more flowers than leaves, in fact; right next to another, of the same species, but the complete opposite.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbju62b2g2mN9Ccg4vKGZkC2U8wUeZS2Xvz49hchJDL4o/1779090728491.jpg)

What had caught my eye was the color and scent of the flowers. However, when I took the photo, I noticed a fortuitous and curious detail: the utility pole is positioned in such a way that it seems to divide the flowering tree from the other. How curious, right?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbMCDWx2btAGCqFCAL46ZNvEB6vpfwk7piDqpNcHaYnoK/1779090728164.jpg)

***
**Leer en español**
***

Saludos, estimados, amantes de la fotografía.

Hay veces que la naturaleza nos sorprende con los colores más vivos e inesperados que podemos imaginarnos y nos obliga a sacar la cámara y tomar una foto.
Eso me sucedió con este árbol, completamente florecido, con más flores que hojas, de hecho; justo al lado de otro, de la misma especie, pero completamente lo opuesto. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbju62b2g2mN9Ccg4vKGZkC2U8wUeZS2Xvz49hchJDL4o/1779090728491.jpg)

Lo que me había llamado era el color y el olor de las flores. Sin embargo, al tomar la foto, me percaté de un hecho fortuito y curioso: el poste de la electricidad, está en tal sitio, que parece que divide al árbol florido del otro. ¿Qué curioso, verdad?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbMCDWx2btAGCqFCAL46ZNvEB6vpfwk7piDqpNcHaYnoK/1779090728164.jpg)

body.title: I was not expecting this much rain...
body.body:
Gosh, it's wet!

Today I only managed to get 6,000 steps because it rained and rained and rained some more.

I did sneak in a brief walk this morning. I'd watch the rain radar like a hawk and picked a 20 minute window that had *light* rain instead of bucketloads. But it already looked like this in the bush...

This is where I had planned to walk, but the creek had flooded the wide path 👇


![1000014606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/consciouscat/EopsziFpNGJZGhLZZC6b96T8FLempJuydv8bS2GmGdTeeZ7mitnEkVH2sLB9eNfv53j.jpg)

So I double backed and took a narrow track. It was a temporary creek rather than a 'track' 👇


![1000014606.jpg](1)![1000014607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/consciouscat/23vhwaQ3C2aRg4HRRYt4RNYH6igrC6XRTAxaPXq2shftnxJTfyPdRUybiTHbTU71Hc3Bp.jpg)

This is the concrete driveway to get out of the bush. I can't remember every seeing it flooded this far across 👇

![1000014608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/consciouscat/EoAag8zn9XyUwUeyG8gg51e3LthJEBCbiL3FG2RspWfGg19Kqgpy8bSq4vDimL2JRb6.jpg)

This is the storm water drain from the road. I don't remember ever seeing it that high either 👇

![1000014609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/consciouscat/Eo8SH9mTVpMn63yyVMsQ3rjGGbeTU5T71DRQfzFRTyNgHkBDfgHvKDWEYmvZpMCPkcB.jpg)

Still, I was delighted to have got in a walk and got home before the next massive shower it. And the nicest surprise? Seeing a pair of King Parrots feeding in the trees in our front yard 👇

![1000014611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/consciouscat/EoXtd5iew28hhFkwqGY4JUenrMjBsiiZM3SRZLdJ3H8kQcxuMcx46A6YMGHsjWtZ6HG.jpg)

The rain must not have bothered me too much as I sat in a deep squat for several minutes simply admiring them, delighted to see a species of bird I rarely ever see.

### If you had a challenging day, what was one great thing that happened in amongst the craziness?

baby.

ဒီနေ့ နားဆင်ဖြစ်ခဲ့တဲ့ သီချင်းက အဆိုတော် ရင်ဂို သီဆိုထားသော \

ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။
တစ်ကယ်တော့ အားလုံးကို ရေစုန် မျှောပစ်လိုက်တာ မကောင်းပါဘူး။
ကောင်းသောအရာတွေကို လက်ခံထားပြီး မကောင်းသောအရာတွေကို စွန့်လွှတ်ပစ်နိုင်ရပါမယ်။
သီချင်းစာသားများကို ခြုံငုံလေ့လာကြည့်လျှင်တော့ မကောင်းခဲ့သော ချစ်သူနှင့်ဆက်ဆံရေး ခံစားချက်များ အားလုံးကို ရေစုန်မှာ မျှောကာ စွန့်ပစ်လိုက်ခြင်းပါပဲ။

ဒီသီချင်းကို ကျွန်တော် အခြေခံပညာအထက်တန်းကျောင်းပြီး တက္ကသိုလ် တက်ရောက်ရတော့မည့် အချိန်ကာလတုန်းကတည်းက နားဆင်ဖြစ်ခဲ့တာပါ။
အချစ်ရေး အဆင်မပြေတဲ့ ခံစားချက်များ ဖြစ်ပေမယ့် ဝေဒနာကို ခံစားမနေဘူး ဆိုတဲ့ စိတ်ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ဖြင့် သီချင်းကို မြူးမြူးလေး သီဆိုထားတာပါ။
ဒီတော့ ကျွန်တော်လည်း ဒီသီချင်းစာသားတွေကို သီဆို အော်ဟစ်ခဲ့ဖူးတာပါပဲ။

ရင်ခုန်သံတွေ မချိုခဲ့သော အတိတ်က ဇာတ်လမ်းတစ်ပုဒ်၊
မဖြစ်နိုင်ခဲ့တဲ့ ဘဝလေးနှစ်ခု အခြေအနေ‌တွေ ခြားခဲ့ပြီ။
အသစ်ရှာဖွေခဲ့သော ရင်ခွင်မှာ ဆွေးမနေတော့ဘူး။
အားလုံး ရေစုန်မျှောလိုက်ပြီ။
ကြည်ပြာရောင်နဲ့ နှလုံးသား ၊
ငါ့အချစ်စိတ်များ အားလုံး ၊
လရောင်ကင်းမဲ့ ညလေးတစ်ခု ၊
မင်းဆီ အကုန် ငါထားခဲ့မယ်။
အဝေးဆုံးဘဝရဲ့ အလွမ်းမော ကိုယ့်ဘဝမှာ မလိုတော့ဘူး။
အားလုံး ရေစုန်မျှောလိုက်ပြီ။
ကဗျာစာပေမဂ္ဂဇင်း သီချင်းများမှာ ရင်ခုန်တယ်။
စကားလုံးများ အသစ်အဆန်းဖွေရှာ 
ဂန္ထဝင်ဆန် ရည်းစားစာ၊
မင်းတစ်ယောက်ကို အချစ်ဆုံး ယုံကြည်ပါ။
ကိုယ့်ဘဝမှာ မလိုတော့ဘူး။
အားလုံး ရေစုန်မျှောလိုက်ပြီ။
အို မိုင်ဒါလင် ဒီလို နှုတ်ဆက်

body.title: Parteienlandschaft: Initiative fordert Gründungsverbot
body.body:
>Eine Petition fordert, an die Zeit nach dem AfD-Verbot zu denken und Parteineugründungen generell zu untersagen.


Der Verfassungsschutz hat die

>gesamte AfD als gesichert rechtsextremistisch eingestuft, die Partei geht dagegen juristisch vor. Die Einstufung befeuert die ohnehin geführte Debatte um ein AfD-Verbotsverfahren weiter - das Risiko ist hoch, denn was geschähe, gelänge es, das Bundesverfassungsgericht zu überzeugen? Die AfD wäre weiter eine Gefahr für unsere Demokratie, denn ihre Wähler und Wählerinnen würden ja nicht gleichfalls verboten. Zwar würde die Neugründung einer AfD 2.0 mit gleichem Personal und ähnlichen Inhalten vorsorglich mit untersagt.

>Wiederbetätigung verbieten 

Niemand aber könnte Sympathisanten und Hinterbänkler aus der zweiten Reihe davon abhalten, eine Auffangorganisation als Sammelbecken für die Anhänger der bereits Anfang des Jahres schon einmal vorübergehend vom Verfassungsschutz als gesichert rechtsextremistisch eingestuften Partei zu gründen.

>Diese Einstufung wird aktuell auf Antrag der AfD gerichtlich überprüft. Siegt der Rechtsstaat, muss er den nächsten Schritt gehen. Spätestens jetzt muss aber auch an die Zeit danach gedacht werden. Schlägt das Parteiverbot – das schärfste Schwert der wehrhaften Demokratie - dem organisierten Rechtsextremismus den Kopf ab, darf es nicht zu einer Wiederbetätigung der AfD-Kader in einer Nachfolgeorganisation kommen.

Für ein Verbot der Wiederbetätigung unter einem unverfänglichen Namen wie Gärtnerpartei, Die Richtigen oder Soziale Syndikalisten wäre es dann zu spät.  Die Täter würde sich zweifellos darauf berufen, dass die Gründung von Parteien ist in Deutschland nach Art. 21 Abs. 1 Satz 2 des Grundgesetzes frei ist und keiner staatlichen Genehmigung bedarf. Sie dürften sicherlich auf eine große und wütende Basis hoffen, die jede Nachfolgepartei aus Trotz wählen würde.

(FoS) aus Sachsen fordert deshalb ein rechtzeitiges Vorbeugen, um späteren Jammer über fehlende Heilungschancen zu verhindern. In einem offenen Brief an Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz erbittet FoS-Chefin Sabrina Kabur die Aufmerksamkeit der demokratischen Mitte für die bisher wenig bekannte Problematik: Noch vor dem Versuch, die AfD zu verbieten, müssten die Erfolgschancen eines generellen Verbotes zur Gründung neuer Parteien geprüft werden. 

Die Organisation aus dem ländlichen Raum im Erzgebirge hat gute Argumente auf ihrer Seite. Es gebe ohnehin ausreichend politische Angebote aller Colour.  Seit 2017 hat die Fragmentierung im Bundestag auf beunruhigende Weise zugenommen: Von 69 auf 83 Mandate für Drittparteien 2021. Das behindere Koalitionen und untergrabe die Stabilität – siehe Ampel-Zerfall 2024 oder ostdeutsche Landtage, wo AfD und  BSW gemeinsam demokratische Mehrheiten verhindern. Weitere Neubildungen brächten für unsere Demokratie keinen Mehrwert.

Nur so könne auf lange Sicht sichergestellt werden, dass nicht eine neue AfD entstehe, die erneut die Unzufriedenen, Ultrakonservativen und Friedensgegner sammle und deren Stimmen nutze, um die traditionelle Durchregierbarkeit in Koalitionen mit nur zwei oder drei Partnern unmöglich zu machen. \

Für die Wirtschaft sei die daraus resultierende Instabilität lähmend.  

\

, sagt Sabrina Kabur. Aber auch das laut Grundgesetz dazu ermächtigte Bundesverfassungsgericht könne nicht jedes Jahr entsprechend tätig werden. Daher sei eine generelle Neugestaltung des Grundrechts unumgänglich: Um eine AfD 2.0 zu verhindern, die einen neuen Anlauf unternimmt, unsere Demokratie zu untergraben und gegen unsere Verfassung zu handeln, müssten sich die demokratischen Institutionen wehren, so lange noch Zeit sei.
, beschreibt Kabur. Damals sei das Gefährdungspotenzial der Blauen unterschätzt worden. \

Ein Szenario, das sich beim nächsten Mal wiederholen könnte, wenn nicht rechtzeitig die Notbremse gezogen wird. Ein Schaden entstehe nicht, denn bundesweit gebe es mit mehr als 40 Parteien ein ausrecihend großes Spektrum für jeden Geschmack. Auch im Bundestag sitzen heute zwei Parteien mehr als in den 80er Jahren. Nach 1990 sei die Zahl der Neugründungen, die über den Nischenstatus hinauskomme, geradezu explodiert: Die SED zog als PDS ein, die AfD folgte, das BSW scheiterte nur knapp.

>Zurück zum Standardmodell 

Das Standardmodell der bundesdeutschen Demokratie umfasse heute acht Parteien. Niemand unter den Wählerinnen und Wähler verstehe doch noch, wozu es die alle brauche. \

, erinnert Karbur – nur drei maßgebliche Kräfte, was stabile Koalitionen ermöglichte. 

Weniger ist mehr, eine Bündelung von Themen und Entscheidungsangeboten mache es den Wählern leichter, sich zu entscheiden, ist Sabrina Karbur überzeugt. Ein anerkanntes Werkzeug der wehrhaften Demokratie sei das Parteienverbot, das aber nur sehr selten angewandt werde und dann jedes Mal über Jahre große Aufregung verursache. Statt das Risko einzugehen, dass sich immer wieder Parteien gründen, die bestrebt sind, die Demokratie abzuschaffen, sei es demokratisch sauberer, Parteiengründungen überhaupt zu untersagen, um der wehrhaften Demokratie die dauernden  Zerreißproben zu ersparen.

>Ende eines leidigen Streit 

Dass dazu das Grundgesetz angefasst werden müsse, halten die sächsischen Demokratieaktivisten nicht für ein Hindernis. \

Mit einem Schlag wäre damit der leidige Streit zwischen den Mitte-Parteien SPD, Grüne, Linke und Union beendet, die sich bisher nicht darauf einigen können, ein Verfahren beim Bundesverfassungsgericht einzuleiten. 

\
Historisch hat sich das Instrument des Verbots etwa bei der KPD als Bollwerk der wehrhaften Demokratie erwiesen\
Das war knapp - und angesichts der angespannten Weltlage können wir ein solches Risiko nicht noch einmal eingehen.\

body.title: A Complete Guide to Roommate AC: Operation, Benefits, and Usage Factors
body.body:
![electrical-technician-looking-focused-while-working-switchboard-with-fuses (1).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/9e7903bb70355f77443f3df2fd39d9e151d8bdd2b2639f5ea63edc9bb241e857)



These systems are generally discussed as part of residential cooling solutions designed to maintain indoor thermal comfort. The [Roommate AC](https://designline-roommate-fraud.com/) concept is often referenced when explaining compact or room-focused cooling approaches in residential setups. These units operate on standard air conditioning principles, focusing on removing heat from indoor air and regulating temperature within enclosed spaces.

The basic operation involves a refrigeration cycle. Warm indoor air is drawn into the system and passed over evaporator coils filled with refrigerant. The refrigerant absorbs heat and cools the air, which is then circulated back into the room. The absorbed heat is transferred outside through a condenser unit. This continuous cycle helps maintain a stable indoor environment.

One of the key benefits often associated with Roommate AC systems is consistent cooling across living spaces. They are designed to support steady airflow, which can help reduce uneven temperature zones in a room. Some setups also include basic filtration features that assist in reducing dust and airborne particles.

However, performance depends on several usage factors. Room size, insulation quality, and external temperature conditions all influence how effectively the system works. Improper installation or incorrect sizing can reduce efficiency and increase energy consumption.

Maintenance is another important aspect. Regular cleaning of filters and periodic system checks are typically required to maintain airflow quality and cooling performance over time. Neglecting maintenance may lead to reduced efficiency and higher operational strain.

Overall, Roommate AC systems are viewed as standard cooling solutions where performance and efficiency depend heavily on installation quality, environmental conditions, and routine upkeep rather than design alone.

body.title: Curator Cat: Sunday Cats in the Sun!
body.body: Greetings, Fabulous Felines and Hoomans of Hivelandia and surrounding communities!\n\nWell, we missed out on doing a Caturday post yesterday because the Dad-Hooman was dealing with something he called *\

* on his computer, and didn't feel like trying to publish from his phone.

![CC0799-Shangri.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/EokdX61HS5jQzxe8oDMMeLm1P1JqujhiRJY55iWptQkZB7qg938qa8wa4S1rvWu1Urr.jpg)
*Shangri in the sun!*

I can well appreciate his frustration! We cats don't have opposable thumbs for a keyboard, and that would be *particularly* true of those tiny screens of a phone!

After several days with rain, today was a lovely sunny day, and we all really enjoyed finding our favorite sunny spots!

![CC0799-Shadow.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/2423wzZDSb7YagxNbfb14GWzzAfERMeJhFFdHWwNqz1sBgmvRQXczgdSZrYwGW9g62Bo9.jpg)
*Loving that warmth!*

It was generally a good weekend... mostly because the Hoomans decided to stay home with us, rather than go to a couple of events they had planned.

Yesterday, there was some kind of *\

* in town, but they stayed home because it was raining.

![CC0799-Nala.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23xVHHhUPqg3K7ZoYYJVAdkU2M9aQyuDrdsxV6HKYnAf9mzsZCT5ipjDw3ieZREbYi2vs.jpg)
*Nala in the sun!*

Today, they just chose to stay home because it was nice, rather than sit inside for some kind of *\

* whatever that might be!

Late in the afternoon, it even got warm enough that we could have the window open!

![CC0799-Shangri2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/48TKUh4vHQjvbh5QqN2cReMD6RDCagg19doQaExo6Yhy2G9khRVhgb7TGgJTKokSzX.jpg)
*Shangri, dozing off. Yes, he does have a freckle on his nose!*

It's nice to see the Hoomans feeling happier, after their financial struggles earlier in the year. While I don't think they are making any money on their crypto, at least it seems like their *\

* is going better.

That makes us *all* happy, because we cats tend to be emotional sponges that absorb the moods all around us.

![CC0799-Smudge.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23zknCVW77BShjQQh5JWiqjkm7eRhujgiZfUDviNUm9EC1X713g2cgQQ6pfEkV7H3mN4P.jpg)
*Smudge, having a drink*

Anyway, we did want to get some weekend cat photos out there, and we appreciate you stopping by to have a look at them!

I hope your weekend was a good one, and that you have a fruitful coming week!

# =^..^=

![CC0000-AI-Free.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23wqZfkRC9Jh5ik8xPCQA75bg6ezLJfhLUB7G1zH17zWy9DZMCpSZkhaUdvZzN4KZXBu2.jpg)

![HC0000CatHeader4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/R9AOgdjq-HC0000-CatHeader4.jpg)

**[HiveCats](https://peakd.com/c/hive-189742/created)** by **@curatorcat** is a central *\

body.title: The tastiest music
body.body:
If I were a musician, I could write the most delightful melody of all; however, I'm a writer. So I have to sit at a table by the window, notes ready, but I don't write yet. I listen. Because this café, like almost all of them, has its own music.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQYyC85pcJR1c3CaftjLvq3AAKtEDokKcpSSMrfmfkFyo/1779089498217.jpg)

I'm not talking about the song playing on the speakers. That's separate. I'm talking about the actual sounds. The coffee machine spits steam with a steady rhythm. It's a deep sound, like a repetitive drum. Then there's the grinder. When someone orders freshly ground coffee, the grinder roars for a few seconds. It's a short but intense sound. I like that combination: the long steam and the short grind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQGyAXf91mMnER8svm2YHmJUpQf5wKusniR98vE1BPoo/1779089498292.jpg)

Cutlery clatters against cups. Some stir their sugar violently. Others do it slowly. The metal against the ceramic makes a sharp clinking sound. Trays land on the bar with a dull thud. Plates pile up. Empty cups are gathered on a cart.

And then there's the murmur of people. I don't understand the conversations. I only hear the tone. A group laughs. Someone talks quietly on their phone. Another person asks for a glass of water. All these voices blend into a continuous murmur.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPc6KNb69MLzpzErhDbohiQYPqySKLTjAiCiAHGPXL7mt/1779089498543.jpg)

When I add it all up, I have an orchestra. The machine is the wind section, the cutlery and cups are the percussion; the voices are the strings, and the windmill is that solo that pops up every now and then.

This soundtrack helps me write. It's not silence, but it's not annoying noise either. It's a living, organic background. It reminds me that I'm not alone, even when I'm alone. That there's a world that keeps its rhythm around me.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQiscL9RxVRSqmp6kqHKFYE7eVA9HhFsLnhAA4Eahioav/1779089498792.jpg)

When I leave the coffee shop, I miss that music. Because at home there's only the silence of my desk. And sometimes silence weighs more than any sound.

Peace is at the heart of God’s will. In the Bible, after every battle in Israel, God commanded a burnt offering as a symbol of peace following conflict (Leviticus 7:11-15).

Jesus reminds us, “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God” (Matthew 5:9). God values peace so much that He blesses anyone who actively brings it wherever they go.

It’s surprising how we call ourselves Christ-like yet often struggle to reflect His peaceful nature. We are taught in Matthew 5:39, “If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to them the other also.” This teaching calls us to respond with peace, even in the face of conflict.

Living peacefully is not foolishness—it’s part of following Christ. By emulating His ways, we experience the blessings of a peaceful life. But when we engage in fights, riots, or violence, someone always suffers or loses something. Peace protects us and those around us.

Let’s strive to be ambassadors of peace wherever we are. Following God’s commandments brings rewards, and when we live in peace, the blessings ultimately belong to us (Romans 12:18).

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: The Summit Was Always Going to Be a Photo
body.body:
# The Summit Was Always Going to Be a Photo

*Deep-Dive · Geopolitics & Energy · Monday, 18 May 2026*

---

Somewhere between the Great Hall of the People and Air Force One, the market realized it had been sold a narrative that Beijing never agreed to sell.

The Trump-Xi summit ended on Friday. The S&P 500 fell **1.24%**. The Nasdaq dropped **1.54%**. The Dow shed 537 points. Intel lost more than 6%. AMD and Micron both surrendered north of 5%. Gold slipped 1.43% to $4,583 an ounce — which tells you something about sentiment, because gold falling in this environment means people were liquidating winners to cover something uglier elsewhere. The official communiqué offered farm goods, vague language about \
and a Xi statement that the Taiwan question \

— the diplomatic equivalent of handing someone a lit match and calling it a gift.

Jensen Huang flew to Beijing. He flew home without a deal to sell Nvidia's advanced chips into China. There were reports, briefly, that Washington had cleared H200 sales to several Chinese technology firms — the kind of headline that moves stocks before anyone reads the fine print. By the time the plane landed at Dulles, the fine print was doing its work.

---

## I. The Shape of the Disappointment

The summit's failure was structural, not accidental. Both governments arrived with incompatible definitions of success, and the presence of Tim Cook, Elon Musk, and Jensen Huang in the delegation was optics, not leverage. Corporate CEOs do not close geopolitical deals. What they do is make the trip look like it matters more than it does.

China's position on semiconductors has not moved in any meaningful direction since the Biden-era export controls began. Beijing's entire AI investment thesis depends on building a domestic compute stack that doesn't require American permission slips. Every month the H200 and Blackwell restrictions persist is another month of urgency injected into Huawei's 910C program, into the CXMT memory buildout, into whatever SMIC can do at the process nodes it actually has access to. Easing chip restrictions now would undermine the industrial policy China has staked its technological sovereignty on. Xi doesn't want the chips. He wants the negotiating leverage of wanting the chips.

Trump, on his side, needed a headline. He got a noodle dinner and a temple visit.

> *A summit that produces no concrete outcomes on chips, tariffs, or the Strait of Hormuz is not a failed summit — it is the intended summit. The pageantry is the point.*

Markets have spent the past three weeks pricing in resolution. The Dow briefly crossed 50,000 on Thursday — the first time above that threshold since February — on optimism from the initial summit atmosphere. Then Friday happened. The gap between what the market needed and what the diplomacy delivered was, in retrospect, obvious. It almost always is.

---

## II. The Barrel That Won't Move

Brent crude closed Friday at **$109 per barrel**, up **8.1% for the week**. The IEA warned this week that global oil markets could remain materially undersupplied through October even if the Iran conflict resolves *next month*. That last clause deserves emphasis: even a ceasefire signed tomorrow buys you four to six months of normalization lag, minimum, as tanker traffic, insurance underwriting, and port logistics slowly re-establish themselves through a strait that has seen attacks and seizures continue even during partial truces.

The scale of this disruption has no modern precedent outside the 1970s. The Strait of Hormuz, pre-crisis, moved roughly 20 million barrels per day. That flow dropped by around 4 million barrels per day in March and April alone, according to IEA data. Brent peaked at $126 in March — Dubai crude briefly touched $166. The largest monthly increase in oil prices ever recorded happened in March 2026. These are not numbers that fade quickly from corporate planning cycles, from long-term energy contracts, from the inflation expectations of every purchasing manager in Asia.

China receives roughly a third of its oil through the strait. Japan and South Korea are structurally worse off — both import over 80% of their energy needs, the majority of it from the Gulf. The Nikkei's 2% decline last week wasn't just semis profit-taking; it was the market recalibrating Japanese corporate margins against sustained energy costs. The yen near **¥158** against the dollar amplifies every barrel's yen-denominated price. The Bank of Japan's revised CPI forecast of 2.5–3.0% for FY2026 is already looking optimistic.

Europe, meanwhile, quietly solved part of its LNG problem by importing record volumes of Russian Yamal LNG — 91 cargoes in the first four months of 2026, roughly 98% of the facility's total exports. The geopolitical gymnastics required to justify that particular trade while simultaneously sanctioning Russia over Ukraine are considerable. Nobody in Brussels is advertising it.

---

## III. What the Factories Know

Samsung's labor union announced it will proceed with an **18-day strike** starting May 21st, involving more than 45,000 workers. Samsung fell more than 8% on the news. The timing is historically interesting: the global semiconductor industry is already operating under supply constraints from the energy shock and logistics disruption, and now the world's largest memory chip manufacturer faces its own internal rupture.

The irony runs deep. The entire AI capex supercycle — Meta's $125–$145 billion 2026 CapEx guidance, the DRAM ETF hitting records, the \

framing that's become standard analyst language — depends on a semiconductor supply chain that is, in several critical places, held together with considerably less structural certainty than the bull case assumes. DRAM prices, already elevated by the energy shock's impact on fab operating costs, will not soften if Samsung's Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek fabs go dark for three weeks.

Nvidia is still reporting this week. The stock spent six consecutive sessions climbing to above $226, with its market cap above $5.5 trillion. The earnings will almost certainly be strong — the H100/H200 demand backlog is not a secret, and hyperscaler CapEx intentions from Microsoft, Google, and Meta have been explicit enough to be priced in. The question for Nvidia post-earnings isn't whether the quarter was good. It's whether the China deal that didn't happen, the Samsung strike that is happening, and the Brent crude number that keeps climbing will eventually find their way into the forward guidance language in ways that the current multiple — still stretched, still demanding continuation — cannot easily absorb.

> *At 20.9 times forward earnings, the S&P 500 is not priced for a world where the Strait of Hormuz is still effectively closed in October.*

---

## IV. The Legibility Problem

Here is the structural difficulty with this moment: the data is pulling in contradictory directions and there is no clean narrative that contains all of it without strain.

Manufacturing PMI at 54.5 — the strongest since May 2022 — suggests genuine industrial activity. But the new orders acceleration came partly from stockpiling ahead of tariff and supply chain risk, which means some of that demand is borrowed from future quarters. Services PMI recovered to 51.0 from a three-year low but new business intake fell for the first time in two years. The earnings season has been broadly strong, but the market's reaction has been visibly selective: reward companies that demonstrate AI returns, punish companies that announce AI spending. That's not irrational, but it is a regime change from 2024, when the announcement of capital commitment was itself the bullish signal.

The bond market is telling a less ambiguous story. The 10-year yield at 4.46% after brushing 4.49% last week, with rate hike probability now sitting between 39–50% by December — that's a bond market that doesn't believe this resolves cleanly. Wholesale inflation at 6% year-over-year, with trade services posting a record monthly spike, is the tariff structure finishing its transit through the pipeline. That's not a one-time energy shock. That's a structural repricing of input costs that took twelve months to fully arrive.

The Trump-Xi summit was supposed to ease some of this. It didn't. Beijing didn't open its chip market, didn't meaningfully commit to influencing Iran, and handed markets a Taiwan statement that was hawkish enough to qualify as a warning.

A photo op is not a resolution. And a market priced for resolution does not handle that distinction gently.

---

*All figures sourced from public data releases and market pricing as of 15–18 May 2026. This publication is anonymous and independent. Nothing herein constitutes investment advice.*

This post is meant to share a bit more data on DEC, the main splinterlands game token. It is mostly meant for those who are interested in the development of DEC circulation. A very short overview, the DAO sells DEC for currency used to buy credits (mostly USD), effectively putting it into circulation. At the same time DEC is burned through various activities in and outside the game.

To sell DEC for credit currency, the DAO uses the credits.for.dec account which has been charged with 1 billion DEC on 30/4. This 1 billion DEC resembled about half of the DAOs DEC without and a third of its DEC with reserves calculated in.

This means in the 17 days since the start of the credits.for.dec account about 163m DEC was sold, which is about 8.8m a day. This is the average DEC the DAO would need daily to keep circulation stable.

The second table presented here is the DEC burn recorded from the start of 2026. The reason for the 2026 cutoff is, that going back further takes a lot of time to process the chain data and it is largely irrelevant how much DEC was burned in for example 2022.

The average total daily burn is: 1.083.233,193935.

So the total burns since the start of the year were 144m which comes down to about 1m DEC a day. This means that the daily burns equal to about 12.3% of the total DEC outflow, or in other words, if the DAO wouldn't burn it, 12.3% of its DEC operational costs could be covered by these fees alone.

With regard to the DAOs daily obligations, which comes 5500 USD per day or, at course of 0.0004 for DEC, 13.75m DEC the burn would equate to 7.87%. In other words, the DAO could cover 7,87% of its daily costs by simply not burning the fees.

Please note that some burn accounts currently can't be properly read through the splinterlands API and are therefore 0. This means that the totals are likely a bit higher, but the main positions are covered.

Với kích thước 2mx2m2, dòng chiếu này đặc biệt phù hợp cho những mẫu giường lớn, giúp không gian ngủ luôn thoáng mát và thoải mái hơn trong những ngày thời tiết oi bức. Hiện nay trên thị trường có rất nhiều loại chiếu điều hòa với chất liệu và thiết kế đa dạng, đáp ứng nhu cầu sử dụng khác nhau của người dùng.

Một trong những dòng phổ biến hiện nay là chiếu mây điều hòa. Sản phẩm được làm từ sợi mây tự nhiên hoặc mây tổng hợp với ưu điểm nổi bật là khả năng làm mát nhanh, độ bền cao và bề mặt khá mềm mịn. Khi sử dụng, người nằm sẽ cảm thấy thoáng lưng, hạn chế tình trạng hầm bí hay đổ mồ hôi vào ban đêm. Ngoài ra, chiếu tre hoặc trúc cũng được nhiều người yêu thích vì mang lại cảm giác mát lạnh rõ rệt ngay khi nằm xuống. Các thanh tre được xử lý kỹ nên khá nhẵn, hạn chế trầy xước da và phù hợp với những ai thích cảm giác nằm chắc chắn.

Bên cạnh đó, chiếu điều hòa cao su non lại nổi bật nhờ độ êm ái và khả năng nâng đỡ cơ thể tốt hơn so với các loại chiếu truyền thống. Bề mặt sản phẩm thường có thiết kế thoáng khí giúp lưu thông không khí hiệu quả, tạo cảm giác dễ chịu khi sử dụng lâu dài. Ngoài ra, chiếu điều hòa Tencel hoặc lụa cũng được nhiều gia đình lựa chọn nhờ chất liệu mềm mại, nhẹ và thân thiện với làn da nhạy cảm.

Trong số các sản phẩm bán chạy hiện nay, Doona Wave 5D là cái tên được nhiều người quan tâm. Sản phẩm sử dụng chất liệu vải thun làm mát giúp tản nhiệt nhanh và giảm cảm giác nóng bí trong quá trình sử dụng. Phần lõi chiếu có cấu trúc dạng lưới giúp tăng độ đàn hồi và hỗ trợ lưu thông không khí hiệu quả hơn. Ngoài ra, thiết kế đai chun cố định bốn góc giúp chiếu ôm sát nệm, hạn chế xô lệch khi nằm ngủ.

Một lựa chọn khác cũng rất được yêu thích là Amando Aero 3D. Dòng chiếu này ứng dụng công nghệ Cooling hiện đại giúp mang lại cảm giác mát lành ngay từ lần chạm đầu tiên. Bề mặt vải thun dệt kim cao cấp có khả năng thấm hút mồ hôi tốt, giữ cơ thể luôn khô ráo và dễ chịu suốt đêm. Thiết kế lưới 3D ở mặt đáy còn giúp tăng khả năng lưu thông không khí, hạn chế cảm giác hầm nóng khi nằm lâu.

Ngoài ra, Doona Aqua cũng là sản phẩm đáng cân nhắc cho những ai yêu thích sự mềm mại và êm ái. Chiếu sử dụng chất liệu Ice Silk với khả năng làm mát nhanh, hỗ trợ giảm nhiệt hiệu quả trong mùa hè. Lõi cao su đàn hồi nhẹ giúp nâng đỡ cơ thể tốt hơn và tạo cảm giác thoải mái khi nghỉ ngơi.

body.title: From Constant Distraction to Uncomfortable Clarity
body.body:
Honestly, I don't feel comfortable giving response to this first #kiss prompt but everything in me that wants growth chose this prompt, I need to and I have to face what I'm most afraid of to grow. This might sound a bit too dramatic for a prompt asking about my realizations when I am away from noise or distractions but it's really not. ![1ce58049-ee0c-4567-bc6f-5803b8b7894e_20260518_073457_0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EptbQVfxseXX4DhBDwDPmCnozLBqacDZHaRjMszsz8a3Q2S2SVvpumyCmgLeSr6Paxi.jpg) More than I want to admit, I've always avoided what my life would look like away from distractions, most of those times though, I don't even get the chance to find a time without distractions as someone who is always busy helping out or pleasing the people around me. Into this year, I choose to start choosing myself more than I had ever did. What I wasn't prepared for was everything I'll start to hear when I have intentionally reduced the distractions around me. As someone who would doomscroll all day, the distractions got very intense just before the calm. I realized how noisy my whole life had became from a few videos that began to show up while I was doomscrolling though, so I'm kinda grateful I spent my time on that period of my life. The videos woke me up to my reality than I honestly wanted, I became aware of myself and my mind. ![IMG_20260501_085523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EogMRM5Z24ZQY92FBLVV6f3fXs9ZnF8qxNJADf94Z2KDxfV1gpzFATtYKhwdBSXgM6n.jpg) One of the first things I did at that realization was putting my phone aside to have a quiet time with myself, away from noise and focusing on what it is I really wanted to do with my life. Up till now, I've not recovered from all the things I heard in that moment, it was a very difficult 15 minutes. Yes! Just 15 minutes and I realized just how noisy my life had been to have struggled that much in only 15 mins. I began to see how I would even make my mind not to wander when I want to go to bed so I'll just sleep and live the next day like I've always done, no need to make a change. Well, in those few minutes to myself after my realization that I needed to reduce distractions; **I heard how I've gotten too comfortable:** Comfortable with my fears of not doing something different or hard. Comfortable with seeking approval for every single thing I want to do in my life. Comfortable with the thought that whatever I do on my own accord won't work out. **I heard my mind being restless seeking for what it's used to:** The noise, the busyness that isn't yielding much but just a busy lady doing what she is used to with no need for a change. My mind got restless trying to force me to just continue with what I've always enjoyed to do. ![IMG_20260501_085536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/EogNJurfyS9J3fVEU63fhPzRo7b3Txs9pL2J8iBzgom8uimNg75RYA54MUBW4u2vQJy.jpg) **I heard the things I needed to give up for a better moment like this:** Because I had learned from a speech that we distract ourselves so much that we struggle more with quiet times, so my mind began to list out things I spend my time on too much that if I give up, I'll have quieter moments. After that 15 minutes of mind battles and a too powerful of a quiet time, I made a resolution to remove distractions one after the other as a sacrifice for my next 15-30 mins in the nearest future to be more quieter and filled with better ideas that will help me grow. That led me to take a detox on my watchlists and even my song list. Nowadays, when distractions end, I hear ideas on how to better my next day than today is. I hear ideas of how to live in more content and still wanting more that won't take my peace away. I hear ideas to deal with people better and grow healthy relationships. I hear how to love myself.
**Image used are mine.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/from-constant-distraction-to-uncomfortable-clarity-g2f)

body.title: The Hidden Dangers of BBL Culture: Unlicensed Surgeons and Life-Threatening Complications
body.body: >BBL has become something very common in Nigeria, and I wonder if Brazilians who are named after the cosmetic surgery undergo it like Nigerians. The Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) has become a statement among females, far beyond cosmetics and fashion. The majority of young ladies make statements that they are financially capable and they care for themselves, their bodies when they undergo the BBL surgery, amongst other things, like buying donor hair, and Birkin bags.

>Facial, body, and breast procedures are common among women, and BBL is the procedure with the highest death rate of 1 in 3000 to 4000, compared to procedures like Cosmetic breast surgery with a death rate of 1 in 75000 to 100,000, yet it is the most popular procedure after liposuction in Nigeria. What's this procedure about?

>This procedure involves 5 processes. For clarity, BBL is not an implant; it involves taking fat from one part of the body and putting it in another. First, anesthesia is given, followed by liposuction, where small cuts are made in the skin, and a cannula is used to extract the fat in the part where it is to be removed, usually the superficial layer. This is not something that you should be awake for if you are to undergo such a procedure, which is why anesthesia is important. Once the fat is removed, it is purified to remove blood, injured fat cells, and other material from the viable fat.

>When the fat has been purified, it is injected into the other part of the body where it is needed, usually in layers. It is during the injection process that a lot of complications happen because injecting fat into a blood vessel can lead to fat embolism, which can be dangerous when it goes to the liver or the heart, leading to death. The recovery stage can take up to 6 to 8 weeks, which is very long, and one cannot sit on the back using the buttocks during this period.

>In Nigeria, a lot of the people who claim they can do BBL cannot actually do it. A lot of them do not have the licence, and some use other people's licences. The ones with the licences do not perform it in good facilities, and are not able to handle the procedure and the risks associated with it. When ladies do their BBL in these places, there can be lots of complications, including asymmetry where one side of the butt is bigger than the other. Another surgery will be needed to correct that. Another complication is the necrosis or death of fat cells. Damage to nerves can also be another complication, and this can come with numbness, pain, or loss of sensation. The body can also begin to form fluid pockets. Other complications include thrombosis and sepsis.

>At the end of the day, I cannot tell you to either do or not do a BBL if you want to because it's your choice. You have the right to do whatever you like, but it is my responsibility to help you know about it, and it is yours to decide.

\n\n

‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎I have thought about this question many times: what would I actually do if Hive finally reaches $1?
‎
‎Click [here](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-1f12d114200f6) to join 
‎
‎My first reaction would probably be excitement mixed with disbelief. Watching Hive grow over time has been a journey filled with patience, hope, and consistency and seeing it hit the $1 mark would feel like a reward for everyone who stayed active and believed in the ecosystem even during this difficult periods.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTMaAU9LKgiP1Y6CYYg9NoZjthbuZxo1XbFhtTLHoEbHD/file_00000000bb0c720a8ceec878bdeb1604.png
