body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today was one of those weird #Splinterlands days where I did not even touch ranked battles lol. Usually I atleast try to grind few matches everyday, but today I mostly focused on preparing for the season and doing guild stuff instead. Sometimes its actually nice to take a small break from stressful ranked games, specially in Diamond where every single loss feels painful. The first thing I did today was purchase around 3,000 Credits because I wanted to rent some better cards for this season. My collection is decent now but there are still many cards that are super useful in higher leagues and renting them makes life much easier. Prices were not too bad today luckily. I ended up renting around 15 cards in total. Some were tanks, some support cards and few annoying cards which I hate playing against myself. But honestly, rentals are one of the best things in #Splinterlands. Without renting, climbing higher leagues becomes much harder unless you own a massive collection.

> After getting the credits, I spent quite a while searching market rentals. I tried to focus mostly on cards which are flexible in many rulesets because I dont want to waste credits on cards I only use once. I rented few strong frontline monsters, some ranged attackers and also few annoying magic cards because magic teams are still very strong. One thing I noticed is that rental prices are slowly becoming higher again. Maybe because many players are trying to push ranks near season progression. Diamond league especially feels very competitive right now.

> Even though I did not play ranked today, I still spent good amount of time checking my deck combinations and testing ideas mentally. Sometimes planning lineups is actually fun. You look at a card and suddenly realize “wait this combo could actually destroy people”. I also played some Guild Brawls today. Honestly brawls feel different compared to ranked. There is more pressure because you dont wanna disappoint guild members. When your guild is active, everybody wants to contribute properly. Our guild has been doing pretty good recently and I really like the competitive atmosphere there. Even when I lose, it still feels nice because everyone shares strategies and discusses battles together. Thats something I enjoy alot in #Splinterlands community. The brawl battles today were decent but nothing super crazy happened. I had few smooth wins and one really annoying match where RNG completely betrayed me. My attack missed at the worst possible moment and the enemy snowballed from there. Classic #Splinterlands experience honestly.

> One thing I’ve learned after reaching Diamond leagues is that preparation matters alot more than people think. Many players just spam battles without changing strategy. But higher leagues punish that hard. Renting correct cards can literally decide your whole season. For example, sometimes one rented legendary card can win multiple battles alone because opponents are not prepared for it. Thats why I dont mind spending credits carefully if it helps me stay competitive. I also checked market prices for few cards I maybe wanna buy permanently in future. Some cards are becoming really expensive though. Especially useful meta cards. Makes me wish I started collecting earlier. Still, renting is carrying me for now.

></center>

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

For now my main goal is still staying competitive in Diamond and maybe eventually pushing even higher if possible. But I know that requires stronger cards and smarter decisions. Renting these 15 cards is hopefully gonna help me alot this season.

I’m also trying to improve my lineup reading skills because predicting enemy teams becomes super important in higher leagues. Sometimes the battle is decided before Round 1 even starts.

Overall, today was not the most action packed #Splinterlands session, but it still felt productive. I upgraded my seasonal setup, participated in guild activities, and prepared myself for upcoming ranked grind.

Tomorrow I’ll probably jump back into ranked matches again and test these rented cards properly. Hopefully they help me win more battles instead of draining my credits for nothing.

Lets see how this season goes.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Lo que aprendí demasiado tarde #1: Sobre intentar poder con todo sola | What I Learned Too Late #1: About trying to handle everything alone
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---

# Lo que aprendí demasiado tarde #1  
## *Sobre intentar poder con todo sola*  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtUaKbWmUUNrBpktEdAJdtgdTbNc7sZvdNCM8PrDF67c/imaartist_woman_7035156_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-portrait-pose-style-7035156/)

---

Hola querida comunidad de Holos & Lotus  

Hubo una etapa de mi vida en la que creía que ser fuerte significaba poder con todo sin ayuda.

Pensaba que la responsabilidad era resistir en silencio, resolver rápido los problemas y seguir adelante aunque por dentro me sintiera agotada.

Y durante muchos años eso se convirtió en parte de mi manera de vivir.

No porque la vida me diera demasiadas opciones, sino porque las circunstancias poco a poco enseñan a sobrevivir así.

Después de que nació mi hija decidí quedarme en casa para cuidarla. Muchas personas pueden pensar que quedarse en casa es más fácil, pero la verdad es que una casa nunca descansa realmente.

El trabajo simplemente cambia de forma.

Siempre hay comida que preparar, ropa que lavar, cosas que resolver, problemas pequeños que se acumulan todos los días sin hacer ruido.

Con el tiempo también empecé a hacer artesanías, costuras y dulces caseros para ayudar económicamente en la casa.

Poco a poco mis días comenzaron a llenarse completamente.

Y sin darme cuenta empecé a creer que pedir ayuda era casi lo mismo que fracasar.

Aprendí a resolverlo todo sola:
estirar el dinero cuando no alcanzaba,
buscar soluciones en medio de las carencias,
manejar el estrés en silencio,
seguir adelante incluso estando agotada.

Especialmente en Cuba, muchas mujeres se vuelven expertas en cargar pesos invisibles.

No porque quieran admiración.

Sino porque muchas veces la vida no deja otra opción.

Sin embargo, una de las cosas más difíciles que he aprendido con los años es que cargar siempre con todo sola termina consumiéndote poco a poco por dentro.

No de golpe.

No de manera dramática.

Sino lentamente.

Dejas de descansar de verdad porque la mente nunca se desconecta.

Incluso cuando estás sentada tranquila, sigues organizando mentalmente los problemas de mañana.

A veces el cuerpo se cansa antes de que las emociones logren reconocerlo.

Y llega un momento en que una entiende algo importante:
ser fuerte no es lo mismo que vivir sacrificándose permanentemente.

Durante mucho tiempo confundí esas dos cosas.

Creía que si me detenía un momento todo alrededor se iba a derrumbar.

Pero la realidad terminó enseñándome algo distinto.

Una casa no se vuelve más fuerte porque una sola persona se destruya intentando sostenerlo todo.

Hay días en los que el agotamiento hace que incluso las tareas más simples parezcan enormes.

Días donde el peso de la vida cotidiana se siente más duro de lo normal:
los problemas con la corriente,
la incertidumbre,
los precios cada vez más altos,
la necesidad constante de adaptarse a todo.

Y en medio de eso he empezado a entender poco a poco que aceptar los límites no es debilidad.

Es honestidad.

Hay cosas que el cuerpo no puede seguir cargando para siempre sin consecuencias.

Hay cansancios emocionales que tarde o temprano también necesitan ser reconocidos.

Y quizás una de las lecciones más grandes de la adultez es entender que nadie fue hecho para sobrevivir completamente solo.

Incluso ahora todavía me cuesta aplicarlo.

Todavía intento resolver demasiadas cosas al mismo tiempo.

Todavía me siento culpable cuando descanso más de lo que creo que debería.

Pero poco a poco estoy aprendiendo que cuidar a los demás no debería significar abandonarse completamente una misma en el proceso.

Quizás aprendí eso más tarde de lo que debía.

Pero al menos lo aprendí antes de que la vida me obligara a entenderlo de una forma más dura.

---

Hay aprendizajes que llegan tarde, pero cuando llegan cambian para siempre la manera en que una se mira a sí misma.

Gracias por leer 

---

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha con DeepL Translate.  

---

🇬🇧 In English  

---

# What I Learned Too Late #1  
## *About trying to handle everything alone*  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQtUaKbWmUUNrBpktEdAJdtgdTbNc7sZvdNCM8PrDF67c/imaartist_woman_7035156_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-model-portrait-pose-style-7035156/)

---

Hello dear Holos & Lotus community  

There was a time in my life when I believed being strong meant being able to handle everything without help.

I thought responsibility meant enduring silently, solving problems quickly, and continuing no matter how tired I felt inside.

And for many years, that became part of who I was.

Not because life gave me many options, but because circumstances slowly teach you to survive that way.

After my daughter was born, I decided to stay home to take care of her. Some people may think that staying at home is easier, but the truth is that a house never truly rests.

The work simply changes shape.

There are meals to prepare, clothes to wash, things to repair, problems to solve, and endless small responsibilities that accumulate quietly every day.

Over time I also began making handmade crafts, sewing, and preparing homemade sweets and recipes to help support the household economy.

Little by little, my days became completely filled.

And without noticing it, I started believing that asking for help was almost the same as failing.

I learned to resolve everything myself:
stretching money when it was not enough,
finding solutions during shortages,
managing stress quietly,
continuing even during exhaustion.

Especially in Cuba, many women become experts at carrying invisible weight.

Not because we want admiration.

But because life often leaves no other choice.

Still, one of the hardest things I have learned over the years is that constantly carrying everything alone slowly consumes you from the inside.

Not immediately.

Not dramatically.

But little by little.

You stop resting properly because your mind never disconnects.

Even while sitting quietly, you are mentally organizing tomorrow’s problems.

Sometimes your body becomes tired before your emotions even realize it.

And there comes a moment when you understand something important:
strength is not the same thing as permanent sacrifice.

For a long time I confused those two ideas.

I believed that if I stopped for a moment, everything around me would collapse.

But reality taught me something different.

A home does not become stronger because one person destroys themselves trying to sustain everything alone.

There are days when exhaustion makes even simple tasks feel enormous.

Days when the pressure of daily life feels heavier than usual:
the electricity problems,
the uncertainty,
the rising prices,
the constant need to adapt.

And during those moments, I have slowly started understanding that accepting limits is not weakness.

It is honesty.

There are things the body cannot continue carrying forever without consequences.

There are emotional burdens that eventually ask to be acknowledged.

And perhaps one of the biggest lessons adulthood teaches is that we were never meant to survive life completely alone.

Even now, I still struggle with this sometimes.

I still try to solve too many things at once.

I still feel guilty when I rest more than I think I should.

But little by little, I am learning that caring for others should not require abandoning yourself completely in the process.

Maybe I learned that later than I should have.

But at least I learned it before life forced me to learn it in a harder way.

---

There are lessons that arrive late, but once they arrive, they change the way we see ourselves forever.

Thank you for reading

body.body:
这个话题有点玄，但根据经历的增加，会渐渐变得清晰，没有那么玄，是因为你真正的退出了被情绪裹挟的那个自己，很自然的退了出来，退出情绪之外来看情绪，突然你会发现那个情绪不是真的，…

  怎么解释呢？你有没有发现一旦人在情绪推动下做的决定事后很多人都会后悔，靠…为什么自己会这么做？你会懊恼…会自责，会后悔，会继续在这种情绪里不断的拉扯与消耗…

      这种情况我觉察到了，近一年多时间，为了不让情绪裹挟我会主动离开，这种离开不是逃避，其实情绪一直都在，今天你要做什么，吃什么，该做就去做，不要让情绪去拖累你，这种觉察就是自我意识的觉察，需要自我训练！


     突然！你会发现这个世界会变得马上不一样，真的，我自己试过很多次了，情绪低落，不开心，抱怨还是会存在，与她们共存不要被裹挟就好，这就是自我觉察的开始！！

        加油！！骚年们！！🤖🤖🤖

body.title: SUROV та TARABAROVA : “Не залишай”
body.body: Українські артисти SUROV та TARABAROVA випустили свою першу спільну роботу - композицію \

. Прем'єра треку відбулася на лейблі ENKO 14 травня, і ця новинка вже з'явилася на всіх популярних стрімінгових музичних платформах.\nНова пісня - про кохання, про страх втратити найдорожче, - звучить як маніфест почуттів. Основою пісні є особистий діалог двох людей, які опинилися на межі втрати. Романтична балада з елементами трагізму, історія про страх залишитися без того, хто став частиною твого \

.

![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/radiogaga/23uEvBm3GRcHVjYGqG8z2S9ZnQyYSaMqhHS3a8eDEyVVcbeBF7TGp3rxBFFmYcpLLxYhE.jpg)
[джерело](https://radiosferamusic.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Opera-%D0%A1%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BA_2026-05-14_175747_drive.google.com_.png)

Для автора тексту SUROV цей реліз є пережитим особистим болем, покладеним на музику. Музичний супровід написав композитор Дмитро Скляров. Як говорить автор тексту, - пісня виросла із переживань, які складно висловити звичайними словами. SUROV розповідає, що в основі треку — почуття тривоги перед можливою втратою близької людини, коли сама думка про розлучення здається руйнівною. Саме тому композиція вийшла настільки емоційно насиченою та щирою.
Улюблениця публіки, артистка TARABAROVA додала пісні м'якість та світлу меланхолію. У цьому дуеті вокал співачки став емоційним балансом похмурого тембру партнера, а сама Тарабарова розкрилася з несподівано тонкої ліричної сторони.
Рядки першого куплета, де звучить прохання не йти, доки не закінчиться темрява і не повернеться світло, вже стали крилатими фразами і повторюються прихильниками творчості нового дуету виконавців. Фрагменти пісні активно розповсюджуються в соцмережах, а цитати з тексту швидко розійшлися серед шанувальників.

body.title: Cuando el cansancio deja de ser solo físico. Ladies of Hive Community Contest # 289 [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Cuando el cansancio deja de ser solo físico  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbEmGBJLskGR1pjUkWpFz7YNfNjfGDSfGBABmV1CJjdaH/screenshot_20260517_164447_01.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-window-relaxation-leisure-7573568/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive  

Hay momentos en los que una no sabe exactamente cuándo comenzó el agotamiento. No aparece de golpe. Se acumula lentamente entre responsabilidades, rutinas y pequeñas exigencias diarias que parecen normales… hasta que el cuerpo y la mente empiezan a pedir una pausa que una misma intenta posponer.

### Sobre sentir que estoy haciendo demasiado  

Sí, hay etapas en las que siento que intento sostener demasiadas cosas al mismo tiempo.

Y creo que una de las situaciones que más me provoca esa sensación es la necesidad de estar disponible constantemente para todo y para todos.

En profesiones relacionadas con el cuidado de otras personas, como la medicina, muchas veces una se acostumbra a funcionar incluso estando cansada. Hay horarios irregulares, guardias, preocupaciones que no siempre terminan cuando acaba la jornada y una presión silenciosa de seguir respondiendo aunque la energía ya no sea la misma.

Pero también están las responsabilidades cotidianas fuera del trabajo. La vida diaria, las preocupaciones normales, las cosas que se acumulan sin pedir permiso.

Y durante mucho tiempo pensé que sentirme agotada era simplemente parte de ser adulta.

Hasta que entendí algo importante: normalizar el cansancio constante no significa que sea saludable.

A veces el cuerpo no necesita que seamos más fuertes. Necesita que dejemos de ignorarlo.

Y creo que una de las cosas más difíciles para muchas personas es aceptar que tener límites no es fracasar.

Es ser humano.

---

### Sobre hacer cosas por culpa o por elección  

Esta pregunta me hizo pensar bastante.

Porque muchas veces hacemos cosas automáticamente, sin detenernos a preguntarnos desde dónde las estamos haciendo realmente.

Hay compromisos que nacen del cariño, de la responsabilidad o del deseo genuino de ayudar. Pero también hay otros que nacen del miedo a decepcionar, de la culpa o incluso de esa sensación de que descansar nos vuelve menos valiosos.

Y distinguir una cosa de la otra no siempre es fácil.

Personalmente, he intentado empezar a observar más mis propias razones.

Preguntarme:
*¿Estoy haciendo esto porque realmente quiero hacerlo… o porque siento que no tengo derecho a decir que no?*

Esa diferencia cambia mucho.

Porque cuando todo se vuelve obligación, incluso las cosas importantes empiezan a sentirse pesadas.

Creo que aceptar nuestros límites también implica aprender a elegir mejor dónde ponemos nuestra energía.

No todo lo urgente es importante.  
Y no todo lo importante necesita destruirnos en el proceso.

Todavía estoy aprendiendo eso.

Aprendiendo que descansar no es abandonar responsabilidades.  
Que decir “hoy no puedo” no me convierte en una mala persona.  
Y que cuidarme también es una forma de poder cuidar mejor a otros.

---

Estas preguntas me hicieron pensar en algo sencillo pero necesario: a veces la vida no nos pide hacer más, sino escucharnos un poco antes de llegar al límite.

Gracias por este espacio de reflexión 

Un abrazo sincero para todas 

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue hecha en DeepL Translate  

---  

🇬🇧 In English  

---  

## When Exhaustion Stops Being Only Physical  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbEmGBJLskGR1pjUkWpFz7YNfNjfGDSfGBABmV1CJjdaH/screenshot_20260517_164447_01.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-window-relaxation-leisure-7573568/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community  

There are moments when you do not exactly know when exhaustion began. It does not appear suddenly. It slowly builds up between responsibilities, routines, and small daily demands that seem normal… until both body and mind begin asking for a pause that we keep trying to postpone.

### About feeling like I am doing too much  

Yes, there are periods when I feel like I am trying to carry too many things at the same time.

And I think one of the situations that causes this feeling the most is the constant need to be available for everything and everyone.

In professions related to caring for others, like medicine, people often become used to functioning even while exhausted. There are irregular schedules, night shifts, worries that do not always end when the workday is over, and a silent pressure to keep responding even when the energy is no longer the same.

But there are also everyday responsibilities outside of work. Daily life, ordinary concerns, all the things that accumulate without asking permission.

And for a long time, I believed feeling exhausted was simply part of being an adult.

Until I understood something important: normalizing constant exhaustion does not mean it is healthy.

Sometimes the body does not need us to become stronger. It needs us to stop ignoring it.

And I think one of the hardest things for many people is accepting that having limits is not failure.

It is being human.

---

### About doing things out of guilt or by conscious choice  

This question made me reflect deeply.

Because many times we do things automatically, without stopping to ask ourselves where those actions are truly coming from.

Some commitments are born from affection, responsibility, or a genuine desire to help. But others are born from fear of disappointing people, from guilt, or even from the idea that resting somehow makes us less valuable.

And distinguishing one from the other is not always easy.

Personally, I have been trying to observe my own reasons more carefully.

To ask myself:
*Am I doing this because I truly want to… or because I feel I do not have the right to say no?*

That difference changes a lot.

Because when everything becomes an obligation, even meaningful things begin to feel heavy.

I believe accepting our limits also means learning to choose more carefully where we place our energy.

Not everything urgent is important.  
And not everything important should destroy us in the process.

I am still learning that.

Learning that resting is not abandoning responsibilities.  
That saying “I cannot today” does not make me a bad person.  
And that taking care of myself is also a way of being able to care better for others.

---

These questions made me think about something simple but necessary: sometimes life is not asking us to do more, but to listen to ourselves before we reach our limit.

Thank you for this space for reflection 

A sincere hug to all 

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done using DeepL Translate  

---

body.title: LOH 289: YOU ALWAYS HAVE A CHOICE
body.body:
![17790827697106185741554374836753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/henrietta27/23zGiwKrCSkprNtBzE1RNvxqNhygAcBqPzEomdCFjoVBtqdU1sihhiAFdqQatJtTZUgJd.jpg)
[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/choices/) 


The kind of world in which we live in, doing things out of guilt or fear is one thing that is constant in our lives because we don't want to disappoint some setting kinds of people. These kinds of activities that we do out of Fear or guilt turns out to be one that pressures us to please people. However the situation of things where we do certain activities by our consciousness brings about a different turn of event such as peace and mental stability. 

In other words, as human beings we need to take time out of our schedule to balance our work and life activities thereby separating was we do out of Fear or guilt from the activities we carry out while we are conscious. These choices can help us on the stand the importance of what that particular task truly means to us if it is worthy or if it is just something of pressure and anxiety. 

Even I as a person have found myself doing things that is not in my line of jurisdiction or job description just because I want some certain tasks to be perfect. Sometimes when you look at it it feels like i am trying to please my bosses and in turn this brings about to various emotional discomfort which includes me not wanting to disappoint others or to avoid conflicts that would seem like I am irresponsible at my job. 

So definitely there is a difference between when you are pressured externally and when you consciously decide to do things based on your choices. It is actually better to prioritize internal choices as this would help you to make internal decisions that are both healthy for you and create a mental balance in whatever space you find yourself. 

This is my participation in the @ladiesofhive community weekly contest, to join in check through this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-219) 
>By identifying which activities you do out of guilt or fear of disappointing others, and which you do by conscious choice, would this lead you to accept whether it is urgent or important to you?

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

, utilizando estos puntos de oro acumulados para comprar los puntos de construcción restantes de esta \

. Actualmente, Caracas ya se encuentra fabricando la primera ojiva nuclear, ya con esto tengo una enorme ventaja sobre el resto de naciones. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEtz2ACe63YZ5uxj8JygQLinHM8t5McJsHWfKENW6wWX/1779084895411.jpg) Por otro lado. Inicié una reorganización estratégica mayor en el continente del norte. Para mantener el frente, dejé una guarnición permanente compuesta por dos unidades de infantería mecanizada en la recién conquistada metrópolis de Santa Catarina. Así podré defender lo que ya he tomado mientras el resto de mis unidades —incluyendo misiles de crucero, Marines, escuadrones de bombarderos y artillería Howitzer— las retiré totalmente hacia la ciudad costera de Santana. body.title: Natro Macro Changed the Way Bee Swarm Simulator Players Farm Honey
body.body:
Bee Swarm Simulator has become one of the most time-consuming yet rewarding games on Roblox. Players spend countless hours collecting pollen, upgrading bees, managing resources, and completing quests. While the game itself is fun, many players eventually reach a point where repetitive farming starts consuming too much time. That is where Natro Macro enters the picture and completely changes the experience for serious honey farmers.

Natro Macro is not just another simple automation utility. It is a detailed open-source macro system created specifically for Bee Swarm Simulator players who want smoother progression and improved efficiency. Built using AutoHotkey, the software handles repetitive in-game actions intelligently while giving players enough flexibility to customize almost every farming activity.

One of the biggest reasons behind the growing popularity of [Natro Macro](https://natromacro.net/) is its balance between simplicity and advanced control. Beginners can install it and start farming quickly with default presets, while experienced users can adjust every farming detail based on hive level, bee composition, field preference, and progression goals. This flexibility makes it suitable for almost every type of player.

The tool automates major activities that normally require constant attention. Pollen collection becomes more consistent because the macro follows optimized movement patterns inside fields. Instead of manually running around collecting resources for hours, players can let the macro handle repetitive routes while they focus on strategy and upgrades. This helps reduce burnout, especially during long grinding sessions.

Quest completion is another area where the macro becomes extremely useful. Many Bee Swarm Simulator quests require repetitive farming in specific zones or collecting particular items. Doing these tasks manually every day can become exhausting. Natro Macro simplifies this process by automatically switching between fields and managing tasks efficiently, helping players complete objectives much faster.

Another standout feature is planter management. Experienced players know how important planters are for gaining resources and improving farming results. However, remembering planter rotations, harvesting schedules, and placements can be frustrating during long sessions. Natro Macro reduces that workload by automating planter handling and ensuring better consistency across farming cycles.

Bug hunting automation is also highly appreciated among players aiming to maximize rewards. Defeating bugs manually over long periods often interrupts farming flow. The macro helps streamline this process, allowing players to maintain productivity without constant interruptions. This creates a smoother and more organized grinding routine.

Unlike many unknown third-party utilities available online, Natro Macro focuses heavily on transparency and safety. Since the project is open-source under the GNU GPL v3.0 license, users can review the code themselves. This level of openness creates trust within the community because players know exactly what the software contains. Many users prefer open-source projects because there are fewer concerns regarding hidden malicious behavior.

The active community surrounding the project is another major advantage. Players regularly share farming patterns, optimization tips, hive strategies, and configuration setups. New users often find helpful Discord discussions where experienced farmers explain how to improve honey production or configure settings for specific game stages. This community support makes the learning process much easier.

Customization is where the macro truly shines. Players are not forced into a single farming style. Instead, they can modify movement routes, boost timing, gathering methods, reconnect settings, and field priorities. This allows the macro to adapt to changing account progression. A beginner farming Sunflower Field may use entirely different settings compared to an endgame player farming Pepper Patch or Coconut Field.

The smart default settings also deserve attention. Many automation tools become difficult because users must configure everything from scratch before getting results. Natro Macro avoids this issue by offering ready-to-use presets that work immediately after installation. New players can launch the macro quickly and begin farming without spending hours studying complicated menus.

Regular updates help maintain compatibility whenever Bee Swarm Simulator receives new changes. Roblox games frequently evolve, and outdated automation systems can quickly stop functioning correctly. The development team behind Natro Macro consistently works on improvements and adjustments so users can continue farming smoothly even after game updates.

Performance optimization is another reason many players rely on the software. Efficient movement patterns reduce wasted time inside farming zones. Better timing during boosts and resource collection helps maximize honey gains over long sessions. Small improvements in efficiency eventually lead to massive progression differences over weeks or months of gameplay.

Many players with limited free time find the macro especially useful. Students, office workers, and casual gamers may not have enough hours to grind manually every day. Instead of falling behind, they can maintain progress more efficiently using automated farming sessions. This helps players continue enjoying the strategic side of Bee Swarm Simulator without dedicating endless hours to repetitive actions.

The installation process is surprisingly simple for a tool with so many advanced capabilities. Comprehensive guides help users through every step, from downloading AutoHotkey to configuring field preferences. Even players with little technical experience usually manage to set everything up within minutes.

Another important aspect is resource efficiency. Since the software is lightweight, it runs smoothly on many systems without consuming excessive computer resources. Players can multitask or leave farming sessions active without major performance problems. This makes it practical for long overnight grinding sessions.

The macro also supports different progression strategies. Some players prioritize honey production, while others focus on quests, materials, tickets, or event farming. Natro Macro allows users to shape their automation according to personal priorities instead of forcing one fixed approach.

Over time, Bee Swarm Simulator becomes heavily focused on efficiency. Endgame upgrades require enormous amounts of honey and resources. Manual farming alone can become extremely slow for players trying to unlock advanced equipment and high-level bee upgrades. Automation tools like Natro Macro help bridge this gap and allow players to progress at a more comfortable pace.

One reason the project continues gaining popularity is the trust built through community feedback. Thousands of players actively use the macro and share positive experiences online. Word-of-mouth recommendations have helped the software grow rapidly among Bee Swarm Simulator communities.

The future of farming utilities in Roblox games will likely continue evolving, but Natro Macro has already positioned itself as one of the most respected tools available for Bee Swarm Simulator. Its combination of transparency, flexibility, active development, and community-driven support makes it stand out from ordinary automation scripts.

For players who want faster progression, better honey farming efficiency, and less repetitive grinding, Natro Macro offers a practical solution without removing the strategic depth that makes Bee Swarm Simulator enjoyable. Whether someone is just starting their beekeeping journey or managing a powerful late-game hive, the macro provides tools that can dramatically improve overall productivity and gameplay flow.

body.title: The Slowness Beyond the Lakes – Reichenow
body.body:
![IMG_1114.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EptZaUVT2bAvUqP3VCkkz8xjkCnFftrR5g6FLLvVRQ5eZU8kqbC9xaMnP5F1GJ5Zim7.jpeg)
The farther one moves away from Berlin, the more Brandenburg seems to become not just a landscape, but a state of mind. Beyond Neuruppin, beyond Nauenhof, further northeast still, lies Reichenow—sleepy, tidy, almost lazily resting in the sun.

The trees here seem old enough to remember different times. Their branches cast shadows across quiet paths, and one of the countless lakes lies directly at the doorstep, as though water belongs to Brandenburg as naturally as the sky itself.
![IMG_1116.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EnqRDnznXBzLLVvw5FfKKYGf7VfWWUhaVe8nVUi4UiD63b2QNaQhY7f276mEDgtr6X2.jpeg)
You can walk here for hours without anything happening. Perhaps that is the event itself.

The few locals look at you questioningly. Not hostile—simply puzzled. Nobody normally passes through here. And those who walk usually do so with a destination in mind. In the cities, movement has become casual—people jog, wander, waste time. Out here, every road seems to imply purpose. Maybe that is why a lone walker appears almost disruptive.

And yet, there is a deep sense of ease hanging over everything. Not the cultivated calm of Rüdesheim, where slowness itself feels curated, but something quieter and more natural. Reichenow does not try to be beautiful—and perhaps that is precisely why it is.
![IMG_1115.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EqSUXefqHvFGR4rwFuX1AcNKcw5hh2LJv3daNDLxGuEqUG9pr2ZBszYEpmbRTzG8dJb.jpeg)
The landscape asks nothing of you. The lakes remain still, the houses low to the ground, the air somehow broader than elsewhere.

Germany, on this journey, often reveals itself through contrasts: the intoxicated nights of Sachsenhausen, the weight of the abbey above the Rhine, the near-complete emptiness of Nauenhof. Reichenow, however, is something different. Not a place of extremes, but one in between.

Quiet. Calm. At ease.
- - - 
# Die Langsamkeit hinter den Seen – Reichenow
![IMG_1114.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EptZaUVT2bAvUqP3VCkkz8xjkCnFftrR5g6FLLvVRQ5eZU8kqbC9xaMnP5F1GJ5Zim7.jpeg)
Je weiter man sich von Berlin entfernt, desto mehr scheint Brandenburg nicht nur eine Landschaft zu werden, sondern ein Zustand. Hinter Neuruppin, hinter Nauenhof, noch weiter nordöstlich, liegt Reichenow – verschlafen, aufgeräumt, fast ein wenig träge in der Sonne.

Die Bäume hier wirken alt genug, um sich an andere Zeiten zu erinnern. Ihre Kronen werfen Schatten auf stille Wege, und einer der vielen Seen liegt direkt vor der Haustür, als gehöre Wasser in Brandenburg so selbstverständlich dazu wie der Himmel selbst.
![IMG_1116.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EnqRDnznXBzLLVvw5FfKKYGf7VfWWUhaVe8nVUi4UiD63b2QNaQhY7f276mEDgtr6X2.jpeg)
Man kann hier lange spazieren gehen, ohne dass etwas passiert. Vielleicht ist genau das das Ereignis.

Die wenigen Einheimischen schauen einen fragend an. Nicht feindselig, eher verwundert. Hier kommt normalerweise niemand vorbei. Und wer hier läuft, der läuft üblicherweise nicht einfach so. In den Städten ist Bewegung selbstverständlich geworden – man joggt, flaniert, verliert Zeit. Hier draußen scheint jeder Weg ein Ziel zu haben. Vielleicht deshalb wirkt ein Spaziergänger wie eine kleine Irritation im Ablauf des Tages.

Und doch liegt über allem eine angenehme Gelassenheit. Nicht die touristische Ruhe von Rüdesheim, wo die Langsamkeit fast kultiviert wird, sondern eine unaufgeregte Selbstverständlichkeit. Reichenow versucht nicht, schön zu sein – und ist es gerade deshalb.
![IMG_1115.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EqSUXefqHvFGR4rwFuX1AcNKcw5hh2LJv3daNDLxGuEqUG9pr2ZBszYEpmbRTzG8dJb.jpeg)
Die Landschaft verlangt nichts von einem. Die Seen liegen still, die Häuser geduckt, die Luft scheint breiter zu sein als anderswo.

Deutschland zeigt sich auf dieser Reise oft in Gegensätzen: der Rausch von Sachsenhausen, die Schwere der Abtei über dem Rhein, die beinahe vollkommene Leere von Nauenhof. Reichenow aber ist etwas anderes. Kein Ort der Extreme, sondern einer des Dazwischen.

Still. Ruhig. Gelassen.
- - -
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/23uFw4wD1whzpoukjFUdhNoHxdhgKCoZzsxti2HenTa18jJ5TYm17wK6QamCr6rbq7DRZ.png)

body.title: The Dolomites are not just mountains
body.body:
The Dolomites are not just mountains, but a cathedral of nature raised between heaven and earth. Their rocks seem to be on fire at sunset, and each peak tells an ancient story, carried by the Alpine winds. Mornings bring an almost unreal silence, when the clouds lie like a white sea under the lofty ridges, and the clear lakes reflect the infinity of the sky.

![20260121_162913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4oVJymGRY6qMCy3RJCWxNH8Vsww4GmXfxVCcDbAYHf8/20260121_162913.jpg)

![20260121_162922.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaw2im1PvF3MAsVG7s19HxNi3crw54ga9cs3ZR1mxXemW/20260121_162922.jpg)

![20260121_162938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUssXhvBn2ELB3K5ZF6WBfLbqxY6jYuk19w8w6if46Hqm/20260121_162938.jpg)

Here, time does not rush. The forests smell of resin and freedom, the paths lead to places where the modern world seems to disappear, and the light changes the landscape from one moment to the next, like in a living painting. The Dolomites are the pure emotion of nature — wild, elegant and impossible to forget.

body.title: La mentira innecesaria también rompe algo.  [ES/EN]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaftzt2yakmio35kU82Sbjo3V61tozJ6TVR39VgnZBFEt/coombesy_corridor_495262_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/corridor-path-tunnel-light-495262/)

---


🇪🇸 En Español

# La mentira innecesaria también rompe algo

---

Hola querida comunidad @holos-lotus,

Hay mentiras que nacen del miedo.  
Otras nacen del interés.  
Y algunas, quizás las más desconcertantes, aparecen sin que realmente exista necesidad de mentir.

Son esas las que más me hacen pensar.

---

En estos tiempos de crisis energética en Cuba, muchos trabajadores vivimos situaciones que hace algunos años habrían parecido absurdas. En mi caso, por la distancia y la falta de combustible, paso gran parte de la semana albergado en un hotel cercano al lugar donde trabajo.

Y ahí, entre pasillos silenciosos y habitaciones vacías de un hotel que alguna vez fue pensado para turistas, terminé viviendo una situación pequeña en apariencia, pero que me dejó pensando mucho más de lo esperado.

---

Después de varios problemas anteriores, finalmente me asignaron una habitación solo para mí. La utilizo de jueves a lunes y, cuando regreso a casa, entrego la llave para que la habitación pueda seguir utilizándose.

Nunca tuve problema con eso.

De hecho, siempre entendí que era lo lógico.

En un país con limitaciones materiales, donde todo debe reutilizarse y optimizarse, sería absurdo pretender que una habitación permanezca vacía varios días solo porque yo no estoy.

---

La semana anterior había ocurrido un problema con la cerradura electrónica de la puerta. El llavín estaba fallando por falta de mantenimiento y las baterías daban problemas. Incluso llegué a pasar varias horas sin poder entrar.

Por eso, antes de irme, le comenté a mi jefe algo muy simple:

> “Si alguien usa la habitación esta semana, dile que tenga cuidado con la puerta y no le dé tirones fuertes para no terminar quedándonos ambos sin acceso.”

Era una observación práctica. Nada más.

---

Cuando regresé el jueves siguiente, pregunté si alguien había usado la habitación.

Mi jefe me respondió que no.

Me lo dijo mirándome directamente a los ojos.

Y aunque no dije nada en ese momento, hay cosas que uno aprende a percibir con los años.

---

Las llaves estaban colocadas de una manera diferente a como yo las había dejado.

Pequeño detalle.

Pequeña alarma.

---

Entré a la habitación y encontré el baño sucio, restos de cigarros y la ausencia de la toalla.

Yo no fumo.

Nunca he fumado.

---

En ese momento entró la camarera para limpiar y cambiar las sábanas. Al reclamar la falta de la toalla, me respondió que si no aparecía una toalla sucia, entonces no podía entregarme una limpia.

Por un instante tuve que respirar profundo.

Porque la escena tenía algo casi surrealista.

Yo acababa de llegar y tenía que explicar que no podía entregar una toalla que jamás había usado.

---

Al final la situación se resolvió, pero ya para entonces la mentira había empezado a desmoronarse sola.

Y aun así, decidí no confrontar directamente a mi jefe.

Solo mencioné que la habitación evidentemente había sido utilizada.

Su respuesta fue una evasiva:
que quizás alguien del personal había entrado.

Y sí, técnicamente era posible.

---

Pero hay algo curioso con la mentira:
cuando aparece, empieza a dejar pequeñas grietas alrededor.

---

Al día siguiente fui a buscar una sombrilla del recipiente que estaba en la entrada de la habitación.

No estaban.

Las dos habían desaparecido.

---

Subí entonces a hablar nuevamente con mi jefe. Se activó una revisión de seguridad y terminaron comprobando en cámaras quién había utilizado la habitación y quién se había llevado las sombrillas.

Exactamente la persona cuya estancia había sido negada desde el inicio.

---

Y ahí ocurrió lo más interesante de toda la historia:

yo no sentí sorpresa.

Ni rabia.

Ni siquiera satisfacción por haber tenido razón.

Sentí cansancio.

---

Porque al final las sombrillas son lo de menos.

Incluso la toalla es lo de menos.

Lo verdaderamente triste es descubrir que alguien con quien trabajas todos los días siente la necesidad de mentirte por algo que ni siquiera requería ocultarse.

---

Nunca exigí exclusividad sobre la habitación.

Nunca protesté porque otro la usara.

Nunca habría generado un conflicto por eso.

Todo el problema nació únicamente de una mentira innecesaria.

---

Y eso me hizo pensar en algo que ocurre mucho más allá de esta anécdota.

Vivimos rodeados de pequeñas manipulaciones cotidianas.
Respuestas incompletas.
Verdades acomodadas.
Explicaciones diseñadas para evitar conversaciones simples.

Como si muchas personas hubieran aprendido que mentir resulta más fácil que hablar claro.

---

Pero la mentira tiene un problema silencioso:

no destruye solamente la confianza en un hecho.

Desgasta la naturalidad de la relación.

---

Porque después de eso ya uno no escucha igual.

Empieza a revisar gestos.
Tonos.
Versiones.

Y trabajar así resulta agotador.

---

Existe un refrán muy conocido que dice que “la mentira tiene patas cortas”.

Y creo que no se refiere solamente a que eventualmente será descubierta.

Creo que también habla de otra cosa:

la mentira nunca llega demasiado lejos sin empezar a tropezar consigo misma.

---

Al final, todo esto me dejó una pregunta más humana que laboral:

> ¿Cómo se sigue construyendo normalidad con alguien que miente incluso cuando no necesita hacerlo?

Tal vez esa sea una de las formas más silenciosas en que se deterioran los vínculos humanos.

No por grandes traiciones.

Sino por pequeñas falsedades repetidas que terminan convirtiendo la convivencia en algo incómodo.

---

Gracias por leerme.

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue realizada con DeepL Translate.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaftzt2yakmio35kU82Sbjo3V61tozJ6TVR39VgnZBFEt/coombesy_corridor_495262_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/corridor-path-tunnel-light-495262/)

---

🇬🇧 In English

# Unnecessary Lies Also Break Something

---

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,

There are lies born from fear.  
Others are born from personal interest.  
And some, perhaps the most unsettling ones, appear even when there is no real need to lie at all.

Those are the ones that make me think the most.

---

In these times of energy crisis in Cuba, many workers are living situations that a few years ago would have seemed absurd. In my case, because of the distance and the lack of fuel, I spend most of the week staying in a hotel near my workplace.

And there, among silent hallways and empty rooms in a hotel that was once meant for tourists, I ended up experiencing something that seemed small on the surface but left me reflecting much more deeply than I expected.

---

After several previous problems, I was finally assigned a room for myself alone. I use it from Thursday to Monday and, when I return home, I hand over the key so the room can continue being used.

I never had a problem with that.

In fact, I always understood it as something logical.

In a country with material shortages, where everything has to be reused and optimized, it would be absurd to expect a room to remain empty for several days just because I am not there.

---

The previous week there had been an issue with the electronic lock on the door. The mechanism was failing due to poor maintenance, and the batteries were causing problems. I even spent several hours unable to enter the room.

So before leaving, I told my boss something very simple:

> “If someone uses the room this week, tell them to be careful with the door and not pull too hard on it so we do not both end up locked out.”

It was just a practical observation. Nothing more.

---

When I returned the following Thursday, I asked whether someone had used the room.

My boss answered no.

He said it while looking directly into my eyes.

And although I said nothing at the moment, there are things you learn to notice after fifty years of life.

---

The keys were placed differently from how I had left them.

A small detail.

A small warning sign.

---

I entered the room and found the bathroom dirty, cigarette remains, and the towel missing.

I do not smoke.

I never have.

---

At that moment, the housekeeper entered to clean and change the sheets. When I mentioned the missing towel, she replied that if there was no dirty towel to collect, then she could not give me a clean one.

For a moment, I had to breathe deeply.

Because the situation felt almost surreal.

I had just arrived and somehow had to explain that I could not hand over a towel I had never even used.

---

In the end the situation was resolved, but by then the lie had already started collapsing on its own.

And even so, I decided not to directly confront my boss.

I only mentioned that the room had obviously been used.

His response was evasive:
that maybe someone from the staff had entered.

And yes, technically that was possible.

---

But there is something curious about lies:

once they appear, they begin leaving small cracks everywhere around them.

---

The next day I went to get one of the umbrellas from the holder near the room entrance.

They were gone.

Both of them had disappeared.

---

So I went upstairs to speak with my boss again. Security reviewed the cameras and eventually confirmed who had used the room and who had taken the umbrellas.

Exactly the same person whose stay had been denied from the very beginning.

---

And that was when the most interesting part of the whole situation appeared:

I did not feel surprised.

Nor angry.

Not even satisfied about being right.

I felt tired.

---

Because in the end, the umbrellas are the least important thing.

Even the towel is the least important thing.

What is truly sad is discovering that someone you work with every day feels the need to lie to you about something that never even needed to be hidden.

---

I never demanded exclusive use of the room.

I never complained about someone else using it.

I would never have created conflict over that.

The entire problem was born only from an unnecessary lie.

---

And that made me think about something that goes far beyond this anecdote.

We live surrounded by small everyday manipulations.
Incomplete answers.
Adjusted truths.
Explanations designed to avoid simple conversations.

As if many people had learned that lying is easier than speaking honestly.

---

But lies have a silent problem:

they do not only destroy trust in a specific fact.

They wear down the naturalness of the relationship itself.

---

Because after that, you never listen in the same way again.

You start paying attention to gestures.
Tones.
Versions of events.

And working like that becomes exhausting.

---

There is a very common saying that “lies have short legs.”

And I think it means more than simply being discovered eventually.

I think it also points to something else:

lies never travel very far before they begin tripping over themselves.

---

In the end, all of this left me with a more human question than a work-related one:

> How do you continue building normality with someone who lies even when there is no need to do so?

Perhaps that is one of the quietest ways human relationships begin to deteriorate.

Not because of great betrayals.

But because of repeated small falsehoods that slowly turn coexistence into something uncomfortable.

---

Thank you for reading.

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done using DeepL Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

body.body:
Hello there! It is great to see you again. For now, we have a nice group of hosts, so no need of any new application. For the next hangout, we will have @daverick invited host. Also, don't forget that 3 posts from our members who participate in the new hangout will be considered for curations Last session, we discussed the topic: --- ### **Kids and Health** --- Last week, we gave a continuation about an important topic concerning our kids. Since they are going to be our future, we keep asking if we are treating them as they should. And health is a big concern. Kids are staying more indoors and eating more unhealthy food since parents don't have time to dedicate to home sometimes because of their work routines. So the community was sincere about their thoughts on this problem and how it can be managed. In conclusion, society needs to change its point of view about its growing kids. --- **THIS WEEK'S TOPIC:** --- ##
MENTAL STRESS OR PHYSICAL STRESS?
--- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23xyteUzrnFQV3o3XWSH2VM5kksrTZyR4VHkYof4ixuoFy1c1L4UJoKr8zoMu4ZU9in3h.png) We live in a world where stress is prevalent. For one reason or another, people tend to get stressed. And it seems like as the days go by, the stress levels increase. We've come to know stress in the form of mental and physical. As the name suggests, stress can be mentally; affecting a person psychologically and emotionally. Or it can be physical; affecting a person's body and their physical aspects. **Discussion Questions:** -What do you think of both mental and physical stress? -What are some of the causes of both types of stress? -Would you say one type is more deadly or presents more destructive effects than the other? -Which would you say is more prevalent in our world today? -How can one manage and/or avoid stress in any form? body.title: Жизнь — это бумеранг.
body.body:
![1000151046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRnjPH4Ud7qSs71eNX5qoRAXxPmw1PoWRpezDGFUkR4FT/1000151046.jpg)

Мне 40. Возможно для кого-то покажется это много. Когда мне было 20, я тоже так думала. А сейчас я понимаю , что это самое то. Самое лучшее время, чтобы жить. Есть образование , есть профессия , есть взрослые дети... Есть опыт и мечта!

‎Я продолжаю двигаться  дальше учиться ,развиваться ,создавать  что-то  новое и трудиться  для близких .И это время я могу вкладывать в себя .
‎
‎Жизнь, она ведь живая. Она словно река постоянно в движении.Дни за днями, недели, месяцы и годы пролетают.Однажды и это пройдёт...

‎А сейчас я живу и наслаждаюсь жизнью. Жизнь, которая наполнилась ароматами весны!

‎Жизнь , которая полна чудес!
‎
‎Знаешь, всё пройдёт! Чёрная полоса однажды закончится и начнётся белая.Ты только не сдавайся, не опускай руки.И даже если упал, вставай. Кто не падал?! Не ты первый и не ты последний !Там, где закрывается одна дверь, открываются другие .А если мир вокруг кажется серым и невзрачным возьми краски и сам раскрась его.Помни после тёмной ночи всегда наступает рассвет. 

Твои печали, переживания, страхи проплывают , как облака. Они гонимы ветром. Твоя боль утихнет. Твои слёзы однажды обратятся в смех. И за каждый подвиг души ты получишь награду. Ведь жизнь-бумеранг. К нам возвращается всё, чем мы поделились с другими.
‎
Всё пройдёт мой, друг и это тоже!
‎
Всё пройдёт!
‎

body.title: The Dolomites are not just mountains
body.body:
The Dolomites are not just mountains, but a cathedral of nature raised between heaven and earth. Their rocks seem to be on fire at sunset, and each peak tells an ancient story, carried by the Alpine winds. Mornings bring an almost unreal silence, when the clouds lie like a white sea under the lofty ridges, and the clear lakes reflect the infinity of the sky.


![20260121_162913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4oVJymGRY6qMCy3RJCWxNH8Vsww4GmXfxVCcDbAYHf8/20260121_162913.jpg)

![20260121_162922.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaw2im1PvF3MAsVG7s19HxNi3crw54ga9cs3ZR1mxXemW/20260121_162922.jpg)

![20260121_162938.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUssXhvBn2ELB3K5ZF6WBfLbqxY6jYuk19w8w6if46Hqm/20260121_162938.jpg)


Here, time does not rush. The forests smell of resin and freedom, the paths lead to places where the modern world seems to disappear, and the light changes the landscape from one moment to the next, like in a living painting. The Dolomites are the pure emotion of nature — wild, elegant and impossible to forget.

Photos taken with the Galaxy S24 Ultra mobile phone

body.title: Being Educated Or Being Wise, What Is The Difference?
body.body:
>

Education and wisdom are sometimes confused to mean the same thing, but there are differences in both of them. You will be surprised to know that someone can be very educated, yet might also make a couple of foolish decisions. Yet someone else may not even have any formal education or maybe a little of it, yet they display high level of wisdom in the way they think and live. It is true that education may give you knowledge, but wisdom is actually what teaches the understanding and practical application of the knowledge. Knowing the difference between education and wisdom is very fundamental for personal growth and success in life.

<center>![pexels-thisisengineering-19895774.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjJVpki8yqttckYoxYrKyDmfkQDNYj43Fu71c7LKvfBS/pexels-thisisengineering-19895774.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/people-with-laptops-at-lecture-in-technical-school-19895774)</sub></center>

In the street where I lived before, there was this professor who lived there too. This man was being paid well, obviously because of his position and the qualifications he has. But you will always observe him making some very careless financial decisions. In fact, before the month was over, he would be owing the shop woman that owns a supermarket down the street. When the salary comes, he will offset the bill and the circle will be repeated again. With his education and academic prowess, it did not teach him how to manage his finances well. He obviously lacked wisdom in that particular aspect of his life.

Yet, in the same street, there was this woman who was barely educated. From her story, he stopped school at secondary, yet over the years, she had accumulated so much wisdom, even beyond what may be taught in school. She managed her resources very well even though she was not paid too much. She also learnt how to manage conflict, and she also took honest advice and feedback even from the younger ones. From what she was earning as a support staff, she was able to start up a side hustle. The business grew to the point the she started employing people to help her. Before the time I left the neighborhood, she had well over 5 staff, including the people with college degree.

It is true that education is good, because it teaches facts, theories, skills, and the \

of life. This often comes through schooling, reading books, training, and other academic experiences. Of course, education helps one to understand the concept of science, mathematics, art, technology, and many more aspects of life. This can also open doors to some opportunities. However, there is something that goes way beyond just information; it is called wisdom. This is the ability to apply the knowledge that you have correctly, so that you will be able to make sound and good decisions. This also involves understanding people, situations, timing, and even consequences. Wisdom does not only show what someone knows, but how they have applied what they know in a practical situation. Take this instance, an educated person may be taught that anger can damage relationships, so they already know it. But a wise person will know how to control their anger when the time comes for it. An educated person may understand the principles of finance and the related theories, but a wise person will know how to manage money responsibly in order to avoid unnecessary problems. It is wisdom that will turn your knowledge into practical living, and into results.
![pexels-yankrukov-8197553.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfLqgZd9X98EUcN4DuoDE77i3gn2giZvUHinjrJr5yqPk/pexels-yankrukov-8197553.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/man-teaching-students-in-a-university-8197553)
One of the major things that differentiate education from wisdom is that education can be taught directly, while wisdom is oftentimes acquired over time through experience, observation, interaction with people, and through reflection. Wisdom also grows when you learn from mistakes, listen to advice, and understand deeply the true meaning of life. One of the things that I have observed in life is that some of the wisest people are not necessarily the people with the most academic qualifications, but people who have learnt vital life lessons through experiences. It is worthy to note that the best approach in life is to go after both education and wisdom. You do not have to sacrifice one for the other because both of them are equally important. Education will give you the knowledge and the opportunities you need, while you need wisdom to be able to use the opportunities properly and to apply the knowledge in the right way. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Завершення альтанки
body.body:
Нещодавно [розпочате будівництво альтанки](https://peakd.com/hive-165469/@valentinalife/buduyemo-omriyanu-altanku) у нашому дворі завершилось. Минуло зовсім небагато часу з моменту, коли ми закупили будматеріали і чоловік почав цю роботу. 

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Eq7KydtHzmGWYHJUM9cBjEbFRHzxnX7HpEPks5KHicvYxkDSZg2GXk75YSH5tG8NLNU.jpg)

З допомогою сусіда, в якого є станок для обробки деревини, він заготував всі необхідні бруси для збірки основи. Стола вирішили робити пізніше, щоб не перевантажувати сусіда роботою. І вже за кілька днів чоловік зібрав цього \

. Складність була тільки в пошуку необхідних кріплень, болтів та шурупів певного розміру: збирав їх по кілька штук по всіх існуючих у містечку магазинах, причому для столу знову прийшлося обійти це коло. 

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23xATutyogMNuyvUTiQUrDqoPTf6euPj1LNxmATJ3FmeWkTQk8gp5eZGY2fu9zGzGZWx9.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/242rtsoQiDoRRuVYw9ZjXvGm5pfDnQa4KtsJeuZ5CkxtZq5grDGmyGQLGY5bumDzJDvhd.jpg)

А ще у нас не продається ондулін, яким ми вирішили накрити альтанку. Ну от найдешевше покриття, здавалось би, має користуватися попитом, - а ні. Продавчиня одна сказала, що вже кілька років його не завозять, бо нема покупців. А нам до найближчого містечка, де більший вибір будматеріалів, їхати 40 кілометрів. При нинішніх цінах навіть на газу це дорого, та й шкода час витрачати на поїздки. Тому знайшли по рекламі бувший у використанні ондулін, і він прекрасно виконує тепер свою роботу.
А от стола через раптове погіршення здоров'я сусіда прийшлося робити вручну, без деревообробного верстату. Тому і часу було потрачено більше на його виробництво. Зате він вийшов надійним, міцним та величезним! А сусід через пару днів виписався з лікарні, благополучно подолавши недугу. І пообіцяв таки відшліфувати в майбутньому деревину стола. Щоб по феншую було. Ага.😉

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EonnVGZH7YZDbmkU8Ggqp4sJHY7yRZpjwy3eVHdoFGqwjKkfWnaFZXpcnmgHXyUtzJs.jpg)

А мені тепер треба облагородити все навколо альтанки за допомогою квітів. Тут вже посаджені кущі барбарису та жимолості. Є і малесенька гліцинія, що має вирости і пишно квітнути ранніми веснами. Тож - виростимо їх, додамо ще чогось прекрасного, і в майбутньому отримаємо райський куточок. А каву пити тут під спів пташок можна вже.

body.title: How expensive is a residential elevator?
body.body:
#

![How expensive is a residential elevator.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/0aca87a4f19af80632e771cf32f453bb1ac0a321185a642b82f8ec58ac2a49e9)



A [residential elevator](https://atticoelevators.com/category/residential-elevator/) can cost anywhere between ₹8 lakhs to ₹35 lakhs or more, depending on the type, size, design, and features you choose. Simple home elevators for small houses are usually more affordable, while luxury elevators with automatic doors, glass cabins, and smart controls are more expensive.

Hydraulic elevators are generally budget-friendly and suitable for low-rise homes. Traction elevators cost more but offer smoother and quieter performance with better energy efficiency. MRL (Machine Room Less) elevators are also popular because they save space and provide a modern look.

The total cost also depends on factors like:

*   Number of floors

*   Elevator capacity

*   Cabin design and materials

*   Safety features

*   Installation requirements

*   Maintenance services

Apart from the elevator price, homeowners should also consider civil work, electrical setup, and annual maintenance costs. Choosing a trusted lift company is important to ensure long-term safety, reliability, and smooth operation.

If you are planning to install a home lift, compare different models and choose one that matches your budget, home structure, and future needs. Companies like Attico Elevators provide customized residential elevator solutions with modern technology, stylish designs, and professional installation support.

body.title: Balancing Life with Faith: Preparing for Our Upcoming Fiesta While Serving the Community
body.body:
![Brown and White Vintage Travel Memories Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48PwnGvgVJshTuQ6pMGLif9EGFEgij9g9Y9wENUFa4t2Xgq3e1hrz7KrXV28nwe5dd.jpg)

Hello everyone! Balancing life as a mother, wife, farmer, church worker, and freelancer is never easy. There are days when I wake up early to prepare food, check our farm, take care of my child, finish online work, and still attend meetings in our community and church. Life gets busy, exhausting, and sometimes overwhelming, but through all these responsibilities, I learned that serving others also gives peace and fulfillment to the heart. 


![IMG_20260514_091114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wC9njkfwmiGaSEceQDs19wxF6wxHgnmWYNdfkewGnVc3xJtp9LT1g8cr2fzcektrt3S.jpg)

As a farmer’s wife and a mother, I already have many responsibilities at home. Farming is not easy because it requires physical strength, patience, and hard work every single day. Freelancing also needs focus and discipline because clients expect quality work and deadlines must be met. At the same time, being a wife and a mother means giving love, guidance, and attention to my family. 



There are moments when I feel physically tired and emotionally drained, but I still choose to participate in our community and church activities because I know these things also help me grow spiritually and emotionally. Freelancing can be draining, so I find happiness through serving our community, church, and spending meaningful time with others.

![IMG_20260515_101219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wWtdNjhRR4WH3US6GG34wN4Y5vEk53K7jSfnQVaWZ8MuG4hz2tTJwACwqfHBNAzLFNF.jpg)

Our church is also preparing for the upcoming patronal fiesta of our beloved patron, Sr. San Isidro Labrador. Our GKK members are excited, cooperative, and supportive of our plans this year. One of our main activities is the carabao parade. Even if it will be simple, we want it to become memorable and meaningful for everyone. This year, there are limitations because of the economic crisis and the LGU memorandum, so many activities were minimized. Even without big competitions and expensive programs, we still focus on encouraging members to become active and involved. So I encourage my members to contribute a vegetablles or whatever their harvest to offer it in our church and we will decorate it during our carabao parade. 

Despite the challenges, I admire how our members continue to help and support each other. We scheduled meetings, cleaned the church together, and prepared snacks after our activities. During one of our clean-up days, I shared ingredients for our snacks while one of our members volunteered to cook binignit for everyone. Simple acts like these may look small to others, but for me, they show unity, kindness, and willingness to serve.


![IMG_20260515_105407.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23x16w3htCu1qMKM1aKH87AXXfD62GdTL7NAmpkBpezH5z8KQn6qTi75zCzDtQyhQAa6R.jpg)

![IMG_20260515_105404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wX1YM1wtwJsJLfykM8NdzMaC1m1mT4udLVcN5dkJUUVeoKkGEkX5V8yHHVyvwnoJBBE.jpg)

![Brown and White Vintage Travel Memories Photo Collage (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48QuPGHZHN4RcEgpAQiK9LuQAowfLDQLEYs7zYqSnXrPrh3EkySLPEXXsjE75wqYoF.png)

As the GKK president and also the vice president in our chapel, I carry big responsibilities. I attend meetings, help organize activities, and assist in preparing programs. There are times when handling people becomes stressful because not everyone participates actively, and some are difficult to convince. Still, I understand that every person has different situations in life, so I continue to encourage them with patience and understanding.


![IMG_20260515_093853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8oLodXsMHoTGu8ApKSjQkqNxNXuTVpLC2qP1qxEE9nt5FC7jpnByhAZqcgcMQnn4PS.jpg)

![IMG_20260515_101939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23sUEoYcvXANjk34pwgMJpGSRVdb9RVNfdMka4vYHTk6KQWx6LqGbbAMuSX8diQWXwUjv.jpg)

There was also a time when I wanted to step down as GKK president because facilitating programs and competitions can be difficult. I worried that if our GKK won, people might think I was being biased since I was the one who prepared the criteria and guidelines. Despite my intentions to stay fair, our group still won, and I hoped others would understand that everything was done honestly and fairly. Leadership is not easy because aside from responsibilities, you also carry the opinions and expectations of many people.

Through all these experiences, I realized that serving the community and the church is not about recognition. It is about love, patience, sacrifice, and faith. Yes, there is stress and exhaustion, but there is also joy and fulfillment in knowing that despite the busyness of life, we can still share our time, talents, and blessings with others.


![IMG_20260515_101155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2m3U6V1tJ9NaNd2DiMFuYVT9K4uaHXUbpGjbcT6bhsAPfjPndhagRcufE8bhujqMts.jpg)


I believe that when we continue to serve with sincerity and love, God sees every sacrifice we make. The reward may not always come immediately, but the happiness and fulfillment in our hearts are already blessings we can treasure every day.

![IMG_20260515_101430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMh2aWx8Li27YgiCLihPFtakcZyxTFERjQ6n91D1cyZ2cNvKhuPi9476gC47cmADWCZ.jpg)

Thank you for reading my story. This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. Have a nice day! 💛

Alo is very happy to be able to capture the beauty of this flower through photography. Although these flowers were quite beautiful, and although they were small, they were a very beautiful home decoration. I thoroughly enjoyed the beauty of this flower which I would like to share with you.

body.title: A piece of joy in my life: my beloved bird June.
body.body:
> ![IMG20250725191450~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ98woidbbUt95ipZZ2cC8d7YnhxLjkt3twBzhb3VzrYo/IMG20250725191450~2.jpg) Blockchain friends, Assalamu Alaikum. I hope everyone is well. Today I will introduce you to the smallest but most important member of my family. She is my beloved cockatiel bird June. If I had not seen June, I would not have believed that birds can be such good friends to humans. June is not just a bird, she is a magical source of alleviating my daily boredom. Whenever I get tired of doing housework or feel down, her sweet chirping and playfulness instantly cheer me up. ![IMG20250725191453~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUbp9s7Cv8mJqv6JAdTXtD3JDxNoxXAAeTWZExudNjXNr/IMG20250725191453~2.jpg) June is so beautiful to look at. MashaAllah. Her white feathers, bright yellow head and red cheeks are like a painting by a skilled artist. Her big black eyes are always curious. Cockatiels are usually very social, and June is no exception. She wants to be around me all the time. When I talk, she listens very attentively—sometimes it feels like she understands everything I say! Every moment spent with June is special. Her favorite thing to do is swing on the swing in her cage and sometimes call out with strange sounds. Her joy is palpable when I feed her. Especially when she gets a grain or food she likes, her fidgetiness increases several times. When I give June time, she lowers her head and comes towards me so that I can pat her on the head. These little acts of love make my day complete. ![IMG20250725191649~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY2q2WVbw5dBKWeongMApwphSzRS6docT7oLcRm4Zewdf/IMG20250725191649~2.jpg) Many people may think that keeping birds in cages is difficult. But I believe that if proper care, balanced food, and love are given, these little creatures can also spend a beautiful life with us. June has enlivened my home environment. Her presence has taught me to be patient and has increased my love for nature. There is a great lack of peace in our busy lives. June is my peace. Those of you who love animals must know how much selfless love these little creatures can give. Everyone please pray for my June so that she is always healthy and happy. ___ |

body.title: Bajo Tu Manto (Vol. II): Cuando Su voz calma nuestras tempestades.
body.body: ​¡Hola de nuevo, amigos de la comunidad!\n​Después de unos días de ausencia debido a las dificultades con la electricidad y la conexión que a veces nos toca enfrentar, por fin puedo sentarme a compartir con ustedes la segunda entrega de mi poemario \

. Qué oportuno se siente volver precisamente con este tema, porque la vida nos pone tormentas de todo tipo, pero la fe nos sostiene.\n​Como les conté en la primera publicación, este libro nació de un mandato divino en agosto de 2025. Hoy quiero dejarles la segunda sección, titulada \

. Son versos nacidos en el Alfarero, en esos momentos donde las fuerzas humanas no alcanzan y entendemos que basta una sola palabra del Creador para que todo cambie.
​Espero que estos poemas sean ese susurro de calma que tu corazón necesita hoy.
​SECCIÓN II: TU VOZ CALMA LA TEMPESTAD
​9. BASTA UNA PALABRA
​No necesitas, Dios mío,
ejércitos de ángeles
fuego del cielo.
​Basta una palabra tuya.
La fiebre huye,
el cáncer huye,
la muerte huye.
​Basta una sílaba
de tu aliento creador
para que lo que no era,
sea.
​10. EL ALFARERO
​Tomaste el barro de mi derrota,
la arcilla gris de mis fracasos.
​Tus dedos sabios
presionaron con paciencia
la grieta de mi alma.
​Hoy, no soy un jarrón perfecto,
pero sí contenedor
de Tu agua viva.
​Eres el Alfarero,
yo, el cántico de barro
que lleva Tu esperanza.
​11. DIOS DE LO IMPOSIBLE
​Lo imposible
es Tu territorio,
Tu lugar favorito
para plantar un jardín.
​Donde la ciencia dice \

.
Donde la lógica se rompe,
Tú tejes un milagro.
​Dios de lo imposible,
que mi mente
no ponga límites
a Tu poder de crear.
​12. TÚ MANDAS A LA TORMENTA
​La tormenta ruge
con furia de león.
Cree que es dueña
del cielo y del mar.
​Pero tú levantas
una mano serena.
​Un susurro:
\

.
​Y el león
se convierte
en un cordero
a tus pies.
​13. FE QUE MUEVE MONTAÑAS
​No es fe en la fe,
eso es un espejismo.
​Es fe en Ti,
eso es un cimiento.
​La montaña
no se mueve
por mi fuerza de voluntad,
sino porque Tú,
desde antes de la fundación del mundo,
decidiste
que era hora
de que se mudara.
​14. CIMIENTOS EN LA ROCA
​No construí
sobre arenas movedizas
de emociones o lógica.
Cavé hondo,
hasta encontrar
la Roca de los siglos.
​Ahora,
aunque vengan vientos,
aunque se alcen ríos
y golpeen mi casa,
solo tiemblan
—y se desgastan—
ellos.
Mi cimiento
es un susurro eterno:
“En Mí, estáis seguros”.
