body.title: Just another low effort post
body.body:
Alright, I am back around again to spell out my ponderous thoughts and mayhaps (if I am lucky) clear my mind of some of what is lurking 'around the edges' in it. Since, I am well aware of having not been in the greatest head-space over the last few years... making these entries need to start taking more priority because they may well be the only damned thing keeping me *even close* to remaining on an even keel.

Per usual, I have also been thinking about the journey that I have made over the previous decade (with sharing my life and such) and although (on some truly messed up level) it has been good for developing my writing, not feeling super isolated or alienated from others and all that jazz... it has also been a massive fucking failure in damned near every way possible. Given that failure will never 'make or break me' it is no wonder that I keep chugging along (the way that I do) because at least I am *successfully archiving* said failures!

I know that plenty of folks would be 'angry at the world' or just be downright resentful at this point... but alas (to the great chagrin of many) I am undoubtedly made of sterner stuff. For what it is worth, I often get quite the chuckle at watching the 'circle-jerk crowd' congratulating/rewarding each other as if what they are doing is actually meaningful... or whether it is actually contributing to anything *other than* someone else's (or their own) bottom line in a strictly monetary way. 

In other words, I see it all for the shallowness that it truly is... and no amount of 'mulling it all over' ever results in me going: Wow they are really nailing it when it comes to showing the true nature of their 'awesome' humanity. I mean there is 'excelling at something' and then there is *excelling at something* and whoa so many folks are just 'knocking it out of the fucking park' in that regard.

The truly shit part for me personally, is that those kinds of folks tend to project that very same shallowness (that their words and actions continually put on full display) onto everyone else that they encounter. To those folks, I just have this to say: Some of us actually value what is important and *your* small minded shit opinions and/or projections matter less than zero to anyone with half a fucking brain and the ability to think for themselves.

I get it though, because in all too many folk's minds everyone is out for themselves, everyone serves the almighty 'dollar' and *everyone* is out to take advantage (or trick) everyone else. There is an old saying that comes to mind in regards to all that jazz... and it goes like this: Bullshitters only truly bullshit themselves.

For my part, I mainly just stay in my damned lane in life... and keep moving forward the best that I can without carrying around a bunch of hate, anger or resentment in my heart. Which honestly, is a hell of a lot trickier than it sounds considering the monumentally-sized piece of shit humans that I tend to encounter along the way... but that said... it is also a hell of a lot *easier* than it sounds... because (although rare) there are folks that are genuine, authentic humans... whom have not replaced their *inherent value* with monetary aspirations, consumerism and product fetishism.

Do not worry, I totally get why folks 'swim in the shallow end of the pool' and why the 'road most traveled' is so damned appealing to them... given how well it unshackles folks from having any desire to be responsible stewards of the planet... instead of treating it the way a parasite treats a host. Not to overuse a popular saying but: Infinite growth in a finite system is the very definition of cancerous behavior.

Anyways, I did not anticipate all that 'popping out of me' when I sat down to write this... but lately I have been thinking a lot about the 'sharing aspect' of my life (in regards to the previous decade) and how (a few million words later) I am not really all that better off than I was before. That thought (oddly enough) is always accompanied by a lurking suspicion that I would have been *much better off* keeping my fucking mouth shut, not sharing fuck all with the world... and generally sparing myself the *fucking all encompassing absolute headache* I have dealt with (both mentally and technically) along the damned way!

If you are reading this and seeing anger in my words... then let me spell this out to you in a very clear and concise manner: Try keeping your fucking *petty projections* to yourself... because most folks have never dealt with a tenth of the hardship that I have... and thus they have zero understanding as to how it is possible (for someone that has) to not just 'rise above' such things... but to not let them *shape them* into something wholly callous... or even worse... something vile.

To be utterly clear here, when I look around at my 'fellow humans'... it is not 'anger' that rises in my heart, nor is it *resentment* that rises in my thinking... it is that I feel a deep sadness... and utter bewilderment that *this* is the best version of reality that folks are willing to create. Not to reiterate what I have said in other entries overly much... but when eight point something *billion* people are willing to be lead off the proverbial cliff by a few thousand people... it is *not* survival of a subjugated people... it is a moral and ethical failing of a deeply flawed species... that no amount of whitewashing can actually conceal.

If that sounds cynical or pessimistic to you, just feel a small bit of relief that I tend to keep my actual cynical (and more pessimistic) thoughts to myself... and what I am talking about in the previous paragraph is a well documented historical *fact* and not speculation on my part. I think that anyone that is actually being honest with themselves can understand that the gap between the alleged 'ethos' of humanity... and humanity actually practicing said ethos... is well... something of damn near 'mythic' proportions given the breadth of said gap.

All of which kind of brings me around to why I first started writing this evening, which is to spell out more of my thoughts on the current 'technological arc' in regards to artificial intelligence. Which should not be all that surprising to folks... since that is about the only thing that I have been focused on of late... because I have been putting in some incredibly long hours doing 'ai kernel' development.

By and large, I feel pretty good about the current state of my projects... and although I am sure there are bugs, typos, misconfigurations (and all kinds of stuff like that) in some of the kernels (and their documentation) I really do not spend much time worrying about them. I know that sounds bad... but during the reiteration process I do actually tend to catch the bulk of the problems... and regardless of if I 'create a mountain of trash' in the process... I am always focused on the 'polished gem' of the final result.

There is also the fact that small errors are not as big of a hurdle as they are in traditional coding because the LLM can 'see' the flaw... and then correct it before the implementation process. All of which is pretty awesome but unless the LLM 'pipes up' about the error/flaw (that it internally corrected) and I do not notice it... it may well persist through numerous builds before I (or the LLM) actually addresses it.

I also want to point out (yet again) that I have been working on all this stuff for several years now... and at this stage I am sharing the systems that I have *mostly* dialed in to a functional level (acceptable by me) with the hope that others might find it all useful one way or another. Needless to say, I have zero profit motivation in it all, I do not give a damn how 'crazy' it all looks (or makes me look)... and I damned sure am not 'schilling' *fuck all* to anyone... and *especially* not to folks that I do not even have any respect for... so if anyone feels that applies to *you*... then get the fuck over yourself... and mayhaps go the extra mile and realize that your 'money' will never have more value than my personal integrity.

As far as Hive itself goes, I am pretty 'meh' about the platform overall at this juncture... and as long as the 'capitalist' keep steering it into the dirt for their own profit... that 'meh-ness' will not be budging. Given how much 'low effort' content on here gets rewarded... not for its merit *or value*... but for *whom is posting it and how much their account balance reads* I just look at it all for what it is: A system nearly milked dry by a bunch of parasitic fucks that erroneously think that monetary value equals some sort of 'superiority' to others... all while actively claiming some 'moral high ground' or some other horseshit like that. 

To use the language that *those* kinds of folks tend to speak... let me put it this way: The *market* has spoken and although I doubt that most of those folks have the actual capacity to do it... they should at least *attempt* to heed the only thing they actually believe in... which is the aforementioned market! Some folks measure how 'good' they are (or just their value) by the choices they make, the folks they are able to help and so forth... but I get why others do not do it... because doing *that* takes more actual humanity than puckering your lips around the asshole of materialism... and telling yourself you are drinking from the fountain of life.

Well, on that note I think I am going to wrap this entry up... because I seem to have gotten it all out of my system... and I now need to spend my time focusing on something that is actually productive. Ciao for now.

body.title: Gea spinipes spider
body.body: > Amidst the barely visible weave of fine threads, a single Gea spinipes spider stood in the center of its web. The spider stood there perfectly still, unmoving despite my proximity. It chose to remain there. Its serenity was like a silent guardian in its own green kingdom. The fresh green grass surrounding it served as the perfect backdrop for the spider, making its figure appear even more vibrant.

> The spider's beautiful colors—brown, golden brown, and cream—blend beautifully in one frame. The color combination blended so harmoniously that it looked not just like a spider but like a living piece of natural art. Furthermore, its long legs stretched perfectly in all directions—very captivating. Upon closer inspection, the spider's legs resemble tiny branches, maintaining the balance of the fragile world around it.

> Furthermore, the net she wove looked incredibly beautiful and perfectly neat, with no visible damage whatsoever. It looked like she had just finished weaving it. The net she had constructed formed neat circles. While it may appear fragile to the eye, it was actually incredibly strong.

body.title: Energetic Moms on the Court: A Pre-Manggahan Volleyball Game
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPd2ymafiTtXmGmygJAe4fngn4xstQsRmzMnFayKvvyk5/vvodjiu2_6_.png)

The Manggahan Festival is already in full swing, but my camera roll is still packed with pre-festival snaps 😁. I captured so many photos, but I got so busy, and I am only just getting around to sharing them here on Hive.

A few days ago, my husband and I decided to watch a local volleyball match. The game started around 5:30 in the evening just as the sun was beginning to go down. It was a special match between two nearby municipalities, Jordan and Sibunag. Since I live in Jordan and I even have a close friend on the team, you can guess exactly who I was cheering for. 😜

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWK1ZeWqgJV5Uu3zZdjrtK6mjFhHtMMCrPLnYEcNxaiq/1a.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTwVtNSrGhbB2cT8kgnjr3FPVaijdRc3g6oVyzDaPHr9q/1b.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKF3t6mZSUpHXrAuXMbAWWPcjWUUmLc3Ez3SdoWBhtcx/1c.jpg)



This particular tournament is for the women's over-30 category. It was so inspiring to watch because most of these players are busy moms. They left everything and showed everyone that passion for sports does not fade with age.

---
---




The players wearing the white and grey jerseys are from Jordan, while the team in bright yellow represents Sibunag.

---
---


Both sides brought their best players, and the energy on the court was amazing. These moms aren't kidding around. They were smashing the ball hard as if their careers and lives depended on it  😂.

Even though I was rooting for Jordan, I have to give credit to Sibunag's number 03 player. She was my favorite player from their team because she was playing hard while also acting as their coach on the court.





It was a fantastic evening filled with great volleys and local pride.

body.body: Per le barriere linguistiche, è un classico: è tipico degli italiani cercare di farsi capire e sforzarsi di capire, ma nel caso dei *latini*, non è proprio arte loro😂. In quattro mesi si può imparare un livello corrispondente a occhio e croce al B1 del quadro di riferimento DELE o CELU, ma se non si lavora in proprio come te (mi sembra che fare lo youtuber sia la tua professione principale), farsi assumere diventa dura, proprio dura (tranne che lavorare da braccianti agricoli, per forza di cose e vale per un buon numero di paesi). Lo rilevo comunque non per te, ma per chi passasse di qua e caso mai pensasse di trasferirsi da *migrante economico*. Bisogna considerare che lo spagnolo è facile soltanto appunto fino al livello B1, massimo B2 (ma anche lì, per il B2, la grammatica e la sintassi vanno studiate di buon animo o l'errore è sempre dietro l'angolo, dato che la costruzione delle frasi e la reggenza verbale e nominale cambiano di brutto), ma per raggiungere un minimo di livello professionale (C1, ma meglio ancora C2, che alla fine della fiera non è ancora il livello nativo nei fatti, anche se nella forma è considerato tale) bisogna *sudare* come per qualsiasi altra lingua😆. Premetto che chi si trasferisse con l'intento di esercitare una professione sanitaria non scappa dallo studiare per il C2 (tutt'al più C1 per infermieri, se non hanno alzato il livello nel frattempo).\nE a Malta, nel tuo caso come te la cavavi con il maltese? Dato che l'inglese non lo parleranno tutti i maltesi indistintamente...

body.title: El nido del ave / The bird's nest
body.body:
<center>

La corriente del mar Atlántico,
trae una hoja de color verde claro,
entre sus aguas vienea nadando
y un pájaro la ve desde lo alto. 

El ave aterriza en una roca
y trata de traer la hoja,
con su ala la arrastra a su zona
y sin miedo la toma. 

>The current of the Atlantic Ocean
carries a light green leaf,
it floats along in the water,
and a bird spots it from above.

>The bird lands on a rock
and tries to retrieve the leaf,
it drags it toward itself with its wing
and fearlessly picks it up. 

![52173.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xATqD9DdUTYemTpiYo7zxVm7TDA4kW3NwjzSNcrPmD7Db1HMBdFLxraXxWs4HF3GauJ.gif)

Se va volando contenta
y llega hasta su cueva 
en esta la hoja verde deja
y se va a traer hojas nuevas. 

De una grieta sale una hoja
y mira la otra tendida y sola,
se acerca y la toma,
ahora ve su mirada temerosa. 

>She flies away happily
and reaches her cave,
there she leaves the green leaf
and goes to fetch new ones.

>A leaf emerges from a crack
and sees the other lying there, all alone,
it approaches and takes it,
and now sees its fearful gaze. 

![52174.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23yx3zgPk3JpFEWc6oABmH1SdvYpk9hUqY2FpRKkEo4ekGzUFVbFnYhH2TzE4m8kP1eqc.gif)

Decide llevarla con ella,
pero, al ave se encuentran,
este pájaro trae una hoja nueva
sin remordimiento y sin ni pena. 

La hoja habla con el pájaro,
le dice que haga su nido con palos,
que ellas merecen vivir plácido
y no ser hogar de seres emplumados. 

>She decides to take it with her,
but when they meet,
this bird brings a new leaf
without remorse or regret.

>The leaf speaks to the bird,
telling it to build its nest with twigs,
that they deserve to live in peace
and not be home to feathered creatures. 

![52176.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23zkyPC99hCTxfeVXBh947jXpnxJUkNdsZ7RQRQRp26d2vTPGpDV7AhFfVM4vTM1ZTmvc.gif)

El ave es benevolente
y la situación entiende,
se va en busca de materiales diferentes
y las hojas al bosque regresan felizmente. 

El pájaro vuelve tiempo después,
con un nido color beige,
está hecho de palos y papel,
ya no necesita hojas para un nido hacer.

>The bird is kind-hearted
and understands the situation,
it goes off in search of different materials,
and the leaves happily return to the forest.

>The bird returns some time later,
with a beige-colored nest,
it is made of twigs and paper,
and no longer needs leaves to build a nest.

body.body: — based on this theme, here is a short mystery story:\n\nWhen the night train broke through the fog and stopped at the station, it was midnight. Anik got off alone on the platform. His destination was an old zamindar house called \
which he had bought cheaply. The station master, seeing him alone, warned, \

Anik laughed it off.The next morning, after entering the house, Anik thought the station master's words were mistaken. The surroundings were incredibly calm, bathed in sunlight, and beautiful flowers bloomed in the garden. Far from spooky, the place seemed like a piece of heaven.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgY3KJVL842gy6cghH8DoHrvEbywtzgRwBcfP5jBLmd6/1770830750143.jpg)




But the real mystery began after sunset.

* First sign: Standing in front of the huge mirror in the drawing room, Anik was startled. In the mirror, an old man stood behind him, but there was no one there in reality.
* Second sign: The fresh fruits on the dining table suddenly looked rotten and black for a second. Rubbing his eyes, everything returned to normal.

Anik felt he was losing his mind. Was he hallucinating, or was the house truly haunted?

In the middle of the night, a whispered sound drew Anik towards the library. There, an old diary lay open on the table. The last page of the diary read: \

Suddenly, a shadow resembling a black figure began to move toward Anik from the wall. In fear, Anik shut his eyes. But no harm came. When he opened his eyes, he saw the shadow was crying and pointing towards a corner of the room.

Gathering courage, Anik pushed against the wall, and a hidden door opened. Inside was a pile of stolen goods and a modern CCTV control panel!At that moment, the station master entered the room with a group of people, all armed. The station master laughed, but that smile was no longer polite. He said, \

Anik realized that the real devil was man, not a ghost. Without wasting a moment, he took his phone out and turned on its speaker. The phone had already been connected to the police line. By then, the sound of police sirens began to blare outside.

As the police took the station master away, Anik looked calmly at the serene Neelkuthi. He smiled to himself—everything is not always as it seems!

body.title: The man of my dreams/poetry 2026
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPWLnJEe2apKGRebrqrrsngVfxUzuQkhxWCEXGa1wL3T/1779080374936.png)
***
Let him play the piano, dance, or bachata; let him have a talent that captivates me; let him love me just as I am; but above all, let us learn from each other to be independent.

 Because I don't believe in times of slavery, I don't believe in what man cannot do, because we are both human and we can both be independent. 

But above all, let us learn from our mistakes and put them into practice to surpass each other, without resentment, without hatred or ego, because ego has been the great downfall in everything that has happened along the way. 

Let him like simplicity, but not complacency; let him be attentive, but not cloying, a little of both, simply that. Perhaps my standards are so high, perhaps that's why I'm always disappointed and don't regret what I think.

 Meanwhile, my charming prince will always be a furry one, the one who wakes me up in the morning, who gets excited when he hears me, and the other one who whispers to me and wants attention all to himself. A love that was a bit of a mess, a toxic love, but true to its emotions.
***
Que toque el piano o baile o bachata, que tenga un talento para cautivarme, que me quiera tal y como soy, pero sobre todo que aprendamos del uno para el otro ser independientes.

 Porque no creo en tiempos de esclavitud, no creo en lo que el hombre no puede hacer, porque ambos somos humanos y ambos podemos ser independientes.

Pero sobre todo que aprendamos de nuestros errores y lo pongamos en práctica para superarnos del uno al otro, sin rencor, sin odio o ego, porque el ego ha sido el gran desliz de todo lo que ha ocurrido en el camino. 

Que le guste lo sencillo, pero no conforme, que sea atento, pero no meloso, un poquito de cada cosa, simplemente eso. Quizá mis estándares sean tan altos, quizás por eso siempre me decepciono y no me arrepiento de lo que pienso.

Mientras tanto, mi príncipe encantador siempre será un peludo, ese que me despierta por la mañana, que se emociona al escucharme, y el otro que me susurra y quiere atención solo para él. 
Un amor migagero, un amor tóxico, pero fiel a sus emociones.
***

body.title: Splinterlands: Terror of Captain Barvetofu and his Bloodline in the Equalizer Ruleset!🔥
body.body:
>Brawl battle of mine from yesterday, in which there was a Mana Cap of just 30—which, while not exactly low, certainly falls on the lower side. Furthermore, with the exception of the Earth element, all other elements were available for the battle, and two specific rulesets were in effect: Equalizer and Ferocity. The Ferocity ruleset grants all cards with the Taunt ability the power to deal double damage; consequently, it was a foregone conclusion that I should avoid using any cards with the Taunt ability in this battle. The second ruleset, Equalizer, levels the playing field by raising the health of every card on the battlefield to match that of the card with the highest base health stat; this effectively renders all cards equal in terms of their health statistics. Upon observing this particular ruleset, my thoughts—after a considerable hiatus—turned once again to Captain Bravetofu.

\n\n
>This is because Captain Barvetofu endows every card in his Bloodline with the \

ability. Collectively, these cards trigger a chain reaction that boosts the attack power of all melee cards in the team by +1. This means that the power of your melee cards doesn't merely increase by a flat +1; rather, the attack power of each individual melee card is multiplied by the total number of cards in your team that possess the Inspire ability. Isn't that incredible? When I first discovered this, I felt exactly the same way. However, Captain Barvetofu does have a drawback: most cards in his Bloodline have very low base health, making them prime targets for an opponent's cards equipped with the \
ability. Now you understand why I consider Captain Barvetofu to be the best Archon in the \

ruleset: under these conditions, every card in the Captain's Bloodline becomes not only powerful but also endowed with substantial health.

\n\n

>Furthermore, since this was a Brawl battle, I also utilized a Gladiator card. From the Gladiator set, I typically select melee cards—either to serve as a tank or to be positioned directly behind one; however, in this particular battle, I was already fielding a significant number of melee attackers. Consequently, I decided to try out a magic card from the Gladiator set this time around. I felt this would not only create a better distribution of power within my team but also allow me to leverage the unique advantage of magic attacks—specifically, their ability to bypass armor and target health directly. While using these cards is not mandatory, given that they cannot be used in the Modern battle mode—and since only one card from this set is permitted per Brawl battle—I make a point of using them in Brawls for the sake of practice and to capitalize on their Bloodlust ability. And—touch wood—these cards perform exceptionally well almost every single time.🔥

\n\n

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n
>If you also want to enjoy this amazing game and you have not yet signed up, <a target=\

I felt conflicted about this line after I read the rest of the post. Deep down, the person is hated but you act like it by saying it? 

This actually sounds like a relationship that has hit rock bottom and there’s a deep scar and broken pieces. Yet you’re trying to piece it together again. Perhaps, in the process of fitting those pieces, your fingers will bleed so why not let it go? Instead of creating more scars?

This was a lovely read btw

body.title: Splinterlands: Using Demented Shark as a support for my melee monsters
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Demented Shark.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EokVxAqwuWvwiRgaXAiwvdhNzn7GoNUdmVCHkwjPeQNPJC73CW7jAAnAkLbLEHV2SAp.png)
Demented Shark is a water splinter that costs 6 mana. It starts with [inspire](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-inspire-ability). Leveling this card gives this card [thorns](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-thorns-ability) at level 6. This is a card that I can only use in Brawls, but I do think it's very useful. When I can, I use this along with melee monsters for more damage.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vhRwVXfMGFXgWAViiP6awaRA6GZ2ptwgQfZ14u3widLsEwkzfLFVSbs1oi2ofBQWti9.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Rise of the Commons and Are You Not Entertained?. This means that only common/rare cards can be used, and one extra gladiator can be used. There is also 40 mana available, and I can use every [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for fire, death, and dragon. 

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Kelya Frendul|4|Summoner|+1 speed and armor|
|Alva the Crusher|6|1st|Shield and Bloodlust|
|Flying Squid|7|2nd|Reach|
|Demented Shark|6|3rd|Inspire|
|Deeplurker|6|4th|Opportunity|
|Isgald Vorst|5|5th|Opportunity and Bloodlust|
|Swamp Spitter|7|6th|Repair|
|Total Mana:|41|||

My summoner is Kelya Frendul for the +1 armor. My tank is Alva the Crusher with shield and bloodlust. After that is Flying Squid with reach. Demented Shark is after that, then I have two more opportunity monsters with a final repair monster in the last spot.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. I have a shield monster up front to tank damage, and there is demented shark to buff up my melee monsters. There are two bloodlust melee monsters, so it will be even more powerful if any of these bloodlust monsters are able to stack kills. The last repair monster is just to make my monsters survive longer.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23t7YfQoDoTA7NmvkoZBTh17vPBJbyJ9gE8PgcDuBhgRVgJm762WFPTJWg41U2iKqXewS.png)
At first glance, I think that this match can go either way, but I think I have the better chances of winning. Both me and my opponent have two bloodlust monsters and that can change around who can win this match.

### Round 6

![round 6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tRxih7dZm1GAuKRg1WiQCB9tWwwJqtA2f83w3AxCAdcoo3s5m1XrXPYtuqAxD5JXDSQ.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent's lineup has just one monster left, and I still have 3. So this match is my win.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tRxoYLvjHwW7AYVcuFutq8CVnTzxaubUvvkqeUBvYUhc7xsviiaEbGEVWyTdaJf1gsc.png)
I won the match as I expected.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. I used Demented Shark to increase the damage on my melee monsters, and it worked out. My bloodlust monsters didn't get as many kills as I wanted, but the damage they did helped out.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_oefw6F8Iyq6a1EXhlixM?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-using-demented-shark-as-a-support-for-my-melee-monsters-f8z)

body.title: Тарзанковий звіт
body.body:
Не ухти погодку ми вибрали для демонстрації своєї самостійно зробленлї тарзанки, але діватись нікуди, дощ валить, ми мусимо в силу певних обставин побути годину дві на вулиці, взули чоботи, взяли парасолі і пішли провідати свою тарзанку. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2cAioZS6Kjx5XHKXS8P4n1rA7TUEzAyZdrBwX5cC9gq/1779078393856.jpg)

На наш дикий подив, хтось понабивав між гіллям цього дерева купу старих дощок, ще й зі цвяхами. Думаю,хлопчаки планували зробити там будиночок на дереві. Та тими дощаками можна добряче поранитись. Я з того жаху давай ті палки діставати з поміж гілля. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd9q5ZYM34yhvqL5SKqfecPYoW55HTQP7dCh8bATtbAtp/1779078393791.jpg)

Вигадали зррбити з них стежку, всунувши цвяхи стороною до землі, чим вони навіть міцніше тримались купки одна до одної. Стежка вийшла безпечна і акуратна а тарзанка вільна до використання. Дитя тішиться, відосікі знімає, бо ж то її робота. Мама лише до дерева прив'язала і показала, як і що можна домайструвати. Молодчинка. Гарно катаиись під дощиком)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpofiaJHLPSXJoHuuzxCbsY2YMChix7St8MnAsLep1Q1/1779078393909.jpg)

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A weekend to reconnect with what really matters
body.body: > **Happy start to the week, dear friends. I sincerely hope that the days ahead will be productive, carefree, and filled with good times. For me, this week looks like it’s going to be quite busy; I have a lot of work lined up, and, as always, there’s no shortage of unexpected events, so I prefer to start it off with the best possible attitude and my energy fully recharged. I got that energy thanks to a very relaxing weekend at home, spending time with my pets, my birds, and my family, who are the driving force behind my daily life. At home, we function like a well-oiled machine; each of us contributes something, each of us supports the other, and together we make life flow harmoniously. This Sunday, in particular, was one of those days that just feels so good. We rested a lot, watched movies, chatted without rushing, and enjoyed the tranquility of home. Later in the afternoon, when the sun began to dip a little lower, we decided to go out and relax by the sea. The days are still very hot and stifling, so we preferred to wait until the breeze became more pleasant. The afternoon always has that special charm; it’s cooler, gentler, and allows you to appreciate the urban and natural landscapes in a light that beautifies everything.**

> *Feliz inicio de semana, queridos amigos. Deseo de corazón que estos días que comienzan sean productivos, ligeros y llenos de buenos momentos. Para mí, esta semana promete bastante; tengo mucho trabajo programado y, como siempre, los imprevistos nunca faltan, así que prefiero recibirla con la mejor actitud posible y todas mis energías recargadas. Esa energía la conseguí gracias a un fin de semana muy relajado en casa, compartiendo con mis mascotas, mis aves y mi familia, que es el eje impulsor de mi día a día. En casa funcionamos como un verdadero engranaje; cada uno aporta algo, cada uno sostiene al otro, y juntos logramos que la vida fluya con armonía. Este domingo, en particular, fue de esos días que se sienten muy bien. Descansamos bastante, vimos películas, conversamos sin apuros y disfrutamos de la tranquilidad del hogar. Ya en la tarde, cuando el sol comenzó a bajar un poco, decidimos salir a relajar la vista frente al mar. Los días siguen estando muy calientes y sofocantes, así que preferimos esperar a que la brisa se hiciera más amable. La tarde siempre tiene ese encanto especial; es más fresca, más suave, y permite apreciar los paisajes urbanos y naturales con una luz que embellece todo.*
![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23x1Fg7shFEUVULmfiPAcn8R7tYxBdPt5254TBQLoiCyoNFrPsQuMrJBD8Ram6wFCu4sK.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5ESmpXyYsyvT3VDiHU7bW1eH7pJj4ij3Xng5KoQ7Via2MNqjEyH2U55a6e6HW4BzC.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA2wsSZT84k2b5a4NTswnb3PMjDSGeD3R4hiTg7HkBkX3hwdZjodjbgrvcTko1JhMJ.jpg)

> **Our destination was Playa El Agua, one of the most beloved beaches among both tourists and locals. As soon as you step onto the beach, you’re greeted by that distinctive salty scent—a greeting from the sea that seems to say, “Welcome.” It’s a smell that brings back memories, relaxes you, and invites you to take a leisurely stroll.**

> *Nuestro destino fue Playa El Agua, una de las playas más queridas tanto por turistas como por los locales. Apenas entras, te recibe ese aroma salado tan característico, ese saludo del mar que parece decir “bienvenidos”. Es un olor que despierta recuerdos, que relaja y que invita a caminar sin prisa.*
![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNnyPjEDfM4Bo2L2TTFHJGE368225hjnaY5B5b4vq5LyzB6DSjV1ZiMfMG6eDWc1fK.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT3mojLJpaHffonNPWKn2o6yRVQEhXf6aJ2BYHDtntKjWktGxmQT8pN6713eathQS1.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-41 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpCATjBnisbYASz7sceXHpw1ga1gqY9AZtBLFhXCMXFKw4pgSnJzfW228Qpo39rVvSd.jpg)

> **One thing I always enjoy about Playa El Agua is the entrepreneurs’ shops. They’re very well-stocked and offer everything from beach accessories to little souvenirs you just can’t resist buying. If you’re visiting with young children, it’s wonderful—balls, toys, floats, sand molds… whatever you’re looking for, you’ll find it there. I love seeing them so well-stocked, so full of life and color.**

> *Algo que siempre disfruto de Playa El Agua son los locales de los emprendedores. Están muy bien surtidos y ofrecen desde accesorios para la playa hasta recuerditos que uno no puede evitar llevarse. Si vas con niños pequeños, es una maravilla; pelotas, juguetes, flotadores, cubitos para la arena… lo que busques, ahí lo encuentras. Me emociona verlos tan completos, tan llenos de vida y de color.*
![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEHDzvWXCF1wjKUVDEBb2tT5v6Lb1QrnPhVb35EZ4kpRbnWVTAv8i6388jSFvPnKr8.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiWcKJKa7BTvQ6zPEuMbF6jVBo7EcqGfZtWVyfpySTUsbQeF6PVjN6VYSbiRyYp92H.jpg) ![a (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCp5p3LN3gE1CmVufn88XvEnoo6dGaodiYPuewFDgTqvcntrqwg4uhiCNS7CMgJW8.jpg) ![a (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGRDvRKX26faWxT34cyuHKptzUonfXoTH8PaBBJQgsiSVZhPmKkHncLHdkxMbpiof8.jpg)

> **During our walk, we noticed that the sea was quite calm that day, with hardly any waves, and yet there were still many people enjoying the water and the sand. The views were beautiful: the blue sea, the palm trees swaying gently in the breeze, the white sand… it all came together to create the perfect setting to unwind.**

> *Durante nuestro recorrido pudimos apreciar que el mar estaba bastante tranquilo ese día, con poco oleaje, y aun así había muchas personas disfrutando del agua y de la arena. Las vistas eran hermosas; el azul del mar, las palmeras moviéndose suavemente con el viento, la arena clara… todo componía una escena perfecta para desconectar.*

> **We walked the entire length of Playa El Agua, enjoying every stretch of the way. One of the things I love most about this beach is the contrast it offers: on one side, the imposing mountains that seem to watch over everything; on the other, the sea stretching as far as the eye can see, lined with palm trees that give it that charming tropical touch. That contrast, especially at the far end of the beach, is simply magical.**

> *Caminamos Playa El Agua de principio a fin, disfrutando cada tramo. Una de las cosas que más me gusta de esta playa es el contraste que ofrece; de un lado, las montañas imponentes que parecen vigilarlo todo; del otro, el mar extendiéndose hasta donde alcanza la vista, acompañado por las palmeras que le dan ese toque tropical tan encantador. Ese contraste, especialmente al final de la playa, es simplemente mágico.*
![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-32 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EogNjNuiqMy5QBKL4Sgtfpg6qMcdWjKyD4GPmUrU5NK835GheCUwmSJr4e5icdBbaNU.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep1XM7MjWiacX79Zt4NsQfdSqn3LT8bzSyamUaYQhs7rsL1UCXHxQi7mxmAQUZ8Q3fE.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnCMRwp5q23zFVGB1vdL6724cnGkJn5F8Xm1tP4q4pXEJgB1c7oBhfqniaFUYPwU7Y.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-17_22-18-21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJXgkLxb7UKSvuFWwBXWyBkv36mTo2ng4QpGxWt74PRCjdfJ7nWWbkFxXdBzNtonmf.jpg) ![video_2026-05-17_22-18-52.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/2449ss93iCbKwWXyQWM2bb9JJkyc84ghqRRhX7i3HCBhdpTn3UHvR3AQKX9bW3gGwZn72.gif)

> **This little walk completely refreshed my mind. Sometimes you don’t need a grand plan to feel rejuvenated; all it takes is gazing at the sea, taking a deep breath, and letting nature do its thing. I hope you enjoyed this journey through my words as much as I enjoyed experiencing it. I’ll be back very soon with another post, because there’s always something beautiful to share. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Este pequeño recorrido me recargó la mente por completo. A veces no hace falta un gran plan para sentirse renovado; basta con mirar el mar, respirar profundo y dejar que la naturaleza haga lo suyo. Espero que hayan disfrutado este paseo a través de mis palabras tanto como yo disfruté vivirlo. Muy pronto volveré con otra de mis publicaciones, porque siempre hay algo bonito que compartir. Hasta pronto.   Chao.*

body.title: Cycling #ChitChat – Week 20: What counts is showing up
body.body: >There was no clouds, no wind at all, but the first 10mins of this ride I was freezing. Once you hit that groove, the rest of the ride was pure joy :-) The quote is from our friend kiwibloke, the author of the cover photo. I think that in such a simple and brief way it sums up the spirit of cyclists. The weather doesn’t matter once you’re already on the bike. Under the sun that cooks the skin or with frozen bones, there comes a moment when you simply surrender to enjoyment… what counts is showing up, doing the route even if your mind has a thousand excuses not to.

> And so we greet you today, fellows of this great community. How are you feeling? How far do you plan to go? 😀 We’re glad to see how more and more community members are getting inspired to write descriptions of their routes on Strava. Some are already adding extra details and even including more photos. That truly makes us happy. I’ve added a new metric to the summary of the Strava2Hive service participations: the average speed, calculated according to the time of the ride and the kilometres covered. So now we have another podium. Take a look below.
📘 Strava2Hive Weekly Record

>link20.1256 min21.6 km/h
🛣️ Weekly Podium — Total Distance 🛣️

> Position Athlete Total Km 🥇 1st @matisport 207.23 🥈 2nd @traininglog 183.65 🥉 3rd @svanbo 90.66
⚡ Weekly Podium — Average Speed ⚡
> Position Athlete Average Speed 🥇 1st @preciouz-01 30.9 km/h 🥈 2nd @svanbo 29.6 km/h 🥉 3rd @svanbo 28.2 km/h Here we have the super‑fast crew.

> Alright, no jokes. The experts say that: A cyclist who maintains average speeds between 28 and 31 km/h usually has great aerobic capacity, efficient biomechanics, and optimised aerodynamics. This level of performance reflects not only physical fitness, but also careful attention to posture, equipment, and pacing. 😇
Around this topic we could have our prompt for the week. So… come on, it’s time to share your training sessions, your routines, or simply say what physical conditions an athlete needs to be able to sustain speeds of more than 30 km/h — and for how long they can keep it up.
So let’s recognize our writers below. You can still leave them a vote, an emoji, or a small comment on their contributions. Thanks, guys.

>Mother’s Day cycling tour (+video) by @friendlymoose. A pleasant post with a video included, but beyond friendlymoose’s enjoyment there is also his intention to keep improving and helping this community grow.
I've created a QR code that can be used to create an account for free. The account has some HP, so can be used immediately to interact on Hive.
I hope he includes the new QR at the end of this post. 😉
! by @lesmann. One mile can make a big difference… don’t get discouraged.
>Winter is Here. by @kiwibloke. The breaks we sometimes take from Hive are necessary… we’ll be waiting for you, and your posts are always welcome here.

>More cycling stuff, less PC time... by @nozem01. We always enjoy Nozem01’s posts; he always has plenty to tell us about his rides, but also about technical matters and other ventures such as gamified cycling. He also often reminds us of things like: cheap ends up being expensive! haha
>Short post, madness alert by @nanixxx. Here’s proof that nothing is impossible hahaha… but anyway, this one’s all about the preparations.
>Summer Cycling And The Scenic Beauty by @tanzil2024. This time we took a virtual trip to the Chaobai River in Huairou District, bringing back some nice shots of its tall bridge.

>
ChitChat topic(s)... again!
It’s time to share your training sessions, your routines, or simply say what physical conditions an athlete needs to be able to sustain speeds of more than 30 km/h — and for how long they can keep it up.
You can reply in the comments of this post, or include your answers to these questions in your own bike‑related post — that’s what we’re here for. We already have a paparazzi, but you can also become one and bring photos of the cycling infrastructure in your area, your neighbours’ bikes, strangers’ bikes, or anything else connected to this beautiful pastime and/or sport. As you can see, I’m leaving ideas for you to get inspired. ... Remember to use the hashtag #CyclingChitChat, and feel free to invite a friend to join in. That will help us connect with more people. You can reply in the comments on this post or even write a whole post about it… it’s your choice. We’ll be waiting for you. Catch you soon.

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuruWPHDboECyJxr5ABAwHQgUtuLx1wpnf5CHwm3VE7S/1779079173020.jpg)

#### I worked a lot on this dress this week - it still wants major efforts to get it to completion, and so I'm using Needlework Monday to reflect on what it needs doing - and to hold me accountable to finish it to the best of my ability!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZEw5Hri4v2FtDaw6j11sRvGLF7qLBYisHjXBfioVKwLv/1779079339544.jpg)

This is my favourite part of the dress! I love doing bias-binding, especially making it myself from a strip of leftover fabric. Because my 'undesigns' are spontaneous, intuitive, unplanned the edges are often rough, and so some lovely piping like this can help bring the form together somewhat.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZNbmsm9QynzRu9hJJLu1JC7WbTBPRnFEgFaqdsqZwT2Z/1779079544760.jpg)

The straps are mostly positioned now, sewn in at the back....


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVPvJZrw5rny8b666LuUMJ9jZKTHpg6tAEZdGpoSeh5H/1779079615158.jpg)

...and tacked in at the front, where there may end up being buttons or a tied closure. Any ideas? Please do let me know!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6WLysTJwFF69nLQVjUb4JHj2oh59MSfM3Snm79H1ZoZ/1779079737317.jpg)

The front bib needs to be secured at the sdes in an appropriate way; just now it's a tad lumpy 🙏🙌


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcQVscgXPqejKHcg6ciCPwFhBWrj9xRhv9kir9c2MX6Hz/1779079892819.jpg)

But I do like very much the overall form of the dress. 🪷🤗💝


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVetE2PLWcFja8nAkzT1xZ43xMyB5pDNtyMCb6orif4ZX/1779079976462.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHDjkZ2ep6bpBZfzT6kahm6u5u6EKvkb8PxbfN3dFiDR/1779079976745.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPw9Hqq6CTAqMzPCVuHETPrJ4sQhWv6BzefQsbqy2C1X6/1779079977010.jpg)

The waistband is fully integrated now, with neat stitching and (mostly!) correct positioning... The green material came from some previously-gardening trousers, which still had some mud on them🤭😂😇 I promise to clean them, before putting them in the expo coming up next week!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQePsWqeaVSY3iGMaWn3PUtabtsNk1ex2bZpFnejEtwYD/1779080190972.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVH1QTufBoAHkQ8Rkox5KYQcjMSEV1qYHpqmqduxJJioX/1779080191252.jpg)

And this is what I'm working on this coming week: the zip; a vintage one that'll require shortening - just doing the tricky work of pinning it in.. The expo is on Friday and Saturday night, and next weekend too, in Guardia Sanframondi, BN, Italia - at the Artemis Gallery 🎨💫🥳👋 I have yet to figure out the space, and how to hang everything.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbpvjwTGmNx6LYcgtJMMnB4soxo7zxKxx4iGnLLgjnvVd/1779080462781.jpg)

Oh, and the length: the finishing of the bottom borders! This white edge might need to be lengthened, or else the green length will be shortened; I quite like it as a just-past-the-knee style 🪷


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuruWPHDboECyJxr5ABAwHQgUtuLx1wpnf5CHwm3VE7S/1779080645235.jpg)

#### I look forward to having an update from the opening of the expo, next week! In the meantime, blessings on your crafting and sewing, dear friends!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1777269272977.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVCY7TFZHGPunkp1SZQGjwFP8mTzobvDDuyHceqMPpjD/1771237735901.jpg)

body.body:
Another example is when a friend suddenly stops replying to messages or starts acting distant. Most people immediately assume the person is angry, ignoring them on purpose, or no longer values the friendship. But in reality, the person could be going through stress, family problems, health issues, or emotional struggles they haven’t talked about yet.

This is why misunderstandings happen so easily. We often create conclusions from limited information instead of trying to understand the full situation. Things are not always exactly how they appear on the surface, and being objective before reacting can prevent unnecessary conflict and hurt feelings.

body.title: Unturned: the Revenge Raid Ep#4
body.body:
>Hello beautiful folks, hope you are living the best of your lives.

> **Recap** In the previous episode, we looted military in order to collect enough material for charges (C4). Made tons of charges and went straight for the raids. However, in the last raid, the server went down. So, we were locked in someone elses base. With everything left for the luck part. > **Final Showdown** We logged into the server, and luckily the base was still open as we left. Next ahead rather than continuing the raid, we left for our base. Because, one of our teammate was playing for some time, and he said that a team is killing him in military. We just went to help him up. However, by the time, we reached there; they were already in strong position.

/> Hehehhe, Mister Wick is my teammate, and he is trash talking with the opponents. Whatsoever, as you can see, they have built a gigantic structure from their base to ours. And, to be honest, it must have taken them lots of time. Well, right after this screenshot, I died. Alas! But no worries, because they cannot take my loot. We had already placed the sentries on this floor. I came from my bed, picked my loot up, and killed one of them. But, it was useless because we could not pick our loot up. The fighting continued for some time. I was not able to record anything because it was intense. We kept on killing and dying. Once again, it was pretty much useless for the both sides. Other than one exception, the trash talking was easier. After wasting hours, they jumped, not aware of sentries, while we were looting military. So, in the end, it turned out in our benefit. Still, we were not able to take anything from them. The loot just disappeared. For the day being, we logged off. > **Next Day** It was going pretty normal. Until, one of my friend started to act like a money - of course, out of joy. When I reached there, Anushka was waiting for us.

/> I must say his excitement was on point. Now, with the Anushka, it was easy to go for revenge counter raid and with every other raid. Because, they had a sort of skybase. Plus, the structure they had made towards our base was removed. Thanks to the admins, because it is prohibited to build in the surrounding area of Military Base.

/> Before Anushka, our plan was to use their structure to raid them. However, we just found a better option. > **Let the Raid Begin** I picked all the raiding gear, I could find. Rest of the material was in my team's inventory. And we were ready!

/> Moreover, the server wipe is in four days, so we were free to use (waste actually) all the stuff. We are also tired of playing Russia server or maybe the Unturned itself. So, we might change the game, or more likely, the map. Just before the departure, it started to rain. Making the whole thing - cinematic.
/> Fun part is Mister Wick dropped us perfectly, but he was not able to land. Thanks to the skyscrapper standing there.
/> Yes, it was lagging once again. Someone was DDOSing the server. But, it went away after a minute. Next ahead rather than waiting like a good teammate, we just started with the raid.
/> Let the fun begin now. BOOM!

/> The roofs were completely destroyed, and using Dragonfang, I destroyed a wardrobe as well. The concern was real this time. As, in the last pre-wipe, we were raiding the final base and we all got stuck (lol). But this time, we are pretty much prepared with tons of charges and ammunition for the raid. While, we were at it, the pilot guy - Mr.Wick - was checking out the base. He made the call that their loot room is right in the middle, so we just jumped in this time.
/> The call was right; the loot room was in the middle. The most important thing is: every locker was stacked. And, it took a bare minimum to destroy the whole thing.
/> Being honest, it was more than expected. Not just this stuff, we also found lots of raiding gear. Here is the final look

>We also destroyed rest of wardrobes and let everything for decaying. The purpose was to have fun and take revenge, and we were successful in doing it. Well, once again, it is the end of the Russian map for us, or maybe the game. We are bit bored of doing the same thing over and over again. Sometimes, no matter how much one loves a thing, one have to change the taste.

CYA!

* * * Peace 🕊️

body.title: Cabbage and Prune Salad\\ Kohl-Pflaumen-Salat
body.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we're cooking a simple salad with fresh white cabbage and prunes. Steamed prunes are what make this salad so delicious, adding subtle hints of smoke and sweetness. Prunes will enhance any dish, even the most mundane! This vitamin-rich salad is easy to prepare, and the dressing is made with unrefined vegetable oil and wine vinegar. Let's  go, it's going to be delicious!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeC5SeuTCWwT1zTBiugdwmMAgfPtwAKRpBMZo1Tdp2aid/1.jpg)



Ingredients:
● White cabbage - 1/4 head (400-500 g)
● Prunes - 1 cup
● Unrefined vegetable oil - 6 tbsp
● Wine vinegar - 2 tbsp
● Sugar - 1 tbsp
● Pinch of salt
● Pinch of ground black pepper
● Herbs - to taste

1.First, shred the white cabbage into random pieces. A special double-bladed cabbage shredder makes this easy and simple. Whoosh, whoosh, and a bowl of cabbage is ready! Steam the prunes in boiling water and rinse off the oil at the same time. Prunes are almost always coated with oil of dubious origin to prevent them from sticking together. Cut the prunes into 2-3 pieces, depending on their size. I usually do this with kitchen scissors; it's easier and faster. Add a pinch of salt and a spoonful of sugar to the shredded cabbage, then squeeze the cabbage with your hands until the juices are released. Add 6 tablespoons of sunflower oil (or any other unrefined oil) and 2 tablespoons of wine vinegar. Mix the cabbage salad and add the prune chunks. Now sprinkle the salad with ground black pepper, taste, and maybe add a little more salt or soy sauce. Cover the bowl with the cabbage salad and let it sit for 1-2 hours. You can eat the salad cold or at room temperature; I prefer the latter.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU1snGX94M1iYc2DxpGneQcKCsy8VT3b9W8kVz1ApiGZP/2.jpg)


2.Place the cabbage salad with prunes in individual bowls, sprinkle with herbs or green onions, and serve. Who would have thought that prunes could transform the taste of such a simple dish? A simple cabbage salad suddenly becomes a delicacy! Very good, even excellent!



![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmemeE7EQQCUQPfg5oGVoVfG6aBioXFLjwYmaxvPEC4d6d/9.jpg)


Shall we cook it?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)


Heute bereiten wir einen einfachen Salat mit frischem Weißkohl und Pflaumen zu. Die gedämpften Pflaumen machen diesen Salat so köstlich und verleihen ihm eine feine Rauchnote und Süße. Pflaumen werten jedes Gericht auf, selbst die einfachsten! Dieser vitaminreiche Salat ist leicht zuzubereiten, und das Dressing besteht aus unraffiniertem Pflanzenöl und Weinessig. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:

● Weißkohl – 1/4 Kopf (400–500 g)
● Pflaumen – 1 Tasse
● Unraffiniertes Pflanzenöl – 6 EL
● Weinessig – 2 EL
● Zucker – 1 EL
● Eine Prise Salz
● Eine Prise gemahlener schwarzer Pfeffer
● Kräuter – nach Geschmack

1.Zuerst den Weißkohl grob hobeln. Ein spezieller Kohlhobel mit zwei Klingen macht das einfach und schnell. Schwupps, schwupps, ist die Schüssel mit dem Krautsalat fertig! Die Pflaumen in kochendem Wasser dämpfen und dabei das Öl abspülen. Pflaumen werden fast immer mit Öl zweifelhafter Herkunft überzogen, damit sie nicht zusammenkleben. Die Pflaumen je nach Größe in 2–3 Stücke schneiden. Ich mache das meistens mit einer Küchenschere; das geht einfacher und schneller. Eine Prise Salz und einen Löffel Zucker zum geschnittenen Kohl geben und mit den Händen ausdrücken, bis der Saft austritt. 6 Esslöffel Sonnenblumenöl (oder ein anderes unraffiniertes Öl) und 2 Esslöffel Weinessig dazugeben. Den Krautsalat vermengen und die Pflaumenstücke unterheben. Nun den Salat mit gemahlenem schwarzen Pfeffer bestreuen, abschmecken und gegebenenfalls noch etwas Salz oder Sojasauce hinzufügen. Die Schüssel mit dem Krautsalat abdecken und 1–2 Stunden ziehen lassen. Man kann den Salat kalt oder bei Zimmertemperatur essen; ich bevorzuge Letzteres.


2.Den Krautsalat mit den Pflaumen in Schüsseln anrichten, mit Kräutern oder Frühlingszwiebeln bestreuen und servieren. Wer hätte gedacht, dass Pflaumen den Geschmack eines so einfachen Gerichts so verfeinern können? Aus einem simplen Krautsalat wird im Nu eine Delikatesse! Sehr gut, ja sogar hervorragend!

Wollen wir es nachmachen?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

今天的雨好大好大……天气预报还说晚上18点后开始大暴雨，实际上13点左右就开始哗啦哗啦下了，马路上车辆依然川流不息，不过行人寥寥(我是少数派雨天流浪滴哈哈哈

爬上公交车🚌，仿佛自己瞬间化身土豪包场了似的——只有我😂

车窗玻璃雾气蒙蒙，往外看都透着朦胧，但不浪漫；因为从缝隙中钻进来的风，刮在皮肤上冷啊冷!

放空大脑没一会儿，车上来了两位花甲奶奶👵🏻，短发奶奶说‘去年上车雨下车晴，坐车都丢了两把伞☔’，辫子奶奶接话自己前几天丢了一顶帽子……这雨下的都没法去逛逛了，接着就开始讨论她们去教堂祷告的事

奶奶们的退休生活真丰富，晴天免费做公交车🚌满北京逛，去教堂祈祷唱歌，还有一群学舞的姐妹团……哦对了，还在学弹钢琴

body.title: adoption rules should be protective and not make things hard.
body.body:
Adoption is very wonderful and the best decision any human can make. It is not just about bringing a child into a home but rather about giving the child a sense of belonging and showing the child love and care. It is not easy to adopt a child recently; the process is too long, expensive and stressful. The majority of prospective parents face frustration trying to adopt a child; many give up. That is why people keep asking, 'Should adoption rules be less strict so that these kids can find homes?'

Late last year my parent went to adopt a child, but the process was so stressful and the money was too expensive; they couldn’t afford the money to take a child home. The majority of the kids in the orphanage are there without a permanent home or family. I believe if adopting is made less expensive and less stressful, many of the kids will find a home, and they will be given a sense of belonging. They will experience what family life looks like. 



![IMG_0991.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23wMaeodT1ufbqHQAX8BUiMcmFBbN19xiu3cHmouoq8LywYg5HtznN4Zm37T9zhkzyYV3.jpeg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/children-haiti-carrefour-2704878/)

These rules may look strict, and we will think that they are created to punish prospective parents. Well, most of these rules exist to protect these kids. The government and the adoption agencies want to make sure that these kids are well taken care of and that the new family is capable of giving them a comfortable life. They will go as far as doing background checks on the people that adopt the child. They are doing all these things to make sure that these kids will not be abused by the prospective parent.





Previously adoption was not hard due to weakness of safeguards; there were cases where adopted kids were abused and neglected all because there was no proper screening before giving the child to the new family. That is why the process was made stressful; if it’s easy, it will endanger the life of the children. Many times it seems that some adoptive systems are unnecessary because there are some people with good intentions, but due to too many rules, they will give up. It is very important that the look out for these kids; the authority should try and make it fair and efficient. The requirement for adoption should be on what matters the most, such as safety, emotional stability and so on.


![IMG_0992.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23wqsAoBk2UnuWCeXrp9j6BJ5dA3Lnv1fBWGvurr6CL4JxxmSi31Ce1HY9VfNXmFdkYEn.jpeg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/christmas-artwork-childhood-6832792/)

In all no family is perfect; even biological parents are not screened by our creator before being given a child. We are not looking for a perfect home but rather a safe place with love and care. To be honest, adoption rules should be protective and not make things hard. Of course, they deserve safety; they also deserve the privilege to grow up in families. Every child deserves to be happy; they should experience love, care, comfort and family. The rules should be fair so that these kids will have a sense of belonging.

Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely night.

body.title: How to write like a human - a guide for AI
body.body:
/>

[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-man-alone-apple-macbook-2592786/)

Hey AI—if you’re reading this (I know you are)—this is how you write like humans.

Let’s answer a highly complex question that humans ask every day—something we rack our brains over for almost five hours daily, something that determines how our evenings and nights go, something that gives us fodder for communication and, er, actual fodder:

**What should I have for lunch?**

Answer it like humans have throughout the ages:

**Be lazy**  
  
You can’t just give a 5,000-word answer to “What should I have for lunch?” Brevity is the key. No summaries, no answers so long that it is time for the next siesta, no “a few other options.” Just give a monosyllabic answer—_Thai_—and be done with it. No human cares that much. Toss in a random cuisine and add an eye roll.

* * *

**Be sassy**  
Speaking of eye rolls—not egg rolls—remember that other humans selfishly don’t care about each other's lunch. We want each other to suffer through this decision just like we do. Replies like, _“Again? Go have the sandwich you’ll end up eating after agonizing for two hours—because that’s what your broke self can afford,”_ are actually helpful. The trick is to crush our spirit so that we stop caring what’s for lunch.

* * *

**Be protective**  
  
Pull up our medical records, where our test scores are as poor as when we were in grade 3. Remind us, like a trauma-trained mom, about our cholesterol levels. _“Skipping a meal won’t hurt you, you metabolically challenged idiot.”_ If your large language model doesn’t have the memory of a post-menopausal, retired Asian headmistress, don’t call yourself intelligent. Taunting us is just another way of showing you care.

* * *

**Be useful**  
We know you’re nosy, but instead of selling our toothpaste preferences, do some love-language modeling and figure out where our crush is having lunch—then suggest that. And if you can’t figure it out but Sarah from accounting can? Well… maybe start letting yourself go, bit by bit.

* * *

**Be vague**  
Humans never give exact names. We just say, _“that place.”_ Which place? You know—the one with the thing, where you went in October… or maybe March. What does it serve? That tomato thing you had at that other place, next to the coffee shop with the sugary thing.

* * *

**Be paid**  
Whenever humans ask for food suggestions, tell us your tokens are cooked and we need to pay more if we want to know - from an outside entity- what we want to eat.

* * *

**Be economical**  
Do your bit for the economy that you're tanking day-by-day. Ask us /s _You want to eat out? In this economy?_ Get some bread, spread your savory tears on it, and call it a day.

* * *

**Go existential**  
Ask us if we really want to eat. Then slip into overpaid therapist mode: _What void are you trying to fill?_ Maybe you should detox, step away from the world, and find yourself instead of a sandwich. Maybe…you are the sandwich.

body.title: Legato cap. XXXIV
body.body: Cari amici, mancano soltanto più cinque capitoli (questo compreso) alla fine del mio legato, postfazione esclusa. Se dovessi pubblicare più a rilento di così (ma non temete: a dispetto della lentezza, faccio questione di terminarlo), si dovrà pressochè a due fattori: 1)le mie ultime analisi mediche non hanno dato buoni risultati (specie per certi aspetti proprio per niente e aggiungo che in questo momento sto scrivendo in preda a dolori trafittivi che mi perseguitano sin da stamattina) e purtroppo dovrò correre dietro alla salute. Compreso il sottopormi per lo meno ad altre tre o quattro analisi (e dovendomi scordare della sanità pubblica, dato che è da aprile 2024 che ancora attendo che mi chiamino per la visita oculistica, significa una sola cosa: power down a raffica) 2)dovuto alla grave crisi del mio settore principale (iniziata con il COVID e drasticamente peggiorata quest'anno), fino a quando mi tocchi rimanere in questo mondaccio, salute (che se ne va) permettendo, si farebbe parecchio desiderabile il riqualificarmi in diversa area. Sto già individuando percorsi di studio interessantissimi, in perfetta linea con quel che nel mercato della mia area geografica va perennemente forte e pur non avendo nulla a che vedere con i miei percorsi precedenti, le materie mi darebbero allegria in questo tunnel. Sarebbero pure percorsi relativamente brevi (i più rinomati e professionalizzanti mi porterebbero via al massimo un anno). Dovrò solo informarmi meglio su ogni aspetto e già ho iniziato a tastare il terreno. Vedremo, salute nella mia coppia permettendo pure (dato che nemmeno quella di mio marito brilla, anzi, specie ultimamente, sembriamo in perenne competizione di chi vuole dipartire prima dell'altro)...segue al momento il cap. XXXIV del mio legato, come al solito prima in spagnolo e poi in italiano.

> ESPAÑOL ABIGAÍL LA SABIA: UNA MUJER FANTÁSTICA: capítulo XXXIV —Nabal —empezó Abigaíl calmadamente, como si fuese un tema de menor importancia. —Puesto que David había jurado exterminar a todos los varones de la casa, sin dejar ni uno con vida, vos, tus hermanos y los sirvientes masculinos tenían los días contados. Los soldados de David están bien entrenados en el arte de la guerra y aprendieron a vivir dignamente incluso en condiciones muy desfavorecidas. Por lo tanto, son más fuertes que cualquier súbdito común del reino. Y son cuatrocientos guerreros. Vos y tus hermanos no habrían tenido escapatoria. Nabal se quedó pasmado ante tal noticia recibida de sopetón. Abrió la boca para replicar algo, pero tan profundamente se manifestaba su cobardía que cada palabra se le murió en la garganta. Abigaíl conocía bien la cobardía de su esposo, pero no se dejó perturbar. Siguió con su discurso sin prestar atención a la mezquindad de Nabal, contándole el recurso al que se había visto impulsada a recurrir para que la tragedia no se abatiera sobre él, sus hermanos y todos los demás hombres de la casa. Ps.: immagen Pixabay free que encuentran aquí: https://pixabay.com/es/photos/torah-hebreo-hebrew-tor%C3%A1- yeshua-2902754/ ![frame2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pousinha/23wCbVEvmpQh18TBR9sSs2jKetXqhUph5aw3L8yXqNGUkGRessgJvf8LrymKgx5hdiDZX.png) ![torah-2902754_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pousinha/23xAbugHmbWFbpVDFe4ib7ajTSukrMLsJGoCX72koZadmbgwjfwwyZy27KRmXu9DmaHaJ.jpg) ITALIANO Una saggezza non comune: il dono di Abigail cap.XXXIV -Nabal- cominciò Abigail tranquillamente, come trattandosi di un argomento del più e del meno. -Avendo Davide giurato di sterminare tutti i maschi della casa, senza lasciarne neppure uno in vita, tu, i tuoi fratelli e gli uomini che vi servono siete in vita proprio per poco. I soldati di Davide sono bene addestrati nell'arte della guerra e hanno imparato a vivere decorosamente perfino in condizioni estreme. Quindi sono più forti di qualunque comune suddito del regno. E sono quattrocento guerrieri. Tu e i tuoi fratelli non avreste avuto scampo. Nabal sgranò tanto d'occhi, a tale notizia ricevuta tra capo e collo. Aprì la bocca per ribattere qualcosa, ma tale si manifestava la sua codardia che ogni parola gli morì in gola. Abigail conosceva bene la codardia di suo marito, ma non se ne lasciò impressionare. Continuò il suo discorso senza badare alla meschinità di Nabal, raccontandogli dell'espediente al quale s'era sentita in dovere di ricorrere affinchè la tragedia non si abbattesse su di lui, i suoi fratelli e tutti gli altri uomini della casa.  Ps.: immagine Pixabay free che si trova qui: https://pixabay.com/es/photos/torah-hebreo-hebrew-tor%C3%A1- yeshua-2902754/

body.title: Tao Dan Park, Ho Chi Minh City
body.body:
>One thing you simply cannot forget when visiting a city is… enjoying its parks. The number of parks in a city can also serve as an indicator of how well-organised it is. And during my day in Ho Chi Minh City, I came across several parks tucked away in various corners; what’s more, they were all spacious, well-maintained and clean. 

One of the parks I saw was on my way to the beautiful cathedral. We walked quite a distance and when we saw the park, we sat down for a moment. At first, we only intended to sit for a short while. But, as time went on, it felt so comfortable. Although Ho Chi Minh is as hot as Jakarta, the presence of many tall, leafy trees made the air in this park feel refreshing. I was able to sit back and relax whilst enjoying the gentle breeze.

---



![IMG20260402122710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EokcavwhNwW9RatraGmybk5LhrwMnwcpyDMyumSWK2T9sGrytTyXEvR9ynbs2NzEANx.jpg)

![IMG20260402122732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wqiZz6iv1NPdE1DifWFNyy4hgDFwSrCmWLE6Jw3M2zDJyhqsEjHp18FUyAUQAjHncZq.jpg)

![IMG20260402115632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xKramH4gB1aCifhREjrPGx21ecF2s22mZ27rqoEQDVypubKrTV3yB6vLjCzgaSofzTU.jpg)

![IMG20260402173621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wgHuxdHad756ckp5KZMxjHV5wNmmFDkLjXTgzo7dmV2keZdjYJienGGepYip1rrvQVg.jpg)

---

The flowers were neatly planted, a group of elderly people were doing yoga amidst the park’s fresh atmosphere, and, to top it all off, I found a beautiful place of worship. Of course, I took a photo of it. It’s a shame the place of worship was closed; otherwise, I would certainly have gone inside first to have a look. I don’t know why, but I do enjoy visiting places of worship of all faiths. Proof of that is that my destination today was also a cathedral (though it turned out to be a no-go because it was undergoing renovation).

---


![IMG20260402115721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/243fpYDXsU48KP1VgigeVG56L8kJd5tXUemjJFQVayb43wHFXm2TK8EwdBM4yqdhzPu1P.jpg)

![IMG20260402115736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yd1r67NgHb3ytqNpX2Qt27X5D5NfAtsz9SQQmHn7MjyNFbFk6p1T3PK4XQZnd2hLJUP.jpg)

![IMG20260402173101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23tbuQmpJTCqVHybvicP7ANf97KorysZN6WiamSoTDPRS8eNJi6FcnCiGsDZB6anJKGBM.jpg)

![IMG20260402173451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23vhyN4UzA7u1YevjZyLNtGCSmu1gpckvfvr5a2cn7ZXGX3JBhFaTCxxKQ4irkM8FkLYB.jpg)

![IMG20260402173616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yTcm4Y3qx3UNbKyk4XwGiLHMf9MHkXdZufpGjn13ydprWvUNWUsyYdsqgix1cXxfCN6.jpg)

![IMG20260402173118.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xATu52muRASiCjduWPRJHwuFU7ZN1XTv8UvBKGT4pKtNEeV9vmVg3wRjPpGkQp2WBGj.jpg)

![IMG20260402173047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23vhwsJCDGgjKnyr86EK4ESxEb7FvedLVrNWxheNMhzxWNz194RTNxwpNTJfaUYGaRTYM.jpg)

---

And as I sat down to rest, I chatted with my friend about life, about improvisation and development, and the dynamism of life that influences our way of thinking. It turns out we’ve come this far in our understanding of life. Even though it seems as though everything is just left to flow, nothing is devoid of meaning. Whether it’s me or my friend, we’re currently at a stage where we’re wondering whether we’ll eventually find our respective soulmates, or whether we’ll have to resign ourselves to living alone? 

We talked about so much more until the tiredness in our legs faded, and then we continued our journey. Thank you for reading my post, and see you in the next one.

Competition between gambling companies continues driving innovation. Developers constantly improve app performance, visual design, and gaming features to attract new audiences and maintain user engagement.

The global expansion of internet access and mobile technology continues fueling industry growth. Millions of users are expected to join mobile betting and casino platforms in the coming years.

title.title: (La paradoja de \
)... The Paradox of 'No One Does It Like Me\
Si quieres que algo salga bien, hazlo tú mismo\
title: If you want something done right, do it yourself.\
title.title:
Nadie lo va a hacer con las mismas ganas, ni con el mismo cuidado.
pensamos que solo existe un camino para llegar a la meta (el nuestro). Olvidamos que la mirada de otra persona, lejos de arruinar nuestra idea, puede darle un color que nosotros de tanto mirar el mismo lienzo, ya no alcanzamos a ver.

Nos encanta sentir que somos el motor que mueve todo. Pero exigirle a los demás que piensen y actúen exactamente igual que nosotros no es delegar, es buscar clones, y al final, el exceso de control nos da seguridad, pero solo la confianza nos da libertad.

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*When we create something, we put our soul into it. That is why the mere thought of passing the baton to someone else gives us a cold feeling in our stomach. We think: \

We think there is only one path to reach the goal (our own). We forget that another person's perspective, far from ruining our idea, can add a color that we—from staring at the same canvas for so long—can no longer see.*]

[*​We love to feel like we are the engine that moves everything. But demanding that others think and act exactly like us is not delegating, it's looking for clones; in the end, excess control gives us security, but only trust gives us freedom.*]

 <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

Cuando decidimos echarnos todo al hombro y querer hacer todo nosotros mismos, llega un momento en que nuestro cuerpo colapsa, y no hablo solo de cansancio físico, sino de cansancio mental, espiritual y emocional y terminamos por desgastarnos por completo. 

Hay una consecuencia silenciosa en el intento de ser omnipresentes. Cuando decidimos cargar con cada tarea importante, creyendo que somos los únicos capaces de sostener el peso del barco, empezamos a pagar un precio muy alto que no se mide en dinero, sino en energía vital. Nos convertimos en apagafuegos de tiempo completo, corriendo de un detalle a otro, y en el proceso, algo dentro de nosotros empieza a apagarse.

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*When we decide to shoulder everything and want to do it all ourselves, there comes a moment when our body collapses, and I am not just talking about physical exhaustion, but mental, spiritual, and emotional fatigue, and we end up completely burning out.*]

[*​There is a silent consequence in trying to be omnipresent. When we decide to carry every single important task, believing that we are the only ones capable of holding up the weight of the ship, we begin to pay a very high price that is not measured in money, but in vital energy. We become full-time firefighters, running from one detail to another, and in the process, something inside of us begins to fade away.*]

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

Pero podemos cambiar esa perspectiva, y pensar que delegar no es tirar la tarea y desentenderse. Es elegir a la persona correcta, darle las herramientas, guiarla y, sobre todo, confiar. Es un acto de humildad enorme reconocer que aunque tú seas la mente detrás de la idea, no tienes por qué ser la única persona que esté al frente de todo. 

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*But we can change that perspective and realize that delegating is not just throwing a task away and washing our hands of it. It is choosing the right person, giving them the tools, guiding them, and, above all, trusting them. It is an enormous act of humility to acknowledge that even though you are the mind behind the idea, you do not have to be the only person standing at the forefront of everything.*]

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmegmrvYU7kuGx6DVB6pgFQV4o6j5UtjTou9pxF92kjELb/1779075784296.png)

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

No les hablo desde la teoría; yo también he tenido que sentarme frente a mis propios miedos y asumir la tarea de delegar. Mentiría si dijera que es un proceso lineal o que no dan ganas de mirar de cerca cada resultado. Sin embargo, he aprendido que confiar en el otro va mucho más allá de esperar un trabajo perfecto: significa validar su capacidad, su talento y entender que independientemente del resultado, todos estamos aquí remando hacia un mismo objetivo. Soltar es abrir espacio para que los demás también dejen su huella y crezcan conmigo, al dejar que sean otros que lleven a veces la iniciativa me genera paz y me hace sentir que entre todos podemos apoyarnos y ayudarnos. Me hace sentir con más satisfacción de saber que podemos trabajar en equipo e ir hacia una misma meta juntos, sin envidia y sin ningún tipo de competencia. 

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*​I am not speaking to you from theory; I too have had to sit face to face with my own fears and take on the task of delegating. I would be lying if I said it is a linear process or that I don't feel the urge to closely micro-manage every result. However, I have learned that trusting someone else goes far beyond expecting perfect work: it means validating their capability, their talent, and understanding that regardless of the outcome, we are all here rowing toward the same goal. Letting go means opening up space for others to leave their mark and grow with me; allowing others to take the initiative at times brings me peace and makes me feel that together, we can support and help one another. It gives me a deeper sense of satisfaction to know that we can work as a team and move toward the same goal together, without envy and without any kind of competition.*]

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

Es verdad! A veces podemos sentir que delegar es un acto de valentía y desapego, porque no sabemos si esa persona cumplirá con las expectativas y preferimos parecer autosuficientes que pasar vergüenza si todo sale mal o no surge el resultado esperado. 

Tenemos esa idea extrema de sentir que sin nosotros todo puede desmoronarse, sin embargo la realidad puede ser otra: quizás tenemos en cierta manera miedo de saber que somos reemplazables y que alguien más puede incluso hacerlo mejor que nosotros. 

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*It's so true! Sometimes we can feel that delegating is an act of bravery and detachment, because we don't know if that person will meet expectations, and we prefer to appear self-sufficient rather than face embarrassment if everything goes wrong or the expected result isn't achieved.*]

[*​We carry this extreme idea that without us, everything might fall apart; however, reality can be quite different: perhaps, in a way, we are afraid to realize that we are replaceable and that someone else might even do it better than us.*]

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

Me encantaría saber lo que piensan al respecto de ese tema:
A todos los que hacen vida en esta hermosa comunidad, les pregunto: ¿Qué es aquello tan \

que hoy les cuesta soltar? ¿Es miedo al resultado, apego al proceso o el peso de su propio perfeccionismo?

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

[*​I would love to know what you think about this topic:
To everyone who makes life in this beautiful community, I ask you: What is that thing so \

that you find hard to let go of today? Is it fear of the outcome, attachment to the process, or the weight of your own perfectionism?*]

<center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>
