title.title: Chaos Rising Pokemon TCG Prerelease 02 Blog
title.body: Hi there. Here is blog 02 of my Chaos Rising Pokemon TCG Prerelease event. This is 30 minutes after the first Chaos Rising prerelease in blog 01. This one happened to be on Mother's Day (in Canada). Maybe the Pokemon Company made a booking error having prereleases possible on Mother's Day. Note that this post is kind of long. Read and see what you want. I did copy and paste some stuff in blog 01 onto here. (Sorry.)   ## Prerelease Event Info & Tournament Structure --- Prerelease events are casual tournament events where players/participants open packs early before the release date. Different stores have different tournament structures and prizing. This second one was at Banana Games. Their price was 45 CAD instead of 40 CAD before 13% tax. They do an extra 2 packs before deckbuilding. More cards to work with here.

>Image Source More prerelease info can be found in my previous posts or from a Youtube guide such as this one: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l8u1Fu0ZnL4   ## Deckbuilding --- The deck I got was different. From my build and battle kit, I got the Ampharos deck. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc9dDKZ6S3Mudio7qzbVEabffpnjiqiQ3ZHoTZfWp7oJv/img_20260510_160410.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJuGTXnwCkHCh9UoqyQktXNGrrFTH6maGDknSL3Uv7Uv/img_20260510_160739.jpg) From the extra packs, I did get some Pokemon ex. Mega Pyroar was not really usable due to energy typing. I did use one Mincinno and one Cincinno ex that I pulled. (Pokemon Proxies images.) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsotBR9epRVCXaV25rbzgQDmxmwy3f4TXmaTpHPXQXFz/img_20260510_161024.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRaCchh4F7bKcJcgph8QamtYGX84hh1nfTNuWSQxubXGh/img_20260510_162638.jpg) | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-015-Mega_Pyroar_ex-OQDBFEiz.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-070-Minccino-DCwTxCZm.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-071-Cinccino_ex-DhjIuAqS.png |   I made some small adjustments to the deck. Minus 2 Emolga for two Speed Deoxys I pulled. Minus 2 Lightning Energy for 2 Psychic Energy. To make room for the one Mincinno and one Cincinno ex I think I cut the one Ultra Ball from the deck and one Lightning Energy.   ## Round One --- During deckbuilding, there was one guy was loud and kind of annoying. He would talk out loud to his peers and I think he talked about how he was just skill diff his opponents. Whatever that means. Prereleases are mostly random. You play with random cards against random decks with random opponents. There is skill diff in decision making and how you play though. That is maybe 50 % of the time. I was locked in and ignored him during deckbuilding. It turned out he was my round one opponent. I have never met this guy before but I think he is a regular player. Not sure. I was up against his Goodra deck with maybe a Trevanant. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-039-Trevenant-CBofXS-a.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-037-Meowstic-BBscqcPY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-066-Goodra-B9ZUOHAX.png |   I do take the early lead. One key moment was me using Judge so that the Ampharos gets the attack boost from its ability. Instead of 140 damage, 240 damage was needed to one hit knockout his Goodra with my Ampharos. | | | |---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-029-Ampharos-Dssy1p__.png | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/POR/POR_076_R_EN_LG.png |   In the mid game I lose some momentum. I think his Goodra knocked out my Ampharos. He also used Meowstick to attack me and move energy. At this point, I had to resort to using Cincinno ex as my final attacker to try to get my final Prize card. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-071-Cinccino_ex-DhjIuAqS.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-037-Meowstic-BBscqcPY.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-066-Goodra-B9ZUOHAX.png |   There was some back and forth going on. My plan was to get one more energy for Cincinno ex to get 120 damage for my last knockout. I do end up getting the topdeck card Energy card I needed, attach Energy, attack and win. It was a close match. I barely win. The opponent did not say much. I suspect he went away fast, went to gossip with his friends. There are some young players in cliques at these places.   ## Round Two --- When I was saw the pairing, I was downpaired against someone with a 0 loss and 1 win record. This is kind of suspect to me. My record against downpaired opponents is not great. In a few instances, I was the downpaired opponent with a worse record than the opponent and managed to win. Round one opponent was on my left. I don't know if he knew my opponent. He told my opponent to `Beat him up` (him as in me). I think he was joking but that is a weird thing to say anywhere. (Looking back I should have been confrontational and reported for possible harassment/taunting. But I was locked in.) | | | | |---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-013-Delphox-BKVSaIaN.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-009-Ninetaless-yZFmjh66.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-011-Fennekin-CnwL6jlN.png | The opponent's deck was Delphox with Ninetales. What was weird right away was that this guy was playing really fast. Very fast as if he has a flight to catch. So okay, this guy is a regular or maybe pro. I thought to myself `Wtf is this? Why go so hard a casual prerelease?`. At a few points, I matched his speed because I can if I wanted to. Long story short, I lose this one badly even though this game was kind of long. Ampharos cannot one hit knockout a 160 HP Delphox without matching hand size. The opponent would just retreat and use a new attacker. I regretted not putting a Keldeo in the deck instead of Deoxys. | | | | | |---|---|---|---| | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-034-Deoxys-DBf6WLGH.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-019-Keldeo-Cz_er4dO.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-013-Delphox-BKVSaIaN.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-029-Ampharos-Dssy1p__.png |   This loss was just weird. I did not play badly overall but the matchup is kind of unfavoured for Ampharos. Some of my turns were not great. This guy was playing fast and every turn he had further setup with/without an attack. Cincinno ex did not really save me either. Imagine a new player to the Pokemon TCG goes up against this guy. Some guy who is playing very fast, hand shuffling too much. I am 99% sure the new player would be uncomfortable. I walked out of the room for a break, use the washroom, regroup myself, see some kids play Beyblade.   This event was either before my break or after. My round one opponent with Goodra lost to a Crobat player. It was interesting to see him lose and go 0 wins and 2 losses. Very interesting. Karma at play? Maybe I did not have to be confrontational after all. He got \

also.

|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
| https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-050-Crobat-CuRfF9mT.png  |  https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-066-Goodra-B9ZUOHAX.png | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-049-Golbat-D5AKabNd.png  |


 

## Round Three Versus Crobat Deck
---

I am at 1 win and 1 loss. Round 3 was my brother's round 1 opponent. I knew the deck he was playing. It was a Crobat deck.

My first turn was going second. I did manage to knockout one Zubat with a Surfer to draw cards plus Emolga.

|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
| https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-030-Emolga-DKXUmn7d.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-048-Zubat-BHZlj4Bc.png  | https://limitlesstcg.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/tpci/ASC/ASC_200_R_EN_LG.png  |

 

When his Crobat came in to attack my Deoxys, I had one Ampharos ready to go for the revenge Knockout. Even with his Special Red Card to try to slow me down, I had too much setup and attackers for him to handle. This was a comfortable win.

|   |   |   |
|---|---|---|
| https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-050-Crobat-CuRfF9mT.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-034-Deoxys-DBf6WLGH.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-029-Ampharos-Dssy1p__.png  |

 

This opponent was much more friendlier than the first two opponents. Round one guy probably got tilted or something when I won a close match due to RNG. Round two guy was going hard at max speed at a casual prerelease. This guy seemed more normal and older. 

From talking to my opponent, he mentioned that he cut out Qwilfish in favour of more Roxie's Performance. His deck adjustments were weird. He actually made his preconstructed deck worse in some ways.

|   |   |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|
| https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-051-Qwilfish-BBPmLiLL.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-050-Crobat-CuRfF9mT.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-077-Roxie's_Performance-Am6dOrer.png  | https://pokemonproxies.com/assets/4a-072-Special_Red_Card-B2QzThxU.png  |

 

## Post Tournament + Notes
---

Again, I finish with 2 wins and 1 loss. This is still good. The two extra packs I got each had a Pokemon ex. Even though not an illustration rare, these were solid pulls. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejvvNpSifvvA9swcrt36Z33R6hEtRsL8yX3cWodeBjHw/img_20260510_174944.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxohqJssN2z2CSEfbYcWFc6E9MG8yayxD1i8vyTUVdMr/img_20260510_175030.jpg)


Generally I don't pull special illustration rares from prereleases. From this prerelease, I got more Pokemon ex than expected. 

I do have a third Chaos Rising prerelease post in the works. At first I was not sure about attending a third but I have an checkup appointment in Toronto that was made years ago. It made sense to do a prerelease then go to my medical checkup appointment. 

At this Banana Games store, there are a few weird players that go too hard at a casual prerelease event. They kind of ruin the spirit of the casual event. There is a Professor Oak quote that goes: `\

`. 

I can go hard too but not for prereleases. A & C Games near University of Toronto and Chinatown has a more friendly, laid back and mature vibe. There are still some good players there (not well known top players but some solid players).

After this event, my brother and I go to IKEA to buy a few items. Then we dine out for dinner.

I do have something planned in the next week. At first I did not want to a third prerelease. Since I was visiting Toronto again, I was like okay why not? Third prerelease Chaos Rising blog coming soon.

title.title: 17 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3106: not what it seems
title.body:
/>

“OK, so this is not what it seems … the earthworms needed some help after all that rain. I just discovered them.”

Nine-year-old George Ludlow was helping earthworms by the handful get back to the soil that had crawled to the top of a bunch of soil-filled sandbags, and Capt. R.E. Ludlow was just letting it happen, controlling his impulse to pull his grandson out of all that dirt.

“You know I could use some help here,” George said.

Capt. R.E. Ludlow stuffed down what generations of Ludlow men would have said to him at nine years old if he would have been helping earthworms back into the soil, and just got busy with his grandson.

“See, I get why Amanda is a vegetarian and I may stay over there too, because once you start working with animals, you don't really want to kill them,” George said. “I mean, I would like to know if earthworms taste like gummy worms or spaghetti, but I guess I will never know.”

“I guess not,” Capt. Ludlow said with a smile. “All principled stands require some trade off.”

Major Ironwood Hamilton rolled up with a tractor and a smile.

“Thank you for looking out for the worms,” he said when he heard the explanation of what was going on. “I am going to get them home in one good go, actually.”

“Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay!” George said, and embraced his big cousin.

“Y'all can go on, or stay and watch me return this dirt to the fields, and spread it out.”

“Can I ride?” George said. “Please, Papa?”

“Of course,” Capt. Ludlow said.

“There's enough room for both of you up here,” the Hamilton cousin said, and Capt. Ludlow smiled and helped George up before climbing up himself and enjoying the ride as Tinyville's chief public safety officer returned the last of the soil used to control water flow from Hurricane Mneme to the fields of Tinyville.

“I need this type of job!” George said later.

“Well, you can come be a deputy for me in just nine years,” the police captain of Tinyville said. “But you have to have a good grounding record to pass the background check, so don't get grounded until you are ten years old.”

“Oh, I got this!” George said while his cousin winked at a suddenly chuckling Capt. Ludlow.

赚钱的目的是什么？活了很多年，才通过读书慢慢明白了一些道理。

最大的误区就是把赚钱的目的就理解成了我要赚很多钱，后来我应该是读了《财富自由之路》加上很多其他的书，才知道，人生最高的目标追求应该是“自由”，精神自由，选择自由。

比如，你可以选择过什么样的生活，选择什么样的工作。

进而延伸到其实，人到了中年，很焦虑，本质也是不自由。开始进入上有老下有小的阶段，好多事情是不自由的。更不敢随便失业，冷静下来一想，比如房贷还有那么多要还，没工作没收入的话，还要倒贴进去换房贷。

我身边的好多朋友，应该已经把房贷结清了。我不换二手房，我早期的房贷应该也结清了。现在二手房这边，还有五六万的本金房贷，近20年的还款时限。

想想都觉得可怕。这还要工作到猴年马月，才能没有债务。

老婆这边也是感叹，近期他们发了奖金，于是提议把房贷提前还贷一部分，我们一起凑了个10万，提前还贷了部分。我是套现的币圈的资金。

目前，公积金的利率是2.6%，老婆这边的投资很保守，基本都在货币基金里，可能收益都不到2%，她有更多闲钱提前还款我觉得是合理的。

用豆包分析了最佳的策略，这次我们应该少了3万多的利息。这是直接马上兑现的未来利息收益了。

这次也发现一个原来不知道的：**公积金提前还款是很方便的，不限次数操作，手机上点几下就可以秒还贷**。我之前的印象，还跑银行折腾了几次。

另外之前，我还傻傻的觉得把**多大余额留在公积金账户，这样每个月就可以有钱还贷款了。想想真是傻**，比如公积金多了1万的余额的话，就应该马上操作提前还款部分，直接把公积金的余额提前还款了。这样又可以少不少利息。

整个手机上操作提前还款，没有次数限制，金额100元以上，这几乎是无成本操作。

title.title: Celebrating my husband's life ❤️🎂
title.body: > This Sunday we celebrated my husband’s birthday, and even though we kept it simple, it was full of special moments that bring joy. Early in the morning, I got into cooking mode because I wanted to make him something special so we could sing “Happy Birthday” at home. I made an orange cake and decorated it with chess towers using powdered sugar, and I also made a delicious cheesecake, because in our family, we can’t go without a good dessert to share.

> Este domingo estuvimos celebrando el cumpleaños de mi esposo, y aunque hicimos algo sencillo, estuvo lleno de momentos especiales que dan felicidad. Desde temprano, me puse en modo cocina porque quería prepararle algo especial para cantarle cumpleaños en casa. Hice una torta de naranja a la que le dibujé unas torres de ajedrez espolvoreando azúcar glass, y, también, un quesillo delicioso, porque en nuestra familia nunca puede faltar un buen postre para compartir. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23x1BANhGCmMUhDPvfn5QwPhD9GN3DSi1SSf45w42wgBRrxZ4cDwcjWLWVvwA13GFivbM.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xyZMoxvkMLHqL9fPCf1sTg6vXjPmjxPSEvg4mFKAL8NK4wvFDTSMZRoeFiK8NJyCvvc.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png

title.title: 🎬 📹 Kotaro wa hitori gurashi 🎬 📹
title.body: > Hello my dear friends of The Anime Realm, I hope you're all doing well, just like me. Today I'd like to tell you about an anime I watched a while ago on Netflix, one that's suitable for everyone, and especially for those of us looking for an original story. This is one of those anime that stirs emotions in countless ways and stays with you because of its mysterious backstory. >***Hola mis queridos amigos de The Anime Realm, al igual que yo, espero estén muy bien. Hoy quisiera comentarte sobre un anime que vi hace tiempo en Netflix, uno que es acto para todos, y especialmente para quienes buscamos una historia original. Este es de aquellos anime que emocionan de mil maneras y que se guardan en tu corazón por el trasfondo misterioso que guarda.*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png) |![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EoeJpZ6wYs4CCeNtWWPXqVHCsdfFYUvb4gVVNZiBSqNM4FRm6iWLKEzrNnZZkRMM1K5.png)|![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23yJNdFzdiebKASLfn8tnia2ojSsrchQo9iADsrFkjE4ZwicrSn4pYoS5fWv4w4wXK2Jx.png)| |-|-| [Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kotaro_Lives_Alone) [Source](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/kotaro_lives_alone/s01/e07)

is an anime produced by LIDEN FILMS and directed by Tomoe Makino, consisting of only 10 episodes. It is based on a live-action series and the manga of the same name, which tell the story of Kotaro Sato, a four-year-old boy who lives alone. He and his neighbors experience daily adventures, gradually revealing the boy's brief past.\n\n>***Kotaro Vive Solo o \

es un anime producido por el estudio LIDEN FILMS con la dirección de Tomoe Makino y cuenta únicamente con 10 episodios. Esta es derivada de una serie live action y del manga del mismo nombre, los cuales cuáles cuentan la historia de Kotaro Satо̄, un niño de 4 años que vive solo. Este junto a sus vecinos viven aventuras diarias, en donde poco a poco vamos conociendo el corto pasado de este niño.***

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Mc0blND-vw

<div class\

> Personally, what captivated me about this anime was the emotional and psychological maturity with which the protagonist faces each of his difficulties. And yes, the fact that a 4-year-old boy is dealing with this sounds unrealistic, but the theme is handled very well in every way, especially in the way he confronts his adversities and his reality. Being such a young child, he had to learn much more about adult life and independence, and yet, this boy showed great wisdom in many scenes, but also naiveté that helped him mature further. >***En lo personal, lo que me atrapó de este anime fue la madurez emocional y psicológica con la que este enfrenta cada una de sus dificultades. Y si, el hecho de que un niño de 4 años se enfrente a esto suena irreal, pero el tema es muy bien tratado en cada sentido, en especial con la forma en la que se enfrenta a sus adversidades y su realidad, al ser un niño pequeño, este debía aprender muchas mas cosas sobre la vida adulta y la independencia, y aun asi, este niño mostró mayor sabiduría en muchas escenas, pero también ingenuidades que lo hicieron madurar más.*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png) |![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/AK56BeuXfZb8BPwUjZKBgkfTL1UUoJumubx8URSKsDHeLmf4cWtgSZHthkjukvw.png)|![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/242DX3T4XezEVhyaj2C6ojVX5jyPVVjkwmV9NKvuazKqFVvZ4M6BuGKrW77jBiA7phi4N.jpg)| |-|-| [Source](https://doblaje-espana.fandom.com/es/wiki/Kotaro_vive_solo) [Source](https://kotarolivesalone.fandom.com/wiki/Kotarou_Satou)

>

The interesting thing about Kotaro is that with each scene, the doubt surrounding his past grows, and everything points to a tragic story behind it. Even though this boy appears brave and self-assured, he's possibly hiding from something or someone that torments him, and all signs point to his father, but the short production run didn't allow the full story to be shown.

>***El detalle con Kotaro está en que con todas las escenas, aumenta la duda sobre su pasado, y todo indica que hubo una historia trágica detrás. Por más que este niño se muestra valiente y seguro de sí mismo, este posiblemente se esconde de algo o alguien que lo atormenta, y todo apunta a su padre, pero la corta producción que tuvo se limitó a mostrar la historia completa.***

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

|![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23wqvtQ5KdeF3zZ8jz1VUtJ89VKgWqvkkX4Y66FmyJHC8htxcp6JR3xeCxY42RHsw733R.jpg)|![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23y96R2oL6aEYusuQPEm5V4FWywd7zhm8f6H1jgrQLtUnWaJw1dz9pwbJYSysm5MvKC5e.jpg)|
|-|-|


[Source](https://english-voice-over.fandom.com/wiki/Kotaro_Lives_Alone_(2022))

[Source](https://media.netflix.com/es_es/only-on-netflix/81275353)

Despite much speculation and even fake news about its continuation, Netflix was forced to admit it was on hiatus due to a bad deal regarding the rights to the work, leaving the ending uncertain in this format. However, nowadays, if you want to continue the story and find out what happened, it's recommended to buy the manga, which concluded in 2023. Personally, I haven't researched anything beyond what I saw in the series, although I would like to own the manga to complete the story that was left unfinished in the animated version.

>***A pesar de que hubo muchas especulaciones, como falsas noticias sobre la continuación de este, pues Netflix se vio obligado a admitir su pausa por un mal acuerdo sobre los derechos sobre la obra, teniendo un final incierto en este formato. Pero hoy en día se recomienda, si quieres continuar con la historia y saber qué pasó, comprar el manga que llegó a su fin en el año 2023, yo por mi parte no he investigado más allá de lo que vi en la serie, aunque si quisiera tener el manga para poder completar esa historia que no tuvo fin en su versión animada.***

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<div class\

> I'm not really disappointed that it was canceled, since these days series renewals are very frequent. Perhaps one day we'll hear the news that Kotaro is returning to finish what left us wanting more. Kotaro Lives Alone is one of those anime that doesn't have bad viewership; in fact, all of us who have seen it faithfully hope it will return. >***Realmente no me decepciona el que esta haya sido cancelada, pues hoy en día las renovaciones de series han sido muy constantes, quizás algún día también nos encontremos con la noticia de que Kotaro vuelve para finalizar lo que un día nos dejó con ganas de más. Kotaro vive solo, es de esos animes que no tienen mala audiencia, de hecho, todos los que lo hemos visto, esperamos fielmente que esta vuelva.*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png) *** ***

title.title: A Sublime Sunday Between the Sand and the Sea [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>

Greetings, friends of the @SublimeSunday community! I hope you all had a wonderful weekend.

This is my first time posting in this community, and it caught my attention because it’s a unique opportunity to share the many activities and experiences we enjoy on Sundays—like discovering new places.

![134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23w2nzH6EKMppvTAY6rwvACGAAQNMnjAkWVckKxVY4NQ43uoYbhCqrBGkenTpAFXPe4bh.jpg)


This time, I want to show you some photos from a trip to the beautiful beaches of Tucacas, in Falcón State, Venezuela.

I traveled with my family on Saturday, and we saved the beach visit for Sunday, hoping the weather would be on our side because there was heavy rain along the entire highway, which delayed us, and we arrived in Tucacas late in the afternoon.

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpvguvUryN1qJP3u3BhEADnhQ2MW21HoMiKmT4iZJGWxq32FdTEtcQ2yGTsrjc1b1qa.jpg)

Fortunately for everyone, the next day was bright and sunny—perfect for a fantastic day at the beach—so we gathered our gear and set out to make the most of the day. 

I took the opportunity to snap several photos of the beautiful seascapes, with their abundant mangroves and crystal-clear waters. We also had the chance to meet people from other regions who had also come to enjoy these beautiful beaches in my country.


We also got the most out of our visit because we met a local man who very kindly guided us to a great spot and acted as a sort of tour guide, explaining some important aspects of this beautiful part of the country.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EprS7XmQNmej1FHLDpKJVw472En2XLJ2KcnsTLRbHfwN25N9Kajsa8mqXpkyBJmGNFE.jpg)

The number of hotels and inns in this part of Falcón is impressive, and yet, during the high season, it is difficult to find available rooms due to the overwhelming number of tourists who flock to these lovely beaches.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpT3Dnx9QFQqB8NuU39n5685puEQg6nLBj7umnwHHknFP2sNnrnymgApZxSHCrdEMua.jpg)


![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/241tQby3zMnJhj1Q7xtXmCBSAV2ahvAXAGtczbDrabPMc3DZBgScmkjD9Y88vg7w2dj9G.jpg)

It was a Sunday full of joy and wonderful experiences, where we were able to get away from the noise of the city and the daily grind of work. It’s a place where time stands still and we feel overwhelmed by the immensity and majestic colors of the sea.

That wraps up this delightful experience, which we plan to repeat as soon as we can. Blessings to all.

![thank-you-very-much-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5tAfanGoki9gRgA1nn2EzvYT5vv3UHJpGVYDF6ChQArJuJ8CVE1AkE1RuurNAtemxv.jpeg)


* Images taken with a Samsung Galaxy A12
* Translator used: Deepl
* Original Content

<div class=\

> # Version en Español # Un sublime domingo entre la arena y el mar Saludos amigos de esta comunidad @SublimeSunday, espero que hayan disfrutado de un excelente fin de semana. Es la primera vez que publico en esta comunidad y me llamó la atención porque es una oportunidad única para abrir la ventana a muchas actividades y experiencias que vivimos los domingos, como por ejemplo conocer sitios nuevos. ![134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23w2nzH6EKMppvTAY6rwvACGAAQNMnjAkWVckKxVY4NQ43uoYbhCqrBGkenTpAFXPe4bh.jpg) En esta oportunidad quiero mostrarles imágenes de un viaje a las hermosas playas de Tucacas, en el estado Falcón en Venezuela. Viajé con mi familia el sábado y dejamos para el domingo la visita a la playa, rogando que el tiempo nos favoreciera porque toda la carretera estuvo acompañada de fuertes lluvias lo cual nos retrasó y llegamos ya finalizando la tarde a Tucacas. ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpvguvUryN1qJP3u3BhEADnhQ2MW21HoMiKmT4iZJGWxq32FdTEtcQ2yGTsrjc1b1qa.jpg) Afortunadamente para todos, el día siguiente estuvo iluminado con un radiante sol, especial para un fantástico día de playa, así que nos armamos con los aperos y nos dispusimos a disfrutar al máximo ese día. Aproveché la ocasión para tomar varias fotos a los bonitos paisajes marinos con abundante presencia de manglares y aguas cristalinas. Además tuvimos la oportunidad de conocer personas de otras regiones que también venían a disfrutar de estas hermosas playas de mi país. También pudimos sacar provecho del sitio porque nos encontramos un señor, habitante de a zona que muy amablemente nos guio hasta un buen sitio y nos hizo una especie de guia turística, explicándonos algunos aspectos importantes de esta bonita zona del país. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EprS7XmQNmej1FHLDpKJVw472En2XLJ2KcnsTLRbHfwN25N9Kajsa8mqXpkyBJmGNFE.jpg) Es impresionante la cantidad de hoteles y posadas que posee este lugar de Falcón y a pesar de eso, en la temporada alta es difícil lograr conseguir habitaciones libres, por la cantidad abrumadora de turistas que invaden estas agradables playas. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpT3Dnx9QFQqB8NuU39n5685puEQg6nLBj7umnwHHknFP2sNnrnymgApZxSHCrdEMua.jpg) ![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/241tQby3zMnJhj1Q7xtXmCBSAV2ahvAXAGtczbDrabPMc3DZBgScmkjD9Y88vg7w2dj9G.jpg) Fue un domingo lleno de alegría y bonitas experiencias, donde pudimos alejarnos un poco del ruido de la ciudad y de la rutina del trabajo. Es un sitio donde el tiempo se detiene y nos sentimos atapados por la inmensidad y majestuoso colorido del mar. Hasta aquí esta agradable experiencia que pensamos repetir en cuanto podamos. Bendiciones para todos. ![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5tAfanGoki9gRgA1nn2EzvYT5vv3UHJpGVYDF6ChQArJuJ8CVE1AkE1RuurNAtemxv.jpeg) * Imágenes tomadas con Samsung Galaxy A12 * Traductor usado: Deepl * Contenido original [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.789861 lat -68.327432 long d3scr)

title.title: Conociendo la Plaza Héroes de Cantaura y sus hermosos Lirios Araña [Esp-Eng-Pt]
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad de @amazingnature. Es un placer saludarlos y desearles un día feliz y lleno de bendiciones. Que las bendiciones de Dios inunden sus vidas. Hoy les comparto mi visita a la plaza Héroes de Cantaura, ubicada en la calle Sucre, muy cerca de las ruinas del Castillo de Santa María de la Cabeza, la Basílica Menor de Santa Inés y el centro cultural. Esta plaza rinde homenaje a quienes cayeron en Cantaura, como indica su nombre. La plaza es un terreno con varias pasarelas de concreto que conducen al centro cultural, donde se realizan exposiciones de pintura. También cuenta con una galería dedicada a exhibir obras de artistas regionales y nacionales. Otras pasarelas llevan al Castillo de Santa María de la Cabeza y a la Iglesia de Santa Inés. Destaca por sus grandes árboles, incluyendo neem, y plantas ornamentales como lirios araña. Estas se encuentran a lo largo de los bordes de las pasarelas y los muros que delimitan la plaza. El área fue limpiada recientemente, como se puede apreciar en las fotografías. Alrededor hay un pequeño muro de concreto de color gris rojizo. Frente a ella se encuentra la casa natal del poeta Ramos Sucre, y en esta calle se ubican varias oficinas gubernamentales que destacan por su diseño colonial. Se pueden observar plantas de lirios en los muros que dividen la plaza, y tenemos una vista parcial de las ruinas del Castillo de Santa María de la Cabeza, la galería, la iglesia y la Basílica Menor de Santa Inés.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @amazingnature community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings flood your lives. Today I'm sharing my visit to the plaza located on Sucre Street, very close to the ruins of Santa María de la Cabeza Castle, the Minor Basilica of Santa Inés, and the cultural center. This plaza pays homage to those who fell in Cantaura, as its name indicates. The plaza is a plot of land with several concrete walkways leading to the cultural center, where painting exhibitions are held. It also has a gallery dedicated to exhibiting the works of regional and national artists. Other walkways lead to the Santa María de la Cabeza Castle and the Santa Inés Church. It is notable for its large trees, including neem trees, and ornamental plants such as spider lilies. These are located along the edges of the walkways and the walls that define the plaza. The area was recently cleaned, as can be seen in the photographs. Around it is a small reddish-gray concrete wall. In front is the birthplace of the poet Ramos Sucre, and on this street are several government offices that stand out for their colonial design. Lily plants can be seen on the walls dividing the plaza, and we have a partial view of the ruins of the Santa María de la Cabeza Castle, the gallery, the church, and the Santa Inés Minor Basilica. ![PC (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1YKE6BvEYD5dxGNnygL7qN8p9U9UEBNb85yL9DVnAESRyGcVFPKmBujqpSzHW9TWk.jpeg) ![PC (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpXJRZ5erm6GpyJ9vUkttGKS5U9qjwoGLCHd1XkUp1DKAYetYz572N6vso9NiTG3CeC.jpeg) ![PC (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wWxy3YNFLSHmgQUtJQfFDpmEMAHRDmBBWDkPxarztek5bGvueS4iprFiUa571sC3Z36.jpeg) ![PC (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNoNnG1ni58TJFBBqivs57X1gd1PMYKiET4wiHj9RTPXDxTFc6TJKzaKVGx2FNbX9G.jpeg) ![PC (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpQwM4XiYw7hi12ntTnVNH6JoufVamqaYQvHoHRbV1SiDaSCRf2Exe1Fr1ncSUcP6Zp.jpeg) ![PC (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpQwHFTR4Yv1YCbiHxxXkiAbqBedBReMVL9psoQv2JehBSdtR9JiCsfSVpEKDRw6Ewo.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

A praça é um espaço com vários caminhos de concreto que levam ao centro cultural, onde são realizadas exposições de arte. Ela também possui uma galeria dedicada a obras de artistas regionais e nacionais. Outros caminhos conduzem ao Castelo de Santa María de la Cabeza e à Igreja de Santa Inés. title.title: A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
title.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. Today I’m bringing you a series that’s very different from anything I’ve shared with you so far. Well, it’s not the first time I’ve featured a Slice of Life anime per se, but I do think it’s the first time I’ve featured an anime with this kind of story. I say this mainly because I don’t recall seeing any other anime like it in the past. Based on the manga series of the same name written and illustrated by Kuzushiro, “A Mangaka’s Weirdly Wonderful Workplace” is an animated adaptation produced by the studio
>Voil. Check out the anime about the young, shy, and antisocial mangaka.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Hoy les traigo una serie muy diferente a todo lo que les he traído hasta ahora. Bueno, no es la primera vez que les traigo un Slice of Life como tal, pero sí creo que es la primera vez que traigo un anime con este tipo de historia. Digo esto más que nada porque no recuerdo haber visto algún otro anime parecido en el pasado. Basada en la serie de manga homónima escrita e ilustrada por Kuzushiro, \
es una adaptación animada producida por el estudio Voil. Conoce el anime de la joven y tímida mangaka asocial.

>

Plot

The anime begins by introducing us to Nana Futami, a shy and often nervous young manga artist who has just started serializing her first original work, titled Dear Subaru. With the help of her editor, Kaede Satō, and her one and only reliable assistant, Mizuki Hazama, she will try to fulfill her dreams of becoming a renowned Shōjo manga artist. However, her anxiety will cause her to have some delusions, in addition to the long hours, constant deadlines, and many other problems she will face in this massive and grueling manga industry.

>

Trama

El anime inicia presentándonos a Nana Futami, una joven mangaka tímida y frecuentemente nerviosa que acaba de serializar su primera obra original llamada Dear Subaru. Con la ayuda de su editora Kaede Satō y su única y confiable asistente Mizuki Hazama intentará cumplir con sus sueños de ser una reconocida mangaka Shōjo. Sin embargo, sus problemas de nerviosismo le causarán algunos delirios, además de las extensas horas de trabajo, los retrasos constantes de entregas y muchos otros problemas que afrontará en esta enorme y extenuante industria del manga.

> I think I took what I said the other day about expanding the variety of anime I watch each season a little too seriously. At the end of last year, I came across this anime and just decided to give it a try because it looked like fun. The humor, while not the best in my opinion, still grew on me, and it was easy to get into the first episode. Over time, I grew quite fond of it, even though the plot focuses solely on the daily life of a mangaka. Yes, this is one of those laid-back Slice of Life anime that’s also funny and caters to a very specific niche. Back then, I think I was still excited about what I’d experienced with

>Zenshū, so I decided to watch this anime to explore the world of manga further. But unlike the Isekai I just mentioned, A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace is a very different anime from what anyone would expect to see. I’ll warn you up front that it’s not for everyone, especially since it’s a Josei anime (meaning it’s aimed at a female and adult audience). And well, you can tell me what I was doing watching an anime for women at the end of last year.

>
Creo que me tomé muy en serio lo que comenté la otra vez sobre ampliar más la variedad de animes que veo en emisión cada temporada. A finales del año pasado me encontré este anime y simplemente me quedé a verlo porque lo consideré algo divertido. El humor que tiene, si bien no es el mejor a mí parecer, me gustó igualmente y fue sencillo llegar a ver su primer episodio. Con el tiempo, le tomé algo de cariño, a pesar de que su trama trate únicamente de la vida diaria de una mangaka. Si, este es de esos animes Slice of Life tranquilos, pero a la vez cómicos y que tratan de un nicho muy específico. En ese entonces creo que aún estaba emocionado de lo que llegué a experimentar con

>Zenshū, así que decidí ver este anime para explorar más sobre el mundo del manga. Pero a diferencia del Isekai que les acabo de mencionar, A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace es un anime muy distinto a lo que cualquiera esperaría ver. De antemano les aviso que no es para todo el mundo, especialmente porque es un anime Josei (o sea, que está dirigido para un público femenino y adulto). Y bueno, ya me dirás tú qué estuve haciendo yo viendo un anime para mujeres a finales del año pasado.

> That said, I’ll say it again: it was a lot of fun watching this anime back then, and I had a great time, especially because I really got into the story it tells. As you’ve probably read above, the story is about Nana Futami, a young manga artist who managed to get her first full-length manga, Dear Subaru, serialized thanks to the help of her editor, Kaede Satō. However, because of this, she’ll have to adapt to a grueling schedule filled with deadlines, constant delays, signing sessions, and other mangaka duties she has to fulfill. To make matters worse, her shyness and nervousness will cause her to run into the occasional extra problem with her editor; plus, her assistant, Mizuki Hazama, will have to deal with our protagonist’s delusions while helping her with her work. The most interesting thing about everything we see in this anime is what we learn about the world of manga. Or rather, at least what Nana’s perspective shows us in this story. The horrendously long hours, the problems with deadlines, the differences between editors and mangaka, and the idealization they have of their work.

>
Igualmente, vuelvo a decirles que fue muy divertido ver este anime en su momento y lo pasé genial, sobre todo porque llegué a disfrutar de la historia que nos cuenta. Como ya leyeron arriba -supongo yo-, la historia trata de Nana Futami, una joven mangaka que consiguió serializar su primer manga largo llamado Dear Subaru, gracias a la ayuda de su editora, Kaede Satō. Sin embargo, debido a esto, tendrá que adaptarse a un horario súper fuerte con trabajos por entregar, retrasos constantes, sesiones de firmas y demás cosas de mangakas que cumplir. Para colmo, su problema de timidez y nerviosismo harán que tenga uno que otro problema de más con su editora; además de que su asistente, Mizuki Hazama, tendrá que lidiar con los delirios de nuestra protagonista mientras la ayuda con su trabajo. Lo interesante de todo lo que llegamos a ver en este anime es lo que aprendemos acerca del mundo del manga. O bueno, al menos lo que nos muestra el punto de vista de Nana en esta historia. Los horarios horriblemente largos, los problemas con las entregas, las diferencias que hay entre los editores y mangakas y la idealización que tienen con su trabajo.

> It’s true that most of what we see in this anime is pure comedy, especially when it comes to our protagonist, whose personality and way of thinking are downright hilarious. Whenever something happens, the way she reacts, speaks, and even interacts with people keeps you entertained. But amid all those pranks, double entendres, and absurd moments, there are some serious themes worth considering. Nana Futami’s story alone teaches us how to deal with certain emotional and personal issues, such as low self-esteem. Cases of bullying, labor exploitation, the tension between creativity and popularity, the inability to fulfill your dreams, and many other issues are addressed here. It may not have the best character development in the world, but at least we get to know more than enough about each of the main characters in this anime to become somewhat familiar with them. You’ll probably think I’m exaggerating all this based on what you saw in the trailer. But while it may seem like a quiet story—which it is—it’s also entertaining and even a little emotional.

>
Si es cierto que la mayoría de cosas que vemos en este anime son pura comedia, sobre todo cuando se trata de nuestra protagonista quien tiene una personalidad y forma de pensar que da hasta risa. Siempre que sucede algo, su forma de reaccionar, hablar y tratar incluso con la gente hace que te entretengas viéndola. Pero entre todas esas bromas pesadas, chistes de doble sentido y momentos absurdos, hay temas un poco densos que son dignos de tomarse en cuenta. Ya de por sí el caso de Nana Futami nos enseña cómo afrontar ciertos problemas emocionales y personales como lo puede ser la falta de autoestima. Casos de bullying, explotación laboral, competencia entre creatividad y popularidad, imposibilidad de cumplir con tus sueños y muchas otras cosas más son las que se tratan acá. No tendrá el mejor desarrollo de personajes del mundo, pero al menos llegamos a conocer más que suficiente de cada uno de los personajes principales de este anime de manera que lleguemos a familiarizarnos de alguna forma con ellos. Seguramente llegarás a pensar que estoy exagerando con todo esto debido a lo que llegaste a ver en el trailer. Pero si bien pareciera tener una historia tranquila -lo cual es así-, también cuenta con ser entretenida y un poco emotiva, inclusive.

> It’s not just the story of Nana Futami trying to adjust to her new life as an up-and-coming manga artist; it’s also the story of a young woman struggling with self-esteem issues who is slowly making her dreams come true. Another thing I really liked and found very entertaining about this anime is the relationship that develops between Nana and her editor, Kaede. At first, she’s portrayed as a mature, professional, and even perfect woman (at least that’s how our protagonist sees her), but little by little we get to see what Kaede is really like with Nana, as well as what she thinks and feels about her. I don’t know if it’s a yuri anime, but based on what I’ve seen in all the episodes so far, I highly doubt it. But anyway, I’m not saying that this bothers me if it is the case. I think that, for a simple slice-of-life series with satirical and somewhat mature humor, I expected some Fanservice, which it doesn’t have either. This is good, and also obvious when you remember that it’s a Josei series—meaning its target audience is women, so it wouldn’t make sense. And well, let’s just say there are a few references to real-life events in the manga world that some of you reading this might recognize. I honestly didn’t catch any of them because I don’t read manga. Yeah, I don’t know why I watched this anime about mangaka when I’m not even a manga fan.

>
No es solo la historia de Nana Futami intentando adaptarse a su nueva vida como mangaka en ascenso, sino que también es la historia de una joven con problemas de autoestima que está cumpliendo poco a poco con sus sueños. Otra cosa que me gusta y me entretuvo mucho de este anime es la relación que vemos desarrollarse entre Nana y su editora Kaede. Al principio nos la pintan como una mujer madura, profesional y hasta perfecta (al menos así la ve nuestra protagonista), pero poco a poco llegamos a ver cómo es Kaede con Nana, además de lo que opina y siente por ella. No sé si sea un anime Yuri, pero hasta lo que llegué a ver en todos sus episodios lo dudo mucho. Pero bueno, tampoco estoy diciendo que esto me moleste si es el caso. Considero que, para ser un simple Slice of Life con humor satírico y un tanto maduro, esperaba algo de Fanservice, cosa que tampoco tiene. Esto es bueno, además de obvio al recordar que es un Josei, o sea, su público objetivo son mujeres así que no tiene sentido. Y bueno, digamos que hay una que otra referencia a casos reales del mundo del manga que puede que alguno de los que me lean reconozcan. Yo sinceramente es que no capté ninguna porque no leo manga. Si, no sé por qué he visto este anime de mangakas si ni siquiera soy fan del manga.

> To wrap things up, I’d like to talk about the audiovisual aspects of A Mangaka’s Weirdly Wonderful Workplace. While the studio behind it seems relatively new, I have to admit they didn’t do a bad job with this series. Quite the opposite, in fact—the art style and character designs are particularly appealing. It isn’t exactly smooth, but that’s not necessary since it achieves its goal of entertaining us with a perfect blend of drawing styles and very well-executed visual effects. Especially when it comes to showing expressions, emotions, reactions… well, all that stuff. I really like the vibrant and varied color palette, as well as the use of light and shadow. The shots are almost always the same, so don’t expect breathtaking views or anything like that. Remember, we’re talking about the story of an antisocial mangaka, so obviously we’ll almost always see the same shots of the room or studio where our protagonist works (and lives). Still, the attention to detail in the setting, the designs, and the way each character’s work is presented is excellent. The sound effects also do their job well, as does the soundtrack. Anyway, here’s a unique anime that might interest you.
Personally, I give it a rating of 8/10 in terms of the Slice of Life and comedy genres.

>
Para finalizar, les hablaré del apartado audiovisual de A Mangaka’s Weirdly Wonderful Workplace. Si bien parece que el estudio a cargo es relativamente nuevo, admito que no hizo un muy mal trabajo con esta obra. Más bien, todo lo contrario, sobre todo con el estilo artístico y el diseño de los personajes que vemos agrada mucho. No tiene una gran fluidez que se diga, pero tampoco es necesario ya que consigue su objetivo de entretenernos con una mezcla perfecta de estilos de dibujo y efectos visuales muy bien logrados. Sobre todo al momento de mostrar expresiones, emociones, reacciones… bueno, todo eso pues. La paleta de colores vivos y variados me gusta mucho, al igual que el uso que le dan a las luces y sombras. Los planos casi siempre son los mismos, así que tampoco esperemos vistas impresionantes ni nada por el estilo. Recordemos que estamos hablando de la historia de una mangaka asocial, así que obviamente veremos casi siempre los mismos planos de la habitación o el estudio donde trabaja (y vive) nuestra protagonista. Igual, los detalles al entorno, los diseños y la manera de mostrarnos el trabajo de cada personaje es excelente. Los efectos de sonido también cumplen con lo suyo, al igual que la banda sonora. En fin, aquí les dejo un anime diferente que puede interesarte.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8/10 en lo que respecta al género del Slice of Life y la comedia.

Bei mir steht schon lange ein A1 mit BMCU. Die Maschine läuft ohne ernste Probleme. Und solange das so ist, kaufe ich keinen neuen Drucker. Manchmal wäre allerdings ein zweiter Drucker interessant. Einfach um größere Projekte schneller fertig zu bekommen. Andererseits wäre dieser dann häufig ungenutzt.

Ist es tatsächlich so schwierig mit dem P1S TPU zu drucken? Auf meinem A1 funktioniert das problemlos. Und ich drucke sehr viel aus TPU, meist 95A.

Ein größerer Bauraum bringt einige Nachteile mit sich. Es wird mehr Masse bewegt und die Wege werden länger. Das ist dann meist mit weniger Präzision und geringerer Geschwindigkeit verbunden. Das würde ich nur machen, wenn ich tatsächlich häufig große Bauteile drucken würde, die man nicht teilen kann.

body.title: AI is destroying jobs
body.body: >Estudie diseño grafico por 3 años, esa fue la carrera que elegí en la universidad y aunque la deje y no la termine ya que no me gusto para nada el diseño gráfico, me decepciona bastante ver estas cosas actualmente, me hace pensar que quizás tome la mejor decisión dejando esa carrera, pero a la vez pienso que la IA en algún momento reemplazara a cualquiera en cualquier trabajo no solo en diseño. Y es que últimamente he visto muchos productos nuevos de bastante dudosa procedencia que su “LOGO” o “mascota” es hecho con IA y se ve tan horrible. > I studied graphic design for three years; that was the major I chose in college. Even though I dropped out and didn’t finish the program because I didn’t like graphic design at all, I’m pretty disappointed to see this kind of thing nowadays. It makes me think that maybe I made the right decision by leaving that major, but at the same time, I think that AI will eventually replace anyone in any job—not just in design. The thing is, lately I’ve seen a lot of new products of rather dubious origin whose “LOGO” or “mascot” is made with AI and looks absolutely awful. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Hace mas de un mes vi el primer producto extraño en el supermercado, me llamo la atención porque las frutas que estaban en el empaque se parecían muchísimo a las famosas frutas de TikTok que últimamente se han hecho virales, historias dramáticas y bizarras representadas con un video hecho con IA inspirándose en frutas y aunque no lo parezca tienen un estilo bastante peculiar que la IA no puede evitar replicar una y otra vez, además de que suelen tener un aspecto demasiado cargado, lleno de muchos elementos que hacen que se vea simple, barato y de mala calidad, definitivamente esas frutas en el empaque de gomitas son IA. > Over a month ago, I saw the first strange product at the supermarket. It caught my attention because the fruits on the packaging looked a lot like the famous TikTok fruits that have recently gone viral—dramatic and bizarre stories depicted in AI-generated videos inspired by fruits. Even though it might not seem like it, they have a rather peculiar style that AI can’t help but replicate over and over again, plus they tend to look overly cluttered, packed with so many elements that they appear simple, cheap, and low-quality—those fruits on the gummy packaging are definitely AI-generated. ![photo_2026-04-02_13-06-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xebMVr2dMfysxt9ZpMmFS3ym2nRKRmx11GaLKcW3TiTH2RF8Z7d1aCQEuZLbbgNSG5W.jpg)

>Pero durante estas últimas semanas la cuestión se ha expandido como virus y ahora hay más productos que jamás había visto con empaques hechos con IA, hoy por ejemplo, vi estos cereales de una marca llamada “SUNNY” primera vez en mi vida que veo esa marca y lo peor es que grita IA por todos los lados de la caja, se ve tan falso que parece un cereal de un videojuego, no se explicarlo, pero no creo que compraría ese cereal por gusto, quizás solo por curiosidad compre alguno a ver si sabe tan mal como lo presentan o quizás solo los estoy juzgando mal. Pero realmente me mato la parte trasera del cereal donde el oso esta vestido de brujo, típica imagen de IA. > But over the past few weeks, this trend has spread like wildfire, and now there are more products than I’ve ever seen with packaging designed using AI. Today, for example, I saw this cereal from a brand called “SUNNY”—the first time in my life I’ve seen that brand—and the worst part is that it screams “AI” from every side of the box. It looks so fake that it seems like cereal from a video game; I don’t know how to explain it, but I don’t think I’d buy that cereal on a whim. Maybe just out of curiosity I’ll buy some to see if it tastes as bad as they make it out to be, or maybe I’m just judging it unfairly. But what really bugs me is the back of the cereal box where the bear is dressed as a wizard—a typical AI image. ![IMG_20260517_121848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23w2qUZSmmaSqW9FFoegdtuTmTVATvzib6ExcMw9ns4JTwsiKFwGGChwDNUMFxw3JRQbw.jpg)

>Es que, incluso si te pones a detallar bien hay muchas diferencias y detalles que parecen mínimos pero que logran ser visibles entre la parte delantera y trasera del cereal de oso, que hacen ver que no es un trabajo ni siquiera limpio. Tambien estan estas otras presentaciones de otros sabores donde igualmente usaron la IA, ese oso polar se ve bastante artificial y no me transmite absolutamente nada. > The thing is, even if you look closely, there are many differences and details—seemingly minor ones—that stand out between the front and back of the bear-shaped cereal, which make it clear that the work isn't even clean. There are also these other versions in different flavors where they used AI as well; that polar bear looks pretty artificial and doesn't convey anything to me at all. ![IMG_20260517_121828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wgQ5atfxwz8CtwPDYrSxG3HneyAXbRzyviNRSqBTajjWox5XhoxFfFmzx1MZvdZgjBo.jpg)

>Y finalmente otro producto que vi hoy es estos toallines de cocina que traen a este perrito hecho con IA y obviamente tambien de una marca toda extraña que nadie conoce me preocupa un poco no solo que usen IA sino tambien me pregunto: ¿De donde estan saliendo tantas marcas extrañas, serán productos seguros de consumir? Son preguntas realmente válidas para este país ya que hemos pasado por cosas horribles y nos ha tocado comer cosas asquerosas que ni siquiera son saludables durante crisis económicas que ya estoy un poco traumada con eso. > And finally, another product I saw today is these kitchen wipes featuring this little dog created with AI—and, of course, from some totally obscure brand that nobody’s heard of. It worries me a bit, not just that they’re using AI, but I also wonder: Where are all these strange brands coming from? Are these products safe to use? These are really valid questions for this country, since we’ve been through horrible things and have had to eat disgusting things that aren’t even healthy during economic crises—I’m already a little traumatized by that. ![IMG_20260517_122243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wX5ETx2hy8aAfirWU4jo95uV4CDLQa6PkFG5J1jpQ68SZ35XTo9AEgm9NFVDvm92HGd.jpg)

body.body: Anytime things fall apart, do not lose yourself. Even if catastrophe looms everywhere, do not lose yourself to such controversies. There are times we need to think outside the box. Many are interested in what we have to offer, just because they can see through our desperation. The truth is that there is nothing without a good side and a bad side. \n\nSometimes ago, a friend of mine said to me, \

The unseen moment is real hard work and not compromise.

However, success might come through a backdoor. This kind of success does not last, because it is either gotten through ungodly means or unworthy methods. This is the bad side. 

Another vital point to take note of is that sticking your neck out for a solution doesn't always result in disappointment.

Once out in the parking lot, it was a regular rodeo trying to get out of the spot while others were vying for that spot. Too small of a parking lot-that’s for sure. I’m figuring the second service was probably just as packed! 😇 Once home, it was time to do some laundry and house chores. Long about noon or so, we headed out for about 45 minutes of basking in the dappled shade while @ silvertop was in full sun. I burn way too easily, but wanted some quiet nature time on my garden swing. It was nice! Interestingly enough, there don’t seem to be any ‘shrooms about despite the rain and the humid and coolish temperatures. So, I searched the archives for some lovely specimens. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779068542.0720801) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779068546.0654159) After enjoying the swing, I headed indoors to begin tackling my loft computer area. There’s things that I can get rid of and some things I want to keep. There’s also my Bible collection that needs organizing, so slowly I will go. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779068721.205329) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779068724.82937) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71779068728.481982) Afterwards, I headed back out for another 30 minutes or so in the swing and to read. body.title: My trip to Alicante, Spain. (Day 1)
body.body:
#
A beautiful seaside town

![PXL_20260513_153521851.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQm3ndc5sDsusQoaFZvR8MuCjzbTqc7imLVhUi1Rh53an/PXL_20260513_153521851.MP.jpg) A lot of good travel stories start in an airport and this would be one of them. If you know anything about airports they are expensive for buying virtually anything and waiting in them typically isn't much fun. Then again, airport lounges tend to help. Less crowded and in our case they are a free perk with our credit card. In a place where nothing is free, the lounge is very nice. ![PXL_20260513_163128448.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3jVu2FvMbKHrFJcxjmf5eUcJg6hkCd8jYDbnay3Qfmd/PXL_20260513_163128448.jpg) Now we travelled Ryanair which means we wanted cheap. Nothing is free on Ryanair and seat selection often means you are either paying money of stuck in the middle of two people. Imagine my surprise when I got put in an interesting seat...with actual legroom! ![PXL_20260513_205026599.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYe8DhFc1QWeJnP6k41fBWxSqBBTdYkkGvM2kx3sLaV9N/PXL_20260513_205026599.MP.jpg) ![PXL_20260513_205031077.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf1YDNiuqouRRHGf7nazKX5DajzELLN7UvGnTjJzv7qrg/PXL_20260513_205031077.jpg) Now the trip was delayed and late at night. That pretty much made things suck. I did get some nice views from the air with my window seat ![PXL_20260513_225008146.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQhvKmExaWRydpFzxd1dTQ2e94qG33jxVByGSBDHLBcDq/PXL_20260513_225008146.jpg) And leaving late means we arrived in Alicante really really early in the morning. Something like 2am. Ugh. Still the bus was still leaving from the airport at that time although it was only every hour. I was tempted to get the Cabify app and call a taxi but when people were lining up and the app said the bus would arrive in 6 minutes it seemed like getting a bus and figuring out public transit was the way to go. ![PXL_20260513_234519557.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMeNV4sDwqHMgsocn7hsifrNm16kU9pWUXc5iBrgUYw2/PXL_20260513_234519557.jpg) ![PXL_20260513_235008577.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUAgCmyvDoeT6jGUkkgMHMbt5w11dedmpGjg1JxtqetSM/PXL_20260513_235008577.jpg) My wife put on a smiley face for the camera but she was exhausted from the long long day. ![PXL_20260513_235815662.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXgtF2iDGNkTHa7G3T4KMn5K7vGsy1iwGSCWqdW2GvSiG/PXL_20260513_235815662.jpg) and when I was looking at the deserted streets late at night I will admit I was half thinking to myself... Am I crazy for walking the streets of an unknown town at a time when no sane person should be awake? ![PXL_20260514_001223026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVnwTFKXsfrtBBQKGgTJY9FTCsP55vEdjeLtaPjyFVWz/PXL_20260514_001223026.jpg) Honestly though I don't think I had too much to worry about. The way to the hotel was only 3 minutes long, well lit, and honestly very pretty at 3am or so. ![PXL_20260514_002111110.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNV61VVk11FbQvzf6SEdFTHEpPPF7BFGFo2GDp4itZfV/PXL_20260514_002111110.jpg) We were so happy to finally rest in our room. We noted the wine and chocolate that was given to us by the hotel. ![PXL_20260514_003358082.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaTDnsRguibQ2M2PrdJzFnqSSksUyvY66Vja2p9QHh11p/PXL_20260514_003358082.jpg) Mostly thought we just wanted to go to sleep and the bed was ready and waiting for us after a long long day ![PXL_20260514_003405331.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPqBg7wz8V3EDaGUvjLXPVxsyyYh368A5xhDj8zWfqt7d/PXL_20260514_003405331.jpg) The next morning we awoke to a bright and sunny day and true the view from our window wasn't exactly stunning but then again, not terrible either. ![PXL_20260514_080405913.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY1h6fUZZDXBtdEfS7r1syRWSkT5fBScsY5TvhkKAsNeR/PXL_20260514_080405913.jpg) And the street in front of our hotel didn't exactly saw that we had an upscale address in the middle of something picturesque. ![PXL_20260514_090538227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfZ6bRi4jAZqbj58CQo6nH7NCYj6yPZk3pLaZNqWJqJpU/PXL_20260514_090538227.jpg) And unfortunately the plug adapter we brought to convert from Canadian to European plugs wouldn't fit in their odd receptacles here so our laptops and cellphones were dying and I really didnt want to tackle a foreign city without speaking the language and having no google lens. So, we headed to a local store to buy a local cellphone charger :) ![PXL_20260514_091248074.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2GTsnNCYSB1GeBPQGb7DPXpmoUWhg86t8LqLugiqsMa/PXL_20260514_091248074.jpg) On the way back we found a street market with lots of local produce. There were fruits, vegetables, nuts and all looked very fresh. ![PXL_20260514_092543345.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaj8ZtbdcorexVLX8CjLJeFboRd4xFbTLERmcVirhcSGZ/PXL_20260514_092543345.jpg) ![PXL_20260514_093302393.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW817ogMAxDp99tgLiFfov1Ah1Yr5ZaXdsjP9YtYSn4Yh/PXL_20260514_093302393.MP.jpg) We then returned to the hotel and took some time to charge up our phones before our first forray into the city to see what it had to offer. Now if I had my way? I wouldn't really head out much. I'm much happier just sitting in the hotel room and going out to the pool to relax. So I went to check out the amenities in the hotel. ![PXL_20260514_103716106.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeb1Mtph9Tc5tWjFrj81UVWykBMYgNDhWuPShjvR2q5zU/PXL_20260514_103716106.MP.jpg) It had a nice pool and a nice lounge area. ![PXL_20260514_103806655.PORTRAIT.ORIGINAL.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVWPfrjhGDzX7UWEVgQR8cM9v9rv7FcjoTJ67Ae9XhuJ/PXL_20260514_103806655.PORTRAIT.ORIGINAL.jpg) Plus it also had a hot tub and exercise area but they were pretty cramped. The thing that made me a little sad was that there was no free breakfast. That is a typical perk for Platinum Marriot members like myself but here there was a $20 USD discount which wasn't even half price for the buffet which was...not terrible, but not what I had become accustomed to at Marriott Properties. After breakfast? First trip into town and walking down the famed road by the beach was out first trip out. We were just steps from the pathways near the beach ![PXL_20260514_105857640.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRCoYqJ1dCt19fSXSNVa4C4foo9cB6iCrrPdAHKTGwhAS/PXL_20260514_105857640.MP.jpg) I was amazed by how large the trees were and some of them must have been a century or two old by how large they were. Others formed an canopy that stretched an entire city block long. But the trees were only the first part then they had their famed walking path with palm trees and 3d style bricks that made it look wavy without actually being anything other than flat. ![PXL_20260514_110239046.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRUnCZcVsXicCkKXELS7X9JPCkA6MZY9syP9rhJuJt94R/PXL_20260514_110239046.MP.jpg) We continued on and found an athletic group dancing and jumping by the marina. The music was pumping and the guys were break dancing and generally doing really cool acrobatic stuff. ![Uploading image #22...]() ![Uploading image #23...]() ![PXL_20260514_111600439.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcvGQryf9hixtNVRRMpYRr22cPhXEAniM7QMXCgRC46gC/PXL_20260514_111600439.jpg) ![PXL_20260514_111601242.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8KmZUquRTPJVYo7csXWXMhnQGBrN2TWS5EF1eyE3WPK/PXL_20260514_111601242.jpg) It would have been way more interesting if I had taken a video but.... well, I only got photo's ![PXL_20260514_111840594.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhSSPa19i1oHYAht1i4NWR882yd1a8XyfsFCPHfJREqF/PXL_20260514_111840594.jpg) From the marina we saw San Bernadine castle which would be our go to place for the next day. ![PXL_20260514_111840594.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhSSPa19i1oHYAht1i4NWR882yd1a8XyfsFCPHfJREqF/PXL_20260514_111840594.jpg) And a really cool building in a nice square ![PXL_20260514_111913994.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTgHmCcKNPb4QEJrkHWaR168i2wzJMyogB2Xzkmrvg9Mo/PXL_20260514_111913994.jpg) And we just kept on walking and noticed the actual beach area. I suppose it was a beautiful beach but wow was it crowded. I don't think I would want to hang out with quite that many people. ![PXL_20260514_112154654.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVUxEHQsjVPvKjjwT8yJBKUFzHFwm8HkTTaJoxhkgn6aB/PXL_20260514_112154654.jpg) Remember the trees which formed a canopy? ![Uploading image #30...]() ![PXL_20260514_113144589.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXRdmSxUjM8i3yMyRYxrJn7j5FiXApiJcNj9559ano7cF/PXL_20260514_113144589.MP.jpg) However, once we hit the road out of town we knew that we had walked far enough and decided it was time to return back to the hotel. ![PXL_20260514_113401762.MP.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbxMpmHzZAAiH5HA8X4zd72GD8mAcDTpNe3TivSkAD4Tb/PXL_20260514_113401762.MP.jpg) But not before taking a few more pictures of the beach :) ![Uploading image #33...]() ![PXL_20260514_113514689.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmptthWhxUJP2omiW9wHKxeYqFY9v9KDfEWqhRvQVD87/PXL_20260514_113514689.jpg) Now honestly I would be happy with that as my day. One trip for shopping. One trip for sightseeing. But my wife wanted more clothes for while she was in town. She also didn't want to buy expensive clothes because we are leaving on Ryanair and we have incredibly limited space in our luggage. Result: Thrift store. BIS to be exact ![PXL_20260514_154842753.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6zpVwHGKE3JPkM6n9mxdUoyJruGPYjE4cAW1QituXQ6/PXL_20260514_154842753.jpg) It is actually designed as an \

which steams and washes all their clothes before putting them out and them marketing them as upscale.  Honestly it was a nice little store and best of all the prices were reasonable AND they had a place where a husband could sit while waiting for his wife to be done shopping.

After all that?  My feet were sore and I was tired.  My wife?  She wanted to hit the gym.

I thought about it and .... nah.... I was done for the day.


![PXL_20260514_144942016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevjs2GfitWqMeBmXhk3jBBoajTrMpdRVu8KJxwUr5axF/PXL_20260514_144942016.jpg)


... and that was my first day in Spain.  Overall enjoyable but tiring.

I can't imagine life without electricity. In my region of Western Canada, we have 100% hydroelectric power produced by our generation dams. Power is consistent and reliable 98% of the time. Outages seldom happen like about once every two years for no more than a few hours. However, I Live in an earthquake zone, I have a small capacity electric solar generator that could run my clothes washer or hot plate when needed. A luxury after an earthquake.

Thanks for sharing @noraydaap

body.title: 생과일로 먹을 수 있는 하귤
body.body:
4~5월이 제주 여행하기에 너~무 좋은 날씨입니다.
지난 주말부터 조금 더워지긴 했지만 그래도 이정도면 아직 습하지도 않고 바람도 시원하고 딱 좋은 날씨입니다.
하지만 아쉬운 것은 제주의 과일 귤을 맛볼 수 없다는 것인데요.
요즘 제주에서 파는 귤종류는 대부분 저온창고에 보관해 두었다가 판매하는 것들입니다.
다음주 정도부터는 하우스에서 재배한 귤들도 판매하게 된다고 하지만요.

서귀포를 여행하시다보면 가로수에 귤이 달려있는 나무들을 보실 수 있는데요.

![KakaoTalk_20260518_120446758.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcF2NLdxsJHDey1XmycxW4TJ7WxGYuh7pPfZRfVdBein/KakaoTalk_20260518_120446758.jpg)

하귤입니다.
종종 길가에 잠시 주차를 해 놓고 한두개 따시는 분들을 봅니다.
차량은 주로 렌트카이고... 관광객분들 입니다.
멀리서 가만히 지켜보고 있으면 그렇게 딴 하귤 껍질을 그자리에서 벗겨서 한조각 먹어보고는 그냥 버리고 갑니다.

하귤은 겨울에 먹는 귤들에 비해서 쓴맛이 있어서 즐겨 먹는 과일이 아닙니다만....

그동안 저도 그렇게 생가했었습니다.
하귤 중에서 청을 담그지 않고도 그냥 먹을 수 있는 품종이 있습니다.
아마나스라는 품종인데요. 다른 하귤에 비해서 신맛이 덜하고 단맛이 강해서 생과일로도 먹을 수 있습니다.

![KakaoTalk_20260518_120015064.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRHXA5oPPsmXeg47yRsnWK1aaon3MM3hizDGFARG4b1Kw/KakaoTalk_20260518_120015064.jpg)

크죠~
물론 겨울철에 먹는 귤종류에 비해서 아주 달지는 않습니다.
자몽맛에 가깝다고 해야 할까요?  약간의 쓴맛이 있지만 그냥 먹기에도 괜찮습니다.

그런데 제가 아직 그 아마나스 품종을 구분을 못한다는 것이죠.. ㅎㅎ
서귀포분들은 아마나스 중에서도 햇볕이 더 많은 하효나 보목쪽 아마나스가 더 달다고 할 정도로 맛을 보고도 어느 지역에서 수확했는지도 대충 아신다네요. ㅎ

서귀포 생활 만2년이 다되어 가니 정말 일년 내내 귤을 먹게 됩니다. ㅎ

body.title: (Humor) Sunday's over. [Eng+Spa] Terminando el domingo.
body.body:
> It's Sunday night, and only two things have stood out today: a reversal of my sleep schedule (I went to bed almost at dawn and woke up very late) and I have a bit of a cold (again).

Neither of these things I've mentioned is unusual or new, but they're still annoying.

Anyway, to change the tone of this post a bit and play on the humor of the meme being shared, do you know what the worst thing about Sunday is?

It's that there's always a Monday waiting just around the corner.

Anyway, I still hope you had a good rest this weekend and have a good start to the workweek this coming Monday.

+++*+++*+++*+++

> Estoy en la noche del domingo, y he tenido solo dos cosas resaltantes este día: una inversión del horario de mi día (me fui a la cama casi al amanecer y desperté ya muy tarde) y estoy un poco resfriado (otra vez).

Ninguna de estas cosas que menciono es rara o nueva, pero siguen siendo molestas.

En fin, para cambiar un poco el tono del post y jugar con el humor del meme que se comparte, ¿sabes qué es lo malo del domingo?

Es que siempre hay un lunes esperando a la vuelta del reloj.

Como sea, igual te deseo que hayas descansado bien este fin de semana y que tengas un buen inicio de semana laboral este lunes próximo.

body.title: Istanbul's Morning Silence 🌿
body.body:
The day after I returned from Ankara, I went out for a job very early in the morning. The sun was just rising. Istanbul hadn't fully woken up yet. The streets were quiet. People were just starting the day. At that moment, I realized once again that Istanbul is really a completely different city. Yes, it's very crowded. Yes, traffic sometimes makes people tired. But despite all this, the spirit of Istanbul is very different. It makes people feel alive.


![IMG_2396.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoeFNum2hvNDyVWPoQ3RHpqSxjSEXiqcjtdNcH6GtJgta3Tx3UhPtDLcxDCWQ1AAGPM.jpeg)


I left the house around six in the morning. The weather was incredibly nice. There was a slight coolness, but it was a coolness that opened up. The sky was deep blue. The sun was slowly rising. I was starting to be happy even while walking on the road. I took my tea and the toast my mother made with me in my thermos. I thought, \

Because the place I'm going to wasn't open yet.

![IMG_2370.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EppHKkqtjKsQnMacfWg2uQfhR4pWsjcwE1GQFVnE9QCyVmL6gL2cRu21N5wV8VPekSL.jpeg)

![IMG_2369.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpV9CDuabK6MBVcJEXscNVtLUDkUrcXYtqDa8dLtFeGca6NRYg6D22RcMStogJBQ6XX.jpeg)

![IMG_2371.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpvbeMyFDxHJqvoWn6jwfgkvM6vux2KRMe3hmTBpLs8hnLkZyjoqj6pmGXw2LXj8diZ.jpeg)
 

I walked to Taksim. I was in Taksim for the first time in the morning. Places that were normally very crowded were empty. It was silent. It was peaceful. There were almost no people. It was very good for me to see that calmness. It was as if the city was showing its true face early in the morning.


![IMG_2372.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqYmRaeZJwdqWXRrBGdaDbRhdEtfe5iH2ygp1TA4L2L1iCA931X3YAwx31aiwJyr7aU.jpeg)

![IMG_2374.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpLfTZd3wzYWAPwFxUoncG5mHEvxL2MjRTZ7AtMXLQvgDzNYu2zcyesHozFku3GycXG.jpeg)

![IMG_2373.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoEpVBrjh1BxY3dHyEPCsDSHrKV9TZi4AQMBrdKNBTCuz4aJRnc23QWcE4Q4BuDPT9z.jpeg)


I passed in front of the historical buildings while walking on the road. Some have just started to get sunlight. Those old stone buildings, wide doors, long windows... The history of Istanbul really affects people. I feel like there's a different story in every corner. I took photos. I wanted to record those moments. Because sometimes people don't just want to live, they want to remember that beauty.


![IMG_2375.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpEFvrjSe636kA7zRAzsaEnQ5jkio8DjzfNajJWJW58PAPnJHVZERq35dMdw29haciQ.jpeg)

![IMG_2376.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep3cuowNCDYdz2iXiBoWdv3BePTzst24YJRVieXWUgGAa6BDHaNAiZgf2NqtQezY9nS.jpeg)

![IMG_2377.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep9zYHbLR8YXymwprZqTgLLmrNd5P8WUdqM2b2DhkTaxCDDupgDq41crCqRWB3svGGC.jpeg)


I wandered around Maçka Park. The air of the park is very different early in the morning. The trees were swaying silently. The sounds of birds were coming. It always seems very interesting to me that there are such quiet places in the middle of Istanbul. Huge city on one side, peaceful streets and parks on the other.


![IMG_2383.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EogMnYhtJW7RHpfkQTb9vzQg3fALuQ4pGpLFS2NmhfnDGpq9p1riESH9Li8pPzKxge3.jpeg)

![IMG_2384.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eos1KxLi6YKHX4nn78BMr5o8UM7VbXnW7HDfeHy7uFjyJUeswRCN7V9gcAWb9fc9dhJ.jpeg)

![IMG_2385.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EonkyhTMXtCUp4FTPxNJ7hWuAFqtqpusGCUYg8jUbASHWGMULLJrKVxWZDHcmufgdbh.jpeg)


After a while, I saw an Espressolab. It hadn't opened yet, but the chairs outside were standing. I sat down too. I took out my tea in the thermos. I started eating the toasts my mother made. I was really peaceful at that moment. People sometimes find the greatest happiness in very small moments.


![IMG_2381.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23w2sMN1xKECjTpokRABVHMcC2og61emVYbutK9SepkVdugW1ms77dc56Rm9kJ7Kz7qJB.jpeg)

![IMG_2379.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoke3gwSeqzV573DdZMrw4WkP7dzGBo7X1DbnasA3BF6fB22sdmy5mRMCNgn3SegJ8v.jpeg)

![IMG_2380.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoiW7tXsQFsxT1Ka7M3C8yaqEoGtWu14iYvMTUhBoguwGE65xCrBJ9FwAYcZy63EAfC.jpeg)


Then two of my little guests came. Two kittens. They were smaller. They were so sweet. First they looked at me from afar. Then they slowly came to me. So I gave some of the cheddar in my toast. They loved it so much... They both started eating with excitement. I think they are quite full. Having breakfast with them made my morning even better.


![IMG_2394.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoeEN34jL8QmRnGrMuKaBX31nyuMgahungcZ64JhvkCii7uRzjzTkDFyp5XxnzDQXeL.jpeg)

![IMG_2395.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EokdB1S1SrhYH8RWL7vXNRveWCRKeJ6zAvd3yxew1x8n1psRDdDA2uPJuqTSnFAiej1.jpeg)


Cats are like a part of the soul of Istanbul. It's hard to spend a day in this city without encountering cats. But I think it's a very good thing. One feels in a warmer place. Sharing the same streets with those little creatures always gives me peace.


![IMG_2401.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpvgTiCbLiNezdHquZuxDJYbCV1nevQjJNZq368rfqLpUqbuVVSfS5h62sMMToH9tWe.jpeg)

![IMG_2398.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpA1Uzv5SiJiyYYoR5ArfkXiAounMgme9Z5zQUACuRdpKAXGz2N9UB5ZL33ATWe7zDS.jpeg)

![IMG_2400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eou7pJu5aMq5dP85MVUT97QSpEHX2KYpjmUtTWKWVydLyKNoukUv4m9y4kNHUkuertV.jpeg)


After breakfast, I started walking again. The streets were slowly getting crowded. People were going to work. The cars were multiplying. But I still had that calm feeling of the morning. I walked on the one hand and watched the surroundings on the other. Florists were opening their new shops. The grocery stores were arranging their products. The city was awake.


![IMG_2402.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EopsWC9EHzM9Nfo6waDUr3FgA2xgT2h8m4YXP7ChtYbDp8H23f7z6p5rJVnchiMsofY.jpeg)

![IMG_2403.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eou7J3xXB1WnN9XgyigZuog9m1Sdi7hMkRLaV8dtvURx8rT889ruRhq56Ap1CVYUdNm.jpeg)


I saw colorful flowers passing by a florist. Red roses, white daisies, purple flowers... Everything looked more beautiful when the morning sun hit them. Istanbul sometimes makes people feel like they are on the movie scene.


![IMG_2438.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xAZgWFwmZM7bPqChTDtBQziUVEphjkton19CbWVzXFCH2JFCeEJH1qm36yXAfPciXai.jpeg)


I really love Istanbul. I love it even though it's tiring sometimes. Because there is life here. There is movement. There is history. There is a sea. There are streets. There are people. And most importantly, there is a different story every day.


![IMG_2405.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eou9DyygVNFjfEKb3VWyvNdiNVArSitHcBswrAGg66AFoCLhRqCUtAdCjQAHRg8Cex8.jpeg)

![IMG_2404.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoiUgGBNL7qHxnGQXDUPB2f3LMM7jKrLeLFs6NnfCBYefoayRvXX3tJCyd8fJVF2VWQ.jpeg)


Right now, while I'm writing these, I'm watching the morning sun from my balcony again. The sky is slowly lighting up. I have a great feeling of gratitude. Sometimes in life you just need to know the value of such small moments. A cup of tea, a beautiful morning, quiet streets, two little cats... One should not actually look for happiness far away.


![IMG_2406.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep5mmmLoRpi2DY4eQY3rF4cZEYapVTR2M7dZTTumxuifptniddJk8Tw94jBKXfaVvmS.jpeg)


I thank my Lord for giving me these beautiful moments. I am grateful that I am healthy, that I can walk, that I can see, that I can feel. Because sometimes the greatest wealth is peace.


![IMG_2407.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoK7GS3BSjDSHrpErx2aaHFPBdMpoGcWBbXSnddfXQc98miB3oPjrYRAkjv51TXcoKN.jpeg)


If you come to Istanbul one day, see not only the crowd during the day, but also the morning. Walk on the streets very early. Get to know the city in its quiet form. I'm sure you feel the peace I feel too.

I wish everyone a very beautiful, peaceful and hopeful day 🤍

Hoy fue un día perfecto para caminar por la ciudad. Comencé mi recorrido en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de los pájaros me dieron la energía que necesitaba. Mientras caminaba, me encontré con una artista callejera que pintaba un mural vibrante. Me detuve a observar su trabajo y conversé con ella; me contó que se inspiró en las historias de la gente que pasa por allí. Más adelante, conocí a un anciano que caminaba con su perro. Me contó anécdotas sobre la ciudad y cómo ha cambiado a lo largo de los años. Sus historias eran fascinantes, llenas de nostalgia y sabiduría. Al final del día, regresé a casa no solo con el cuerpo en movimiento, sino también con nuevas perspectivas y conexiones. Cada caminata es una pequeña aventura que siempre me sorprende. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: 公車上的閱讀者們
body.body: >Unsplash 這陣子在通勤的路上有意無意的發現，好多人都在用手機閱讀，雖然我無法肯定閱讀的內容，但看那種頁面格式，大概率是網路小說，而且很讓我訝異的是有男有女，也有的是年紀大我一輪的，年輕人也很多，讓我不禁想起電影功夫的最後一幕，人人都在練功，象徵一個文化型態正在蔓延。 當然這邊還是要善意提醒，在交通工具上閱讀，多少會有不良的影響，除了光線昏暗因素，也要考慮晃動對眼睛帶來的負荷，我以前也當這些是耳邊風，直到眼睛開始不太對勁的時候，才比較注意這些。 網路小說在我的生活圈中，算是非常小眾的，我自己也是偶而看個一部，還不一定追得完，並不是一次追好幾部的那種，前陣子好不容易看了一部大奉打更人，才能用來當作談資，不過也就這一部而已。 我猜想會不會是後來很多戲劇是用網路小說改編的，才會有我開頭提到的現象，當然這只是我沒證據的憑空猜測，我也不會一口咬定就是這樣的因果關係。畢竟我也不是什麼專家來著，只能用個人的觀察來隨意推斷。 看小說的確有小說的魅力、好處所在，文字的世界天馬行空限制較少，如果單純只有戲劇，很容易被框架限制住想像，舉個例子像是魔戒、哈利波特，要不是先在小說架構起來，並且取得成功，戲劇方面可能不會有念頭去做這樣的嘗試，也比較難會有類似的作品類型產生。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/qrmfd)
